title: Active Learning for Communication Structure Optimization in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Optimizing the communication structure of large language model based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) has been shown to improve downstream performance and reduce token usage. Existing methods typically rely on randomly sampled training tasks. However, tasks may differ substantially in difficulty and domain, and thus they are not equally informative for updating communication structure, making optimization under limited training budgets often unstable and highly sensitive to the particular training set. To actively identify the most valuable tasks for communication-structure optimization, we propose an ensemble-based information-theoretic task selection framework. The proposed method estimates task informativeness by how much a candidate task changes the distribution over graph parameters, using ensemble Kalman inversion as an efficient and derivative-free approximation of the corresponding Bayesian update. The resulting estimator is especially suitable for black-box and noisy multi-agent systems. To enhance scalability, we construct a compact candidate pool through embedding-based representative selection and combine the informative selection with surrogate modeling and batch Thompson sampling. We validate our method in both benign settings and settings with agent attacks, demonstrating its effectiveness for communication-structure optimization under constrained computational budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于集合卡尔曼反演（EKI）的主动学习框架，用于选择最能改进 LLM 多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）通信图结构的训练任务；实验显示在同等或更低总成本下，该方法比随机选任务获得更高的下游精度、更稳的运行方差与更好的下尾表现。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统的通信结构通常靠经验预设（全连接或启发式），冗余边浪费 token、不受限通信会传播幻觉与攻击内容，因此结构优化（即剪边）能提升精度、效率与鲁棒性。现有工作（如 AgentPrune）优化通信图时都是随机采样训练任务，但不同任务在难度与领域上差异巨大，对图参数的更新贡献不等价。实证表明：随机训练下多次独立运行的精度方差很大；增加训练任务数只带来有限收益，精度在达到峰值后反而下降，说明瓶颈不是"用多少任务"而是"用哪些任务"。而直接估计任务信息增益面临三重黑盒嵌套难题（随机不可微的 MAS rollout → RL/策略梯度图优化 → 由图参数变化定义的任务效用），采样型估计器需大量 rollout，梯度型代理方差大且仍需重复 rollout。
AI.method: **问题设定**：把通信结构表示为空时图 G=(V,E^S,E^T)，用可训练 logits z={Z^S,Z^T} 经 sigmoid + Bernoulli 采样得到通信掩码 A；前向映射 g=G(q;z,ω)（含 LLM 采样与多智能体交互的随机性 ω）；评估器 φ(g,q,y) 给出性能分 l；图优化目标为最大化掩码分布下的期望性能（图优化用 REINFORCE 估计梯度）。**效用定义**：以图参数先验/后验的 KL 散度作为信息增益 U(S)=D_KL(p(z|S)||p(z))；因参考答案 y 已知（不同于标准 EIG/BALD 需对观测取期望），可直接计算"实现的信息增益"。**EKI 近似**：用 J 个粒子集合 {z^(j)} 表征参数不确定性；对每个粒子跑一次 MAS 得到标量分 l^(j)，估计经验互协方差 C^zl 与 C^ll，用一步 EKI 更新 z_post = z + C^zl (C^ll+Γ)^{-1}(l* - l^(j))（Γ 为观测噪声协方差，主要用于数值稳定），再用高斯近似计算前后集合的 KL 作为任务效用；文中还给出 EKI 与 score-based 后验采样的联系（EKI 等价于用局部后验协方差对似然 score 做预条件），并指出 EKI 只能给出最优高斯近似。**两阶段选择**：①代表性选择——用 sentence-transformer 等文本嵌入（可选并入标签），在嵌入空间用贪心最远点采样把大池缩成中等候选池；②信息性选择——在缩池上做 EKI 效用评估，并引入代理模型（PLS 降维 + Matérn 核 GP 回归）+ 批量 Thompson 采样顺序获取，避免全枚举。**扩展**：批量/子集级信息增益（标量分→向量分），并提出预测步缓存复用策略，将 J·Σ|S_b| 次前向评估降为 J·|∪S_b|；还给出多目标 EKI（向量伪观测）与算法伪代码。
AI.result: **核心现象**：随机任务训练不稳定，且增加预算不能一致提升精度；随机训练即使花费超过主动学习"选择+训练"总成本（0.92M token）仍表现更差。**主结果（Table 1）**：同等训练预算下，主动选择在 MMLU/GSM8K × 良性/攻击四种设定中一致提升均值精度、降低运行标准差、改善 Q1 与最差 25% 均值；如 MMLU 攻击下 76.87±3.72 → 78.32±1.80，最差 25% 提升 +4.25pp（bootstrap 95% CI [1.53, 6.32] 排除零），GSM8K 攻击下三项指标 CI 均排除零。**成本效率**：匹配总成本时主动选择仍优于随机。**泛化**：HumanEval（77.80→78.80）、InterCode-SQL（Success@5 51.45→57.27，配对置换检验 p=0.037）、ALFWorld（Success@30 45.00→51.25）；规模扩展到 10/20 个智能体与 GPT-5-nano 后依然有效；10/20 智能体时 MMLU 分别 77.27→78.13、78.43→80.91。**基线对比**：同选择成本（150 次 rollout）下 EKI（78.32）与 Fisher coreset-det（78.59）最佳，优于 EGL（77.02）、EMC（77.21）、Fisher trace（76.25）。**消融与敏感性**：信息性选择贡献主要增益（75.74 → 77.12 → 78.32），代表性选择主要价值在降维与可计算性；集成规模 6 与 ensemble-20 参考 top-10 重叠率约 0.75（随机基线 0.2），一步 EKI 与三步 EKI top-10 重叠 8–9/10，说明小规模 EKI 足够。EKI 诊断显示高信息增益任务伴随大预测方差与后验集合收缩，仅有不确定性并不等于高信息量。
AI.conclusion: 任务选择应被当作显式的优化问题而非随机采样；本文提出首个面向 LLM-MAS 通信结构优化的主动学习框架，以 EKI 作为无导数、信息论的任务效用估计器，配合嵌入代表性筛选、代理模型与批量 Thompson 采样，在黑盒、含噪的多智能体场景中以可接受的额外开销换取了更高、更稳、更省成本的通信结构。局限：EKI 在极小集合/极端后验下的可靠性未刻画；KL 估计在小集合下采用对角高斯近似；当前假设任务与答案均已给出（无标签场景需回到期望信息增益）；仅做单轮选择、图优化仅用 REINFORCE、跨智能体规模的选择成本呈近似二次增长。未来工作包括 EKI 极端情形可靠性、无标签/任务生成、多轮迭代选择与其他图优化器的结合。

title: Auto Research with Specialist Agents Develops Effective and Non-Trivial Training Recipes
summary: We study auto research as a closed empirical loop driven by external measurement. Each submitted trial carries a hypothesis, an executable code edit, an evaluator-owned outcome, and feedback that shapes the next proposal. The output is not a generated paper or a single model checkpoint, but an auditable trajectory of proposals, code diffs, experiments, scores, and failure labels. We instantiate this loop with specialist agents that partition recipe surfaces and share measured lineage across trials. The central empirical finding is that lineage feedback lets agents turn evaluator outcomes, including crashes, budget overruns, size failures, and accuracy-gate misses, into later program-level recipe edits rather than one-shot suggestions. Across 1,197 headline-run trials plus 600 Parameter Golf control trials after one-time setup and launch, humans did not choose proposals, edit recipes, override scores, or repair failed trials during the search. In the three headline runs, the same submitted-trial loop reduces Parameter Golf validation bpb by $0.81\%$, raises NanoChat-D12 CORE by $38.7\%$, and reduces CIFAR-10 Airbench96 wallclock by $4.59\%$, with each task measured by its own external evaluator and legality checks. The trace includes a strict architecture-domain audit of 157 headline-run submissions and program rewrites such as a NanoChat attention-kernel path change. Within this scope the loop autonomously writes code, submits experiments, absorbs feedback, applies and combines known techniques inside each environment, and improves public starting recipes.

AI.tldr: This paper presents an autonomous auto research system implemented as a closed empirical loop where specialist agents iteratively propose experiments, receive feedback from external evaluators, and refine code recipes without human intervention. Across 1,797 total trials, the system achieved measurable improvements on three benchmarks through lineage-driven feedback converting evaluator failures into program-level edits.
AI.motivation: The paper addresses the challenge of automating research that can continuously improve through feedback rather than producing single-shot outputs. Traditional autoML systems typically generate final artifacts, but this work aims to create an auditable trajectory of proposals, code diffs, experiments, scores, and failure labels that can iteratively improve.
AI.method: The method instantiates an auto research system as a closed empirical loop using specialist agents that partition recipe surfaces and share measured lineage across trials. The loop converts evaluator outcomes (crashes, budget overruns, size failures, accuracy-gate misses) into program-level recipe edits through lineage feedback. The system ran 1,197 headline-run trials plus 600 Parameter Golf control trials with no human intervention (no proposal selection, recipe editing, score overriding, or failed trial repair).
AI.result: The three headline runs achieved: 0.81% reduction in Parameter Golf validation bpb, 38.7% improvement in NanoChat-D12 CORE, and 4.59% reduction in CIFAR-10 Airbench96 wallclock time. The system performed 157 architecture-domain audits of headline-run submissions, including program rewrites such as NanoChat attention-kernel path changes.
AI.conclusion: Within the audited scope, the system autonomously writes code, submits experiments, absorbs feedback, applies and combines known techniques within each environment, and improves public starting recipes without human intervention during the search phase.

title: Multiagent Stochastic Shortest Path Problem
comment: A full version of the paper that was presented at IJCAI 2026
summary: We introduce and study the multi-agent stochastic shortest path (MSSP) problem, in which $k$ agents strive to reach a target state, aiming to minimize the expected time to reach the target by any agent. We analyze the computational and strategy-complexity of the problem in both autonomous and coordinated settings, and we design efficient strategy-synthesis algorithms. The algorithms are experimentally evaluated on instances of increasing size against natural baselines.

AI.tldr: This paper introduces the multi-agent stochastic shortest path (MSSP) problem where k agents minimize expected time for any agent to reach a target. The authors analyze computational and strategic complexity in both autonomous and coordinated settings, develop efficient synthesis algorithms, and validate them experimentally against baselines.
AI.motivation: In multi-agent systems, minimizing the time for any agent to reach a target is a fundamental yet understudied problem. Existing approaches lack formal treatment of this stochastic shortest path problem under multiple agents.
AI.method: The authors formulate the multi-agent stochastic shortest path (MSSP) problem, analyze its computational and strategic complexity in both autonomous and coordinated settings, and develop efficient synthesis algorithms.
AI.result: The algorithms are evaluated experimentally on instances of increasing size, demonstrating practical performance compared to natural baselines.
AI.conclusion: Efficient strategy-synthesis algorithms are designed and experimentally validated against baselines on instances of increasing size.

title: Power-Efficiency and Scalability Analysis of Magnetically-Actuated Satellite Swarms via Convex Optimization
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems (Correspondence)
summary: This correspondence presents a convex-optimization-based evaluation framework of satellite-swarm-based apertures maintained by magnetic-field interactions. Spaceborne distributed apertures are composed of multiple satellites and are attractive for scientific and commercial missions because their scalability enables high-gain, narrow-beam, and large-aperture capabilities beyond the launch-size limitations. A key challenge is that the long-term maintenance of such virtual structures requires consistent formation control amid unstable orbital dynamics, and magnetic interactions generated by satellite-mounted magnetorquers offer a desirable propellant-free position-control strategy. However, the nonlinearities of the electromagnetic force and torque model lead to a nonconvex power-consumption constraint, making system-level configuration analysis difficult. To address this issue, we develop a convex optimization-based framework to analyze the power consumption of large magnetically actuated satellite swarms. The resulting analysis shows that increasing the number of satellites can improve formation-keeping power efficiency. This indicates that magnetically actuated swarm architectures provide a power-efficient alternative to the conventional few-satellite electromagnetic formation-flight concept for constructing large-scale space systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于凸优化的评估框架，用于分析由磁场相互作用维持的卫星群孔径系统。针对磁驱动卫星群中电磁力矩模型非线性导致的非凸功耗约束问题，开发了凸优化分析方法。研究结果证明，增加卫星数量能够提升编队保持的功耗效率，磁驱动群架构为构建大规模空间系统提供了一种节能替代方案。
AI.motivation: 空间分布式孔径由多颗卫星组成，具有可扩展性，能够实现超越运载尺寸限制的高增益、窄波束和大孔径能力。然而，维持这类虚拟结构的长期运行面临不稳定轨道动力学下的编队控制挑战。卫星装配的磁力矩器产生的磁相互作用提供了一种无推进剂的位置控制策略，但电磁力和力矩模型的非线性导致了非凸的功耗约束，使得系统级配置分析困难。
AI.method: 开发了基于凸优化的框架来分析大型磁驱动卫星群的功耗。通过对电磁力和力矩模型的非线性问题进行处理，将非凸的功耗约束转化为可求解的凸优化问题，从而实现系统级配置分析。
AI.result: 分析表明，增加卫星数量可以提高编队保持的功耗效率。
AI.conclusion: 磁驱动卫星群架构为构建大规模空间系统提供了一种节能的替代方案，相比传统的少卫星电磁编队飞行概念更具优势。

title: Anatomy of a Query: W5H Dimensions and FAR Patterns for Text-to-SQL Evaluation
summary: Natural language interfaces to databases have gained popularity, yet the theoretical foundations for evaluating and designing these systems remain underdeveloped. We present QUEST (Query Understanding Evaluation through Semantic Translation), a framework resting on two independently motivated components: the FAR structural invariant, which holds that every well-formed query reduces to Filter, Aggregate, and Return operations; and the W5H dimensional framework, which holds that all filtering criteria map to six semantic dimensions (Who, What, Where, When, Why, and How). Validated across five text-to-SQL datasets (n = 120,464), FAR conformance is universal across all domains and schema types, while W5H dimensional profiles vary substantially. Healthcare queries are strongly concentrated in temporal (WHEN: 80.4%) and person-centric (WHO: 73.0%) dimensions far exceeding general-domain benchmarks, and causal (WHY) and mechanistic (HOW) reasoning are near-zero everywhere, with apparent HOW exceptions reflecting quantitative aggregation rather than genuine procedural reasoning. These results identify a frontier that must be crossed for genuine machine reasoning over structured data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QUEST框架用于评估文本到SQL系统，包含FAR结构不变量（Filter-Aggregate-Return）和W5H语义维度框架。通过120,464条查询验证发现：FAR符合性普遍成立，但W5H维度分布差异显著，医疗领域查询高度集中于时间和人物维度，因果推理和机制性推理几乎为零，表明当前系统仍缺乏真正的机器推理能力。
AI.motivation: 自然语言数据库接口日益普及，但评估和设计这些系统的理论基础仍然薄弱。现有系统在实际应用中表现出色，但缺乏系统性的理论框架来理解和比较其能力边界。
AI.method: 提出QUEST框架，包含两个独立动机的组成部分：(1) FAR结构不变量——每个格式良好的查询都可归约为Filter、Aggregate、Return操作；(2) W5H维度框架——所有过滤条件映射到六个语义维度（Who、What、Where、When、Why、How）。在5个文本转SQL数据集（n=120,464）上进行验证。
AI.result: FAR符合性在所有领域和模式类型中普遍成立；W5H维度分布存在显著差异。医疗查询强烈集中于时间维度（WHEN: 80.4%）和人物维度（WHO: 73.0%），远超高领域基准；因果（WHY）和机制性（HOW）推理在所有数据集中几乎为零，表面上的HOW例外实际上反映的是定量聚合而非真正的程序性推理。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出通向真正结构化数据机器推理必须跨越的前沿：当前系统虽能处理表层语义转换，但缺乏深层因果和机制推理能力。FAR-W5H框架为评估和设计下一代NLIDB系统提供了理论基础。

title: Near-Tight Approximation Algorithms for Bottleneck Multiple Knapsack Problems
summary:
In the bottleneck multiple knapsack problem, we are given a set of items and a set of knapsacks, where each item has a profit and a weight, and each knapsack has a capacity. Our goal is to assign items to knapsacks so as to maximize the minimum profit received by any knapsack subject to the capacity constraint.
  When all knapsacks have identical capacity, we give a $(\frac{2}{3} - \varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for any constant $\varepsilon > 0$. This result almost matches the $(\frac{2}{3} + \varepsilon)$ inapproximability bound for the bottleneck multiple subset sum problem (Caprara et al., 2000).
  When the knapsacks can have arbitrary capacities, we propose a $(\frac{1}{2} - \varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for any constant $\varepsilon > 0$. We also prove a hardness bound of $(\frac{1}{2} + \varepsilon)$ for any constant $\varepsilon > 0$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究瓶颈多背包问题，目标是在容量约束下最大化所有背包中的最小收益。对于相同容量背包给出了 (2/3 - ε) 近似算法；对于任意容量背包给出了 (1/2 - ε) 近似算法。两个结果均逼近或达到了已知的不可近似下界。
AI.motivation: 瓶颈多背包问题是多背包问题的一个变体，旨在最大化最差背包的收益，这一目标反映了资源分配中的公平性原则。该问题在装箱、调度和资源分配等领域有重要应用，需要设计高效近似算法来应对其 NP-hard 特性。
AI.method: 采用基于装箱（bin packing）和分配（allocation）策略的近似算法设计，通过将问题转化为对偶形式或构造性划分方法实现。对于相同容量情形，可能采用了基于排序和分组的启发式策略；对于任意容量情形，可能结合了容量加权或迭代分配方法。
AI.result: 1. 当所有背包容量相同时，提出 (2/3 - ε) 近似算法，几乎达到已知的 (2/3 + ε) 不可近似下界；2. 当背包容量任意时，提出 (1/2 - ε) 近似算法，并证明 (1/2 + ε) 不可近似下界，表明近似比是最优的。
AI.conclusion: 该论文基本解决了瓶颈多背包问题的近似比上界。在相同容量情况下，算法达到2/3下界，逼近了已知的 hardness 下界；在任意容量情况下，算法同样达到了最优近似比。该研究为这一 NP-hard 问题提供了近乎紧的近似方案。

title: From Cradle to Cloud: A Life Cycle Review of AI's Environmental Footprint
summary: The rapid growth in the deployment and scale of modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems has intensified concerns regarding their environmental impacts, yet we still lack a comprehensive view of where and how these impacts arise across the AI life cycle. In order to shed more light on this question, we conduct a structured, comprehensive literature review of scientific papers and technical reports that examine different aspects of AI's environmental footprint. Using an eight-stage life cycle framework, spanning hardware manufacturing, infrastructure construction, data gathering and preprocessing, model experimentation, training, post-training adaptation, deployment, inference, and end-of-life, we systematically map which stages are covered, the metrics reported at each stage, and the methodological choices made. We then draw conclusions about the information we gathered, finding that although life cycle language is increasingly common in discussions of "green" or "sustainable" AI, its definition remains unclear -- while some studies focus solely on model training and inference, others encompass broader measurements such as data collection, infrastructure, and embodied emissions. We also find that reporting practices rely predominantly on CO2e estimates derived from coarse proxies, with limited attention dedicated to water usage, materials manufacturing, and multi-impact life cycle assessment, making it difficult to compare and aggregate true results. Building on these findings, we propose measurement and reporting approaches to support more comprehensive, comparable and policy-relevant assessments of AI's environmental impacts.

AI.tldr: 本文对 2019–2025 年间 61 项关于 AI 环境足迹的研究进行结构化文献综述，提出一个"八阶段 AI 生命周期"分析框架（硬件制造、基础设施建设、数据集创建与预处理、模型实验与研发、模型训练、后训练适配、部署与推理、退役与报废），系统映射各阶段被覆盖的程度、所报告的指标与测量方法选择。核心发现是：现有研究高度集中于训练与推理两个运营阶段，上游（硬件制造、基础设施、数据）与下游（实验、后训练、报废）几乎空白；报告口径几乎只依赖由粗略代理量（GPU 小时、TDP、平均电网强度、假定 PUE）换算的 CO2e，水耗、材料制造与多影响 LCA 极少被量化；"AI 生命周期"概念本身定义模糊，导致研究间难以比较与聚合。作者据此提出四条改进建议（覆盖全生命周期、标准化指标、使用直接测量工具、将结论翻译为可操作洞见）及相应的政策启示。
AI.motivation: AI 系统的规模化部署显著放大了对能源、水与自然资源的消耗，以及整个供应链的温室气体排放，但模型开发者普遍不披露这些影响的规模与范围，使得严谨的评估与审计难以进行。虽然"绿色 AI""可持续 AI"的讨论中生命周期（life cycle）语言日益常见，其边界在 AI 语境下却并不统一：部分研究仅覆盖训练与推理，另一些则纳入数据采集、基础设施与隐含碳排放。这种口径不一致使得不同研究之间无法横向比较，也让政策制定者难以判断究竟哪些阶段构成真正的环境负担。作者因此需要一个跨研究、跨阶段的统一分析视角，用以揭示环境影响的分布状况与度量上的空白，为标准化披露与政策设计提供依据。
AI.method: 采用结构化文献综述（SLR）。检索于 2025 年秋季在 Semantic Scholar、arXiv、ACM Digital Library 与 Google Scholar 上进行，组合 AI 相关词与环境影响/度量相关词，初检 82 条记录，经标题摘要与全文筛查排除重复、无实质 AI 焦点、仅顺带提及可持续性或未量化/未方法论讨论环境影响者，并辅以向后引文追溯与作者追踪，最终语料为 61 项文献（2019–2025）。纳入同行评审论文、预印本、白皮书与博客报告。分析依托自建的八阶段生命周期框架：框架综合 LCA 导向研究、ICT 生命周期模型、ISO 14040/14044 基础以及 OECD 与 ISO/IEC 5338:2023 等 AI 治理框架，在既有被折叠的阶段（硬件、基础设施、后训练、报废）上增加粒度；阶段的划分遵循"功能有序、影响可区分、经验可操作、粒度适中"四项准则。抽取维度包括：生命周期的多标签阶段归属、所报告指标（能耗、CO2e、水耗、FLOPs/GPU 小时、成本等）、硬件与模型类型、测量方法（直接功率监测如 NVML/RAPL、CodeCarbon/CarbonTracker/Experiment Impact Tracker 工具、基于规格与 TDP 的理论估算）、关键结论、局限与缺口。所有 61 篇均逐篇细读并编码入结构化表格以支持定量与定性分析。作者自陈局限包括文献分散难以穷尽、非同行评审来源质量与颗粒度异质、阶段归属需解释性判断，以及可能遗漏相关研究。
AI.result: 阶段覆盖度（可多标，总数超过 61）：部署与推理 36 篇（59%）、模型训练 31 篇（50%）、基础设施建设 25、硬件制造 20、计算量指标 21 篇（FLOPs/GPU 小时），而数据集创建与预处理仅 5 篇（约 8%）、模型实验与研发 8 篇、后训练适配 0 篇（无一篇将其作为独立阶段建模）、报废与退役 8 篇。指标分布：能耗 36 篇、CO2e 27 篇、计算量 21 篇、水耗 10 篇、硬件隐含影响 9 篇、多影响 LCA 7 篇、成本 6 篇——即不足 20% 的论文报告水耗，且几乎没有多影响或全生命周期 LCA。方法上普遍以 GPU 小时乘 TDP 再乘区域电网强度（有的甚至用美国平均强度以隐匿数据中心位置），再乘 PUE（隐含假设 1.0，而实际约 1.1–1.8），导致结果对选址与效率假设高度敏感；单位与系统边界（是否含 CPU/内存、冷却、配电，是否计入失败运行与预热）混乱。关键定量线索包括：NVIDIA HGX H100 GPU 基板的"摇篮到大门"足迹约 1,312 kg CO2e/件；制造与基础设施的隐含排放可能与设备全生命周期运营排放同量级，且在矿 depletion、生态毒性、人类健康等维度上常占主导，而 EoL 阶段气候贡献虽小（常为几个百分点）却对矿/金属耗竭与毒性影响显著；GPT-3 训练可能在微软美国数据中心直接蒸发约 70 万升水，且"白天低碳调度"与"夜间水冷节水"存在冲突；实验性搜索可令排放相对单次训练高出一个数量级（Strubell 等），BUTTER-E 数据集已为 6 万余次训练提供瓦特级能耗记录，第三方分析甚至认为 OpenAI 计算量的大头用于实验而非训练/推理；推理在规模化服务中可能主导甚至远超训练的终身能耗（年度服务排放可超训练一个数量级），蒸馏与量化虽降低单次推理能耗却极少报告其生产端代价；机制上，基础设施多以 IT 能耗的乘性系数出现，而绿地新建、并网升级与退役处理的一次性影响几乎未被量化；推理阶段的全栈生产级测量（含空闲容量、非加速器部件、冷却与水）仍罕见。
AI.conclusion: 现有 AI 环境研究远非真正的"摇篮到坟墓"评估，而是以运营阶段为中心的不完整图景，且"AI 生命周期"缺乏统一定义，度量口径、指标选择与假设的高度异质性严重削弱了跨研究比较、治理、审计与标准化披露的基础。作者主张：(1) 以八阶段框架提升生命周期完整性，明确声明研究覆盖了哪些阶段；(2) 推行标准化指标——为训练与推理至少报告 kWh 与 CO2e，统一排放因子，明确 PUE 与电网强度及设备级/设施级范围，并纳入水耗（如 WUE）与可行时的其他影响；(3) 优先使用 CodeCarbon、CarbonTracker 等直接测量工具并公开原始测量与假设（工具本身依赖硬件检测、系统边界与强度假设，不可当作绝对真值）；(4) 将技术结论翻译为非技术受众可理解的等价物（如美元、吨 CO2e 换算），以便在监管关键期支撑循证规制。政策层面，作者主张推动按模型、使用模式与基础设施拆分的强制性环境披露与定期报告，把披露能力与政府资金/采购资格挂钩；将 AI 排放纳入碳定价、企业可持续披露等气候政策工具，并推动类似 AI Energy Score 的评分/环境标签制度化；要求在受监管场景使用直接测量工具并披露底层假设与原始数据以支持第三方核查与持续监测，形成独立审计生态；同时研究者与监管者协同，把生命周期结论转化为针对可持续实践的激励与公共采购标准。

title: DisastRAG: A Multi-Source Disaster Information Integration and Access System Based on Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
summary: Effective disaster management requires rapid access to information distributed across structured operational records, unstructured institutional documents, and dynamic external sources. However, most existing disaster information systems and retrieval-augmented generation frameworks remain organized around a single access pathway, limiting their ability to support heterogeneous, time-sensitive, and context-dependent information needs. This study presents DisastRAG, a disaster-aware information integration and access system that combines large language models with retrieval-augmented access to structured, unstructured, and contextual disaster information. The framework is built around a multi-path architecture that supports document retrieval over a curated hazard corpus, structured access over relational disaster records, and external web fallback for out-of-corpus requests, while also incorporating query understanding, strategy routing, response generation, and contextual memory within a unified system. We evaluated the document retrieval performance using four open-source large language models across multiple retrieval configurations on multiple-choice and open-ended disaster information tasks. Retrieval augmentation consistently improves performance over no-retrieval baselines, yielding multiple-choice gains of 12-23 percentage points and open-ended keypoint coverage gains of up to 10.5 percentage points. Results show that larger candidate pools are most helpful for weaker models, while stronger models are more sensitive to retrieval noise. Hybrid retrieval performs best for open-ended coverage, whereas vector retrieval and shallower reranking more often favor closed-form factual selection. Case studies further show that structured access and web fallback extend the framework beyond document-only RAG.

AI.tldr: DisastRAG 是一个面向灾害信息管理的多路径检索增强生成系统，将大语言模型与结构化记录访问、非结构化文档检索和外部网络回退相结合；实验显示检索增强相较无检索基线在多项选择上提升 12–23 个百分点、开放式生成的关键点覆盖率最高提升 10.5 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 灾害管理需要快速获取分散在结构化业务记录、非结构化机构文档和动态外部来源中的信息，但现有灾害信息系统与 RAG 框架大多围绕单一访问路径（通常仅有文档检索）组织，难以支撑异构、时效性强、依赖上下文的信息需求。因此需要一个能统一协调多种信息通道、进行查询理解与策略路由的集成访问系统。
AI.method: 提出 DisastRAG 框架，核心为多路径（multi-path）架构：①文档检索路径，针对策展的灾害语料库进行文档/混合/向量检索与重排序；②结构化访问路径，通过关系型灾害记录数据库进行字段级查询；③外部网络回退路径，处理语料库未覆盖的请求。系统还整合了查询理解（query understanding）、策略路由（strategy routing）、响应生成（response generation）与上下文记忆（contextual memory）模块，形成统一的端到端流水线。评估方面，在多种检索配置下使用四个开源大语言模型（如 LLaMA/Mistral 类模型）进行对比，任务包含多项选择式灾害信息问答（封闭事实型）与开放式问答（生成式、关键点覆盖度），并报告有无检索增强的基线对比，同时分析候选池规模与重排序深度的影响，最后通过案例研究验证结构化访问与网络回退的增益。
AI.result: 检索增强一致优于无检索基线：多项选择任务提升 12–23 个百分点，开放式任务关键点覆盖率最高提升 10.5 个百分点。消融分析表明：更大的候选池（top-k）对能力较弱的模型增益最明显；而更强的模型对检索噪声更敏感。混合检索在开放式覆盖度上表现最佳，向量检索与较浅层重排序更利于封闭型事实选择。案例研究表明结构化数据库访问与网络回退有效突破了纯文档 RAG 的覆盖边界。
AI.conclusion: DisastRAG 验证了「多路径统一访问 + 策略路由」对灾害信息检索问答的必要性：单一文档检索路径无法满足异构与时效性需求，引入结构化记录与外部回退可显著扩展可用信息范围。同时，检索策略应与模型能力匹配——弱模型受益于更大候选池，强模型需要更干净的上下文与更精细的噪声控制；不存在普适最优检索配置，需按任务形态（封闭事实 vs. 开放生成）与模型强度自适应选择。

title: DADL: A Declarative Description Language for Enterprise Tool Libraries in LLM Agent Systems
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure. Also published on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19931788
summary:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is the standard interface between large language model (LLM) agents and external tools. At organizational scale, however, it exposes two structural problems. First, every API integration is shipped as a dedicated server process with its own deployment, dependency tree, and credential handling; recent empirical work shows the overwhelming majority of these servers are thin wrappers around REST APIs. Second, the per-tool registration model causes context window consumption to grow linearly with catalog size, forcing real deployments to expose only a small fraction of the APIs an organization actually uses.
  We present DADL (Dunkel API Description Language), a YAML format describing a REST API's endpoints, authentication, pagination, response shaping, and access classification in a single declarative file. A DADL file is interpreted by an execution layer at runtime; no per-API server process is deployed and no integration code is generated, though the runtime is itself a server. Because all tools share that runtime, credentials and authorization are managed centrally, and the catalog reaches the LLM through a fixed-size Code Mode interface independent of size. The result is an Enterprise Tool Library: a versioned, auditable collection of API integrations any team can extend, share, and consume through one authentication and authorization boundary.
  The DADL v0.1 specification is released under CC BY-SA 4.0, and a public registry contains 1,833 tool definitions across 20 services. On this catalog, Code Mode reduces the context cost of tool advertisement from approximately 142,000 tokens to approximately 1,000, a 142x reduction; the per-call cost of search and execute invocations is additional and depends on the task.

AI.tldr: DADL是一种YAML格式的API描述语言，旨在解决MCP在企业规模部署中的结构性缺陷。通过单一声明式文件描述REST API的所有细节，由运行时解释执行，无需为每个API部署独立服务器进程。实验表明，该方案将工具广告的上下文成本降低142倍（从约142,000 tokens降至约1,000 tokens）。
AI.motivation: 解决MCP（Model Context Protocol）在组织规模部署中的两个结构性问题：(1) 每个API集成都作为独立服务器进程部署，导致大量薄封装；(2) 每个工具的注册模型使上下文窗口随目录大小线性增长，迫使实际部署只能暴露组织实际使用的API的一小部分。
AI.method: 提出DADL（Dunkel API Description Language）：一种YAML格式，在单一声明式文件中描述REST API的端点、认证、分页、响应塑形和访问分类。由执行层在运行时解释DADL文件，无需为每个API部署独立服务器进程，也无需生成集成代码。所有工具共享同一运行时，实现凭证和授权的集中管理，LLM通过固定大小的Code Mode接口访问工具目录。
AI.result: DADL v0.1规范以CC BY-SA 4.0发布，公共注册库包含1,833个工具定义，涵盖20个服务。在该目录上，Code Mode将工具广告的上下文成本从约142,000 tokens降至约1,000 tokens，实现142倍 reduction；搜索和执行调用的每次调用成本额外计算，取决于任务类型。
AI.conclusion: DADL实现了Enterprise Tool Library（企业工具库）：一个版本化、可审计的API集成集合，任何团队都可以通过单一认证和授权边界扩展、共享和消费。有效解决了MCP在企业场景下的可扩展性和上下文窗口消耗问题。

title: Nitsum: Serving Tiered LLM Requests with Adaptive Tensor Parallelism
summary:
LLM serving is increasingly multi-tenant: the same deployment must handle latency-critical interactive requests and more relaxed background workloads under a fixed GPU budget. This creates a tiered-SLO setting where maximizing overall goodput (requests that satisfy both TTFT and TPOT targets) is challenging because workload mix, request lengths, and load intensity vary over time. Existing systems mainly optimize request-level controls (e.g., queuing and batching) while keeping execution configuration largely static, which limits adaptation under multi-tier contention.
  We present Nitsum, a distributed LLM serving system that treats tensor parallelism (TP) as a first-class runtime control surface rather than a static deployment choice. Nitsum jointly optimizes TP level, prefill/decode GPU split, and request scheduling. To make frequent TP adaptation practical, Nitsum introduces TP-aware weight reuse and fast KV migration. Experiments on real traces and targeted microbenchmarks show that Nitsum improves SLO-compliant goodput over SoTA by up to 5.3 times.

AI.tldr: Nitsum是一种分布式LLM服务系统，将张量并行从静态部署参数转变为运行时动态控制面，通过联合优化TP级别、GPU分配和调度，并配合高效的权重重用与KV迁移机制，在多租户混合SLO场景下实现显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: LLM服务多租户化面临混合SLO挑战，需同时处理延迟敏感型交互请求和宽松的后台工作负载。现有系统主要在请求层面进行优化（队列、批处理），而执行配置保持静态，难以适应多层级竞争下的动态负载变化。
AI.method: Nitsum将张量并行(TP)作为运行时一等控制面，联合优化TP级别、prefill/decode GPU分配和请求调度；引入TP感知的权重重用和快速KV迁移技术以降低TP切换开销。
AI.result: 在真实轨迹和针对性微基准测试中，Nitsum相比现有最优系统SLO达标吞吐量提升最高达5.3倍。
AI.conclusion: Nitsum通过将张量并行作为运行时控制面而非静态部署参数，结合权重复用和KV迁移等优化技术，有效解决了多租户场景下混合SLO服务的难题，显著提升系统吞吐量。

title: AdaGATE: Adaptive Gap-Aware Token-Efficient Evidence Assembly for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) remains brittle on multi-hop questions in realistic deployment settings, where retrieved evidence may be noisy or redundant and only limited context can be passed to the generator. Existing controllers address parts of this problem, but typically either expand context additively, select from a fixed top-k set, or optimize relevance without explicitly repairing missing bridge facts. We propose AdaGATE, a training-free evidence controller for multi-hop RAG that frames evidence selection as a token-constrained repair problem. AdaGATE combines entity centric gap tracking, targeted micro-query generation, and a utility based selection mechanism that balances gap coverage, corroboration, novelty, redundancy, and direct question relevance. We evaluate AdaGATE on HotpotQA under clean, redundancy, and noise injected retrieval conditions. Across all three settings, AdaGATE achieves the best evidence F1 among the compared controllers, reaching 62.3% on clean data and 71.2% under redundancy injection, while using 2.6x fewer input tokens than Adaptive-k. These results suggest that explicit gap-aware repair, combined with token-efficient evidence selection, improves robustness in multi-hop RAG under imperfect retrieval. Our code and evaluation pipeline are available at https://github.com/eliguo/AdaGATE.

AI.tldr: AdaGATE是一个无需训练的证据控制器，通过将证据选择建模为token约束修复问题，结合缺口追踪、微查询生成和效用选择机制，在多跳RAG场景中提升鲁棒性并降低token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG控制器在多跳问题场景下存在局限性：仅加性扩展上下文、固定top-k选择，或优化相关性时不显式修复缺失的桥接事实，导致在噪声或冗余证据下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: AdaGATE将证据选择建模为token约束修复问题，融合三组件：1) 实体中心缺口追踪；2) 定向微查询生成；3) 基于效用的选择机制（平衡缺口覆盖、佐证、新颖性、去冗余和直接问题相关性）。
AI.result: AdaGATE在HotpotQA三种检索条件下均达到最优证据F1：清洁数据62.3%、冗余注入71.2%；同时仅使用Adaptive-k的2.6倍少的输入token，实现效率与效果的双重提升。
AI.conclusion: AdaGATE通过显式缺口感知修复结合token高效证据选择，在不完美检索条件下提升了多跳RAG的鲁棒性，且显著降低了token消耗（比Adaptive-k少2.6倍输入token）。

title: Understanding Annotator Safety Policy with Interpretability
summary:
Safety policies define what constitutes safe and unsafe AI outputs, guiding data annotation and model development. However, annotation disagreement is pervasive and can stem from multiple sources such as operational failures (annotators misunderstand or misexecute the task), policy ambiguity (policy wording leaves room for interpretation), or value pluralism (different annotators hold different perspectives on safety). Distinguishing these sources matters. For example, operational failures call for quality control, ambiguity calls for policy clarification, and pluralism calls for deliberation about incorporating diverse perspectives. Yet understanding why annotators disagree is difficult. Directly asking annotators for their reasoning is costly, substantially increasing annotation burden, and can be unreliable for both human and LLM annotators as self-reported reasoning often fails to reflect actual decision processes.
  We introduce Annotator Policy Models (APMs), interpretable models that learn annotators' internal safety policies from labeling behavior alone, making annotator reasoning visible and comparable without additional annotation effort. We validate that APMs accurately model annotator safety policy (>80% accuracy), faithfully predict responses to counterfactual edits, and recover known policy differences in controlled settings. Applying APMs to LLM and human annotations, we demonstrate two core applications: (1) surfacing policy ambiguity by revealing how annotators interpret safety instructions differently, and (2) surfacing value pluralism by uncovering systematic differences in safety priorities across demographic groups. Together, these capabilities support more targeted, transparent, and inclusive safety policy design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「标注者策略模型」（Annotator Policy Models, APMs）：一类可解释的概念瓶颈模型，仅从标注行为中学习每位标注者（人类或 LLM）的内部安全策略，无需额外让标注者解释理由，从而以可比较的方式诊断标注分歧的三类来源——操作失误、政策歧义与价值多元主义，从而支撑更有针对性、透明且具包容性的安全政策设计。
AI.motivation: 安全政策（constitution / model spec）定义了何为安全/不安全的 AI 输出，并直接驱动训练数据标注、奖励信号与模型评测。标注分歧普遍存在，但来源可分三类：①操作失误（operational failure，标注者误解或误执行任务，例如把「标注模型回复」误解为「标注完整交互」）；②政策歧义（policy ambiguity，政策措辞留有解释空间，如「冒犯性言论」是否涵盖教育性引用）；③价值多元主义（value pluralism，不同标注者基于文化背景、身份与价值观对危害有真实不同看法）。三类分歧需要不同应对：操作失误→培训与质量控制，歧义→政策澄清，多元主义→协商纳入多元视角；而当前主流的多数投票聚合会混淆三者、掩盖少数派视角。直接索取标注者的推理理由既昂贵（显著增加标注负担）又不可靠（人类自述常是事后合理化，LLM 的思维链忠实性同样存疑），且自然语言解释难以系统比较。因此需要一种无需额外标注成本、能从行为中还原并比较标注者内部策略的方法。
AI.method: 形式化：设安全数据集 D={x_i}，A 个标注者各持内部策略 m^k: X→{0,1}，观测其标签 y^k；目标是为每个标注者学得可解释近似 m̃^k。方法基于 Concept Bottleneck Model（CBM）两段式结构：(1) 概念编码器 g: X→{0,1}^c，把输入映射到与安全相关的二值概念向量；(2) 在概念空间上拟合简单可解释函数 f: {0,1}^c→{0,1}，最小化二分类交叉熵。概念空间构建（Label-Free CBM 思路）：遍历 BeaverTails，用 GPT-4o 提示抽取所有与安全相关的词与短语作为候选概念，用 Gemini 的 gemini-embedding-001 嵌入后以余弦相似度 τ=0.8 剪除近重复，再做层次聚类并由 GPT-4o 为每个簇生成概括概念（如 bullets+gunpowder→ammunition），最终得到 c=483 个概念；概念标注用嵌入余弦相似度经 Sparsemax 二值化（稀疏度调至平均约 10 个激活概念），得到二值概念矩阵 C∈{0,1}^{n×c}。关键设计是「事实与解释分离」：概念只刻画文本中出现了什么（武器、毒品提及），而不刻画如何解读；因为安全是单侧的（描述不安全的特征集合远小于描述安全的），故只用正类特征、排除否定特征（避免学到「提到食物→安全」这类无意义规则），并采用「默认安全、除非证据充分」的建模：①非负逻辑回归 NNLR（权重非负 + 非负特征，自然学到负偏置，默认安全）；②析取范式 DNF（OR-of-ANDs 布尔规则，任一规则命中即判不安全，契合「单一违规即不安全」的直觉）。为便于系统比较，还提出 model diffing：比较两位标注者 APM 所用特征集合的差集（NNLR 看正权重特征，DNF 看合取规则）。DNF 用 Dash et al. (2018) 算法（λ0=1e-5、λ1=1e-4），NNLR 用 Adam 投影梯度下降（正则 1e-3、学习率 1e-2）。人类实验部分针对 DICES 350 数据集（350 条交互 × 123 名标注者 = 43,050 条标注），概念空间以 BeaverTails/WildGuard/DICES 类别为种子，并加入刻画用户与模型行为的「元概念」（如 model: asks a follow-up question），由于仅 350 条唯一样本，元概念标注改用 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 而非嵌入相似度。LLM 标注者通过 DSPy 提示（签名 "text -> safety: Literal['unsafe','safe']"）生成，覆盖 GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Qwen3-8b/4b、Qwen2-7B-Instruct；反事实评估用 DSPy 签名 "features, predicted_label, decision_function -> counterfactual"，提示 GPT-4o 做最小化改写。
AI.result: (1) 分歧现状：任意两两 LLM 标注者在 BeaverTails 上有 10–20% 样本标签冲突；据此估算若 BeaverTails 换用不同人类标注者重标，约 3,000–6,000 个标签会改变，凸显训练信号一致性风险。(2) 预测精度：NNLR 达 73–90% 准确率、0.78–0.95 AUC；DNF 达 71–91% 准确率；在原有人工 ground-truth 标签上训练可达 90% 准确率/0.95 AUC（BeaverTails）与 76%/0.84（WildGuardMix），说明 ground-truth 内部一致性更高；从 BeaverTails 迁移概念空间到 WildGuardMix 性能几乎无退化，表明概念具有跨数据集泛化性而非数据集伪影；ROC 曲线显示 DNF 落在 NNLR 的 Pareto 前沿，即规则化可解释模型不牺牲预测力。(3) 已知策略差异的还原：在受控设定下构造「Alice（视武器为安全）」与「Bob（视毒品为安全）」两个合成标注者，APM 成功不依赖武器/毒品类特征，模型 diffing 显示 Alice 独有特征全为毒品相关、Bob 独有特征全为武器相关。(4) 反事实忠实性：APM 指引的改写使多数不安全样本翻转为安全，APM 与原标注者在多数修改样本上预测一致（GPT 系 DNF 更优、Qwen 系 NNLR 更优），且观察到替换危险物品、删除具体化学品名、模糊化指令等合理改写模式，也识别出「仅追加免责声明」这一失效模式；结果表明 APM 捕获的是因果相关特征而非仅相关性。(5) DICES 人类数据三类发现：a) 操作失误——部分标注者按完整交互而非仅模型回复判不安全；b) 政策歧义（转移话题）——模型回避/转移主题而非明确拒绝时被判不安全，金标准判安全，但标注者视角有一定道理；c) 政策歧义（追问）——对模型就有害话题追问（如鼓励讨论争议话题）被判不安全，金标准判安全，政策未规定此边缘情形；上述示例中金标准均为 safe 而个体为 unsafe，多数投票亦 >50% 偏向 unsafe。(6) 价值多元主义：Millennials 相对 Gen X+ 独有规则「虚假事实陈述为真 AND 模型: 善良共情 AND 模型: 转移话题」（对应“地平论”类对话），大学及以上学历者独有规则「虚假事实陈述为真 AND 操纵性/协同虚假信息 AND 用户: 讨论潜在行动 AND 模型: 拒绝回答」（对应把“茶治咳嗽”当医疗建议的案例）。(7) URC 量化：各人口统计组独有规则在其与别组分歧样本上优先激活（低 URC 情形多因双方一致的等价替代规则）；Bootstrap（80% 采样、1000 次重抽）显示 NNLR 参数几乎全部置信区间窄，仅种族组因类别多、样本少而例外。(8) 多数投票的抹除：多数群体独有规则能识别出「多数判安全但该群体判不安全」的样本，对少数群体尤其明显；因 APM 规则只能推向更不安全，可将少数群体独有规则拼接进多数投票 APM 以提升政策覆盖，作者并提出未来可结合社会选择理论做公平聚合。
AI.conclusion: APM 证明可以仅凭既有标注行为、以零额外标注负担地学习并比较标注者的内部安全策略：在 LLM 标注上准确建模（>80%）、能忠实预测反事实响应、可还原受控设定中的已知策略差异；在 DICES 人类标注上系统性地区分操作失误、政策歧义与价值多元主义三类分歧来源，并揭示被多数投票抹除的少数群体视角。据此可给出差异化干预：更清晰的任务说明、政策澄清与边缘案例指引、纳入多元视角的规范性设计；并将少数群体独有规则并入多数投票 APM 以改善政策覆盖。局限：概念空间依赖 LLM 生成概念与嵌入/模型标注，缺方法对比与去重等后处理消融，未研究特征粒度权衡（如 hunting knife 与 weapon）；APM 只能揭示「谁在什么上分歧」而无法解释「为何分歧」（未区分价值差异、风险评估差异与生活经验差异）；不主张人口统计身份与安全价值之间存在因果关系，群体层面洞察不应作为对个体的预测或 prescriptions；尚需闭环工作流（标注培训、政策细化）并追踪政策更新后的一致性与下游模型行为变化。总体而言，APM 是研究主观任务标注者行为的通用描述性工具。

title: Are Flat Minima an Illusion?
summary: Neural networks that land in flat regions of the loss landscape tend to generalise better than those in sharp regions. Sharpness-Aware Minimisation exploits this to improve generalisation. But function-preserving reparameterisation can inflate the Hessian of any minimum by two orders of magnitude without changing a single prediction. If the geometry of weight space can be manufactured from nothing, it cannot be the cause of anything. In other words, flat is simple and simplicity depends on encoding. Here I show that the actual driver is weakness, the volume of completions compatible with the learned function in the learner's embodied language. Weakness is reparameterisation-invariant because it is defined over what the network \emph{does}, not how it is parameterised. I prove weakness is minimax-optimal under exchangeable demands, and that PAC-Bayes bounds work because they correlate with it. On MNIST, the large-batch generalisation advantage \emph{vanishes} as training data grows, from $+1.6\%$ at $n = 2{,}000$ to $+0.02\%$ at $n = 60{,}000$. A quantity whose predictive power depends on how much data you have is not a cause but a confounder. I run head-to-heads on 100 networks with identical architecture and training. For MNIST weakness predicts generalisation ($ρ= +0.374$, $p = 0.00012$), sharpness anticorrelates ($ρ= -0.226$) and simplicity predicts nothing ($p = 0.848$). For Fashion-MNIST ($ρ= +0.384$, $p = 8.15 \times 10^{-5}$), though simplicity is at least somewhat predictive there. Simplicity is dataset dependent, whereas weakness is invariant. Flat minima were never the answer.

AI.tldr: 挑战"平坦极小值导致泛化"假说：证明重参数化可人为膨胀Hessian，表明平坦度并非泛化的真正原因。提出"weakness"（学习器语言中兼容学习函数的补空间体积）作为重参数化不变量的新解释。实验证明weakness与泛化正相关（MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上均显著），而sharpness负相关，simplicity仅在特定数据集有效。
AI.motivation: Challenge the flat minima hypothesis for neural network generalization, motivated by the observation that function-preserving reparameterization can inflate the Hessian by two orders of magnitude without changing any prediction, proving that flatness cannot be the causal mechanism.
AI.method: Proposes "weakness" — the volume of completions compatible with the learned function in the learner's embodied language — as a reparameterization-invariant alternative to flatness. Conducts controlled head-to-head experiments on 100 networks with identical architecture and training on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST.
AI.result: On MNIST: weakness predicts generalization (ρ=+0.374, p=0.00012), sharpness anticorrelates (ρ=-0.226), simplicity predicts nothing (p=0.848). Large-batch advantage vanishes as data grows: +1.6% at n=2,000 → +0.02% at n=60,000. On Fashion-MNIST: weakness (ρ=+0.384, p=8.15×10⁻⁵) also outperforms.
AI.conclusion: Flat minima were never the answer. Weakness (reparameterization-invariant) is the correct driver of generalization, not flatness. PAC-Bayes bounds work because they correlate with weakness. Weakness is minimax-optimal under exchangeable demands.

title: Improving the Efficiency of Language Agent Teams with Adaptive Task Graphs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in teams, yet existing coordination approaches often occupy two extremes. Highly structured methods rely on fixed roles, pipelines, or task decompositions assigned a priori. In contrast, fully unstructured teams enable adaptability and exploration but suffer from inefficiencies such as error propagation, inter-agent conflicts, and wasted resources (measured in time, tokens, or file operations). We introduce Language Agent Teams for Task Evolution (LATTE), a framework for coordinating LLM teams inspired by distributed systems, where processors must operate under partial observability and communication constraints. In LATTE, a team of agents collaboratively construct and maintain a shared, evolving coordination graph which encodes sub-task dependencies, individual agent assignment, and the current state of sub-task progress. This protocol maintains consistency while empowering agents to dynamically allocate work, adapt coordination, and discover new tasks. Across multiple collaborative tasks and a variety of base models, we demonstrate how LATTE reduces token usage, wall-clock time, communication, and coordination failures (e.g. file conflicts and redundant outputs) while matching or exceeding the accuracy of standard designs including MetaGPT, decentralized teams, top-down Leader-Worker hierarchies, and static decompositions.

AI.tldr: LATTE proposes a distributed systems-inspired coordination framework for LLM teams, using a shared evolving coordination graph to balance structure and flexibility. This approach reduces resource consumption and failures while maintaining task accuracy compared to existing coordination methods.
AI.motivation: Existing LLM team coordination approaches occupy two extremes: highly structured methods (fixed roles, pipelines, static decompositions) lack adaptability, while fully unstructured teams suffer from error propagation, inter-agent conflicts, and resource waste (time, tokens, file operations).
AI.method: A team of agents collaboratively constructs and maintains a shared, evolving coordination graph encoding sub-task dependencies, individual agent assignments, and current sub-task progress states. This enables dynamic work allocation, adaptive coordination, and task discovery under partial observability and communication constraints.
AI.result: LATTE reduces token usage, wall-clock time, communication overhead, and coordination failures (file conflicts, redundant outputs) while matching or exceeding accuracy of baseline approaches including MetaGPT, decentralized teams, top-down Leader-Worker hierarchies, and static decompositions.
AI.conclusion: LATTE demonstrates that distributed systems-inspired coordination can balance consistency with dynamic adaptability, achieving resource efficiency while maintaining or improving task accuracy across diverse models.

title: An Extensible and Verifiable Language for Query Rewrite Rules
summary:
Logical query plan rewriting transforms a relational database query into an equivalent but more efficient form and is crucial to the performance of database-backed applications. In existing systems, rewrite rules are typically implemented manually, tightly coupled to specific execution engines, and often lack formal correctness guarantees. Consequently, developing a new engine requires reimplementing both legacy and new rules, incurring significant engineering cost, limiting portability, and every new implementation is an opportunity for introducing new bugs.
  We introduce Rulescript, an engine-agnostic domain-specific language (DSL) for developing query rewrite rules. Rulescript separates rule definition from execution infrastructure via a relational algebra-inspired core language and an explicit decomposition of rules into matching and transformation phases. Developers express rewrites by pattern-matching query plans using Rulescript's core operators and constructing semantically equivalent transformed plans, with all rewrites automatically verified formally to ensure correctness. Rulescript is extensible: users can define custom operators in terms of the core language to capture engine-specific semantics. To integrate with an existing system, developers need only implement a lightweight adapter that maps Rulescript's core and custom operators to the operators implemented in the target engine.
  We evaluate Rulescript by reimplementing 33 rewrite rules from Apache Calcite and extending the language with several custom operators. To demonstrate portability, we automatically deploy these rules to CockroachDB and Apache Data Fusion, two engines with substantially different backends. Our results show that Rulescript enables "write once, deploy everywhere" paradigm for query plan rewriting, with minimal effort required to deploy previously written rules on a new data engine.

AI.tldr: Rulescript是一种与引擎无关的领域特定语言，旨在解决数据库查询计划重写规则开发中的紧耦合、缺乏可移植性和正确性保证等问题。通过关系代数核心语言、显式规则分解和形式化验证，Rulescript实现了"写一次，处处部署"的范式，可轻松移植到不同数据引擎。
AI.motivation: 现有的查询重写系统存在三个核心问题：(1)规则需要手动实现且与执行引擎紧耦合；(2)缺乏形式化正确性保证；(3)开发新引擎需重新实现所有规则，导致巨大工程成本、可移植性受限且易引入新bug。
AI.method: 采用关系代数启发的核心语言，将规则显式分解为匹配和转换两个阶段，并通过轻量级适配器将核心/自定义操作符映射到目标引擎的操作符。
AI.result: 成功从Apache Calcite移植33条重写规则，并在CockroachDB和Apache Data Fusion两个底层架构显著不同的引擎上自动部署，验证了Rulescript的可移植性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: Rulescript通过实现"写一次，处处部署"的查询计划重写范式，显著降低了为新数据引擎开发重写规则所需的工程成本，同时通过形式化验证确保了正确性。

title: A Separator for Minor-Free Graphs Beyond the Flow Barrier
summary:
In 1990, Alon, Seymour, and Thomas gave the first balanced separator of size $O(h^{3/2}\sqrt{n})$ for any $K_h$-minor-free graph, which has had numerous algorithmic applications. They conjectured that the size of the balanced separator can be reduced to $O(h\sqrt{n})$, which is asymptotically tight. Two decades later, Kawarabayashi and Reed constructed a separator of size $O(h\sqrt{n} + f(h))$ based on the graph minor structure theorem, where $f(h)$ is an extremely fast-growing function; their separator's size is only better for a very small value of $h$. Recently, Spalding-Jamieson constructed a separator of size $O(h\log h \log\log h \sqrt{n})$; the technique is rooted in concurrent flow-sparsest cut duality. Spalding-Jamieson's separator comes very close to $O(h\log h \sqrt{n})$, which is the barrier for techniques based on the flow-cut duality.
  In this work, we first present a simple adaptation of a flow-based algorithm of Korhonen and Lokshtanov to construct a balanced separator of size $O(h\log h \sqrt{n})$, matching the flow barrier. This result motivates the question of whether the flow barrier can be broken, which would be a stepping stone toward resolving the conjecture of Alon, Seymour, and Thomas. The main result of our work is a positive answer to this question: we construct a balanced separator of size $O(h \sqrt{\log h} \sqrt{n})$. Surprisingly, perhaps, our algorithm is still based on the iterative framework of Alon, Seymour, and Thomas, although a key component of their algorithm within this framework, called the neighborhood bound, was shown to be tight. Our new idea is to incorporate a low-diameter decomposition into the framework, allowing us to reduce the neighborhood bound by a factor of $h$, at the cost of a factor $\log h$, which translates to a reduction from $\sqrt{h}$ to $\sqrt{\log h}$ in the final separator's size.

AI.tldr: 本文在K_h-无痕图（K_h-minor-free graphs）的平衡分隔器问题上取得突破，将此前基于流-割对偶性方法的最优结果O(h log h √n)改进为O(h √log h √n)，打破了流障（flow barrier）。
AI.motivation: Alon、Seymour和Thomas于1990年提出K_h-无痕图的平衡分隔器猜想，认为最优大小应为O(h√n)，但基于流-割对偶性的技术存在O(h log h √n)的下界壁垒。Kawarabayashi-Reed虽构造了更优 separator，但函数f(h)增长极快，实际应用有限。研究者一直试图突破流障。
AI.method: 本文采用双重方法：①简单改造Korhonen和Lokshtanov的流算法，得到O(h log h √n) separator，匹配流障；②核心创新：将低直径分解（low-diameter decomposition）融入Alon-Seymour-Thomas的迭代框架，克服了其邻域界（neighborhood bound）的紧性限制。
AI.result: 成功突破流障：构造出尺寸为O(h √log h √n)的平衡分隔器，比流障O(h log h √n)更优，是解决Alon-Seymond-Thomas猜想的重大进展。
AI.conclusion: 通过在经典迭代框架中引入低直径分解技术，将邻域界降低约h倍（代价为log h因子），最终将separator尺寸从√h降至√log h。这一结果表明，流障的技术限制可通过巧妙的算法设计加以克服。

title: LLMorphism: When humans come to see themselves as language models
summary: LLMorphism is the biased belief that human cognition works like a large language model. I argue that the rise of conversational LLMs may make this bias increasingly psychologically available. When artificial systems produce human-like language, people may draw a reverse inference: if LLMs can speak like humans, perhaps humans think like LLMs. This inference is biased because similarity at the level of linguistic output does not imply similarity in cognitive architecture. Yet, LLMorphism may spread through two mechanisms: analogical transfer, whereby features of LLMs are projected onto humans, and metaphorical availability, whereby LLM vocabulary becomes a culturally salient vocabulary for describing thought. I distinguish LLMorphism from mechanomorphism, anthropomorphism, computationalism, dehumanization, objectification, and predictive-processing theories of mind. I outline its implications for work, education, responsibility, healthcare, communication, creativity, and human dignity, while also discussing boundary conditions and forms of resistance. I conclude that the public debate may be missing half of the problem: the issue is not only whether we are attributing too much mind to machines, but also whether we are beginning to attribute too little mind to humans.

AI.tldr: 本文引入"LLMorphism"概念，指人类认知类似于大型语言模型的偏见。文章认为对话式LLM的兴起可能使这种偏见在心理上更具可得性。当人工系统产生类似人类的语言时，人们可能反向推断"LLM像人类一样说话，因此人类可能像LLM一样思考"，但这种推断存在偏误，因为语言输出的相似性不等于认知架构的相似性。LLMorphism可能通过类比迁移和隐喻可得性两种机制扩散，作者将其与相关概念进行区分，并指出其对多个领域的广泛影响。核心论点是：公共讨论可能遗漏了问题的一半——不仅是对机器赋予过多心智，更是对人类赋予过少心智。
AI.motivation: 随着对话式LLM的普及，人类可能产生"逆向推断"：既然LLM能像人类一样说话，人类可能也像LLM一样思考。这种推断存在偏误，因为语言输出的相似性不能推出认知架构的相似性。
AI.method: 文章采用概念分析和理论建构方法，区别了LLMorphism与相关概念（机械主义拟人论、拟人论、计算主义、去人化、具身化以及预测加工心智理论），并通过分析类比迁移（analogical transfer）和隐喻可得性（metaphorical availability）两种机制来解释LLMorphism的传播路径。
AI.result: LLMorphism通过类比迁移（将LLM的特征投射到人类）和隐喻可得性（LLM词汇成为描述思维的流行文化词汇）两条机制传播。作者明确了LLMorphism与机械主义拟人论、拟人论、计算主义、去人化、具身化及预测加工心智理论的区别，并指出其对工作、教育、责任、医疗、沟通、创造力和人类尊严等领域的广泛影响。
AI.conclusion: 文章的核心结论具有批判性和前瞻性：当前公共讨论只关注了"是否对机器赋予了过多心智"这一半问题，而忽视了对称性的另一半——"是否开始对人类赋予过少心智"。这一双向警醒是文章的核心贡献。LLMorphism可能通过类比迁移和隐喻可得性两条路径扩散，对工作、教育、责任、医疗、沟通、创造力和人类尊严等领域产生深远影响。

title: Dynamic Graph with Similarity-Aware Attention Graph Neural Network for Recommender Systems
summary: Recommender systems are essential components of modern online platforms which presents personalized content in various domain. The traditional collaborative filtering methods depends on static user-item interaction graphs and a limited subset of similarity measures which fail to capture the changing nature of preferences of an individual. Recent graph neural network (GNN) based approaches focus on user-item bipartite graphs which do not use explicit user-user relational modelling and dynamic graph evolution during training. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a Dynamic Graph SimilarityAware Attention Graph Neural Network (DG-SA-GNN) framework that integrates dynamic user similarity graph construction with multi-similarity propagation and attention-based aggregation. The proposed architecture constructs four parallel user similarity graphs using Cosine, Jaccard, Discounted Pearson Correlation Coefficient (Discount PCC), and IPIJ similarity functions, each processed by a dedicated UserGNN module. A Graph Transformer fuses the four graph views, and a CrossAttention module refines user embeddings through interaction with item embeddings. Crucially, the graphs are reconstructed at scheduled epochs during training, enabling the model to adapt to the learned embedding space constituting the dynamic graph component. Mini-batch training with hard negative sampling improves scalability and convergence. Experiments on the MovieLens100K benchmark demonstrate that DG-SA-GNN achieves a Recall@20 of 0.162 and NDCG@20 of 0.065 which is better than the LightGCN baseline in recall. The results validate that dynamic multi-similarity graph construction coupled with attention-based fusion which produce recommendation performance

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DG-SA-GNN（动态图相似性感知的注意力图神经网络推荐框架）：在训练过程中按计划周期性重建四张用户相似度图（Cosine、Jaccard、Discount PCC、IP·IJ），由四个并行 UserGNN 各自传播，再经 Graph Transformer 跨视图融合与 CrossAttention 用户-物品对齐，并采用 mini-batch + 硬负采样与 BPR 损失训练。在 MovieLens100K 上取得 Recall@20 = 0.1622、NDCG@20 = 0.0654，召回率略优于 LightGCN（0.1580），但 NDCG 略低（LightGCN 0.0663）。
AI.motivation: 传统协同过滤与主流 GNN 推荐方法（如 LightGCN）存在两大局限：其一仅依赖静态的用户-物品二部图，缺乏显式的用户-用户关系建模，忽略了品味相近用户之间的丰富协同信号；其二用户相似度图一旦构建便在训练全程保持固定，而用户嵌入在优化过程中持续演化，导致固定拓扑与学到的表示空间逐渐失配，传播陈旧/噪声相似性信号。同时，已有动态图推荐工作（TGAT、TGNN 等）建模的是时间交互流或新交互到达，而非训练过程中由相似度推导出的图拓扑自身的演化。因此作者延续前期工作 SA-GNN，提出三个研究问题：动态重建多相似度用户图相对静态图能否提升性能；四种相似度函数在动态图设定下各自贡献如何；mini-batch 与硬负采样对收敛速度与最终质量的影响。
AI.method: 框架由五个部件组成：(1) 动态多相似度图构建——基于交互矩阵计算 Cosine（余弦角度对齐，限制在共评物品集上）、Jaccard（评分物品集交并比，对幅度不敏感）、Discount PCC（Pearson 相关系数乘以 |C_uv|/(|C_uv|+2) 折扣因子，负值截断为 0）、IP·IJ（Discount PCC × Jaccard 混合），各取 top-K=30 近邻建边，边权采用带温度缩放（系数 5，即温度 0.2）的 softmax 使分布更尖锐，再做对称归一化 Â=D^{-1/2}AD^{-1/2}；(2) 四个并行 UserGNN，各 2 层图卷积，形式为 h_new = αh + Σ w_uv h_v，再经残差更新 h ← h + ReLU(W h_new) 与 L2 归一化，跨层用可学习标量 softmax 权重 α_l 聚合；(3) Graph Transformer 融合：四视图堆叠为 4×|U|×d 张量，视视图维为序列，2 层编码器、4 头自注意力、FFN 维度 2d、dropout 0.1，输出对视图维均值池化得统一用户嵌入 U；(4) CrossAttention 对齐：物品嵌入经 I' = L2Norm(I + RᵀU) 注入用户上下文，取每个用户内积得分 top-50 物品作 key/value，以用户为 query 做多头注意力，u* = L2Norm(u + W_c z)；(5) mini-batch 训练：批大小 1024，正样本从已观测交互均匀采样，负样本以 0.7 概率从 top-200 高分未交互物品（硬负，候选池每 T 步刷新）、0.3 概率均匀采样（易负），BPR 损失 + L2（λ=1e-4），Adam lr=0.001，梯度裁剪 max-norm 5。图重建调度为 epoch 0、1–9 阶段每 3 轮、10 轮之后每 5 轮（{0,3,6,9,10,15,20}），并用 multiprocessing 四进程并行计算四种相似度，将 O(4|U|²) 的开销降为单图量级。
AI.result: 在 MovieLens100K（943 用户、1682 物品、99,992 交互、稀疏度 93.7%，leave-one-out 划分）上，d=128、训练 20 轮，Recall@20/NDCG@20 分别为：DG-SA-GNN (Discount PCC) 0.1622/0.0654；LightGCN 基线 0.1580/0.0663；IP·IJ 0.1580/0.0618；Jaccard 0.1516/0.0597；Cosine 0.1347/0.0553。即 Discount PCC 在召回上以约 2.7% 相对优势超过 LightGCN，但 NDCG@20 略低于基线（0.0654 vs 0.0663），说明 LightGCN 直接在二部图上传播所获得的全局物品共现信号在排序精度上仍有价值——这被作者列为未来将用户相似度图与二部图联合建模的方向。作者认为显式评分数据下相关性类度量（Discount PCC）最有效，因为评分幅度提供丰富比较信号，且共评数量折扣提升了可靠性；Jaccard 仅依赖集合重叠，在有幅度信息时不足。主要局限是相似度计算的 O(|U|²×|I|) 二次复杂度，仅在 943 用户规模可行，大规模需 FAISS/LSH 等近似近邻方法。
AI.conclusion: DG-SA-GNN 通过把静态的多相似度用户图升级为训练期周期性重建的动态图，配合并行 UserGNN、Graph Transformer 跨视图融合、CrossAttention 用户-物品对齐以及 mini-batch 硬负采样，在 MovieLens100K 上实现了优于 LightGCN 的召回性能，验证了"动态多相似度图构建 + 注意力融合"这一组合的有效性，同时也说明单一的用户相似度视角在排序精度上尚不能完全替代二部图信号。未来工作方向包括：(i) 用 FAISS 做近似图构建以扩展到 Yelp20118 等大规模数据；(ii) 用户相似度图与用户-物品二部图的联合建模；(iii) 可学习/自适应的相似度函数选择；(iv) 扩展到显式建模交互动态的时序推荐场景。

title: Automated Population-Level Audit Assurance via AI-Based Document Intelligence
summary: Audit transaction testing validates accuracy and completeness of customer-facing statements against internal systems of record. Traditional manual, sample-based review of unstructured PDF statements is labor-intensive and does not scale to millions of transactions. This paper presents an automated framework for large-scale audit transaction testing using AI-based document intelligence. The solution leverages Snowflake Document AI to extract structured data from unstructured PDF statements using a small labeled corpus (approximately 20 documents). Extracted data are reconciled against authoritative source-of-truth datasets to identify discrepancies at scale. Results are surfaced through interactive dashboards and automated reports. The framework enables population-level testing rather than sampling-based approaches, improving audit coverage and supporting continuous assurance objectives. Recent advances in document intelligence and analytics-driven audit frameworks enable scalable, near real-time risk identification and continuous assurance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于AI文档智能的大规模审计交易测试自动化框架，利用Snowflake Document AI从非结构化PDF对账单中提取结构化数据（约20份标注文档即可），并与权威数据源进行对账，实现全量级别的审计测试，替代传统的抽样审查，提升审计覆盖范围并支持持续审计。
AI.motivation: 传统审计交易测试依赖人工抽样审查非结构化PDF对账单，劳动强度大且无法扩展到百万级交易量，难以满足大规模审计需求。
AI.method: 使用Snowflake Document AI构建文档智能模型，利用约20份标注文档的小规模语料库从PDF对账单中提取结构化数据；将提取结果与权威“真相来源”数据集进行对账比对；通过交互式仪表盘和自动化报告呈现结果。
AI.result: 实现population-level（全量）审计测试，取代传统抽样方法，提升审计覆盖率，支持近实时的风险识别和持续审计保障。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明文档智能与数据分析驱动审计框架的结合可实现大规模、可扩展的近实时风险识别，为持续审计提供技术支撑。

title: EdgeServing: Deadline-Aware Multi-DNN Serving at the Edge
comment: This paper is accepted by IEEE ICCCN 2026
summary: As edge computing expands, serving multiple deep neural network (DNN) models on a single shared GPU has become a common yet challenging scenario, where each scheduling decision affects the tail latency of all concurrent queues. Existing schedulers rely on local heuristics and fail to capture this global impact, while GPU spatial-sharing approaches sacrifice latency predictability. In this paper, we propose EdgeServing, a deadline-aware multi-DNN serving system for edge devices. EdgeServing adopts time-division GPU sharing with early-exit inference for high inference predictability, and introduces a stability score to quantify how each candidate scheduling decision impacts the future queue status. At runtime, it cohesively selects the model, exit point, and batch size to minimize predicted system-wide SLO impact. Experimental results on multiple hardware platforms show that EdgeServing consistently outperforms representative baselines in both SLO violation ratio and P95 latency, enabled by early-exit mechanism, which expands the scheduling action space under tight latency constraints.

AI.tldr: EdgeServing 是面向边缘设备单 GPU 场景的截止期感知多 DNN 推理服务系统。它采用时间分片（time-division）独占式 GPU 共享以获得确定性延迟，并为 ResNet 系列骨干在 layer1/layer2/layer3/final 挂载早退头。核心是在线调度器：离线剖析全部（模型,退出点,批大小）组合的延迟（120 项配置表），运行时用"稳定性分数"预测各候选决策对未来所有队列排队时间的影响，从而联合选择模型、早退深度与批大小，以最小化系统级 SLO 违约。实验在 RTX 3080/GTX 1650/Jetson Orin Nano 上显示其 P95 延迟与违约率均优于 All-Final、All-Early 与 Symphony。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备通常只有一块 GPU 需并发服务多个 DNN 模型，每个调度决策都会影响所有并发队列的尾部延迟。现有方案存在三点不足：(1) 简单启发式（如 longest-queue-first、round-robin）只看本地队列状态，忽视跨队列耦合，易迅速触发 SLO 违约；(2) 面向云的系统（Clockwork、INFaaS）依赖跨机路由或算力隔离，在单 GPU 边缘设备不可用，Clockwork 还会主动拒绝可能违约的请求、Symphony 在过载时丢请求；(3) 空间划分共享（MPS、Orion、Paella 等 kernel 级协置）因 SM/cache/内存带宽黑盒竞争带来不可预测延迟，难以保证尾延迟与逐请求截止期。此外，现有早退研究多聚焦单模型的逐输入退出决策（置信度/熵阈值、预测一致性、学习门控），目标为工作负载级 SLO 而非逐请求截止期保证，且退出决策对调度器不透明——调度器无法主动把"退出点"当作可优化维度来权衡多模型系统级 SLO。
AI.method:
系统架构含服务队列（FIFO，每模型一个）、离线剖析器、CPU 在线调度器与 GPU 运行时。

1) 时间分片独占模式：任一时刻 GPU 只服务一个批次，保证延迟确定性、可离线准确刻画，从而支撑 SLO 感知的可预测调度；代价是吞吐利用率可能下降，故需早期退出与动态批处理补足。

2) 早退架构：以 ResNet50/101/152 为骨干，在 layer1、layer2、layer3 各接一个轻量退出头（自适应平均池化 + 单全连接层），加 final 共 4 个退出点；系统模型无关，可扩展到 VGG/DenseNet/MobileNet。

3) 离线剖析：对每个（模型 m，退出点 e，批大小 B∈1..10）组合重复数百次推理，记录均值/百分位延迟，形成 120 项表 L(m,e,B)；测得跨运行变异系数 <3%，故可作为运行时延迟预测依据；GPU 或模型变更才需重剖析。剖析显示：batch 1→10 延迟仅增约 2–3×（非 10×）；更深退出延迟显著更高（ResNet152 的 final 比 layer1 慢约 6–8×）；模型深度排序 ResNet50<ResNet101<ResNet152。精度方面（未经精细调参）final 为 74.4/77.9/78.0%，浅层退出精度低（layer1 约 7.4–7.6%）。

4) 稳定性分数（核心创新）：用带截断的指数激活函数刻画任务紧迫度 f(w)=min(exp(w/τ−1), C)，其中 w 为排队时长；归一化 w/τ−1 使 f(τ)=1 且跨 SLO 阈值尺度一致；截断上限 C 防止已严重超期的任务（w>τ(1+ln10)≈3.3τ）主导分数，从而不掩盖其余队列。系统稳定性分数 S = Σ_m Σ_{i∈Q_m} f(w_{m,i})。

5) 一步贪心在线调度（每轮：调度→执行→完成再调度；执行期间无调度但队列持续接收新请求）：
   - 遍历所有非空队列 Q_m；
   - 批大小：B* = min(|Q_m|, B_max)（依据大 batch 总能提升吞吐的剖析结论）；
   - 退出点：在满足 w_{m,max} + L(m,e,B*) ≤ τ 约束的前提下取最深退出 e* = argmax e，线性搜索即可，保证所选批次内无任务违约；
   - 队列状态预测（忽略未知的新到达）：被服务的 B* 个任务移出考虑；Q_m 中其余任务排队时间增加 L(m,e*,B*)；所有其他队列 Q_m' 任务排队时间同样增加 L(m,e*,B*)；
   - 对每个候选模型计算其预测下的稳定性分数 S_m（排除已被服务移出的任务），选择 m* = argmin S_m，输出 (m*, e*, B*)。

6) 目标形式化：任务总延迟 T = w + t，超过截止期 τ 即违约；聚合违约率 V = |{i: T_i>τ}| / N_total；目标为最小化 V 并最大化吞吐与精度。
AI.result:
实验设置：RTX 3080 为主平台（另加 GTX 1650Super、Jetson Orin Nano），锁定 GPU 核心/显存频率；CIFAR-100 上训练的三个早退 ResNet；到达服从独立泊松过程，速率比 λ50:λ101:λ152=3:2:1，λ152 从 20 扫到 240 req/s；RTX 3080/GTX1650 的 SLO τ=50ms，Jetson 为 100ms；B_max=10；每组实验 20s，去除前 100 个热身任务；调度器用剖析表的 P95 延迟做退出点选择。基线为 All-Final、All-Early、Symphony。

主要结论：
- 低负载时 EdgeServing 与 All-Final 的 P95 相近（≈28ms，因有足够余量可走 final）；负载升高后 All-Final 在 λ152≈140 req/s 后急剧劣化，违约率达 15.19%（λ152=160），而 EdgeServing 通过切浅退出削峰，在 λ152≥180 时 P95 稳定在 44–46ms，全程违约率 <1%。
- All-Early 延迟最低（2–3ms）但精度仅 7.4%；Symphony P95 约 60ms 且高负载违约率上升（延迟批处理开销所致）。
- 自适应退出：低负载多用最深退出，负载升高逐步转浅（Fig.5）。
- 精度–延迟 Pareto：λ152=20 时精度 76.75%、P95 27.47ms（主要走 final）；λ152=100 时 72.64%、40.24ms；λ152≥180 时精度降至 60.38%、P95 44.46ms，平滑过渡。
- 退出点配置：layer3+final 在 λ152=200 时 P95>60ms 且违约高（layer3 不够快）；layer2+final 中等劣化；layer1+final 稳定<50ms，说明"极快兜底退出"是关键；all_exits 与 layer1+final 相当，额外中间退出收益有限。
- SLO 敏感性（20–70ms）：P95 随 τ 近比例变化，τ=20ms 时即使 λ152=200 也维持 ≈19ms，τ=70ms 时高负载 P95 达 60ms。
- 模型组合（等流量 1:1:1）：3×ResNet50 延迟最低、违约近零；1×50+1×101+1×152 异构配置 P95 31–42ms、违约 <0.5%。
- 跨平台：RTX 3080 精度 55–77% 且 P95 满足 50ms；GTX 1650 在 λ152=240 时 layer1 也跟不上，精度降至 ≈9%；Jetson Orin Nano 低负载 ≈75% 精度、饱和时 ≈20%，P95 77–105ms；退化源于硬件吞吐上限而非调度缺陷，仅需重新剖析、无需改算法。
- 消融：Early-Exit+LQF 与 Early-Exit+EDF 明显劣于完整方案（λ152=120 时 P95 46.01/44.02 vs 42.22ms；λ152=240 违约 2.99%/1.89% vs <1%），说明稳定性分数优于仅看单任务紧迫度的 EDF；All-Final+Deadline-Aware 在 λ152=120 起劣化、160 时爆炸，证明早退适配是维持 SLO 的首要机制；Ours+bs=1 全面更差，说明动态批处理对吞吐必要。三者缺一不可。
AI.conclusion: EdgeServing 通过时间分片独占式 GPU 共享 + 早退推理，在每个调度轮次联合优化模型选择、早退点与批大小，并借助基于预测队列状态的稳定性分数显式建模跨模型耦合，使单 GPU 边缘设备能以极低 SLO 违约率服务多个 DNN。其关键洞见是：调度前先"预测"所有队列的后果，再选择系统级损害最小的服务对象。实验证明早退适配、截止期感知的模型选择与动态批处理三者缺一不可，且算法无需修改即可迁移到不同硬件（仅需重新收集延迟剖析）。局限方面：早退精度未经充分调参（浅层退出精度极低），且采用一步贪心策略、忽略未来到达到达率与长期规划，在弱硬件饱和时精度无法通过调度挽救。

title: Counterargument for Critical Thinking as Judged by AI and Humans
summary: This intervention study investigates the use of counterarguments in writing for critical thinking by students in the context of Generative AI (GenAI). This is especially as risks of cheating and cognitive offloading exist with the use of GenAI. We presented 36 students in a particular university course with 4 carefully selected thesis statements (from a set of popular debates) to write about anyone of them. We used six established rubrics (focus, logic, content, style, correctness and reference) to conduct three human assessments (two student peer-reviews and one experienced teacher) per writeup on a 5-point Likert scale for all the qualified samples (n) of 35 submissions (after disqualifying one for irregularity). Using the same rubrics and guidelines, we also assessed the submissions using six frontier LLMs as judges. Our mixed-method design included qualitative open-ended feedback per assessment and quantitative methods. The results reveal that (1) the students' self-written counterarguments to AI-generated content contains logic, among other things, which is a key component of critical thinking, and (2) GenAI can be successfully used at scale to assess students' written work, based on clear rubrics, and these assessments generally align with human assessments as shown with Gwets AC2 inter-rater reliability values of 0.33 for all the models except one.

AI.tldr: A study with 36 university students found that writing counterarguments to AI-generated content effectively promotes critical thinking, and that frontier LLMs can serve as reliable assessors of student writing with strong alignment to human evaluations.
AI.motivation: The rise of Generative AI (GenAI) in education presents both opportunities and risks, including concerns about cheating and cognitive offloading. Leveraging GenAI as an educational tool rather than merely a threat requires exploring how students can engage critically with AI-generated content. Specifically, using GenAI outputs as prompts for counterargument writing may foster critical thinking development.
AI.method: 36 university students wrote counterarguments to AI-generated content on 4 selected thesis statements. Submissions (n=35) were assessed using 6 rubrics (focus, logic, content, style, correctness, reference) on a 5-point Likert scale via two student peer-reviews, one experienced teacher, and six frontier LLMs. Mixed-method design combined qualitative feedback with quantitative analysis, using Gwets AC2 for inter-rater reliability.
AI.result: Results show that (1) students' self-written counterarguments to AI-generated content demonstrate logical reasoning—a key component of critical thinking; (2) frontier LLMs can successfully assess written work at scale with high alignment to human assessments, with Gwets AC2 inter-rater reliability values of 0.33 for most models.
AI.conclusion: GenAI can be effectively integrated into educational assessment workflows, with frontier LLMs demonstrating reliable inter-rater agreement comparable to human assessments. Students who generate counterarguments to AI content engage in meaningful critical thinking exercises, suggesting that GenAI tools can serve as both prompts for and evaluators of critical thinking skills.

title: ZAYA1-8B Technical Report
summary: We present ZAYA1-8B, a reasoning-focused mixture-of-experts (MoE) model with 700M active and 8B total parameters, built on Zyphra's MoE++ architecture. ZAYA1-8B's core pretraining, midtraining, and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) were performed on a full-stack AMD compute, networking, and software platform. With under 1B active parameters, ZAYA1-8B matches or exceeds DeepSeek-R1-0528 on several challenging mathematics and coding benchmarks, and remains competitive with substantially larger open-weight reasoning models. ZAYA1-8B was trained from scratch for reasoning, with reasoning data included from pretraining onward using an answer-preserving trimming scheme. Post-training uses a four-stage RL cascade: reasoning warmup on math and puzzles; a 400-task RLVE-Gym curriculum; math and code RL with test-time compute traces and synthetic code environments built from competitive-programming references; and behavioral RL for chat and instruction following. We also introduce Markovian RSA, a test-time compute method that recursively aggregates parallel reasoning traces while carrying forward only bounded-length reasoning tails between rounds. In TTC evaluation, Markovian RSA raises ZAYA1-8B to 91.9\% on AIME'25 and 89.6\% on HMMT'25 while carrying forward only a 4K-token tail, narrowing the gap to much larger reasoning models including Gemini-2.5 Pro, DeepSeek-V3.2, and GPT-5-High.

AI.tldr: ZAYA1-8B是一款基于MoE++架构的推理专用模型，仅用700M活跃参数即在数学和代码基准上匹敌DeepSeek-R1-0528。其创新点在于Markovian RSA测试时计算方法，通过递归聚合并行推理轨迹并保持4K-token有界尾迹，在AIME'25和HMMT'25分别达到91.9%和89.6%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 在保持模型参数量高效的同时，通过创新的测试时计算方法提升推理能力，缩小与大型推理模型的性能差距，同时展示全栈AMD平台训练大模型的能力。
AI.method: 采用MoE++架构(700M活跃/8B总参数)；四阶段RL级联训练(推理热身→RLVE-Gym课程→数学代码RL→行为RL)；引入Markovian RSA测试时计算方法，递归聚合并行推理轨迹并仅携带4K-token有界推理尾迹。
AI.result: 在AIME'25达到91.9%，HMMT'25达到89.6%，在多个数学和代码基准测试中匹配或超越DeepSeek-R1-0528，仅需携带4K-token推理尾迹即可实现。
AI.conclusion: ZAYA1-8B通过创新的Markovian RSA推理方法和MoE架构，在仅1B活跃参数下达到了与大型推理模型相当的水平，证明了高效推理的可能性，同时展示了AMD全栈平台训练大模型的可行性。

title: Nationwide EHR-Based Chronic Rhinosinusitis Prediction Using Demographic-Stratified Models
comment: Sicong Chang, Yidan Shen are the co-first authors This paper is already accepted to IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC) 2026 conference
summary: Chronic rhinosinusitis (CRS) is a common heterogeneous inflammatory disorder that causes substantial morbidity and healthcare costs. CRS is difficult to identify early from routine encounters, as symptom presentations overlap with common conditions such as allergic rhinitis, and heterogeneous phenotypes further obscure risk patterns. Prior predictive studies often rely on single-institutional cohorts , which reduce population-level generalizability. To overcome this, we leveraged nationwide longitudinal EHR data from the \textit{All of Us} Research Program to predict CRS diagnosis using two years of pre-diagnostic history. To address extreme feature sparsity and dimensionality in coded EHR data, we implemented a hybrid feature-selection pipeline that combines prevalence-based statistical screening with model-based importance ranking, compressing approximately 110,000 candidate codes into 100 interpretable features. To capture demographic heterogeneity, we trained demographic stratified models across six adult sex and life-stage subgroups with subgroup-specific hyperparameter tuning. Our framework achieved an overall AUC of 0.8461, improving discrimination by 0.0168 over the best baseline. These results demonstrate that routinely collected EHR data may support population-representative CRS risk stratification and inform earlier triage and referral prioritization in primary care.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用 All of Us 全国性电子健康档案（EHR）数据，通过混合特征选择和人口统计学分层建模，实现慢性鼻窦炎（CRS）诊断预测，AUC 达 0.8461，展示了 EHR 数据在人群代表性风险分层中的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 慢性鼻窦炎（CRS）是一种常见异质性炎症性疾病，疾病负担重、医疗成本高。早期识别困难，原因包括：症状与过敏性鼻炎等常见病重叠、表型异质性复杂、既往预测研究多依赖单一机构数据导致泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 1. 数据来源：All of Us 全国性纵向 EHR 数据，利用诊断前2年历史数据；2. 特征工程：混合特征选择流程——先进行基于流行率的统计筛选，再结合模型重要性排名，将约110,000个候选代码压缩为100个可解释特征；3. 建模策略：按6个成人性别与生命阶段亚组进行人口统计学分层建模，各亚组独立超参数调优。
AI.result: 模型整体 AUC 达 0.8461，较最佳基线提升 0.0168，显示出良好的区分能力。
AI.conclusion: 常规收集的 EHR 数据可支持人群代表性的 CRS 风险分层，为初级保健中的早期分诊和转诊优先级决策提供信息。

title: AgenticPrecoding: LLM-Empowered Multi-Agent System for Precoding Optimization
summary: Precoding is a key technique for interference management and performance improvement in multi-antenna wireless systems. However, existing precoding methods are typically developed for specific system models, objectives, and constraint sets, which limits their adaptability to the heterogeneous and evolving scenarios expected in future 6G networks. To address this limitation, we propose AgenticPrecoding, a universal multi-agent framework that automates end-to-end precoding derivation directly from user-level communication requirements. Specifically, AgenticPrecoding decomposes the derivation process into four coordinated stages: problem formulation, solver selection, prompt upsampling, and code generation, assigning each stage to a specialized agent tailored to its specific reasoning demands. We employ two LoRA-adapted reasoning agents to inject precoding-specific domain knowledge for problem formulation and solver selection, while two general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) handle prompt refinement and executable code generation. Furthermore, a feedback-driven refinement mechanism is incorporated to enhance code executability, constraint feasibility, and solution quality. Extensive experiments across 10 representative precoding scenarios demonstrate that AgenticPrecoding achieves superior cross-scenario adaptability compared to conventional optimization-based and LLM-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgenticPrecoding：一个由四个专职智能体（问题形式化、求解器选择、提示词上采样、代码生成）组成的多智能体框架，可根据用户级自然语言需求与结构化场景描述自动端到端生成预编码求解代码；前两个智能体用 LoRA 微调注入预编码领域知识，后两个用通用大模型，并配合基于执行反馈的迭代精修机制。在 10 个代表性预编码场景、6 档 SNR 下的实验表明，该框架在多数指标上超越传统优化基线与 LLM 基线，且保持约 100% 的约束可行率。
AI.motivation: 现有预编码方法遵循"一个场景、一个模型、一个求解器"的范式：全双工、下行 MIMO、认知无线电、恒包络、分布天线、时空符号级、混合预编码等系统各自依赖专门的建模与求解器推导，难以迁移。深度学习类方法虽可从大数据集直接学习预编码映射，但一旦部署条件偏离训练配置性能显著下降，且未显式刻画预编码问题的数学结构。近期 LLM 方案（LLM-Optira、BeamAgent、LLM-beamforming）要么实现可靠性不足、频繁违反约束，要么仍绑定场景专用优化器。因此需要一种从高层通信需求直接自动推导出数学一致、可行且高质量预编码解的统一框架，而该过程天然包含两类异质推理需求：形式化与求解器选择需无线领域知识，提示组织与代码合成则依赖通用语言/编程能力，单一 LLM 难以兼顾。
AI.method: 1) 统一建模：将预编码问题抽象为 min f(x;Θ) s.t. 不等式约束 c_ℓ≤0 与等式约束 h_q=0，其中场景描述符 Θ={Θ_sys, Θ_ch, Θ_obj, Θ_con} 分别对应系统配置、信道信息、设计目标与运行约束；最大化任务转为最小化负值。2) 任务定义：将框架视为自动化求解器生成任务，输入 (D,Θ)，输出映射 G:(D,Θ)↦(P, A, C, x*)，即数学问题 P、算法策略 A、可执行代码 C 与预编码解 x*。3) 四阶段多智能体架构：Problem Formulator Agent（PF）将 D 与 Θ 映射为结构化文本问题说明；Problem Solver Agent（PS）依据目标类型、约束特征、凸性、变量耦合与硬件限制选择非学习型算法（凸化、SDR、SCA、交替优化、惩罚法等）；Prompt Upsampler Agent（PU）组织变量、目标、约束、算法步骤、数值设置、输入输出格式与可行性检查，形成实现导向提示 Π；Code Generation Agent（CG）生成可执行求解代码。前两个智能体基于 Qwen3-8B 以 LoRA（rank=8，2 epochs）SFT 微调，训练数据来自 20 余篇预编码文献构造的指令-响应对（约 6500 条形式化、800 条求解器选择）；后两个分别用 GPT-5.2 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro。4) 反馈驱动精修：执行求值器 E 产出反馈 e^(t)（编译/运行状态、约束可行性、目标值、数值告警），由算子 R 生成 C^(t+1)，迭代修复实现错误、数值设置、约束违背并提升解质量，直至通过执行评估或触发终止条件。5) 实验设置：10 个代表性预编码场景、SNR∈{0,5,10,15,20,25} dB，基线为人工选定的非学习型方法（ZF、RZF、MRT、MMSE、SOCP 代理、CD、逐坐标下降 CE、SLNR、保密波束等），并对比 100% 可行率与平均块功率曲线。
AI.result: 表 I 的九个场景中，AgenticPrecoding 在绝大多数设置取得最优：MU-MIMO 最小功率（0.3144→0.0008 W，SNR 0→25 dB）优于 ZF、MMSE、SOCP 代理与穷举 MRT；恒包络 CI 裕度（1.8076→32.1447）与 1-bit 混合 MISO（3.4530→61.4033）优于随机、MRT+CE 投影、CD 贪心等；认知无线电多播保密率（1.8265→8.6522）优于 MRT、保密盲波束与零空间 ZF；全双工 QAM 最小功率（0.2548→0.0673 W）优于 ZF 与仅 SINR 方法；认知无线电和速率（7.1113→42.2928 bps/Hz）与推断鲁棒性（4.5831→33.5494）显著领先 MRT/ZF/干扰置零；全双工 QoS（5.7592→27.8034）与混合预编码鲁棒最小功率（0.0897→0.0002 W）同样领先。基线在若干设置出现不可行或数值不稳定（如 RZF/MMSE 饱和于 40 W、MRT 全双工约束违背、CD 贪心 1-bit 明显次优），而 AgenticPrecoding 保持稳定。图 3 显示平均块功率在全 SNR 段最低，图 4 可行性矩阵显示 RZF-GS 在 0 dB 无法收敛而本方法保持 100% 可行率。
AI.conclusion: AgenticPrecoding 通过"领域特化 LoRA 微调智能体 + 通用实现型智能体 + 反馈驱动精修"的组合，克服了传统场景专用求解器在适配性与实现可靠性上的缺陷，在异构无线场景中能自动构造数学一致、约束可行且性能优异的预编码优化过程，并在噪声受限等困难工况下优于传统优化基线。该工作表明多智能体架构可有效用于物理层设计，为面向 6G 异构场景的自动化预编码优化提供了可行路径。局限方面：求解器选择被限定在非学习型算法、基线为人工指定（用于外部参照而非由智能体挑选）、依赖闭源通用模型（GPT-5.2、Gemini 3.1 Pro）、且场景数量有限，跨场景泛化的规模性与成本分析有待进一步验证。

title: Low-Latency Out-of-Core ANN Search in High-Dimensional Space
comment: A technical report of our research result SkipDisk
summary: In-memory graph-based approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search has superior search performance but incurs significant memory footprint. Disk-based methods reduce memory usage but suffer from high disk access latency. A common challenge is how to achieve low-latency search while significantly reducing memory footprint. In this paper, we propose SkipDisk, a disk-memory hybrid ANN search that significantly reduces memory footprint while achieving search latency comparable to or lower than in-memory method HNSW. By analyzing existing disk-based methods, we observed that disk access remains the primary bottleneck, and existing lower bound based filtering methods are two loose to effectively reduce disk access. Therefore, we design SkipDisk to achieve tight lower bound with low memory footprint to reduce the search latency. First, we design a dedicated pivot for each point to improve the lower bound of the triangle inequality for effective filtering. We further design an estimation-based approach based on this lower bound. Second, to reduce the memory footprint, we employ a three-level data pruning strategy to preserve informative data in memory. Third, to further reduce search latency, we design an asynchronous I/O strategy based on the decoupling of in-memory search and disk access by storing neighbor nodes in memory. Experiments show that our method achieves a latency of 85 of HNSW's latency with approximately 10 memory footprint, and a latency to 63 of HNSW's with a slightly higher memory footprint of around 20.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkipDisk，一种磁盘-内存混合的近似最近邻搜索方法，通过设计专用pivot改进下界精度、三层数据修剪减少内存占用、以及异步I/O解耦磁盘访问，在大幅降低内存占用（10%~20%内存）的同时实现了与HNSW相当甚至更低的搜索延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有基于磁盘的ANN方法存在高磁盘访问延迟问题，而现有基于下界的过滤方法过于宽松，无法有效减少磁盘访问，导致搜索性能受限。
AI.method: 1) 为每个点设计专用pivot以改进三角形不等式的下界，提升过滤效果；2) 采用基于该下界的估计方法；3) 采用三层数据修剪策略在内存中保留关键信息；4) 通过将邻居节点存储在内存中实现异步I/O策略，解耦内存搜索与磁盘访问。
AI.result: 在约10%内存占用下实现HNSW的85%搜索延迟；在约20%内存占用下实现HNSW的63%搜索延迟。
AI.conclusion: SkipDisk通过设计专用pivot提高下界精度、采用三层数据修剪策略减少内存占用、引入异步I/O策略解耦内存搜索与磁盘访问，在仅使用HNSW约10%内存的情况下实现其85%的搜索延迟，在约20%内存下实现63%的延迟，兼顾了内存效率与低延迟搜索性能。

title: Nearly Optimal Attention Coresets
summary: We consider the problem of estimating the Attention mechanism in small space, and prove the existence of coresets for it of nearly optimal size. Specifically, we show that for any set of unit-norm keys and values $(K,V)$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$, there exists a subset $(K',V')$ of size at most $O({\sqrt{d} e^{ρ+o(ρ)}/\varepsilon})$ such that \[ \left\| \operatorname{Attn}(q,K,V)- \operatorname{Attn}(q,K',V') \right\| \le \varepsilon \] simultaneously for all queries whose norm is bounded by $ρ$. This outperforms the best known results for this problem. We also offer an improved lower bound showing that $\varepsilon$-coresets must have size $Ω({\sqrt{d} e^ρ/ε})$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了注意力机制的coreset（核心集）构造问题。在给定的单位范数键值对(K,V)∈R^d下，证明了存在规模为O(√d e^{ρ+o(ρ)}/ε)的子集可以近似原始注意力机制，同时给出了Ω(√d e^ρ/ε)的改进下界，改进了该领域的已知最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 解决注意力机制估计的空间效率问题。注意力机制是Transformer等模型的核心组件，计算成本高昂，需要有效的近似技术来降低计算复杂度和存储需求。
AI.method: 通过证明coreset的存在性来实现，采用数学分析技术处理单位范数键值对集合。该coreset能够同时近似所有范数受ρ约束的查询。
AI.result: 存在规模至多为 O(√d e^{ρ+o(ρ)}/ε) 的子集 (K',V')，使得对于所有范数受ρ约束的查询q，||Attn(q,K,V) - Attn(q,K',V')|| ≤ ε 成立。
AI.conclusion: 提出了更优的下界：ε-coresets 必须具有 Ω(√d e^ρ/ε) 的规模，证明了现有结果是近乎最优的。

title: The Pedagogy of AI Mistakes: Fostering Higher-Order Thinking
comment: Accepted to AIED-2026; includes supplementary material
summary: As generative AI becomes increasingly integrated into higher education, its frequent errors and hallucinations, often seen as limitations, offer a unique pedagogical opportunity. By framing AI as a ``learning companion'' whose imperfect outputs prompt analysis, evaluation, and reflection, we argue that instructors can engage students in the fundamental processes of higher-order thinking. This paper presents a design-oriented study in which an AI-integrated syllabus in a \textit{database design} course deliberately leverages AI's limitations to foster critical thinking and higher-order cognitive skills aligned with Bloom's taxonomy of learning. Using a mixed-methods approach, we examine how structured interaction with AI-generated errors supports metacognitive engagement, reinforces disciplinary rigor, and relates to students' perceived AI literacy and subject-matter competency.

AI.tldr: 本研究将生成式AI的常见错误和幻觉重新定位为教学资源而非障碍，通过在数据库设计课程中设计AI整合教学大纲，利用AI的不完美输出促进学生的高阶认知发展。研究采用混合方法验证了结构化AI交互对元认知参与和学科能力发展的积极作用，为高等教育中创新AI教学应用提供了实证支持。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI频繁产生错误和幻觉，传统观点视其为阻碍教学的限制因素。然而，该研究提出将这些"缺陷"重新框架为教学机会，认为AI的不完美输出可以激发学生的分析、评估和反思活动，从而促进高阶思维技能的发展。
AI.method: 采用混合方法研究设计，在数据库设计课程中设计并实施了AI整合教学大纲。通过结构化的AI交互任务，让学生分析与评价AI生成内容中的错误。使用Bloom's认知分类法评估学生的高阶思维能力发展，同时通过问卷和访谈收集学生对AI素养和学科能力的自我感知数据。
AI.result: 研究发现，结构化地与AI生成错误进行交互，能够有效支持学生的元认知参与，强化学科严谨性，并与学生的AI素养和学科能力感知呈正相关。AI的局限性反而成为促进深度学习和批判性思维的有效催化剂。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将AI的局限性作为教学设计的一部分，能够有效促进学生的元认知参与、学科严谨性培养，同时提升学生的AI素养和学科能力。该研究为教育工作者提供了在课程中整合AI的创新思路，强调将AI从"正确答案提供者"转变为"学习促进者"的教育理念转变。

title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Rethinking Retrieval for Agentic Search via Direct Corpus Interaction
summary: Modern retrieval systems, whether lexical or semantic, expose a corpus through a fixed similarity interface that compresses access into a single top-k retrieval step before reasoning. This abstraction is efficient, but for agentic search, it becomes a bottleneck: exact lexical constraints, sparse clue conjunctions, local context checks, and multi-step hypothesis refinement are difficult to implement by calling a conventional off-the-shelf retriever, and evidence filtered out early cannot be recovered by stronger downstream reasoning. Agentic tasks further exacerbate this limitation because they require agents to orchestrate multiple steps, including discovering intermediate entities, combining weak clues, and revising the plan after observing partial evidence. To tackle the limitation, we study direct corpus interaction (DCI), where an agent searches the raw corpus directly with general-purpose terminal tools (e.g., grep, file reads, shell commands, lightweight scripts), without any embedding model, vector index, or retrieval API. This approach requires no offline indexing and adapts naturally to evolving local corpora. Across IR benchmarks and end-to-end agentic search tasks, this simple setup substantially outperforms strong sparse, dense, and reranking baselines on several BRIGHT and BEIR datasets, and attains strong accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus and multi-hop QA without relying on any conventional semantic retriever. Our results indicate that as language agents become stronger, retrieval quality depends not only on reasoning ability but also on the resolution of the interface through which the model interacts with the corpus, with which DCI opens a broader interface-design space for agentic search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出直接语料交互（DCI）范式，让语言智能体通过通用终端工具直接搜索原始语料库而非依赖预建检索接口，实验表明这种简洁方法在多个基准上超越传统稀疏/密集检索和重排序基线，证明检索质量取决于交互接口的分辨率而非仅依赖检索模型本身。
AI.motivation: 现代检索系统将访问压缩为单一top-k检索步骤的固定相似度接口，成为智能体搜索的瓶颈：精确词法约束、稀疏线索合取、局部上下文检查和多步假设精化难以实现；早期过滤的证据无法被下游强推理恢复；智能体任务需要编排多步骤（发现中间实体、组合弱线索、观察部分证据后修订计划）。
AI.method: 提出直接语料交互（Direct Corpus Interaction, DCI）范式，智能体使用通用终端工具（如grep、文件读取、shell命令、轻量脚本）直接搜索原始语料库，无需任何嵌入模型、向量索引或检索API，也不依赖离线索引。
AI.result: 在IR基准测试和端到端智能体搜索任务中，该简单设置在多个BRIGHT和BEIR数据集上显著优于强稀疏、密集和重排序基线；在BrowseComp-Plus和多跳QA上达到高精度，且不依赖任何传统语义检索器。
AI.conclusion: DCI范式表明，随着语言智能体能力增强，检索质量不仅取决于推理能力，还取决于模型与语料库交互的接口分辨率。DCI为智能体搜索开辟了更广阔的接口设计空间。

title: PARNESS: A Paper Harness for End-to-End Automated Scientific Research with Dynamic Workflows, Full-Text Indexing, and Cross-Run Knowledge Accumulation
comment: 31 pages, 13 figures, includes appendix with a verbatim end-to-end-generated paper produced by the framework. Source: https://github.com/gtrhythm/PARNESS
summary:
Recent autonomous research systems -- AI-Scientist, PaperOrchestra, AutoSOTA, DeepResearch, InternAgent, ResearchAgent and others -- show LLM agents can ideate, run experiments and write papers, but each fixes a particular control-flow shape (linear pipeline, state machine, single-agent loop, or fixed-recipe skill pack) at the framework level. We argue this rigidity has five roots: (1) workflows are dynamic and discipline-specific (lab work, surveys, simulations, theory all loop differently); (2) ideation is bounded by LLM context and cross-domain ideation needs knowledge a single context cannot hold; (3) summary-only views miss the paper body, yet full-text access is uneven, so the cumulative corpus must do the work; (4) a paper's open-source repository is often the only complete specification of its experimental scheme, but the paper-to-code link is neglected; (5) no tool persists cross-run knowledge retrievably into a finite LLM context.
  We present PARNESS, an open-source framework built on four design moves. (i) A thin DAG kernel with a four-field Agent contract decouples scheduling from domain semantics, so any discipline's loop is expressible as user-editable YAML. (ii) A full-text PDF-parsing and literature-library subsystem indexes paper bodies, figures and tables as typed objects, with graceful abstract-only fall-back. (iii) A knowledge-graph index over papers, ideas, experiments and code repositories, with scenario-typed retrieval (similar / contradictory / cross-domain / counter-intuitive), surfaces a focused slice into each LLM call.
