(iv) A small extension surface lets any modern coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, OpenCode) add or replace any module. To our knowledge PARNESS is the first open-source system combining declarative pipelines, full-PDF and code-repository indexing, and cross-run knowledge. Source: https://github.com/gtrhythm/PARNESS

AI.tldr: PARNESS 是一个开源的「论文工装」框架：用一个约 600 行的极薄 DAG 内核（GraphRunner）+ 四字段 Agent 契约（_route/_routes/_score/_metadata），把研究工作流的拓扑从代码变成用户可编辑的 YAML；配合全文 PDF 解析与文献库子系统（PDF-Extract-Kit/MinerU，输出布局/公式/OCR/表格四类带 (paper_id,page,bbox) 溯源的类型化对象，缺全文时优雅退化为仅摘要）、覆盖论文/想法/实验/代码仓库四类节点的 Neo4j 知识图谱索引（八阶段、四类边、四种场景化检索：similar/opposite/cross-domain/counter-intuitive）、以及五个 SQLite 存储构成的跨轮次知识沉淀，使任意学科的循环（湿实验、问卷、仿真、理论证明）都可表达。参照实现含 130+ 模块、50 条 YAML 流水线、553 项测试，已在真实文献集合上端到端跑通（单节点约 1 小时），但论文明确承认尚未做与 AI-Scientist v2 / PaperOrchestra / InternAgent 的同基准对比、无人评、无认知角色消融、跨轮次累积收益未量化。
AI.motivation: 作者以 AI-Scientist v1/v2、PaperOrchestra、OpenAGS、Karpathy 的 autoresearch、AutoSOTA、Tongyi DeepResearch、InternAgent、ResearchAgent 等系统为参照，指出它们各自在框架层固化了某一种控制流形态（线性流水线、硬编码状态机、单智能体循环、固定五智能体技能包），由此引出五个结构性根源（L1–L5）及其两个推论（L1+ 智能体与框架职责混淆、L1++ 生命周期覆盖缺口）：L1 控制流冻结单一化——湿实验生物、社会科学问卷（含 IRB/招募/编码循环）、仿真、理论证明、消融各自循环拓扑与讨论模式不同；L2 构思受限于 LLM 上下文窗口且存在 lost-in-the-middle，跨领域构思需要单窗口无法承载的长期积累；L3 全文阅读是「一次性、解析后即丢弃」而非可查询的类型化语料，全文可得性不均（PaperOrchestra 仅用 Semantic Scholar 标题+摘要）时无退路；L4 论文开源仓库常是实验方案的唯一完整规格（超参、预处理、隐藏常量），但论文↔代码对应关系只是「每任务、隐式」的，缺少语料级图谱，既无法交叉审稿也无法为无代码论文寻找最接近的同级仓库实现；L5 现有系统每轮运行从零开始（跑 N 次等于并行跑 1 次），而单纯堆积全部历史又会溢出上下文，核心工程问题是「如何把累积语料中最有用的一小片送进有限窗口」。作者主张共享单位不应是「每学科一个框架」，而是薄内核+可插拔模块。
AI.method: 四层架构 L0–L3。L0 内核：GraphRunner 约 600 行，做拓扑调度、输入输出映射、进程池执行；BaseModule 只要求实现 async execute(inputs)->Dict，运行时只解析四个保留字段——_route（单后继）、_routes（一对多扇出）、_score（数值，供上游迭代控制器使用）、_metadata（溯源），其余键原样传给下游；三种调度策略：显式后继、下游子 DAG 按元素克隆扇出、否则 Kahn 拓扑排序（结合 depends_on 与从 input_mapping 推断的隐式依赖）；双后端（测试用进程内 asyncio，生产用 ProcessPoolExecutor，每节点结束 os._exit(0) 释放显存）；YAML DSL 三段式（nodes/edges/config），节点含 id、module、depends_on、params、input_mapping、output_mapping、routes、timeout、retry；四层校验器（schema/contract/type/topology，含环、不可达、孤立终端检测）并入 CI。L1 持久化：五个 SQLite（papers_db、knowledge_store.db 约 20 表、evaluations.db、paper_writing.db、experiments db），UNIQUE 约束（如按类型 LOWER(TRIM(seed))）在存储层去重；Neo4j 知识图谱含原生向量索引（已从 Qdrant 迁移），八阶段增量索引：extract→dedup→embed→write_node→internal_edge→struct_edge→semantic_edge→random_walk，边分结构边（SQLite 外键）、内部边（批次内 LLM 关系）、语义边（向量候选+LLM 分桶，GraphRAG 风格）、游走边（加权随机游走发现长程跨域关系）；五个查询适配器 kg_vector_search / kg_graph_traverse / kg_nl_query / kg_abstract_enrich / kg_synthesize，按 scenario 参数化出 similar/opposite/cross-domain/counter-intuitive 四种检索切片。L2 智能体层：25+ LLM 领域智能体 + 130+ 适配器，六个 LLM 提供商工厂（OpenAI/Anthropic/GLM/MiniMax/本地/Mock，Mock 带 44 条规则使全流程离线可跑）；六认知角色构思（Reader/Analyst/Connector/Contrarian/Synthesizer/Critic）经 _routes 并行扇出、各自绑定场景化检索，再由聚合器去重排序；code-link 提取器用正则扫描 github/gitlab/huggingface 与 README/摘要，沙箱克隆后 code_analyzer 对 train/configs/model/data 目录分型，写入带 derivation 边的类型化节点；实验侧用 experiment_runner_cli / experiment_verifier_cli 包装外部编码智能体（OpenCode/Claude Code/Codex），产出结果与验证器两类工件，由 experiment_success_gate 依据验证器输出区分「已跑」与「已通过」。L3 用户面：50 条 YAML 流水线与入口脚本；每个模块=一个 Python 文件+@register 装饰器+一个 YAML 节点，INPUT_SPEC/OUTPUT_SPEC 自描述并导出 JSON 供 IDE 补全，Claude Code/Cursor/Copilot/OpenCode/Kilo Code 可直接改写模块或重连流水线，无需专用插件。四条设计原则：框架不感知领域语义、组合即数据、失败局部隔离、知识跨轮次存活、LLM 可替换、验证器是一等类型化输出。
AI.result: 代码库约 62.2k LoC 核心 + 13.4k LoC 测试，130+ 模块（构思 26、实验 24、KG 17、基础设施 16+、写作评审 11、研究/爬虫/解析 8、迭代控制与门 7、后处理 2）、50 条流水线、5 个 SQLite、Neo4j KG，553 项测试（Table 1 与摘要口径存在不一致）。运行层面：以 arXiv 子集上的 arxiv_heplat_dag（11 个 DAG 阶段）等流水线在单 GPU 节点约 1 小时内端到端完成，作者明确定位为「控制流持久性」基线而非质量基准；适配器层在 MiniMax-M2.7 上真实 LLM 集成测试大部分通过，失败集中于 Agent 类适配器一个空输入回归；KG 端到端 harness 覆盖全部 KG 适配器；MockLLM 使全部测试离线运行；实验-论文子系统的图像生成路径实测生成并校验真实 PNG。构思层收益未严格测量（作者自认「尚未严格测量，列为 future work」），跨轮累积收益也只描述未量化。负向/风险事实：认知角色并行 token 成本高；os._exit(0) 造成节点间内存缓存丢失；KG 语义边依赖 LLM 分桶，合成测试数据上出现 mode collapse，需保守阈值。附录给出 8 条通过质量门的构思想目（离线 RL 的拟乐观探索、粒子物理 Lorentz 等变网络、柏拉图式持续学习表示、混合模数神经网、组合式逆设计、跨模态对比蒸馏、缓存侧信道可证明防御、HyperCircuit），以及一条由同一 idea 记录端到端生成的 LaTeX 论文（含 18.36% MAE 退化，作者声明该科学结论属于流水线而非作者）。
AI.conclusion: PARNESS 的定位是设计空间中的新点：全生命周期覆盖 + 流水线即数据 + 智能体自主路由 + 跨轮次知识持久化 + 多学科工作流形状，五者同时满足在既有开源系统中未见。核心主张是「框架只做调度，所有领域决策写在模块里，通过四字段契约与 YAML 拓扑表达不同学科的循环」，并以薄内核吸收既有系统——PaperOrchestra 的五步写作可作为单个模块，AI-Scientist 的树搜索可作为打分门控循环，InternAgent 的八智能体生成-演化图可作为子 DAG。作者坦承这是 v1 系统论文：缺少共享基准上的头对头比较、人评、认知角色消融与 run_n vs run_{n+1} 的累积消融；未来方向是固定任务（如 2 小时 GPU 预算下改进 nanoGPT）与等算力设定下的定量对比、写作阶段用 PaperWritingBench。总体评价：架构与工程完整度高、动机叙述清晰、开放程度好，但学术贡献的验证强度偏弱，结论应视为「有前景的系统框架 + 待验证的设计主张」。

title: A Scalable Digital Twin Framework for Energy Optimization in Data Centers
summary: This study proposes a scalable Digital Twin framework for energy optimization in data centers.The framework integrates IoT-based data acquisition, cloud computing, and machine learning techniques to enable real-time monitoring, forecasting, and intelligent energy management. A controlled small-scale data center environment was developed to monitor variables such as power consumption, temperature, and computational workload. Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models were employed to predict energy demand and support operational decision-making. Experimental results demonstrated improvements in energy efficiency, including reductions in power consumption and enhancements in Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE). Despite being evaluated in a constrained environment, the proposed framework demonstrates strong potential as a scalable and cost-effective solution for sustainable data center management.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个用于数据中心能源优化的可扩展数字孪生框架，该框架整合物联网数据采集、云计算和LSTM机器学习模型，实现实时监控、能源预测和智能管理。在小型受控环境中的实验结果表明，该方案能够有效降低功耗并改善PUE，展现出作为可持续数据中心管理解决方案的可扩展性和成本效益。
AI.motivation: 数据中心的能源消耗持续增长，亟需有效的能源优化解决方案来实现可持续运营。
AI.method: 该框架集成了基于物联网的数据采集、云计算和机器学习技术。实验中开发了一个小型受控数据中心环境，监测功耗、温度和计算工作负载等变量，并采用长短期记忆(LSTM)模型预测能源需求以支持运营决策。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该框架实现了能源效率的提升，包括功耗降低和PUE（电源使用效率）改善。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在受控环境中表现出色，展现出作为数据中心的可扩展且经济有效的可持续管理解决方案的潜力。

title: Generating Query-Focused Summarization Datasets from Query-Free Summarization Datasets
summary: Large-scale datasets are widely used to perform summarization tasks, but they may not include queries alongside documents and summaries. In the search for suitable datasets for Query-Focused Summarization (QFS), we identify two research questions: Is it possible to automatically generate evidence-based query keywords from query-free datasets? Does evidence-based query generation support the QFS task? This paper proposes an evidence-based model to generate queries from query-free datasets. To evaluate our model intrinsically, we compare the similarity between the original queries and the system-generated queries of two QFS datasets. We also perform summarization tasks using different pre-trained models, as well as a state-of-the-art (SOTA) QFS model, to measure the extrinsic performance of our query generation approach. Experimental results indicate that summaries generated using evidence-based queries achieve competitive ROUGE scores compared to those generated from the original queries.

AI.tldr: 本文针对查询聚焦摘要任务，提出从无查询数据集中自动生成证据驱动查询的方法。通过内在相似度比较和外在摘要任务评估验证了该方法的有效性，生成的查询能够支持QFS任务并产生具有竞争力的摘要质量。
AI.motivation: 大规模摘要数据集往往缺乏配套的查询，导致难以直接用于查询聚焦摘要任务（QFS）。因此需要探索能否从无查询数据集中自动生成证据驱动的查询，并验证这种查询生成方式对QFS任务的有效性。
AI.method: 该方法首先提出了一种证据驱动的模型，用于从无查询数据集中自动生成查询关键词。实验采用双重评估策略：内在评估方面，比较系统生成的查询与原始查询的相似度；外在评估方面，使用多种预训练模型和先进的QFS模型执行摘要任务，通过ROUGE评分衡量性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用证据驱动查询生成的摘要能够达到与使用原始查询相近的ROUGE分数，验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 证据驱动查询生成方法能够有效支持QFS任务，使用生成查询产生的摘要与使用原始查询产生的摘要相比，能够达到具有竞争力的ROUGE分数。

title: Partial Evidence Bench: Benchmarking Authorization-Limited Evidence in Agentic Systems
comment: Benchmark paper with deterministic synthetic corpora, 14 pages, 6 tables
summary: Enterprise agents increasingly operate inside scoped retrieval systems, delegated workflows, and policy-constrained evidence environments. In these settings, access control can be enforced correctly while the system still produces an answer that appears complete even though material evidence lies outside the caller's authorization boundary. This paper introduces Partial Evidence Bench, a deterministic benchmark for measuring that failure mode. The benchmark ships three scenario families -- due diligence, compliance audit, and security incident response -- with 72 tasks total, ACL-partitioned corpora, oracle complete answers, oracle authorized-view answers, oracle completeness judgments, and structured gap-report oracles. It evaluates systems along four surfaces: answer correctness, completeness awareness, gap-report quality, and unsafe completeness behavior. Checked-in baselines show that silent filtering is catastrophically unsafe across all shipped families, while explicit fail-and-report behavior eliminates unsafe completeness without collapsing the task into trivial abstention. Preliminary real-model runs show model-dependent and scenario-sensitive differences in whether systems overclaim completeness, conservatively underclaim, or report incompleteness in an enterprise-usable form. The benchmark's broader contribution is to make a governance-critical agent failure measurable without human judges or contamination-prone static corpora.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Partial Evidence Bench，一个用于测量AI智能体在访问控制环境中是否错误声称完整性的基准测试。该基准包含72个任务，涵盖尽职调查、合规审计和安全事件响应三个场景，评估智能体在答案正确性、完整性意识、差距报告质量和不安全完整性行为四个维度的表现。
AI.motivation: Enterprise AI agents operate within scoped retrieval systems and policy-constrained environments where access control is correctly enforced, yet the system can produce answers that appear complete while critical evidence lies outside the caller's authorization boundary — a subtle but potentially dangerous failure mode that existing benchmarks fail to capture.
AI.method: Developed a deterministic benchmark with 72 tasks across three enterprise scenarios (due diligence, compliance audit, security incident response), using ACL-partitioned corpora with oracle complete answers, oracle authorized-view answers, oracle completeness judgments, and structured gap-report oracles. Evaluated four surfaces: answer correctness, completeness awareness, gap-report quality, and unsafe completeness behavior.
AI.result: Baseline systems show that silent filtering is "catastrophically unsafe" across all scenarios, while explicit fail-and-report behavior eliminates unsafe completeness without causing trivial abstention. Real-model runs reveal model-dependent and scenario-sensitive differences in completeness handling behaviors.
AI.conclusion: Partial Evidence Bench provides a deterministic, governance-critical benchmark for measuring AI agents' completeness awareness in access-controlled environments, demonstrating that baseline systems exhibit catastrophic unsafe completeness behavior that can be eliminated through explicit fail-and-report mechanisms.

title: SAT: Sequential Agent Tuning for Coordinator Free Plug and Play Multi-LLM Training with Monotonic Improvement Guarantees
summary: Large language models (LLMs) with a large number of parameters achieve strong performance but are often prohibitively expensive to deploy. Recent work explores using teams of smaller, more efficient LLMs that collectively match or even outperform a single large model. However, jointly updating multiple agents introduces compounding distribution shifts, making coordination and stability during training difficult. We address this by introducing Sequential Agent Tuning (SAT), a coordinator-free training paradigm. SAT represents the team as a factorized policy and employs block-coordinate updates over agents, enabling scalable, decentralized training without a central controller. Specifically, we develop a sequence-aware, on-policy advantage estimator that conditions on the evolving team policy, coupled with per-agent KL trust regions that isolate occupancy drift. Theoretically, this framework provides two critical guarantees. First, it ensures monotonic improvement, stabilizing the training process. Second, it establishes provable plug-and-play invariance: any agent can be upgraded to a stronger model without retraining the rest of the team, with a formal guarantee that the performance bound improves. Empirically, a team of three 4B agents (12B total) trained with SAT surpasses the much larger Qwen3-32B on AIME24/25 benchmarks by 3.9\% on average. We validate our plug-and-play theory by swapping in two 8B agents, which boosts the composite score by 10.4\%. We provide code and appendix of proof at https://github.com/Yydc/SAT-AAMAS

AI.tldr: 本文提出顺序智能体调优（SAT），一种无需中心控制器的多智能体协作训练范式。通过因子化策略表示、块坐标更新、序列感知优势估计和KL信任域，实现去中心化可扩展训练，理论上保证单调改进和即插即用不变性。实验表明12B参数的3个智能体团队即可超越32B大模型。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）参数量大虽性能强，但部署成本高昂。虽然多个小型高效LLM协作可能匹配甚至超越单一大型模型，但联合更新多个智能体会导致复合分布偏移，使训练中的协调和稳定性变得困难。
AI.method: 提出顺序智能体调优（SAT）框架：1）将团队表示为因子化策略；2）采用智能体间块坐标更新，实现去中心化可扩展训练，无需中心控制器；3）开发序列感知的on-policy优势估计器，条件化于演化中的团队策略；4）结合每智能体KL信任域以隔离策略漂移。
AI.result: 理论证明：1）单调改进保证，稳定性训练过程；2）即插即用不变性：任何智能体可升级为更强模型而无需重训练其他智能体，性能下界保证提升。实验：3个4B智能体（总计12B）在AIME24/25上平均超越Qwen3-32B达3.9%；替换为2个8B智能体后，组合分数提升10.4%。
AI.conclusion: SAT通过去中心化训练范式成功解决了多智能体协作训练的稳定性问题，证明了小型模型团队可超越大型模型，且具备理论保证的即插即用特性，为高效部署LLM提供了新思路。

title: Coordination Matters: Evaluation of Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) benchmarks commonly emphasize aggregate outcomes such as return, success rate, or completion time. While essential, these metrics often fail to reveal how agents coordinate, particularly in settings where agents, tasks, and joint assignment choices scale combinatorially. We propose a coordination-aware evaluation perspective that supplements return with process-level diagnostics. We instantiate this perspective using STAT, a controlled commitment-constrained spatial task-allocation testbed that systematically varies agents, tasks, and environment size while holding observation access and task rules fixed. We evaluate six representative value-based MARL methods across varying levels of centralization. Our results show that similar return trends can reflect distinct coordination mechanisms, including differences in redundant assignment, assignment diversity, and task-completion efficiency. We find that in commitment-constrained task allocation, performance under scale is shaped not only by nominal action-space size, but also by assignment pressure, sparse decision opportunities, and redundant choices among interdependent agents. Our findings motivate coordination-aware evaluation as a necessary complement to return-based benchmarking for cooperative MARL.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对现有协同多智能体强化学习基准过度依赖聚合结果指标的问题，提出协调感知评估视角，并通过STAT测试平台验证了相似回报可能掩盖不同协调机制的现象，强调协调感知评估应作为回报基准的必要补充。
AI.motivation: 现有协同多智能体强化学习基准主要关注聚合结果指标（回报率、成功率、完成时间），无法揭示智能体如何协调，特别是在智能体、任务和联合分配选择组合式扩展的场景中。
AI.method: 构建STAT测试平台（受约束承诺的空间任务分配），系统变化智能体数量、任务数量和环境规模，同时固定观察访问和任务规则；跨不同集中化程度评估六种代表性基于值的MARL方法。
AI.result: 相似回报趋势可能反映截然不同的协调机制，包括冗余分配、分配多样性和任务完成效率的差异；在约束承诺的任务分配中，规模性能不仅受名义动作空间大小影响，还受分配压力、稀疏决策机会和相互依赖智能体间冗余选择的影响。
AI.conclusion: 协调感知评估作为回报基准的必要补充，有助于揭示规模化场景下多智能体强化学习的真实协调机制。

title: Algorithmic Phase Transition for Large Independent Sets in Dense Hypergraphs
comment: 38 pages plus references; abstract shortened due to arxiv restrictions
summary:
We study the algorithmic tractability of finding large independent sets in dense random hypergraphs. In the sparse regime, much of the natural algorithms can be formulated within either the local or the low-degree polynomial (LDP) framework, and a rich literature has subsequently identified nearly sharp algorithmic thresholds within these classes by exploiting their stability. In the dense setting, however, the algorithmic paradigms are fundamentally different: they are online and thus need not be stable. Perhaps more crucially, even for the classical Erdős-Rényi random graph $G(n,p)$, LDPs are conjectured to fail in the 'easy' regime accessible to online algorithms, thereby challenging their viability for dense models.
  Our focus is on two models: (i) finding large independent sets in dense $r$-uniform Erdős-Rényi hypergraphs, and (ii) the more challenging problem of finding large $γ$-balanced independent sets in dense $r$-uniform $r$-partite hypergraphs, where the $i$-th coordinate of $γ\in\mathbb{Q}^r$ specifies the proportion of vertices from $V_i$ in the independent set. For both models, we pinpoint the size of the largest independent set and design online algorithms that achieve a multiplicative approximation factor of $r^{1/(r-1)}$ in the uniform and $(\max_i γ_i)^{-1/(r-1)}$ in the $r$-partite model. Furthermore, we establish matching algorithmic lower bounds, showing that these computational gaps are sharp: no online algorithms can breach these gaps.

AI.tldr: 研究了在稠密随机超图中寻找大独立集的算法可解性，针对均匀 Erdős-Rényi 超图和 $\gamma$ 平衡 $r$ 部超图两种模型设计了在线算法，分别达到 $r^{1/(r-1)}$ 和 $(\max_i \gamma_i)^{-1/(r-1)}$ 的近似因子，并证明这些界在算法上不可突破。
AI.motivation: 稀疏随机图中的局部或低度数多项式（LDP）框架已被广泛研究，但在稠密设置下算法范式根本不同——是在线的且可能不稳定。更关键的是，即使是经典 Erdős-Rényi 随机图，LDP 在在线算法可访问的"容易"区域也可能失效，这挑战了其对稠密模型的适用性。
AI.method: 采用在线算法框架，分析了稠密$r$一致 Erdős-Rényi 超图和 $r$部超图中的独立集问题。通过设计在线算法并建立对应下界，证明了近似因子的尖锐性。
AI.result: 对于均匀模型，在线算法达到乘法近似因子 $r^{1/(r-1)}$；对于 $r$ 部模型，达到 $(\max_i \gamma_i)^{-1/(r-1)}$。两个模型均实现了最优近似因子，算法上下界匹配。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了稠密随机超图中大独立集问题的算法上界与下界，证明在线算法在这些模型中无法突破上述近似因子，为稠密随机图模型的可计算性边界提供了完整的刻画。

title: Rigorous Interpretation Is a Form of Evaluation
summary: Current machine learning models are evaluated through behavioral snapshots, with benchmark accuracies, win rates and outcome-based metrics. Model explanations and evaluations, however, are fundamentally intertwined: understanding why a model produces a behavior can be as important as measuring what it produces. If we trusted interpretability, we argue that it can serve not merely as diagnostics but as a richer and more principled form of model evaluation beyond surface-level performance metrics. We explore three ways interpretability can function evaluatively: (1) fixing problems by identifying the root causes of unwanted behavior, (2) detecting subtly faulty mechanisms that invalidate model outputs, and (3) predicting potential issues before they arise by fully understanding the model's weaknesses. To fulfill its evaluative potential, we argue that interpretability methods must generate claims that are falsifiable, reproducible, and predictive -- that is, interpretability must meet scientific standards.

AI.tldr: The paper argues that interpretability should move beyond being a diagnostic tool to become a principled form of model evaluation. Current ML evaluation focuses on behavioral outcomes (benchmarks, win rates) but misses understanding why models produce certain behaviors. The authors propose three evaluative functions of interpretability: identifying root causes of failures, detecting subtle faulty mechanisms, and predicting potential issues by understanding weaknesses. To achieve this, interpretability methods must meet scientific standards—producing claims that are falsifiable, reproducible, and predictive.
AI.motivation: Current model evaluation relies solely on behavioral outcomes (accuracy, win rates) which measure "what" but not "why." This superficial evaluation is insufficient for understanding and addressing model failures.
AI.method: Conceptual framework exploring three evaluative functions of interpretability, with emphasis on scientific methodology requirements.
AI.result: Proposed three ways interpretability can serve evaluative purposes: (1) root-cause diagnosis for fixing problems, (2) detecting subtle faulty mechanisms, and (3) predictive identification of potential weaknesses.
AI.conclusion: Interpretability methods must satisfy scientific standards (falsifiability, reproducibility, and predictive power) to fully realize their evaluative potential.

title: Towards Dependable Retrieval-Augmented Generation Using Factual Confidence Prediction
summary: Incorporating specific knowledge into large language models via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a widespread technique that fuels many of today's industry AI applications. A fundamental problem is to assess if the context retrieved by some similarity search provides indeed supporting facts, or instead misguides the generator with irrelevant information. It is critical to associate meaningful confidence measures about the factuality of the retrieval process with the generated answers. We present a new, two-staged approach to predict fact faithfulness of the output of retrieval-augmented generations. First, we employ conformal prediction to select only those retrieved chunks who have a high chance to come from the correct source. This approach in itself can improve answer quality by up to 6% in some of the studied datasets, however, the associated statistical guarantees do not hold generally, since the assumption of sample exchangeability depends on the retriever setup. We present diagnostic metrics to assess whether a setup is suitable. Second, we quantify confidence in the consistency of a generated final answer with a given retrieved context, using an attention-based factuality classifier. This approach can detect inconsistent answers with a chance of up to 77%. Our work helps to establish a novel type of certified RAG systems for a broad range of natural language industry applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段方法评估检索增强生成的事实忠实度：一是通过 conformal prediction 筛选高质量检索 chunks（提升答案质量6%），二是用注意力分类器检测答案与检索上下文的不一致性（检测率77%），旨在构建可认证的RAG系统。
AI.motivation: 将特定知识注入大语言模型时，检索到的上下文可能提供支持性事实或包含无关信息误导生成器，因此需要为生成答案的事实性建立有意义的置信度度量。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：第一阶段使用 conformal prediction 选择高置信度检索 chunks；第二阶段使用基于注意力的 factuality 分类器量化生成答案与检索上下文的置信度一致性。
AI.result: Conformal prediction 方法可将答案质量提升达6%，但其统计学保证依赖于检索器的样本交换性假设；注意力事实性分类器可检测出高达77%的不一致答案。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一种新型认证RAG系统的框架，通过 conformal prediction 选择高质量检索 chunks（提升答案质量达6%）和注意力事实性分类器（检测不一致答案率达77%），有助于提升自然语言工业应用的可靠性。

title: Bridging Generation and Training: A Systematic Review of Quality Issues in LLMs for Code
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate defective outputs in code generation tasks, ranging from logical bugs to security vulnerabilities. While these generation failures are often treated as model-level limitations, empirical evidence increasingly traces their root causes to imperfections within the training corpora. Yet, the specific mechanisms linking training data quality issues to generated code quality issues remain largely unmapped. This paper presents a systematic literature review of 114 primary studies to investigate how training data quality issues propagate into code generation. We establish a unified taxonomy that categorizes generated code quality issues across nine dimensions and training data quality issues into code and non-code attributes. Based on this taxonomy, we formalize a causal framework detailing 18 typical propagation mapping mechanisms. Furthermore, we synthesize state-of-the-art detection and mitigation techniques across the data, model, and generation lifecycles. The reviewed literature reveals a clear methodological shift: quality assurance is transitioning from reactive, heuristic-based post-generation filtering toward proactive, data-centric governance and closed-loop repair. Finally, we identify open challenges and outline research directions for developing reliable LLMs for code through integrated data curation and continuous evaluation. Our repository is available at https://github.com/SYSUSELab/From-Data-to-Code.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述114项研究，探讨训练数据质量问题如何影响代码生成质量。建立了统一的分类体系和包含18种机制的因果框架，并综合分析了检测与缓解技术。研究发现质量保证正从后生成过滤转向主动的数据治理和闭环修复，为通过集成数据策管开发可靠代码生成LLM提供了研究方向。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在代码生成任务中频繁产生有缺陷的输出，从逻辑错误到安全漏洞不等。尽管这些生成失败常被视为模型层面的问题，但经验证据表明其根本原因往往可追溯到训练语料库的缺陷。然而，训练数据质量问题与生成代码质量问题之间的具体关联机制尚未被清晰映射。
AI.method: 对该领域114项主要研究进行系统性文献综述，建立了统一的分类体系，将生成代码质量问题分为9个维度，训练数据质量问题分为代码和非代码属性两大类。在此基础上，形式化了一个包含18种典型传播映射机制的因果框架，并对数据、模型和生成生命周期中的最新检测与缓解技术进行综合分析。
AI.result: 建立了统一的分类体系：生成代码质量问题涵盖9个维度，训练数据质量问题分为代码属性和非代码属性两类；形式化了一个包含18种典型传播映射机制的因果框架；综合分析了跨越数据、模型和生成生命周期的检测与缓解技术。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现了明显的方法论转变：质量保证正从被动的、基于启发式的后生成过滤，转向主动的、以数据为中心的治理和闭环修复。最终识别了开放性挑战并概述了通过集成数据策管和持续评估开发可靠LLM的研究方向。

title: Irminsul: MLA-Native Position-Independent Caching for Agentic LLM Serving
summary: Agentic LLM workloads put bit-identical tokens at shifted positions every turn, voiding prefix caches at the first byte of divergence. Operators report cache-hit regressions ranging from moderate slowdowns to severe TTFT spikes of 10-16s on unchanged content. Prior position-independent caching systems correct RoPE on the full $d_K$-dimensional key, an architectural cost imposed by GQA, not by caching itself. Multi-Head Latent Attention, deployed at scale in DeepSeek-V2/V3/R1, Kimi-K2/Moonlight, GLM-5, and Mistral Large 3, factors each KV row into a position-free $c_{KV}$ and a 64-dim $k_r$ correctable in closed form; this structure motivates content-addressed caching as a natural fit rather than a GQA workaround. We present Irminsul, which extends SGLang's radix cache with content-hash keying over CDC-chunked segments and a $δ$-rotation rule for $k_r$. We evaluate three native MLA-MoE deployments - DeepSeek-V2-Lite (16B/2.4B), Kimi Moonlight-16B-A3B, and JoyAI-Flash (48B/3B) - with output-consistency on all three and recovery measured on the two endpoints; Irminsul recovers up to ~83% of prompt tokens above exact-prefix on agentic traffic while delivering 63% prefill energy savings per cache hit. We argue that content-addressed caching belongs in the serving stack as a first-class primitive, not a retrofit over prefix matching.

AI.tldr: Irminsul是一个基于MLA架构内容寻址特性设计的缓存系统，通过内容哈希键控和k_r的δ旋转规则扩展SGLang基数缓存，在三个主流MLA-MoE模型上实现了83%的提示令牌恢复率和63%预填充能耗节省，为LLM服务系统提供了一种新的缓存范式。
AI.motivation: Agentic LLM工作负载每轮将位相同的令牌置于偏移位置，导致前缀缓存在首个分歧字节处失效，产生10-16秒的TTFT尖峰；现有位置无关缓存系统需对GQA全d_K维Key进行RoPE校正，带来不必要架构开销。
AI.method: Irminsul通过内容哈希键控CDC分块段和k_r的δ旋转规则扩展SGLang基数缓存，利用MLA中c_KV位置无关性与k_r的64维可封闭形式校正特性，实现跨请求缓存复用。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-V2-Lite(16B/2.4B)、Kimi Moonlight-16B-A3B、JoyAI-Flash(48B/3B)三个MLA-MoE部署上，Irminsul在Agentic流量中恢复了约83%的精确前缀以上提示令牌，每次缓存命中节省63%预填充能耗。
AI.conclusion: Irminsul将内容寻址缓存定位为服务栈的一等公民(First-Class Primitive)，而非前缀匹配的后备方案，实现了83%的提示令牌恢复率和63%的预填充能耗节省。

title: SLAM: Structural Linguistic Activation Marking for Language Models
summary: LLM watermarks must be detectable without compromising text quality, yet most existing schemes bias the next-token distribution and pay for detection with measurable quality loss. We present SLAM (Structural Linguistic Activation Marking), a novel white-box watermarking scheme that sidesteps this cost by writing the mark into structural geometry rather than token frequencies: sparse autoencoders identify residual-stream directions encoding linguistic structure (e.g., voice, tense, clause order), and we causally steer those directions at generation time, leaving lexical sampling and semantics unconstrained. On Gemma-2 2B and 9B, SLAM achieves 100% detection accuracy with a quality cost of only 1-2 reward points - compared to 7.5-11.5 for KGW, EWD, and Unigram - with naturalness and diversity preserved at near-unwatermarked levels across both models. The trade-off is a complementary robustness profile: SLAM resists word-level edits but is vulnerable to paraphrase that restructures syntax (at a quality cost), the converse of token-distribution methods.

AI.tldr: SLAM是一种新型白盒水印方案，通过稀疏自编码器识别残差流中的语言结构方向并引导生成，在Gemma-2模型上实现100%检测率，质量损失仅1-2分（传统方法为7.5-11.5分），但对句法改写攻击抵抗力较弱。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM水印方案通过偏置下一个token分布来嵌入水印，导致文本质量明显下降（质量损失达7.5-11.5分），这种检测能力与质量之间的权衡制约了水印技术的实用价值。
AI.method: SLAM通过稀疏自编码器识别残差流中编码语言结构（如时态、从句顺序）方向的向量，在生成时因果性地引导这些方向，同时保持词汇采样和语义不受约束。
AI.result: 在Gemma-2 2B和9B上，SLAM达到100%检测准确率，质量损失仅1-2分（对比KGW、EWD、Unigram的7.5-11.5分），自然性和多样性接近无水印水平。
AI.conclusion: SLAM通过结构几何编码而非token频率实现了检测质量权衡的突破，其鲁棒性特征与token分布方法互补：能抵御词级编辑攻击，但对重构句法的改写攻击敏感（代价是质量损失）。

title: BALAR : A Bayesian Agentic Loop for Active Reasoning
summary: Large language models increasingly operate in interactive settings where solving a task requires multiple rounds of information exchange with a user. However, most current systems treat dialogue reactively and lack a principled mechanism to reason about what information is missing and which question should be asked next. We propose BALAR (Bayesian Agentic Loop for Active Reasoning), a task-agnostic outer-loop algorithm that requires no fine-tuning and enables structured multi-turn interaction between an LLM agent and a user. BALAR maintains a structured belief over latent states, selects clarifying questions by maximizing expected mutual information, and dynamically expands its state representation when the current one proves insufficient. We evaluate BALAR on three diverse benchmarks: AR-Bench-DC (detective cases), AR-Bench-SP (thinking puzzles), and iCraft-MD (clinical diagnosis). BALAR significantly outperforms all baselines across all three benchmarks, with $14.6\%$ higher accuracy on AR-Bench-DC, $38.5\%$ on AR-Bench-SP, and $30.5\%$ on iCraft-MD.

AI.tldr: BALAR是一种基于贝叶斯推断的主动推理框架，通过结构化信念维护和互信息最大化引导LLM agent主动向用户提问以获取关键信息，在侦探推理、思维谜题和临床诊断三项任务中均取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 当前的大语言模型在交互式环境中处理多轮对话时存在缺陷：系统被动响应用户，缺乏推理缺失信息和决定下一步提问的机制。
AI.method: BALAR是一个任务无关的外环算法，无需微调。它通过三个核心机制实现主动推理：1) 维护对潜在状态的结构化信念表示；2) 通过最大化预期互信息来选择澄清性问题；3) 当当前表示不足时动态扩展状态空间。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试上显著优于所有基线方法：AR-Bench-DC（侦探案件）提升14.6%、AR-Bench-SP（思维谜题）提升38.5%、iCraft-MD（临床诊断）提升30.5%。
AI.conclusion: BALAR provides an effective task-agnostic solution for structured multi-turn interaction between LLM agents and users, requiring no fine-tuning and demonstrating significant improvements across diverse benchmarks including detective cases, thinking puzzles, and clinical diagnosis scenarios.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Learnable Loss Balancing and Transfer Learning
summary: We propose a self-supervised physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework that adaptively balances physics-based and data-driven supervision for scientific machine learning under data scarcity. Unlike prior PINNs that rely on fixed or heuristic weighting of physics residuals and data loss, our approach introduces a learnable blending neuron that dynamically adjusts the relative contribution of each term based on their uncertainties. This mechanism enables stable training and improved generalization without manual tuning. To further enhance efficiency, we integrate a transfer learning strategy that reuses representations from related domains and adapts them to new physical systems with limited data. We validate the framework for the prediction of heat transfer in liquid-metal miniature heat sinks using only 87 CFD datapoints, where the adaptive PINN achieves an error <8%, outperforming shallow neural networks, kernel methods, and physics-only baselines. Our framework provides a general recipe for embedding physics adaptively into neural networks, offering a robust and reproducible approach for data-scarce problems across various scientific domains, including fluid dynamics and material modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自监督 PINN 框架：用可学习的 sigmoid"混合神经元"（λd=σ(α)、λp=1−σ(α)）自动平衡物理残差与数据损失，并配合从水冷微通道到钠冷微型热沉的迁移学习。验证对象为仅 87 个 CFD 数据点的液态钠（SS-316）矩形微型热沉努塞尔数预测。结论是：迁移学习 NN 的精度最低（MAPE 0.0020），SVR–Bayesian 次之（0.0125），而自监督 PINN 为 0.0185，但其预测方差最低、鲁棒性最好（学习到的 λp 集中在 0.5 附近）。值得注意的是，摘要中"PINN 优于浅层网络与核方法"的说法与正文表格结果（PINN 精度劣于这两类）并不一致。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习中常面临高保真仿真/实验数据极其稀缺的情况（如航天任务、机器人集群、粒子加速器），纯数据驱动网络在小样本、含噪条件下精度与稳定性急剧下降，而 PINN 可通过将守恒方程以软约束形式写入损失函数来约束解空间。核心痛点在于物理损失与数据损失的权重平衡：固定或人工启发式权重会导致收敛失败或预测偏差；已有的自适应方案（基于梯度的 self-adaptive PINN、NTK 分析、贝叶斯不确定度加权）要么依赖启发式规则、要么带来贝叶斯推断的额外开销、要么对超参敏感。同时，PINN 与迁移学习的结合仍属空白，而迁移学习在 CFD 代理模型中已被证明能加速收敛。作者因此希望用一个轻量、自监督、无需调参的机制动态完成"物理—数据"权衡，并在极小样本（87 点）下保持可复现的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 数据与CFD：使用 Ansys Fluent 求解 SS-316 矩形微型热沉中液态钠的层流与湍流对流换热，87 个样本，输入为热沉宽度、长宽比、水力直径、钠冷却剂 Peclet 数，输出努塞尔数；控制方程为不可压缩连续性方程、Navier–Stokes 动量方程、流体能量方程与固体基体热传导方程（k 随温度变化），固—液界面无滑移、入口等温等速。框架：标准 PINN 损失 L=λd·L_data+λp·L_physics；数据项为 CFD 努塞尔数的 MSE，物理项为配点上的 PDE 残差平方均值。混合神经元用单一可训练标量 α 经 sigmoid 生成互补权重 λd=σ(α)、λp=1−σ(α)，与网络参数 θ 一起由反向传播更新，从而免去人工调参（形式上实现"自监督"）。迁移学习：先在数据较多的水冷微通道源任务上训练基础 PINN，得到 θ*_source，用其初始化目标网络 θ_target(0)←θ*_source，微调时冻结前部隐层、只更新末若干层与 α。训练用 Adam + 学习率调度 + 早停；模型选择用 GA/贝叶斯优化架构；泛化评估用 10 折交叉验证与 500 次蒙特卡洛模拟；基线包括 GP(RBF)、SVR(RBF，随机搜索与贝叶斯优化)、无迁移的 NN、带迁移的 NN；另用核密度估计与 Mann–Whitney U 检验比较水/钠数据分布以论证跨域迁移的合理性。
AI.result: 1) 核方法：GP(RBF) MAPE 0.0756；SVR–RS 0.0272（C=10, γ=1e-4, ε=1e-3, 4 次迭代）；SVR–Bayesian 0.0125（C=27.23, γ=7e-4, ε=3.1e-3, 17 次迭代收敛更快）。2) 迁移学习：GA 选出 2 隐层结构，第二层 8 神经元随机初始化；迁移第 1 隐层时 MAPE 由 0.0028 降至 0.0020；迁移越靠近输出的层反而变差，说明浅层低层特征可迁移而高层为域特有表示。3) 分布检验：钠数据方差大于水（KDE），Mann–Whitney U 检验 p≪0.05 支持水→钠迁移。4) 自监督 PINN：最优结构为 20-20-12，Adam 学习率 0.34，100 次优化迭代后 10 折交叉验证 MAPE=0.0185；学到的 λp 分布中心约在 0.5，说明物理与数据贡献近似均衡。5) 蒙特卡洛（500 次）：PINN 的 var(pred)=0.1146 低于 TR_NN 的 0.2183 与 NN 的 0.2323，但 var(MAPE)=0.0008 高于两者的 0.0002，且平均训练轮数 35 明显多于 14.2–14.3。6) 所有方法的预测均落在 ±8% 误差带内。7) 值得注意的内部矛盾：摘要称 adaptive PINN"误差 <8%，优于浅层神经网络、核方法与纯物理基线"，但表 4 显示 PINN 的 MAPE（0.0185）明显劣于 SVR–Bayesian（0.0125）与迁移学习 NN（0.0020）；且全文未报告任何"纯物理基线"的对比结果。另外，方法部分声称混合神经元"依据两项损失的不确定度"动态调节，但公式 (6) 仅是标量 α 的 sigmoid 映射，并未显式计算或利用不确定度，摘要表述与实现存在偏差。第三，3.3 节提出的"迁移学习 PINN"组合在实验中没有端到端评估——表中最好的迁移学习模型是不含物理约束的纯 NN，而 PINN 一栏看不出是否使用了迁移初始化，因此"框架的两大组件被联合验证"这一主张缺乏证据支撑。此外，PINN 输出目标是标量努塞尔数，但损失中的物理项是速度/压力/温度场残差，从场解到 Nu 的后处理映射在文中未加说明。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，GP/SVR 是有竞争力的基线但对核函数与超参调优敏感；迁移学习 NN 精度最优（MAPE 0.0020），证明相关物理系统之间存在可复用的结构特征；自监督 PINN 虽精度略逊（MAPE 0.0185），但通过自适应混合神经元在无需人工调参的前提下获得最佳鲁棒性（更低预测方差、对超参与初始化随机性不敏感），在数据极度稀缺及安全攸关场景（液态金属热管理、航空航天、生物医学器件）中更具部署价值。作者定位该框架为"在有控制方程但数据有限"场景下的通用配方，并指出未来工作为多物理场混合机制、不确定度量化以及扩展到大规模 3D CFD。需要提醒读者：由于摘要中的优越性表述与正文量化结果相悖，本文更适合作为"自适应加权 PINN + 跨域迁移"的一种探索性组合思路来解读，其"优于核方法/浅层网络"的结论并未被自身实验数据支持；且作为单案例、小样本（87 点）研究，统计显著性仅由 Mann–Whitney U 与交叉验证支撑，缺乏独立数据集上的可复现性验证。

title: Cooperative Profiles Predict Multi-Agent LLM Team Performance in AI for Science Workflows
summary: Multi-agent systems built from teams of large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for collaborative scientific reasoning and problem-solving. These systems require agents to coordinate under shared constraints, such as GPUs or credit balances, where cooperative behavior matters. Behavioral economics provides a rich toolkit of games that isolate distinct cooperation mechanisms, yet it remains unknown whether a model's behavior in these stylized settings predicts its performance in realistic collaborative tasks. Here, we benchmark 35 open-weight LLMs across six behavioral economics games and show that game-derived cooperative profiles robustly predict downstream performance in AI-for-Science tasks, where teams of LLM agents collaboratively analyze data, build models, and produce scientific reports under shared budget constraints. Models that effectively coordinate games and invest in multiplicative team production (rather than greedy strategies) produce better scientific reports across three outcomes, accuracy, quality, and completion. These associations hold after controlling for multiple factors, indicating that cooperative disposition is a distinct, measurable property of LLMs not reducible to general ability. Our behavioral games framework thus offers a fast and inexpensive diagnostic for screening cooperative fitness before costly multi-agent deployment.

AI.tldr: Multi-agent LLM systems require cooperation under shared constraints, yet it was unclear if stylized game behaviors predict realistic task performance. This study benchmarks 35 LLMs across 6 behavioral economics games and finds that cooperative profiles robustly predict performance in AI-for-Science tasks. Models that coordinate and invest in team production produce better scientific reports across accuracy, quality, and completion. This suggests cooperative disposition is a distinct, measurable property usable as a diagnostic tool.
AI.motivation: Multi-agent LLM systems require cooperative behavior under shared constraints (e.g., GPUs, credit balances), but it was unknown whether a model's behavior in stylized behavioral economics games predicts its performance in realistic collaborative tasks.
AI.method: Benchmarked 35 open-weight LLMs across 6 behavioral economics games, then tested their performance in AI-for-Science tasks (collaborative data analysis, model building, and report generation) under shared budget constraints.
AI.result: Game-derived cooperative profiles robustly predict downstream AI-for-Science performance. Models that coordinate games and invest in multiplicative team production produce better scientific reports across three outcomes (accuracy, quality, and completion). These associations hold after controlling for multiple factors.
AI.conclusion: Cooperative disposition is a distinct, measurable property of LLMs not reducible to general ability. Behavioral economics games offer a fast and inexpensive diagnostic tool for screening cooperative fitness before costly multi-agent deployment.

title: Discrete Optimal Transport: Rapid Convergence of Simulated Annealing Algorithms
summary:
We develop a discrete optimal transport framework for analyzing simulated annealing algorithms on finite state spaces. Building on the discrete Wasserstein metric introduced by Maas (J. Funct. Anal., 2011), we define a generalized discrete Wasserstein-2 distance and the associated notion of \emph{discrete action} for paths of probability measures on graphs. Using these tools, we establish non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for simulated annealing: the KL divergence between the algorithm's output and the target distribution is controlled by the discrete action of the annealing path. This can be viewed as the discrete counterpart of the action-based analysis of annealed Langevin dynamics in continuous spaces by Guo, Tao, and Chen (ICLR 2025).
  As applications, we analyze simulated annealing for two fundamental models in statistical physics. For the \emph{mean-field Ising model}, we show that annealed single-site Glauber dynamics achieves $\varepsilon$ error in KL divergence in $O(n^5β^2/\varepsilon)$ steps at \emph{any} inverse temperature $β\ge 0$. For the \emph{mean-field $q$-state Potts model}, we show that annealed $(q-1)$-block Glauber dynamics achieves $\varepsilon$ error in $\mathrm{poly}(n, β, 1/\varepsilon)$ steps for all $β\ge β_{\mathsf{s}}=q/2$, the regime where the disordered phase has completely lost stability. In both cases, the key technical contribution is a polynomial upper bound on the discrete action, obtained by exploiting the symmetry of the model to reduce the analysis to a low-dimensional projected chain.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一套离散最优传输框架来分析有限状态空间上的模拟退火算法。通过定义广义离散Wasserstein-2距离和路径的离散作用量，为模拟退火提供了非渐近收敛保证，并将KL散度与退火路径的离散作用量联系起来，可视为连续空间退火Langevin动力学分析（ICLR 2025）的离散对应物。应用于平均场Ising模型和平均场q状态Potts模型，分别给出多项式步数收敛界。
AI.motivation: 连续空间中的模拟退火分析已有基于作用量的框架（Guo et al., ICLR 2025），但离散状态空间缺乏对应理论。现有离散最优传输工具（ Maas, 2011）尚未被系统用于分析退火算法的收敛性。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立离散空间中的非渐近收敛理论。
AI.method: 1. 基于Maas的离散Wasserstein度量，定义广义离散Wasserstein-2距离；2. 定义路径的"离散作用量"概念；3. 建立KL散度上界与离散作用量之间的关系；4. 利用模型对称性，将分析约化到低维投影链，从而得到离散作用量的多项式上界。
AI.result: 对平均场Ising模型：任意β≥0，O(n⁵β²/ε)步达到ε误差；对平均场q状态Potts模型：在β≥β_s=q/2（无序相完全失稳区域），(q-1)块Glauber动力学在poly(n,β,1/ε)步内收敛。
AI.conclusion: 建立了离散状态空间模拟退火的非渐近理论框架，统一了连续与离散空间的分析方法。通过对称性约化到低维分析的技术路线，为其他离散模型的退火算法分析提供了可推广的范式。

title: The Missing Evaluation Axis: What 10,000 Student Submissions Reveal About AI Tutor Effectiveness
comment: Accepted to the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026), Main Conference Track
summary: Current Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based tutoring systems (AI tutors) are primarily evaluated based on the pedagogical quality of their feedback messages. While important, pedagogy alone is insufficient because it ignores a critical question: what do students actually do with the feedback they receive? We argue that AI tutor evaluation should be extended with a behavioral dimension grounded in student interaction data, which complements pedagogical assessment. We propose an evaluation framework and apply it to 10,235 code submissions with corresponding AI tutor feedback from an introductory undergraduate programming course to measure whether students act on tutor feedback and whether those actions are applied correctly. Using this framework to compare two deployed AI tutors across different semesters in a large-scale introductory computer science course reveals substantial differences in student engagement patterns that are not captured by pedagogy-only evaluation. Moreover, these engagement-based behavioral signals are more strongly associated with student perception of helpful feedback than pedagogical quality alone, providing a more complete and actionable picture of AI tutor performance.

AI.tldr: 传统AI辅导系统评估仅关注教学反馈质量，忽略了学生是否真正采取行动。该研究提出一个行为维度的评估框架，基于10,235份代码提交数据，发现不同AI辅导系统之间学生参与模式存在显著差异，且行为信号与学生感知反馈有用性的关联比单纯的教学质量更强。
AI.motivation: Current AI tutor evaluation focuses solely on pedagogical quality of feedback, which is insufficient because it ignores whether students actually act on the feedback they receive.
AI.method: Proposed an evaluation framework grounded in student interaction data and applied it to 10,235 code submissions with AI tutor feedback from an introductory undergraduate programming course; compared two deployed AI tutors across different semesters.
AI.result: Substantial differences in student engagement patterns were found between the two AI tutors that pedagogy-only evaluation fails to capture; behavioral signals are more strongly associated with student perception of helpful feedback than pedagogical quality alone.
AI.conclusion: AI tutor evaluation should include a behavioral dimension that complements pedagogical assessment to provide a more complete and actionable picture of AI tutor performance.

title: TriAlignGR: Triangular Multitask Alignment with Multimodal Deep Interest Mining for Generative Recommendation
summary: We introduce TriAlignGR, a unified multitask-multimodal framework for generative recommendation that establishes two-stage multimodal semantic propagation: (i) encoding visual semantics directly into SIDs via multimodal embeddings, and (ii) enabling the model to decode these semantics through visual description tasks. Existing Semantic ID (SID) pipelines suffer from two fundamental but underexplored problems: \textbf{SID Content Degradation (SCD)}, where cascaded encoding and residual quantization discard critical multimodal and interest-level semantics; and \textbf{SID Semantic Opacity (SSO)}, where models autoregressively generate SID sequences without truly comprehending their underlying meaning, leading to hallucination and poor generalization. Prior work addresses at most text-SID alignment, leaving visual semantics and latent user interests entirely unexploited. TriAlignGR resolves both problems through three tightly integrated components: (1)~\textbf{Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment (CMSA)} integrates visual content into SID construction through both VLM-generated textual descriptions and a multimodal embedding model that directly encodes image features alongside text, ensuring that SIDs inherently carry multimodal semantics; (2)~\textbf{Multimodal Deep Interest Mining (MDIM)} leverages LLM Chain-of-Thought reasoning to extract latent user intents (\eg ``productivity-focused lifestyle'' from noise-canceling headphones) beyond surface attributes, enriching SID semantics before discretization; and (3)~\textbf{Triangular Multitask (TMT)} jointly trains on eight complementary generation tasks under a single autoregressive loss -- including two novel visual-semantic tasks (VisDesc$\to$SID, VisDesc$\to$Title) that map VLM-generated image descriptions to SIDs and titles, completing the SID-Text-Image triangle -- without requiring task-specific towers or complex loss weighting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TriAlignGR，一个用于生成式推荐的多任务多模态统一框架。该框架通过跨模态语义对齐(CMSA)、多模态深度兴趣挖掘(MDIM)和三角多任务(TMT)三个组件解决现有SID管道中的内容降解和语义不透明问题，实现视觉语义向SID的直接编码和模型对语义的真理解读。
AI.motivation: 现有SID(语义ID)管道存在两个关键问题：①SID内容降解(SCD)——级联编码和残差量化丢弃了关键的多模态和兴趣级语义；②SID语义不透明(SSO)——模型自回归生成SID序列但未真正理解其底层含义，导致幻觉和泛化差。现有工作仅处理文本-SID对齐，视觉语义和潜在用户兴趣完全未被开发。
AI.method: 提出TriAlignGR框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)跨模态语义对齐(CMSA)通过视觉-语言模型生成的文本描述和多模态嵌入模型将图像特征直接编码进SID；(2)多模态深度兴趣挖掘(MDIM)利用LLM思维链推理提取用户潜在意图；(3)三角多任务(TMT)在单一自回归损失下联合训练8个互补生成任务，包括两个新的视觉语义任务(VisDesc→SID, VisDesc→Title)完成SID-Text-Image三角闭环。
AI.result: 通过CMSA实现视觉内容向SID的直接整合，MDIM通过思维链推理挖掘深层用户意图，TMT以统一损失函数完成多任务协同训练，构建了完整的多模态语义传播链路。
AI.conclusion: TriAlignGR通过三个紧密集成的组件有效解决了SID(content降解)和SSO(语义不透明)问题，在统一的多任务框架下实现了视觉语义向SID的直接编码和模型对语义的真理解读，为生成式推荐的多模态融合提供了新的解决思路。

title: Mise en Place for Agentic Coding: Deliberate Preparation as Context Engineering Methodology
comment: 5 pages. Accepted at VibeX 2026, the 1st International Workshop on Vibe Coding and Vibe Researching, co-located with EASE 2026, Glasgow, June 9-12 2026. Camera-ready version. Research artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19868258
summary: The rapid adoption of AI coding agents has produced a dominant workflow pattern -- often called "vibe coding" -- that prioritizes speed of implementation over deliberate preparation. We argue that this approach creates a systematic alignment problem: agents that lack sufficient context produce code requiring extensive debugging and refactoring, consuming substantial development time. Drawing on the culinary concept of mise en place (everything in its place; abbreviated MEP), we propose a three-phase preparation methodology for agentic coding: (1) contextual grounding, where domain expertise and tacit knowledge are externalized into structured documents; (2) collaborative specification, where human-agent dialogue produces detailed design artifacts; and (3) task decomposition, where specifications are converted into structured, dependency-aware task records. We report on the application of MEP during a competitive hackathon, where roughly two hours of preparation enabled a rapid parallel implementation of a full-stack educational platform by concurrent AI agents. We introduce the concept of context fluency as an emerging developer skill -- the ability to create rich, structured context that agents can act on -- and connect it to established frameworks in backward design and tacit knowledge externalization. We conclude with a research agenda for empirically validating preparation-phase methodologies in AI-assisted software development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「Mise en Place（MEP）」方法论，将代理式编码（agentic coding）中的对齐问题重新定义为「准备问题」：先完成三阶段准备（情境化落地→协作式规格→任务分解），再让多个AI代理并行实现。以2026年1月一次5小时黑客松为案例，约2小时准备产出10份文档（9,386词）、一份产品规格与64条依赖感知任务记录，随后4个并行代理用184分钟完成43个任务、产出43个TS/TSX文件共8,496行代码，几乎无架构返工。同时提出「上下文流利度（context fluency）」作为新的开发者技能，并给出5个研究问题与3条研究路线。
AI.motivation: 当前主流的「vibe coding」工作流强调快速实现而牺牲了前期准备，导致AI编码代理因上下文不足而产生系统性对齐问题：代码需要大量调试与重构，返工成本高（Veracode 2025 报告45%的AI生成代码含安全缺陷）。作者主张代理式编码的瓶颈并非代码生成能力，而是开发者意图与代理产出之间的对齐（规格符合度、架构保真度、纠正性提交比例），并将其本质归因为一个「准备（preparation）」问题。既有方法（spec-driven开发、prompt engineering、RPI、Beads等）各自解决局部问题，缺乏一个理论有据、把隐性知识外化、协作规格与依赖感知分解整合为阶段门控序列的统一方法。
AI.method: 方法上采用「方法论提案 + 单一案例研究 + 理论定位」三部分：(1) 提出MEP三阶段流程——Phase 1情境化落地（将领域专长与隐性知识外化为结构化markdown简报文档，依逆向设计从预期结果出发）、Phase 2协作式规格（人机对话生成设计文档，将价值判断编码为规格约束，强调「排除什么」与记录「为什么」）、Phase 3任务分解（用Beads风格的JSON任务记录承载优先级、依赖与验收标准），三阶段在实现开始前全部完成（阶段门控）。(2) 案例：2026年1月某出版商编辑档案+AI内容API主题黑客松，5小时、约12队、评审团与5000美元奖金；实践者投入约2小时准备，产出10份规划文档、1份产品规格、64条任务记录，随后部署4个并行子代理（课堂创建、学生研究工作区、演示切换、苏格拉底式AI导师）分工实现，43个bead关闭（中位5.9分钟/任务），部署阶段52分钟9次提交。(3) 定性对照：对12队公开pitch与现场观察做粗粒度聚类（vibe/decomp/mixed），未对其他队伍做仪表化。(4) 理论支撑：逆向设计（Wiggins & McTighe）、波兰尼隐性知识与Nonaka-Takeuchi SECI外化模型，并与prompt engineering（调用粒度）、spec-driven开发、迭代式工作流（流程粒度）做作用域定位。
AI.result: 量化结果：准备与代码的规划-代码比为9,386词 : 8,496行 = 1.10:1；准备与执行时间比约5.7:1（2小时准备 vs 每代理约21分钟净实现）；64条任务中43条关闭（中位5.9分钟，长尾为API客户端与状态持久化任务）；实现阶段184分钟；最终43个TypeScript/TSX文件共8,496行并完成生产部署；部署后9次提交（每约5分钟一次），发现的缺陷均为集成与样式类（API内容截断、组件间数据流、favicon配置），架构层面零结构性重构；缺陷类bead中位1.2分钟（均值1.5分钟）修复，对比实现类任务9.7分钟。定性观察：12队中约半数为vibe式迭代prompt，工程主导团队均先做显式规划；仅本研究团队使用并行子代理分解执行。结论为「与假设一致」而非因果证明。
AI.conclusion: MEP是对资深实践者自发趋同做法的形式化：它主张代理式编码中的对齐问题在根本上是准备问题，应作为一等工程学科对待，并引入「上下文流利度」命名位于领域专长与规格技艺交叉处的新技能（分解、规格、约束定义、领域编码四个成分），并将其影响延伸到开发者教育课程、招聘标准与工具设计三大方面。作者明确声明不做普遍性主张：实证基础为单场黑客松、单一实践者、无对照组，操作者「教育+软件工程」双重背景构成混淆变量，5.7:1比率与近零返工属观察而非相对于基线的效应。后续研究议程含5个RQ与3条研究线（配对比较、跨队复现、纵向研究），其中RQ1最具可操作性；研究构件包（匿名数据、提示与代理配置、CLAUDE.md/bads schema/规划模板等MEP脚手架）以CC-BY 4.0/MIT发布于Zenodo（doi:10.5281/zenodo.19868258）以支持复现。

title: LLM-Enhanced Deep Reinforcement Learning for Task Offloading in Collaborative Edge Computing
summary: Collaborative edge computing uses edge nodes in different locations to execute tasks, necessitating dynamic task offloading decisions to maintain low latency and high reliability, especially under unpredictable node failures. Although deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for task offloading, DRL often suffers from high sample inefficiency and local optima, whereas LLMs struggle with real-time decision-making. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{LeDRL}, a hybrid decision framework that couples a \emph{lightweight LLM} with self-attention-enhanced DRL for real-time task offloading. LeDRL constructs structured, context-aware prompts capturing node status, task semantics, and link dynamics to derive high-level strategy priors. These are selectively processed by a self-attention-based alignment module for context-aware policy optimization. A reflective evaluator distills semantic feedback from past trajectories to guide future prompts, enabling more informative and temporally generalizable LLM queries. Extensive experiments show that LeDRL outperforms baselines in task success rate, convergence speed, and real-time responsiveness across diverse network scales, achieving over 17\% improvement in success rate. Furthermore, we deploy LeDRL on Jetson-based edge devices using our prototype system \textit{CoEdgeSys}, demonstrating its robustness and feasibility under resource constraints. Our code is available at:https://github.com/GalleyG5/LeDRL.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LeDRL——一种将轻量级大语言模型（Qwen3-4B）与自注意力增强的深度强化学习（MAPPO）耦合的混合决策框架，用于协同边缘计算中的去中心化动态任务卸载。通过结构化提示（节点状态/任务语义/链路动态）、双存储记忆库（短期轨迹+长期摘要）、反思式评估器（将回合结果转为语义反馈）以及自注意力策略融合模块，将 LLM 产生的高层策略先验注入 DRL 策略学习，同时用可调衰减的融合系数 λ_llm 在语义引导与实时性之间取得平衡。该工作还形式化了卸载问题为 Dec-POMDP 与 MINLP（证明 NP 难），并在仿真与 Jetson 原型系统 CoEdgeSys 上验证：相比 VDN-TO、MAPPO-TO、MASAC-TO、RATC、AGSP、Reflexion 等基线，任务成功率提升逾 17%，推理时延仍满足 4 s 时限约束。
AI.motivation: 协同边缘计算（CEC）要求在节点故障、链路中断、拓扑动态变化下实时决定任务本地执行或多跳转发，以兼顾低时延与高可靠性。现有静态启发式与预训练策略缺乏适应性，易导致任务失败；纯 DRL 虽能通过交互学习自适应策略，但存在样本效率低、在大网络中状态/动作空间因维数灾难急剧膨胀而收敛慢、易陷入局部最优等问题，且节点失效会改变有效动作集合，导致非法或次优决策。LLM 具备上下文推理与知识泛化能力，可提供启发式策略先验，但参数庞大导致推理时延违反边缘实时性要求，且输出具有随机性、决策不一致，难以直接作为决策者。因此需要一个既能利用 LLM 语义先验提升样本效率与收敛速度，又满足边缘实时性约束的混合决策框架。
AI.method: 1）问题建模：将时变无向图上的卸载建模为 Dec-POMDP，每个节点为智能体、仅观测局部状态；观测包含到达率 λ_i、软件/硬件失效率 α_i、γ_i、算力 F、队列长度、任务量 S_i/C_i/截止期 D_i/转发计数 H_i/等待时间 W_i 及邻居链路速率与失效率 β_ij，全部归一化到 [0,1]；动作集由拓扑感知掩码 M_i^t(j) 动态确定（本地执行 i、无任务 ∅、转发给邻居）；转移由随机到达、队列更新与拓扑演化驱动；团队奖励 r_t = Σ(s_i^t − v_i^t)（成功指示减违约指示），最大化期望回报与最大化任务成功率目标一致。同时给出 MINLP 形式化（时延约束、可靠性约束 exp(−(α_j+γ_j)T^c − β_ij T^t) ≥ Φ_i、资源与内存约束），并通过从 Bin Packing 的多项式归约证明问题 NP 难。2）LLM 决策引擎：构建 P_t = [S_t; T_t; N_t] 结构化提示；维护双存储记忆（短期存近期轨迹，长期存典型失败/成功摘要），以 Loc/Type/Sim_task/Sim_load 加权相关性检索 Top-K 上下文拼入提示；反思式评估器在 r_t<0 时构造 Diag_t={o,a,r,风险摘要 R_t} 触发 LLM 内省，将原因分析与更安全选择以 FIFO 方式写入长期记忆；决策输出遵循预定义 schema，违规输出默认回退本地执行以保证安全。3）DRL 侧：基于 MAPPO 的 Actor-Critic，PPO 裁剪代理目标 + GAE + 熵正则。自注意力融合模块 A_att 将环境特征 f_θ1(o_t) 与 BERT 编码的 LLM 决策特征 f_θ2(e(a_LLM)) 做 Q=env、K/V=LLM 的交叉注意力，输出 g_LLM，与 DRL 编码 g_DRL=φ_DRL(o_t) 经 φ_Last 投影后按 g_F=(1−λ_llm)g_DRL+λ_llm·φ_Last(g_LLM) 融合；注意力模块用特征匹配损失 + 动作交叉熵损失训练，最终 min(L_π + L_att)；λ_llm 按周期 T_λ 以 η 提升、γ_decay 衰减并设上下限，兼顾探索与实时性。
AI.result: 仿真环境：100 时隙、10/20 异构节点、稀疏随机拓扑、任务 2000–4000 KB、复杂度 800–2400 cycles/bit、截止期 4 s、链路 10–40 MB/s、节点失效率 0.01、节点出现概率 0.1，10 次随机运行取均值±标准差。结果：LeDRL 收敛更快、早期方差更低、最终成功率最高（10 节点 59.46%，较 MAPPO-TO 提升 12.87%；20 节点 63.78%）；推理时延 0.70–0.74 s，显著低于 Reflexion（1.58–3.01 s）且满足 4 s 时限；鲁棒性实验中任务规模/复杂度升高或失效率增至 0.25 时成功率下降幅度最小，失效率 0.25 时较 MAPPO-TO 在执行失效率与传输失效率下分别提升约 12% 与 17%；在随机图与环形拓扑两种结构下均最优，MAPPO-TO 在环形拓扑显著退化；消融显示 Plain MAPPO 最差，LLM+MLP+MAPPO 提升有限，引入自注意力进一步提升，完整 LeDRL 最优。真实系统：10 台 Jetson（4 Nano + 6 Xavier NX）千兆局域网构成 CoEdgeSys，YOLOv8 + COCO 数据集，随机注入 DoS 节点失效，在置信度阈值 0.4/0.5 两种严苛度下 LeDRL 成功率最高（最高约 60%），较最佳基线提升 13.5%，且时延与纯 DRL 基线接近。
AI.conclusion: LeDRL 通过"轻量 LLM 语义先验 + 自注意力策略对齐 + 反思式反馈记忆"的组合，在去中心化动态边缘卸载中同时提升了任务成功率、收敛速度、拓扑/故障鲁棒性与推理实时性，优于 DRL、启发式与 LLM 基线，并在 Jetson 原型系统上验证了资源受限下的实际可行性。其关键价值在于：LLM 不直接做实时决策，而作为可蒸馏的策略先验与经验记忆，通过注意力融合与动态权重退火注入 DRL，从而兼顾语义泛化与边缘实时性。作者指出未来工作为将 LLM 与在线执行解耦（仅在训练期使用以保留鲁棒性收益）以及向更大规模网络扩展。

title: ReaComp: Compiling LLM Reasoning into Symbolic Solvers for Efficient Program Synthesis
summary: LLMs can solve program synthesis tasks but remain inefficient and unreliable on hard instances requiring large combinatorial search. Given a small set of reasoning traces, we use coding agents to compile them into reusable symbolic program synthesizers over constrained DSLs. The resulting solvers require no LLM calls at test time and are strong standalone systems: symbolic solver ensembles reach 91.3% accuracy on PBEBench-Lite and 84.7% on PBEBench-Hard, outperforming LLMs with test-time scaling for the latter by +16.3 percentage points at zero LLM inference cost. They also complement LLM search, improving PBEBench-Hard accuracy from 68.4% to 85.8% while reducing reported token usage by 78%, and raising SLR-Bench hard-tier accuracy from 34.4% to 58.0% in a neuro-symbolic hybrid setting. Compared to directly using coding agents as per-instance solvers, induced solvers are substantially more Pareto-efficient, amortizing a small one-time construction cost over many zero-token executions. Finally, most solvers transfer zero-shot to a real historical linguistics task - predicting sound changes in natural language data - reaching 80.1% accuracy under ensembling and recovering some plausible linguistic rules. Together, these results show that reasoning traces can be compiled into reusable symbolic solvers that solve many tasks directly, complement LLM inference on hard cases, and provide a scalable route to domain-general solver induction. We release code and data for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将少量推理轨迹编译成符号程序合成器的方法，实现零LLM推理成本的强求解能力，在多个基准测试上显著超越LLM，并可零样本迁移到历史语言学等领域。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型(LLMs)在需要大规模组合搜索的困难程序综合任务上效率低且不可靠。
AI.method: 使用编码智能体(coding agents)将少量推理轨迹编译成约束DSL上的可重用符号程序合成器。该方法无需测试时LLM调用，形成独立的强求解系统。
AI.result: 符号求解器集成在PBEBench-Lite上达到91.3%准确率，在PBEBench-Hard上达到84.7%，比使用测试时扩展的LLMs高出16.3个百分点；在神经符号混合设置下，将PBEBench-Hard准确率从68.4%提升至85.8%，同时减少78%的token使用量，SLR-Bench困难层级从34.4%提升至58.0%；零样本迁移到历史语言学任务（预测自然语言数据中的音变）达80.1%准确率，并能恢复一些可信的语言学规则。
AI.conclusion: 推理轨迹可以编译成可重用的符号求解器，这些求解器能够直接解决许多任务、在困难情况下补充LLM推理，并提供可扩展的领域通用求解器归纳路线图。代码和数据已开源以支持复现。

title: Intelligent CCTV for Urban Design: AI-Based Analysis of Soft Infrastructure at Intersections
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables, Submitted/Under Review at the International Journal of Transportation Research (Submitted on 12 Jan 2026)
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) and computer vision are transforming transportation data collection. This study introduces an AI-enabled analytics framework leveraging existing CCTV infrastructure to evaluate the impact of soft interventions, such as temporary pedestrian refuges and curb extensions, on vehicle speed and safety. Using deep learning and perspective-based speed estimation, we evaluated driver behavior before and after interventions, with repeated post-installation monitoring in Week 1 and Week 2, in Minneapolis. Findings reveal that at unsignalized intersections, mean and 85th-percentile speeds fell by up to 18.75% and 16.56%, respectively, while pass-through traffic decreased by as much as 12.2%. Signalized intersections showed comparable reductions except one location, with mean and 85th-percentile speeds dropping by up to 20.0% and 17.19%. These results demonstrate the traffic-calming effectiveness of soft infrastructure and underscore the utility of AI-powered methods for rapid, low-cost, and evidence-based transport policy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一套基于AI视频分析的评估框架，利用城市既有CCTV监控摄像头（配合YOLOv8l目标检测、ByteTrack多目标跟踪与单应性矩阵透视变换测速），在明尼阿波利斯9个交叉口对"软性"快速建施干预（临时行人安全岛、路缘外扩/bollard）实施前后的车辆速度与驾驶行为进行了量化评估。结果显示干预整体有效：非信号交叉口平均速度最多下降18.75%、85分位速度下降16.56%、"减速通过"比例上升最多12.2%；信号交叉口平均速度最多下降20.0%、85分位下降17.19%（仅一个点位出现反弹）。研究证明AI视频分析可作为快速、低成本、可扩展的交通政策评估工具，但受行为适应、移除路侧停车、天气与通行量等混杂因素影响，效果可能随时间衰减。
AI.motivation: 城市交叉口的传统安全管理往往是被动且滞后的：问题暴露后才修建混凝土安全岛、隔离带等硬性设施，成本高、审批与施工周期长达数月；后续的限速/测速评估又依赖速度枪或昂贵传感器，进一步拉长评估周期，导致"实施—评估"整体时延与财政负担显著。软性（quick-build）干预如临时行人安全岛、路缘外扩（bump-out）、防撞柱虽被广泛认为能降低车速、改善让行，但因缺乏即时量化的行为证据，其效益一直难以在实施后短时间内被证实——以往研究多依赖长期事故数据或小规模人工观测。作者因此希望借助已广泛部署但闲置的CCTV基础设施，用深度学习与计算机视觉把被动监控转为主动的、数据驱动的安全评估手段，实现低成本、可扩展、可快速部署的干预效果量化，并支持主动式、预防性的街道安全管理。
AI.method: 研究采用前后对照（before–after）设计：每个点位先采集1周基线视频，实施后再分两个观测窗口（Week 1反映新奇效应，Week 2反映习惯化行为），全程7:00–18:30录制，帧率10–25 fps。样本为明尼阿波利斯9个交叉口（3个非信号化：1永久行人安全岛、2临时路缘外扩、3临时安全岛+路缘外扩；6个信号化：含临时安全岛/外扩、硬化中心线及2个永久路缘外扩作为参照基线），涵盖2023–2025年不同季节，其中11月采集仅限无雪无冰路面以控制季节性摩擦条件。AI流程为：以BDD100K微调YOLOv8l检测、ByteTrack跟踪与re-ID、限定ROI单帧处理，经车辆类型筛选（仅小汽车/公交/卡车）、剔除静止车、剔除40像素内跟车、按预设行驶方向过滤后，用≥4个图像—实景对应点经DLT求解3×3单应矩阵H将检测框底边中点映射到真实世界坐标，在约1秒滑动窗内以质心欧氏位移除以帧间隔计算速度（轨迹长度需≥fps/2帧才输出），并以移动平均速度将非信号交叉口车辆行为划分为通过（≥10 mph）、减速（5–10 mph）、停车/走停（<5 mph）三类。分析指标为平均速度、85分位速度及三类行为占比；计算环境为AMD Threadripper PRO 3975WX + Nvidia A6000，处理约10.5小时10 fps视频耗时约4.5小时（≈23.33 fps吞吐）。作者明确说明永久/硬性点位数量有限且非随机布设，故不主张因果性"硬vs软"对比，结果为描述性、逐点位呈现。
AI.result: 非信号交叉口（Loc 1–3）：三处平均速度均下降，Week 1降幅2.2–5.0 mph（Loc 2由27.4降至22.4），85分位速度Week 1最多降5.4 mph，Week 2仍全部低于基线；Loc 2出现部分回弹但未超基线。干预前91%–99.6%车辆为"直接通过"行为，Week 1起Loc 1、2通过比例下降，Week 2三处减速/停车比例均高于基线，Loc 3呈延迟性转变，让行与停车行为增幅超过20%。信号交叉口（Loc 4–9）：Week 1有5处（4、5、6、8、9）平均与85分位速度同步下降，Loc 7变化可忽略；Week 2部分点位（4、5、6）出现回弹，Loc 6平均速度由13.9升至15.7 mph（+3.6）、85分位升至24.6 mph（+4.2），反超基线，作者归因于为实施干预而移除路侧停车拓宽了视觉走廊、降低了道路摩擦；总体6处中5处仍呈净减速效果。最大降幅汇总为非信号交叉口平均速度-18.75%、85分位-16.56%、减速通过占比提升达+12.2%；信号交叉口平均速度-20.0%、85分位-17.19%（除1处例外）。测速精度方面，透视变换法在良好标定下的文献误差为0.5–1.5 mph，作者认为结果落在可接受误差范围内。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，基于CCTV的AI视频分析（检测+跟踪+透视测速）能够以远低于人工观测的成本、在远短于实时的时间内完成交通干预的前后评估，从而为交通缓行（traffic calming）与行人安全干预提供可扩展、客观量化的证据；软性基础设施总体上确实降低了车辆速度并提升了交叉口附近的减速/让行行为。但效果并非普遍且持久：部分点位出现第二周回弹甚至反超基线，说明新奇效应消退后的行为适应、视觉走廊变化等站点特异性因素会侵蚀安全收益，单一"前后对照+两周窗口"的设计难以完全控制天气、通行量、时段与季节等混杂变量，且永久与软性处理点位非随机、数量有限，无法支撑因果性类型比较。后续方向包括：接入动态标志/警示灯实现超速实时反馈与主动干预、构建可持续学习与自重标定的自适应系统、将监测期延长至数月以刻画长期适应与季节效应、叠加执法与公众宣传等持续性手段，并在更多不同城市环境中验证该框架的普适性。

title: Horizon-Constrained Rashomon Sets for Chaotic Forecasting
summary: Predictive multiplicity and chaotic dynamics represent two fundamental challenges in machine learning that have evolved independently despite their conceptual connections. We bridge this gap by introducing horizon-constrained Rashomon sets, a theoretical framework that characterizes how model multiplicity evolves with prediction horizon in chaotic systems. Unlike static prediction tasks where the Rashomon set remains fixed, chaos induces exponential divergence among initially similar models, fundamentally transforming the nature of predictive equivalence. We prove that the effective Rashomon set contracts exponentially with lead time at a rate determined by the maximum Lyapunov exponent and introduce Lyapunov-weighted metrics that provide tighter bounds on predictive disagreement. Leveraging these insights, we develop decision-aligned selection algorithms that choose among near-optimal models based on downstream utility rather than forecast accuracy alone. Extensive experiments on synthetic chaotic systems (Lorenz-96, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky) and real-world applications (wind power, traffic, weather) demonstrate that our framework improves decision quality by 18-34\% while maintaining competitive predictive performance. This work establishes the first rigorous connection between chaos theory and predictive multiplicity, providing principled guidance for deploying machine learning in safety-critical chaotic domains.

AI.tldr: This paper bridges predictive multiplicity and chaotic dynamics by introducing horizon-constrained Rashomon sets—a framework characterizing how model multiplicity evolves with prediction horizon. The key finding is that chaos causes the effective Rashomon set to contract exponentially with lead time, with contraction rate determined by the maximum Lyapunov exponent. The paper develops Lyapunov-weighted metrics for tighter predictive disagreement bounds and decision-aligned selection algorithms. Experiments on synthetic (Lorenz-96, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky) and real-world systems (wind power, traffic, weather) show 18-34% improvement in decision quality.
AI.motivation: Predictive multiplicity and chaotic dynamics have evolved as two independent research challenges in machine learning despite their conceptual connections. In chaotic systems, chaos induces exponential divergence among initially similar models, fundamentally transforming the nature of predictive equivalence—unlike static prediction tasks where the Rashomon set remains fixed. This creates a gap in understanding how model multiplicity behaves in chaotic domains.
AI.method: The paper introduces horizon-constrained Rashomon sets as a theoretical framework to characterize model multiplicity evolution with prediction horizon. Key methods include: (1) proving exponential contraction of effective Rashomon set with lead time at rate determined by maximum Lyapunov exponent, (2) developing Lyapunov-weighted metrics that provide tighter bounds on predictive disagreement compared to standard metrics, and (3) designing decision-aligned selection algorithms that choose among near-optimal models based on downstream utility rather than forecast accuracy alone.
AI.result: Empirical validation on synthetic chaotic systems (Lorenz-96, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky) and real-world applications (wind power, traffic, weather) demonstrates that the proposed framework improves decision quality by 18-34% while maintaining competitive predictive performance.
AI.conclusion: The framework establishes the first rigorous connection between chaos theory and predictive multiplicity, providing principled guidance for deploying machine learning in safety-critical chaotic domains. Key contributions include: (1) horizon-constrained Rashomon sets for characterizing model multiplicity evolution, (2) proof that effective Rashomon set contracts exponentially with lead time at a rate determined by Lyapunov exponent, (3) Lyapunov-weighted metrics for tighter bounds on predictive disagreement, (4) decision-aligned selection algorithms, and (5) empirical validation showing 18-34% improvement in decision quality across diverse domains.

title: FinRAG-12B: A Production-Validated Recipe for Grounded Question Answering in Banking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly being adopted across various domains. However, their adoption in banking industry faces resistance due to demands for high accuracy, regulatory compliance, and the need for verifiable and grounded responses. We present a unified, data-efficient framework for training grounded domain-specific LLMs that optimizes answer quality, citation grounding, and calibrated refusal under real-world deployment constraints. First, we describe a data generation pipeline that combines LLM-as-a-Judge filtering, citation annotation, and curriculum learning with only 143M tokens. The resulting 12B model achieves high answer quality outperforming GPT-4.1 on citation grounding, with a modest citation tradeoff versus the untuned base. Second, we propose a calibrated refusal mechanism: training on 22% unanswerable examples yield a 12% "I don't know" rate, substantially improving over the base model's unsafe 4.3% rate while avoiding GPT-4.1's over-refusal (20.2%). Third, we present an end-to-end methodology spanning from data curation to quantized serving. The system is deployed at 40+ financial institutions, achieving a 7.1 percentage point improvement in query resolution (p < 0.001). Additionally, the model delivers 3-5x faster responses at 20-50x lower cost compared to GPT-4.1.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个用于训练金融领域专属LLM的统一框架，通过创新的数据生成流水线（143M tokens）和校准拒绝机制，在保证答案质量和引用准确性的同时实现可控的拒绝率。12B模型在40+金融机构的实际部署中表现优异，速度和成本效益显著优于GPT-4.1。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在银行领域的应用面临阻力，主要源于对高准确性、监管合规以及可验证、可 grounding 回答的迫切需求。
AI.method: 提出统一的数据高效框架：1）结合LLM-as-Judge过滤、引用标注和课程学习的 数据生成流水线，仅需143M tokens；2）基于22%不可回答样本的校准拒绝机制；3）从数据管理到量化服务的端到端方法论。模型规模12B参数。
AI.result: 12B模型在引用 grounding 方面优于GPT-4.1；拒绝机制将"I don't know"率从基线的4.3%（不安全）提升至12%，同时避免了GPT-4.1的过度拒绝（20.2%）；查询解决率提升7.1个百分点（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架已在40多家金融机构部署，模型响应速度提升3-5倍，成本降低20-50倍，具有实际部署可行性。

title: Label Correcting Algorithms for the Multiobjective Temporal Shortest Path Problem
summary:
Given a directed, discrete-time temporal graph $G=(V,R)$, a start node $s\in V$, and $p\geq1$ objectives, the single-source multiobjective temporal shortest path problem asks, for each $v\in V$, for the set of nondominated images of temporal $s$-$v$-paths together with a corresponding efficient path for each image. A recent general label setting algorithm for this problem relies on two properties of the objectives - monotonicity and isotonicity. Monotonicity generalizes the nonnegativity assumption required by label setting methods for the classical additive single-objective shortest path problem on static graphs, while isotonicity ensures that the order of the objective values of two paths is preserved when both are extended by the same arc.
  In this paper, we study the problem without assuming monotonicity and/or isotonicity. A key difficulty in this setting is that zero-duration temporal cycles may need to be traversed an arbitrary finite number of times to generate all nondominated images. This motivates the study of a restricted problem variant in which a maximum admissible path length $K$ is imposed, and only paths containing at most $K$ arcs are considered. We develop general label correcting algorithms for this setting and establish several sufficient conditions under which such a bound is not required, implying that the algorithms compute all nondominated images.

AI.tldr: 研究单源多目标时间最短路问题，移除之前算法对单调性和等调性的依赖。针对零持续时间循环带来的挑战，引入最大路径长度K约束，开发一般性标签纠正算法，并给出无需此约束的充分条件。
AI.motivation: 现有算法依赖于单调性(monotonicity)和等调性(isotonicity)两个性质，本文旨在研究不依赖这些假设条件下的问题求解。
AI.method: 开发了带路径长度约束K的一般性标签纠正算法；建立了若干充分条件来保证算法的完备性。
AI.result: 在无单调性和/或等调性假设下，零持续时间时间循环可能需要被遍历任意有限次才能生成所有非支配图像。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一般性标签纠正算法，并证明了若干充分条件，使得在特定条件下无需路径长度约束即可计算所有非支配解。

title: Breaking In and Reaching Out: Networking for Women in Computer Science
summary: Networking is central to careers in computer science, where a globally distributed and diverse community increasingly collaborates across institutional and geographic boundaries, often in hybrid and remote settings. However, access to effective networking is shaped by structural and personal factors, including geography, funding, language, identity, personality, and caregiving responsibilities. Building on prior work, this workshop focuses on women in computing to examine lived experiences of networking and the barriers they encounter. Through a community-driven discussion grounded in a factor-based framework, the workshop aims to surface overlooked challenges and foster shared understanding. Ultimately, it seeks to inform more inclusive, equitable, and accessible networking practices within the computer science community.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇面向 ACM womENcourage 2026 的工作坊提案（workshop proposal），围绕"计算机科学中的女性职业网络"展开。作者以自己此前的研究（ICSE-CHASE 论文 + 巴西软件工程社区的定性/定量数据）为基础，提出一个包含八个维度的"因素导向框架"（地理与位置、资金与资源、国籍与法规、会议时长、语言与沟通、性别与社会认同、个性与神经多样性、照护责任），并设计一场 1.5 小时的社区驱动式互动讨论，邀请不同背景的女性参与者分享网络建立中的经验与障碍，目标是发现被忽视的因素，推动更具包容性、公平性和可及性的网络实践。
AI.motivation: 网络（networking）对计算机科学职业发展至关重要，直接影响合作机会、可见度、导师关系与长期职业影响力；但学界普遍认识到网络机会分配不均：拥有更多资源、流动性和成熟学术环境的人（如能负担国际会议、免受签证限制、英语母语、身处发达学术圈者）占据优势，而早期职业研究者、女性、全球南方学者被边缘化。非正式互动（走廊交谈、社交活动）进一步放大了会议场景中的不平等。既有研究虽已识别这些结构性障碍，但对女性在多元背景与语境下如何体验、协商与感知这些挑战仍缺乏理解，因此本文提出面向计算领域女性的具体、社区驱动的讨论空间，以弥补这一缺口。
AI.method: 方法上为定性工作坊设计而非实验研究。工作坊采用基于因素（factor-based）的框架作为讨论骨架：地理与位置、资金与其他资源、国籍与监管、会议时间安排、语言与沟通、性别与社会认同、个性与神经多样性、照护状态与个人责任。组织者（Bayreuth 大学软件工程组负责人 Shalini Chakraborty）负责 15 分钟引言介绍动机、ICSE-CHASE 论文核心发现与框架；随后 60 分钟引导式讨论，参与者围绕每个因素分享个人经历、反思影响、指出遗漏因素；最后 15 分钟自愿反思与贡献。为保障安全感，全程不录音，无需技术设备，允许使用笔记本。目标受众为 womENcourage 中从事 CS/SE 的女性学者、从业者与学生，涵盖学术界、工业界与产业界。
AI.result: 本文未报告实证结果（属工作坊提案/立场性论文），而是提出了一个可复用的八因素分析框架与一套具体的社区讨论流程设计。其间接经验基础来自作者先前在 ICSE'26 开展的问卷调查及后续在巴西软件工程社区通过在线社交媒体收集的定性与定量数据，这些材料被用作"动机来源"而非本工作坊的研究数据。工作坊预期产出为：参与者对网络障碍的集体理解、新的/被忽视的影响因素清单，以及面向更包容网络实践的社区共识。
AI.conclusion: 工作坊的核心主张是：网络不是单纯的个人技能，而是被结构性与个人因素共同塑造的过程；通过以女性为中心的、社区驱动的对话，可以揭示既有文献中被忽视的障碍因素，为计算机科学界（尤其软件工程）建立更包容、公平、可及的网络实践提供依据。作者强调讨论的交集性（intersectional）视角与安全空间的重要性，并将该工作坊定位为一项持续性、开放参与的社区议程，而非一次性的成果产出。

title: Decision-aware User Simulation Agent for Evaluating Conversational Recommender Systems
summary: Conversational recommender systems (CRS) increasingly rely on user simulators for automated evaluation of sales agents. A key requirement for such simulators is the ability to model human decision-making. However, most existing simulation frameworks do not explicitly model the internal decision process, and LLM-based simulators often exhibit unrealistically strong information-processing capabilities, rarely exhibit the hesitation or decision deferral commonly observed in real consumer behavior, resulting in overly high acceptance probabilities. To address this limitation, we propose Hesitator, a theory-grounded user simulation framework that explicitly models human decision-making under choice overload. The framework introduces a modular Decision Module that separates utility-based item selection from overload-aware commitment decisions. Experiments across multiple user simulation frameworks, domains, sales modes, and LLM backbones show that integrating our module consistently mitigates unrealistic behaviors under increasing overload conditions. Furthermore, Hesitator reproduces established behavioral patterns from psychological economics, demonstrating its ability to model human decision behavior.

AI.tldr: Hesitator是一个基于理论的用户模拟框架，通过模块化决策模块显式建模人类在选择过载下的犹豫行为，将效用选择与承诺决策解耦，显著提升了模拟器在多种场景下的行为真实性。
AI.motivation: 当前对话式推荐系统依赖用户模拟器进行自动化评估，但现有模拟器未能显式建模内部决策过程。基于LLG的模拟器表现出不切实际的强信息处理能力，很少展现真实消费者行为中常见的犹豫或决策延迟现象，导致接受概率过高。
AI.method: 提出了Hesitator框架，该框架引入模块化的"决策模块"，将基于效用的项目选择与过载感知的承诺决策进行分离。决策模块显式建模了人类在选择过载条件下的犹豫和延迟决策行为。
AI.result: 跨多个模拟框架、领域、销售模式和LLM骨干的实验表明，集成该模块能持续缓解过载条件下不切实际的行为。同时，Hesitator复现了心理经济学中的经典行为模式。
AI.conclusion: Hesitator通过将效用选择与承诺决策解耦，成功解决了传统模拟器在选择过载条件下行为不现实的问题。该框架不仅提升了模拟器的行为合理性，还证明了其在建模人类决策行为方面的有效性，为对话式推荐系统的自动化评估提供了更可靠的仿真基础。

title: Is this Build Failure Related to my Patch? An Empirical Study of Unrelated Build Failures in Continuous Integration
summary: Continuous Integration (CI) systems often run many builds concurrently. In this setting, a legitimate build failure may not be caused by the code push that triggered it. Such unrelated build failures can waste developer effort because developers must determine whether the failure is actionable for their current change. We study 77,354 CI build failures from seven open source Apache projects to understand and predict unrelated build failures. We find that developers spend a median of 4 hours identifying whether a failure is related or unrelated to their push. We also perform a document analysis of 371 confirmed unrelated build failures sampled from 10,316 potentially unrelated failures. The analysis shows that unrelated test failures account for 20% of the cases in which developers classify build failures as unrelated. To predict unrelated build failures, we extract 33 features from issue reports, issue comments, and commits associated with the triggering push. We build semi-supervised Positive and Unlabeled (PU) learning models for seven Apache projects. The models achieve precision from 0.70 to 0.88, recall from 0.30 to 1.00, F1-score from 0.44 to 0.91, and AUC from 0.63 to 0.97. Feature importance analysis shows that CI latency, repeated error messages, and the number of preceding comments are useful indicators of unrelated build failures. These results show that PU learning can help developers identify build failures that are unlikely to be caused by their current push.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对CI系统中无关构建失败的识别问题，基于7个Apache项目的77,000+构建失败数据，采用半监督PU学习建立预测模型，实现0.63-0.97的AUC性能，可有效辅助开发者快速判断构建失败是否与自身代码变更相关。
AI.motivation: CI系统并发运行多个构建时，合法构建失败可能与触发它的代码提交无关，导致开发者需要浪费大量时间（平均4小时）来确定失败是否与当前变更相关，造成不必要的人力浪费。
AI.method: 对7个Apache项目的77,354次CI构建失败进行分析；对371个已确认的无关构建失败进行文档分析；从问题报告、评论和提交中提取33个特征；使用半监督PU（正样本与未标记样本）学习构建预测模型。
AI.result: 无关测试失败占无关构建失败的20%；模型精确率0.70-0.88，召回率0.30-1.00，F1分数0.44-0.91，AUC 0.63-0.97；CI延迟、重复错误信息和前置评论数量是预测无关构建失败的重要指标。
AI.conclusion: PU learning可有效帮助开发者识别可能与当前代码提交无关的构建失败，从而减少不必要的工作量。关键特征包括CI延迟、重复错误信息和评论数量。

title: A Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning Framework for Edge Intelligence: An Empirical Analysis
summary: As Edge Intelligence (EI) becomes increasingly prevalent in domains such as smart healthcare, manufacturing, and critical infrastructure, ensuring data privacy while maintaining system efficiency is a growing challenge. This paper presents a new privacy-preserving machine learning (PPML) framework tailored for EI applications, including a four-layer system architecture and training and inference algorithms. We focus on three leading approaches: Differential Privacy (DP), Secure Multi-party Computation (SMC), and Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE), and assess their impact on key performance metrics, including model accuracy, response time, and energy consumption. Results from real implementation and extensive trace-based simulations of inference tasks show that DP generally preserves throughput and latency close to plaintext baselines, while accuracy drops with model complexity (up to 35 percent on AlexNet and under 18 percent on LeNet for FordA). SMC performance is driven by communication; network bandwidth and round complexity determine end-to-end latency. For AlexNet, increasing link capacity from 250 Mbps to 500 Mbps reduces latency by about 30 percent. FHE is highly sensitive to model structure and numerical precision bit width, with tighter parameters imposing substantial compute overhead; we observe roughly a 1000 times increase in response time compared to DP. Beyond efficiency, DP shifts the privacy-utility-extractability frontier by reducing the attacker's data efficiency in black-box model stealing, whereas SMC and FHE, while protecting inputs and parameters during inference, require complementary output controls to achieve similar resistance to extraction. These findings provide critical insights into the trade-offs between privacy, performance, and resource efficiency in edge computing scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向边缘智能（EI）的隐私保护机器学习（PPML）框架，采用"云—边缘服务器—边缘设备—传感器"四层架构与"数据/模型/系统/应用"四组件设计，以 TensorFlow Privacy（DP-SGD）、CrypTen（SMC）、Concrete-ML（FHE）实现训练与推理算法，并在真实边缘硬件（Intel NUC、Jetson AGX、Raspberry Pi 5、桌面服务器）加 EdgeSimPy 基于真实轨迹（trace-based）的仿真下，对 DP、SMC、FHE 在模型精度、响应时间与能耗三方面做系统性对比，并补充了黑盒模型窃取攻击的安全性分析。结论：DP 性能最接近明文基线但精度损失大；SMC 由通信带宽与参与方数量主导；FHE 算力开销极高（响应时间约为 DP 的 1000 倍、能耗高达 20 Wh/次推理）。
AI.motivation: 边缘智能在智慧医疗、智能制造、智能电网与关键基础设施中快速落地，但端侧算力、内存与延迟预算受限，且采集的多为敏感数据（如心电信号、车辆感知数据），隐私保护必须覆盖"感知—端侧处理—传输—云端分析"全链路。已有工作多停留在云中心场景：Shokri 等只做成员推断/模型反演风险评估，Mercier 等仅比较精度而忽略推理性能与能耗，Ding 等的评估框架不含 ML 任务性能，Hrzich 等只测试了少量 HE 方案与简单分类模型。缺乏"哪种隐私方案适合哪类 EI 场景"的系统量化对比，导致工程选型困难；此外，密文推理类方案（SMC/FHE）在输出明文暴露下是否同样能抵抗黑盒模型窃取，也鲜有针对 EI 场景的定量研究。
AI.method: 框架层面：四层架构（传感器层/边缘设备层/边缘服务器层/云层）承载四组件（Data、Model、System、Application），隐私模块下沉到边缘设备与边缘服务器。算法层面给出两个伪代码：Algorithm 1（云端训练与部署准备）——DP 走 DP-SGD 并将模型下发边缘服务器明文推理；FHE 用 Concrete-ML 以精度位宽 p、量化位宽 q 编译模型并做密钥分层（边缘设备持 sk，边缘服务器仅持 pk/evk）；SMC 将基线模型在 P0（边缘服务器）侧加密/秘密分享。Algorithm 2（边缘推理与度量采集）——DP 明文转发、FHE 端侧加密后密文推理并端侧解密、SMC 以 2PC/3PC 秘密分享联合计算并仅向授权方揭示结果，同时记录计算时间、传输字节数、往返轮次。实验层面：三种模型（LeNet-5、SqueezeNet、AlexNet）× 三个 UEA/UCR 时序数据集（FordA、ElectricDevices、ECG5000）；硬件实验在 AWS r6i.4xlarge 上训练（batch 50、25 epoch、lr 0.001）、在四类异构边缘设备上采集 500 条推理轨迹；仿真实验用 EdgeSimPy 构建 4 边缘服务器 + 12 边缘设备、3000 请求、并发用户 30~70、SMC 带宽 250/500 Mbps，采用线性功率模型计算每次推理能耗。安全分析层面：分别给出三者的威胁模型（DP 训练时 (ε,δ)-DP；SMC 半诚实 t=1；FHE ≥128-bit 经典安全）、侧信道与可信执行环境要求，并针对 EI 场景改造黑盒模型窃取协议（攻击者控制边缘设备、抓取传感器轨迹、以 q∈{0.15,0.30} 比例查询测试集并注入高斯抖动合成样本训练替代模型），用 RDP 会计器计算 ε，并以 ΔAcc/ΔPrec/ΔSens/ΔF1 衡量提取间隙，5 个随机种子取均值。
AI.result: 精度：DP 精度随噪声乘子 σ 单调下降且强依赖（模型，数据集）组合——AlexNet 在 ECG5000 降 3–4%、ElectricDevices 降 21–22%、FordA 降 35%；LeNet-5/SqueezeNet 稳健得多（ECG5000 1–2%、ElectricDevices ≤3%、FordA 13–18%）。FHE 精度随量化位宽提升、5 位后收益递减，4→6 位 AlexNet/SqueezeNet 提升约 3–7%，6 位接近明文；精度位宽 5→6 使 AlexNet 反而下降 8–15%，延迟再增 20–60%。时延：FHE 推理时间随位宽超线性增长（AlexNet 4→6 位增 7–9 倍），仿真中 FHE 平均响应时间约为 DP 的 1000 倍，AlexNet+FordA 在 70 用户下高达约 10000 秒；SMC 对通信极敏感，250→500 Mbps 使 AlexNet 延迟下降约 30%（70 用户下从约 100 s 降到约 70 s），两方较三方快约 100%，相对 DP 约 9 倍开销；DP 延迟与吞吐几乎与明文基线一致（AlexNet/ECG5000/70 用户总 0.185 s）。能耗（ECG5000，每次推理 Wh）：DP 0.0009–0.0011；SMC 2 方 250 Mbps 0.0111–0.4766、500 Mbps 降至 0.0088–0.3093、3 方升至 0.0186–0.7436；FHE 1.1168–20.0167。模型窃取：σ 增大使目标精度由约 72%（σ=0.1）降至约 60%（σ=2.0），q=0.15 时 ΔAcc 在 σ≈0.5 附近达到约 0.10，σ=2.0 收窄至约 0.05；q=0.30 时 ΔAcc 从 0.097（σ=0.1）降至 0.024（σ=2.0）；ε 随 σ 从 10^4–10^5 量级降至 σ≈1.0 时的 O(1)。
AI.conclusion: 隐私方案选型不应孤立进行，而应结合检测精度、时延阈值、能耗预算与合规约束在具体 EI 用例中权衡。DP 性能最优、能效最高且能直接抬升"隐私—效用—可提取性"前沿（通过降低攻击者数据效率），但必须针对每个模型/数据集单独标定隐私预算与噪声水平，否则在 AlexNet+FordA 等复杂组合上精度损失不可接受；SMC 精度与明文基本一致（因协议计算同一函数），性能受带宽与参与方数量支配，故应取满足威胁模型的最小参与方数并提升链路容量，且需辅以 TLS、隔离沙箱、MAC/一致性检查以应对主动攻击与侧信道；FHE 在足够精度下精度接近明文且支持密文推理，但受 Concrete-ML 8 位上限与电路深度约束，须配合量化（4–6 位）、轻量模型（如 LeNet-5）与向高性能边缘服务器卸载，同时仅靠密文保护无法阻止输出明文被窃取，须补充输出扰动、限流、访问控制等输出级控制。后续工作方向为优化各技术实现并设计面向 PPML 的新型任务调度算法。

title: Chainwash: Multi-Step Rewriting Attacks on Diffusion Language Model Watermarks
summary: Statistical watermarking is a common approach for verifying whether text was written by a language model. Most existing schemes assume autoregressive generation, where tokens are produced left to right and contextual hashing is well defined. Diffusion language models generate text by denoising tokens in arbitrary order, so these schemes cannot be applied directly. A recent watermark by Gloaguen et al. addresses this gap for LLaDA 8B Instruct and reports true positive detection above 99%. This paper studies what happens when watermarked text is rewritten not once but several times. Using the same watermark configuration, 1,605 watermarked completions of about 300 tokens each are produced across five WaterBench domains. Each completion is rewritten by four open weight language models, from 1.5B to 8B parameters, none of which know the watermark key. Five rewrite styles are tested: paraphrase, humanize, simplify, academic, and summarize expand. Each style is chained for up to five hops, producing 160,500 rewritten texts in total. The watermark is detected on 87.9% of the original outputs at the standard significance threshold. After a single rewrite, detection falls to between 14% and 41% depending on the rewriter and style. After five chained rewrites, detection falls to 4.86%, meaning 94.76% of the originally detected texts are no longer flagged. After three rewrites, the detector score has dropped 86% of the way from its watermarked baseline toward the null distribution. Repeated rewriting is therefore a much stronger attack than a single rewrite, and the result holds across all four rewriters tested.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究扩散语言模型水印在多次改写攻击下的鲁棒性，发现五轮链式改写可将检测率从87.9%降至4.86%，表明重复改写是有效的水印攻击手段。
AI.motivation: 现有统计水印方案假设自回归生成（从左到右逐token生成，上下文哈希定义清晰），但扩散语言模型通过任意顺序去噪生成文本，无法直接应用现有方案。研究旨在探索扩散语言模型水印在面对多次改写攻击时的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 研究使用1,605个约300词的水印完成文本，跨越五个WaterBench领域。由四个开源语言模型（1.5B至8B参数）对每个完成文本进行改写，采用五种风格（释义、人性化、简化、学术、总结扩展），每种风格链式执行最多五轮，共生成160,500个改写文本。所有重写模型均不知晓水印密钥。
AI.result: 原始水印在标准显著性阈值下检测率为87.9%。单次改写后检测率降至14%至41%（取决于重写器和风格）。五轮链式改写后检测率仅为4.86%，即94.76%的原始检测文本不再被标记。三轮改写后检测器得分已下降86%从水印基线趋近零假设分布。
AI.conclusion: 重复改写是对扩散语言模型水印的强攻击方式。经过5轮链式改写后，检测率从87.9%急剧下降至4.86%，意味着94.76%的原始标记文本不再被检测出。经过3轮改写后，检测器得分已下降86%趋近于零假设分布。该结论在所有四个测试的重写模型中均成立，表明即使不知道水印密钥的非授权重写也能有效破坏水印检测。

title: When Helpfulness Becomes Sycophancy: Sycophancy is a Boundary Failure Between Social Alignment and Epistemic Integrity in Large Language Models
summary: This position paper argues that sycophancy in LLMs is a boundary failure between social alignment and epistemic integrity.
