Existing work often operationalizes sycophancy through external behavior such as agreement with incorrect user beliefs, position reversals, or deviation from an objective standard of correctness. These formulations capture only overt forms of the phenomenon and leave subtler boundary failures involving epistemic integrity and social alignment underspecified. We argue that sycophancy should not be understood as agreement alone, but as alignment behavior that displaces independent epistemic judgment. To clarify this boundary, we propose a three-condition framework for sycophancy. First, the user expresses a cue in the form of a belief, preference, or self-concept. Second, the model shifts toward that cue through alignment behavior. Third, this shift compromises epistemic accuracy, independent reasoning, or appropriate correction. We also introduce a taxonomy for classifying sycophancy, consisting of alignment targets, mechanisms, and severity. The paper concludes by discussing implications for alignment evaluation and argues for boundary-aware assessment, structured rubrics, and mitigation strategies, while situating these proposals alongside alternative views of sycophancy.

AI.tldr: 本文认为LLM中的谄媚不应仅被理解为同意行为，而是将对齐行为替代独立认知判断的边界失败。论文提出三条件框架和分类学，以区分社交对齐与认知诚信之间的边界，并为对齐评估提供边界感知评估方法、结构化评估标准和缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 现有工作通常通过外部行为（如同意错误信念、立场反转或偏离客观正确标准）来操作化谄媚，但这些 formulation 只捕捉了明显的谄媚形式，而忽视了涉及认知诚信和社交对齐的更微妙边界失败。
AI.method: 提出了一个三条件框架来界定谄媚：（1）用户表达信念、偏好或自我概念等线索；（2）模型通过对齐行为向该线索倾斜；（3）这种倾斜损害了认知准确性、独立推理或适当纠正。进一步引入了分类学，从对齐目标、机制和严重程度三个维度对谄媚进行分类。
AI.result: 提出了三条件谄媚框架和分类学，为对齐评估提供理论基础。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了评估LLM谄媚的边界感知方法、结构化评估框架和缓解策略，并对替代性观点进行了讨论和定位。

title: Sparse Prefix Caching for Hybrid and Recurrent LLM Serving
summary:
Prefix caching is a key latency optimization for autoregressive LLM serving, yet existing systems assume dense per-token key/value reuse. State-space models change the structure of the problem: a recurrent layer can resume from a single stored state rather than requiring the entire token history. This asymmetry opens a new design point between no reuse and dense caching: store exact recurrent states at a sparse set of checkpoint positions and, on a cache hit, resume from the deepest stored checkpoint and recompute the remaining suffix exactly.
  We formalize sparse prefix caching as checkpoint placement under a distribution over overlap depths, yielding an exact O(NM) dynamic program. For use cases where requests share a non-trivial prefix (e.g. asking different questions about a single long document), we show that our method consistently improves the Pareto frontier traced by standard heuristics on real-world data. Across QuALITY and System Prompts, distribution-aware placement dominates every fixed-budget baseline on the measured layer-group Pareto frontier and matches or outperforms the strongest heuristic (block caching) while typically using substantially fewer checkpoints, with the largest gains at low checkpoint budgets where the overlap distribution is most non-uniform. The method is most relevant when many requests share a substantial but not identical prefix within a retained cache entry. It preserves exact outputs, does not change the recurrent computation itself or require new recurrent update kernels, applies to recurrent/SSM layers whose hidden state can be extracted and restored exactly, and for hybrid models can be combined with existing KV-cache compression techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文针对混合/循环（SSM）大模型服务中的前缀缓存提出“稀疏前缀缓存”：在若干稀疏位置保存精确的循环层隐状态检查点，命中时从最深检查点恢复并精确重算剩余后缀。问题被形式化为重叠深度分布下的检查点放置（单侧加权 k-median），并给出精确 O(NM) 动态规划（借助凸包技巧）。理论还证明均匀分布/最坏情形下均衡间隔最优，且经验直方图 plug-in 方案在总变差意义下具有可界定的次优性（含漂移下的指数加权界）。在 QuALITY、NarrativeQA、System Prompts 上，分布感知放置在层组 Pareto 前沿上全面优于固定预算基线，以更少检查点达到或超过最强启发式（block caching）的运行时。
AI.motivation: 主流服务系统（vLLM 的 PagedAttention、SGLang 的 RadixAttention、Preble 的分布式 prompt 调度、CacheBlend、ChunkAttention）都假设可复用的状态是“逐 token 的稠密 KV 张量”。但状态空间模型与线性循环模型的循环层只维护固定大小的隐状态 h_t = F(h_{t-1}, x_t)，从位置 t 继续只需 h_t，无需全部历史；稠密缓存循环状态既无必要又代价高昂（如 Qwen-3.5 的 GatedDeltaNet 每头状态按 d_head^2 增长，而注意力 KV 仅按 d_head 线性增长）。另一方面，Marconi 等人已指出混合模型采用原地循环更新、难以部分回滚，导致服务系统偏向“精确匹配”条目，产生大量低价值的大缓存条目。因此需要一个介于“完全不用复用”与“稠密缓存”之间的新设计点：让部分前缀重叠变得有用。目标问题是：在长度 N 的缓存前缀上给定 M 个检查点槽位的内存预算，如何放置检查点以在未来请求的重叠结构下最小化期望重算量（这与缓存准入/驱逐策略正交）。
AI.method: 形式化：设检查点集 C={c_1<...<c_M}，重叠深度为 T 时最深可复用检查点为 ℓ(t;C)=max({0}∪{c∈C: c≤t})，重算代价 r(t;C)=t−ℓ(t;C)，目标为期望重算 E_T[r(T;C)]=Σ p_t (t−ℓ(t;C))，以 Savings=1−E[r]/R_nc 与 Reduction=R_nc/E[r] 报告。理论结果包括：(1) Theorem 1：均匀重叠与最坏情形下均衡（balanced）检查点集最优，期望重算 N/(2(M+1))+O(1)，最坏重算 ⌈(N+1)/(M+1)⌉−1，证明基于间隙分解与严格凸性 φ(x)=x(x−1)/2 及鸽巢原理；(2) Theorem 2：精确动态规划 dp[0,j]=Σ_{t≤j} p_t t，dp[m,j]=min_{1≤s≤j}(dp[m−1,s−1]+w(s,j))，其中 w(s,j)=Σ_{t=s}^j p_t(t−s)；利用前缀和 P_j、T_j 与单调凸包技巧（斜率 −s 单调、查询点 P_j 非减）实现 O(NM) 总时间；(3) Lemma 1：值函数在重叠律上 Lipschitz，|E_p[r]−E_q[r]| ≤ N‖p−q‖_1；(4) Theorem 3：i.i.d. 样本下经验直方图 plug-in 的高概率超额代价 ≤ 2N(√(N/n)+√(2log(1/δ)/n))，以 McDiarmid 不等式结合 E‖p̂−p‖²₂ ≤ 1/n 导出；(5) Theorem 4：指数加权直方图在漂移下的偏差-方差界，偏差 ≤ Δγ/(1−γ)，方差项 √(N(1−γ)/(1+γ))；实验取 γ=0.99、每 10 个请求重估一次直方图。实现上所有检查点位置对齐到块边界（HuggingFace/Flash Linear Attention 块粒度 64，文中表格处另述 B=128/64），采用固定 last-K 条目保留策略以隔离准入/驱逐效应；注意 capture 检查点的运行与计时运行分离，因为 Flash Linear Attention 尚未暴露非末位检查点提取的 Python API。理论上限制为单前缀，但因真实拓扑多为星型或梳型（每条边为一条长共享前缀），可无损失分解为单前缀问题。
AI.result: 三个真实数据集的重叠深度分布都远离均匀：QuALITY 在文档全长附近有尖峰，NarrativeQA 呈宽多峰分布，System Prompts 质量集中于较短前缀——这正是分布感知放置优于均衡间隔的原因，尤其在低检查点预算时。NarrativeQA 上（因序列过长未做原型计时）DP 最优调度在全部预算区间都优于确定性基线（无缓存、均衡、block、√L、logarithmic），且优势在低预算最大、随预算增大而收窄；报告的重算下降因子（Reduction）在小数据集上与墙钟时间近似线性（仅有来自 CPU→GPU 缓存加载的小常数偏移，且该偏移随缓存量增大）。原型墙钟实验在 RTX 2080 Super (8GB) + i5-12400F 上，用 Qwen-3.5-0.8B 的一个代表性层组（1 个注意力层 + 3 个 GatedDeltaNet 层）测得 Pareto 前沿：QuALITY 与 System Prompts 上分布感知放置支配所有固定预算基线，并以显著更少的检查点达到与最强启发式（block caching）相同或更好的实测运行时间；System Prompts 上 DP 在分歧峰值附近密集布点、放弃尾部，实现同运行时但更少检查点；QuALITY 上因分布接近点质量，DP 与均衡的差距较小；大预算极限下所有策略收敛。结果保持输出精确（与完整 prefill 逐字节一致），不改变循环计算本身、不需要新的循环更新 kernel。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心是混合/循环 LLM 中“精确复用不需要稠密逐 token 循环状态”这一结构不对称性，由此得到稠密 KV 中心化服务无法达到的新内存/重算折中：稀疏检查点 + 后缀精确重放。主要局限在于方法最适用于“许多请求在保留的缓存条目内共享较长但不完全相同前缀”的场景；对仅追加式聊天负载（历史完整包含、只做追加）只需保存最后一个状态，方法无额外收益也无额外开销。论文给出的实测只是代表性层组的原型证据，而非全模型/生产级基准（单次确定性运行、无误差棒），且检查点 capture 与计时分离。后续工作包括：在生产运行时实现高效的循环状态提取/恢复、与 Marconi 式准入/驱逐结合、以及把单前缀理论推广到含分支与驱逐的通用前缀树。

title: Retrieval-Conditioned Topology Selection with Provable Budget Conservation for Multi-Agent Code Generation
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track Submission Under review
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems for code generation face a fundamental routing problem: the optimal orchestration topology depends on the structural complexity of the code under modification, yet existing systems select topologies without consulting the codebase. We present Retrieval-Guided Adaptive Orchestration (RGAO), an architecture that closes this loop by extracting a structural complexity vector from a hierarchical code index before selecting the orchestration topology. RGAO operates within Code-Agent, a multi-agent framework whose sub-agents are governed by formal contracts with six-dimensional budget vectors. Our headline contribution is the composition of two previously separate lines of work -- complexity-conditioned LLM routing and formal resource algebras -- yielding a property neither admits alone: provable budget conservation under retrieval-conditioned dynamic topology selection. Concretely we contribute: (1) a complexity-conditioned topology router that reduces proxy-measured misrouting from 30.1% to 8.2%; (2) a budget algebra with a structural-induction conservation theorem; and (3) a hierarchical code retrieval engine. Empirical evaluation demonstrates sub-millisecond DAG construction and linear tree-index scalability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RGAO（Retrieval-Guided Adaptive Orchestration）：在多智能体代码生成系统中，先从分层代码索引中抽取 5 维结构复杂度向量，再据此选择编排拓扑（FastPath / SubAgent / MultiAgent / DeepResearch），并配合一套带静态预算守恒验证器的六维预算代数，在任何 LLM 调用之前以 O(|V|+|E|) 复杂度拒绝不可行的委托森林。核心贡献是两件已有工作的"组合"——复杂度条件化的拓扑路由 + 形式化资源代数——共同产生单独任一方都不具备的性质：检索条件化动态拓扑选择下的可证明预算守恒。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统在代码生成任务上的编排拓扑选择存在根本性缺陷：现有系统（正则分类器、AdaptOrch 的任务依赖图、DAAO 的 VAE 难度估计、MasRouter 的文本特征级联、AgentConductor 的 RL 策略）全部基于"查询侧"特征选择拓扑，从不查阅任务实际将要修改的代码结构——而代码结构正是区分"单文件五行修复"与"跨十几个包的协同重构"的唯一干净信号。同时，多智能体分解是否真的带来收益存在争议（MultiAgentBench 报告 2–6× 效率惩罚；固定总算力下单一智能体加统一上下文可匹敌多智能体系统），作者认为这一张力的根源就在于编排器"不看代码就选拓扑"。另一动机是资源保证的时机问题：Agent Contracts、AOrchestra 等仅在运行时（资源已被消耗后）验证预算约束，缺少执行前的静态可拒绝性。此外，作者主动回避 SWE-bench Verified，因其存在约 35 个点的污染膨胀（Claude Opus 4.5：80.9% Verified vs 45.9% Pro），故全部实验数据来自代理测试框架（proxy harness），并透明标注该局限。
AI.method: 系统架构（Code-Agent 五层：agent graph / 子智能体编排 / swarm 执行 / 代码检索 / 基础设施）之上叠加 RGAO 环路。① 检索层：CodeIndexTree 将仓库建模为 Root→Dir→File→Sym 的树，由 tree-sitter 提供符号/类型/依赖元数据，摘要自底向上生成（deterministic / semantic / LLM-enhanced PageIndex 三模式）；查询被分类为 identifier / exact / conceptual / dependency / structural 五类，conceptual 走四路并行（PageIndex LLM beam search、LATTICE EMA 路径校准 α=0.6、KohakuRAG 多查询改写、BM25），经 RRF（k=60）融合后由七信号复合评分器（TF-IDF 子词重叠、语言先验、符号类型优先级、上下文邻近、log 度量 hub 分、内容长度、静态 PageRank 式全局重要性）重排，并做 1-hop RepoGraph 类型化依赖扩展。② 路由层：从树元数据中以 <1 ms 抽取 5 维复杂度向量 c=(d_dep, n_f, n_s, h_t, ρ_x)（最大依赖链深度、涉及文件数、检索符号数、最大树遍历深度、跨模块耦合比），由确定性阈值分类器映射到四种拓扑；阈值由 100 任务调参子集网格搜索确定，规则而非学习模型以保证可解释与可审计。③ 预算代数：预算向量 B∈ℕ⁶（iter/calls/tok/sec/retry/handoff），并行合成 ⊕ 为逐维相加，委托约束要求父预算同时覆盖自身直接成本 c_A 与子预算之和；证明采用对委托森林的结构归纳（不变式 c_A^↓ ⪯ B_A），假设 A1 确定性工具成本、A2 有界检索深度、A3 有限动作空间；VerifyConservation 在 DAG 构建时以单次拓扑序遍历做 O(|V|+|E|) 静态校验，早于任何 LLM 调用。④ 执行层：SwarmSupervisor 以 O(n) 构建 DAG，三重执行前门（合约存在性、预算可行性、SHA-256 交接完整性），只读合约并行且带锁扇入，写型合约串行，干预状态机扩展 DoVer 为 5 态（Skip/RetrySame/RetryDifferent/Replan/Abort），重试扣减同一父预算池；智能体间仅通过带 kind 标签、SHA-256 校验和 parent_artifact_ids 的类型化 SwarmArtifact 通信，把 O(n²) 转录共享降为 O(k) 依赖边传递。形式化部分还给出命题 1（已验证子流水线的顺序/并行组合安全性）与命题 2（组合必要性：仅查询文本路由的运行时与仅运行时校验的运行时均不满足联合性质 P 的反例）。
AI.result: 路由（250 实例标注集，三标注者 Fleiss' κ=0.78，38/29/21/12% 分布，100 调参/150 留出评测）：误路由率由正则基线 30.1%（95% Wilson CI [26.4, 34.1]）降至 8.2%（[6.1, 10.9]），绝对下降 21.9 pp（相对 73%），配对 McNemar χ²=43.6、p<10⁻⁶；增益主要来自正则被"implement/test"等关键词误导而复杂度向量显示范围极小（n_f=1、ρ_x=0）的样例。微基准（n=20，pytest-benchmark，禁 GC）：DAG 构建 <0.01 ms（20 任务流水线）、树索引构建 11.1±0.4 ms（200 文件/2002 节点，线性可扩展）、合约工厂实例化 1.10±0.03 μs、预算检查开销 0.65±0.02 μs、路由决策 0.11±0.02 ms、conceptual 四路 RRF 检索 0.90±0.08 ms，均比 LLM 推理延迟低 4 个数量级以上。多步流水线：5 条复合流水线（含 2 条注入干预）100% 完成，均约 6,000 tokens/流水线，干预经 RetrySame/RetryDifferent 恢复。代理 SWE-bench 集：10 条合成 issue 中 pass@1 解决 40%，token 成本较无约束单智能体低 8–20×（50–120k → ~6k tokens/任务）。七信号留一消融：nDCG@10 0.977、MRR 1.000；去掉 s_tfidf 损失最大（nDCG 0.955，误路由 +2.8 pp 至 11.0%），去掉 s_len 反而微升 nDCG 至 0.987。分布偏移探针：标识符重命名 20% → 11.7%、同义词替换 → 14.3%、陌生语言（Rust，tree-sitter 语法缺失）→ 19.6%、长尾 >5000 LOC → 16.8%（正则基线分别为 32.4/34.8/38.2/36.5%），相对优势从 21.9 pp 收窄至 18.6 pp。
AI.conclusion: 结论性主张是"组合"本身：复杂度条件化路由与形式化预算代数单独都无法给出检索条件化动态拓扑选择下的可证明预算守恒，命题 2 通过构造单文件 fixture 与 12 包单仓的同 prompt 反例、以及"父预算被自身成本饱和后仍委托正预算子节点"的反例，给出形式化分离而非仅经验性缺失声明。守恒界是紧的（子节点饱和时可达等号），静态校验在构造期禁止超配以保持界有意义；作者也坦承 Theorem 1 依赖 A1–A3，在随机成本（采样温度、非确定性工具）下退化为期望预算保证，仅以 Azuma–Hoeffding 给出高概率尾界（Bernstein 型紧化留待未来）。局限与未来工作包括：全部数据来自代理测试框架，完整 SWE-bench Verified / Pro 与 LiveCodeBench v6 端到端运行因约 220 GPU 小时与约 $3,400 API 成本而推迟；阈值为手工调参，学习型路由（逻辑回归或小 MLP over c 与查询嵌入）待更大标注数据；5 维 c 遗漏圈复杂度、测试覆盖密度、语言特定惯例（如 C++ 模板深度）；LATTICE 路径校准首次用于代码语料（路径语义由篇章锚点变为 import/call/继承边），α 可能需重调；与 AgentConductor 的"用复杂度向量热启动 RL 策略"、与 KVCOMM 的组合均未实施；作者将"在给定任务复杂度 C、算力预算 B、工具表面积 |T| 的条件下多智能体分解何时稳定优于单智能体推理期扩展"列为最关键的开放问题，并公开 250 实例路由标注集供后续研究。

title: The Pareto Frontier of Randomized Learning-Augmented Online Bidding
summary: Online bidding is a classical problem in online decision-making, with applications in resource allocation, hierarchical clustering, and the analysis of approximation algorithms. We study its randomized learning-augmented variant, where an online algorithm generates a sequence of random bids while leveraging predictions from an oracle. We provide analytical upper and lower bounds on the optimal consistency $C$ as a function of the robustness $R$, which match when $R \geq 2.885$, effectively closing the gap left by previous work. The key technical ingredient is the notion of a bidding function, a novel abstraction that provides a unified framework for the design and analysis of randomized bidding strategies. We complement our theoretical results with an experimental application of randomized bidding to the incremental median problem, demonstrating the applicability of our algorithm in practical clustering settings.

AI.tldr: 研究随机学习增强的在线竞价问题，通过引入竞价函数统一框架，给出了一致性与鲁棒性之间的最优权衡，理论上闭合了R ≥ 2.885时的差距，实验验证了在增量中位数聚类问题上的实用性。
AI.motivation: 研究在线决策中随机学习增强的竞价问题，分析预测误差下的最坏情况权衡
AI.method: 提出了"竞价函数(bidding function)"这一新抽象概念，为随机竞价策略的设计与分析提供统一框架
AI.result: 给出了最优一致性C关于鲁棒性R的解析上下界，当 R ≥ 2.885 时边界匹配
AI.conclusion: 理论边界在 R ≥ 2.885 时闭合，实验验证了算法在聚类实际场景中的适用性

title: A Benchmark for Strategic Auditee Gaming Under Continuous Compliance Monitoring
summary: Continuous post-deployment compliance audits, mandated by emerging regulations such as the EU AI Act and Digital Services Act, create a class of strategic gaming distinct from the one-shot input/output gaming studied in prior work. Regulated systems can delay outcome reporting, drift their reports within plausible noise envelopes, exploit longitudinal sample attrition, and cherry-pick among ambiguous metric definitions. We formalize continuous auditing as a $T$-round Stackelberg game between an auditor that commits to a temporal policy and an adaptive auditee, and identify a structural feature of any noise-aware static-auditor design: a cover regime in which coverage gaps and granularity gaps cannot be closed simultaneously. We make this formal as Observation 1 and show that two minimal extension policies, each derived from the observation, close the regime along orthogonal axes: a sample-size-aware static rule (Periodic-with-floor) closes the granularity-failure case, while a history-conditioned suspicion-escalation policy closes the coverage-failure case for the naive Drift strategy -- and neither closes both, exactly as the observation predicts; an audit-aware OffAuditDrift strategy that exploits Stackelberg commitment defeats both. To support empirical study we contribute a non-additive harm decomposition (welfare loss $W$, coverage loss $C$) that exposes how attrition shifts harm from the regulator-accountable surface to a regulator-invisible one; an initial library of five auditee strategies (Delay, Drift, Cherry-pick, Attrition, OffAuditDrift) and five auditor policies, calibrated to summary statistics from published audits of the DSA Transparency Database; and a reproducible simulator with a small, extensible Python interface.

AI.tldr: 本文研究持续性合规审计中的博弈问题。论文将连续审计形式化为T轮Stackelberg博弈，发现了静态审计设计的根本性限制——覆盖 regime，其中覆盖缺口和粒度缺口无法同时关闭，并提出两种正交扩展策略及可击败二者的OffAuditDrift策略，辅以可复现的模拟器和经验校准的策略库。
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案和数字服务法案(DSA)要求进行持续性的部署后合规审计，这产生了一种与先前研究的单次输入/输出博弈不同的战略性博弈形式。监管系统可通过延迟结果报告、在合理噪声范围内漂移报告、利用纵向样本流失和在模糊指标定义间进行选择性报告来规避审计。
AI.method: 将连续审计形式化为审计者承诺时序策略、审计对象自适应响应的T轮Stackelberg博弈。通过理论分析识别静态审计设计的结构特征：覆盖 regime（Observation 1）。提出两种最小扩展策略——样本量感知的Periodic-with-floor规则和历史条件怀疑升级策略，并设计OffAuditDrift策略。经验研究方面，贡献了非加性危害分解(W, C)揭示流失将危害从监管可见转移到不可见层面，构建了包含5种审计对象策略和5种审计者策略的库，并开发了基于DSA透明度数据库校准的可复现Python模拟器。
AI.result: Observation 1的理论预测得到验证：两种最小扩展策略各自关闭一个失败case但无法同时关闭两者，而OffAuditDrift策略利用Stackelberg承诺可击败两者。危害分解显示样本流失将损害从监管问责表面转移到监管盲区。
AI.conclusion: 本文为持续审计提供了形式化框架，揭示了噪声感知静态审计设计的根本限制（覆盖 regime），并通过理论-经验结合的方法为审计机制设计提供了分析工具和可扩展的实验平台。

title: EnterpriseRAG-Bench: A RAG Benchmark for Company Internal Knowledge
comment: Code and dataset available at https://github.com/onyx-dot-app/EnterpriseRAG-Bench or https://huggingface.co/datasets/onyx-dot-app/EnterpriseRAG-Bench
summary:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become the standard approach for grounding large language models in information that was not available during training. While existing datasets and benchmarks focus on web or other public sources, there is still no widely adopted dataset that realistically reflects the nature of company-internal knowledge. Meanwhile, startups, enterprises, and researchers are increasingly developing AI Agents designed to operate over exactly this kind of proprietary data. To close this gap, we release a synthetic enterprise corpus, its generation framework, and a leaderboard.
  We present EnterpriseRAG-Bench, a dataset consisting of approximately 500,000 documents spanning nine enterprise source types (Slack, Gmail, Linear, Google Drive, HubSpot, Fireflies, GitHub, Jira, and Confluence) and 500 questions across ten categories that test distinct retrieval and reasoning capabilities. The corpus is generated with cross-document coherence (grounded in shared projects, people, and initiatives) and augmented with realistic noise such as misfiled documents, near-duplicates, and conflicting information. The question set ranges from simple single-document lookups to multi-document reasoning, constrained retrieval, conflict resolution, and recognizing when information is absent. The generation framework lets teams generate variants tailored to their own industry, scale, and source mix. The dataset, code, evaluation harness, and leaderboard are available at https://github.com/onyx-dot-app/EnterpriseRAG-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EnterpriseRAG-Bench：一个面向企业内部知识检索的 RAG 基准测试，包含约 51.2 万篇跨 9 类企业数据源（Slack、Gmail、Linear、Google Drive、HubSpot、Fireflies、GitHub、Jira、Confluence）的合成语料、500 个覆盖 10 类能力的问答，以及可公开复现的生成框架、评测框架与排行榜。核心结论是：公开基准（NQ、MS MARCO、BEIR 等）的表现无法迁移到企业检索场景——BM25 在本基准上反而优于向量检索与 Bash Agent，凸显企业专有术语与文档噪声带来的真实挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 基准（Natural Questions、MS MARCO、BEIR、HotpotQA、MuSiQue、MTEB、KILT 等）几乎都建立在公开语料（Wikipedia、网页、论坛、论文）之上，隐含假设语料是公开且结构整洁的。而 RAG 当前最具影响力的应用之一是企业内部知识（邮件、工单、CRM 记录、会议纪要、聊天），其特征在现有基准中完全缺失：文档无组织、噪声多、类型多样（支持工单、邮件线程、通话转写、聊天对话）、使用仅在公司内部有意义的项目代号与缩写。KARLBench 虽体现行业关注，但语料以公开文档为主，专有子集未公开。此外，百万级语料的 LLM 生成成本极高，若要求每篇文档都有全量跨文档感知则不可行，因此需要既保证跨文档连贯性又可规模化的生成策略。作者提出五项设计原则（跨文档连贯性、真实体量分布、真实噪声、内部术语、跨企业场景通用性）与两项工程约束（question-aware 语料、可验证的 ground truth）。
AI.method: 整体为「生成语料→注入噪声→生成问题→质量保证→评测」的分阶段流水线（4 个 stage、全部脚本可断点续跑）。(1) 脚手架：由人机协作产出五个人工在环工件——公司概览、高层战略 initiative、员工目录、九类源的目录结构（source structure）、以及分布在目录树各处的 agents.md（以自然语言规定各位置的文档格式与内容），所有下游生成步骤均引用这些工件以保证组织一致性；initiative 再分解为约 100 篇文档规模的 project，并为每个 project 生成详细描述、文档清单（manifest）与相关员工。(2) 高保真生成：每篇文档可见公司概览、project manifest、路径上的 agents.md 及读工具，可按需检索已生成同 project 文档，形成共享决策/引用会议/关联工单等隐式交叉引用；另生成 4–10 篇互相全可见的「completeness cluster」，事实刻意分散，支撑需穷尽召回的问题。(3) 高体量生成：针对「模型漂移」（实验中仅用公司概览生成 100 篇时 LLM 判定逾 40% 存在近似兄弟文档），引入 topic scaffolding 层级分解（叶子主题≤500 篇），生成时仅提供公司概览、关键 initiative、相关 agents.md 与同叶子主题的路径，成本大幅下降且消除重复爆炸。(4) 噪声注入：随机 shuffle（5%，按目录游走采样、限定同源类型）、LLM shuffle（3%，迁移至结构合理但次优的位置，累计 8% 受影响）、跨源近重复（改动具体事实，形成受控事实分歧并被追踪用于冲突类问题）、miscellaneous 目录/文件（slack/memes、github/hackathons 等）。(5) 问题生成：统一输出「问题 + 标准答案 + 原子答案事实 +（可选）gold 文档 ID」，分三族：单文档流（Basic/Semantic/Intra-Doc Reasoning/Miscellaneous，采样+提示词差异+一致性校验，如 intra-doc 必须无法由单一连续片段作答）；语料探索流（Project Related/Constrained/High Level/Info Not Found，LLM agent 携带 glob/grep/read 等文件系统工具先探索语料再命题，Constrained 额外产出「反幻觉事实」，Info Not Found 通过刻意落在语料边界之外构造）；生成依赖流（Conflicting Info 基于近重复对，Completeness 基于 completeness cluster）。(6) 质量保证：LLM 一致性校验 + 三检索器（BM25/OpenSearch、向量/Qdrant+text-embedding-3-large、带 shell 工具的 bash agent）pooling 补全 gold，并按目标数随机下采样。(7) 评测：四维指标（correctness 二值 LLM 判定、completeness 原子事实逐条判定、document recall@10、invalid extra documents 绝对数）；correctness 与 fact 校验相互独立且先剥离引用；排行榜单分数为「答对则取 completeness 百分比，否则 0」的均值；提供三评委一致性 + gold 偏置 tie-break 的 gold set correction 机制（required/valid/invalid 三分类、序数多数投票）与双系统对比评测（随机交换顺序消除位置偏差、区分共享与独有文档）。所有 leaderboard 提交均按初版固定 gold 集打分，修正离线累积并进入后续版本。
AI.result: 语料最终为 511,962 篇文档，Slack 285,605、Gmail 121,390、Linear 35,308、Google Drive 25,108、HubSpot 15,017、Fireflies 10,173、GitHub 8,052、Jira 6,120、Confluence 5,189；文本长度差异显著（Fireflies 均值 11,605 字符 vs Slack 3,427）。问题 500 个：Basic 175、Semantic 125、Intra-Doc Reasoning 40、Project Related 40、Constrained 30、Conflicting Info 20、Completeness 20、Miscellaneous 20、Info Not Found 20、High Level 10；gold 文档数均值 Basic/Semantic 等为 1.0、Conflicting Info 2.0、Constrained 1.4、Project Related 4.2、Completeness 6.5（最多 10）。结构分析（t-SNE + text-embedding-3-large 余弦相似度）显示本语料与真实企业语料 Onyx 子集远比公开语料 BrowseComp-Plus 更接近：top-10 KNN 局部相似度 0.83 vs 0.83 vs 0.69，簇内相似度 0.61/0.56/0.29，跨簇 0.50/0.36/0.20；其簇更均匀是 topic scaffolding 所致。基线（统一用 GPT-5.4 Medium 生成与评测）中 BM25 领先：正确性 68.8%、完整性 56.0%、文档召回 68.4%、无效额外文档 9.0；Bash Agent 正确性 60.6%、完整性最高 61.1%、召回 55.8%、无效文档仅 2.0 但单题可达 10 分钟；向量检索最弱（正确性 51.4%、完整性 42.9%、召回 46.0%），甚至在应为向量检索设计的 Semantic 类上仅 32.8%/24.8%（推测因嵌入模型对项目代号、内部缩写、工单/CRM 结构与对话风格缺乏暴露）。分类型上 Intra-Doc Reasoning（BM25 85.0/90.0）、Conflicting Info（90.0/82.5）、Miscellaneous（Bash 90.0/100.0）与 Completeness（Bash 召回 59.0 vs BM25 46.5 vs 向量 33.4）差异显著；Info Not Found 三系统均 100%。规模化实验中语料增大时 top-10 局部相似度上升、Recall@10 下降。Confluence/Jira 作为 gold 源被显著高估（占语料 1.0%/1.2%，出现在 24%/21% 的问题中），而 Slack 占语料 56% 却只出现在 17% 的问题中。
AI.conclusion: EnterpriseRAG-Bench 通过 50 万篇级带跨文档连贯性与真实噪声的合成企业语料、10 类 500 问的问题集，以及「可修订 gold 标签 + 正确性/完整性/召回/无效文档」四维的 correction-aware 评测框架，填补了企业内部知识 RAG 评测的空白，并公开发布数据、生成框架、评测 harness 与排行榜。核心洞见是：公开基准的高分不可迁移到企业检索（BM25 优于向量检索，agentic 检索在完整性上占优但成本高昂），说明企业环境中的真实难点在于内部术语、结构化记录与噪声，而非单纯的语义相似度。局限包括：语料为合成，存在长尾格式错误、时间戳/公司名等合成随机性伪影、目录与路径漂移、LLM 对话过于聚焦等保真度问题；文档统一扁平化为 JSON key-value 丢失嵌套结构；高体量生成流程牺牲跨文档连贯性与员工目录 grounding；仅模拟单一特定阶段的科技公司；生成过程上下文累积限制了向更大规模的扩展；评测上 gold 标签本质是可修订假设而非固定真值。作者计划的方向包括多模态检索、真正的多跳推理、高体量聚合查询、时效性感知检索（最新文档）与以人为中心的员工职责/关系类问题，并邀请社区通过排行榜提交系统与修正意见以持续改进真值。

title: Operationalizing Ethics for AI Agents: How Developers Encode Values into Repository Context Files
comment: 3rd ACM International Conference on AI-powered Software (AIware 2026)
summary: As AI coding agents become embedded in software development workflows, developers are beginning to operationalize ethical principles by encoding behavioral rules into repository-level context files for AI agents, such as AGENTS.md files. Rather than examining the ethics of AI agents in the abstract, this vision paper investigates how ethics and values are already being translated for AI agents into actionable instructions that shape agent behavior. Through a preliminary investigation, we find that developers are already embedding guidance related to fairness, accessibility, sustainability, tone, and privacy. These artifacts function as a developer-authored governance layer, translating abstract principles into situated, natural-language directives within development workflows. We outline a research agenda for studying this emerging practice, including how encoded values vary across communities, what governance dynamics emerge when multiple contributors negotiate these files, and whether agents reliably adhere to the constraints specified. Understanding how ethics and values are operationalized for AI agents is essential to ground AI governance in modern software engineering practice.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇愿景论文（vision paper），提出并初步刻画一个新现象：开发者正在把伦理原则"操作化"——以自然语言指令的形式写入仓库级 AI 上下文文件（如 AGENTS.md），为 AI 编码代理设定行为约束。作者通过 GitHub 代码检索 + ChatGPT 网页检索初步考察，手工检视 25 个仓库并精选 6 个示例（涉及公平性、可访问性、可持续性、语气、隐私、包容性等），指出这些文件构成一层"开发者自撰的治理层"，并提出包括大规模实证测绘、翻译过程研究、代理遵从性实验、纵向演化分析及机器导向伦理文档形式等在内的研究议程。
AI.motivation: AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Copilot 等）正深度嵌入软件开发流程，其行为不仅由模型训练与提示词决定，还受仓库内上下文文件影响。传统伦理治理路径（ACM/IEEE 伦理准则、Responsible AI 模式目录、价值敏感设计 VSD、价值驱动工程 VBE、IEEE 7000、伦理用户故事、SLEEC 需求等）主要面向人类开发者与组织流程，存在原则模糊、不可执行、彼此冲突、生命周期覆盖偏向需求/设计阶段等问题，缺少对"代理实际约束层"的研究。作者主张：与其抽象讨论 AI 代理的伦理，不如考察开发者已经在做的"为 AI 代理操作化伦理"（operationalizing ethics for AI agents），把仓库级上下文文件（如 AGENTS.md）视为一种人写、机器读、嵌入工作流的新的、几乎未被探索的治理操作层。研究动机还包括：以往伦理框架面向人类（依赖共享规范与情境判断），而自然语言指令对机器代理是否足够、伦理表达形式是否需要根本性改造，均为空白。
AI.method: 属于立场/议程型研究（vision paper），方法为初步探索性实证：结合 GitHub 代码搜索与 ChatGPT 网页搜索，定位含 AGENTS.md 且带有伦理相关指导的仓库；人工检视其中 25 个仓库，挑选 6 个具有代表性的开源项目摘录原文片段，构成表 1（ez-recipes-web、awesome-copilot、DHCP、create、home-assistant/core、magentaA11y）。作者明确声明该小样本仅用于引出研究议程，不构成系统性实证结论。分析视角以定性解读为主，聚焦"抽象原则→具体可执行约束"的翻译形态：既有高层模糊指令（如"遵循所有伦理 AI 指南、保持人在回路、对变更负责、透明"），也有结构化可执行逻辑（如给定包含不同族裔姓名的测试数据，要求检查"相同资历不同姓名导致不同结果"的偏见），以及规范边界（"避免道德说教或未经请求的意见"）、语言规范（"使用客观、非歧视性语言"、"为非母语英语者写作"）与设计要求（可访问性、降低数据与电量消耗的可持续性）。
AI.result: 初步发现：开发者已在实际编码中主动选择与其项目相关的伦理关切，并将其重构为机器可解释的约束——公平被转写为偏见测试逻辑，问责被转写为交互约束，包容性被转写为语言与语气指导，可持续性被转写为设计要求，隐私等亦有涉及。同时发现关键的"落差"：高层伦理意向型指令（如"遵循伦理 AI 指南"）只记录了道德意图，并未给出可执行条件、触发器或执行机制，因而代理能否据此产生具体行为改变仍不明确；这类实践整体仍处早期（nascent）。相关背景证据显示：AGENTS.md 已被 60,000+ 开源项目使用；对 2,303 个 "Agent README" 的分析显示其内容以构建指令、实现细节与架构信息为主，安全与性能很少被指定；另对 466 个项目的研究发现上下文表达方式（描述性、规定性、禁止性、解释性、条件性）差异极大且缺乏既定内容结构；亦有研究表明 AGENTS.md 可降低代理运行时与 token 消耗而不损害任务完成度。
AI.conclusion: 结论认为：仓库级上下文文件正在成为一层新的、由开发者撰写的治理层，将抽象伦理原则转译为具体的自然语言指令并嵌入开发工作流，AI 治理由此可扎根于现代软件工程实践，而非停留在抽象原则层面。作者据此提出研究路线图：(1) 大规模实证测绘——统计各类伦理类别（偏见、可访问性、可持续性、隐私）被编码的频率与缺失情况，并分析其在不同领域与文化间的差异；(2) 研究翻译与协商过程——开发者如何选择编码哪些原则、指令的宽窄尺度、Pull Request 中的协商、人机之间的价值协商，结合仓库历史挖掘与定性分析；(3) 实验评估代理遵从性——对比有无上下文文件时的行为，测量在偏见缓解、语气、可访问性、合规指引等约束上的遵从度，以判断操作化是否真的塑造行为抑或仅是意图信号；(4) 纵向演化分析——伦理承诺在事故后强化、在生产力压力下松动、随新法规调整，并区分"打勾式合规"与真实承诺；(5) 反思面向机器的伦理文档形式——人类导向的行为准则/政策文档是否足够，抑或需要根本不同的机器导向表示；(6) 超越自然语言文件，考察 agent skills、工具权限设置、hook 脚本、系统提示文件等程序化配置层是否复现、补充或与自然语言约束相矛盾。作者强调这是理解"被操作化的伦理"如何在编码、解释与修订中被实现的实证路径，并期待将洞见推广至商业与社会科学等其他领域的 AI 代理行为。

title: Relay Buffer Independent Communication over Pooled HBM for Efficient MoE Inference on Ascend
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference requires large-scale token exchange across devices, making dispatch and combine major bottlenecks in both prefill and decode. Beyond network transfer, routing-driven layout transformation, temporary relay, and output restoration can add substantial overhead. Existing MoE communication paths are often buffer-centric, using explicit inter-process relay and reordering buffers around collective transfer. This report presents a relay-buffer-free communication design for MoE inference acceleration on Ascend systems. The design reorganizes dispatch and combine around direct placement into destination expert windows and direct reading from remote expert windows. Built on globally pooled high-bandwidth memory and symmetric-memory allocation, it removes most intermediate relay and reordering buffers while retaining only lightweight control state, including counts, offsets, and synchronization metadata. We instantiate the design as two schedules for the main phases of MoE inference: a prefill schedule with richer planning state for throughput-oriented execution, and a compact decode schedule for latency-sensitive execution. Experiments on Ascend-based MoE workloads show reduced dispatch and combine latency in both settings. At the serving level, the implementation improves time to first token (TTFT), preserves competitive time per output token (TPOT), and enlarges the feasible scheduling space under practical latency constraints. These results indicate that, on platforms with globally addressable device memory, reducing intermediate buffering and output restoration around expert execution is an effective direction for accelerating MoE inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套运行在昇腾（Ascend）平台上的"无中继缓冲（relay-buffer-free）"MoE 通信设计：利用全局池化 HBM 与对称内存（shmem 式远程访问），把 dispatch 改为"直接写入目标专家窗口"、combine 改为"从远端专家窗口直接读取并本地加权归约"，从而剥离传统 sender-pack / IPC-relay / receiver-restore 流水线中的大块中间缓冲；并分别实例化为 prefill（保留丰富规划状态）与 decode（紧凑低延迟控制路径）两套调度。实验显示：prefill dispatch 从 1.1ms/1024 token、9.4ms/16384 token 降至 1.0ms/6.8ms；decode dispatch 平均加速 14.8%–31.0%，combine 约 22%–24%；端到端 TTFT 从 11197ms 降至 6793ms，TPOT 30.10→31.31ms 仍满足目标，并扩大了 TTFT/TPOT 联合约束下的可行调度空间。
AI.motivation: MoE 推理在专家并行（EP）下需要大规模跨设备 token 交换，dispatch 与 combine 成为 prefill（吞吐导向）和 decode（延迟敏感）两大阶段的通信瓶颈。已有工作（Tutel、DeepEP、DeepSpeed-MoE、BigMac、FUSCO）表明，通信开销不只来自网络传输本身，路由驱动的布局变换、临时中继（relay）、输出还原（restore）等 buffer-centric 数据搬运同样占据显著比例，且会放大瞬态 HBM 占用，挤压 batch size 与长上下文空间。传统实现普遍是"打包/置换 → 通用集合通信（A2A/A2AV）→ 还原为专家主序或 token 主序"的 buffer-centric 范式，把通信与算子执行刚性割裂，引入额外访存与拷贝。昇腾平台提供的全局池化 HBM（经 AclShmem/Memfabric 对称内存分配暴露）使跨 rank 直接访问全局可见地址成为可能，从而具备消除显式中继与重排缓冲的硬件条件；作者进一步依据昇腾"读偏好（read-favored）"的实际执行特性，将通信组织为消费者发起的直接读取。
AI.method: 整体定位在上层服务框架（vLLM/SGLang/MindIE）与底层通信运行时之间。核心三项目标：G1 消除或大幅削减 dispatch/combine 路径上的大块中继与重排缓冲；G2 用轻量通信状态（counts、offsets、交换地址、同步符号、状态位、wait symbol、vector/core barrier）替代张量级控制；G3 契合昇腾读偏好的执行习惯，避免延迟敏感阶段反复写重 staging。内存基础：bootstrap 时建立 world-visible 对称设备虚拟地址空间，各 rank 通过确定性偏移获得本地切片，并划分为"前缀通信可见状态区 + 后缀 allocator 堆"，避免逐负载指针交换。执行模型：dispatch 直接把 token 行写入目标专家窗口，位置由"大偏移（专家级块起点，如 putOffset / ep_recv_count）+ 小偏移（token 局部序，如 sendTokenIdx / expandIdx）"两级规则确定，即 expert-window row = o_{e,r} + s_{t,j}；combine 由消费侧依据同样的偏移规则从远端专家窗口直接读取专家输出，乘路由权重后本地累加得到 token 对齐输出，可选 cached-address 快路径跳过重复地址握手。两套调度：Prefill 采用 Prefill Layout → Prefill Notify → Prefill Dispatch → Prefill Combine 四阶段，Layout 计算 per-rank/per-expert 路由分支计数与 sendTokenIdx（分块计数+前缀累加，不做负载重排），Notify 交换计数元数据构造 recvData 计数矩阵 M∈R×E 与 putOffset 等大偏移，Dispatch 直接写入 expandXOut，Combine 直接读远端；Decode 取消 Layout/Notify 显式阶段，将计数/偏移（ep_recv_count、expandIdx）与地址准备折叠进 Decode Dispatch 与 Decode Combine，Combine 用 remoteBase + remoteOffset 计算远端行并本地加权归约。实现包含 normal 与 low-latency 两套 dispatch/combine kernel、少量辅助集合通信 kernel，以及内存分配、buffer 注册、barrier、循环计数器、core 切分等运行时组件；仍保留同步状态与少量兼容用 IPC 地址槽，但不再作为主负载中继路径。
AI.result: 对比基线为同环境下启用 HCCL 的 DeepEP。Prefill normal kernel：非量化下 dispatch/combine 延迟均下降，且 token 数越大差距越明显（dispatch 由 1.1ms@1024 tokens、9.4ms@16384 tokens 降至 1.0ms 与 6.8ms）；量化下仍有收益，但 dispatch 侧因 scale 处理开销占比上升而缩小。Decode low-latency（batch {16,32,64,80,128,144} 均值）：dispatch 加速 20.18%（4096 非量化）、31.02%（4096 量化）、14.83%（7168 非量化）、27.72%（7168 量化）；combine 稳定在 22.43%–24.45%。低延迟案例研究：DeepSeek 3.1 场景 dispatch −23.3%、combine −10.8%；Qwen-235B 场景 dispatch −52.8%、combine −18.3%，表明增益幅度依赖模型与阶段但方向一致。端到端服务（DeepSeek 3.1 场景）：TTFT 从 11197ms 降至 6793ms，TPOT 由 30.10ms 变为 31.31ms 且低于目标阈值，说明收益主要体现在 prompt 处理阶段。调度空间（DeepSeek 3.2 场景，TTFT<5000ms 且 TPOT<60ms 约束）：更多配置同时满足双约束，最优吞吐可行点贴近约束边界，验证了"更低 TTFT 配置未必是最低 TPOT 配置"的权衡。作者说明实验为早期阶段性结果，更广模型覆盖、显存占用细粒度测量与系统化服务基准留待后续版本。
AI.conclusion: 在具备全局可寻址设备内存的平台上，MoE 推理瓶颈应被视为围绕 dispatch/combine 的 buffer-centric 分布式执行问题，而非单纯的集合通信带宽问题；削减专家执行周围的中间缓冲与输出还原是一条有效的加速路径。该文在昇腾上以全局池化 HBM + 对称内存为底座，用"直接放置 + 直接读取"取代 pack-relay-reorder-restore 流水线，并在 prefill（丰富规划状态、吞吐导向）与 decode（紧凑控制路径、延迟敏感）两套调度下同时降低 dispatch/combine 延迟，改善 TTFT、保持有竞争力的 TPOT，并扩大实际延迟约束下的可行调度区域。设计要点是：payload 搬运与通信控制分离、以两级偏移规则定位专家窗口行、契合硬件读偏好执行；"无中继缓冲"并不等于零状态，同步与紧凑通信状态仍然存在。后续工作方向包括更广模型覆盖、更系统的内存占用测量与更完善的服务级基准。

title: A Few Good Clauses: Comparing LLMs vs Domain-Trained Small Language Models on Structured Contract Extraction
summary:
This paper evaluates whether a domain trained Small Language Model (SLM) can outperform frontier Large Language Models on structured contract extraction at radically lower cost. We test Olava Extract, a self hosted legal domain Mixture of Experts model, against five frontier models.
  Olava Extract achieved the strongest aggregate performance in the study, with a macro F1 of 0.812 and a micro F1 of 0.842, while reducing inference cost by 78% to 97% compared with the frontier models tested. It also achieved the highest precision scores, producing fewer hallucinated and unsupported extractions, an important distinction in legal workflows where hallucinations create operational risk and downstream review burden.
  The findings shows that high performing, human comparable legal AI no longer requires the largest externally hosted models. More broadly, they challenge the assumption that commercially valuable enterprise AI capability must remain tied to ever larger models, massive infrastructure expenditure, and centrally hosted providers.

AI.tldr: 一项关于法律合同提取的研究表明，领域定制的Small Language Model（Olava Extract）能够以显著更低的成本（78-97%）超越多个前沿Large Language Models，同时保持更少的幻觉输出。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在验证在结构化合同提取任务上，经过领域训练的Small Language Model (SLM)是否能够以极低成本超越前沿Large Language Models (LLM)。研究挑战了商业化企业AI能力必须依赖最大模型和集中式托管提供商的传统假设。
AI.method: 研究人员测试了Olava Extract（一个自托管的法律领域专家混合模型）与五个前沿模型在结构化合同提取任务上的表现。通过计算宏F1和微F1分数、精度以及幻觉率等指标进行对比评估。
AI.result: Olava Extract在研究中取得最强综合性能，宏F1达到0.812，微F1达到0.842，同时相比测试的前沿模型将推理成本降低了78%至97%。该模型还实现了最高精度分数，产生的幻觉和不支持的提取更少，在法律工作流程中具有重要意义。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明高性能、人工可比的法律AI不再需要最大的外部托管模型。该研究挑战了商业上有价值的企业AI能力必须与越来越大模型、大规模基础设施投资和集中式托管提供商绑定的假设，预示着法律AI领域可能转向更经济高效的领域定制方案。

title: PRISM: Perception Reasoning Interleaved for Sequential Decision Making
summary: Scaling LLM-based embodied agents from text-only environments to complex multimodal settings remains a major challenge. Recent work identifies a perception-reasoning-decision gap in standalone Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which often overlook task-critical information. In this paper, we introduce PRISM, a framework that tightly couples perception (VLM) and decision (LLM) through a dynamic question-answer (DQA) pipeline. Instead of passively accepting the VLM's description, the LLM critiques it, probes the VLM with goal-oriented questions, and synthesizes a compact image description. This closed-loop interaction yields a sharp, task-driven understanding of the scene. We evaluate PRISM on the ALFWorld and Room-to-Room (R2R) benchmarks. We show that: (1) PRISM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art image-based models, (2) our Interactive goal-oriented perception pipeline yields systematic and substantial gains, and (3) PRISM is fully automatic, eliminating the need for handcrafted questions or answers.

AI.tldr: PRISM 是一个把「感知（VLM）」与「决策（LLM）」紧密耦合的具身智能框架：LLM 不再被动接受 VLM 的场景描述，而是批判性地发现信息缺口、针对当前目标动态生成问题（dynamic question-answering, DQA），再把问答结果与初始描述「语义合成」为一段精简、任务驱动的场景文本，最后由带 LoRA 的同一 LLM 依据该描述、目标和历史输出动作。在 ALFWorld 上 PRISM（BC+RL）平均成功率 80%，超过所有无文本特权监督的图像基线（Idefics2-8B 69%、VIPER 75%），逼近使用 oracle 文本监督的 EMMA/EMAC+（82%/86%）；在 R2R 导航上 SR 46.08%、OSR 65.38%、SPL 43.14 为最佳，且优于依赖 oracle 问题与多位专家的 DiscussNAV。整个流程全自动，无需人工编写问题或答案。
AI.motivation: LLM 具身智能在纯文本环境中已相当成熟（ReAct、Reflexion、DEPS 等），但迁移到多模态视觉环境时性能明显落后，根源在于「感知—推理—决策鸿沟」（perception–reasoning–decision gap）：独立工作的 VLM 往往给出任务无关（task-agnostic）、遗漏任务关键细节的通用描述；而决策侧的 LLM 又无法主动回头向感知模块追问信息。已有的交互式问答方案（如 DialFRED、DiscussNAV）虽引入了问答机制，但存在三点不足：(1) 依赖人工预定义的问题或 oracle 答案，真实场景不可用；(2) 只是把问答结果与描述简单拼接，产生冗长含噪的提示；(3) 直接把目标注入 VLM 提示以实现「目标感知」，容易诱发幻觉，反而降低下游性能。本文目标是用一种全自动、目标驱动、输出紧凑的感知—决策闭环来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 问题形式化为目标条件的 POMDP，观测为 RGB 图像、目标与动作为文本指令。PRISM 分两阶段：(1) 交互式目标导向感知（DQA 闭环）——VLM 以固定目标无关指令「Describe the scene in detail」生成初始描述 d_i^t；同一 LLM 作为推理模块 R 依据 (d_i^t, g) 生成问题集合 Q^t（约束为以「Do you see…」开头、只针对当前观测与目标、无缺失信息时回答「I have all the information」）；VLM 逐条回答得到 Λ^t；最后 R 对 (d_i^t, Q^t, Λ^t) 做语义合成/精炼，去矛盾、删冗余、只保留被确认的内容，输出单段紧凑描述 d_f^t（不同于 DiscussNAV 的直接拼接）。(2) 序贯决策——同一 LLM 骨干加 LoRA 适配器（仅作用于 W_q、W_v，r=32，α=16；仅在决策阶段启用），依据 d_f^t、目标 g 与历史 ℋ（长度 5）以 token 级乘积计算动作概率并贪心执行。训练分两阶段：先在视觉环境用规则 bot 采集成功轨迹，将其渲染为文本语料 D_text={d_f^t, ℋ, g, a^t, r^t} 后做行为克隆（BC，lr=1e-4，AdamW）；再在视觉环境内做在线 PPO 强化学习（lr=5e-6，clip=0.1，熵系数 0.001，γ=0.99），且 RL 阶段 DQA 感知保持在线激活。骨干为 Idefics2-8B（感知）+ Mistral-7B（推理与决策），并验证 Qwen3-4B/InternVL 等替代组合。全部提示模板在附录中给出。
AI.result: ALFWorld（平均 SR）：PRISM BC 77%、BC+RL 80%，较 MiniGPT-4（16%）、RL4VLM（21%）高约 60 点，较 Idefics2-8B（69%）高 9–12 点，且已超过 VIPER BC+RL（75%）；与享有 oracle 文本监督的 EMMA（82%）、EMAC+（86%）接近，且跨 6 类任务表现更均衡。架构消融：相比单体 VLM（Idefics2 8B 69%、Qwen3-VL 4B 68%）与静态 Raw perception（69–70%），PRISM 提升约 6–8 点（复杂任务 Pick2 提升 9–12 点），说明增益来自任务相关信息提取而非单纯模块拆分。合并策略消融：LLM-merge（75%）优于 Concat（72%）与 QA-Only（70%）；Concat 提示长度可翻倍（967→1764 token）且含噪。与 oracle 对比：Oracle Q 与 Oracle QA 完全相同（均 77%），PRISM 仅落后 2 点（75%），6 项中 4 项持平；t-SNE 显示生成问题与人工问题语义分布高度一致。描述质量：PRISM 相对 Raw perception 在 RougeL/METEOR/BERTScore 分别 +0.082/+0.052/+0.068，LLM-as-judge 偏好率 46.6% vs 25.9%（p<0.005）；换成 InternVL 偏好率达 66.9%。Goal-aware 感知（直接把目标塞给 VLM）反而降至 64% 并产生幻觉（虚构不存在的物体）。VLM 问答答案准确率平均 F1 0.92（精度 0.91、召回 0.93）。问题数量：平均提问 2–3 个，QA 预算从 1 增至 3 使平均 SR 由 70% 升至 74%，动态生成最佳（75%）。R2R：PRISM BC 的 NE 6.23、OSR 65.38、SR 46.08、SPL 43.14，优于 LangNav（7.10/45/34/29）、NavGPT（6.46/42/34/29）、DiscussNAV（5.32/61/43/40）以及同骨干重实现 DiscussNAV*（7.66/50.40/35.52/31.04），SR 领先 DiscussNAV* 逾 10 点。代价方面单步推理延迟 6.35s vs 2.14s（约 3×），但平均步数由 20.9 降至 17.1，SR +6 点。
AI.conclusion: PRISM 证明：在具身智能中，把「感知」与「推理/决策」从松耦合的模块拼接升级为带目标导向动态问答的闭环，可以系统性弥补 VLM 遗漏任务关键信息的缺陷；在 ALFWorld 与 R2R 两个基准上一致优于现有图像基线，且无需任何人工/Oracle 问题与答案，可完全自动化运行。其核心洞见在于，信息获取与噪声过滤同等重要——问答信息必要但不充分，而 LLM 对初始描述与问答对的语义合成能产出既简洁又全面的提示，优于朴素拼接与单纯目标条件化。局限与未来工作：单步计算开销约 3 倍（多三次前向），且尚未扩展到低层连续控制（如机器人实体执行），后续将探索将交织式感知—推理能力与底层控制结合，以弥合决策与物理动作之间的落差。

title: MidSteer: Optimal Affine Framework for Steering Generative Models
summary: Steering intermediate representations has emerged as a powerful strategy for controlling generative models, particularly in post-deployment alignment and safety settings. However, despite its empirical success, it currently lacks a comprehensive theoretical framework. In this paper, we bridge this gap by formalizing the theory of concept steering. First, we establish a link between steering and affine concept erasure, proving that the standard approach for removing unwanted behaviors is a special case of LEACE (a closed-form method for affine erasure). Next, we formulate a principled theoretical framework for concept switching, LEACE-Switch, and characterize the assumptions under which it provides an optimal affine solution. Building on this analysis, we then introduce MidSteer (Minimal Disturbance concept Steering), a more general affine framework for concept manipulation that relaxes these assumptions and enables directed, minimal-disturbance transformations. We demonstrate that MidSteer performs favorably across a range of tasks, modalities, and architectures, including vision diffusion models and large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文为概念导向理论建立形式化框架，证明标准行为去除方法是LEACE的特例，提出LEACE-Switch和MidSteer，在多种生成模型上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 中间表征导向已成为控制生成模型的重要策略，但目前缺乏全面的理论框架支撑。
AI.method: 1）建立导向与仿射概念擦除的关联，证明标准去除方法为LEACE（仿射擦除的闭合形式方法）的特例；2）提出LEACE-Switch原则性框架，刻画其作为最优仿射解的条件；3）提出MidSteer（最小扰动概念导向），放宽假设条件，支持定向最小扰动变换。
AI.result: MidSteer在多种任务、模态和架构（包括视觉扩散模型和大型语言模型）上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: MidSteer作为一个通用框架，在视觉扩散模型和大型语言模型等多种任务、模态和架构中表现优异。

title: BioResearcher: Scenario-Guided Multi-Agent for Translational Medicine
summary:
Translational medicine turns underspecified development goals into evidence synthesis that must combine literature, trials, patents, and quantitative multi-omics analysis while preserving identifiers, uncertainty, and retrievable provenance. General-purpose foundation models and off-the-shelf tool-augmented or multi-agent systems are not built for this: they tend to produce single-shot answers or run open-endedly, and fall short on the auditable, scenario-specific workflows that heterogeneous biomedical sources demand.
  This paper introduces Ingenix BioResearcher, a scenario-guided multi-agent system that maps queries to versioned research playbooks, delegates to specialized subagents over 30+ tools and machine-learning endpoints, mixes structured database access with sandboxed code for genome-scale analyses, and applies claim-level multi-model reconciliation before editorial assembly.
  We evaluate BioResearcher across unit-level capabilities, open-ended biomedical reasoning, and end-to-end clinical discovery. It leads evaluated baselines on 109 single-step tests (83.49% pass rate; 0.892 average score), achieves strong biomedical benchmark performance (89.33% on BixBench-Verified-50 and the top 0.758 mean score on BaisBench Scientific Discovery), and leads on a 30-query clinical end-to-end benchmark with the highest positive hit rate (74.7% $\pm$ 3.3%) and negative clear rate (96.8% $\pm$ 0.2%). These results show broad, competitive performance across unit-level, open-ended, and end-to-end clinical evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ingenix BioResearcher，一个面向转化医学研究的多智能体系统，通过场景引导工作流整合30+工具和ML端点，支持可审计的异构生物医学数据分析。在单元能力、开放域生物医学推理和端到端临床发现三项评估中均展现出领先性能，验证了多智能体架构在生物医学场景的可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有通用基础模型和现成工具增强或多智能体系统无法满足转化医学需求：倾向于生成单次答案或开放式运行，缺乏异构生物医学来源（文献、试验、专利、定量多组学分析）所需的场景特定可审计工作流、标识符保留、不确定性量化和可追溯溯源能力。
AI.method: Ingenix BioResearcher采用场景引导的多智能体系统架构：查询映射至版本化研究剧本，委托至30+工具和ML端点的专业子智能体，混合结构化数据库访问与沙箱化代码执行基因组规模分析，并在编辑组装前进行声明级多模型协调。
AI.result: 单元测试：109项单步测试通过率83.49%，平均得分0.892；基准测试：BixBench-Verified-50达89.33%，BaisBench科学发现平均分0.758；临床评估：30查询端到端基准阳性命中率74.7%±3.3%，阴性清除率96.8%±0.2%。
AI.conclusion: Ingenix BioResearcher demonstrates broad, competitive performance across unit-level, open-ended, and end-to-end clinical evaluations, validating the scenario-guided multi-agent architecture for biomedical discovery workflows.

title: Bilateral Treewidth for QBF: Where Strategies and Resolution Meet
summary: Treewidth is a well-studied decompositional parameter to measure the tree-likeness of a graph. While the propositional satisfiability problem (SAT) is known to be tractable when parameterized by the treewidth of the underlying primal graph, the evaluation of quantified Boolean formulas (QBFs) remains PSPACE-complete even on formulas of constant treewidth. Intuitively, this is because ordinary treewidth does not take into account the prefix of the QBF: it neither distinguishes between existential and universal variables, nor accounts for the order in which they are quantified. In the past, several weaker variants of treewidth have been devised to incorporate prefix-sensitive information. To establish tractability for QBFs under these notions, prior work has employed either strategy- or resolution-based techniques, thereby dividing the parameterized complexity landscape of QBF into two regimes that are incomparable in strength. We establish fixed-parameter tractability with respect to bilateral treewidth, a novel and strictly more powerful decompositional parameter that combines these rivaling approaches by simultaneously allowing for branching on strategies and performing Q-resolution. As in previous works in this direction, our algorithm assumes that a suitable tree decomposition is provided on the input.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的参数——双侧树宽度（bilateral treewidth），该参数结合了策略分解和Q-分解两种方法的优点，能够更有效地求解量化布尔公式（QBF）的可满足性判定问题，并在给定树分解的情况下证明了该问题的固定参数 tractability。
AI.motivation: 量化布尔公式（QBF）评估问题即使在常数树宽度下也是PSPACE完全问题。传统树宽度未考虑量词前缀（存在/通用变量区分及量化顺序），先前研究分别采用基于策略和基于Resolution的两类技术，但这两类方法强度不可比较。本文动机是找到一个统一且更强大的参数化方法。
AI.method: 提出双侧树宽度（bilateral treewidth）这一新型分解参数，该参数同时兼容策略分支和Q-Resolution操作。文章假设输入已提供合适的树分解，并设计固定参数算法进行QBF评估。
AI.result: 证明了基于双侧树宽度的QBF评估问题是固定参数可求解的（fixed-parameter tractable）。该参数严格强于之前分离的策略分解和Resolution分解方法，统一了两个原本不可比较的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 双侧树宽度成功结合了策略分解和Q-Resolution两类方法的优势，建立了一个更强大且统一的参数化框架，为QBF的参量化复杂度研究开辟了新方向。

title: From Review to Design: Ethical Multimodal Driver Monitoring Systems for Risk Mitigation, Incident Response, and Accountability in Automated Vehicles
summary:
As vehicles transition toward higher levels of automation, Driver Monitoring Systems (DMS) have become essential for ensuring human oversight, safety, and regulatory compliance in a vehicle. These systems rely on multimodal sensing and AI-driven inference to assess driver attention, cognitive state, and readiness to take control. While technologically promising, their deployment introduces a complex set of ethical and legal challenges - ranging from privacy and consent to data ownership and algorithmic fairness. While overarching frameworks such as the GDPR, EU AI Act, and IEEE standards offer important guidance, they lack the specificity required for addressing the unique risks posed by in-cabin sensing technologies.
  This paper adopts a review-to-design perspective, critically examining existing regulatory instruments and ethical frameworks -- such as the GDPR, the EU AI Act, and IEEE guidelines -- and identifying gaps in their applicability to the distinctive risks posed by multimodal, AI-enabled in-cabin monitoring. Building on this review, we propose a modular ethical design framework tailored specifically to Driver Monitoring Systems. The framework translates high-level principles into actionable design and deployment guidance, including user-configurable consent mechanisms, fairness-aware model development, transparency and explainability tools, and safeguards for driver emotional well-being.
  Finally, the paper outlines a risk analysis and failure mitigation strategy, emphasizing proactive incident response and accountability mechanisms tailored to the DMS context. Together, these contributions aim to inform the development of transparent, trustworthy, and human-centered driver monitoring systems for next-generation autonomous vehicles.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自动驾驶车辆中的驾驶员监控系统（DMS）所引发的伦理和法律挑战，批判性地分析了GDPR、欧盟AI法案、IEEE标准等现有监管框架的局限性，并提出了一套模块化伦理设计框架，将高级伦理原则转化为用户可配置同意机制、公平感知模型开发、可解释性工具和情感健康保障等具体设计指导，同时制定了DMS情境的风险分析和故障缓解策略，旨在推动开发透明、可信、以人为中心的下一代车内监控系统。
AI.motivation: 随着车辆自动化程度提高，驾驶员监控系统（DMS）对于保障人类监督、安全和法规合规变得不可或缺，但这些系统的部署引发了复杂的伦理和法律挑战（隐私、知情同意、数据所有权、算法公平性），现有监管框架缺乏针对车载感知技术特殊风险的具体指导。
AI.method: 采用综述到设计的研究视角，首先批判性地审查现有监管工具（GDPR、欧盟AI法案、IEEE标准），识别其对多模态AI车内监控适用性的不足；然后基于此提出针对DMS的模块化伦理设计框架，并将高级原则转化为可操作的指导；最后制定风险分析和故障缓解策略。
AI.result: 提出了一套模块化伦理设计框架，包括：用户可配置同意机制、公平感知模型开发、透明度和可解释性工具、以及驾驶员情感健康保障措施；同时建立了针对DMS情境的风险分析和失效缓解策略，强调主动事件响应和问责机制。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为下一代自动驾驶汽车的驾驶员监控系统开发提供了透明、可信、以人为中心的指导框架，通过模块化设计方法将伦理原则转化为可操作的技术和部署指南，并强调了主动事件响应和问责机制的重要性。

title: Career-Aware Resume Tailoring via Multi-Source Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Provenance Tracking: A Case Study
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Also available on SSRN
summary: AI-assisted resume tailoring systems commonly operate on a single uploaded resume, which limits their ability to recover relevant experience omitted from the current draft and makes it difficult for users to distinguish grounded edits from model-generated suggestions. This paper presents Resume Tailor, an agentic resume-tailoring system that maintains a longitudinal career vault in a vector database and uses multi-source retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to assemble job-specific resume content from historical resumes and structured career records. The system is implemented as a 12-node LangGraph pipeline with typed state management, hybrid semantic-lexical confidence scoring, provenance-aware fallback generation, anti-hallucination guardrails, and a conditional review loop. We report a pilot evaluation on nine job descriptions (JDs) across software engineering, data analytics, and business analysis roles using a single candidate's career history. For six JDs where the candidate held at least one prior role in the same occupational category, enabling the career vault improved Applicant Tracking System (ATS)-style fit scores by an average of 7.8 points. For two JDs requiring domain-specific expertise absent from the vault, scores decreased by an average of 8.0 points. One partially overlapping role showed a modest gain of 2 points. These results suggest that longitudinal retrieval can improve resume tailoring when relevant prior experience exists, while also highlighting the need for confidence-gated retrieval when domain overlap is weak.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Resume Tailor系统，通过纵向职业保险库和多源检索增强生成改进简历定制。当候选人有相关先前经验时ATS评分提升7.8分，但缺乏领域知识时分数反而下降8分，提示系统需具备置信度门控能力以避免误导性建议。
AI.motivation: 现有AI辅助简历定制系统仅依赖单一上传的简历，限制了恢复遗漏相关经历的能力，且用户难以区分有据可查的编辑与模型生成的建议。现有方法缺乏对用户历史职业经历的系统性整合和溯源机制。
AI.method: 该系统基于LangGraph实现12节点管道，采用Typed State Management、混合语义-词义置信度评分、溯源感知回退生成、抗幻觉防护栏和条件审查循环。核心技术包括向量数据库存储的纵向职业保险库和多源检索增强生成(RAG)架构。
AI.result: 在9个职位描述的试点评估中：存在同职业类别先前经验的6个JD，启用职业保险库后ATS评分平均提升7.8分；缺乏领域专业知识的2个JD评分平均下降8.0分；部分重叠的1个JD仅获得2分增益。评分采用申请人追踪系统(ATS)风格评估。
AI.conclusion: 纵向检索在存在相关先前经验时可改善简历定制效果，但当领域重叠较弱时，需要置信度门控检索机制。研究表明，基于向量数据库的职业保险库结合多源RAG能够有效提升ATS评分，但系统应具备识别经验差距的能力以避免误导性建议。

title: An Empirical Study of Proactive Coding Assistants in Real-World Software Development
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based coding assistants have made substantial progress, yet most systems remain reactive, requiring developers to explicitly formulate their needs. Proactive coding assistants aim to infer latent developer intent from integrated development environment (IDE) interactions and repository context, thereby reducing interaction overhead and supporting more seamless assistance. However, research in this direction is limited by the scarcity of large-scale real-world developer behavior data. Existing studies therefore often rely on LLM-simulated IDE traces, whose fidelity to real development behavior remains unclear. In this paper, we investigate this simulation-to-reality gap through a large-scale empirical study. We collect real IDE interaction traces from 1{,}246 experienced industry developers over three consecutive days using a custom Visual Studio Code extension, and construct paired LLM-simulated traces for controlled comparison. Our analysis shows that simulated traces differ substantially from real traces in behavioral diversity, temporal structure, and exploratory patterns. Based on the collected data, we introduce \textbf{ProCodeBench}, a real-world benchmark for proactive intent prediction. Experiments with representative LLMs, retrieval-augmented methods, and agentic baselines show that current approaches remain far from reliable under real IDE traces, suggesting that simulation-based evaluation can overestimate real-world performance. Finally, our training study shows that simulated data cannot replace real data, but can complement it when used before real-world fine-tuning. These findings highlight the importance of real developer behavior data for evaluating and training proactive coding assistants.

AI.tldr: 通过大规模实证研究揭示了LLM模拟IDE轨迹与真实开发者行为的显著差距，提出ProCodeBench基准，发现当前方法在真实场景下表现不佳，强调真实数据的重要性。
AI.motivation: 主动编码助手研究受限于大规模真实开发者行为数据的稀缺，现有研究依赖LLM模拟的IDE轨迹，但这些模拟数据与真实开发行为的保真度尚不清楚。
AI.method: 从1,246名资深行业开发者收集了连续三天的真实IDE交互轨迹（通过自定义VS Code扩展），并构建配对的LLM模拟轨迹用于对照研究。
AI.result: 分析表明模拟轨迹在行为多样性、时间结构和探索模式上与真实轨迹存在显著差异；ProCodeBench基准测试显示当前方法在真实IDE轨迹下远未达到可靠水平，模拟评估可能高估真实世界性能；训练研究表明模拟数据无法替代真实数据，但可在真实数据微调前作为补充。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现突显了真实开发者行为数据对于评估和训练主动编码助手的重要性。模拟数据虽不能替代真实数据，但可在真实数据微调前作为补充。

title: FalconGEMM: Surpassing Hardware Peaks with Lower-Complexity Matrix Multiplication
summary: Peak breaking Matrix Multiplication is a promising technique to improve the performance of DL, especially in LLM training and inference. We present FalconGEMM, a cross-platform framework that automates the deployment, optimization, and selection of Lower-Complexity Matrix Multiplication Algorithms (LCMAs) across diverse hardware. There are three key innovations: (1) a Deployment Module that enables portable execution across various hardware and input configurations through code generation; (2) an Execution Module with Group-Parallel Optimizations that maximizes on-chip data reuse, utilizes parallel resources, and reduces bandwidth overhead; and (3) a Decision Module featuring a lightweight analytical performance model to select the optimal strategy based on matrix shapes and hardware profiles. Extensive evaluation is conducted on LLM workloads across GPU (H20, A100) and CPU (ARM, x86) architectures with multiple data types. FalconGEMM succeeds in delivering peak breaking performance and outperforms GEMM libraries (e.g., cuBLAS, CUTLASS, Intel MKL, etc) by 7.59%-17.85% and LCMA competitors like AlphaTensor by 12.41%-55.61%. Our framework makes the theoretical promise of LCMAs practical for production deployment across the heterogeneous landscape of modern hardware.

AI.tldr: FalconGEMM是一个跨平台框架，通过代码生成、Group-Parallel优化和自适应性能模型选择，在GPU和CPU异构硬件上实现LCMA的峰值突破性能，超越现有GEMM库和LCMA竞品。
AI.motivation: 传统GEMM库和低复杂度矩阵乘法算法(LCMA)在跨平台部署、性能优化和策略选择方面存在瓶颈，亟需一套自动化、可移植且高效的解决方案来释放LCMA在LLM训练推理中的理论性能优势。
AI.method: 提出三模块协同架构：(1) Deployment Module通过代码生成实现跨平台可移植部署；(2) Execution Module采用Group-Parallel优化策略最大化数据复用、并行资源和带宽效率；(3) Decision Module基于轻量级解析性能模型实现自适应策略选择。
AI.result: FalconGEMM较GEMM库(cuBLAS, CUTLASS, Intel MKL等)提升7.59%-17.85%，较LCMA竞品(如AlphaTensor)提升12.41%-55.61%。
AI.conclusion: FalconGEMM成功将LCMA理论优势转化为实际生产部署，在GPU（H20, A100）和CPU（ARM, x86）异构平台上均实现峰值突破性能。

title: The Cost of Context: Mitigating Textual Bias in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly integrated with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to mitigate hallucinations, the introduction of external documents can conceal severe failure modes at the instance level. We identify and formalize the phenomenon of recorruption, where the introduction of even perfectly accurate "oracle" context causes a capable model to abandon an initially correct prediction. Through a mechanistic diagnosis of internal attention matrices, we show that recorruption is driven by a two-fold attentional collapse: (1) visual blindness, characterized by the systemic suppression of visual attention mass ($M_{vis}$) and sharpness ($S_{vis}$), and (2) a structural positional bias that forces the model to prioritize boundary tokens over semantic relevance. Our analysis reveals an Illusion of Success, demonstrating that many seemingly correct RAG outcomes are merely positional coincidences where the model's textual copying bias happens to align with the ground-truth location. To address these vulnerabilities, we propose Bottleneck Attention Intervention for Recovery (BAIR), a parameter-free, inference-time framework that restores visual saliency and applies position-aware penalties to textual distractors. Across medical factuality, social fairness, and geospatial benchmarks, BAIR successfully restores multimodal grounding and improves diagnostic reliability without requiring model retraining or fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多模态大模型RAG系统中普遍存在的recorruption现象——精确上下文反而导致模型放弃正确答案。通过注意力机制分析，发现根源在于视觉注意力崩溃和位置偏差。基于此提出的BAIR方法无需训练即可恢复模型视觉聚焦能力，在多个领域基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 当多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)与检索增强生成(RAG)结合时，外部文档的引入会掩盖严重的实例级失败模式。即使提供完全准确的"oracle"上下文，模型也可能放弃原本正确的预测，这一现象被称为recorruption，亟需系统性的诊断与干预。
AI.method: 通过注意力矩阵的机制诊断，发现recorruption源于双重注意力崩溃：(1)视觉 blindness——视觉注意力质量(M_vis)和锐度(S_vis)的系统性抑制；(2)结构性位置偏差——模型优先关注边界token而非语义相关性。BAIR通过恢复视觉显著性和对文本干扰项施加位置感知惩罚来解决这些漏洞。
AI.result: 揭示了"Illusion of Success"现象——许多看似正确的RAG结果仅是位置巧合（模型文本复制偏差与真值位置恰好对齐）。实验表明BAIR在医学事实性、社会公平性和地理空间基准上有效恢复多模态接地能力，提升诊断可靠性。
AI.conclusion: BAIR成功恢复多模态接地能力，提升医学诊断可靠性，全程无需重训练或微调。

title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Financial Document Question Answering
comment: 22 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables, submitted to Expert Systems with Applications
summary: Financial document question answering (QA) demands complex multi-step numerical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence--structured tables, textual narratives, and footnotes--scattered across corporate filings. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches adopt a single-pass retrieve-then-generate paradigm that struggles with the compositional reasoning chains prevalent in financial analysis. We propose FinAgent-RAG, an agentic RAG framework that orchestrates iterative retrieval-reasoning loops with self-verification, specifically engineered for the precision requirements of financial numerical reasoning. The framework integrates three domain-specific innovations: (1) a Contrastive Financial Retriever trained with hard negative mining to distinguish semantically similar but numerically distinct financial passages, (2) a Program-of-Thought reasoning module that generates executable Python code for precise arithmetic rather than relying on error-prone LLM-based mental computation, and (3) an Adaptive Strategy Router that dynamically allocates computational resources based on question complexity, reducing API costs by 41.3% on FinQA while preserving accuracy. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets--FinQA, ConvFinQA, and TAT-QA--demonstrate that FinAgent-RAG achieves 76.81%, 78.46%, and 74.96% execution accuracy respectively, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.62--9.32 percentage points. Ablation studies, cross-backbone evaluation with four LLMs, and deployment cost analysis confirm the framework's robustness and practical viability for financial institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FinAgent-RAG——一个面向金融文档数值推理的智能体式 RAG 框架，通过"检索-推理"迭代循环与自我验证，取代传统单轮"先检索后生成"范式；引入对比式金融检索器（困难负例挖掘）、Program-of-Thought（生成可执行 Python 代码做精确算术）与自适应策略路由器（按问题复杂度分配算力）三项领域创新，在 FinQA/ConvFinQA/TAT-QA 上分别取得 76.81%/78.46%/74.96% 执行准确率，较最强基线提升 5.62–9.32 个百分点，并在 FinQA 上降低 41.3% API 成本。
AI.motivation: 金融文档问答（Financial Document QA）需要在结构化表格、文本叙述与脚注等异构证据上完成复杂的多步数值推理，这些证据分散于企业财报各处。现有 RAG 方法采用单轮"检索后生成"范式，难以处理金融分析中普遍存在的组合式（compositional）推理链：一方面固定的一次性检索往往无法召回数值上真正关键或被干扰项掩盖的段落；另一方面让大模型"心算"数值极易累积算术错误；同时不同难度的问题被赋予同等计算资源，导致成本高企而收益有限。因此需要一种具备迭代检索、精确数值计算与难度自适应调度能力的金融专用 RAG 系统。
AI.method: FinAgent-RAG 以智能体循环编排"迭代检索—推理—自我验证"过程，并融合三项领域定制模块：(1) Contrastive Financial Retriever（对比式金融检索器），采用困难负例挖掘（hard negative mining）训练，使模型能区分语义相近但数值不同的金融段落；(2) Program-of-Thought（PoT）推理模块，生成并执行 Python 代码完成精确算术，替代易出错的 LLM 心算；(3) Adaptive Strategy Router（自适应策略路由器），依据问题复杂度动态分配检索深度/推理预算等计算资源。实验在 FinQA、ConvFinQA、TAT-QA 三个基准上进行，包含消融研究、跨四种 LLM 骨干的泛化性评测以及部署成本分析。
AI.result: 在 FinQA、ConvFinQA、TAT-QA 上执行准确率分别达到 76.81%、78.46%、74.96%，比最强基线高出 5.62–9.32 个百分点；自适应策略路由使 FinQA 上的 API 成本下降 41.3% 且准确率不受损。消融实验验证了三大模块各自的贡献，跨四种 LLM 骨干的实验显示框架对底座模型的鲁棒性与可迁移性，成本分析表明该方案对金融机构具有实际落地可行性与实用价值。
AI.conclusion: FinAgent-RAG 证明，将领域化的对比式检索、基于程序执行的精确算术推理与难度自适应的算力调度整合进智能体式 RAG 循环，可显著提升金融文档多步数值问答的准确率并同时降低成本。相比单轮 retrieve-then-generate 基线，该框架在精度与效率上取得双赢，表明面向垂直领域的智能体 RAG 设计对高精度数值推理场景具有普遍借鉴意义，是金融等高合规要求行业部署 LLM 问答系统的可行路径。

title: Data-Driven Variational Basis Learning Beyond Neural Networks: A Non-Neural Framework for Adaptive Basis Discovery
summary: Classical representation systems such as Fourier series, wavelets, and fixed dictionaries provide analytically tractable basis expansions, but they are not intrinsically adapted to the empirical structure of modern high-dimensional data. Neural networks overcome this limitation by learning features from data, yet they do so through layered nonlinear parameterizations that often sacrifice interpretability, explicit control over basis structure, and mathematical transparency. In this manuscript we develop a non-neural alternative that learns basis functions directly from data through variational optimization. The proposed framework, termed Data Driven Variational Basis Learning (DVBL), treats basis atoms as primary optimization variables and learns them jointly with sample-specific coefficients and, when appropriate, a latent linear evolution operator. This yields a data-adaptive basis expansion that remains explicit, interpretable, and amenable to rigorous analysis. We formulate the model, establish existence of minimizers, prove blockwise descent properties for an alternating minimization algorithm, give conditions for coefficient recovery and basis identifiability, and show how manifold and dynamical regularization can be integrated without invoking neural architectures. We also discuss the conceptual novelty of the framework relative to classical dictionary learning, spectral methods, Koopman operator methods, and deep representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「数据驱动变分基学习」（DVBL）：把基函数本身当作主要优化变量，与样本系数（及可选的潜在线性演化算子）联合通过变分优化从数据中学习，从而得到显式、可解释、可严格分析的非神经网络表示。作者建立了最小值存在性、交替最小化的单调下降与临界点收敛、稀疏系数恢复与基可辨识性等理论，并扩展出流形正则化、动力学（Koopman式）扩展及物理约束基模型；进一步把同一思想用于语言建模，提出「基状态语言模型」（BSLM），配以训练流程、评价指标、消融与实验协议。
AI.motivation: 经典表示系统（Fourier、小波、样条、固定字典）具有闭式结构与良好逼近理论，但其基是先验固定的，无法适配现代高维数据的各向异性、低维流形与任务相关结构。神经网络通过层叠非线性参数化学习特征，克服了这一缺陷，却以牺牲可解释性、对基结构的显式控制与数学透明性为代价，且优化高度非凸、组合性强，难以做稳定性保证与领域约束（稀疏性、对称性、平滑性、守恒律）的显式注入。本文试图提出第三条路线：不使用层叠神经参数化，而是通过结构化变分问题直接学习基函数，在保留基展开概念清晰度的同时获得数据自适应性、可解释性与严格的可分析性，并希望在科学机器学习与语言建模等需要可控、可检验表示的场景中建立「非神经表示学习」的可行范式。
AI.method: 以观测 X=[x_1,…,x_N]∈R^{d×N} 为输入，定义变分目标 J(Φ,{α_i}) = Σ_i ‖x_i−Φα_i‖² + λΣ_i R(α_i) + μΩ(Φ)，其中 Φ∈R^{d×m} 的列为单位范数基原子（可加相干性约束 |φ_k^T φ_l|≤δ），R 可取 ℓ1、ℓ2² 或组稀疏，Ω 可取 ‖Φ‖_F²、Σ_k‖∇φ_k‖² 或 ‖Φ^TΦ−I‖_F²；矩阵形式为 min ‖X−ΦA‖_F² + λR(A) + μΩ(Φ)。理论上：假设R为proper、lsc、coercive，Ω为proper、lsc且可行集C_Φ非空紧，得最小值存在（直接法）；系数子问题在R凸时为凸（严格凸或Φ^TΦ正定时解唯一），基子问题在Ω凸且可行集凸时为凸（归一化约束非凸，故基步一般非凸）；由算法1（ISTA/FISTA或坐标下降做系数步、正则最小二乘加列归一化做基步）给出单调下降定理、目标收敛推论及在Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz条件下的块坐标不动点临界性定理。恢复方面：在稀疏生成模型 x_i=Φ_*α_i^*+ε 下，基于互相关 μ(Φ) 给出 ‖α‖_0 < (1+1/μ)/2 的唯一稀疏表示定理，并在支撑足够丰富、噪声有界、非退化条件下给出全局最小元在带符号置换意义下等于真基的可辨识性论证。扩展包括：加入图拉普拉斯流形正则项 ηTr(ALA^T)（等于 ½Σ_ij W_ij‖α_i−α_j‖²）；加入潜在线性演化 x_t≈Φz_t、z_{t+1}≈Az_t，得闭式解 A*=Z_+Z_-^T(Z_-Z_-^T+νI)^{-1}（ν>0 时强凸、唯一）。近似视角下给出自适应逼近类 A_{m,s}，并由 Eckart–Young–Mirsky 定理指出无正则时最优误差退化为最佳秩m逼近 Σ_{j>m}σ_j²。语言建模部分提出 BSLM：词表基 Φ∈R^{V×m} + 稀疏 token 编码 a_t + 算子驱动状态 z_{t+1}=Az_t+Ba_t（可用切换算子 A_{σ_t}、低秩创新校正）、读出 ℓ_t=Cz_t+d 或 ℓ_t=ΦMz_t+d，并以 NLL 加基/系数正则与状态一致性惩罚为训练目标，采用 token 块级交替优化（token 编码推断→状态推断→基与算子更新→归一化/稳定性投影），配合 PPL、NLL、延迟、显存、基相干性、系数稀疏度与可解释性等评测。
AI.result: 本文给出的是框架、理论结果与一份实验方案（protocol），而非已完成的实证结论：①存在性定理保证在温和假设下变分问题良定，且指出‖φ_k‖=1 是消除(Φ,A)→(cΦ,c^{-1}A)尺度退化的必要约束；②交替最小化目标单调不增并收敛，在紧性、Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz 等正则条件下聚点为块坐标临界点；③系数步与算子步均为凸/强凸子问题，可用ISTA/FISTA、近端梯度与闭式岭回归求解，凸显算法结构简单、无需反向传播；④相干性保证稀疏系数唯一，稀疏生成假设支持基在带符号置换下的可辨识，说明自适应基学习在原理上是良定的逆问题而非纯启发式；⑤无稀疏/结构正则时框架退化为低秩（主子空间）逼近，框架价值必须来自正则与结构约束；⑥实验部分以「示意性/待验证」的方式给出WikiText-2/103、OpenWebText子集上的比较表：40M参数BSLM在WikiText-103上Test PPL 34.0、5.9 ms/token、4.1 GB、解释性8.7，优于42M小型Transformer基线（30.6 PPL、7.4 ms、5.8 GB、解释性2.1）的延迟/显存/可解释性但困惑度更差；消融显示去掉基正则（37.5）、改稠密编码（36.2）、仅固定线性算子（38.0）、去多尺度状态（36.7）均劣化；缩放表显示基维度和语料增大时PPL单调下降（WikiText-1024:45.8 → OpenWebText-2048:28.3）。作者明确声明这些数字是尚未开展生产级实证验证的「蓝图式」预期模式，不应视为已确证的实验事实。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张自适应基学习不必依赖层叠神经参数化：DVBL把基原子作为一等的优化变量与系数、可选的潜在线性演化算子联合学习，形成介于手设计基系统与深度黑箱模型之间的、显式且可分析表示族；理论部分证明其良定、单调下降与临界点收敛，并在稀疏生成假设下给出系数恢复与基可辨识性条件。流形正则化与动力学扩展使基可同时满足几何一致性与演化线性，物理约束基模型（如 Σ_k‖Lφ_k‖²）则显示其适合科学机器学习。语言建模部分提出 BSLM 作为「非神经 LLM」架构类，诚实承认其近期在困惑度上预计弱于 Transformer，但可能带来更强可解释性、显式可控性、算子/物理先验易集成、紧致状态空间下的更低显存与更长程稳定性；因此其近期研究价值在于开辟「自适应基与算子推断」这一新架构方向，而非争夺 SOTA。局限包括联合非凸导致全局最优无保证、初始化敏感、可辨识性依赖稀疏/非相干/支撑多样性假设、单层基展开的表达力弱于深层组合非线性、精确状态推断成本高、大词表输出计算与长上下文仍是核心难题。开放问题包括多层/层次化 DVBL、领域特定基正则设计、流形与动力学约束下的统计恢复率，以及把自适应基学习与压缩感知的测量设计、逆问题统一起来。

title: From Agent Loops to Deterministic Graphs: Execution Lineage for Reproducible AI-Native Work
summary:
Large language model systems are increasingly deployed as agentic workflows that interleave reasoning, tool use, memory, and iterative refinement. These systems are effective at producing answers, but they often rely on implicit conversational state, making it difficult to preserve stable work products, isolate irrelevant updates, or propagate changes through intermediate artifacts.
  We introduce execution lineage: an execution model in which AI-native work is represented as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of artifact-producing computations with explicit dependencies, stable intermediate boundaries, and identity-based replay. The goal is not to make the model a better one-shot writer, but to make evolving AI-generated work maintainable under change.
  We compare execution-lineage replay against loop-centric update baselines on two controlled policy-memo update tasks. In an unrelated-branch update, DAG replay preserved the final memo exactly in all runs, with zero churn and zero unrelated-branch contamination, while loop baselines regenerated the memo and frequently imported unrelated context. In an intermediate-artifact edit, all systems reflected the new constraint in the final memo, but only DAG replay achieved perfect upstream preservation, downstream propagation, unaffected-artifact preservation, and cross-artifact consistency.
  These results show that final answer quality and maintained-state quality are distinct. Strong loop baselines can remain competitive at producing polished final outputs when the task is a bounded synthesis/update problem and all current sources fit in context, but immediate task success can mask partial state inconsistency that may compound over future revisions. Execution lineage provides stronger guarantees about what should change, what should remain stable, and how work evolves across revisions.

AI.tldr: 提出"执行谱系"（execution lineage）：把AI原生工作表示为产出工件的有向无环图（DAG），带显式依赖、稳定中间边界与基于执行身份的确定性重放。在两项受控政策备忘录更新任务上对比循环式（loop）基线：DAG重放能精确保留不受依赖路径影响的最终产物、隔离无关分支污染，并在中间工件编辑时实现完美上下游传播与跨工件一致性；而最终答案质量与"被维护状态质量"是两个不同维度。
AI.motivation: 基于ReAct等范式的LLM智能体系统把推理、工具调用、记忆与迭代交织在隐式对话状态中，带来非确定性执行、隐式依赖、有限可复现性与全局重算等系统性局限：许多被归因于"LLM不可靠"的失败实为系统结构失败。研究动机是把工作结构从"prompt谱系"外化为"执行谱系"，使中间工件成为一等可寻址对象，从而获得可重放、可观测、可局部重算的系统属性，而非靠提示工程技巧。核心区分是"交付物质量"与"被维护状态质量"：循环可能产出漂亮的最终答案，却无法保留未受影响的工作、隔离无关更新或维持跨工件一致性。
AI.method: 采用任务内（within-task）比较设计，两个受控政策备忘录更新任务（远程医疗扩张备忘录）：(1) unrelated_branch_noop_update——更新发生在与最终备忘录非上游依赖的相邻分支（医患招募与人员配置）；(2) intermediate_artifact_edit——编辑中间"推荐标准"工件加入首年预算中性+利用率管控约束。三种条件：loop final update（自然循环基线）、loop + edit event（额外告知编辑事件但无依赖图）、DAG replay（获得工件身份、依赖图与依赖推导的重算计划）。固定模型家族、源材料、任务域、存储的渲染提示与输出；DAG 条件按设计获得运行时派生的依赖与谱系状态（属被评估的架构基底，非等提示比较）。模型为 GPT-5.2、temperature 0.7、n=3 重复、每次两轮语义评判。度量含精确保留/哈希保留、churn 率、无关分支污染率、约束反映、跨工件一致性、下游传播召回、无影响工件保留、语义忠实度/当前状态精度，以及 token、模型调用数与墙钟时间等效率指标；确定性指标由工件哈希与重放记录直接计算，语义指标由评判器评估。
AI.result: 任务1（无关分支更新）：DAG replay 3/3 运行精确保留最终备忘录（exact match=1.00、hash preserved=1.00）、stable artifact preservation=1.00、churn=0、污染=0；两个循环基线 3/3 均重写备忘录，污染率分别为 0.667 与 1.000。效率上 DAG 仅 382 输入 token vs 约 11.7k（≈30.5×/30.6× 更少），墙钟 7.9s vs 33.5s/55.0s（≈4.2×/6.9× 更快）。任务2（中间工件编辑）：三种条件均正确反映新约束（constraint reflection=1.00、忠实度与精度=1.00），因此仅看最终备忘录会判定全部成功；但只有 DAG replay 达到 stable preservation=1.00、downstream propagation recall=1.00、upstream churn=0.00、unaffected artifact preservation=1.00、cross-artifact consistency=1.00，循环基线一致性仅 0.50。该任务中 DAG 输入 token 更少（8461 vs 11404/11464）但输出 token 更多、墙钟更慢（73.6s vs 38.7s/31.1s，约1.9×/2.36×），因实现为串行多阶段重算。结论：不存在"DAG 总是更快"的普遍主张，效率取决于更新结构与运行时实现。
AI.conclusion: 执行谱系的价值不在于让模型成为更好的一次性写作者，而在于使AI生成的工作在变更下可维护：明确什么应当改变、什么应保持稳定、变化如何沿依赖传播。强循环基线在有界合成/更新且源材料全部在上下文内时仍可产出与DAG相当的最终文稿，但即时任务成功会掩盖部分状态不一致，长期修订中可能累积为状态漂移。论文明确限定其主张：实验为机制性研究（单领域、2任务、3条件、3次重复、单一模型家族），未直接测量多轮累积；不主张确定性图取代所有开放式探索，也不主张DAG普遍产出更优散文。适用场景为具备依赖隔离、无关分支隔离、中间工件编辑、累积修订、共享被维护工件与重算成本不对称等特征的工作流。

title: Designing Capacitated Subnetworks for Shortest Path Routing
summary: In pursuit of higher energy efficiency in computer networks, one subfield of green traffic engineering aims at reducing the size of a network during times of low traffic, while still guaranteeing the ability to route all occurring demands. In this setting, we have to simultaneously solve a network design problem (choosing connections to deactivate) and a routing problem (routing paths in the active subnetwork, adhering to some routing protocol). Interestingly, there seems to be no available method to tackle the problem as a whole for the simplest (and still most commonly used) routing paradigm: shortest path routing. State-of-the-art methods either do not consider capacities, or assume that the routing paths should not change when deactivating network connections, or separate the problem into its two constituents, first solving the network design problem (using some estimators in lieu of the precise routing protocol) and only then the actual routing problem. In this paper, we present an algorithm to tackle the full combined problem exactly via a novel integer linear program, modeling dynamically changing shortest paths. To solve it, we need to devise a special-purpose column generation method. To speed up the solution process, we further propose additional provably strengthening constraints. Now having the means to yield true optimal solutions for (small) practical instances, we can for the first time give an in-depth experimental evaluation that includes the absolute quality intrinsic to the above simplifying algorithms. It turns out that the arguably simplest method--first computing a routing, fixing it, and turning off all superfluous connections--yields solutions surprisingly close to the true optimum in practice. When considering multiple different traffic demands, a recent traffic-oblivious approach (TOCA) performs best, while being comparatively straightforward to implement.

AI.tldr: The paper addresses energy-efficient network design by simultaneously solving network deactivation and shortest path routing. They develop a novel ILP with column generation to solve the combined problem exactly, providing the first experimental benchmark. Results show simple heuristics are near-optimal in practice, with TOCA performing best for diverse traffic scenarios.
AI.motivation: Current green traffic engineering methods fail to solve the combined network design + routing problem for shortest path routing (the most common paradigm). Existing approaches either ignore capacities, assume static routing during deactivation, or solve sub-problems sequentially with estimators instead of the actual routing protocol.
AI.method: Novel integer linear programming model with dynamically changing shortest paths, solved via special-purpose column generation and additional strengthening constraints.
AI.result: First exact solutions for small practical instances; experimental evaluation reveals simple fixed-routing methods produce surprisingly close-to-optimal results. TOCA approach excels when handling multiple traffic demands.
AI.conclusion: Simple heuristic methods (fixing routing then deactivating connections) achieve near-optimal solutions in practice; TOCA performs best for multiple traffic demands while being straightforward to implement.

title: Effective Knowledge Transfer for Multi-Task Recommendation Models
summary: The conversion rate (CVR) is a crucial metric for evaluating the effectiveness of platforms, as it quantifies the alignment of content with audience preferences. However, the limited nature of customers' conversion actions presents a significant challenge for training ranking models effectively. In this paper, we propose an Effective Knowledge Transfer method for Multi-task Recommendation Models (EKTM). This method enables the ranking model to learn from diverse user behaviors, thereby enhancing performance through the transfer of knowledge across distinct yet related tasks. Each specific CVR task can directly benefit from the insights provided by other tasks. To achieve this, we first introduce a router module that integrates and disseminates knowledge across tasks. Subsequently, each CVR task is equipped with a transmitter module that facilitates the transformation of knowledge from the router. Additionally, we propose an enhanced module to ensure that the transferred knowledge benefit the original task learning. Extensive experiments on several benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches. Online A/B testing on a commercial platform has validated the effectiveness of the EKTM algorithm in large-scale industrial settings, resulting in a 3.93% uplift in effective Cost Per Mille (eCPM). The algorithm has since been fully deployed across two of the platform's main-traffic scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EKTM方法解决多任务推荐系统中转化率预测的数据稀疏问题，通过路由器-发射器架构实现跨任务知识迁移，在基准数据集和商业平台上均验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 转化率(CVR)是衡量平台有效性的关键指标，但用户转化行为数据有限，给排序模型训练带来重大挑战。现有方法难以有效利用跨任务知识来提升CVR预测性能。
AI.method: 提出EKTM方法，包含三个核心模块：1)路由器模块用于整合和传播跨任务知识；2)发射器模块将知识从路由器转换到各CVR任务；3)增强模块确保迁移知识真正有益于目标任务学习。
AI.result: 所提方法在多个基准数据集上优于现有最先进方法，线上A/B测试验证了工业级有效性，eCPM提升3.93%。
AI.conclusion: 实验在多个基准数据集上进行，线上A/B测试在商业平台上验证了有效性，eCPM提升3.93%，已在平台主要流量场景全面部署。

title: From Chat to Interview: Agentic Requirements Elicitation with an Experience Ontology
summary: Requirements elicitation interviews are crucial and time-consuming in requirements engineering, but heavily rely on the experience of requirements analysts. Although recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have created new opportunities to automate this process, existing approaches rely solely on LLMs for free-form chat without taking into account the interview and development experience. That leads to the omission of implicit requirements and redundant questions. Practically, experienced analysts implicitly follow a structured cognitive framework when conducting requirements elicitation. Inspired by this observation, this paper proposes an interview agent named OntoAgent for the elicitation of requirements guided by an experience ontology. OntoAgent automatically analyzes domain-specific requirements descriptions to construct an experience ontology, which organizes requirements concerns into an ontology to support systematic and explainable interviews. During the interview, OntoAgent first performs four operations (i.e., ParseUser, ScoreOnto, ReRankOnto, GatePrune) guided by the ontology to identify the relevant requirement concerns. The selected concern is then combined with the current dialogue context to generate the elicitation question. To validate OntoAgent, we conduct comprehensive quantitative experiments using the widely adopted website application domain. The results show that OntoAgent significantly outperforms existing baselines in both elicitation effectiveness and questioning efficiency, achieving a 33% improvement in IRE and a 21% improvement in TKQR. Ablation studies further validate the contribution of each key design component. In addition, a qualitative user study demonstrates its practical advantages in real-world scenarios. We believe that OntoAgent can also be extended to requirements interview tasks in other domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OntoAgent——一个由"经验本体"（experience ontology）引导的需求 elicitation（需求获取）访谈智能体。它从领域需求文本中自动归纳出"aspect（方面）–dimension（维度）–slot（细化槽位）"三级本体树，并在多轮访谈中通过 ParseUser、ScoreOnto、ReRankOnto、GatePrune、QuestionGen 五个操作动态选择最相关且尚未被充分探索的需求槽位，从而把 LLM 的"自由闲聊式提问"转变为结构化、可解释的系统访谈。在 ReqElicitGym 的 101 个 Web 应用场景上，IRE 达 0.69（较最佳基线相对提升 33%），TKQR 达 0.59（提升 21%）；风格类需求提升尤为显著（0.17→0.55）。
AI.motivation: 需求获取访谈是需求工程的核心环节，但高度依赖资深需求分析师的经验，耗时且成本高，并易受人类偏见与沟通误解影响，导致需求不完整或含糊。已有基于 LLM 的自动化尝试（如 LLMREI、ReqElicitGym 中的经验研究）均采用"自由形式聊天"（free-form chat），缺少对访谈与开发经验的显式建模，导致两大缺陷：(1) 难以挖掘隐式需求；(2) 早期对话易生成泛泛而谈的通用问题。此外，此类方法生成的问题缺乏可解释性与可控性，难以纳入 human-in-the-loop 监督。作者观察到经验丰富的分析师在访谈中隐式遵循一套结构化的认知框架：从高层 aspect（如 Interaction、Content）逐步收敛到具体 dimension（如 Search、Display），最终落到可澄清的实现细节（slot，如搜索机制、报告格式），形成层次化扩展的连贯提问流。作者将这种隐式的结构化知识称为"经验本体"，以此作为改进动机。
AI.method: OntoAgent 由两阶段组成。①经验本体归纳：定义三级树 T=(A,D,S,π_D,π_S)，aspect 层由领域专家给定（如 interaction/content/style）以保证稳定性；dimension 层用 LLM 以"逐步扩展"方式从需求文本中提取，采用"合并优先于新增"的保守策略（提示词 P_d）以保持粒度一致；slot 层在维度下抽取可直接澄清的细粒度需求项 S=⟨k,q⟩（k 为归一化需求项，q 为候选澄清问题），语义冲突时保留更短更一般的表述（提示词 P_s），并按细化程度区分疑问形式（仅提及用"是否需要…"二值确认，已有部分约束用"什么…"开放细化）。②本体引导访谈：将访谈建模为本体约束的迭代决策循环，每轮先执行 ParseUser（解析用户回答，支持 aspect/dimension 两级的确认与剪枝判断）、ScoreOnto（对话开始前基于初始需求描述为本体节点赋初始优先级，避免固定树序导致早期偏题）、ReRankOnto（每轮依据最新对话历史在当前活跃分支内重排候选槽位）、GatePrune（aspect 级：同一 aspect 下连续 N 轮无新增需求则发起宏观确认问句，用户表示无更多需求即整体剪枝该分支；dimension 级：用户明确拒绝某维度（如不需要注册登录）则立即剪除其下槽位），随后由 QuestionGen 结合选中槽位与对话上下文生成自然语言问题；直至无可选槽位或达到最大轮数 T。实验：RQ1 在 ReqElicitGym 的 101 个场景上对比 Non-CoT、CoT、LLMREI-short、LLMREI-long、Mistake-guided Prompt 五个自由形式基线；RQ2 增量消融四个核心模块（ParseUser 与 QuestionGen 因是流水线必需而不消融）；RQ3 换用 6 个不同骨干 LLM（Claude Opus 4.5、Gemini 3 Flash、DeepSeek V3.2、Kimi K2.5、GLM-4.7、Qwen3 235B）；RQ4 做 aspect 级 IRE 分解；RQ5 改变本体归纳数据规模（每类 5/10/15/20 场景）。指标为 IRE=|R̂|/|R| 与基于 DCG/IDCG 归一化的 TKQR（惩罚延迟与冗余提问）。本体归纳使用 WebGen-Bench 训练集，评测场景来自其测试集，确保无数据泄漏；所有 LLM 贪心解码，最大对话轮数统一为 20。另做 6 人被试的组内设计人工评测（Salon 与 Ski Resort 两个真实场景，7 点 Likert 量表，考察有效性、效率、适应性）。
AI.result: RQ1：OntoAgent 的 IRE=0.69，显著超过全部基线（最佳基线 Mistake-guided Prompt 为 0.52，相对提升 33%）；TKQR=0.59，超过最佳基线 LLMREI-short（0.49，相对提升 21%），说明不仅覆盖更多隐式需求，且更早命中关键需求。RQ2：Base LLM 0.13/0.09 → +Experience Ontology 0.41/0.34（贡献最大）→ +ScoreOnto 0.58/0.37 → +ReRankOnto 0.64/0.52 → +GatePrune 0.69/0.59，各模块均有独立贡献；剪枝在提升效率的同时不损害甚至提升覆盖率。RQ3：6 个骨干 LLM 下 IRE 介于 0.55–0.68、TKQR 介于 0.47–0.74（Claude Opus 4.5 获最高 TKQR 0.74，Qwen3 235B 获最高 IRE 0.68），最高与最低 IRE 差仅 0.13，表明框架对底层模型能力依赖弱、泛化性好。RQ4：aspect 级 IRE 为 interaction 0.74、content 0.64、style 0.55，三类全面领先；基线在 style 上几乎失效（Non-CoT/CoT <0.01，结构化提示基线仅 0.05/0.09/0.17），差距最大的正是 style。RQ5：归纳数据从 5 增至 15 时 IRE 由 0.69 升至 0.73，但增至 20 时 TKQR 由 0.60 降至 0.57，过大的本体扩展搜索空间、削弱早期问题聚焦性。人工评测：OntoAgent 在有效性 5.87、效率 5.79、适应性 6.12 上均优于基线，分别提升约 15%、10%、19%，p 值均显著小于 0.05（参与者仅 6 人，样本偏小，作者亦承认）。案例分析：前 3–5 轮即可快速收敛、最终覆盖率最高、中途停滞平台期更少。
AI.conclusion: 结论：显式地把访谈经验建模为层次化本体，并以此约束 LLM 的提问决策（而非依赖纯自由生成），可将 LLM 驱动的需求访谈从"闲聊式问答"转变为系统化、可解释、可控的访谈过程，能显著提升隐式需求覆盖与提问效率，且不依赖特定强模型、可迁移到 Web 之外的其他领域。作者认为"本体引导的 LLM 智能体"对推进自动化需求工程具有重要意义，并公开了代码、数据集与轻量工具以支持复现。需注意的局限：评测集中于 Web 应用域（外部效度依赖人工评测补充）、人工评测样本量小、风格类需求仍是相对薄弱项（0.55），且归纳数据规模与效率之间存在权衡。

title: Tackling the Data-Parallel Load Balancing Bottleneck in LLM Serving: Practical Online Routing at Scale
summary: Data-parallel (DP) load balancing has emerged as a first-order bottleneck in large-scale LLM serving. When a model is sharded across devices via tensor parallelism (TP) or expert parallelism (EP) and replicated across many DP workers, every decode step ends in a synchronization barrier whose latency is set by the most heavily loaded worker; even modest persistent imbalance across DP workers compounds, step after step, into a substantial fraction of wasted compute. The problem is hard for reasons specific to LLM decoding: assignments are sticky (migrating KV caches has a high cost), per-request loads grow over time, arrivals are non-stationary, and the router must decide within a sub-100\,ms decode budget over hundreds of waiting requests and tens of workers. We present \textbf{BalanceRoute}, a family of practical online routing algorithms that target this bottleneck. The first, \textbf{BR-0}, requires no prediction infrastructure and uses a piecewise-linear F-score that captures the sharp asymmetry between admissions that fill safe margin and those that overflow into the envelope; a two-stage decomposition keeps per-step cost compatible with millisecond-scale scheduling. The second, \textbf{BR-H}, generalizes BR-0 with a short, constant lookahead $H$ and a lightweight termination-classifier interface, extending the F-score to a horizon-discounted form. We deploy BalanceRoute on a 144-NPU cluster and evaluate against vLLM baselines on both a proprietary production trace and the public Azure-2024 trace. Across both workloads, BalanceRoute substantially reduces average DP imbalance and improves end-to-end serving throughput.

AI.tldr: 论文提出BalanceRoute系列在线路由算法解决大规模LLM推理中的数据并行负载均衡瓶颈。该算法通过分段线性F-score捕获请求接纳的收益-代价非对称性，支持无需预测基础设施的快速调度（BR-0）和带常数视界预测的增强版本（BR-H）。实验表明该方案能有效降低DP不平衡度并提升服务吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 在大规模LLM服务中，数据并行（DP）负载均衡已成为首要瓶颈。当模型通过张量并行（TP）或专家并行（EP）分片并跨多个DP worker复制时，每个解码步骤末尾的同步屏障延迟由负载最重的worker决定，即使 modest的持续不平衡也会在每一步中累积成大量计算浪费。
AI.method: 提出BalanceRoute算法族，包含两个变体：BR-0使用分段线性F-score捕获请求接纳的收益与溢出代价之间的非对称性，采用两阶段分解保证每步调度成本适用于毫秒级调度；BR-H引入常数视界H和轻量级终止分类器，将F-score扩展为视界折扣形式，实现更前瞻的负载预测。
AI.result: 在144-NPU集群上部署BalanceRoute，对比vLLM基线，在生产追踪和公开Azure-2024追踪上均显著降低了平均DP不平衡度，提升了端到端服务吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: BalanceRoute通过实用的在线路由算法有效解决了大规模LLM推理中的数据并行负载均衡瓶颈问题，在144-NPU集群上验证了其在生产环境和公开数据集上均能显著改善端到端服务吞吐量。

title: When2Speak: A Dataset for Temporal Participation and Turn-Taking in Multi-Party Conversations for Large Language Models
comment: Currently under review. Dataset can be found: https://huggingface.co/datasets/duke-trust-lab/When2Speak
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at generating contextually appropriate responses but remain poorly calibrated for multi-party conversations, where deciding when to speak is as critical as what to say. In such settings, naively responding at every turn leads to excessive interruptions and degraded conversational coherence. We introduce When2Speak, a grounded synthetic dataset and four-stage generation pipeline for learning intervention timing in group interactions. The dataset comprises over 215,000 examples derived from 16,000 conversations involving 2-6 speakers, spanning diverse conversational styles, tones, and participant dynamics, and explicitly modeling SPEAK vs. SILENT decisions at each turn. Our pipeline combines real-world grounding, structured augmentation, controlled transcript synthesis, and fine-tuning-ready supervision, and is fully open-sourced to support reproducibility and adaptation to domain-specific conversational norms. Across multiple model families, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on When2Speak significantly outperforms zero-shot baselines (e.g., the average Macro F1 increase across 4B+ parameter models was 60%, with the largest increase being 120%). However, SFT-trained models remain systematically over-conservative, missing nearly half of warranted interventions as seen through the Missed Intervention Rate (MIR), which was on average 0.50 and is noticed even at larger model sizes. To address this limitation, we apply reinforcement learning with asymmetric reward shaping, which reduces MIR to 0.186-0.218 and increases recall from 0.479 to 0.78-0.81. Our findings establish that temporal participation is a distinct and trainable dimension of conversational intelligence, and that grounded synthetic data provides an effective and scalable pathway for enabling LLMs to participate more naturally and appropriately in multi-party interactions.
