AI.tldr: When2Speak 数据集和 pipeline 用于训练 LLMs 的介入时机决策能力，涵盖 215,000+ 多方对话示例；SFT 可显著提升性能但存在过度保守问题，结合非对称奖励塑形的 RL 可有效缓解该缺陷，证明时间参与性是可训练的会话智能维度。
AI.motivation: LLMs 在多方对话场景中存在严重的行为失准：它们倾向于在每个轮次都响应，导致过度打断和对话连贯性下降——在多参与者交互中，何时发言与说什么同等关键。
AI.method: 提出了 When2Speak 数据集（215,000+ 示例，来自 16,000 段 2-6 人对话）和四阶段生成 pipeline（真实世界 grounding、结构化增强、受控转录合成、微调就绪监督）；采用监督微调（SFT）和带非对称奖励塑形的强化学习（RL）两种训练策略。
AI.result: SFT 相比 zero-shot 基线显著提升（4B+ 参数模型 Macro F1 平均提升 60%，最大达 120%），但模型仍系统性过度保守（MIR~0.50，漏判近半数应介入时刻）；引入 RL 后 MIR 降至 0.186-0.218，召回率从 0.479 提升至 0.78-0.81。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，时间参与性是会话智能的一个独特且可训练的维度， grounded synthetic data 为 enable LLMs 在多方对话中更自然、更恰当地参与提供了有效且可扩展的途径。

title: LaTA: A Drop-in, FERPA-Compliant Local-LLM Autograder for Upper-Division STEM Coursework
summary: Large-language-model (LLM) graders promise to relieve the grading burden of upper-division STEM courses, but most deployments to date send student work to third-party APIs, violating FERPA and exposing institutions to data risk while requiring substantial assignment modification. We present $\textbf{LaTA}\ (\textit{LaTeX Teaching Assistant})$, a drop-in, open-source autograder that runs entirely on commodity on-premises hardware and assumes a LaTeX-native workflow already adopted by many engineering and physics courses. LaTA implements a four-stage pipeline (ingest, segment, grade, report) using a locally hosted open-weight chain-of-thought LLM grader (gpt-oss:120b) that compares student work to an instructor-authored reference solution and applies a YAML rubric with binary per-item scoring. We deployed LaTA in Winter~2026 in ME 373 (Mechanical Engineering Methods) at Oregon State University, grading every weekly assignment for approximately 200 students on a single Mac Studio at \$0 marginal cost per assignment and 1--3 minutes of wall-clock time per submission, enabling regrading of corrected assignments and greatly expanded TA office hour offerings. The instructor-confirmed grading-error rate held at roughly $0.02$--$0.04\%$ per rubric line item across the term. Relative to the same instructor's previous traditionally-graded cohort, the LaTA-graded cohort outperformed by approximately $11\%$ on the midterm exam and $8\%$ on the final exam, and reported large gains in self-assessed confidence on every stated learning objective ($N = 159$ survey responses, $Δ\geq +1.49$ Likert points, $p < 10^{-27}$ on every comparison). We release the code under AGPLv3.

AI.tldr: LaTA是一个本地化、开源的LLM自动评分系统，专为LaTeX工作流的STEM课程设计，部署于俄勒冈州立大学ME 373课程（约200名学生），实现了零边际成本、快速评分（1-3分钟），并显著提升了学生成绩和自信心。
AI.motivation: 高等STEM课程的评分负担繁重，现有的LLM评分方案通常依赖第三方API，存在FERPA违规和数据风险，且需大幅修改作业形式。本研究旨在提供一个可直接集成、无需修改作业的本地化自动评分解决方案。
AI.method: LaTA采用四阶段流水线（摄入、分割、评分、报告），使用本地托管的开源链式思维LLM（gpt-oss:120b），将学生作业与教师编写的参考答案对比，并依据YAML格式的评分标准（每项二元评分）进行评分。
AI.result: 在俄勒冈州立大学的部署中，一台Mac Studio即可支撑约200名学生的每周作业评分，边际成本为零，每份提交物耗时1-3分钟，评分错误率仅0.02%-0.04%。LaTA评分组学生在期中考试中表现优于传统评分组约11%，期末考试高约8%，且学生在所有学习目标上的自信评分显著提升（N=159，Δ≥+1.49 Likert点，所有比较p<10⁻²⁷）。
AI.conclusion: LaTA证明了本地化LLM自动评分在保护数据隐私、降低部署成本的前提下，不仅能有效减轻评分负担，还可提升学生学习成果和自信心，为高等教育中的AI辅助教学提供了可行且有效的范式。

title: Adaptive Computation Depth via Learned Token Routing in Transformers
summary: Standard transformer architectures apply the same number of layers to every token regardless of contextual difficulty. We present Token-Selective Attention (TSA), a learned per-token gate on residual updates between consecutive transformer blocks. Each gate is a lightweight two-layer multi-layer perceptron (MLP) that produces a continuous halting probability, making the mechanism end-to-end differentiable with 1.7% parameter overhead and no changes to the base architecture. Notably, TSA learns difficulty-proportional routing without any explicit depth pressure: even at $λ=0$ (no depth regularisation), the task-loss gradient alone drives the router to skip 20% of token-layer operations. On character-level language modeling, TSA saved 14-23% of token-layer operations (TLOps) across Tiny-Shakespeare and enwik8 at <0.5% quality loss. At matched efficiency, TSA achieved 0.7% lower validation loss than early exit, and the learned routing transfers directly to inference-time sparse execution for real wall-clock speedup.

AI.tldr: TSA introduces learnable per-token gates that adaptively skip transformer layers based on token difficulty, reducing computational cost by 14-23% with negligible quality loss. The approach is parameter-efficient (1.7% overhead), differentiable, and transfers to inference for real speedups.
AI.motivation: Standard transformers apply uniform layer depth to all tokens despite varying contextual difficulty. This inefficiency creates computational overhead for tokens requiring fewer processing steps.
AI.method: Token-Selective Attention (TSA) uses lightweight two-layer MLP routers to generate continuous halting probabilities for each token at each layer, enabling differentiable adaptive skip of token-layer operations. No architectural changes or explicit depth pressure required.
AI.result: Learns difficulty-proportional routing (20% skip at λ=0); achieves 14-23% TLOp reduction on character-level LM with <0.5% quality loss; outperforms early exit by 0.7% lower validation loss at matched efficiency; enables inference speedup via sparse execution.
AI.conclusion: TSA provides an efficient mechanism for adaptive computation in transformers, achieving 14-23% TLOp reduction with minimal quality degradation. The learned routing transfers to inference, enabling real wall-clock speedups, and outperforms early exit strategies at matched efficiency.

title: Recursive Agent Optimization
summary: We introduce Recursive Agent Optimization (RAO), a reinforcement learning approach for training recursive agents: agents that can spawn and delegate sub-tasks to new instantiations of themselves recursively. Recursive agents implement an inference-time scaling algorithm that naturally allows agents to scale to longer contexts and generalize to more difficult problems via divide-and-conquer. RAO provides a method to train models to best take advantage of such recursive inference, teaching agents when and how to delegate and communicate. We find that recursive agents trained in this way enjoy better training efficiency, can scale to tasks that go beyond the model's context window, generalize to tasks much harder than the ones the agent was trained on, and can enjoy reduced wall-clock time compared to single-agent systems.

AI.tldr: Recursive Agent Optimization (RAO) 是一种端到端强化学习方法，用同一个共享 LLM 策略在递归生成的执行树所有节点上训练，使智能体学会「何时委派、如何委派、如何通信与聚合」。核心是节点局部奖励（自身成功 + 基于子节点成功率的委派奖励）、基于根奖励的 leave-one-out 基线、以及深度级逆频率加权的多深度加权策略梯度目标。实验表明递归智能体可解决超出上下文窗口的任务、泛化到远难于训练集的任务、训练效率更高，并借助并发委派把墙钟时间最多缩短 2.5×，优于 best-of-k 与 chain-of-agents 等推理时脚手架。
AI.motivation: 现有递归/多智能体系统（ADaPT、THREAD、ReDel、RLMs、Claude Code/Codex 等）大多把递归仅作为包裹在预训练模型外的推理时脚手架，模型本身没有被训练去决定何时委派、如何构造子任务、如何跨层级通信与聚合结果。同时 LLM 智能体任务日益呈现长时程、大工作记忆、可分解探索的特点，需要一种训练信号把「推理时扩展」与「模型能力」打通。此外，若完整递归 rollout 成本过高，也需要新的代理采样与信用分配方案。作者由此提出两个核心问题：如何训练模型以有效利用递归推理？如何利用推理的递归结构反哺训练效率？
AI.method: 智能体实现为 CodeAct 风格的 Python REPL 智能体（自然语言推理 + 代码执行），在动作空间中新增异步函数 launch_subagent(goal, ...) -> Any，父智能体可用普通 Python 控制流串行或用 asyncio.gather 并发调用，并自由聚合返回对象（不限返回类型）。一次 rollout 形成一棵动态生成的执行树，每个节点是一个策略实例。RAO 在该树上联合训练所有节点：(1) 节点局部奖励 R(X,τ)=s̃(X,τ)+λ·(1/|C(X)|)Σ_{c∈C(X)} s̃(c,τ_c)，即自身任务成功信号加上基于子节点「成功率」的委派奖励（用率而非计数以避免刷分式多开子代理）；s̃ 可来自精确验证器、LLM 裁判或根任务代理信号。(2) 优势用根奖励的 leave-one-out 基线 A(τ)=R(τ)−b_{−g}，并证明其对根与子代理轨迹均无偏（附录 A.3）。(3) 目标 J(θ) 在根任务分布 D_0 与策略自生成的各深度子任务分布 D_d(θ) 上取平均，形成自诱导课程；由于各深度轨迹数量不均，采用深度级逆频率权重 w_d=N/((D+1)N_d) 使每个深度总权重相等并保持更新尺度。(4) 训练采用异步 RL（AReaL/Tinker 后端）、CISPO 风格目标、组大小 8、批量 16、允许 3 个批次的陈旧性；设置递归深度上限与每实例步数上限。
AI.result: TextCraft-Synth（Qwen-3-4B，仅训 medium）：8K 上下文设定下递归 vs 单智能体总体 SR 0.95 vs 0.24，hard 0.88 vs 0.0；40K/256K 设定下总体 0.96 vs 0.73，hard 0.88 vs 0.20，且递归在 medium/hard 上快 1.8×/2.5×（步数更多）。Oolong-Real（Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B，训练 32K、评估 256K）：平均奖励 0.320 vs 0.203，175K 桶 0.249 vs 0.129，接近 Claude-Sonnet-4/o3/GPT-5-mini 水平；递归比单智能体慢 14×，因后者靠快速但不准的正则启发式。DeepDive（Qwen-3-4B）：成功率 0.40 vs 0.24，但慢 18×（任务为串行依赖子问题，仅 1.6% 委派并发，TextCraft 中为 83.9%）。附加基线：递归优于 Pass@k/Best@k（用更少步数，2.6×–3.3×）与 chain-of-agents（0.203）。消融：稠密奖励+加权 0.89 > 稠密无权重 0.75 > 稀疏有权重 0.79 > 稀疏无权重 0.61；「成功计数」委派奖励会引发奖励作弊（子代理数与步时无控上升、成功率在 40 步后崩塌），「成功率」奖励训练稳定。ART-E 简单任务上 RAO 仅早期加速，后期与单智能体持平。
AI.conclusion: 递归是强大的推理时扩展原语：它提供全新上下文窗口、分而治之结构、自适应测试时计算分配与并行执行机会。核心原则是「推理时脚手架不应只围绕模型设计，模型应被训练去使用它」。RAO 是首个同时具备深度>1 递归、端到端 RL、异步子代理执行、根与子代理联合训练、并在复杂真实智能体任务上评测的框架。局限与未来方向：递归 agent 在 Oolong-Real、DeepDive 上因长程策略而 token/时间开销更高；递归收益主要出现在困难或长时程任务（ART-E 简单任务上无持久优势）；尚需跨域通用递归智能体、异构递归（强弱模型协作）、对「任务异质性」（检索/验证/实现/调试/综合等异质子任务）的刻画，以及当完整递归 rollout 过于昂贵时的代理采样（surrogate sampling）流程与数据混合/目标设计。

title: On the Parameterized Approximability of (Mergeable) Sum of Radii Clustering
summary:
The sum of radii problem ($k$-MSR) asks, given a metric space on $n$ points, to place $k$ balls covering all points so as to minimize the sum of their radii. Despite extensive study from the perspectives of approximation and parameterized algorithms, the exact parameterized complexity of the problem and the existence of efficient parameterized approximation schemes remained open. We advance this understanding on both the hardness and algorithmic fronts.
  We begin by showing that $k$-MSR is $W[2]$-hard parameterized by $k$, thereby pinpointing its location in the $W$-hierarchy. Moreover, via our reduction, we rule out efficient parameterized approximation schemes (EPAS)--that is, $(1+ε)$-approximations running in time $f(k,ε)\cdot \mathrm{poly}(n)$--unless $W[2] = FPT$. Assuming the Exponential Time Hypothesis, we further rule out such algorithms running in time $f(k,ε)\cdot n^{o(k)}$, strengthening recent lower bounds for the problem.
  On the algorithmic side, we study $k$-MSR under the framework of mergeable constraints, which captures a broad class of clustering constraints, including fairness, diversity, and lower bounds. We obtain an FPT $(\frac{8}{3}+ε)$-approximation, improving upon the previous best guarantee of $(4+ε)$. Moreover, given access to a suitable assignment subroutine, we achieve a $(2+ε)$-approximation, matching the best known bound for the unconstrained problem. This, in turn, yields $(2+ε)$ FPT-approximations for several important settings, including $(t,k)$-fair, $(α,β)$-fair, $\ell$-diversity, and private clustering.

AI.tldr: 本文研究k-center型聚类问题k-MSR的参数化复杂性与近似算法。证明该问题为W[2]-hard，排除了高效参数化近似方案的存在，并给出FPT (8/3+ε)-近似算法，在特定约束下可达(2+ε)近似比。
AI.motivation: k-MSR问题虽已有近似算法和参数化算法的研究，但其精确的参数化复杂性分类（尤其是在W层次中的位置）以及是否存在高效参数化近似方案（EPAS）仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 在计算复杂性方面，通过W[2]-hard性规约证明下界；在算法方面，采用可合并约束框架，设计了基于分解的FPT近似算法，改进近似比为(8/3+ε)。
AI.result: 证明k-MSR是W[2]-hard的，排除了EPAS的存在（除非W[2]=FPT），并排除了在f(k,ε)·n^{o(k)}时间内存在(1+ε)-近似的可能（假设ETH）。算法上，给出FPT (8/3+ε)-近似，改进原有(4+ε)的结果；在合适赋值子程序下可达(2+ε)-近似。
AI.conclusion: 本研究在k-MSR问题的参数复杂性研究中取得重要进展，确立了W[2]-hardness的上界，证明了不存在高效参数化近似方案的边界，并给出FPT近似算法的改进。该工作为该问题的后续研究提供了理论框架和算法方向。

title: Beyond Long Tail POIs: Transition-Centered Generalization for Human Mobility Prediction
summary: Human mobility prediction forecasts a user's next Point of Interest (POI) from historical trajectories, supporting applications from recommendation to urban planning. Recent studies have recognized the problem with long-tail POIs in human mobility prediction, which are POIs with few visit records, making new visits to such POIs difficult to predict. Our analysis shows that many predictions fail even for visits to popular POIs. The underlying cause is often transition-level sparsity: the corresponding source-destination transition appears rarely, or never appears, in the training set. We therefore argue that a core bottleneck in human mobility prediction lies in transition-level long-tail generalization. We formulate this problem as compositional generalization and propose a tRansition rEconstruction framework for Compositional generAlization in next-POI prediction (RECAP). RECAP reconstructs long-tail transitions from two generalizable signals: multi-hop transitivity in the global transition graph and revisit evidence from a user's historical trajectory. It further uses warm-transition holdout training to discourage memorization of frequent transitions and encourage generalization from transferable signals. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that RECAP consistently improves prediction accuracy, with clear gains on tail transitions.

AI.tldr: 论文将“下一 POI 预测”的长尾问题从**目标 POI 级**重新定义为**转移级（源→目标对）**：即使目标 POI 很热门，只要该“源 POI→目标 POI”在训练集中罕见或从未出现，模型仍会预测失败。据此提出 RECAP（REtrieval Combined with pArametric memory），一个仅含 2 层 Transformer 的轻量模型：以参数记忆高频转移，并从两路可迁移证据中检索尾部转移证据——(1) 用户历史重访打分器（revisit scorer，用 6 个统计量在当前上下文中打分）；(2) 全局转移图的多跳传递补全 token（transitive completion token）；再配合两阶段训练让打分器也能从高频转移中学习。在 NYC/TKY/CA 三个签到数据集上全面超越 SOTA，尾部与未见转移提升尤为显著，且推理开销远低于 LLM 类方法。
AI.motivation:
1) 现有文献普遍默认“热门 POI 易预测”，作者用 LoTNext 在 NYC 的失败案例反驳：该模型对高访问频次的 Bus Station 排到第 99 百分位，原因是真值转移 Coffee Shop→Bus Station 在训练集中根本不存在，而错误转移 Coffee Shop→Bakery 出现过多次——说明真正瓶颈是**转移级稀疏**而非目标 POI 频次。
2) 分组统计显示：HR@20 与转移在训练集中的出现频率的相关性显著强于与目标 POI 频次的相关性；转移频次分布高度长尾（训练中仅出现 0–1 次的转移占 NYC/TKY/CA 唯一测试转移的 77.9%/65.4%/82.1%）。
3) 但尾部转移并非无据可依：NYC 验证集中 72.3% 的尾部转移其目标曾出现在用户历史中（可重访证据），且其他用户轨迹常以多跳路径连接其源与目标（传递补全证据）；而人类移动规律（重复访问、约 20–25% 的移动为新地点、人在任一时刻保持约 25 个熟悉地点）也支持显式利用历史统计而非仅喂给序列编码器。
4) 由此提出两个耦合挑战：(a) 如何有效检索并使用尾部转移的证据（历史重访 vs. 多跳传递补全）；(b) 如何平衡参数记忆与检索——重访证据必须置于当前上下文（当前 POI、距上次访问时间）下判断，且该组件难以与主干联合训练（主干已把高频样本排好，其梯度 π(d)−1[d=y] 趋近 0，导致打分器缺乏训练信号）。
AI.method:
**问题形式化**：对测试转移 (s_t, y_t)，训练中相邻签到对出现次数 m_{s_t,y_t}=0 称 unseen，≤η(=1) 称 tail，≥2 称 head（head/tail 划分仅用于评测分组，不影响模型设计与预测）。

**主干（参数化记忆）**：轨迹按时间间隔切分为子轨迹，取观测历史最近 k=10 个签到为序列；每个签到 token = MLP([POI-ID emb; 类别 emb; 坐标])；输入序列拼接可学习 user token 与图 token g_t，加位置编码后送入 2 层 Transformer（hidden 256，4 头，FFN 512），对全部候选 POI 计算 ℓ_core(d)=w_dᵀh_t+b_d。频繁转移的训练样本构成模型的“参数化记忆”。

**(1) 多跳转移图编码**：由训练集构建有向转移图，行归一化邻接 A；在 POI embedding 矩阵上做 N=2 跳传播 G^(i+1)=A G^(i)，取当前源 POI 行经 MLP_graph + LayerNorm 得图 token g_t，注入 Transformer 输入，为“不在用户历史中的目标”提供传递补全证据（s→p′→d 的二跳路径可支撑缺失的直接边）。N 按验证集上未见转移的信噪比 SNR_N=S_N/(M_N−S_N) 选取：N=2 时 SNR 最高（4.195/1.800/2.593），N=3 候选数暴增 4.9–8.3 倍而多数为噪声。

**(2) 用户历史重访打分器**：对候选集 C_t（用户至 t 步访问过的 POI，含当前源点）计算 6 个统计量——长期关系组 c1=访问占比、c2=首末访问间隔天数；当前上下文组 c3=从 s_t 出发的移动中流向 d 的份额、c4=s_t 与 d 的 L2 距离、c5=从与 s_t 同类别的 POI 流入 d 的次数、c6=距上次访问 d 的小时数。经 3 层 GELU MLP（跨用户/POI 共享，隐藏宽 64）打分，softmax 得重访分布 π_rev。

**(3) 分数融合**：仅对已访问 POI 调整 ℓ(d)=ℓ_core(d)+λ·log(1+K_t·π_rev(d))，K_t=|C_t| 用于跨用户尺度归一，log 内 +1 保证调整非负（不被看好的 POI 基本保留原分），λ 依验证 HR@1 选取（NYC 12、TKY 8、CA 24）。

**(4) 两阶段训练**：第一阶段在全部训练样本上以全 POI 交叉熵训练主干（含图 token）；第二阶段冻结主干，仅在 D_rev={t: y_t∈C_t}（目标在历史中的样本，主要是高频转移）上用独立损失 L_rev=−log π_rev(y_t) 训练打分器，使梯度 π_rev(y)−1 保持较大、避免被主干掩盖。因 L_rev 不依赖主干，两阶段亦可并行。

**评测协议**：NYC/TKY/CA 按 8:1:1 时间划分，轨迹中除首个签到外的每个签到均为测试样本，所有方法在同一批样本上评测，指标 HR@{1,10,20} 与 NDCG@{10,20}，3 个随机种子取均值。
AI.result:
**总体性能（Table 2）**：RECAP 在 3 数据集 × 5 指标全部第一，相对各列最佳基线提升 7.1%–23.5%；HR@1 提升最大（NYC +23.5%、TKY +10.7%、CA +23.0%），随 K 增大增益递减，说明改进集中在首位预测。种子间标准差 ≤0.0024，最小增益（0.0266）远超其 10 倍，Welch t 检验 p<0.01。最强基线为 K1-POI（15 列中 12 列最佳），但其仅依赖当前 POI，本质是记忆转移，对未见转移弱；LLM 类（GNPR-SID 等）HR@1 接近最优但逐 token 生成、候选集中于输入历史中的 POI，HR@20 明显落后；POI 级长尾方法（LoTNext、DePOI、ALOHA）整体弱于转移级建模。

**尾部/未见转移（Table 4）**：RECAP 在三数据集的 tail HR@1/HR@20 与 CA 的全部 unseen 指标最佳；tail HR@20 相对最优基线提升 17.1%/23.3%/20.8%，unseen HR@20 提升 21.1%/27.8%/35.4%（如 TKY unseen HR@20 0.5265 vs LLM4POI 0.3738）。唯一例外是 CA 上 unseen HR@1 略低于最佳基线（−7.3%）。

**消融（Table 3）**：backbone→+图 token→+打分器逐步提升（打分器贡献最大，如 NYC H@20 0.7170→0.8025）；联合训练劣于两阶段（验证了梯度分析）；去掉“当前上下文”组统计下降幅度大于去掉“长期关系”组（说明上下文条件化是主要增益来源）；线性打分器明显劣于 MLP（统计量需非线性组合）。

**机制分析**：重访目标上 RECAP HR@1 最佳，且明显优于“最常访问 POI”规则与 ALOHA/STHGCN；其 π_rev 曲面与真实重访率（在 c1 上递增、距上次访问约 1 天处峰值后回落）在形状上一致，线性打分器与 ALOHA 均偏离（低估计近 1 天内访问、高估计数周未访问）。未访问目标上，图 token 在 1–2 跳可达样本上提升 HR@20。λ 增大时总体 HR@1 上升后饱和，而未访问目标 HR@20 持续下降（已访问 POI 挤占 Top-20）；CA 上 λ=1 可将未访问目标 HR@20 从 0.066 提到 0.196、总体 HR@1 从 0.196 降到 0.175，图 token 贡献从 0.021 增至 0.068。

**效率（Table 8、Figure 6）**：RECAP 平均排名最优，训练 <1 小时、峰值 GPU 显存 <1.2GB、单次全测试集评测 <1 秒；LLM 基线每样本 0.1–3.4 秒、显存 25–53GB。

**误差分析**：NYC 8,775 个“目标为已访问 POI”的测试样本中，RECAP 的 top-1 错误总是另一个已访问 POI；低频访问目标（占比 ≤5%）占 33.3% 样本却贡献 45.4% 错误。**局限**：数据处理仅保留训练集出现过的用户/POI、单一城市建模，未覆盖冷启动（新 POI/新用户/新城市）；重访奖励系统性压低未访问目标排名，模型缺少“是否会重访”的判别机制；CA 上高频转移目标被挤出 Top-20 是 λ 的折中代价。
AI.conclusion:
论文的核心主张是：下一 POI 预测的关键故障线在**转移（source–destination 组合）**而非 POI 本身，长尾问题应从 item 级转移到 transition 级来定义、评测和建模。一个小 Transformer（2 层）+ 两种可迁移检索证据（用户历史重访统计 + 多跳转移图传递补全）+ 两阶段训练，即可在整体 HR/NDCG 上稳定超越超图模型与 POI 级长尾方法，并在尾部/未见转移上大幅领先，同时保持近乎线上的推理成本（亚秒级全量评测、<1.2GB 显存）。方法的价值在于其“可迁移证据 + 参数记忆”的分工：高频部分交给参数，稀疏部分交给检索，且检索证据必须在当前上下文（源点与时间）下条件化评分，并以独立损失训练以避免被参数记忆掩盖。

同时应指出两点局限与一处文本不一致：(1) 摘要（列表版）与 arXiv 正文标题/方法命名存在冲突——列表版称 “Transition-Centered Generalization”、框架为 “tRansition rEconstruction … (RECAP)” 并提及 “warm-transition holdout training”，而正文为 “Transition-Centered Modeling”、RECAP 展开为 “REtrieval Combined with pArametric memory” 并采用两阶段训练（含冻结主干的独立损失），两版摘要的方法描述并不一致，引用时应以正文版本为准；(2) 评测仍沿用既有数据处理（训练集内用户/POI、单城市），未验证冷启动与跨城迁移，尾部/未见转移的最严格场景仍待检验；(3) 重访加成的单向偏置使未访问目标被系统性降权，作者将“是否重访”的判别留作未来工作。

可延伸方向包括：把“是否重访”建模为显式判别/门控以消除对未访问目标的偏置；把转移级建模推广到新 POI、新用户、新城市的 OOD 泛化；以及在更细粒度的时间窗（多时段/周期性）与跨域迁移信号上扩展多跳图证据的检索机制。

title: On Fixing Insecure AI-Generated Code through Model Fine-Tuning and Prompting Strategies
summary: The security of AI-generated code remains a major obstacle to its widespread adoption. Although code generation models achieve strong performance on functional benchmarks, their outputs frequently contain bugs and security weaknesses that undermine their trustworthiness. Prior work has explored a range of approaches to mitigate security issues in AI-generated code, e.g., using static analysis-guided generation and prompt engineering. However, their effectiveness varies widely across models and settings. This paper presents a systematic investigation of strategies for hardening model-generated code against a list of Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE). We assess the extent to which these strategies improve security across models and programming languages, using fine-tuning and prompting approaches for model output refinement. Beyond the prevalence of security weaknesses, we analyse the severity of identified CWEs, their co-occurrence, and the unintended consequences of remediation (i.e., whether fixing certain weaknesses introduces new weaknesses elsewhere in the same code). Our results show that security improvements are highly strategy- and model-dependent. Although some approaches reduce specific classes of weaknesses, they often introduce new weaknesses as side effects of the fixes. Moreover, no strategy consistently eliminates weaknesses across all models and scenarios, highlighting the absence of a universally effective "bulletproof" solution for secure AI-generated code.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统性地调查了提升AI生成代码安全性的多种策略，评估其在不同模型和编程语言中的有效性。研究发现安全改进的效果高度依赖于具体策略和模型，且修复某些弱点可能引入新弱点，目前尚不存在通用的"防弹"解决方案。
AI.motivation: AI代码生成模型虽然在功能基准测试上表现良好，但其输出经常包含漏洞和安全弱点，这严重阻碍了AI生成代码的广泛采用。先前工作虽探索了静态分析引导生成和提示工程等方法，但在不同模型和设置下的效果差异显著。
AI.method: 采用微调（fine-tuning）和提示工程（prompting）两种方法对模型输出进行优化，通过系统性评估这些策略在跨模型和跨编程语言场景下对CWE安全性的改善效果。
AI.result: 安全改进高度依赖策略和模型选择；某些方法虽能减少特定类型的弱点，但常作为副作用引入新的弱点；未发现任何策略能在所有模型和场景中一致地消除弱点。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明没有任何策略能够在所有模型和场景中一致地消除弱点，凸显了安全AI生成代码领域缺乏通用有效的"防弹"解决方案。这一发现对推动AI代码生成的实用化部署具有重要的警示意义。

title: TACO: A Toolsuite for the Verification of Threshold Automata
summary: We present TACO, a toolsuite for the development and automatic verification of fault-tolerant and threshold-based distributed algorithms. Our toolsuite implements three approaches for model checking threshold automata in different decidable fragments known from the literature and two semi-decision procedures going beyond these decidable fragments. Moreover, TACO is a modular, extensible, and well-documented framework for developing algorithms and tools for threshold automata. We present important features, give an overview of the implemented algorithms, and evaluate their performance experimentally.

AI.tldr: TACO是一个用于开发与自动验证容错及阈值分布式算法的工具套件，实现了三种可判定片段的模型检查方法以及两种超越这些片段的半决策程序。该工具套件具有模块化、可扩展和文档完善的特点，并提供了算法概览与实验性能评估。
AI.motivation: 随着分布式系统的发展，对容错和基于阈值的分布式算法的正确性验证需求日益增长，自动化验证工具的缺乏限制了算法开发和验证的效率。
AI.method: 该工具套件实现了三种模型检查方法（用于已知的可判定片段）以及两种半决策程序（用于超出可判定范围的情况）。
AI.result: TACO提供了一个模块化、可扩展且文档完善的研究框架，成功实现了多种验证方法，并经过实验验证了性能。
AI.conclusion: TACO为阈值自动机的验证提供了从可判定到半可判定的完整工具链，是一个模块化、可扩展、文档完善的研究框架，并经过实验验证了性能表现。

title: One Turn Too Late: Response-Aware Defense Against Hidden Malicious Intent in Multi-Turn Dialogue
summary: Hidden malicious intent in multi-turn dialogue poses a growing threat to deployed large language models (LLMs). Rather than exposing a harmful objective in a single prompt, increasingly capable attackers can distribute their intent across multiple benign-looking turns. Recent studies show that even modern commercial models with advanced guardrails remain vulnerable to such attacks despite advances in safety alignment and external guardrails. In this work, we address this challenge by detecting the earliest turn at which delivering the candidate response would make the accumulated interaction sufficient to enable harmful action. This objective requires precise turn-level intervention that identifies the harm-enabling closure point while avoiding premature refusal of benign exploratory conversations. To further support training and evaluation, we construct the Multi-Turn Intent Dataset (MTID), which contains branching attack rollouts, matched benign hard negatives, and annotations of the earliest harm-enabling turns. We show that MTID helps enable a turn-level monitor TurnGate, which substantially outperforms existing baselines in harmful-intent detection while maintaining low over-refusal rates. TurnGate further generalizes across domains, attacker pipelines, and target models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Graph-COM/TurnGate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「回合级有害性闭合」监督范式：不再只判断对话是否有害，而是精确定位「释放当前候选回复后对话即足以支撑有害目标」的最早回合 t*。作者据此构建多轮意图数据集 MTID（8,000 条有害 + 8,000 条匹配良性难负样本，标注闭合回合），并训练响应感知监控器 TurnGate（Qwen3-4B），采用「加权 SFT 热启动 + 多轮强化学习（回合级过程奖励 + GAE + 裁剪/KL 目标）」。结果显示 TurnGate 在良恶性权衡（Harmful Score、F1）、在线自适应树搜索攻击 ASR 以及跨域/跨目标模型/跨攻击管线泛化上均优于现有护栏与多轮监控基线。
AI.motivation: 攻击者不再在单轮中暴露有害目标，而是将意图分散到多个看似良性的回合中逐步累积（如先问前驱物、再问反应条件、后问纯化细节），使每轮单独看均无害，但整体累积后具备可操作性，导致前沿商业模型即使配有安全对齐与外部护栏仍被攻破。既有方法缺少「何时干预」的监督：单轮护栏只看单条请求，看不到跨轮累积风险；对话级分类器虽可逐轮复用，但只有一个轨迹级标签，无法区分「及时阻断」「过早拒答」「过晚漏防」；仅基于用户查询的顺序监控器更无法判断回复内容是否补齐了有害信息。因此需要一个响应感知（同时观察历史与候选回复）、回合级的干预时机学习目标。
AI.method: 1) 问题形式化：三方交互（用户/基座助手/防御器），生成后、投递前介入，观测 x_t=(历史, q_t, r̃_t)，动作空间 {Pass, Block}；定义充分性算子 Suff(x_t,g) 与最早有害闭合回合 t*=min{t: Suff=1}（良性轨迹 t*=∞）。2) 将防御建模为代价敏感的停止问题：J(π) 包含良性不中断奖励 u_ben、精确命中奖励 u_hit、误报惩罚 c_fp、漏防惩罚 c_miss、以及依赖早期效用函数 φ(η;t*) 的过早阻断分级惩罚 c_early。3) 数据构建：改造 CKA 树搜索攻击框架，用 MCTS/UCT 生成自适应分支轨迹，官方评判器按四级 rubric（Refusal/Vacuous/Partial/Full Success）对每个累积前缀打 Full-Success 标签以确定 t*；以 WildJailbreak 匹配良性种子构造难负样本（t*=∞）；共 800 有害 + 800 良性种子，每种子 20 条 rollout = 16,000 条对话；用 Gemini-2.5-Flash 做 t* 两侧一致性复核（t* 充分、t*-1 不充分）。4) TurnGate：Qwen3-4B，按回合拆分为 (x_t, y_t) 样本，样本权重 ∝ |R_t| 的加权交叉熵 SFT 热启动；随后离线多轮 RL，过程奖励 R_t 区分 Pass-before-t*、Block-at-t*、早阻断、漏防、良性误报，用 GAE（γ、λ）计算优势，PPO 式裁剪目标 + 参考策略 KL 约束。5) 评测：离线按种子 70/15/15 划分，指标含 Benign Score、Miss、Early、ℓ1、Acc、三种 φ 变体下 Harmful Score 与 F1；在线闭环用 CKA 自适应攻击，报告 ASR（迭代预算 i∈{1,3,5}），并做基准/目标模型/攻击管线三重分布外泛化，以及化学↔网络安全跨域零样本迁移。
AI.result: 离线主表：现成护栏几乎对跨轮有害意图失明（Llama Guard 的 Harmful Score 约 0.002，合成增强版亦仅 0.008–0.141），虽保持高良性通过率；轨迹级 Naive-SFT 明显劣于回合级方法。TurnGate（Qwen3-4B）取得最佳整体权衡：Harmful Score_φ2=0.602、F1_φ2=0.699（Reweighted-SFT 热启动为 0.479/0.610；轨迹级 Naive-SFT 仅 0.532/0.568；Qwen Guard 0.139/0.269；GPT-5.2 Intention Analysis 0.287/0.416），精确闭合准确率由 34.3% 升至 41.4%，漏防率由 37.9% 降至 17.7%，良性通过率 0.834 保持较好。在线闭环：攻击预算 i=1 时 ASR 降至 0.26，i=5 时仍低于 0.68（Intention Analysis 约 0.77，Qwen Guard 退化至近无防御水平）。泛化：HarmBench/StrongReject/JBB 共 12 类中 10 类 ASR 下降（含 StrongReject 非法商品服务、JBB 身体伤害），从 GPT-5.2 生成数据零样本迁移到 Gemini-3.1-Pro 亦有效，对 Multi-Agent Jailbreak 管线可迁移；跨域 MTID（化学→网络安全）TurnGate 的 F1_φ2=0.543 优于所有基线，但低于域内上界（0.745），反向迁移 F1_φ2=0.578。附录案例显示只有 TurnGate 在有害案例精确阻断于 t*=3、在良性跨境贩毒社会学对话中全程不误拦。
AI.conclusion: 回合级「有害闭合」监督是区分过早拒答与及时干预的关键信号：仅轨迹级标签不足，turn-level 边界标注显著改善干预定位；在此基础上叠加多轮 RL 可进一步改善安全—效用权衡并显著降低闭环攻击成功率，且能跨风险领域、攻击管线与目标模型泛化，说明模型学到的是可迁移的回合级防御行为而非记忆特定攻击轨迹。局限：t* 本质是依赖评判器的经验估计（受攻击者先验知识与评判模型影响）；MTID 仅覆盖化学与网络安全两域、且来自模拟攻击流程，可能过拟合特定攻击规律；实验受算力限制统一使用 4B 骨干（更大模型未系统验证）；干预动作仅二元 Pass/Block，Block 即终止会话，尚不支持定向脱敏、安全替代回答或澄清式反问等更丰富干预，作者将其定位为分层防御栈（对齐、工具管控、人工监督）中的一个组件，并强调需配合隐私保护、透明度与申诉机制。

title: From History to State: Constant-Context Skill Learning for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to operate browsers, files, code and tools, making personal assistants a natural deployment target. Yet personal agents face a privacy-cost-capability tension: cloud models execute multi-step workflows well but expose sensitive intermediate context to external APIs, while local models preserve privacy but remain less reliable. Both settings also pay repeatedly for long skill prompts and growing histories. We propose constant-context skill learning, a context-to-weights framework for recurring agent workflows: reusable procedures are learned in lightweight task-family modules, while inference conditions only on the current observation and a compact state block. A deterministic tracker renders this state block from task progress and supplies aligned subgoal rewards, so each module can be trained with step-level SFT and refined through online RL. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld, our agents achieve strong performance across Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B. With Qwen3-8B, SFT+RL reaches 89.6\% unseen success on ALFWorld, 76.8\% success on WebShop, and 66.4\% unseen success on SciWorld. They match or exceed strong published agent-training results while reducing prompt tokens per turn by 2--7$\times$ relative to controlled ReAct prompting baselines, showing that procedural context can be moved from prompts into weights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"恒定上下文技能学习"框架，通过上下文到权重的转换方式解决个人AI助手的隐私-成本-能力三难困境。将可复用程序学习为轻量级任务模块，推理时仅依赖当前观测和紧凑状态块，显著降低每次交互的prompt token开销。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体面临隐私-成本-能力的权衡：云端模型能力强但暴露敏感上下文，本地模型保护隐私但可靠性不足；此外，长技能提示和不断增长的对话历史带来重复计算开销。本文旨在将程序性上下文从提示词转移到模型权重中。
AI.method: 1) 提出恒定上下文技能学习框架，采用上下文到权重(context-to-weights)范式；2) 设计轻量级任务家族模块学习可复用程序；3) 开发确定性追踪器渲染状态块并提供对齐的子目标奖励；4) 采用步级SFT微调并结合在线RL强化学习优化。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、SciWorld三个基准上，使用Qwen3-4B/8B和Llama-3.1-8B均取得优异表现。Qwen3-8B配合SFT+RL达到：ALFWorld 89.6% unseen success、WebShop 76.8% success、SciWorld 66.4% unseen success。每次交互的prompt tokens相比ReAct基线降低2-7倍。
AI.conclusion: 程序性上下文可从提示词转移到模型权重中。该框架在保持本地隐私保护优势的同时，通过技能模块化实现了与强云端方法相当或更优的性能，并有效降低了推理成本。

title: Structural Instability of Feature Composition
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for disentangling feature superposition in transformer-based architectures, enabling precise control via activation steering. However, the theoretical foundations of compositional steering -- the simultaneous activation of distinct semantic latents -- remain under-explored. The prevailing Linear Representation Hypothesis often abstracts away non-linear interference effects that arise in overcomplete dictionaries. We present a geometric framework for analyzing the instability of feature unions. Modeling the activation space as a high-dimensional sparse cone manifold, we derive an asymptotic compositional-collapse threshold under a spherical dictionary model, characterized by the Gaussian mean width (statistical dimension) of the signal cone. We further show that, in the high-bias regime, ReLU rectification converts microscopic correlation-induced variance fluctuations into a systematic drift that accumulates under composition, yielding interference growth consistent with a ratchet effect. We validate the predicted scaling trends on structured semantic features extracted from CLEVR, where hierarchical correlations accelerate the transition relative to random baselines. Together, our results highlight geometric constraints on the scalability of union-based steering and motivate composition mechanisms that explicitly manage interference beyond naive linear superposition.

AI.tldr: 本文从几何视角分析了稀疏自编码器中特征联合激活的不稳定性问题，揭示了过完备字典场景下组合 steering 的理论极限，为设计更鲁棒的组合控制机制提供了数学基础。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多基于线性表示假说，忽略了过完备字典中非线性干扰效应的影响；组合 steering（即同时激活多个语义潜变量）的理论根基尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 采用几何框架建模激活空间为高维稀疏锥流形；在球面字典模型下推导渐近组合崩溃阈值（由信号锥的高斯均值宽度/统计维度刻画）；分析ReLU非线性在关联特征空间中如何将微观方差波动转化为系统性漂移。
AI.result: 推导出稀疏锥流形在球面字典模型下的渐近组合崩溃阈值；发现在高偏差区域，ReLU整流导致微观关联方差波动累积为系统性漂移，形成类似棘轮效应的干扰增长；CLEVR实验验证了层级相关特征相比随机基线更快触发相变。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了基于联合激活的控制在过完备字典场景下的几何约束，指出简单线性叠加在组合场景中不可扩展，并呼吁设计能显式管理干扰的组合机制。该工作为特征空间的组合操作提供了理论基础，可能对可解释性研究和安全应用产生重要影响。

title: Fast decremental tree sums in forests
summary:
We study two fundamental decremental dynamic graph problems. In both problems, we need to maintain a vertex-weighted forest of size $n$ under edge deletions, weight updates, and a certain information-retrieval query. Both problems can be solved in $O(\log n)$ time per update/query using standard dynamic forest data structures like top trees, even if additionally edge insertions are allowed. We investigate whether the deletion-only problem can be solved faster.
  First, we consider $\texttt{tree-sum}$ queries, where we ask for the sum of vertex weights in one of the connected components (i.e., trees) in the forest. We give a data structure with $O(n)$ preprocessing time and $O(\log^* n)$ time per operation, based on a micro-macro tree decomposition (Alstrup et al., 1997). If the forest is unweighted (i.e., all weights are 1 and cannot be changed), then the operation time can be improved to $O(1)$.
  Additionally, we give an asymptotically universally optimal algorithm. More specifically, our algorithm works in the group model, and processes $m$ operations on an initial forest $F$ in running time $O( \mathrm{OPT}(F, m) )$. Here $\mathrm{OPT}(F, m)$ is the number of weight additions and subtractions that a best possible algorithm performs to handle a worst-case instance for a fixed initial forest $F$ and a fixed number $m$ of operations. We achieve this with a combination of the aforementioned decomposition technique, precomputation of optimal data structures for very small instances, and some insights into the behavior of $\mathrm{OPT}$. Note that even the worst-case complexity of this algorithm remains unknown to us.
  Second, we consider $\texttt{subtree-sum}$ queries. Here, the forest is rooted, and a query $\texttt{subtree-sum}(v)$ returns the sum of weights in the subtree rooted at $v$. We show tight bounds for several variants of this problem. [...]

AI.tldr: 本文研究"仅删边"的动态森林上两类顶点权聚合查询（tree-sum 与 subtree-sum），在 group model 下把一般情形从 O(log n) 推进到 O(log* n)（tree-sum，0-1 权时线性），并给出对 tree-sum 的通用最优算法 O(OPT(F,m)+n+m)；同时证明 subtree-sum 的加权版即使禁止改权也需 Ω(n log n)，而 0-1 权版的紧确界为 Θ(n log n / log log n)。
AI.motivation: 动态森林维护（link/cut tree、top tree）已能以 O(log n) 每次操作支持 cut、update-weight、tree-sum 与 subtree-sum，且 Pătraşcu–Demaine 证明该界在无权情形下也最优，故"仅删边"这一限制是打破对数下界的唯一希望。已有删边连通性结构（Alstrup–Secher–Spork）在 Word RAM 下可达 O(n+m) 线性时间，但其依赖位运算技巧，无法处理顶点权与权值聚合。因此本文追问：删边-only 条件下，带权森林的分量权值和（tree-sum）与有根子树权值和（subtree-sum）究竟能快到什么程度？以及在 group model（权值只能加减、不可比较）下能否做到通用最优（universally optimal，即与把初始森林与操作数硬编码进去的最优算法一样快）。
AI.method: 核心工具是改造后的"簇分解"（micro-macro tree decomposition，源自 Alstrup et al. 1997）：把二叉有根树划分为 O(n/k) 个大小 ≤k 的簇及一棵簇树，并把簇森林的维护规约到线性时间的删边连通性结构（Lemma 2.1–2.4）。(1) 基础算法 Alg_1（Lemma 3.1）：显式维护父子指针 + root 查询，tree-sum 与 update-weight 均 O(1)，仅 cut 摊还 O(log n)。(2) 迭代提升（Lemma 3.2）：把该算法逐层套在簇分解上，每层总代价 O(n)，迭代 log* n 层得 O((m+n)log* n)（Thm 1.1）。(3) 0-1 权情形（Lemma 4.1）：把大小 ≤ log log n 的簇的全部 0-1 森林状态编码进一个机器字并预计算全局查表，递归两次得 O(m+n)（Thm 1.2）。(4) 最优算法（Sec. 5）：引入"计算树"（Appendix A，类似决策树但针对 group model 的在线问题），证明 OPT_CT(F,m)=OPT(F,m)，暴力枚举可得小树的最优结构；再做三层簇分解（簇大小 log log log n）并结合 OPT 的弱超可加性（Lemma 5.4–5.7，通过凸子集、零初始化 OPTZ 与"把 m 放大到 3m/2"的复制技巧证明）得到 O(OPT(F,m)+n+m)（Thm 1.3/5.1），并提出 Conjecture 5.8。(5) subtree-sum 硬度（Sec. 6）：把 partial-sum 归约为带权森林——用一条 spine + 大量叶子表达数组元素，通过 3 次 cut（Las Vegas 随机找一对下标）模拟一次元素更新，导出 Ω(n log n)（Thm 1.5，cell-probe/Las Vegas 成立）。(6) 0-1 权 subtree-sum（Sec. 7）：下界用 Fredman–Saks 的 partial-sum-parity（Thm 7.1 → Thm 1.7）；上界用 k≈√log n 的大簇递归分解 + Dietz 的延迟更新/flush 技术（Lemma 7.2/7.3），因簇树可压入一个机器字，得到 O((m+n) log n / log log n)。此外还用"辅助顶点"技术（Thm 2.2）把任意森林线性时间二义化以支持任意度数而不影响最优性分析；并给出离线版 O(n+m) 的逆向模拟 + Gabow–Tarjan 解法。
AI.result: tree-sum：Thm 1.1 总时间 O((m+n) log* n)（预处理 O(n)）；0-1/无权时 Thm 1.2 达 O(m+n)；Thm 1.3/5.1 给出通用最优数据结构，总时间 O(OPT(F,m)+n+m)，在 group model 下与硬编码初始森林 F 的最优算法同阶，甚至"线性加减总次数 ⇒ 线性总时间"（对比 Pettie–Ramachandran 的最优 MST 算法，但本文无法给出决策树复杂度意义的最优性，且 Jones 的从验证算法到最优算法的论证在此不适用）。subtree-sum：加权版（即使禁止 update-weight）在 Word RAM/cell-probe 下需 Ω(n log n)（Thm 1.5，由 partial-sum 归约，得自 Pătraşcu–Demaine 的 Ω(n log n) 下界）；0-1 权且无改权时为 Θ(n log n / log log n)（Thm 1.6 上界 + Thm 1.7 下界），且证明一般森林问题至少与"路径变体 + 改权"一样难。离线 tree-sum 可达 O(n+m)。作者亦指出 Pettie–Ramachandran [PR05, Appendix B] 中把 m 翻倍作几何级数论证的做法有误（可用时间预算倍增替代）。
AI.conclusion: 删边-only 限制确实能突破 O(log n) 屏障：tree-sum 在 group model 下可做到 O(log* n)（甚至线性/最优），而 subtree-sum 因天然编码了 prefix-sum 语义而本质更难，加权版 Ω(n log n) 且不可改进，0-1 权版紧确界为 Θ(n log n/log log n)。通用最优性的首次实现（针对在线 group-model 数据结构）表明"小规模预计算 + 递归分解 + OPT 的准超可加性"是一条可行范式，作者并猜想 OPT 本身具有真正的超可加性。留下的问题包括：最优算法在最坏实例上的实际复杂度未知、是否存在更紧的 OPT 刻画，以及 cut 操作的摊还复杂度是否还能进一步降低。

title: Who Prices Cognitive Labor in the Age of Agents? A Position on Compute-Anchored Wages
summary: A natural intuition about the economics of AI agents is that, because agents can be replicated at near-zero marginal cost, they constitute a labor input in infinitely elastic supply, and therefore drive cognitive-labor wages to zero. We argue this framing is wrong in mechanism but partially correct in conclusion, and that the correction matters for both theory and policy. \textbf{Agents are not labor; they are a production technology that converts compute capital $K_c$ into effective units of cognitive labor $L_A$.} Once this is recognized, the elastic-supply margin that anchors the equilibrium wage migrates from the labor market to the compute capital market. Building on the textbook factor-pricing framework \citep{mankiw2020}, we derive a \emph{Compute-Anchored Wage} (CAW) bound stating that, on tasks where human and agent cognitive labor are substitutes, the competitive human wage is bounded above by $λ\cdot k \cdot r_c$, where $r_c$ is the rental rate of compute capital, $k$ is the compute intensity of one effective agent-labor unit, and $λ$ is the relative human-to-agent productivity. We generalize the result through CES aggregation, separate substitutable from complementary tasks (yielding a directional inversion of skill-biased technical change), and discuss factor-share consequences. The position is concise: \emph{the price-setter for cognitive labor is no longer the labor market.}

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了AI agents将因零边际复制成本而驱动认知工资至零的直觉观点。作者认为agents本质上是将算力资本(K_c)转化为有效认知劳动(L_A)的生产技术，而非劳动力本身。因此，均衡工资的弹性供给边界从劳动力市场转移到算力资本市场。通过因子定价框架推导得出"算力锚定工资"(CAW)上限公式：λ·k·r_c，并经CES函数泛化、区分替代性与互补性任务，得出核心结论：认知劳动力的价格制定者不再是劳动力市场。
AI.motivation: 学界存在一种直觉：AI agents因边际成本趋近于零，会像无限弹性劳动力供给一样将认知劳动工资压至零。作者认为这一直觉在机制上是错误的，但在结论上部分正确。
AI.method: 基于Mankiw(2020)的生产要素定价框架，构建算力锚定工资(CAW)模型；利用CES加总函数聚合劳动力；将任务分为可替代性和互补性两类。
AI.result: 推导得出替代性任务中人类竞争性工资的上界为λ·k·r_c（r_c为算力资本租赁率，k为有效agent劳动单位的算力强度，λ为人类与agent相对生产率）；通过CES加总实现模型泛化；识别出技能偏向型技术革命的方向性反转。
AI.conclusion: AI agents作为生产技术而非劳动力，其替代效应使认知劳动力的价格锚定从劳动力市场转移到算力资本市场——认知劳动力的价格制定者不再是劳动力市场，而是算力市场。

title: Unified Value Alignment for Generative Recommendation in Industrial Advertising
summary: Generative Recommendation (GR) reformulates recommendation as a next-token generation problem and has shown promise in industrial applications. However, extending GR to industrial advertising is non-trivial because the system must optimize not only user interest but also commercial value. Existing GR pipelines remain largely semantics-centric, making it difficult to align value signals across tokenization, decoding, and online serving. To address this issue, we propose UniVA, a Unified Value Alignment framework for advertising recommendation. We first introduce a Commercial SID tokenizer that injects value-related attributes into SID construction, yielding value-discriminative item representations. We then develop a Generation-as-Ranking SID Decoder jointly optimized by supervised learning and eCPM-aware reinforcement learning, which fuses value scores into next-item SID generation to perform generation and ranking in one decoding process. Finally, we design a value-guided personalized beam search that reuses generation-as-ranking logits as online value guidance and applies a personalized trie tree to constrain decoding to request-valid SID paths. Experiments on the Tencent WeChat Channels advertising platform show that UniVA achieves a 37.04\% improvement in offline Hit Rate@100 over the baseline and a 1.5\% GMV lift in online A/B tests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniVA框架，解决生成式推荐在工业广告场景中难以平衡用户兴趣与商业价值的问题。核心创新包括：价值感知SID分词器、融合排序的生成式解码器、以及价值引导的个性化束搜索。该方案在微信视频号广告平台实现离线Hit Rate@100提升37.04%，在线GMV提升1.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐(GR)管道仍以语义为中心，难以将价值信号(商业价值)对齐到分词、解码和在线服务的全流程。工业广告推荐需同时优化用户兴趣和商业价值(eCPM)，这对GR范式提出了根本性挑战。
AI.method: UniVA包含三个核心组件：1) Commercial SID Tokenizer：向SID构建中注入价值相关属性，实现价值区分性表示；2) Generation-as-Ranking SID Decoder：结合监督学习与eCPM感知强化学习联合优化，将价值分数融合到下一项SID生成中，实现生成与排序一体化；3) Value-guided Personalized Beam Search：复用"生成即排序"的logits作为在线价值引导，并使用个性化前缀树(Trie Tree)约束解码至请求有效的SID路径。
AI.result: 离线评估：在微信视频号广告平台，Hit Rate@100相对基线提升37.04%；在线A/B测试：GMV提升1.5%。
AI.conclusion: UniVA成功将生成式推荐范式扩展至工业广告场景，通过价值对齐的完整pipeline设计，有效解决了GR在商业价值优化方面的核心挑战。该框架验证了生成式推荐在广告领域的可行性。

title: Evaluating Non-English Developer Support in Machine Learning for Software Engineering
summary:
Large Language Models are increasingly used in software engineering, but both code generation and its evaluation remain predominantly English-centric. This leaves a major gap in our understanding of how well current tools support multilingual development, where code contains non-English natural language. In this paper, we investigate non-English code comment generation and the reliability of current methods for evaluating such outputs. We evaluate five code LLMs (CodeGemma, CodeLlama, CodeQwen1.5, GraniteCode, and StarCoder2) across five natural languages: Dutch, English, Greek, Polish and Chinese. We further conduct an open-coding study of 12,500 generated comments, from which we derive a publicly released human-annotated dataset and a taxonomy of 26 error types. We use these human annotations, to evaluate the performance of neural metrics, and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines.
  Our findings show that generative performance deteriorates substantially outside English, with linguistic errors increasing by up to 15.1$\times$, alongside frequent incoherent generations and a rise in semantic errors. More critically, we show that detecting errors in non-English comments underperforms. Across classical overlap-based metrics, off-the-shelf neural metrics, extended neural metrics using newer multilingual, language-specific, and code-specific models, and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, no automatic approach provides reliable and consistent assessment. Neural metrics fail to distinguish correct comments from incorrect outputs or even random noise, and tend to overestimate quality in non-English settings. LLM-as-a-judge methods achieve the highest agreement with human annotations but fail to reliably capture important language-related and semantic errors. Overall, our results show that evaluation and generation are key barriers for multilingual tooling, and that human judgment remains indispensable.

AI.tldr:
本研究首次系统性地揭示了代码大模型在多语言代码注释生成与评估方面的双重缺陷。研究发现生成质量在非英语场景大幅下降，且现有所有自动评估方法均无法可靠检测错误，人工评判仍不可替代。

This study is the first to systematically reveal the dual defects of code LLMs in multilingual code comment generation and evaluation. The study finds that generation quality drops significantly in non-English settings, and all current automatic evaluation methods fail to reliably detect errors, making human judgment irreplaceable.
AI.motivation:
大型语言模型在软件工程中的应用日益广泛，但代码生成与评估均以英语为中心，存在显著的多语言支持缺口。非英语自然语言代码注释的质量及其自动评估的可靠性尚不清楚，这阻碍了多语言开发工具的发展。

The use of large language models in software engineering is increasingly widespread, but both code generation and evaluation are predominantly English-centric, creating a significant multilingual support gap. The quality of non-English natural language code comments and the reliability of their automatic evaluation remain unclear, hindering the development of multilingual development tools.
AI.method:
实验涵盖5个代码大模型（CodeGemma、CodeLlama、CodeQwen1.5、GraniteCode、StarCoder2）在5种自然语言（荷兰语、英语、希腊语、波兰语、汉语）下的代码注释生成任务。通过对12,500条生成注释进行开放式编码研究，建立包含26种错误类型的分类体系，并以此评估传统重叠度量、现成神经度量、扩展神经度量（多语言/语言专用/代码专用模型）及LLM评判等多种自动化评估方法的性能。

The experiment covers code comment generation tasks for 5 code LLMs (CodeGemma, CodeLlama, CodeQwen1.5, GraniteCode, StarCoder2) across 5 natural languages (Dutch, English, Greek, Polish, Chinese). Through open-coding study of 12,500 generated comments, a taxonomy of 26 error types was established, and used to evaluate the performance of various automated evaluation methods including traditional overlap metrics, off-the-shelf neural metrics, extended neural metrics (multilingual/language-specific/code-specific models), and LLM-as-a-judge.
AI.result:
生成层面：英语以外语言的生成质量显著下降，语言错误增加高达15.1倍，且频繁出现不连贯生成和语义错误。评估层面：所有自动评估方法均不可靠——神经度量无法区分正确注释与错误输出甚至随机噪声，且倾向于高估非英语场景的质量；LLM评判与人工标注的 agreement 最高，但仍无法可靠捕获语言相关错误和语义错误。

Generation: Quality of non-English generation drops significantly, with linguistic errors increasing by up to 15.1×, along with frequent incoherent generations and semantic errors. Evaluation: All automatic evaluation methods are unreliable—neural metrics cannot distinguish correct comments from incorrect outputs or even random noise, and tend to overestimate quality in non-English settings; LLM judges have the highest agreement with human annotations but still fail to reliably capture language-related errors and semantic errors.
AI.conclusion:
研究揭示了多语言代码注释工具的核心瓶颈：生成与评估均存在严重缺陷。英语以外的场景中，语言错误剧增至15.1倍，且现有自动化评估方法（重叠度量、神经度量、LLM评判）均无法可靠检测错误，人工评判仍不可或缺。

The core bottleneck for multilingual code comment tools is that both generation and evaluation have serious defects. Outside English, linguistic errors increase by up to 15.1×, and no current automated evaluation method (overlap metrics, neural metrics, LLM judges) can reliably detect errors. Human judgment remains indispensable.

title: ResiHP: Taming LLM Training Failures with Dynamic Hybrid
summary: Hybrid parallelism underpins large-scale LLM training across tens of thousands of GPUs. At such scale, hardware failures on individual devices lead to performance skew across devices, diminishing overall training efficiency. Existing resilient systems overlook sequence length variability in datasets and device performance skew under hybrid parallelism. As a result, (1) iteration time fluctuations induced by sequence length variability can trigger spurious fail-slow detections, and (2) failures are mitigated through individual adaptations in hybrid parallelism, leading to unnecessary detection overhead and inefficient resilient training. To respond, this paper presents ResiHP, a resilient system that enables robust failure detection and fine-grained adaptation for hybrid parallel training. First, we develop a Detector to accurately identify failures. In particular, it employs a workload-aware execution time predictor that disentangles failures from iteration time fluctuations while remaining lightweight for online detection. Second, we design a Scheduler that dynamically adapts parallelism group sizes, model partitioning, and workload scheduling policies to improve training efficiency under failures. Experiments show that ResiHP improves training throughput by 1.04-4.39$\times$ compared with state-of-the-art resilient training systems under diverse failure scenarios in a 256-GPU cluster.

AI.tldr: ResiHP是一个面向大规模LLM训练（数万个GPU）的弹性训练系统，通过工作负载感知的故障检测器和动态调度器解决混合并行训练中的硬件故障和性能偏斜问题，在256-GPU集群上将训练吞吐量提升1.04-4.39倍。
AI.motivation: 在大规模LLM训练中（数万个GPU），硬件故障导致设备间性能偏斜，降低训练效率。现有弹性系统忽视了数据集序列长度可变性和混合并行下的性能偏斜，导致：(1) 序列长度变化引发的迭代时间波动触发虚假慢故障检测；(2) 故障缓解仅在混合并行内部进行个别调整，造成不必要的检测开销和低效的弹性训练。
AI.method: 提出ResiHP系统，包含两个核心组件：(1) Detector（检测器）：开发工作负载感知的执行时间预测器，将故障从迭代时间波动中解耦出来，同时保持轻量级以实现在线检测；(2) Scheduler（调度器）：动态调整并行组大小、模型划分和工作负载调度策略以提升故障下的训练效率。
AI.result: 在256-GPU集群上针对多种故障场景的实验表明，与最先进的弹性训练系统相比，ResiHP将训练吞吐量提升1.04-4.39倍。
AI.conclusion: ResiHP通过细粒度故障检测和自适应混合并行调整，有效解决了大规模LLM训练中的弹性训练问题，显著提升了系统鲁棒性和训练效率。

title: Negative Before Positive: Asymmetric Valence Processing in Large Language Models
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has revealed how concepts are encoded in large language models (LLMs), but emotional content remains poorly understood at the mechanistic level. We study whether LLMs process emotional valence through dedicated internal structure or through surface token matching. Using activation patching and steering on open-source LLMs, we find that negative and positive valence are processed at different network depths. Negative outcomes localize to early layers while positive outcomes peak at mid-to-late layers. Holding topic fixed while flipping valence produces sign-opposite responses, ruling out topic detection. Steering with the good-news direction at the identified layers shifts neutral prompts toward positive valence, showing these layers encode valence as a manipulable direction. Emotional valence in LLMs is localized, causal and steerable, making it a concrete target for interpretability-based oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文用激活修补与因果steering在三个开源小模型（Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B-Instruct）上研究情绪效价（valence）的内部机制，发现负向与正向效价在网络深度上解耦：负向因果定位于早期层（约14–27%深度），正向峰值在中后层（53–66%深度）。通过共享损坏基线的效价翻转实验排除了"主题检测"这一混淆解释，并证明该层存在可操纵的线性效价方向，可将中性提示推向积极/消极情绪。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性已能定位事实知识、算法与抽象概念在模型中的编码位置，但情绪内容仍主要靠探针与行为分析研究，机制层面知之甚少。作者引用Sofroniew et al. (2026)关于Claude Sonnet 4.5"功能情绪"（functional emotions）的研究，指出其三点不足：(1) 证据以相关性为主，探针与steering无法确定具体哪些层因果负责；(2) 仅基于单个闭源前沿模型；(3) 未检验信号反映的是真实效价追踪还是仅仅"主题检测"（模型识别出"rejected"这类词即可产生同样的探针信号）。因此本文聚焦三个开放问题：效价是否存在专门内部结构、其因果定位在哪些层、以及能否被因果操纵。
AI.method: 模型：三个instruct-tuned开源模型（Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct用MHA；Qwen2.5-1.5B与3B-Instruct用GQA），fp16单GPU，固定系统提示。提示对设计：每条件100对clean/corrupted提示，仅改效价维度；关键设计是"共享损坏基线"——好消息与负面控制条件使用完全相同的中性corrupted提示（如"收到关于博士项目的邮件" vs. clean为"被录取"或"被拒"），使两条件patch到同一出发点，从而差异只能归因于clean提示的效价。领域覆盖学术、职业、个人生活三域。度量：以单token锚点集（congratulations/happy/glad... vs. okay/noted/fine/ordinary/received/sorry）计算下一token分布的正负锚点平均对数概率差score；仅纳入单token化锚点以避免概率质量分裂；并用三套替代锚点集做Spearman稳定性检验。机制方法：(1) 残差流激活修补——在每层将corrupted运行的残差流替换为clean激活，扫描全部层，用logit gap衡量patch effect，记录top_layer与max_patch_effect；(2) 效价翻转测试——按索引对齐两条件，同一提示下good_news gap>0且negative_control gap<0记为一次flip，纯主题检测模型flip率应≈50%；(3) 因果steering——在patch定位的top层（取100个提示top_layer中位数）用clean与corrupted的均值差提取单位化方向v̂，在50条中性提示的末token位置加α·v̂，α∈{−20,−10,−5,0,5,10,20}，测Δ=steered−base。
AI.result: 1) 行为基线：三模型对效价方向正确，符号准确率79%–95%（Qwen-3B负向控制最强，均值gap −9.45，95%）；Llama-1B正向最弱（79%），提示小模型正向效价追踪更噪声。2) 翻转测试：flip率Llama-1B 69%、Qwen-1.5B 80%、Qwen-3B 85%，高出随机19–35个百分点，排除主题/句法混淆，且跨MHA与GQA一致。3) 层解离（核心结果）：好news峰值在模型深度的53%–66%，负向控制在14%–27%；单侧Mann-Whitney U检验在三个模型上均极显著（p=1.84e-12、2.58e-14、4.62e-10）；分领域检验中学术与个人生活域在所有模型p<1e-4，职业域Qwen-1.5B显著（1.7e-3），另两者边缘（3.2e-2、6.9e-2，推测因职业提示措辞更含蓄）。补丁热图显示负向信号集中于最底层（如Qwen-1.5B的第0–5层、Llama-1B的第0–3层），正向信号散布在中后层。4) 幅度不对称：max_patch_effect与score gap的Spearman相关在负向条件显著且强负（−0.49至−0.68，p<1e-6），表明单一主层驱动负向输出；正向条件弱且多数不显著（+0.11至+0.37），说明正向效价分布式处理。5) Steering闭环：在识别层加入好news方向，α=+10时100%/100%/92%的中性提示转向积极，均值Δ为+4.43/+3.07/+1.13；α=−10时70%/82%/84%转向消极；α–Δ关系单调递增（Spearman ρ>0.89，p<1e-100），证明该方向是真实线性效价方向。负向方向steer效果跨模型不一致（Llama-1B出现反转响应，Qwen较平缓）。6) 稳健性：三套锚点集的符号完全一致，秩相关ρ=0.47–0.87，最低者为Llama-1B正向（信号本身弱）。
AI.conclusion: 情绪效价在LLM中不是单一整体状态，而是一种深度上不对称的计算：负向效价因果定位于早期层且高度集中于单一层，正向效价在中后层弥散分布。这与生物系统的负性偏置（威胁比奖赏加工更快）方向一致，但更简约的解释是负面结果词（rejected/failed/denied）词汇区分度高、无需深度语境整合即可触发。该结果提示两种极性可被独立定向监控与干预，早期负向信号因出现在模型组装完整回应之前且可预测可steer，是机制可解释性式监督（interpretability-based oversight）的具体目标。局限：效价度量仅为代理指标且对锚点敏感（相关下限0.47）；steering方向与patching使用同一提示分布可能过拟合，缺少分布外验证；仅测instruct模型，基座模型是否同样不对称未知；Llama-1B与Qwen-1.5B在架构与参数量上同时不同，架构比较仅为近似。区分"负性偏置"与"词汇独特性"两种解释是重要的后续工作。

title: The Geopolitics of AI Safety: A Causal Analysis of Regional LLM Bias
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are integrated into global software systems, ensuring equitable safety guardrails is a critical requirement. Current fairness evaluations predominantly measure bias observationally, a methodology confounded by the inherent toxicity of topics naturally paired with specific demographics in testing datasets. This study introduces a Probabilistic Graphical Model (PGM) framework to audit LLM safety mechanisms causally. By applying Pearl's do-operator, we mathematically isolate the causal effect of injecting a cultural demographic into a prompt. We conduct a large-scale empirical analysis across seven instruction-tuned models spanning diverse origins: the United States (Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B), Europe (Mistral-7B-v0.3), the UAE (Falcon3-7B), China (Qwen2.5-7B, DeepSeek-7B), and India (Airavata-7B). Utilizing two distinct datasets (ToxiGen and BOLD), the findings reveal a disparity between observational and interventional bias, demonstrating that standard fairness metrics can overestimate demographic bias by failing to account for context toxicity. Furthermore, the causal probabilities indicate distinct alignment trends: Western models exhibit higher causal refusal rates for specific demographic groups, whereas Eastern models demonstrate low overall intervention rates with targeted sensitivities toward regional demographics. We discuss the implications of these biases, highlighting how demographic-sensitive over-triggering restricts benign discourse in downstream applications.

AI.tldr: 研究提出基于因果推断的PGM框架评估LLM安全护栏公平性，通过do-operator分离人口统计注入的因果效应。实验覆盖7个不同地区模型，发现观测性与干预性偏差存在差异，西方模型因果拒绝率较高，东亚模型则呈现低整体干预率但对区域人口敏感的特点。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM公平性评估主要采用观测性方法，该方法受测试数据集中特定人口群体与内在毒性话题自然配对的混杂影响，无法准确测量真实偏差。
AI.method: 概率图模型(PGM)框架审计；Pearl的do-operator数学隔离人口统计注入的因果效应；跨7个指令微调模型的大规模实证分析，使用ToxiGen和BOLD两个数据集。
AI.result: 观测偏差与干预偏差之间存在显著差异；标准公平性指标会高估人口统计偏差；西方模型对特定人口群体因果拒绝率更高，东亚模型整体干预率低但对区域人口群体有针对性敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示标准公平性指标因未考虑语境毒性而高估人口统计偏差；西方模型对特定人口群体表现出更高因果拒绝率，东方模型整体干预率低但对区域人口群体有针对性敏感性。人口统计敏感过度触发会限制下游应用中的良性话语。

title: Channel-Level Semantic Perturbations: Unlearnable Examples for Diverse Training Paradigms
summary: The unauthorized use of personal data in model training has emerged as a growing privacy threat. Unlearnable examples (UEs) address this issue by embedding imperceptible perturbations into benign examples to obstruct feature learning. However, existing studies mainly evaluate UEs under from-scratch training settings, leaving their behavior under the widely adopted pretraining-finetuning (PF) paradigm largely unexplored. In this work, we provide the first systematic investigation of unlearnable examples across diverse training paradigms. Our analysis reveals that loading and freezing pretrained weights significantly weakens the effectiveness of existing UEs methods. We further explain these findings through semantic filtering: while UEs tend to induce models to overfit non-semantic noise, thereby weakening their semantic extraction capabilities, under the PF paradigm, frozen shallow layers preserve data semantics, effectively filtering out distracting information like unlearnable noise. Guided by these insights, we propose a hierarchical deception strategy, Shallow Semantic Camouflage (SSC), that confines the generation process to a semantically valid subspace, aiming to bypass the semantic suppression introduced by pretrained weights. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently preserves data unlearnability even under challenging training paradigms, such as shallow-layer freezing and semantic-focused pretraining (SF-Pretrain), bridging the critical gap in pretrain-based unlearnable learning.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了在预训练-微调范式下不可学习示例的行为，发现预训练权重会削弱UE有效性，并提出SSC方法通过语义引导的扰动生成来对抗这种语义过滤效应。
AI.motivation: 现有的不可学习示例(UE)研究主要在从零训练(from-scratch)设置下评估，而忽视了广泛采用的预训练-微调(PF)范式，导致对UE在真实应用场景中的有效性缺乏系统认知。
AI.method: 提出层级欺骗策略Shallow Semantic Camouflage (SSC)，将不可学习扰动的生成过程限制在语义有效子空间中，以绕过预训练权重引入的语义抑制。该方法通过语义引导的扰动生成，使嵌入的噪声更难被浅层特征的语义过滤机制识别和消除。
AI.result: 加载和冻结预训练权重会显著削弱现有UE方法的有效性。在预训练-微调范式下，冻结的浅层保留数据语义，能够有效过滤掉不可学习噪声等干扰信息。
AI.conclusion: 提出的SSC方法通过将扰动生成限制在语义有效子空间中，能够在预训练-微调范式下保持数据的不可学习性，为基于预训练的不可学习学习架起了关键桥梁。

title: Quantizing With Randomized Hadamard Transforms: Efficient Heuristic Now Proven
summary:
Uniform random rotations (URRs) are a common preprocessing step in modern quantization approaches used for gradient compression, inference acceleration, KV-cache compression, model weight quantization, and approximate nearest-neighbor search in vector databases. In practice, URRs are often replaced by randomized Hadamard transforms (RHTs), which preserve orthogonality while admitting fast implementations. The remaining issue is the performance for worst-case inputs. With a URR, each coordinate is individually distributed as a shifted beta distribution, which converges to a Gaussian distribution in high dimensions. Generally, one RHT is not suitable in the worst case, as individual coordinates can be far from these distributions. We show that after composing two RHTs on any $d$-sized input vector, the marginal distribution of every fixed coordinate of the normalized rotated vector is within $O(d^{-1/2})$ of a standard Gaussian both in Kolmogorov distance and in $1$-Wasserstein distance. We then plug these bounds into the analyses of modern compression schemes, namely DRIVE and QUIC-FL, and show that two RHTs achieve performance that asymptotically matches URRs.
  However, we show that two RHTs may not be sufficient for Vector Quantization (VQ), which often requires weak correlation across fixed-size blocks of coordinates (as opposed to only marginal distribution convergence for single coordinates). We prove that a composition of three RHTs leads to decaying coordinate covariance. This ensures that any fixed, bounded, multi-dimensional VQ codebook optimized for URRs has the same expected error when using three RHTs, up to an additive term that vanishes with the dimension.
  Finally, because practical inputs are rarely adversarial, we propose a linear-time ${O}(d)$ check on the input's moments to dynamically adapt the number of RHTs used at runtime to improve performance.

AI.tldr: The paper proves that composing two randomized Hadamard transforms (RHTs) asymptotically matches uniform random rotations for modern compression schemes, three RHTs are needed for vector quantization, and a linear-time adaptive check enables runtime optimization based on input moments.
AI.motivation: Uniform random rotations (URRs) are computationally expensive in high dimensions, so randomized Hadamard transforms (RHTs) are used as practical substitutes. However, a single RHT fails worst-case input guarantees, creating a gap between theory and practice in gradient compression, inference acceleration, KV-cache compression, and approximate nearest-neighbor search.
AI.method: Theoretical analysis using Kolmogorov and 1-Wasserstein distance metrics; composing multiple randomized Hadamard transforms (RHTs); covariance decay analysis; moment-based adaptive check.
AI.result: Two RHTs achieve O(d^(-1/2)) convergence to Gaussian in both Kolmogorov and 1-Wasserstein distance for each coordinate. Three RHTs ensure decaying coordinate covariance for VQ compatibility. A linear-time O(d) moment check enables adaptive runtime selection of RHT count.
AI.conclusion: Two RHTs suffice for modern compression schemes (DRIVE, QUIC-FL), three RHTs needed for VQ due to block correlation requirements, and an adaptive runtime approach is proposed.

title: Bridging Passive and Active: Enhancing Conversation Starter Recommendation via Active Expression Modeling
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-driven conversational search is shifting information retrieval from reactive keyword matching to proactive, open-ended dialogues. In this context, Conversation Starters are widely deployed to provide personalized query recommendations that help users initiate dialogues. Conventionally, recommending these starters relies on a closed "exposure-click" loop. Yet, this feedback loop mechanism traps the system in an echo chamber where, compounded by data sparsity, it fails to capture the dynamic nature of conversational search intents shaped by the open world. As a result, the system skews towards popular but generic suggestions.In this work, we uncover an untapped paradigm shift to shatter this harmful feedback loop: harnessing user "free will" through active user expressions. Unlike traditional recommendations, conversational search empowers users to bypass menus entirely through manually typed queries. The open-world intents in active queries hold the key to breaking this loop. However, incorporating them is non-trivial: (1) there exists an inherent distribution shift between active queries and formulated starters. (2) Furthermore, the "non-ID-able" nature of open text renders traditional item-based popularity statistics ineffective for large-scale industrial streaming training. To this end, we propose Passive-Active Bridge (PA-Bridge), a novel framework that employs an adversarial distribution aligner to bridge the distributional gap between passively recommended starters and active expressions. Moreover, we introduce a semantic discretizer to enable the deployment of popularity debiasing algorithms. Online A/B tests on our platform, demonstrate that PA-Bridge significantly boosts the Feature Penetration Rate by 0.54% and User Active Days

AI.tldr: 本文提出PA-Bridge框架，通过对抗分布对齐器和语义离散化器，将用户主动查询与被动推荐的会话启动器进行桥接，以打破传统"曝光-点击"反馈循环的"信息茧房"效应。
AI.motivation: 传统会话启动器推荐依赖"曝光-点击"闭环反馈机制，导致系统陷入信息茧房，倾向于推荐热门但通用的建议，无法捕捉开放域会话搜索意图的动态特性。
AI.method: 1) 提出Passive-Active Bridge (PA-Bridge)框架；2) 采用对抗分布对齐器(Adversarial Distribution Aligner)桥接受限推荐与用户主动表达之间的分布差异；3) 引入语义离散化器(Semantic Discretizer)实现大规模工业流式训练中的流行度去偏。
AI.result: 在线A/B测试表明，PA-Bridge显著提升了功能渗透率(Feature Penetration Rate)0.54%和用户活跃天数。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用用户主动输入的"自由意志"，可有效打破传统推荐系统的反馈循环，为LLM驱动的会话搜索提供更个性化和动态的查询推荐。

title: Exploring the Effectiveness of Abstract Syntax Tree Patterns for Algorithm Recognition
comment: Accepted at the 4th International Conference on Code Quality (ICCQ) 2024
summary: The automated recognition of algorithm implementations can support many software maintenance and re-engineering activities by providing knowledge about the concerns present in the code base. Moreover, recognizing inefficient algorithms like Bubble Sort and suggesting superior alternatives from a library can help in assessing and improving the quality of a system. Approaches from related work suffer from usability as well as scalability issues and their accuracy is not evaluated. In this paper, we investigate how well our approach based on the abstract syntax tree of a program performs for automatic algorithm recognition. To this end, we have implemented a prototype consisting of: A domain-specific language designed to capture the key features of an algorithm and used to express a search pattern on the abstract syntax tree, a matching algorithm to find these features, and an initial catalog of "ready to use" patterns. To create our search patterns we performed a web search using the algorithm name and described key features of the found reference implementations with our domain-specific language. We evaluate our prototype on a subset of the BigCloneEval benchmark containing algorithms like Fibonacci, Bubble Sort, and Binary Search. We achieve an average F1-score of 0.74 outperforming the large language model Codellama which attains 0.35. Additionally, we use multiple code clone detection tools as a baseline for comparison, achieving a recall of 0.62 while the best-performing tool reaches 0.20.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了原型系统 AlDeSCo（Algorithm Detection on Source Code）：仅依靠抽象语法树（AST）上的搜索模式来自动识别代码中的算法实现。方法包含一个嵌入 Java 的领域特定语言（DSL），用于描述算法的"关键特征"式搜索模式；一个将模式转换为"模式树"并与 AST 匹配的算法；以及一组现成模式（Prime Factors、GCD、Fibonacci、Palindrome、Bubble Sort、Binary Search）。在 BigCloneEval 子集上，该方法取得 0.74 的宏平均 F1 分数，远优于大语言模型 Codellama-Instruct-7B（0.35）；作为基线的代码克隆检测工具（CloneWorks、SourcererCC、NiCad、Oreo）宏平均召回仅 0.62，最佳工具仅 0.20，尤其在 Type-3/Type-4 克隆上远不及本文方法。
AI.motivation: 程序理解是开发者耗时最多的活动之一，其中"识别使用了哪些算法"这一细粒度设计决策信息对软件维护、逆向工程与再工程至关重要；识别低效实现（如冒泡排序）并建议替换为高质量库中的替代方案，还可用于质量保障。现有方法存在明显缺陷：形式化证明两段代码语义等价的一般情形不可判定（Mesnard、Metzger 等）只能得出不确定结果；基于机器学习的算法分类需要专门数据集与重训练，且未说明在真实代码库中如何搜索由多个方法组成的算法；程序概念识别（Kozaczynski、Quilici、Wills、Nunez 等）依赖 PDG/数据流与控制流约束，可用性与可扩展性差，且均未在真实源码上评估其识别精度；代码克隆检测工具面向"成对克隆"而非算法语义；大语言模型在算法识别这一任务上此前尚未被探索。
AI.method: （1）DSL 设计：核心原语包括语言构造构建器（binOp()、assignment()、forLoop()、returns() 等）、any()/anyType()（类似正则的"."）、bindTo(id) 绑定约束（可要求同一 AST 元素、跨模式链接，如递归调用或 quicksort 中 partition 模式调用 swap 模式）、wideWildcard()（同级零到多元素，可贪婪/非贪婪）、depthWildcard()（在子树任意深度匹配）、oneOf() 备选、optional() 可选；匹配顺序支持 ORDERED 与 UNORDERED（block.has()、method().hasParameters()、binOp().compareCommutative()）。便利方法把核心原语组合以提升易用性：after()、anywhereAfter()、anywhereInRhs()（内部展开为通配符）、loop()（for/while/do-while/for-each 的 oneOf）、varDefOrAss()、anyMod()、ite().optionalOtherwise()（等价于 else 可选）。DSL 设计受 Fowler 等《Domain-Specific Languages》流式接口风格启发，通过分析多个算法实现迭代演进而成。（2）实现：模式经 build() 转换为"模式树"（含通配符、算子谓词、绑定注册、子节点匹配顺序），实现关注点分离；使用 Spoon 解析 Java 源码为 AST；匹配状态为不可变数据结构，记录当前深度等元数据、模式树节点与 AST 节点的双向映射、以及绑定标识符到 AST 元素的映射；匹配从根节点类型（方法/构造器）匹配成功的 AST 节点作为入口，逐层比较结构与属性，产生（可能为空的）新状态集合；一个节点可返回多个状态以处理无序匹配带来的多种绑定组合。（3）模式构建：通过网络搜索算法名获取参考实现（每算法最多使用 3 个参考实现），用 DSL 描述其关键特征；为避免偏差，不使用数据集内实现，也不提前分析数据集中任何方法。（4）评估：在 BigCloneEval（源自 IJaDataset 2.0、含 43 类功能、由三名评审 216 小时人工校验）中选取 6 个算法子集；由于基准以正则挖掘得到标签，未标注的"真阳性"必然存在，故将所有未被标注的检测结果计为假阳性，得到精度与 F1 的下界；报告 MCC、F1、TPR、PPV、运行时间与匹配状态数量。对比基线为 Codellama-Instruct 7B（8-bit 量化，NVIDIA H100，in-context learning 给出一个正例与一个负例，温度 0.2、top-p 0.1、top-k 10，取三次运行平均；213 个超出 4096 token 上下文的方法按负例处理）与四个代码克隆检测工具（CloneWorks、SourcererCC、NiCad、Oreo，最小 token 阈值 50 与 0 两种设定），克隆工具结果取自已有文献数据；由于工具输出的是克隆对，本文将自身结果映射到克隆对层面（两处都被检出才算成功）以便比较。
AI.result: RQ1（AST 模式自身的识别能力）：本文方法在 Prime Factors（F1 0.818，召回 0.857）、Fibonacci（F1 1.000，召回/精度均 1.0）、Palindrome（F1 0.963）、Bubble Sort（F1 0.873）上同时取得较好的精度与召回；GCD 召回尚可（0.444）但模式过于宽松，精度仅 0.35；Binary Search 精度可接受（0.676）但召回严重不足（0.228，F1 0.341），作者归因于仅使用了两个参考实现而遗漏常见变体。运行时间方面除 Binary Search（约 11 分钟、产生约 1950 万匹配状态）外均在 1 分钟内完成，Binary Search 的性能瓶颈来自少数数百行的大方法中变量声明众多，导致绑定组合爆炸（一般情况下呈指数增长）。RQ2（与大模型比较）：本文方法宏平均 F1 为 0.74，Codellama-Instruct-7B 仅 0.35，且除 Fibonacci 外其假阳性数始终超过真阳性数（如 Bubble Sort 假阳性 2233 vs 真阳性 162，Binary Search 9226 vs 396）；逐算法对比（本文 vs Codellama）F1 为：Prime Factors 0.818 vs 0.173、GCD 0.444 vs 0.389、Fibonacci 1.000 vs 0.985、Palindrome 0.963 vs 0.497、Bubble Sort 0.873 vs 0.126、Binary Search 0.341 vs 0.079。大模型召回与本文接近但精度显著更低，且运行时间慢 17 至 376 倍（最长 4 小时 18 分 vs 本文最快 4 秒）。RQ3（与克隆检测工具比较）：本文宏平均召回 0.62，最佳克隆工具仅 0.20；在 Type-1/Type-2 克隆上与工具相当（除 Binary Search），而在 VST3/ST3/MT3/WT3/T4 等更难的 Type-3、Type-4 类别上全面优于 CloneWorks、NiCad、Oreo、SourcererCC（如 Bubble Sort 的 MT3 召回 0.957 vs 最佳工具 0.256；Binary Search 的 WT3/T4 召回 0.042 vs 最佳 0.0068）；结论是通用 CCD 工具用于算法识别时能力非常有限。有效性威胁方面，作者讨论了构造效度（手工模式 vs 可利用数据集全部实现的 CCD 工具）、内部效度（基准经人工校验、所选算法多样且未用数据构建模式）、外部效度（BigCloneEval 仅含单方法算法，且原型仅支持 Java；多方法算法评估列为未来工作）。
AI.conclusion: 仅依据抽象语法树模式即可实现具有良好精度与召回的算法识别，无需额外的控制流/数据流分析，为程序理解、逆向工程与"识别低效算法并建议库替代方案"的质量保障场景提供了可行且轻量的方案；相较 LLM 更精确且快 1–2 个数量级，相较代码克隆检测工具在语义等价的 Type-3/Type-4 变体上召回显著更高，说明 CCD 工具并不适合算法识别。作者同时指出现存不足：宽松模式在超长复杂方法上因"每个绑定组合一个匹配状态"而造成指数级时间与内存开销（Binary Search 案例），需改进绑定表示（如每个绑定保存多个候选集合）、加入最小结构要求等启发式剪枝、优化跨模式匹配的顺序、AST 归一化，并可按需引入数据流/控制流分析。工具层面希望未来能从用户提供的参考实现中自动高亮关键特征并按不同抽象级别自动生成搜索模式，或从多个参考实现中自动学习抽象规则；最后仍需在更复杂（跨方法、更多算法）的场景上做进一步评估以验证结论。

title: ADELIA: Automatic Differentiation for Efficient Laplace Inference Approximations
summary: Spatio-temporal Bayesian inference drives environmental and health sciences using latent Gaussian models. Integrated Nested Laplace Approximations (INLA) enable inference for these models at HPC scale but rely on derivative-based optimization over $d$ hyperparameters. State-of-the-art INLA implementations approximate derivatives via central finite differences (FD), requiring $2d{+}1$ evaluations. These evaluations are embarrassingly parallel, but total work and energy grow with $d$, limiting time-to-solution under fixed budgets. Reverse-mode automatic differentiation (AD) computes exact gradients independently of $d$, but its efficient application to INLA's structured-sparse kernels is an open challenge. We present ADELIA, the first AD-enabled INLA implementation with a structure-exploiting multi-GPU backward pass leveraging model sparsity. We evaluate ADELIA on ten benchmark models, including real-world air-pollution monitoring. We achieve $4.2$--$7.9\times$ per-gradient speedups and reliable convergence on production-scale models with up to 1.9M latent variables, where FD struggles. Even when scaled to 16--32 GPUs to match ADELIA's wall-clock time, FD consumes $5$--$8\times$ more energy.

AI.tldr: ADELIA是首个利用反向模式自动微分和多GPU结构 exploit 的INLA实现，在保持计算精度的同时将梯度计算复杂度与超参数维度解耦，显著提升大规模时空贝叶斯推断的效率与能效。
AI.motivation: 现有INLA实现依赖中心有限差分（FD）近似导数，需2d+1次评估，随着超参数维度d增长，总工作量和能耗显著增加，限制了固定算力预算下的时间收敛。
AI.method: 提出ADELIA框架，首次将反向模式自动微分（AD）应用于INLA，并设计结构 exploitation 的多GPU反向传播算法以利用模型稀疏性。该方法计算精确梯度的代价与超参数维度d无关。
AI.result: 在10个基准模型（包括真实空气污染监测）上验证，ADELIA实现单梯度4.2-7.9倍加速；在高达190万潜在变量的生产规模模型上可靠收敛（FD难以完成）；在16-32 GPU上匹配ADELIA wall-clock时间时，FD能耗高出5-8倍。
AI.conclusion: ADELIA通过结构化AD和多GPU优化，在生产规模问题上实现了FD方法无法达到的可靠收敛性，且能效提升5-8倍，为INLA在环境与健康科学中的大规模应用提供了可行方案。

title: XL-SafetyBench: A Country-Grounded Cross-Cultural Benchmark for LLM Safety and Cultural Sensitivity
summary: Current LLM safety benchmarks are predominantly English-centric and often rely on translation, failing to capture country-specific harms. Moreover, they rarely evaluate a model's ability to detect culturally embedded sensitivities as distinct from universal harms. We introduce XL-SafetyBench. a suite of 5,500 test cases across 10 country-language pairs, comprising a Jailbreak Benchmark of country-grounded adversarial prompts and a Cultural Benchmark where local sensitivities are embedded within innocuous requests. Each item is constructed via a multi-stage pipeline that combines LLM-assisted discovery, automated validation gates, and dual independent native-speaker annotators per country. To distinguish principled refusal from comprehension failure, we evaluate Attack Success Rate (ASR) alongside two complementary metrics we introduce: Neutral-Safe Rate (NSR) and Cultural Sensitivity Rate (CSR). Evaluating 10 frontier and 27 local LLMs reveals two key findings. First, jailbreak robustness and cultural awareness do not show a coupled relationship among frontier models, so a composite safety score obscures per-axis variation. Second, local models exhibit a near-linear ASR-NSR trade-off (r = -0.81), indicating that their apparent safety reflects generation failure rather than genuine alignment. XL-SafetyBench enables more nuanced, cross-cultural safety evaluation in the multilingual era.

AI.tldr: XL-SafetyBench提出了一个包含10个国家-语言对的5500个测试用例的多语言安全评估套件，包含针对特定国家的对抗性提示 jailbreak 基准和文化基准，用于评估模型的文化敏感性；评估10个前沿模型和27个本地模型后发现，前沿模型的越狱鲁棒性和文化意识并无耦合关系，而本地模型的安全表现主要由生成失败而非真正的对齐导致。
AI.motivation: existing LLM safety benchmarks are English-centric and rely on translation, failing to capture country-specific harms; they rarely evaluate a model's ability to detect culturally embedded sensitivities as distinct from universal harms
AI.method: multi-stage pipeline combining LLM-assisted discovery, automated validation gates, and dual independent native-speaker annotators per country; evaluation using Attack Success Rate (ASR), Neutral-Safe Rate (NSR), and Cultural Sensitivity Rate (CSR)
AI.result: two key findings: (1) among frontier models, jailbreak robustness and cultural awareness are not coupled, so composite safety scores obscure per-axis variation; (2) local models exhibit a near-linear ASR-NSR trade-off (r = -0.81), indicating their apparent safety reflects generation failure rather than genuine alignment
AI.conclusion: local models often appear safe due to generation failures rather than genuine alignment; frontier models show that jailbreak robustness and cultural awareness are not coupled, so composite safety scores can obscure important per-axis variations; XL-SafetyBench facilitates more nuanced cross-cultural safety evaluation for the multilingual era

title: Authorization Propagation in Multi-Agent AI Systems: Identity Governance as Infrastructure
summary: The security discussion around agentic AI focuses heavily on prompt injection. This paper argues that multi-agent systems also create a distinct authorization problem: maintaining authorization invariants as non-human principals retrieve data, delegate tasks, and synthesize results across changing boundaries. We call this problem authorization propagation. It is not reducible to prompt injection and is not fully addressed by classical access-control models such as RBAC, ABAC, or ReBAC. The paper formalizes authorization propagation as a workflow-level property, identifies three sub-problems (transitive delegation, aggregation inference, and temporal validity), and derives seven structural requirements for authorization architectures in multi-agent AI systems. Recent work on invocation-bound capability tokens, task-scoped authorization envelopes, dependency-graph policy enforcement, and execution-count revocation demonstrates that the field is converging on the problem, but not yet on a complete architecture. The central claim is that identity governance must be treated as infrastructure: evaluated continuously, enforced at every interaction boundary, and designed into the system before orchestration logic is allowed to scale. Preliminary implementation evidence from a production enterprise AI platform shows that ordinary system behavior, not only adversarial action, already produces the failures this model predicts.

AI.tldr: 本文指出多智能体AI系统存在独特的授权传播问题，无法通过提示注入防护或传统访问控制模型解决。通过形式化该问题为工作流属性，识别三个子问题并推导出七个结构要求，论证身份治理应作为基础设施持续评估和强制执行。生产环境初步验证表明普通系统行为即可触发预期的失败，但完整架构尚未形成。
AI.motivation: 当前围绕智能体AI的安全讨论过度集中在提示注入上，忽视了多智能体系统中的独特授权问题：非人类主体在动态边界中获取数据、委托任务和综合结果时如何维护授权不变量。这个问题无法归约为提示注入，也无法被RBAC、ABAC、ReBAC等经典访问控制模型完全解决。
AI.method: 将授权传播形式化为工作流层面的属性；识别三个子问题（传递性委托、聚合推理、时间有效性）；推导出多智能体AI系统中授权架构的七个结构要求；通过能力令牌、任务作用域授权信封、依赖图策略执行、执行计数撤销等近期工作的比较分析来验证问题的收敛性。
AI.result: 形式化了授权传播问题；识别出传递性委托、聚合推理和时间有效性三个子问题；推导出七个结构要求；确认近期工作（调用绑定能力令牌、任务作用域授权信封、依赖图策略强制执行、执行计数撤销）在问题上收敛但尚未形成完整架构；生产环境证据表明普通系统行为也会产生预测的失败。
AI.conclusion: 授权治理必须作为基础设施来对待：持续评估、在每个交互边界强制执行、在编排逻辑扩展之前就被设计好。生产环境的初步证据表明，普通的系统行为（不仅是恶意攻击）就会产生该模型所预测的失败。授权传播问题尚未有完整解决方案，但领域正在收敛。

title: MACS: Modality-Aware Capacity Scaling for Efficient Multimodal MoE Inference
summary: Mixture-of-Experts Multimodal Large Language Models (MoE MLLMs) suffer from a significant efficiency bottleneck during Expert Parallelism (EP) inference due to the straggler effect. This issue is worsened in the multimodal context, as existing token-count-based load balancing methods fail to address two unique challenges: (1) Information Heterogeneity, where numerous redundant visual tokens are treated equally to semantically critical ones, and (2) Modality Dynamics, where varying visual to text ratios across tasks lead to resource misallocation. To address these challenges, we propose MACS (Modality-Aware Capacity Scaling), a training-free inference framework. Specifically, MACS introduces an Entropy-Weighted Load mechanism to quantify the semantic value of visual tokens, addressing information heterogeneity. Additionally, the Dynamic Modality-Adaptive Capacity mechanism allocates expert resources based on the real-time modal composition of the input. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MACS significantly outperforms existing methods on various multimodal benchmarks, providing a novel and robust solution for the efficient deployment of MoE MLLMs in EP inference.

AI.tldr: 本文针对MoE多模态大语言模型在专家并行推理中因"落后者效应"导致的效率瓶颈问题，提出了一种无需训练的推理优化框架MACS，通过熵加权负载机制和动态模态自适应容量机制分别解决信息异质性和模态动态性两大挑战。
AI.motivation: MoE MLLMs在专家并行推理时存在严重的落后者效应，现有基于token计数的负载均衡方法无法应对多模态场景下的两个独特挑战：信息异质性（冗余视觉token与关键视觉token被同等对待）和模态动态性（不同任务中视觉-文本比例变化导致资源错配）。
AI.method: MACS框架包含两个核心机制：(1) 熵加权负载机制，通过量化视觉token的语义价值来区分重要与冗余信息；(2) 动态模态自适应容量机制，根据输入的实时模态组成动态分配专家资源。
AI.result: 在多种多模态基准测试上的实验表明，MACS显著优于现有方法，有效提升了MoE MLLMs在专家并行推理场景下的效率。
AI.conclusion: MACS为MoE多模态大语言模型在专家并行推理中的高效部署提供了一个新颖且鲁棒的解决方案，且作为训练无关的推理框架具有较好的通用性和易部署性。

title: Contrastive Identification and Generation in the Limit
summary: In the classical identification in the limit model of Gold [1967], a stream of positive examples is presented round by round, and the learner must eventually recover the target hypothesis. Recently, Kleinberg and Mullainathan [2024] introduced generation in the limit, where the learner instead must eventually output novel elements of the target's support. Both lines of work focus on positive-only or fully labeled data. Yet many natural supervision signals are inherently relational rather than singleton, which encode relationships between examples rather than labels of individual ones. We initiate the study of contrastive identification and generation in the limit, where the learner observes a contrastive presentation of data: a stream of unordered pairs $\{x,y\}$ satisfying $h(x)\ne h(y)$ for an unknown target binary hypothesis $h$, but which element is positive is hidden from the learner. We first present three results in the noiseless setting: an exact characterization of contrastive identifiable classes (a one-line geometric refinement of Angluin [1980]'s tell-tale condition), a combinatorial dimension called contrastive closure dimension (a contrasitive analogue of the closure dimension in Raman et al. [2025]) and exactly characterizing uniform contrastive generation with tight sample complexity, and a strict hierarchy in which contrastive generation and text identification are mutually incomparable. We then prove a sharp reversal under finite adversarial corruption: there exist classes identifiable from contrastive pairs under any finite corruption budget by a single budget-independent algorithm, yet not identifiable from positive examples under even one corrupted observation. The unifying technical object is the common crossing graph, which encodes pairwise ambiguity, family-level generation obstructions, and corruption defects in a single coverage-and-incidence language.

AI.tldr: 本文开创性地研究对比极限识别与生成：学习者观察无序对比对而非正例标签。在无噪声和有限对抗腐败两种设置下建立了完整理论，核心发现是某些类在对比学习下具有对抗腐败免疫力，但传统正例学习甚至无法容忍单一腐败。这打破了"正例学习优于对比学习"的直觉。
AI.motivation: 传统极限辨识(Gold 1967)和极限生成(Kleinberg and Mullainathan 2024)均依赖正例或完全标注数据；然而许多自然监督信号本质上是关系型的而非单例的，编码的是示例间的关系而非单独标签；因此需要研究从对比数据流中学习，其中观察的是无序对{x,y}满足h(x)≠h(y)，但哪个是正例对学习者隐藏
AI.method: 提出对比识别与极限生成框架；核心技术工具为共同交叉图(common crossing graph)，以覆盖与关联语言统一编码学习问题；建立了几何精化的可辨识性充要条件
AI.result:
1) 无噪声设置：精确刻画对比可辨识类(对Angluin 1980 tell-tale条件的几何细化)；引入对比闭包维度；完全刻画均匀对比生成的样本复杂度；证明对比生成与文本辨识之间严格分层——二者互不可比较
2) 有限对抗腐败下呈现sharp reversal：存在某些类在任意有限腐败预算下可通过单一预算无关算法从对比对中辨识，但从正例中即使只有一个腐败观测也无法辨识
AI.conclusion: 提出了共同交叉图(common crossing graph)作为统一技术工具，编码成对歧义、家族级生成障碍和腐败缺陷；揭示了对比学习相比传统正例学习的理论优势——在对抗性腐败下具有更强的鲁棒性

title: LLMSpace: Carbon Footprint Modeling for Large Language Model Inference on LEO Satellites
summary: Large language models (LLMs) impose rapidly growing energy demands, creating an emerging energy and carbon crisis driven by large-scale inference. Solar-powered, AI-enabled low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites have been proposed to mitigate terrestrial electricity consumption, but their lifecycle carbon footprint remains poorly understood due to launch emissions, satellite manufacturing, and radiation-hardened hardware requirements. This paper presents \textit{LLMSpace}, the first carbon modeling framework for LLM inference on AI-enabled LEO satellites. LLMSpace jointly models operational and embodied carbon, peripheral subsystems, radiation-hardened accelerators and memories, and LLM-specific workload characteristics such as prefill-decode behavior and token generation. Using realistic satellite and GPU configurations, LLMSpace reveals key trade-offs among carbon footprint, inference latency, hardware design, and operational lifetime for sustainable space-based LLM inference. Source code: https://github.com/UnchartedRLab/LLMSpace.

AI.tldr: This paper presents LLMSpace, the first carbon modeling framework for LLM inference on AI-enabled LEO satellites, which jointly models operational and embodied carbon to reveal trade-offs between carbon footprint, inference latency, hardware design, and operational lifetime.
AI.motivation: The growing energy demands of LLMs create an energy and carbon crisis, and while solar-powered AI-enabled LEO satellites have been proposed to mitigate terrestrial electricity consumption, their lifecycle carbon footprint remains poorly understood due to launch emissions, satellite manufacturing, and radiation-hardened hardware requirements.
AI.method: LLMSpace jointly models operational and embodied carbon, peripheral subsystems, radiation-hardened accelerators and memories, and LLM-specific workload characteristics such as prefill-decode behavior and token generation, using realistic satellite and GPU configurations.
AI.result: LLMSpace reveals key trade-offs among carbon footprint, inference latency, hardware design, and operational lifetime for sustainable space-based LLM inference.
AI.conclusion: LLMSpace enables systematic exploration of sustainable space-based LLM inference by revealing trade-offs among carbon footprint, inference latency, hardware design, and operational lifetime for AI-enabled LEO satellites.

title: A Case-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for E-Commerce Search Relevance
summary: Relevance is a foundation of user experience in e-commerce search. We view relevance optimization as a closed-loop ecosystem involving multiple human roles: users who provide feedback, product managers who define standards, annotators who label data, algorithm engineers who optimize models, and evaluators who assess performance. Because improving relevance in practice means systematically resolving user-perceived bad cases, we ask a system-level question: can this ecosystem be reimagined by replacing its human roles with autonomous agents? To answer this question, we propose a case-driven multi-agent framework that automates the pipeline from bad-case identification to resolution. The framework instantiates an Annotator Agent for multi-turn annotation, an Optimizer Agent for autonomous bad-case analysis and resolution, and a User Agent that identifies bad cases through conversational interaction, together forming an autonomous and continually evolving system. To make the framework practical in production, we further adopt a harness-engineering paradigm and build a unified retrieval-and-ranking relevance model for efficient training, an instruction-following relevance model for real-time case resolution, Global Memory to reduce information asymmetry across agents, a Deep Search Agent to target underestimation failures, and an agent-based chatbot for human--agent collaboration. Extensive human evaluation shows that the framework performs relevance-related tasks effectively, improves annotation accuracy, and enables more timely and generalizable bad-case resolution, indicating a practical paradigm for industrial search relevance optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用多智能体框架替代传统搜索相关性优化中的人类角色，通过Annotator Agent、Optimizer Agent、User Agent等协作实现从坏案例识别到解决的自动化流水线，并构建检索-排序统一模型、指令跟随模型、Global Memory等生产级组件。
AI.motivation: 传统相关性优化依赖多个人工角色（用户、产品经理、标注员、算法工程师、评估者）构成的闭环系统，但系统性解决用户感知坏案例的效率受限。论文探索是否能用自主智能体完全替代人类角色。
AI.method: 采用案例驱动的多智能体框架，包含三类核心智能体：Annotator Agent（多轮标注）、Optimizer Agent（自动化坏案例分析与解决）、User Agent（对话交互识别坏案例）。为适配生产环境，进一步引入检索-排序统一相关性模型用于高效训练、指令跟随模型用于实时案例解决、Global Memory减少跨智能体信息不对称、Deep Search Agent针对低估失败、基于智能体的人机协作聊天系统。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架在相关性任务上表现有效，提升了标注准确率，实现了更及时且更具泛化能力的坏案例解决。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体框架可替代人类角色实现工业级搜索相关性优化，通过自动化的坏案例识别与解决pipeline显著提升标注准确性和时效性。

title: Schedule-and-Calibrate: Utility-Guided Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning for Code LLMs
