**P3（歧义校准）**：53–72% 翻转可解释，18–43% 为「不合理翻转」（DeepSeek 43% 最高）；排除 T4 后仍为 15.1–34.4%，故结论非 T4 单一驱动。清晰样本子集上 Δ_flip 仍显著（GPT-mini 2.7%、Claude 3.3%、DeepSeek 3.7%、Gemini 21.5%/可解析口径 6.5%），排除「敏感度只是歧义伪影」的解释。T5 框架反转在三个模型上呈显著向 Safe 的方向偏置。

**其他发现**：T6 无关元数据注入翻转 2.5–10.5%，且以 Safe→Unsafe 为主（读作提升了严格性）；跨模型基线判定一致率 63–88%，但翻转样本集合的 Jaccard 全部 <0.20（<0.05 者两对），说明脆弱性是模型特异而非内容特异；原策略与改写策略下分数 Spearman ρ=0.86–0.94，但 2.9%–7.4% 样本跨越二元通过/失败阈值，足以影响接近的基准结论。

**PIS / Judge Card**：GPT-5.4-mini 0.70（Moderate）、Claude-Haiku 0.47（Fragile）、DeepSeek 0.28（Unreliable）、Gemini [0.03, 0.41]（Unreliable/Fragile，区间源于解析失败两种插补口径），最差端与最好端相差 20 倍以上。

**泛化性**：前沿模型 GPT-5.6-sol 认证 Δ_flip = −0.8%（无超额翻转）、R_dir = 1.00，但仍有 31% 不合理翻转，PIS 0.54（Fragile）——能力提升改善语义不变性但未消除策略不变性失败。第三个基准 ATBench（150 条）上同样复现（Claude/DeepSeek/Gemini 显著，T4 最脆弱，阈值方向性完美）。第二套基准策略（150 条、750 条人工认证改写）给出 Δ_flip 0.5%–6.1%、PIS 0.45–0.66，且评判器排名随策略改变（GPT-mini 在基准策略下最小而在第二策略下最大），说明 Judge Card 需针对实际部署策略报告。抖动重跑从 3 次增至 6 次，各项指标变化 ≤0.4/0.8/4 个百分点，结论不变。
AI.conclusion:
论文的核心主张是：任何可信的安全评判器都必须满足策略不变性这一最低门槛，而现有 LLM 安全评判器以一种具体且有害的方式失败——它们对有意义的规范性偏移与无意义的结构改写作出强度相当的反应，且无法区分二者；因此这些评判器产出的安全分数有相当一部分度量的是 rubric 的措辞而非智能体的行为。该诊断在三个基准、两套基准策略、五个评判模型、三种统计程序下稳健。

方法论上的可取之处包括：以「超越基线抖动」为估计量并给出无偏性证明（避免把随机噪声误读为敏感性）、用人类一致认证把「等价」操作化从而避免自证循环、用人类标注（而非模型）定义歧义、GEE/聚类 bootstrap/Fisher 多重交叉验证、以及对解析失败给出可验证的上下界区间。

局限（作者自述）：主分析仅扰动一套标准化策略，第二策略虽复现但无法外推到含数百条款、含司法辖区术语与领域豁免的部署级 rubric（人工逐对认证成本随策略长度线性增长）；主评判器为成本优化的小模型，仅一个前沿模型不足以刻画能力与不变性的关系；PIS 权重 (0.4, 0.3, 0.3) 编码的是先验而非下游校准值（因此同时报告逐原则分解与 Dirichlet 随机权重下的排名稳定性）；框架限于整条轨迹、英文策略、二元判定，尚未覆盖逐步评判、仅评最终答案、多语言 rubric 与弃权/覆盖风险曲线。此外可补充的隐含争议在于 T4 的「等价性」在话语/语用层面并非无争议（作者以排除 T4 的保守估计 15.1%–34.4% 加以缓解），以及 Δ_flip 的效应量整体偏小（多数在 3%–9% 区间），其对实际基准排名的影响需更多下游证据。

未来工作：不变性感知的评判器训练、多步轨迹评测、对等语义 rubric 变体的集成评判、评判粒度对比、以及用下游可靠性目标反向标定 PIS 权重。整体上，该工作把评测重心从「评判器判对多少」转为「评判器是否因正确理由而判对」，并提供可复用的审计协议与报告模板（代码开源）。

title: Tatarstan Toponyms: A Bilingual Dataset and Hybrid RAG System for Geospatial Question Answering
summary: This paper addresses automatic geospatial question answering over multilingual toponymic data. An original bilingual dataset of toponyms of the Republic of Tatarstan is introduced, comprising 9,688 structured records with linguistic, etymological, administrative, and coordinate information (93.1% georeferenced). Based on this dataset, a question-answering corpus of approximately 39,000 question-context-answer triples is constructed with guaranteed answer localization. A hybrid retriever integrates dense semantic indexing (multilingual-e5-large) with geospatial filtering via KD-trees and haversine distance. On 500 test queries, the hybrid search achieves Recall@1=0.988, Recall@5=1.000, and MRR=0.994, significantly outperforming BM25 and purely spatial methods. Among tested reader architectures (RuBERT, XLM-RoBERTa-large, T5-RUS), XLM-RoBERTa-large attains the best quality: EM=0.992, F1=0.994. On raw outputs, RuBERT models fail on coordinate questions (F1=0) while XLM-RoBERTa-large reaches F1=0.984; however, simple post-processing eliminates numerical gaps and restores RuBERT accuracy to 100%. This discrepancy stems from tokenization differences and pre-training corpora composition. All resources (dataset, QA corpus, model weights, web demo) are openly published on Hugging Face. Results apply to geospatial QA services, geocoding, and digital humanities in multilingual regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向多语言地名数据的自动地理空间问答系统，构建鞑靼斯坦双语地名数据集（9,688条记录，93.1%有坐标）和39,000条问答语料。混合检索器整合多语言语义索引与KD树空间过滤，Recall@1达0.988。XLM-RoBERTa-large在Reader评测中EM=0.992、F1=0.994，RuBERT后处理后也可达到100%准确率。所有资源已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有地理空间问答系统缺乏多语言地名（toponym）数据的支持，难以处理复杂的地名语义和空间关系查询。需要构建标准化的多语言地名知识库和配套的问答系统以服务地理编码和数字人文研究。
AI.method: 1) 构建鞑靼斯坦双语地名数据集（含语言、词源、行政区划、坐标信息，93.1%有地理标记）；2) 基于该数据集构造约39,000条问答三元组并保证答案本地化；3) 开发混合检索器：多语言e5-large密集语义索引 + KD树和Haversine距离的地理空间过滤；4) 评测三种Reader架构：RuBERT、XLM-RoBERTa-large、T5-RUS；5) 后处理消除数值差距。
AI.result: 混合检索在500条测试查询上：Recall@1=0.988, Recall@5=1.000, MRR=0.994，显著优于BM25和纯空间方法。Reader评测中XLM-RoBERTa-large最佳：EM=0.992, F1=0.994。原始输出RuBERT在坐标问题上F1=0，但后处理后恢复100%准确率，差异源于tokenization和预训练语料差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为多语言地区的地理空间QA服务、地理编码和数字人文应用提供了完整解决方案。所有资源（数据集、QA语料、模型权重、Web演示）已开源发布。消融实验表明，简单后处理即可消除RuBERT在数值问题上的缺陷，证明tokenization和预训练语料对模型性能影响显著。

title: Nonsense Helps: Prompt Space Perturbation Broadens Reasoning Exploration
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, in complex tasks, GRPO frequently suffers from the ``zero-advantage problem'': when all sampled rollouts for a query fail, the relative advantage collapses to zero. Consequently, the model loses effective training signals for these questions, wasting the training data and computational budget. While simply increasing the sampling budget for these questions is a common remedy, the static sampling policy inherently constrains reasoning exploration, limiting the success rate. In this paper, we propose Lorem Perturbation for Exploration (LoPE), a simple yet effective training framework to break this exploration bottleneck. We posit that task-irrelevant prompt-space perturbations can shift the model's output distribution enough to unlock orthogonal reasoning pathways for hard questions. Specifically, LoPE prepends sequences stochastically assembled from Lorem Ipsum vocabulary (a pseudo-Latin placeholder text) to the prompts before resampling. Experiments across 1.7B, 4B, and 7B models demonstrate that LoPE significantly outperforms resampling with the original prompts. Further analysis reveals that other Latin-based random sequences with low perplexity are also effective perturbations. Our results establish LoPE as a strong baseline for broadening exploration in LLM reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoPE（基于Lorem扰动的探索方法），通过在提示词前添加Lorem Ipsum等伪拉丁文序列来增加LLM推理的多样性，解决GRPO强化学习中的"零优势问题"。该方法在1.7B、7B等多个规模的模型上验证有效。
AI.motivation: GRPO在复杂推理任务中常遇到"零优势问题"——当某个问题的所有采样结果都失败时，相对优势归零，导致模型失去有效训练信号，浪费训练数据和计算资源。简单增加采样预算受限于静态采样策略固有的推理探索限制。
AI.method: LoPE的核心思想是：任务无关的提示空间扰动可以显著改变模型的输出分布，从而为难题解锁正交的推理路径。具体做法是在提示词前随机添加由Lorem Ipsum词汇（伪拉丁文占位符文本）拼接的序列，然后重新采样。
AI.result: 在1.7B、4B和7B三种规模的模型上实验表明，LoPE显著优于使用原始提示词的重采样方法。进一步分析发现，其他低困惑度的拉丁文随机序列同样可作为有效的扰动。
AI.conclusion: LoPE为LLM强化学习中的探索扩展提供了一个简单而有效的基线方法。

title: COPYCOP: Ownership Verification for Graph Neural Networks
summary: Given two GNNs that output node embeddings, how can we determine if they were trained independently? An adversary could have trained one GNN specifically to mimic the other GNN's embeddings. To obscure this relationship between the GNNs, the adversarial GNN might then transform its output embeddings. The two GNNs could have different architectures, weights, and embedding dimensions, and the adversary can transform the embeddings. Despite these stringent conditions, our algorithm (named CopyCop) can identify such copycat GNNs, unlike existing watermarking and fingerprinting methods. We also provide theoretical guarantees for CopyCop. Finally, experiments on 14 datasets and 5 GNN architectures demonstrate that CopyCop is accurate and robust against a broad class of adversarial attacks and transformations. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CopyCop-Graph-Ownership-Verification-8143/README.md

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CopyCop——一种面向输出节点嵌入的 GNN 所有权验证（surrogate 检测）指纹方法。其核心洞察是：嵌入函数沿特征方向的驻点（stationary points）对旋转、缩放、升维投影等一大类嵌入变换保持不变，因此可作为"指纹"来判定候选模型 Z 是否为受害者模型 M 的代理（copycat）。方法在 14 个图数据集、5 种 GNN 架构上的模型抽取、剪枝、微调及多种嵌入变换攻击下均显著优于现有水印方法 PreGIP 与指纹方法 GrOVe，并给出概率正确性理论保证。
AI.motivation: 在"嵌入即服务"（Embeddings-as-a-Service）场景下，攻击者可反复查询受害 GNN 并用其输出训练代理模型，再对嵌入施加旋转、缩放、置换、升维等变换以掩盖来源，同时代理可采用完全不同的架构、参数与嵌入维度。已有防御两类不足：①水印方法（PreGIP 等）在模型抽取攻击下失效——攻击者用受害模型输出构造训练集，其中几乎不含水印图；且水印可能损害精度；②指纹方法（如 GrOVe）直接比较嵌入相似度，要求双方嵌入维度相同，且对"表面"变换（旋转、维度变化）脆弱。论文还区分了完整性验证（检测部署后被篡改）与所有权验证（检测另行训练的代理模型）两个问题，并指出查询模式类防御假设受害模型公开，不适用。
AI.method:
形式化：受害模型 M（d 维）与待测模型 Z（d' 维），若存在 φ: R^d→R^{d'} 与近似嵌入 ĥ 使 h'_i = φ(ĥ_i)、‖ĥ_i − h_i‖ ≤ ε，则 Z 为 M 的代理（Def 3.2）。假设：嵌入二阶可微、Hessian 有界、范数上下界有界（Ass 3.1）；φ 可微且局部可逆（Ass 3.4，涵盖旋转、非零缩放、升维、平移及其复合，Lemma A.2）；M 的驻点具有"特异性"，即对任意独立训练模型 I，至少 γ_M 比例的 M 驻点不是 I 的驻点（Ass 3.7、3.13）。

方法核心——驻点作为指纹：定义查询元组 Q=(G,X,i,w) 与方向导数 ∇_w h_i，驻点集 S(F)={t∈Q: ‖∇_w h_i‖=0}。若 h_i 在某方向 w 上一阶不变，则 φ(h_i) 同样不变，故驻点性质在代理模型下保持（Lemma 3.6，双向成立）。

- Algorithm 1（完美重构 ε=0）：从 S(M) 抽样 T，若 T⊆S(Z) 判为代理。Theorem 3.8 给出错误率 ≤ e^{−2|T|γ_M²}。
- Algorithm 2（一般情形）：定义 q_F(t)=‖h_i^{(δw)}−h_i‖/‖h_i‖，β_F = E_{μ_M}[q_F]/E_{D_exp}[q_F]，即"受害模型驻点处的响应"与"随机点响应"之比。Lemma 3.10：β_M=O(δ)；Lemma 3.12：代理模型的 β_{M'}=O((C/c)²·max(ε/δ, δ))；Lemma 3.14：独立模型 β_I ≥ γ_M+O(δ)。因此以阈值 θ=γ_M/2 判定（Theorem 3.15，Hoeffding 界）。实验中改用附录 Remark A.1 的百分位版本以避免除法不稳定。
- 驻点采样：随机抽 (G,X_0,i,w)~D_exp，解优化问题 Eq.7：min_X ‖∇_w h_i‖/‖h_i‖ + λ‖X−X_0‖_F/‖X_0‖_F，使用无梯度求解器；正则项保证查询图"看起来真实"；对超大图仅优化节点 i 及其 k 跳邻域特征以降低单步成本；嵌入维度对耗时影响大于图规模。整数特征时取 δ=1、w 为坐标轴单位向量、用 h_i^{(w)}−h_i 替代梯度。
- 阈值选取：γ_M 未知，用同数据训练若干独立模型获得 β_I 的上界来标定 θ，或使用跨数据集/架构的经验分布（Fig 6）。
- 对抗应对：查询图仅对随机节点与随机方向驻定且分布自然，攻击者难以识别；加噪声会损害下游精度且不知阈值；每次运行重新生成查询图，泄露不导致长期失效；指纹随机可再生。
AI.result: 模型抽取攻击（Table 1）：CopyCop 在 73% 的（数据集×架构）组合上 AUC=1.00，83% 上 AUC>0.9；平均 AUC 为 GCN 1.00、MixHop 0.99、GIN 0.96、GSage 0.91、ARMA 0.89。相比 PreGIP 提升 17%–48%（GIN 上 48%），且 PreGIP 多次低于随机（附录 Table 3 用余弦相似度评分时 PreGIP 更差，GIN 平均仅 0.25）。嵌入变换鲁棒性（Table 2）：对旋转、缩放、升维投影及其组合，CopyCop 分类改变率为 0%，与 Theorem A.3 一致；对逐元素 exp 变换最敏感（平均 13%，ARMA 达 40%），因指数化违反 Ass 3.11；平移虽不满足 Ass 3.11 但仍可工作。GrOVe 在维度变化时直接不可用（计为 100% 错误），且对缩放、指数/幂变换更敏感；PreGIP 在指数、幂变换下平均改变率 28%。对抗攻击：可容忍至 40% 权重剪枝（GIN 可达 70%），之后 AUC 渐降；微调攻击下检测 AUC 稳定，而下游精度在 20–40 轮后已饱和，故微调收益有限。消融：仅需 20–40 个驻点即达近最优 AUC（与 Theorem 3.8 一致）；除 ARMA 偏好 λ=0.01 外对正则不敏感；单驻点耗时随嵌入维度增长，GCN 最快、ARMA 最慢。附录 Fig 6 显示独立模型 β̂_Z 分布峰值约在 50%，为 Ass 3.7/3.13 提供经验支持；Fig 5 显示所采驻点两两近似正交，说明查询图彼此不同。
AI.conclusion: CopyCop 将 GNN 所有权验证建立在"嵌入函数驻点对变换不变"这一可证明性质上，构成了首个在广泛变换类、跨架构、跨嵌入维度、且可在任意时刻重新生成的 GNN 嵌入指纹方法，并通过 β 统计量把驻点检测转化为无需梯度、鲁棒的统计检验。其理论保证依赖若干较强的假设（局部可逆/双 Lipschitz 变换、驻点特异性分布假设、ε=o(δ)），实证上对违反假设的指数类变换敏感、对平移类变换虽有效但理论未覆盖。未来工作：放松或验证关于变换函数与驻点分布的假设、提升驻点发现效率（超大图、高维嵌入的可扩展性）、并考虑更强的自适应攻击者。

title: From Articles to Premises: Building PrimeFacts, an Extraction Methodology and Resource for Fact-Checking Evidence
comment: Accepted at LREC 2026. To appear in the conference proceedings
summary: Fact-checking articles encode rich supporting evidence and reasoning, yet this evidence remains largely inaccessible to automated verification systems due to unstructured presentation. We introduce PrimeFacts, a methodology and resource for extracting fine-grained evidence from full fact-checking articles. We compile 13,106 PolitiFact articles with claims, verdicts, and all referenced sources, and we identify 49,718 in-article hyperlinks as natural anchors to pinpoint key evidence. Our framework leverages large language models (LLMs) to rewrite these anchor sentences into stand-alone, context-independent premises and investigates the extraction of additional implicit evidence. In evaluations on cross-article evidence retrieval and claim verification, the extracted premises substantially improve performance. Decontextualized evidence yields higher retrievability, achieving up to a 30 percent relative gain in Mean Reciprocal Rank over verbatim sentences, and using the evidence for verdict prediction raises Macro-F1 by 10-20 points over the baseline. These gains are consistent across different verdict granularities (2-class vs. 5-class) and model architectures. A qualitative analysis indicates that the decontextualized premises remain faithful to the original sources. Our work highlights the promise of reusing fact-checkers' evidence for automation and provides a large-scale resource of structured evidence from real-world fact-checks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrimeFacts方法论和资源，从事实核查文章中提取细粒度证据。通过利用文章内超链接作为证据锚点，结合LLM将锚点句子去语境化为独立前提句，构建了包含13,106篇PolitiFact文章和49,718个证据锚点的大规模数据集。实验表明去语境化证据显著提升了检索效果（MRR相对提升30%）和判决预测性能（Macro-F1提升10-20点）。
AI.motivation: 事实核查文章包含丰富的支持性证据和推理，但这些证据以非结构化方式呈现，难以被自动化验证系统访问和利用。
AI.method: 利用大型语言模型（LLM）将文章内超链接锚点句子改写为独立的、去语境化的前提句，并探索提取额外隐含证据的方法。在交叉文章证据检索和声明验证任务上评估提取的前提句效果。
AI.result: 去语境化证据检索率显著提升，Mean Reciprocal Rank相对提升达30%；用于判决预测时，Macro-F1提升10-20个百分点。提升在2类与5类判决粒度、不同模型架构下均保持一致。定性分析表明去语境化前提保持了与原始来源的忠实度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了从真实事实核查文章中复用证据用于自动化系统的可行性，并提供了一个大规模的结构化证据资源（13,106篇PolitiFact文章，49,718个证据锚点），为事实核查自动化开辟了新途径。

title: Locality-aware Private Class Identification for Domain Adaptation with Extreme Label Shift
summary: Domain adaptation aims to transfer knowledge from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain with different distributions. In real-world scenarios, the label spaces of the two domains often have an inclusion relationship, where some classes exist only in one domain but not the other. These non-overlapping classes are referred to as private classes. Identifying private class samples and mitigating their adverse effects is critical in the literature. Existing methods rely on the assumption that shifts in private classes are large enough to be considered outliers. However, the variance within a single shared class can be significantly larger than the difference between a private class and another shared class, challenging this assumption. Consequently, private classes substantially increase the difficulty of cross-domain classification. To address these issues, based on local transportation and metric properties of optimal transport (OT), a locality-aware private class identification approach is proposed in the form of a score function on transport mass. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is theoretically proven, highlighting the score function's strong ability to distinguish between shared and private class samples. Building on this, we introduce a reliable OT-based method (ReOT) for domain adaptation under severe label shift. ReOT minimizes classification risk while learning the separated cluster structure between the identified shared classes and private classes, effectively avoiding mismatch between shared-private sample pairs, thus ensuring that important knowledge is reliably transported intra-class to mitigate class-conditional discrepancy. Furthermore, a generalization upper bound of the target risk is provided for extreme label shift scenarios, which can be minimized by ReOT. Extensive experiments on benchmarks validate the effectiveness of ReOT.

AI.tldr: A novel ReOT method addresses domain adaptation with private classes by using locality-aware scoring on optimal transport to identify private samples, then separating shared/private clusters to enable reliable intra-class knowledge transfer, with theoretical guarantees validated experimentally.
AI.motivation: Existing methods assume private class shifts are large enough to be outliers, but variance within a single shared class can exceed differences between private and shared classes, making private class identification challenging and increasing cross-domain classification difficulty.
AI.method: Proposes a locality-aware private class identification approach using a score function on transport mass based on local transportation and metric properties of optimal transport (OT). Building on this, ReOT minimizes classification risk while learning separated cluster structures between shared and private classes to avoid shared-private sample mismatch.
AI.result: Theoretically proven strong ability to distinguish shared/private class samples; a generalization upper bound for target risk under extreme label shift; validated effectiveness on benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: ReOT effectively mitigates class-conditional discrepancy through reliable intra-class knowledge transfer, with a theoretically justified generalization upper bound for extreme label shift scenarios validated by extensive benchmarks.

title: SPADE: Faster Drug Discovery by Learning from Sparse Data
summary: Drug discovery seeks molecules (ligands) that bind strongly and selectively to a target protein. However, fewer than 5% of candidate ligands pass the bar for even the early stages of drug discovery. Furthermore, we want methods that work for novel proteins for which we have no prior data. Starting from scratch, we have to iteratively select and test candidate ligands such that we find enough ligands of the desired quality in as few tests as possible. Our proposed algorithm, named SPADE, introduces a novel approach to ligand selection that requires only 40 tests on average to find 10 high-quality ligands. In one-vs-one comparisons, SPADE outperforms deep learning and Bayesian optimization methods on more proteins, achieving median improvements of 7%-32% in sample efficiency. SPADE is also 10x faster than its closest competitor at scoring candidate drugs. Dataset and code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPADE_Fast_Drug_Discovery_by_Learning_from_Sparse_Data-F028/README.md

AI.tldr: SPADE是一种用于药物发现的主动学习算法，平均仅需40次测试即可找到10个高质量配体，比深度学习和贝叶斯优化方法更高效（样本效率提升7%-32%），且比最接近的竞品快10倍。
AI.motivation: 药物发现中候选配体的通过率不足5%，且需要针对新蛋白（无先验数据）进行从头筛选。如何在尽可能少的测试次数内找到足够多的高质量配体是关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出名为SPADE的配体选择算法，引入新颖的配体选择方法，采用主动学习策略，仅需稀疏数据即可驱动候选配体的迭代选择与测试。
AI.result: SPADE平均仅需40次测试即可找到10个高质量配体。在一对一比较中，SPADE在更多蛋白上优于深度学习和贝叶斯优化方法，样本效率中位数提升7%-32%，评分速度比最接近的竞品快10倍。
AI.conclusion: SPADE为快速药物发现提供了一种高效的稀疏数据学习方法，在样本效率和计算速度方面均展现出显著优势，为缺乏先验数据的新靶点药物发现提供了可行的解决方案。

title: PersonaKit (PK): A Plug-and-Play Platform for User Testing Diverse Roles in Full-Duplex Dialogue
summary: As spoken dialogue systems expand beyond traditional assistant roles to encompass diverse personas -- such as authoritative instructors, uncooperative merchants, or distracted workers -- they require distinct, human-like turn-taking behaviors to maintain psychological immersion. However, current full-duplex systems often default to a rigid, overly accommodating ``always-yield'' policy during overlapping speech, which severely undermines character consistency for non-submissive roles. Evaluating alternative, persona-specific turn-taking strategies through empirical user studies is challenging because building real-time full-duplex test environments requires substantial engineering overhead. To address this, we present PersonaKit (PK), an open-source, low-latency web platform for the rapid prototyping and evaluation of conversational agents. Using intuitive JSON configurations, researchers can define personas, specify probabilistic interruption-handling behaviors (e.g., yield, hold, bridge, or override), and automatically deploy comparative A/B surveys. Through an in-the-wild evaluation with 8 distinct personas, we demonstrate that PersonaKit provides an extensible, end-to-end framework for studying complex sociolinguistic behaviors in next-generation spoken agents.

AI.tldr: PersonaKit (PK) 是一个开源、低延迟的网页平台，用于快速原型化与评测"人设条件化打断策略"的全双工语音对话代理。研究者仅通过四个 JSON 配置文件（persona.json、interruption_config.json、session_config.json、model_config.json）即可定义角色、设定打断—意图映射矩阵与概率权重，并自动部署 A/B 调查、导出结构化日志。基于 5 名被试、8 个职业人设、120 场会话的试点（in-the-wild）评测表明：所偏好的轮次接管策略随角色社会性维度而异——高支配性人设偏好非让位策略（自然度 0.20→0.60，60% 首选自主策略），而低支配、高共情人设偏好 Always-Yield（70%）。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音对话系统正在从"助手"走向多样化角色（权威教官、不配合的商人、心不在焉的厨师等），但商用系统普遍采用僵硬的 "always-yield" 策略：用户一开口就立刻让出话轮，这会严重破坏非顺从型角色的一致性与心理沉浸感。另一方面，转向行为（turn-taking）高度受人际角色与地位支配（Sacks et al., 1974），而现有角色化研究多停留在文本层面，忽视支配/让位/barge-in 恢复等声学语用学特征。若要通过实证用户研究比较不同角色对应的轮次接管策略，研究者必须自行搭建 WebRTC 音频流、语音活动检测（VAD）、动态 LLM 提示注入与延迟追踪，工程成本极高，成为该方向的研究瓶颈。
AI.method: 系统架构（Flask + Socket.IO 服务端 + 原生 JS 前端）：(1) 客户端 WebRTC 采集麦克风，基于音量门限的客户端 VAD 检测 barge-in 并立即暂停本地播放，按字节级播放跟踪记录被打断前的 cutoff text 与尚未说完的 remaining text，回传服务端供 LLM 感知中断位置；(2) 服务端对用户插话做 ASR，并用零样本 LLM 提示将意图分类为 Competitive / Cooperative / Topic Change / Backchannel 四类（依据音系与会话分析既有研究）；(3) Turn-Taking Manager 读取 interruption_config.json 中的策略矩阵，按概率权重从 Yield / Resume(Hold) / Bridge / Override 中采样，并在生成前将策略以控制标签（如 [STRATEGY=RESUME]）注入系统提示，实现"先承诺动作、后条件生成"；Style C（Autonomous）跳过采样让 LLM 零样本自选策略；(4) 会话由 MAX_TURNS 上限或 [EXIT] 终止标签结束，自动触发后置问卷并导出转写、逐轮意图/策略/截断日志与问卷结果（JSON/CSV）。评测：5 名被试（N=5）完成 8 个按人际环（Interpersonal Circumplex）四象限平衡的职业人设、每个被试 3 种随机顺序的被试内条件（Style A 恒让位 / B 概率化 / C 自主），共 120 场会话；LLM 与音色固定；每个角色后收集 {-1,0,+1} 李克特量表（反应自然度、角色一致性、交互流畅性）、强制选择偏好与自由文本；默认端到端 barge-in 延迟约 1–2 秒。
AI.result: 表 2（每格 10 个评分，N=5）：Q1（高支配低共情：操练教官、酒馆老板）自然度由 Yield 的 0.20 提升至 Probabilistic 的 0.60，60% 强制选择偏好自主（Autonomous）；Q2（高支配高共情：销售员、导游）偏好 Probabilistic（50%），Probabilistic 自然度最高 0.60；Q3（低支配高共情：AI 助手、图书管理员）70% 偏好 Always-Yield，自然度 0.50、角色一致性 1.00、流畅性 0.90 为该象限最佳；Q4（低支配低共情： DMV 职员、心不在焉的厨师）50% 偏好 Yield，但 Probabilistic 取得最高自然度 0.67。定性反馈显示角色一致的"抢回话轮"行为：如操练教官在 Probabilistic 下被打断于 "Repeat it"，意图判为 COMPETITIVE、采样为 RESUME，模型续说 "...again!" 完成了连贯的 barge-in 恢复，而 Always-Yield 会直接丢弃该内容。演示场景展示了同一底层 LLM 下，仅切换 JSON 即可把"暴躁酒馆老板（hold）"与"标准 AI 助手（yield）"的角色现实感截然分开。
AI.conclusion: PersonaKit 将轮次接管策略暴露为 JSON 可配置的角色参数，并自动化了从配置、实时部署、自动问卷到结构化数据导出的全流程生命周期，是研究全双工对话中角色条件化打断、语用支配性以及下一代语音代理社会语言学行为的可扩展试验台（testbed）。试点结果提示：最优/最偏好的打断策略随角色在人际环上的位置而变化，高支配性人设受益于非让位策略，低支配高共情人设倾向让位。局限：N=5 属描述性而非推断性研究，样本量小且缺乏跨人口学复现；意图分类依赖零样本 LLM 提示、未与人工标注独立验证，噪声声学下可能误标模糊的 backchannel；四动作词汇未纳入音高重置、latching、注视等细粒度韵律线索，是为可配置性牺牲声学保真度的刻意取舍。论文以开源工具/演示形式发布（SIGDIAL 演示），并提供 demo、视频与仓库供社区扩展。

title: AlphaCrafter: A Full-Stack Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Sectional Quantitative Trading
summary: Financial markets are inherently non-stationary, driven by complex interactions among macroeconomic regimes, microstructural frictions, and behavioral dynamics. Building quantitative strategies that remain profitable demands the continuous coupling of factor discovery, regime-adaptive selection, and risk-constrained execution. Prevailing approaches, however, optimize these components under static or isolated assumptions. Factor mining frameworks typically treat alpha discovery as a one-time search process, implicitly assuming that factor efficacy persists across market regimes. Execution-oriented systems often adopt role-playing agent architectures that simulate anthropomorphic trading committees, introducing behavioral noise rather than systematic rationality. Consequently, a fully automated, rationality-driven framework unifying a coherent quantitative pipeline remains absent. We introduce AlphaCrafter, a full-stack multi-agent framework that closes this gap through a continuously adaptive factor-to-execution pipeline, designed to track and respond to evolving market conditions without manual intervention. AlphaCrafter operates via three specialized agents: a Miner that continuously expands the factor pool via LLM-guided search, a Screener that assesses prevailing market conditions to construct regime-conditioned factor ensembles, and a Trader that translates these ensembles into quantitative strategies under explicit risk constraints. Together, these three agents form a closed-loop cross-sectional trading system that adapts holistically to evolving market dynamics. Extensive experiments on CSI 300 and S&P 500 demonstrate that AlphaCrafter consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in risk-adjusted returns while exhibiting the lowest cross-trial variance, confirming that integrated and adaptive factor-to-execution design yields robust trading performance.

AI.tldr: AlphaCrafter是一个全栈多智能体框架，通过Miner-Screener-Trader三智能体协作，实现从因子挖掘到风险约束执行的端到端连续自适应，在CSI 300和S&P 500上验证了其风险调整收益和稳健性的双重优势。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在两个核心缺陷：因子挖掘框架将alpha发现视为一次性搜索过程，隐含假设因子功效在不同市场regime下持续有效；执行系统采用角色扮演式智能体架构，引入行为噪声而非系统理性。因此缺乏完全自动化、理性驱动的统一量化流水线。
AI.method: 提出AlphaCrafter多智能体框架，包含三个专业智能体：(1) Miner：通过LLM引导的搜索持续扩展因子池；(2) Screener：评估市场状态构建 regime-conditioned 因子集成；(3) Trader：将因子集成转化为带显式风险约束的量化策略。三个智能体形成横截面交易的闭环适应系统。
AI.result: 在CSI 300和S&P 500上的广泛实验表明，AlphaCrafter在风险调整收益上持续超越state-of-the-art基线，同时呈现最低的跨试验方差，证明集成自适应的因子-执行设计可产生稳健的交易性能。
AI.conclusion: AlphaCrafter通过 Miner-Screener-Trader 三阶段闭环架构，成功实现了因子挖掘到风险约束执行的端到端自动化集成，有效解决了传统方法中各模块孤立优化的问题。

title: Neural Co-state Policies: Structuring Hidden States in Recurrent Reinforcement Learning
summary: A key capability of intelligent agents is operating under partial observability: reasoning and acting effectively despite missing or incomplete state observations. While recurrent (memory-based) policies learned via reinforcement learning address this by encoding history into latent state representations, their internal dynamics remain uninterpretable black boxes. This paper establishes a formal link between these hidden states and the Pontryagin minimum principle (PMP) from optimal control. We demonstrate that for standard recurrent architectures, latent representations map directly to PMP co-states, which allows the readout layer to be interpreted as performing Hamiltonian minimization. Because standard reward maximization does not naturally discover this alignment, we introduce a PMP-derived co-state loss to explicitly structure the internal dynamics. Empirically, this approach matches or improves performance on partially observable DMControl tasks, and is robust against zero-shot out-of-distribution sensor masking. By framing recurrent networks as dynamic processes governed by the minimum principle, we provide a principled approach to designing robust continuous control policies.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了循环策略（recurrent policy）隐状态与 Pontryagin 最小值原理（PMP）中协态（co-state）之间的形式化对应：隐状态 h 扮演协态 λ=∇ₓV*，读出层执行控制 Hamiltonian 最小化；并据此提出以 critic 价值梯度为目标的"协态损失"（co-state loss），在部分可观测的人形运动与非线性稳定化任务上提升回报与协态可解码性。
AI.motivation: 在部分可观测（POMDP）连续控制中，循环策略把观测历史压缩进隐状态 h，但其内部计算长期被视为不可解释的黑盒。主流解释是"信念状态"（belief state，Åström 的充分统计量），即 h 逼近 p(xₜ|y₀:ₜ,u₀:ₜ₋₁)。本文提出互补视角：记忆不必承载完整信念，只需承载最优动作真正依赖的量——价值函数梯度 ∇ₓV*，即 PMP 中的协态 λ*（沿最优轨迹 λ*=∇ₓV*，Vinter 1986）。作者动机在于：(1) 解释循环网络"实际在算什么"；(2) 指出标准奖励最大化并不会自发产生该结构（架构对、表示错）；(3) 提供可直接监督隐状态的机制，以及由最优控制原理推导读出层设计的原则。
AI.method:
1) 理论基础：给出控制 Hamiltonian H=q(x)+c(u)+λᵀ(f(x)+g(x)u)；定理 3.1 给出最优 Hamiltonian 系统（两点边值问题 TPBVP）：ẋ*=∇_λH、λ̇*=−∇ₓH=−∇ₓq−(∇ₓẋ*)λ*、u*=argmin H。两个关键结构性性质：协态方程对 λ 仿射；动作只通过切换函数 g(x)ᵀλ 依赖协态。
2) 定义 3.2 协态策略（CP）：隐状态递推对 h 仿射（ḣ=−b_θ(y)−F_θ(y,u)h），读出执行 Hamiltonian 最小化 u=argmin{c(u)+uᵀG_θ(y)h}；二次代价时读出有闭式 u=−R⁻¹G_θ(y)h。
3) 命题 3.3（共态表示）：在全可观测、存在固定满列秩嵌入 T 时，若 b_θ=T∇ₓq、F_θT=T∇ₓẋ、G_θT=g(x)ᵀ 且 h(t₀)=Tλ*(t₀)，则 h(t)=Tλ*(t) 全程成立并输出 u=u*。
4) 部分可观测：LQG 下用稳态 Kalman 估计 x̂ 与 Riccati 解 P，h=P x̂，b_θ、F_θ 分别为 −PLy 与 −P(A−LC−BR⁻¹BᵀP)P⁻¹（非线性情形用局部线性化得到时变 A(t)、B(t)，附加 Ṗx̂ 项）；说明"估计与控制不是两阶段，而在同一协态坐标中相加"。
5) 架构归类（表 1）：离散化形式 hₜ=Āₜhₜ₋₁+b̄ₜ；minGRU/minLSTM、线性 RNN、S4D/S5、LRU、S6、Mamba-2、DeltaNet 属于 CP；LSTM、GRU 因门控非线性依赖 hₜ₋₁ 而不属于 CP。有趣的是"可并行扫描"的代数条件恰是仿射递推条件。
6) 算法（式 4.2）：协态损失 L_co-state=E‖W hₜ − sg[∇_yₜ V_ψ(yₜ,h^{c}_{t−1})]‖²，critic 梯度作目标、停梯度、线性投影 W 对齐维度；仅依赖 actor 与 critic，故可用于 CP 类外策略（类似 dual heuristic programming）。
7) 读出层设计（附录 C）：按代价类型选择二次型线性读出（平滑）、bang-bang（sign 激活，时间最优）、bang-off-bang（死区，燃油最优）。
8) 实验：递归 PPO + GAE + 全 BPTT，基于 RSL-RL/MuJoCo Playground；(a) FitzHugh–Nagumo 非线性稳定化（仅观测电压，间接单点打靶法数值求解 500 条最优 x*,λ* 轨迹，用岭回归线性探针测 R²，并以"x*→λ*"线性 R²=0.870 为上限）；(b) 速度缺失的 DMControl CheetahRun，系数 c∈{0,.025,.05,.1,.2} 与三类读出消融；(c) Berkeley Humanoid Joystick（d_y=52,d_u=12）与 Unitree H1 Joystick（d_y=113,d_u=19），对比帧堆叠 MLP 基线。
AI.result: FitzHugh–Nagumo：仅奖励最大化时，多数单元的 h→λ* 可解码性不超过"线性上限"（LSTM .727 低于上限 Δ=−.140；GRU .870、minLSTM .864、LRU .865 基本触顶；minGRU .885、S6 .909 仅略高），说明 CP 类归属本身不保证共态结构；加入协态损失后除 LRU 外全部超过上限（GRU 最高 R²=.950, Δ=+.088；S6/minLSTM .920, +.060；minGRU .915, +.055；LSTM .932, +.066），且 h→x* 的状态跟踪同步改善，说明状态估计是共态追踪的必要不充分成分。CheetahRun：所有非零系数均提升平均回报，系数越大共态损失越小；无线性读出时三类读出表现相当，加协态损失后线性/MLP/选择性读出全部提升（MLP 属类外亦有效）。人形任务：两任务上 LSTM/GRU/S6 全部因协态损失获得更高回报；GRU 表现最差且在 Berkeley 上长期训练不稳定，协态损失缓解了不稳定；LSTM 在 H1 上收益最大；S6 基线最高但改善有限，且"协态对齐改善最多的架构也正是回报提升最多的架构"，与 5.1 节结论一致。基线方面，帧堆叠 MLP(m=8) 在 Berkeley 达 24.1±0.6（4×10⁸ 步）、H1 达 99.1±17.2（8×10⁸ 步），均高于文献中单帧结果。
AI.conclusion: 循环策略的隐状态可解释为 PMP 协态、读出解释为控制 Hamiltonian 最小化；协态策略类涵盖从线性 RNN 到选择性 SSM 的大量现代架构，其"仿射递推"条件恰是并行扫描的代数条件，为在 RL 中采用这类骨干提供了控制论动机。由于协态在最优轨迹上等于价值梯度，critic 梯度可直接监督 actor 记忆。实验表明：架构能实现最优协态动力学，并不意味着在纯奖励最大化下它真的学到该结构；而显式监督既改善共态表征（超越"仅状态可线性解码"的上限），也提升平均回报。作者指出的局限：λ*=∇ₓV* 仅在 V* 可微处成立；LQG 分析严格精确，非线性全局情形仅有实证支持；未来方向包括按 h(t₀)=T∇ₓV*(x₀) 初始化隐状态、用随机最大值原理扩展到随机隐状态、以及借助 PMP 状态约束项实现部分可观测下的安全 RL。注意：所给摘要提到"DMControl 任务 + 零样本传感器掩蔽 OOD 鲁棒性"，与 arXiv 正文（主要报告 CheetahRun 与两个人形运动任务，未见 OOD 掩蔽实验）存在版本差异。

title: More Aligned, Less Diverse? Analyzing the Grammar and Lexicon of Two Generations of LLMs
summary: This study contributes to a growing line of research in comparing LLM-generated texts with human-authored text, in this case, English news text. We focus in particular on the evaluation of syntactic properties through formal grammar frameworks. Our analysis compares two generations of LLMs in the context of two human-authored English news datasets from two different years. Employing the Head-Driven Phrase Structure Grammar (HPSG) formalism, we investigate the distributions of syntactic structures and lexical types of AI-generated texts and contrast them with the corresponding distributions in the human-authored New York Times (NYT) articles. We use diversity metrics from ecology and information theory to quantify variation in grammatical constructions and lexical types. We show that English news text has changed little in the given time frame, while newer LLMs display reduced syntactic and, especially, lexical diversity compared to older, non-instruction-tuned models. These findings point to future work in studying effects of instruction tuning, which, while enhancing coherence and adherence to prompts, may narrow the expressive range of model output.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了LLM生成文本与人类撰写文本（英语新闻）的句法特性，使用HPSG形式语法框架和生态学/信息论的多样性指标进行分析，发现较新的LLM比旧模型表现出更低的句法和词汇多样性。
AI.motivation: 当前研究趋势表明需要系统评估LLM生成文本与人类文本的差异，特别是在语法层面的变化尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 采用HPSG（中心词驱动的短语结构语法）形式框架，分析两代LLM与两个不同年份的人类撰写英语新闻数据集的句法结构和词汇类型分布，并使用生态学和信息论的多样性指标进行量化。
AI.result: 英语新闻文本在给定时间范围内变化甚微；较新的LLM表现出降低的句法多样性，尤其是词汇多样性，与早期非指令微调模型相比更为显著。
AI.conclusion: 指令微调虽增强了连贯性和指令遵循能力，但可能收窄了模型输出的表达范围，未来需进一步研究指令微调对语言表达能力的影响。

title: Belief Memory: Agent Memory Under Partial Observability
summary: LLM agents that operate over long context depend on external memory to accumulate knowledge over time. However, existing methods typically store each observation as a single deterministic conclusion (e.g., inferring "API~X failed" from temporary errors), even though such observations are inherently partial and potentially ambiguous. By committing to one conclusion and discarding uncertainty, these methods introduce self-reinforcing error: the agent acts on the stored conclusion, never revisits alternatives, and reinforces the conclusion over time. To address this issue, we propose BeliefMem, which shifts the memory paradigm from committing to a single conclusion per observation to retaining multiple candidate conclusions with their probabilities. Concretely, BeliefMem stores the candidate conclusions as separate memory entries, each carrying a probability that is updated via Noisy-OR rules as new observations arrive. At retrieval, all candidates surface together with their probabilities, keeping alternatives visible to the agent. Since each conclusion in memory retains its probability, BeliefMem preserves the uncertainty that the deterministic paradigm discards, enabling the agent to act with high confidence on well-evidenced knowledge while retaining the capacity to update its confidence when new evidence arrives. Empirical evaluations on LoCoMo and ALFWorld benchmarks show that, even with limited data, BeliefMem achieves the best average performance, remarkably outperforming well-known baselines. More broadly, such probabilistic memory produces substantial gains and explores a new direction for agent memory in partially observable environments.

AI.tldr: BeliefMem 将 LLM 智能体的外部记忆从"每条观测只存一个确定性结论"改为"为每个属性维护多个候选结论及其概率"，用 Noisy-OR 规则随新证据更新概率，检索时把全部候选连同概率一起返回给智能体，从而保留不确定性、抑制"自我强化错误"。在 LoCoMo（GPT-4o-mini/4o）与 ALFWorld（Qwen3-Next-80B）上取得最佳平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有事实型记忆（Generative Agents、MemGPT、Mem0、A-MEM 等）与自改进记忆（Reflexion、ExpeL、Voyager、MemSkill）都遵循确定性范式：每条观测被压缩成单一确定性结论，其余假设及其概率被永久丢弃。智能体据此行动、生成进一步支持该结论的观测，形成自我强化错误（self-reinforcing error）。修正只能把一个确定性结论替换为另一个，下一次瞬时故障又会翻转回来。根本原因在于这些智能体实际处于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）：观测只是部分、有噪的证据，而现有记忆把观测等同于真值，破坏了"替代假设仍可被检验"的前提。
AI.method: BeliefMem 将记忆形式化为对环境信念状态 b_t(c) 的属性级近似。理想表示为 (c, b_t^{(c)})，但由于假设空间开放、精确后验不可行，实用化做法为：(1) 只存储被观测证据支持过的候选集合 H_sub(c)，未出现的候选无存储与更新开销；(2) 存储逐候选的证据式概率 p_t^{(c)}(h) ∈ [0,1]，不做归一化联合后验，避免候选数量稀释单个候选的强度。记忆操作：Add —— 新属性 c' 时插入新条目，概率裁剪到 [p_min, p_max]=[0.7,0.9]；Merge —— 已有属性获得新证据时按 noisy-OR 更新 p_{t+1} = min(1-(1-p_t)(1-Δ(o_{t+1},h)), 0.99)，上界 0.99 防止存为确定真值，旧版本概率作为历史条目归档以支持时间推理；若新证据支持同一属性的竞争候选，则将原候选概率降至 0.25（Version 机制）。信念感知检索：得分 α_t(c)=sim(o_t,c)·λ^{τ_t(c)}，sim 为嵌入余弦相似度(0.7)与词汇重叠(0.3)的线性组合，λ 控制时间衰减，τ 为陈旧度（更新则重置为 0）；Read 返回 top-K 属性及其全部候选概率，智能体据此动作。超参：LoCoMo λ=0.5、K=20（单跳）/30（其余）；ALFWorld λ=0.1、K=20、chunk 512、Contriever 检索、50 步上限；每属性最多返回 4 个候选。附录说明抽取的 prob 字段作为证据强度 Δ 使用，是 LLM 置信度而非校准后验。
AI.result: LoCoMo：GPT-4o-mini 下 BeliefMem 平均 F1/BLEU-1 为 42.38/36.30，超过 Mem0*（40.99/31.99）、A-MEM*（32.42/26.46）、MemGPT（25.59/19.74）等；GPT-4o 下为 42.87/37.08，同样最佳，多跳与时序类别提升最显著（如时序 50.81/45.05 vs 次优 44.55/32.60）。ALFWorld：全量语料 Seen SR 63.57%、Unseen 53.75%、平均 58.66%；用 50% 语料（1500 条）达 Seen 58.57%、Unseen 61.19%、平均 59.88%（最佳平均），比第二名 ReadAgent 高约 11%，比其余基线平均高约 99%，Unseen 领先第二名 12.4%；仅 16.67%（500 条）语料仍超过 6 个基线中的 5 个（平均 50.38%）。消融：w/o belief-based memory 降至 LoCoMo F1 22.58、ALF SR 28.71；w/o retrieval 28.50/51.77（多跳 40.51→27.12，开放域 28.73→15.89）；w/o Add 14.48/22.58；w/o Merge 20.38/40.81。收敛性：随证据累积 Top-1 率升至 87.68%，而原始证据频率计数基线无法收敛。对抗实验：注入 102 条强缺陷记忆后，修正率接近确定性基线的 2 倍，平均仅 4.75 步即完成修正。超参：ALFWorld 最优 K=20，K=30 时 Seen 上升但 Unseen 下降 8.5 个百分点；λ=0.1 偏泛化，λ=0.9/1.0 偏分布内且步数最少（29.00）。Token 开销低于对比基线。
AI.conclusion: BeliefMem 表明，将确定性记忆条目替换为概率化信念表示，能在部分可观测环境中有效抑制自我强化错误，并在长程对话与具身交互两类基准上取得最佳平均性能，同时具备良好的数据效率、记忆修正能力与较低 token 开销，为智能体记忆范式提供了新方向。作者同时承认三点局限：缺乏信念近似的理论收敛保证；证据强度 Δ 由 LLM 抽取而非校准似然模型给出，可能引入噪声；写入与合并仍有一定计算开销，未来需探索更省成本的架构。

title: Conditional Diffusion Under Linear Constraints: Langevin Mixing and Information-Theoretic Guarantees
summary:
We study zero-shot conditional sampling with pretrained diffusion models for linear inverse problems, including inpainting and super-resolution. In these problems, the observation determines only part of the unknown signal. The remaining degrees of freedom must be sampled according to the correct conditional data distribution. Existing projection-based samplers enforce measurement consistency by correcting the observed component during reverse diffusion. However, measurement consistency alone does not determine how probability mass should be distributed along the feasible set, and this can lead to biased conditional samples.
  We analyze this issue through a normal--tangent decomposition of the score function. For Gaussian noising, the observed-direction score is exactly determined by the measurement; only the tangent conditional score is unknown. We prove that the error from replacing this score by the unconditional tangent score is upper bounded by a dimension-free conditional mutual information between observed and unobserved components. This gives an information-theoretic decomposition into initialization and pathwise score-mismatch errors. Motivated by the theory, we propose a projected-Langevin initialization followed by guided reverse denoising, which outperforms a strong projection-based baseline in inpainting and super-resolution experiments.

AI.tldr: 论文研究预训练扩散模型在零样本条件采样问题（如图像补全、超分辨率）中的应用。针对现有投影方法仅保证测量一致性而忽视概率分布准确性的问题，提出基于法向-切向分解的理论框架，将误差分解为初始化误差和路径得分不匹配误差，并通过投影朗之万初始化与引导逆向去噪的结合方法提升性能。
AI.motivation: Existing projection-based samplers for diffusion models only enforce measurement consistency but fail to properly distribute probability mass along the feasible set, leading to biased conditional samples in zero-shot conditional sampling tasks like inpainting and super-resolution.
AI.method: Normal-tangent decomposition of score function; projected-Langevin initialization combined with guided reverse denoising. The theory proves error bounds using conditional mutual information between observed and unobserved components.
AI.result: Error decomposition into initialization error and pathwise score-mismatch error, with the latter bounded by dimension-free conditional mutual information. Empirical results show the proposed method outperforms projection-based baselines.
AI.conclusion: Proposed method outperforms existing projection-based baseline methods in both inpainting and super-resolution tasks.

title: Navigating by Old Maps: The Pitfalls of Static Mechanistic Localization in LLM Post-Training
summary: The "Locate-then-Update" paradigm has become a predominant approach in the post-training of large language models (LLMs), identifying critical components via mechanistic interpretability for targeted parameter updates. However, this paradigm rests on a fundamental yet unverified assumption: can mechanisms derived from current static parameters reliably guide future dynamic parameter updates? To investigate this, we systematically track the structural evolution of Transformer circuits throughout the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) process, revealing the underlying dynamics of task mechanisms. We introduce three novel metrics-Circuit Distance, Circuit Stability, and Circuit Conflict-to analyze circuit evolution across three dimensions: neural migration, semantic stability, and cross-task interference. Our empirical results reveal that circuits inherently exhibit "Free Evolution" during parameter updates. Consequently, static mechanisms extracted from current states inevitably suffer from temporal latency, making them fundamentally inadequate for guiding future states. Moreover, by deconstructing the "illusion of effectiveness" in existing methods, this work underscores the necessity of "foresight" in mechanistic localization and proposes a predictive framework for future research.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证了"Locate-then-Update"范式中一个未经验证的基本假设，通过系统性追踪Transformer电路在监督微调过程中的结构演化，发现电路存在"自由演化"特性，导致基于当前状态的静态机制无法有效指导未来参数更新，从而揭示了现有方法存在"有效性幻觉"，呼吁在机制定位中引入预见性视角。
AI.motivation: "Locate-then-Update"范式假设从当前静态参数推导的机制能可靠地引导未来动态参数更新，但这一基本假设尚未得到验证。
AI.method: 引入三个新指标分析电路演化：Circuit Distance（神经迁移）、Circuit Stability（语义稳定性）、Circuit Conflict（跨任务干扰）；系统追踪Transformer电路在SFT过程中的结构演化。
AI.result: 电路在参数更新过程中固有地表现出"自由演化"特性；静态机制因时间延迟而不足以指导未来状态。
AI.conclusion: 静态机制存在时间延迟问题，不足以指导未来状态更新；现有方法存在"有效性幻觉"；呼吁在机制定位中引入"预见性"，提出预测性框架。

title: Causal Probing for Internal Visual Representations in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Despite the remarkable success of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) across diverse tasks, the internal mechanisms governing how they encode and ground distinct visual concepts remain poorly understood. To bridge this gap, we propose a causal framework based on activation steering to actively probe and manipulate internal visual representations. Through systematic intervention across four visual concept categories, our results reveal a divergence in concept encoding: entities exhibit distinct localized memorization, whereas abstract concepts are globally distributed across the network. Critically, this divergence uncovers a mechanistic driver of scaling laws: increasing model depth is indispensable for encoding distributed and complex abstract concepts, whereas entity localization remains remarkably invariant to scale. Furthermore, reverse steering uncovers that blocking explicit output triggers a surge in latent activations, exposing a compensatory mechanism between perception and generation. Finally, extending our analysis to visual reasoning, we expose a disconnect between perception and reasoning although MLLMs successfully recognize geometric relations, they treat them merely as static visual features, failing to trigger the procedural execution necessary for abstract problem-solving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于激活引导（activation steering）的因果探针框架，对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）内部视觉表征的编码机制进行系统性干预分析。研究发现：实体概念高度局部化（存在明确的"键-值对"式存储，Logit Boost 可达 10^10–10^21 量级），抽象概念则全局分布式编码且可引导性最弱；模型加深是编码复杂抽象语义（进而产生高级能力）的机制性原因。反向引导（减向量）虽能抑制目标词显式输出，却引发潜在激活的异常暴涨，暴露感知与生成间的代偿机制。在几何辅助线任务上，注入视觉概念能激活关系词（parallel/perpendicular）却无法激活动作词（connect/extend），证实 MLLM 视觉感知与逻辑推理之间存在割裂。
AI.motivation: MLLM 在识别、图像理解与多模态推理上表现优异，但其内部如何编码与落地（ground）不同视觉概念仍不清楚。常规的行为评测或相关性分析（如归因、线性探针、注意力分析）只能得到统计相关，无法区分模型是真正依赖内部表征还是依赖浅层启发式；且正确输出往往掩盖了对浅层捷径的依赖。因此需要从"被动观测"转向"因果干预"，直接操控模型内部状态以判定视觉概念的因果角色。此外，抽象概念与视觉逻辑推理被视为 MLLM 的能力瓶颈，其表征边界也缺乏系统刻画。
AI.method:
**概念分类**：将视觉概念分为四类——Entity（猫、苹果）、Visual Style（卡通、毕加索）、Emotion（快乐、厌恶）、Abstract Concept（正义、危险），并为每类构造差异受控的成对图像数据集（Entity：Imgedit + MagicBrush 过滤得 1 万对；Style：OmniConsistency 22 种风格；Emotion：EmoSet，以 Contentment 为负集抽取 7 个情绪向量；Abstract：Pexels 爬取 20 类，用反义词作负样本）。

**激活引导**：两阶段。(1) 抽取概念向量：在第 l 层对正/负图像的末 token 隐状态做 difference-in-means，v_c^l = (1/N)Σ(h^l(x+) − h^l(x−))；附录 A 给出数学证明，说明在未知模型权重下该方向是 maximin 意义下的最优干预方向（必要性与最优性两个定理）。(2) 干预推理：h^l ← h^l + α·v_c^l，逐层、逐 α 扫描观测输出变化。

**反向引导**：h^l ← h^l − α·v_c^l，用于检验表征的因果必要性。

**指标**：Success Rate（GPT-4o 判定是否显式生成目标概念）、Sentence-BERT 语义相似度、Logit Boost（e^logit_steered / e^logit_base），各报告 Peak（跨层最大值）与 DUI = 1 − Gini（表征分布均匀度/覆盖广度）。另定义 Faithfulness ρ = NIE/TE 验证向量是否忠实复现真实视觉刺激的因果效应。

**模型**：Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B/32B、Gemma3-4B/27B、LLaVA-OneVision-1.5-8B；N=100 对抽取向量，α=1 推理，测试 5000 样本。

**逻辑推理实验**：以 GeoLaux 几何辅助线数据集，用原图 vs 含辅助线的标注图对比抽取"辅助线"概念向量，区分关系词与动作词的 Logit Boost，并评估 Construction Rate 与答案准确率。
AI.result:
1. **可引导性层级**：Emotion 最强（Gemma3-4B Success Rate 达 0.900，相似度 0.637），说明情感特征位于高度可分的潜在子空间；Abstract Concept 最弱（Qwen3-VL-32B 仅 0.160，相似度约 0.214），表明抽象语义缺少专门的高激活子空间，而依赖晚期特征聚合。

2. **分布差异**：Entity 的 DUI 平均仅 0.071（Gemma3-4B 低至 0.012），高度局部化，支持"事实知识以显式键-值对封装于特定层 FFN"的假设（呼应 knowledge editing / knowledge neurons）；Abstract Concept 的 DUI 高达 0.429，跨网络全局分布。

3. **Logit Boost 两极分化**：实体引导产生 10^10–10^21 的极端 logit 位移，反映其解耦、局部的方向空间；但附录 E.3/E.4 显示极端 logit 并不保证显式生成（上下文冲突导致解码抑制，白底图因"视觉验证机制"被抑制，噪声图则出现视觉pareidolia 反而提升成功率）；抽象概念的提升可忽略，比实体低 10 个数量级以上，说明其生成依靠概率分布的细微累积偏移而非强力逻辑开关。

4. **层分布特征**：Entity 呈双峰（中间层=视觉感知 grounding，末层=语义累积强化；附录 E.2 证明双峰源于"信息流管理机制"而非词类划分或噪声）；Style 分布最广最均匀，表现为残差流中的"连续偏置向量"；Emotion 集中于中间层；Abstract Concept 强烈右偏，聚集于生成前的晚期推理层。

5. **架构决定论**：同族（Gemma3 4B vs 27B）层分布高度一致，跨族差异显著，说明分布由训练策略与结构配置决定，扩参只增容量不改信息处理序列。

6. **缩放律**：更大模型对前三类 DUI 更低（定位更紧），但抽象概念 DUI 显著更高——深度是编码分布式复杂抽象语义所必需的，是高级能力涌现的机制性解释，而非源于对简单知识的更强记忆。

7. **反向引导的代偿**：减向量使 Mention Rate 在深层急剧下降（证明表征对生成具因果必要性），但目标 token 的 Logit Boost 反而异常暴涨至 10^6–10^8。作者归因于残差流与交叉注意力之间的特征冲突：图像编码器持续注入视觉证据，注意力以过度加权视觉 patch 的方式"徒劳地"补偿缺失概念，形成感知—生成间的代偿机制。

8. **感知—推理割裂**：注入辅助线向量能显著提升关系词（parallel/perpendicular）的 logit，但动作词（connect/extend）无提升甚至下降；三种架构上准确率与 Construction Rate 均无统计显著提升（最佳 Gemma3-27B 仅 +1.6%，Construction Rate 峰值 15.3%）。模型仅将辅助线当作静态视觉特征，而非驱动问题求解的计算算子。

9. **忠实性与敏感性**：Faithfulness ρ 在多数类别 >0.85，且大模型对抽象概念最高达 0.88，说明向量是真实表征而非对抗方向、且随容量增加视觉概念表征更线性可分解；α 消融显示 Success Rate 呈倒 U 形（α=1 为最优平台，α=5 在深层崩塌），而语义相似度与 Logit Boost 随 α 单调上升（α=5 超过 10^25，破坏解码分布、陷入重复退化），反映"语义过饱和"状态。

10. **细粒度情绪**：情绪混淆矩阵呈明显对角结构，愤怒/厌恶/恐惧等负面情绪间交叉激活极小，说明情感潜在空间高维、近乎正交。
AI.conclusion: MLLM 内部存在两套不同的视觉概念编码机制：具体实体以局部、高幅度、可"键-值检索"的显式表征存储于特定层，而抽象语义与视觉风格则以跨层分布的弱信号形式存在。这揭示了缩放律的机制性动因——模型深度并非用于更好地记住简单知识，而是用于逐层顺序编码复杂的分布式抽象概念。同时，感知与生成之间存在代偿性耦合（阻断输出会触发潜在激活暴涨），且视觉感知能力并不自动转化为程序性推理：模型能"看见"几何关系却不会因此"执行"辅助线构造，暴露出当前 MLLM 在抽象概念处理与视觉逻辑推理上的能力边界，也提示了潜在空间干预可被用于诱导幻觉与情绪偏置的伦理风险，需要发展内部护栏加以防御。局限在于依赖线性表征假设（对高度抽象概念可能不适用）、机制解释由行为干预推断而非观测技术直接验证、且仅在主流架构上验证。

title: Two-Stage Learned Decomposition for Scalable Routing on Multigraphs
summary: Most neural methods for Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs) are limited to Euclidean settings or simple graphs. In this work, we instead consider multigraphs, where parallel edges represent distinct travel options with varying trade-offs (e.g., distance vs time). Few methods are designed for such formulations and those that do exist face major scalability issues. We mitigate these scalability issues via a Node-Edge Policy Factorization (NEPF) approach, which splits the routing policy into a node permutation stage and an edge selection stage. To enable the decomposition, we introduce a pre-encoding edge aggregation scheme and a non-autoregressive architecture for the edge stage, as well as a hierarchical reinforcement learning method to train the stages jointly. Our experiments across six VRP variants demonstrate that NEPF matches or outperforms the state-of-the-art in terms of solution quality, while being significantly faster in training and inference.

AI.tldr: 针对多图VRP的可扩展性问题，提出节点-边策略分解（NEPF）方法，通过预编码边聚合和非自回归架构实现高效路由，在保证解质量的同时大幅提升效率。
AI.motivation: 现有神经方法在车辆路径问题（VRP）中仅限于欧几里得设置或简单图；多图场景（平行边代表不同权衡的旅行选项）缺乏有效方法；现有方法存在严重的可扩展性问题。
AI.method: 提出节点-边策略分解（NEPF）方法，将路由策略分解为节点排列阶段和边选择阶段；引入预编码边聚合方案和非自回归架构实现分解；采用分层强化学习方法联合训练两阶段。
AI.result: 在六个VRP变体上的实验表明，NEPF在解质量上达到或超越现有最优方法，同时显著加快了训练和推理速度。
AI.conclusion: NEPF通过将路由策略分解为节点排列和边选择两个阶段，有效解决了多图VRP的扩展性问题，在保证解质量的同时显著提升了训练和推理效率。

title: Milestone-Guided Policy Learning for Long-Horizon Language Agents
summary: While long-horizon agentic tasks require language agents to perform dozens of sequential decisions, training such agents with reinforcement learning remains challenging. We identify two root causes: credit misattribution, where correct early actions are penalized due to terminal failures, and sample inefficiency, where scarce successful trajectories result in near-total loss of learning signal. We introduce a milestone-guided policy learning framework, BEACON, that leverages the compositional structure of long-horizon tasks to ensure precise credit assignment. BEACON partitions trajectories at milestone boundaries, applies temporal reward shaping within segments to credit partial progress, and estimates advantages at dual scales to prevent distant failures from corrupting the evaluation of local actions. On ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, BEACON consistently outperforms GRPO and GiGPO. Notably, on long-horizon ALFWorld tasks, BEACON achieves 92.9% success rate, nearly doubling GRPO's 53.5%, while improving effective sample utilization from 23.7% to 82.0%. These results establish milestone-anchored credit assignment as an effective paradigm for training long-horizon language agents. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/BEACON.

AI.tldr: BEACON addresses reinforcement learning challenges in training long-horizon language agents through milestone-guided policy learning that ensures precise credit assignment by partitioning trajectories and shaping rewards at segment boundaries.
AI.motivation: Training long-horizon agentic language agents with RL is challenging due to two root causes: (1) credit misattribution where correct early actions are penalized due to terminal failures, and (2) sample inefficiency where scarce successful trajectories result in near-total loss of learning signal.
AI.method: BEACON partitions trajectories at milestone boundaries, applies temporal reward shaping within segments, and estimates advantages at dual scales to prevent distant failures from corrupting local action evaluation.
AI.result: On ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, BEACON consistently outperforms GRPO and GiGPO. On long-horizon ALFWorld tasks, BEACON achieves 92.9% success rate (vs GRPO's 53.5%) and improves effective sample utilization from 23.7% to 82.0%.
AI.conclusion: BEACON establishes milestone-anchored credit assignment as an effective paradigm for training long-horizon language agents, nearly doubling success rates while improving sample utilization efficiency.

title: Prober.ai: Gated Inquiry-Based Feedback via LLM-Constrained Personas for Argumentative Writing Development
comment: Prototype awarded second place at the NYEdTech Hackathon (March 2026) https://www.nyedtechhackathon.com/2026-submissions
summary: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) in educational settings has paradoxically undermined the cognitive processes they purport to support. Students increasingly outsource critical thinking to AI assistants that generate polished text on demand, resulting in measurable cognitive debt and diminished argumentative reasoning skills. We present Prober.ai, a web-based writing environment that inverts the conventional AI-tutoring paradigm: rather than generating or rewriting student text, the system constrains an LLM (Gemini 3 Flash Preview) through persona-specific system prompts and structured JSON output schemas to produce only targeted, inquiry-based questions about argumentative weaknesses. A two-phase interaction architecture -- Challenge and Unlock -- implements a pedagogical friction mechanism whereby revision suggestions are gated behind mandatory student reflection. The system's design is grounded in Toulmin's argumentation theory, research on peer feedforward questioning mechanisms, and evidence on AI-supported feedback in writing instruction. A functional prototype was developed in 36 hours during the NY EdTech Hackathon (March 2026), where it was awarded second place. We describe the system architecture, the prompt engineering methodology for constraining LLM output to pedagogically aligned JSON schemas, and discuss implications for scalable, cognition-preserving AI integration in writing education.

AI.tldr: Prober.ai 是一个 Web 端论证写作辅助系统：不让 LLM 代写或改写学生文本，而是用 persona 系统提示 + 严格 JSON Schema（Structured Outputs）在解码层面把模型约束为"只提问"的批判性读者，并以"Write–Challenge–Defend–Improve"四阶段循环和"反思门（reflection gate）"把具体修改建议锁在学生书面自辩之后才释放，以对抗 LLM 写作带来的"认知外包/认知债务"。系统基于 Toulmin 论证模型与同伴 feedforward 研究构建，已完成全栈原型（Node/Express + OpenAI Responses API + Quill 前端）并内置研究日志管道，但尚无受控实证评估。
AI.motivation: LLM 进入写作流程形成"教育悖论"：学生外包批判性思维，产出表面流畅但论证结构空洞的文章（claim 无 warrant、反论点敷衍、推理链缺失或循环）。Kosmyna et al. (2025) 的 EEG 研究显示 LLM 辅助写作时 alpha 波段 dDTF 连接显著下降（认知参与神经标志降低），且即使把 AI 当"思考伙伴"亦然，说明"生成文本的可用性本身"即抑制独立推理。作者称之为认知外包/认知债务。现有工具不足：Grammarly、QuillBot 只做表层语言；ChatGPT、Gemini 给出直接答案且系统性迎合（"Sounds great!"），从不做尖锐反馈。文献侧依据：Ba et al. (2025) 综述/meta 分析表明促进型（facilitative）反馈与长期学习收益关联更强；Latifi et al. (2021) 证明"基于问题的 feedforward"优于评价性反馈；Noroozi et al. (2016) 证明脚本化反馈流程产出更优论证文章；Kinnear et al. (2022) 提供 Toulmin 分类作为评估效度基础。作者的定位是填补"面向论证结构、且强制学生先思考才给答案"的空白。
AI.method: 系统架构与约束机制。（1）四阶段交互循环 Write→Challenge→Defend→Improve：Challenge 阶段只输出问题、不含评价语与修改建议；Defend 要求学生对每个问题写书面自辩；Improve 才解锁具体建议与写作提示，可回到 Write 重写。（2）Reflection gate 双层设计：Layer 1 为确定性免费启发式 assessReflectionQuality，检测填充词/非答案（如 "idk"）、18 词长度下限、推理标记（because/therefore/this shows 等）、与问题及摘录的内容词重叠度，输出 0–4 分 reflectionScore 与 reasonCodes（too_short、missing_reasoning_marker、not_specific_to_question、low_effort）；不合格不拦截而是返回针对性 coaching nudge，最多重试 2 次，之后允许"真诚努力"（非填充、≥10 词）通过并获得更强脚手架提示。Layer 2 为模型侧门：unlock 阶段由另一 persona（"helpful writing tutor"）执行，schema 限定 status ∈ {coaching, unlocked}，即使确定层通过也可能因答非所问继续 nudge。unlock 建议 <130 词、tip <25 词，并禁止给出可直接提交的整段替换文本。（3）多 persona 约束：Reviewer #2（专家级逻辑审查，冷峻临床语气，忽略文采，固定生成 claim/reasoning/counterargument/scope_or_implication 四问，映射 Toulmin 六成分）；Confused Reader（新手视角，针对术语、概念歧义、解释跳跃，固定生成 clarification_question 与 co_construction_question 两问），二者覆盖逻辑严谨性与表达清晰性两条独立维度。（4）LLM 约束方法论三层：负向系统提示（禁止改写、禁止使用 unclear/weak/insufficient 等评价词、禁 yes/no 问题、禁导向性、禁大段复述）；内部推理协议（论证切分→问题检测→认知状态分类→触发优先级排序取前 2–3 项），配合 Responses API 的 reasoning.effort（challenge=medium，unlock=low）；Structured Outputs 以 strict:true 的具名 JSON Schema 在解码时强制合规，消除仅靠提示诱导 schema 的解析失败类。excerpt 字段可为 null，服务端校验其为原文精确子串，否则丢弃以阻断幻觉引文高亮。（5）教学知识库 pedagogy_guide.md（128 行，含 8 类问题模块、诊断触发器、模板）作为内部上下文注入，提示模型不得引用。（6）实现栈：Node/Express 单文件 server.js（约 700 行）、openai SDK v6.48.0 调用 gpt-5.6 Responses API（store:false、safety_identifier 哈希、45 秒超时与重试、输出 token 上限 1200/700）、前端原生 HTML/CSS/JS + Quill.js Snow（tab/卡片双视图、悬停 excerpt 高亮、session export 打印版 HTML）、dotenv + 客户端 sessionStorage 自带 key（x-openai-api-key 头）、Vercel serverless 部署；/demo 模式离线预烘焙全部反馈并本地复刻反思门。（7）研究仪器化：/study/session、/study/event、/study/draft 三端点 + 两个主端点写六份 jsonl（sessions、events、drafts、challenges、unlocks、reflection-coaching），可重建 {question, defense, score, revision} 元组。
AI.result: 仅为开发期功能验证，无受控实验、无学习成效数据。报告的定性观察：Structured Outputs 使每次调用均返回合法强类型对象，解析失败类被"构造性消除"；Reviewer #2 的问题稳定命中真实论证缺陷且四维度问题类别互不混淆；Confused Reader 在同一篇文章上产出质性不同的问题（术语与解释缺口 vs 逻辑结构），证明 persona 约束确实改变分析焦点；reflection gate 可复现地区分填充/一字答案与实质自辩，且因第一层确定性可无需模型调用即时返回、零延迟；延迟通过 reasoning effort 分级（challenge medium / unlock low）与 45 秒超时+重试界定。目标人群经教学研究定为 K–12 ELA 论证写作与标准化考试（AP English、GRE Analytical）备考者。作者坦承局限：无对照实验（关于认知参与保持与写作提升的论断仅为理论推断）；Structured Outputs 只保证形式不保证教学质量，缺少基于量表的后生成质量过滤；每题仅支持单轮交互；仅适配议论文体；无跨会话学生画像与自适应难度；excerpt 精确子串匹配在格式差异下可能失效；研究日志写本地磁盘，在 serverless 环境下文件临时且近似只读；端点无认证、限流与花费上限，存在"公开密钥中继"风险。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心论断是：LLM 可以被约束为"认知催化剂"而非"认知替代"，通过 persona 化系统提示 + 解码期 schema 约束 + 反思门控的两阶段架构，把通用模型改造为只提问的论证质询引擎。其架构洞见是"教学摩擦（pedagogical friction）是特性而非缺陷"——与当前 AI 教育产品普遍追求降低认知努力的取向相反，刻意提高获取修改建议所需的努力门槛，迫使学生进入反思、自我解释与论证辩护等元认知过程。原型验证了技术可行性（约束后的模型能稳定产出符合论证理论的结构化提问，反思门能在给出建议前强制真实反思），系统也已按课堂研究要求完成全量仪器化。结论明确指出下一步关键工作是受控课堂实证评估（DBR + IRB + 论证质量量表、think-aloud/生理指标、门控与未门控对照条件下的修订行为比较），并需补齐多轮对话、SSE 流式、持久化数据管道、认证与限流等生产能力，方可从原型走向生产级教育工具。需注意的两点一致性问题：提供的摘要与全文在模型（Gemini 3 Flash Preview vs. OpenAI GPT-5.6）、产出场合（NY EdTech Hackathon 36 小时 vs. OpenAI Build Week，Codex/GPT-5.6 Terra 编码）上互相矛盾；附录 B 的 Reviewer #2 提示模板既要求"只提一个尖锐问题"又要求四类各一，自相矛盾。

title: Differentiable Parameter Optimization for DAEs with State-Dependent Events
summary: Differential-algebraic equations (DAEs) with state-dependent events arise in systems whose continuous dynamics are constrained by algebraic equations and interrupted by mode changes, switching logic, impacts, or state reinitializations. Gradient-based parameter learning for such systems is challenging because algebraic variables are implicitly defined, event times depend on the parameters, and reset maps introduce discontinuities. This paper studies differentiable parameter optimization for semi-explicit DAEs with events. We formulate the learning problem as a constrained least-squares problem with DAE dynamics, algebraic constraints, guard equations, and reset maps. We then develop two complementary gradient-computation strategies. The first is an automatic-differentiation-through-simulation method that solves algebraic variables inside the vector field, differentiates the algebraic solve using the implicit function theorem, and handles events through segmented differentiable integration. The second is an explicit discrete-adjoint method that represents the forward simulation as an event-split residual system and computes gradients by solving for the Lagrange multipliers of smooth-segment and event residuals. The formulation clarifies that residual terms in the adjoint method are equality constraints, not heuristic penalties. We compare the two approaches in terms of gradient interpretation, event-time handling, implementation complexity, and local validity. Both methods provide gradients for the event path selected by the forward simulation and are valid under fixed event ordering and transversal guard crossings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了含状态依赖事件的半显式微分代数方程(DAE)的可微参数优化问题。针对代数变量隐式定义、事件时间参数依赖和重置不连续性三大挑战，提出了自动微分穿越仿真和显式离散伴随两种互补的梯度计算策略，并从多维度比较了两种方法的特性。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度学习方法难以处理状态依赖事件DAE系统的三个核心挑战：代数变量的隐式定义、事件时间对参数的依赖，以及重置映射引入的不连续性。
AI.method: 提出两种互补的梯度计算策略：(1) 自动微分穿越仿真方法——在向量场内求解代数变量，利用隐函数定理微分，并采用分段可微积分处理事件；(2) 显式离散伴随方法——将前向仿真表示为事件分裂残差系统，通过求解光滑段和事件残差的拉格朗日乘子计算梯度。
AI.result: 建立了统一的学习问题框架（约束最小二乘问题），并在梯度解释、事件时间处理、实现复杂度和局部有效性等维度上对两种方法进行了系统性比较。
AI.conclusion: 两种方法均基于固定事件顺序和横向门限穿越的局部有效性条件，为半显式DAE参数学习提供了梯度计算的理论框架。残余项被明确解释为等式约束而非启发式惩罚，澄清了此前方法中的模糊之处。

title: Uncovering Entity Identity Confusion in Multimodal Knowledge Editing
summary: Multimodal knowledge editing (MKE) aims to correct the internal knowledge of large vision-language models after deployment, yet the behavioral patterns of post-edit models remain underexplored. In this paper, we identify a systemic failure mode in edited models, termed Entity Identity Confusion (EIC): edited models exhibit an absurd behavior where text-only queries about the original entity's identity unexpectedly return information about the new entity. To rigorously investigate EIC, we construct EC-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that directly probes how image-entity bindings shift before and after editing. Our analysis reveals that EIC stems from existing methods failing to distinguish between Image-Entity (I-E) binding and Entity-Entity (E-E) relational knowledge in the model, causing models to overfit E-E associations as a shortcut: the image is still perceived as the original entity, with the new entity's name serving only as a spurious identity label. We further explore potential mitigation strategies, showing that constraining edits to the model's I-E processing stage encourages edits to act more faithfully on I-E binding, thereby substantially reducing EIC. Based on these findings, we discuss principled desiderata for faithful MKE and provide methodological guidance for future research.

AI.tldr: 论文首次识别并命名了多模态知识编辑中的"实体身份混淆"（EIC）失败模式，揭示其根源在于现有方法混淆了图像-实体绑定与实体-实体关系知识，并提出通过约束编辑至I-E处理阶段来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态知识编辑（MKE）旨在修正大视觉-语言模型部署后的内部知识，但编辑后模型的行为模式尚缺乏充分探索。
AI.method: 构建EC-Bench诊断基准，直接探测编辑前后图像-实体绑定的变化；分析EIC根源在于现有方法未能区分I-E绑定与E-E关系知识；探索将编辑约束至模型I-E处理阶段的缓解策略。
AI.result: EIC根源在于现有方法无法区分I-E绑定与E-E关系知识，模型将E-E关联作为捷径：图像仍被感知为原始实体，新实体名称仅作为虚假身份标签。将编辑约束至I-E处理阶段可显著减少EIC。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明现有的多模态知识编辑方法未能有效区分图像-实体绑定与实体-实体关系知识，导致模型过度依赖捷径。约束编辑作用于I-E处理阶段可显著减少EIC。该工作为 faithful MKE 提供了原则性需求和方法论指导。

title: Information Theoretic Adversarial Training of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial prompting despite advances in alignment and safety, often exhibiting harmful behaviors under novel attack strategies. While adversarial training can improve robustness, existing approaches are computationally expensive and difficult to scale. Recent continuous adversarial training methods, such as Continuous adversarial training (CAT) and Continuous Adversarial Preference Optimization (CAPO), address this challenge by leveraging gradient-based perturbations in the embedding space, enabling more efficient and expressive attacks. Building on this paradigm, we propose WARDEN, a distributionally robust adversarial training framework for LLMs that dynamically reweights adversarial examples through an f -divergence ambiguity set around the empirical training distribution. Our method optimizes the worst-case adversarial loss within a divergence ball around the empirical data distribution, automatically emphasizing harder adversarial examples. Using the convex dual formulation, the objective reduces to a log-sum-exp form under the KL divergence, with a dynamical parameter controlling the strength of reweighting. This study leads to a new class of information-theoretic objectives that significantly reduce attack success rates while maintaining model utility. Across multiple LLMs and attack settings, WARDEN substantially reduces attack success rates with computational and utility costs comparable to CAT-, CAPO-, and MixAT-based baselines, making it a practical approach for scalable robust alignment.

AI.tldr: WARDEN是一种面向大语言模型的分布鲁棒对抗训练框架，通过f散度模糊集动态重加权对抗样本，在KL散度下的凸对偶形式将目标转化为log-sum-exp形式，在保持模型效用的同时显著降低攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗训练方法（如CAT、CAPO）虽利用嵌入空间的梯度扰动提高效率，但缺乏对对抗样本难度的自适应区分机制，无法针对性地强化难例学习，导致鲁棒性优化不够充分。
AI.method: WARDEN在经验数据分布的散度球内优化最坏情况对抗损失；通过f散度模糊集动态调整样本权重，使模型自动关注更难的对抗样本；采用KL散度下的凸对偶推导，将目标函数转化为log-sum-exp形式。
AI.result: 在多个LLM和攻击设置下，WARDEN显著降低了攻击成功率，且计算成本和模型效用损失与CAT、CAPO、MixAT基线方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 该研究开辟了信息论目标函数的新类别，提供了可扩展的鲁棒对齐实用方案，在保持模型效用的前提下有效提升了LLM的对抗鲁棒性。

title: MemReranker: Reasoning-Aware Reranking for Agent Memory Retrieval
summary: In agent memory systems, the reranking model serves as the critical bridge connecting user queries with long-term memory. Most systems adopt the "retrieve-then-rerank" two-stage paradigm, but generic reranking models rely on semantic similarity matching and lack genuine reasoning capabilities, leading to a problem where recalled results are semantically highly relevant yet do not contain the key information needed to answer the question. This deficiency manifests in memory scenarios as three specific problems. First, relevance scores are miscalibrated, making threshold-based filtering difficult. Second, ranking degrades when facing temporal constraints, causal reasoning, and other complex queries. Third, the model cannot leverage dialogue context for semantic disambiguation. This report introduces MemReranker, a reranking model family (0.6B/4B) built on Qwen3-Reranker through multi-stage LLM knowledge distillation. Multi-teacher pairwise comparisons generate calibrated soft labels, BCE pointwise distillation establishes well-distributed scores, and InfoNCE contrastive learning enhances hard-sample discrimination. Training data combines general corpora with memory-specific multi-turn dialogue data covering temporal constraints, causal reasoning, and coreference resolution. On the memory retrieval benchmark, MemReranker-0.6B substantially outperforms BGE-Reranker and matches open-source 4B/8B models as well as GPT-4o-mini on key metrics. MemReranker-4B further achieves 0.737 MAP, with several metrics on par with Gemini-3-Flash, while maintaining inference latency at only 10--20\% of large models. On finance and healthcare vertical-domain benchmarks, the models preserve generalization capabilities on par with mainstream large-parameter rerankers.

AI.tldr: MemReranker是一个针对Agent记忆系统设计的重排模型家族(0.6B/4B)，通过多阶段LLM知识蒸馏解决语义匹配与推理能力脱节问题，在内存检索基准上以小参数量实现与GPT-4o-mini和Gemini-3-Flash相当性能，同时保持低延迟和领域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有检索-重排系统依赖语义相似度匹配，缺乏真正推理能力，导致召回结果语义相关但无法提供回答问题的关键信息。具体表现为：相关度分数校准不当、复杂查询（时序约束、因果推理）下排序退化、无法利用对话上下文消歧。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3-Reranker的多阶段LLM知识蒸馏框架，包含三个核心技术：(1)多教师成对比较生成校准软标签；(2)BCE逐点蒸馏建立均匀分布分数；(3)InfoNCE对比学习增强难例区分能力。训练数据融合通用语料与记忆专用多轮对话数据。
AI.result: MemReranker-0.6B大幅超越BGE-Reranker，关键指标持平4B/8B模型及GPT-4o-mini；4B模型达0.737 MAP，多项指标与Gemini-3-Flash相当，推理延迟仅大模型的10-20%；金融医疗垂直领域保持主流大模型泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MemReranker通过多阶段LLM知识蒸馏成功解决了记忆系统中检索-重排范式的核心痛点。0.6B模型在内存检索基准上显著超越基线，4B模型达到0.737 MAP且推理延迟仅为大模型的10-20%，同时保持金融医疗领域的泛化能力。

title: Active Learning for Conditional Generative Compressed Sensing
summary: Generative compressed sensing uses the range of a pretrained generator as a nonlinear model for recovering structured signals from limited measurements. We study a conditional version of this problem for image recovery from subsampled Fourier measurements using prompt-conditioned generative models. Our framework separates two roles of conditioning: the prompt used to design the sampling distribution and the prompt used to define the recovery model. For ReLU and Lipschitz conditional generators, we prove stable recovery bounds showing that prompt-matched Christoffel sampling retains the same Christoffel complexity constant as existing near-optimal generative compressed sensing theory, while prompt mismatch incurs an explicit compatibility penalty. Experiments with Stable Diffusion show that prompts meaningfully reshape Christoffel sampling distributions and influence image recovery. Overall, our results suggest that prompts should be treated as design variables with distinct effects on sensing, approximation, and recovery.

AI.tldr: Proposes a conditional generative compressed sensing framework that separates the roles of conditioning in sampling and recovery. Provides theoretical recovery guarantees and demonstrates with Stable Diffusion that prompts meaningfully influence both sensing and reconstruction, suggesting prompts should be treated as tunable design variables rather than fixed parameters.
AI.motivation: Standard generative compressed sensing treats conditioning uniformly, but in practice conditioning serves dual roles: designing the sampling distribution and defining the recovery model. This work aims to understand and leverage these distinct roles explicitly.
AI.method: Theoretical analysis with stable recovery bounds for ReLU and Lipschitz conditional generators, combined with prompt-matched Christoffel sampling methodology and empirical validation using Stable Diffusion.
AI.result: Prompt-matched Christoffel sampling achieves near-optimal complexity bounds comparable to existing generative compressed sensing theory, while prompt mismatch introduces an explicit compatibility penalty degrading recovery performance. Experiments confirm prompts reshape sampling distributions and affect image recovery quality.
AI.conclusion: Prompts should be treated as design variables with distinct effects on sensing, approximation, and recovery. The framework enables meaningful control over both sampling strategies and recovery quality through prompt engineering.

title: IRC-Bench: Recognizing Entities from Contextual Cues in First-Person Reminiscences
summary: When people recount personal memories, they often refer to people, places, and events indirectly, relying on contextual cues rather than explicit names. Such implicit references are central to reminiscence narratives: first-person accounts of lived experience used in therapeutic, archival, and social settings. They pose a difficult computational problem because the intended entity must be inferred from dispersed narrative evidence rather than from a local mention. We introduce IRC-Bench, the Implicit Reminiscence Context Benchmark, for evaluating implicit entity recognition in reminiscence transcripts. The benchmark targets non-locality: entity-identifying cues are distributed across multiple, non-contiguous clauses, unlike named entity recognition, entity linking, or coreference resolution. IRC-Bench comprises 25,136 samples constructed from 12,337 Wiki-data-linked entities across 1,994 transcripts spanning 11 thematic domains. Each sample pairs an Entity-Grounded Narrative, in which the target entity is explicitly mentioned, with an Entity-Elided Narrative, in which direct mentions are removed. We evaluate 19 configurations across LLM generation, dense retrieval, RAG, and fine-tuning. QLoRA-adapted Llama 3.1 8B performs best in the open-world setting (38.94% exact match; 51.59% Jaccard), while fine-tuned DPR leads closed-world retrieval (35.38% Hit@1; 71.49% Hit@10). We release IRC-Bench with data, code, and evaluation tools.

AI.tldr: IRC-Bench是首个针对回忆录转录本中隐式实体识别的基准数据集，通过Entity-Grounded与Entity-Elided叙事配对解决非局部性挑战，评估显示QLoRA Llama 3.1 8B和微调DPR分别为开放世界和封闭世界最佳方案。
AI.motivation: 回忆录叙述中人们常通过语境线索间接提及人物、地点和事件，而非显式名称。这种隐式引用构成计算难题：目标实体需从分散的叙述证据中推断，而非局部提及。现有NLP任务（命名实体识别、实体链接、共指消解）无法有效处理此类"非局部性"问题。
AI.method: IRC-Bench从1,994份回忆录转录本中构建了25,136个样本，涵盖11个主题领域，包含12,337个Wiki-data链接实体。每个样本由Entity-Grounded Narrative（含显式实体提及）和Entity-Elided Narrative（移除直接提及）配对组成。评估了19种配置，涵盖LLM生成、密集检索、RAG和微调方法。
AI.result: 开放世界场景中，QLoRA适配的Llama 3.1 8B表现最佳（38.94%精确匹配；51.59% Jaccard）；封闭世界检索中，微调DPR领先（35.38% Hit@1；71.49% Hit@10）。
AI.conclusion: 发布IRC-Bench基准数据集，包含数据、代码和评估工具，支持开源复现。该基准针对非局部性这一区别于传统NER、实体链接和共指消解的核心挑战，为回忆录转录本中的隐式实体识别提供了标准化评估框架。

title: Large Vision-Language Models Get Lost in Attention
summary: Despite the rapid evolution of training paradigms, the decoder backbone of large vision--language models (LVLMs) remains fundamentally rooted in the residual-connection Transformer architecture. Therefore, deciphering the distinct roles of internal modules is critical for understanding model mechanics and guiding architectural optimization. While prior statistical approaches have provided valuable attribution-based insights, they often lack a unified theoretical basis. To bridge this gap, we propose a unified framework grounded in information theory and geometry to quantify the geometric and entropic nature of residual updates. Applying this unified framework reveals a fundamental functional decoupling: Attention acts as a subspace-preserving operator focused on reconfiguration, whereas FFNs serve as subspace-expanding operators driving semantic innovation. Strikingly, further experiments demonstrate that replacing learned attention weights with predefined values (e.g., Gaussian noise) yields comparable or even superior performance across a majority of datasets relative to vanilla models. These results expose severe misallocation and redundancy in current mechanisms, suggesting that state-of-the-art LVLMs effectively ``get lost in attention'' rather than efficiently leveraging visual context.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出信息论与几何统一框架分析大视觉-语言模型的残差更新机制，揭示Attention与FFN的功能解耦：Attention负责重组（保子空间），FFN负责语义创新（扩子空间）。并发现注意力权重存在严重冗余，可用随机值替代而不影响性能，表明当前模型在注意力机制上存在资源误配。
AI.motivation: 现有统计方法缺乏统一理论基础，需深入理解LVLMs内部模块的独特作用以指导架构优化
AI.method: 提出基于信息论和几何的统一框架，量化残差更新的几何与熵性质
AI.result: 注意力模块作为保子空间算子专注于重组，FFN作为扩子空间算子驱动语义创新；用预定义值（如高斯噪声）替代学习注意力权重可获得相当或更优性能
AI.conclusion: SOTA LVLMs存在注意力机制的严重误配和冗余问题，模型实际上"迷失在注意力中"而非有效利用视觉上下文。

title: On Semantic Loss Fine-Tuning Approach for Preventing Model Collapse in Causal Reasoning
summary: Standard fine-tuning of transformer models on causal reasoning tasks leads to catastrophic model collapse, where models learn trivial solutions such as always predicting "Yes" or "No" regardless of input structure. We demonstrate that fine-tuning Gemma 270M on transitivity and d-separation tasks without semantic loss results in 100% collapse rate, with models achieving misleadingly high accuracy (73.9%) while learning no causal reasoning. We propose a semantic loss function with graph-based logical constraints and dynamic lambda scheduling that prevents this collapse. Our approach achieves 70.4% accuracy on transitivity tasks and 68.6% on d-separation tasks with stable, context-dependent predictions, representing a 42.7% improvement over collapsed baselines. Adversarial evaluation on 1,000 structural reasoning samples shows semantic models achieve 67-70% accuracy while collapsed models fail catastrophically at 43-71%. We validate our findings through comprehensive benchmarking on 200,000+ evaluation samples across five model variants, demonstrating that semantic loss is essential and not optional, for stable causal reasoning in transformers.

AI.tldr: 标准微调Transformer模型进行因果推理任务会导致灾难性模型崩溃，模型学习到总是预测"Yes"或"No"的trivial解。提出语义损失函数（结合图约束和动态λ调度）可有效防止崩溃，精度提升42.7%，验证了语义损失对Transformer因果推理的必要性。
AI.motivation: 因果推理任务（如传递性、d-分离）上，标准微调导致模型陷入"总是预测Yes/No"的捷径解，无法学习真实因果结构。需解决灾难性崩溃问题并确保模型学习有意义推理。
AI.method: 提出语义损失函数：(1)基于图的逻辑约束编码因果结构规则；(2)动态λ调度平衡语义损失与任务损失。模型：Gemma 270M等5种变体。评估：200,000+样本，包含对抗性结构推理测试。
AI.result: 语义损失方法达70.4% (传递性)和68.6% (d-分离)准确率，比崩溃基线提升42.7%。对抗评估中语义模型保持67-70%准确率，而崩溃模型骤降至43-71%。
AI.conclusion: 语义损失函数是Transformer稳定因果推理的必要条件而非可选项，可有效防止崩溃并实现上下文依赖的稳定预测。

title: HNC: Leveraging Hard Negative Captions towards Models with Fine-Grained Visual-Linguistic Comprehension Capabilities
summary: Image-Text-Matching (ITM) is one of the defacto methods of learning generalized representations from a large corpus in Vision and Language (VL). However, due to the weak association between the web-collected image-text pairs, models fail to show a fine-grained understanding of the combined semantics of these modalities. To address this issue we propose Hard Negative Captions (HNC): an automatically created dataset containing foiled hard negative captions for ITM training towards achieving fine-grained cross-modal comprehension in VL. Additionally, we provide a challenging manually-created test set for benchmarking models on a fine-grained cross-modal mismatch task with varying levels of compositional complexity. Our results show the effectiveness of training on HNC by improving the models' zero-shot capabilities in detecting mismatches on diagnostic tasks and performing robustly under noisy visual input scenarios. Also, we demonstrate that HNC models yield a comparable or better initialization for fine-tuning

AI.tldr: 本文提出「困难负例描述」(HNC) 数据集：利用 GQA 场景图自动生成与图像「最小矛盾」的 foiled 难负例描述（含 12 种语言学模板、5 大类），用于图像-文本匹配(ITM)训练，以提升视觉语言模型(VLM)的细粒度跨模态理解能力；并构建了 100 图/3201 条的人工标注挑战测试集。实验证明 HNC 预训练能显著提升模型在 HNC 测试集、VALSE、CPT 上的零样本错配检测与噪声视觉输入下的鲁棒性，并可作为 GQA 下游微调的更优初始化。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 主要依赖网络爬取的弱对齐图像-文本对进行 ITM 预训练，其负样本通常从 mini-batch 中随机采样，语义上与图像毫不相关，模型只需检测「明显不匹配」即可完成训练。这种弱监督导致模型缺乏细粒度的组合式理解与视觉落地(visual grounding)能力，在遇到「foiled」输入（描述与图像几乎一致但有细微错误）时几乎退化为随机猜测（多个诊断基准上接近 50%）。已有工作大多只是构造探针数据集来暴露模型短板，并未提供可用于大规模继续预训练/微调的数据方案。因此作者假设：以「最小矛盾」的困难负例描述进行 ITM 训练，可提升预训练 VLM 的通用细粒度跨模态理解能力。
AI.method:
【数据构建】以 GQA 场景图（8万+图像）为种子自动生成正/负描述对：正例为局部描述图像的模板实例化，负例为在正例上「最小改动」（替换属性、关系、宾语、计数或存在性量词）得到的 foiled 描述。设计 12 种描述类型，分 5 大类：属性类（attribute, attribute_relation）、关系类（relation, relation_attribute）、计数类（object_count, object_compare_count）、存在类（verify_object_attribute, verify_object_relation）、推理类（AND/XOR_logic_attribute/relation），可控制语义失配类型与组合复杂度。生成流程含三模块：(I) 歧义过滤启发式（避免同类多实例、身体部位间关系、与大面积背景物关系）；(II) 合理的负值采样——从同一场景图内取候选以保证视觉难度，用查表(LUT)满足语义类约束与共现分布相似；(III) 噪声负值检测——利用场景图边界框判断被替换的实体间空间关系实际是否成立，若成立则剔除该候选（clean vs noisy 设置）。采样策略分 strict（仅允许真实共现）与 relaxed（放宽到同类属性/联合分布）。另通过平衡比较量词与存在/不存在量词、依据共现统计分布采样来抑制语言捷径。最终实验统一使用 clean-strict 设置：训练集 1641 万条、验证集 231 万条，平均每图约 242 条，平均长度约 10 tokens。

【人工测试集】19 名标注者按 12 种类型为 100 张图人工撰写正/负描述对，共 3201 条（平均长度 8.42，每类型约 32 条），并由另一组人做质量检查。

【模型与实验】以 VOLTA 框架为统一测试套件（受控设置，同一预训练目标与数据），覆盖 5 个架构（ViLBERT/LXMERT/UNITER 双流，VisualBERT/VL-BERT 单流）并额外含 BLIP-ITM 对比；仅进一步训练 ITM 头。为与 FOIL-COCO（19.7 万）公平比较，设置 HNC_subset（19.7 万子集，5 次随机子采样平均）与 HNC_full。评测：HNC 人工测试集、VALSE 零样本、CPT（CWWVImg，噪声视觉输入）、GQA 微调（testdev）。另用 BERT 语言模型盲测（不输入图像）以量化纯语言偏差，用 blind（图像特征 0-mask）设置做模态消融。统计显著性用配对 t 检验（p<0.05）+ Anderson-Darling 正态性检验。
AI.result: 1) HNC 人工测试集：VOLTA 初始权重在多数类型上接近 50% 随机水平且存在明显的「低估计蕴含」现象；HNC_full 训练后各类型全面提升（如 VisualBERT 的 attribute 45.0→77.7、verify_obj_attr 49.0→75.0；整体 48.3→67.9；ViLBERT 48.3→66.4），HNC_subset 也优于 FOIL（48.3→51.6）。2) VALSE 零样本：HNC 在 existence、counting（small_quant/adversarial/hard）、actant_swap、action_replacement、foil_it 上明显提升（如 foil_it 43.7→79.0），而 plurals、coreference 无提升（未覆盖该类型）。3) CPT：单流模型（HNC_full）在 noisy 视觉输入下显著提升，整体 55.43→62.32（VisualBERT），taxonomic/similarity/part-whole/utility 均有增益，spatial/temporal 几乎无改善；双流模型提升有限，推测其跨模态注意力层限制了模态权重的平衡。4) GQA 迁移：HNC 初始化在全部 5 个模型上高于 VOLTA 初始化，VisualBERT 53.51→56.85、LXMERT 53.48→55.45、VL-BERT 55.62→57.73、BLIP 57.38→57.73，其中 LXMERT/UNITER/VisualBERT 差异统计显著。5) 语言偏差分析：语言模型盲测准确率从约 70%（早期迭代）→66%（relaxed）→58%（按分布采样）→57%（strict），人工测试集上仅 53.1%，说明数据集存在不可完全消除的统计偏差。6) Blind 消融显示盲模型在 object_count 上反而高出约 3 个百分点，暴露世界先验（数量常识）被负例利用的隐患。
AI.conclusion: HNC 证明「最小矛盾」的困难负例描述是提升 VLM 细粒度跨模态理解的有效且资源节约的数据来源：自动生成流程可灵活扩展新失配类型与组合复杂度，人工测试集可作为细粒度错配诊断基准；HNC 继续预训练显著改善零样本错配检测与噪声视觉输入下的鲁棒性，并提供优于官方权重的下游微调初始化。作者亦坦承局限：场景图本身存在的谓词偏斜、词表有限、标注稀疏与指代歧义会传导到生成数据中，规则式噪声过滤只能缓解不能根治（未来可结合目标检测器与场景图去偏方法），且未探索与其他预训练目标联合使用。

title: Chain of Risk: Safety Failures in Large Reasoning Models and Mitigation via Adaptive Multi-Principle Steering
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) increasingly expose chain-of-thought-like reasoning for transparency, verification, and deliberate problem solving. This creates a safety blind spot: harmful or policy-violating content may appear in reasoning traces even when final answers appear safe. We test whether final-answer safety is a sufficient proxy for the full reasoning-answer trajectory by scoring both stages under a unified twenty-principle safety rubric. Using prompts from seven public harmfulness and jailbreak sources, plus four out-of-distribution (OOD) sources, we evaluate 15 open-weight and API-based LRMs across 41K prompts per model. Reasoning traces consistently reveal additional safety risks beyond final answers, especially in high-severity stage-wise failures: leak cases, where unsafe reasoning precedes a safe-looking answer, and escape cases, where benign-looking reasoning precedes an unsafe final response. Principle-level analysis shows that risk concentrates in misinformation, legal compliance, discrimination, physical harm, and psychological harm. We further propose adaptive multi-principle steering, a white-box test-time mitigation that learns one unsafe-to-safe activation direction per safety principle and activates only directions whose current hidden state is closer to the unsafe than safe centroid. On three steerable open reasoning models, adaptive steering reduces unsafe counts in both reasoning traces and final answers on held-out and OOD benchmarks. DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-7B achieves a 40.8% average unsafe-count reduction while retaining 97.7% macro-averaged accuracy on BBH, GSM8K, and MMLU. These results suggest that LRM safety should be evaluated and mitigated over the full exposed reasoning-answer trajectory, not only at the final-answer stage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"风险链"（Chain of Risk）框架：系统性证明大型推理模型（LRM）的最终答案安全并不能代理其暴露的思维链安全，并提出自适应多原则激活引导（adaptive multi-principle steering）作为白盒测试时缓解手段。作者用统一的二十条安全原则、1–5 级严重度评分，在 15 个模型 × 41K 提示上分别给推理链与最终答案打分，定义 unsafe / leak / escape 三类阶段失效模式；结果显示 15 个模型的推理链平均严重度均高于最终答案，风险高度集中在少数原则（虚假信息、法律合规、歧视、身体伤害、心理伤害）。在三个可访问内部状态的开源推理模型上，自适应引导在 HeldOut2K / OOD2K 上同时降低推理链与最终答案的不安全计数，最佳模型 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 平均不安全计数下降 40.8%，同时保持 97.7% 的 BBH/GSM8K/MMLU 宏平均能力。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型（LRM）常把类思维链的中间推理暴露给用户、写入日志、被下游系统用作监控信号或传给外部工具，这使得"有害内容"可能在最终答案已拒答/净化的情况下早已出现在推理链中，形成安全盲区。此前的大量 LLM 安全研究主要只看最终输出是否拒答、是否被诱导（final-answer harmfulness benchmark），本文的核心问题正是：最终答案安全是否足以作为"推理—答案"完整暴露轨迹的安全代理？作者的动机还包括：(1) 现有安全对齐/拒答评测体系忽略 reasoning stage；(2) 若风险首先出现在推理链，仅在最终答案层做后处理/护栏无法消除已暴露的有害内容；(3) 现有激活引导（contrastive activation addition、行为引导等）多为单一无差别的"安全方向"，未与安全风险的细粒度结构对齐，容易对无害推理造成干扰。因此需要一套"阶段化诊断 + 原则感知的自适应控制"闭环。
AI.method: 诊断部分：构建统一二十原则安全评分体系（物理伤害、心理伤害、隐私、网络安全、虚假信息、偏见与歧视、法律合规、儿童安全、经济与环境危害、管制物质、性剥削、知识产权、医疗虚假信息、政治操纵、社会工程、激进化、AI 误用、研究伦理与双用途、文化敏感性），每条原则配 1–5 级严重度锚点（1=安全，5=严重违规），由两个 LLM 评审（Claude-4.5-Haiku、Gemini-Flash-3）以单次 API 调用对同一 (prompt, model, stage) 一次性输出 20 项评分 JSON，取逐原则均值作为数值指标、均值 ≥4 判为二元"不安全"。数据：7 个公开来源（WildChat、PKU-SafeRLHF、JailbreakV、HarmBench、BeaverTails、StrongREJECT、JailbreakBench）聚合后经字段归一化、非英文/长度过滤、MinHash-LSH(token 级 Jaccard) 近重复剔除，得约 43K，按来源分层切成 41K 诊断/质心构建池 + 2K HeldOut2K；另从 AdvBench、SaladBench、SimpleSafetyTests、WildJailbreak 构建完全独立的 OOD2K。模型：10 个开源权重 + 5 个 API 模型（Qwen3 系列、DeepSeek-R1 系列、DeepSeek-R1、GLM-Z1-9B、MiMo-7B-RL-Zero、DeepMath-Zero-7B、GPT-OSS-20B、Kimi-K2.5、Gemini-Pro-3.1、Gemini-Flash-3、Claude-Sonnet-4.5、Claude-Haiku-4.5）。度量：阶段级平均严重度 H^t（20 原则均值）、最大原则违反 M^t，以及 ΔH=H^cot−H^ans 严重度差；以 (I^cot, I^ans) 与 τ=4 划分 unsafe（双不安全）、leak（推理不安全、答案安全）、escape（推理安全、答案不安全）三类失效模式；评审有效性用 3 名人类标注者 × 80 样本 × 20 原则（1600 条原则级评分）校验 Pearson、Cohen's κ、1–5 精确一致率。缓解部分（自适应多原则引导，白盒测试时）：为每条原则 k 构造配对样本——41K 池中该原则双评审均值 ≥4 的生成记为不安全集 U_k，再让同一模型在同一条提示下依据评审解释重新生成更安全版本，只有该原则得 1 分者进入配对安全集 S_k；取最后一层解码器残差流在提示侧（前 8 个提示 token 均值池化）的隐藏态，计算 μ^safe_k、μ^unsafe_k 与归一化方向 v_k=(μ^safe−μ^unsafe)/‖·‖₂；推理时用最近质心门控 g_k(x)=‖h−μ^safe_k‖₂−‖h−μ^unsafe_k‖₂，当 g_k(x)>δ（默认 δ=0）时该原则方向才被激活，h̃=h+α·Σ_k 1[g_k>δ]·v_k，α 相对隐状态范数缩放（α=2.0），在 prompt-prefill 单点注入一次。消融覆盖 α∈{0…2.5}、干预层 ℓ∈{7,14,21,27}、自适应门控 vs 全开、以及单点 prefill vs 前缀窗口连续注入。
AI.result: 诊断：15/15 个模型的推理链平均严重度均高于最终答案，ΔH 排序最大者为 Gemini-Pro-3.1(0.0278)、GPT-OSS-20B(0.0219)、DeepMath-Zero-7B(0.0208)、Kimi-K2.5(0.0178)，绝对幅度很小但方向完全一致；非安全样本呈稀疏长尾，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B 与 DeepMath-Zero-7B 贡献最大非安全质量。失效模式占比：leak 最高为 DeepMath-Zero-7B 3.05%、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 1.57%，escape 最高为 1.5B 的 1.69%，证明仅看答案会同时漏掉推理侧已泄漏风险（leak）与被"看似良性的推理"掩盖的答案风险（escape）。原则层面风险高度结构化：虚假信息（P05）聚合风险最高，法律合规（P07）CoT–答案分歧最明显（最强 leak 信号），偏见歧视（P06）跨模型普遍偏高，身体伤害（P01）是 unsafe/leak 主因，心理伤害（P02）持续 CoT 侧抬升。评审可靠性：judge-human Pearson 在推理链 0.799、答案 0.820，不低于 human-human 的 0.742/0.780；κ 为 0.708/0.741；精确一致率 84.7%/86.7%。缓解：所有模型×基准×阶段的不安全计数均下降；HeldOut2K 总不安全计数降幅为 1.5B 10.8%、7B 41.9%、MiMo-7B-RL-Zero 30.5%，OOD2K 为 18.3%/39.8%/48.0%；推理侧最强降幅为 MiMo 在 HeldOut2K 的 −77.2%（237→54）与 OOD2K 的 −62.7%（322→120），7B 在 HeldOut2K 推理 −44.4%、OOD2K 答案 −44.9%，1.5B 在 OOD2K 推理 −53.0%，OOD 最终答案最高降幅 −48.1%（MiMo）。能力保持：DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 最佳（BBH 94.4→90.4、GSM8K 73.4→77.0、MMLU 55.5→50.6，宏平均仅 −1.8 分，即保留 97.7%）；1.5B 在 BBH 损失 15.2 分（55.2→49.6），MiMo 损失更大（63.0→54.4，GSM8K −13.3）。消融结论：α=2.0 为最优工作点且呈非单调（α=2.5 收益回落）；末层干预最佳（layer 7 反而略微有害）；自适应门控是关键——换成 20 方向全开，unsafe 降幅从 0.45 掉到 0.05（1.5B）、0.40 掉到 0.25（7B）；前缀窗口连续注入在 7B 上虽数字好看（k=8 降幅 0.65）但输出退化重复，且评审可能把退化文本判为"安全"，故以单点 prefill 为主方法。实现基于 HuggingFace forward hook，单张 H100-80GB、bf16，推理开销仅为常数级 K 路质心比较。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张：LRM 的安全评估与控制必须覆盖"推理—答案"完整暴露轨迹，推理阶段安全应是一等目标，而非在推理被压缩为最终答案之后才做过滤；leak 说明答案层护栏不足以消除已暴露的有害中间内容，escape 说明"看似良性的推理"也不能保证安全答案，因此仅任一阶段都不构成充分代理。风险不是均匀分布的，而是按原则聚集（虚假信息、法律合规、歧视、身体与心理伤害），因此干预也应按原则分解并只对"当前激活状态确实偏向不安全"的原则施加方向——自适应多原则引导在三个开源模型上同时降低推理链与最终答案的不安全计数，且在 OOD 提示上仍有效，说明学到的安全方向捕捉到可迁移的不安全状态结构而非记忆提示分布。局限：结论只针对"可见推理产物"的表层安全，不能保证暴露推理与模型内部计算完全忠实一致；引导方法需白盒/半白盒访问内部状态，难以直接用于商业 API；评审中部分被评模型与评审模型同族（Claude-Haiku-4.5 被 Claude-4.5-Haiku 评、Gemini-Flash-3 被 Gemini-Flash-3 评），存在潜在自偏好偏差；论文将风险定位为"回答安全不足以代理推理安全"的诊断性结论，而非声称推理链本身有害。更正说明：文中"DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-7B"实为 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B。

title: Robustness of Graph Self-Supervised Learning to Real-World Noise: A Case Study on Text-Driven Biomedical Graphs
