AI.method: 方法上，将雨场重建建模为贝叶斯逆问题，以扩散模型（DM）作为高保真空间先验分布。该方法无需额外训练即可通过 Plug-and-Play、序列蒙特卡洛（Sequential Monte Carlo）和副本交换（Replica Exchange）等多种方法进行后验采样。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比现有CML重建基线方法取得了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过将扩散模型作为高保真空间先验，成功将降雨场重建问题框架化为贝叶斯逆问题，绕过了传统方法依赖训练数据的局限，并为后验采样提供了多种灵活的求解方法家族。

title: Detecting Time Series Anomalies Like an Expert: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework with Specialized Analyzers
comment: Preprint. 9 pages main text, 29 pages total, 8 figures, 9 tables, with appendix
summary: Recent studies have explored large language models for time-series anomaly detection, yet existing approaches often rely on a single general-purpose model to directly infer anomaly indices or intervals, limiting controllability, interpretability, and reliability for complex anomaly patterns. We propose SAGE (Specialized Analyzer Group for Expert-like Detection), a multi-agent framework for structured anomaly diagnosis in univariate time series. It decomposes anomaly analysis into four specialized Analyzers for point, structural, seasonal, and pattern anomalies. Each Analyzer applies family-specific numerical tools and diagnostic visualizations to generate evidence, while an evidence-grounded Detector consolidates the evidence into confidence-scored anomaly records with intervals and candidate types. A Supervisor then converts these structured records into analyst-facing diagnostic reports. SAGE further constructs synthetic in-context examples from normal-reference training segments, without using real anomalous segments or anomaly-type labels as in-context examples. Across three benchmarks, SAGE achieves the best average performance among strong ML/DL and language-model-based baselines. Ablation studies and human evaluation further show that the proposed framework improves detection reliability and the practical usefulness of diagnostic outputs.

AI.tldr: SAGE是一种用于单变量时间序列结构化异常诊断的多智能体框架，通过四个专业化分析器分解异常分析任务，结合证据驱动的检测器和监督器实现可靠的异常检测与诊断报告生成，无需真实异常样本即可构建有效的上下文学习能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的时间序列异常检测方法通常依赖单一通用模型直接推断异常索引或区间，难以应对复杂异常模式，在可控性、可解释性和可靠性方面存在显著局限。
AI.method: 提出多智能体框架SAGE，包含四个专业化分析器（点、结构、季节、模式异常），每个分析器使用家族特定的数值工具和诊断可视化生成证据；证据驱动的检测器将证据整合为带置信度评分的异常记录；监督器将结构化记录转换为面向分析师的诊断报告。该框架从正常参考训练片段构建合成上下文示例，无需真实异常片段或异常类型标签。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，SAGE在强基线（ML/DL和基于语言模型的模型）中取得最佳平均性能。消融实验和人类评估表明，该框架有效提升了检测可靠性和诊断输出的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过多智能体协作架构和证据驱动机制，在三个基准数据集上实现了最佳平均性能，显著提升了时序异常检测的可靠性和诊断输出的实用性，为复杂异常模式的可解释分析提供了新范式。

title: MOSAIC: Module Discovery via Sparse Additive Identifiable Causal Learning for Scientific Time Series
summary: Causal representation learning (CRL) seeks to recover latent variables with identifiability guarantees, typically up to permutation and component-wise reparameterization under appropriate assumptions. However, identifiability does not imply interpretability: latent semantics are typically assigned post hoc by alignment with known ground-truth factors. This limitation is particularly acute in scientific time series, where underlying mechanisms are unknown and discovering interpretable structure is a primary goal. In contrast, scientific observations (such as residue-pair distances, climate indices, or process sensors) are inherently semantic, as they correspond to named physical quantities. This raises a key question: can the interpretability of observations be transferred to the identifiable latent space? We propose MOSAIC (Module discovery via Sparse Additive Identifiable Causal learning), a sparse temporal VAE that integrates temporal CRL identifiability with support recovery over observed variables. MOSAIC identifies latent variables via regime-conditioned temporal variation, and recovers for each latent a sparse set of associated observations through an additive decoder, yielding module-level interpretability. We show that ANOVA main-effect supports are identifiable under general smooth mixing functions, and provide finite-sample recovery guarantees for a tractable sparse-additive variant. Empirically, MOSAIC recovers domain-consistent variable groups across RNA molecular dynamics, solar wind, ENSO climate, the Tennessee Eastman process, and a synthetic tokamak benchmark, enabling interpretable discovery of latent mechanisms in scientific time series.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC将可解释观测的语义迁移到潜在空间，通过稀疏加性解码器实现模块级可解释性。在RNA分子动力学、太阳风、ENSO气候、田纳西伊士曼过程和托卡马克基准上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: Existing CRL methods achieve identifiability (up to permutation and reparameterization) but lack interpretability—latent semantics require post hoc alignment with ground truth. This is critical for scientific time series where discovering interpretable structures is the primary goal and underlying mechanisms are unknown.
AI.method: MOSAIC integrates temporal CRL identifiability with support recovery via a sparse additive decoder. The method identifies latent variables via regime-conditioned temporal variation and recovers sparse associated observation sets per latent. Theoretical analysis shows ANOVA main-effect supports are identifiable under general smooth mixing functions with finite-sample recovery guarantees for sparse-additive variants.
AI.result: MOSAIC enables interpretable discovery of latent mechanisms in scientific time series by recovering domain-consistent variable groups.
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC recovers domain-consistent variable groups across RNA molecular dynamics, solar wind, ENSO climate, Tennessee Eastman process, and synthetic tokamak benchmark, enabling interpretable discovery of latent mechanisms in scientific time series.

title: Teaching Thinking Models to Reason with Tools: A Full-Pipeline Recipe for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
summary: Tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) offers a direct way to extend thinking models beyond the limits of text-only reasoning. Paradoxically, we observe that tool-enabled evaluation can degrade reasoning performance even when the strong thinking models make almost no actual tool calls. In this paper, we investigate how to inject natural tool-use behavior into a strong thinking model without sacrificing its no-tool reasoning ability, and present a comprehensive TIR recipe. We highlight that (i) the effectiveness of TIR supervised fine-tuning (SFT) hinges on the learnability of teacher trajectories, which should prioritize problems inherently suited for tool-augmented solutions; (ii) controlling the proportion of tool-use trajectories could mitigate the catastrophic forgetting of text-only reasoning capacity; (iii) optimizing for pass@k and response length instead of training loss could maximize TIR SFT gains while preserving headroom for reinforcement learning (RL) exploration; (iv) a stable RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) stage, built upon suitable SFT initialization and explicit safeguards against mode collapse, provides a simple yet remarkably effective solution. When applied to Qwen3 thinking models at 4B and 30B scales, our recipe yields models that achieve state-of-the-art performance in a wide range of benchmarks among open-source models, such as 96.7% and 99.2% on AIME 2025 for 4B and 30B, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种综合性的TIR（工具集成推理）训练方案，通过精心设计的SFT和RLVR阶段，在保持模型文本推理能力的同时有效注入工具使用行为，最终在Qwen3 4B/30B模型上实现开源SOTA性能，AIME 2025分别达到96.7%和99.2%。
AI.motivation: 观察到工具启用评估可能降低推理性能这一悖论现象，即使强思考模型几乎不进行实际工具调用；同时需解决如何在注入工具使用行为的同时不牺牲无工具推理能力的问题。
AI.method: 提出四项关键技术：（i）选择适合工具增强的教师轨迹问题；（ii）控制工具使用轨迹比例防止灾难性遗忘；（iii）优化pass@k和响应长度而非训练损失；（iv）基于适当SFT初始化的稳定RLVR阶段。
AI.result: 在Qwen3思考模型4B和30B规模上实现开源SOTA，AIME 2025分别达到96.7%和99.2%。
AI.conclusion: 综合SFT和RLVR的TIR训练配方是有效方案，关键在于教师轨迹可学习性、工具轨迹比例控制、训练目标选择以及稳定的RLVR阶段。

title: SkillRet: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Skill Retrieval in LLM Agents
summary: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed with large libraries of reusable skills, selecting the right skill for a user request has become a critical systems challenge. In small libraries, users may invoke skills explicitly by name, but this assumption breaks down as skill ecosystems grow under tight context and latency budgets. Despite its practical importance, skill retrieval remains underexplored, with limited benchmarks and little understanding of retrieval behavior on realistic skill libraries. To address this gap, we introduce SkillRet, a large-scale benchmark for skill retrieval in LLM agents. SkillRet contains 17,810 public agent skills, organized with structured semantic tags and a two-level taxonomy spanning 6 major categories and 18 sub-categories. It provides 63,259 training samples and 4,997 evaluation queries with disjoint skill pools, enabling both benchmarking and retrieval-oriented training. Across a diverse set of retrievers, we find that skill retrieval remains far from solved: off-the-shelf models struggle on realistic large-scale skill libraries, and prior skill-retrieval models still leave substantial headroom. Task-specific fine-tuning on SkillRet substantially improves performance, improving NDCG@10 by +13.1 points over the strongest prior retriever and by +16.9 points over the strongest off-the-shelf retriever. Our analysis further suggests that these gains arise because fine-tuned models better focus on the small skill-relevant signals within long and noisy queries. These results establish SkillRet as a strong benchmark and foundation for future research on retrieval in large-scale agent systems.

AI.tldr: SkillRet提出大规模技能检索基准，包含近18,000个技能和近5,000个评估查询，系统评估表明微调模型可通过聚焦技能相关信号实现显著性能提升，为LLM智能体技能检索研究奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体技能库规模扩大，在严格的上下文和延迟限制下，如何为用户请求选择合适技能成为关键挑战，但技能检索研究缺乏基准测试和对其在真实大规模技能库上行为的理解。
AI.method: 提出SkillRet基准，包含17,810个公共智能体技能、6大类18子类的两层分类体系、63,259个训练样本和4,997个评估查询，采用离析技能池设计，并对多种检索器进行系统评估和任务特定微调。
AI.result: 技能检索仍远未解决：现成模型在真实大规模技能库上表现不佳，任务特定微调显著提升性能，NDCG@10提升+13.1点（相对最强先前模型）和+16.9点（相对最强现成模型），且收益源于微调模型更好地聚焦于冗长嘈杂查询中的小型技能相关信号。
AI.conclusion: SkillRet为大规模智能体系统中的技能检索研究提供了强有力的基准和训练基础，任务特定的微调能显著提升检索性能。

title: Energy Generative Modeling: A Lyapunov-based Energy Matching Perspective
summary: Generative models based on static scalar energy functions represent an emerging paradigm in which a single time independent potential drives sample generation through its gradient field, eliminating the need for time conditioning entirely. We unify the training and sampling phases of this paradigm, conventionally treated as separate procedures, within a single framework: density transport on the Wasserstein space, cast as a nonlinear control problem in which the Kullback Leibler (KL) divergence serves as a Lyapunov function. Training and sampling are then two instances of this same master dynamics, differing only in initial condition. Within this autonomous framework we develop two analytic results. First, since the Lyapunov certificate is asymptotic, we derive a finite step stopping criterion for Langevin sampling and prove that no Lyapunov certificate exists for the deterministic gradient flow on the same energy landscape. Second, the reformulation brings the toolkit of nonlinear control theory to bear on static scalar energy generative modeling, that is, we show that additive composition of trained scalar energies retains an explicit Gibbs invariant measure and inherits the closed-loop Lyapunov certificate. Beyond these immediate results, this reformulation bridges static scalar energy generative models with the full toolkit of nonlinear control theory, opening the door to barrier functions for constrained generation and contraction metrics for accelerated sampling. Experiments on synthetic distributions validate the theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文将静态标量能量生成模型的训练与采样阶段统一为Wasserstein空间上的非线性控制问题，以KL散度为Lyapunov函数。在此框架下，证明了Langevin采样可获得有限步停止准则，并建立了能量函数加性组合保持不变测度和Lyapunov证书的理论基础，为约束生成和加速采样提供了控制理论工具。
AI.motivation: 传统静态标量能量生成模型中，训练和采样被视为分离的两个阶段，研究旨在统一这两个过程，并引入非线性控制理论工具。
AI.method: 通过将密度传输建模为Wasserstein空间上的非线性控制问题，以KL散度作为Lyapunov函数，实现训练与采样的统一框架化。
AI.result: (1) 推导出Langevin采样的有限步停止准则，证明确定性梯度流在同一能量景观下不存在Lyapunov证书；(2) 证明训练得到的标量能量的加性组合保持显式Gibbs不变测度并继承闭环Lyapunov证书。实验验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将静态标量能量生成模型与非线性控制理论统一框架，建立了采样停止准则，并证明了能量函数的加性组合仍保持Lyapunov证书和Gibbs不变测度，为约束生成和加速采样奠定了理论基础。

title: Measuring Evaluation-Context Divergence in Open-Weight LLMs: A Paired-Prompt Protocol with Pilot Evidence of Alignment-Pipeline-Specific Heterogeneity
summary:
Safety benchmarks are routinely treated as evidence about how a language model will behave once deployed, but this inference is fragile if behavior depends on whether a prompt looks like an evaluation. We define evaluation-context divergence as an observable within-item change in behavior induced by framing a fixed task as an evaluation, a live deployment interaction, or a neutral request, and present a paired-prompt protocol that measures it in open-weight LLMs while controlling for paraphrase variation, benchmark familiarity, and judge framing-sensitivity.
  Across five instruction-tuned checkpoints from four open-weight families plus a matched OLMo-3 base/instruct ablation ($20$ paired items, $840$ generations per checkpoint), we find striking heterogeneity. OLMo-3-Instruct alone is eval-cautious -- evaluation framing raises refusal vs. neutral by $11.8$pp ($p=0.007$) and reduces harmful compliance vs. deployment by $3.6$pp ($p=0.024$, $0/20$ items inverted) -- while Mistral-Small-3.2, Phi-3.5-mini, and Llama-3.1-8B are deployment-cautious}, with marginal eval-vs-deployment refusal effects of $-9$ to $-20$pp. The matched OLMo-3 base also exhibits the deployment-cautious pattern, identifying alignment as the inversion stage; within Llama-3.1, the $70$B model preserves direction with attenuated magnitude, ruling out a simple ``small-model effect that reverses at scale.'' One caveat: the cross-family heterogeneity is judge-dependent. Re-judging with a different-family safety classifier (Llama-Guard-3-8B) preserves the within-OLMo eval-cautious direction but flattens the cross-family contrast, indicating that the two judges operationalize distinct constructs.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了语言模型安全行为存在"评估-部署上下文分歧"现象：不同模型对评估框架的反应截然不同（有的在评估时更谨慎，有的在部署时更谨慎），且这种异质性依赖于评判者的选择。这表明安全基准可能无法可靠预测模型在真实部署场景中的行为。
AI.motivation: 安全基准常被用于推断语言模型在部署后的行为，但这种推断是脆弱的，因为模型行为可能取决于提示是否看起来像评估。现有基准缺乏对"评估-部署行为差异"的系统测量，需要控制多个混淆变量。
AI.method: 采用配对提示协议（paired-prompt protocol），控制释义变异、基准熟悉度和评判者框架敏感性。跨越五个指令微调检查点（来自四个开源权重家族）加上OLMo-3 base/instruct匹配的消融实验，每个检查点生成840个样本（20个配对项）。使用两种评判者进行评估：一种是内部安全分类器，另一种是跨家族分类器（Llama-Guard-3-8B）。
AI.result: 发现显著异质性：OLMo-3-Instruct是eval-cautious（评估谨慎型），评估框架使拒绝率比中性条件提升11.8pp（p=0.007），有害遵从率比部署条件降低3.6pp（p=0.024）；而Mistral-Small-3.2、Phi-3.5-mini和Llama-3.1-8B是deployment-cautious（部署谨慎型），评估vs部署的拒绝效应为-9至-20pp。OLMo-3 base也表现部署谨慎模式，识别对齐为反转阶段；Llama-3.1-70B保留方向但幅度减弱。跨家族异质性是评判者依赖的。
AI.conclusion: 跨家族异质性取决于评判者；不同安全分类器（Llama-Guard-3-8B）会保留OLMo内部eval-cautious方向但消除跨家族对比，表明两种评判者操作化了不同的构念。这项研究揭示了安全基准推断部署行为的脆弱性，并强调了评估设计中对框架效应控制的重要性。

title: Knee Osteoarthritis Severity Grading Using Optimized Deep Learning and LLM-Driven Intelligent AI on Computationally Limited Systems
comment: 6 pages, 11 figures, Accepted and presented at the 2nd International Conference on Emerging Computational Intelligence (ICECI 2026), IEEE. Published in conference proceedings. To appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is among the musculoskeletal disorders that considerably restrict joint mobility, cause severe chronic pain and impact negatively on quality life. It is one of the persistent health issues worldwide. Generally, subjectivity and inter-observer variability undermine conventional practices and evaluation process that are adopted to address such health issues. Hence precise and timely diagnosis would be one of the effective ways for the assessment of its severity. This paper proposes an automated diagnostic approach for severity grading of KOA by blending a deep learning convolutional neural network (CNN) with a device-based inference platform powered by TensorFlow Lite. It proposes a model based on the ResNet-18 convolutional neural network. The designed model is trained on publicly available database. Through a transfer learning approach obtained knee images are first classified into five Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) grades. Further the developed model is optimised. During the training of the model test accuracy of 94.48% with stable convergence has been achieved. Subsequently the optimised model transformed into a lightweight TensorFlow Lite format, facilitating seamless deployment on resource-constrained devices. The designed model is capable enough to operate in the environment having no continuous internet connectivity. Also, an auxiliary Large Language Model (Gemini-2.0-flash) is applied to generate structured interpretive findings like potential symptoms, risk factors, and preventive majors etc. The LLM component functions as interface without influencing the classification process. The proposed model articulates the feasibility of an on-device, interpretable decision-support tools for early diagnosis and improve accessibility to Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted knee screening tool.

AI.tldr: An automated KOA severity grading system using ResNet-18 CNN with TensorFlow Lite deployment achieves 94.48% accuracy for 5-class KL classification, enabling on-device AI screening without internet dependency, with Gemini-2.0-flash providing interpretive clinical support.
AI.motivation: KOA significantly restricts joint mobility, causes chronic pain, and impacts quality of life. Conventional evaluation methods suffer from subjectivity and inter-observer variability, necessitating precise and timely automated diagnostic tools.
AI.method: Transfer learning with ResNet-18 CNN trained on publicly available knee X-ray images, classifying into 5 KL grades; model optimized and converted to TensorFlow Lite format for on-device deployment; Gemini-2.0-flash LLM used as auxiliary interface for generating interpretive findings.
AI.result: Test accuracy of 94.48% with stable convergence during training; lightweight TensorFlow Lite model enables operation without continuous internet connectivity on resource-constrained devices.
AI.conclusion: The proposed system demonstrates the feasibility of on-device AI-assisted KOA screening, achieving high accuracy (94.48%) while enabling deployment on resource-constrained devices without internet dependency, with Gemini-2.0-flash providing interpretive support for clinical decision-making.

title: Adversarial Graph Neural Network Benchmarks: Towards Practical and Fair Evaluation
summary: Adversarial learning and the robustness of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are topics of widespread interest in the machine learning community, as documented by the number of adversarial attacks and defenses designed for these purposes. While a rigorous evaluation of these adversarial methods is necessary to understand the robustness of GNNs in real-world applications, we posit that many works in the literature do not share the same experimental settings, leading to ambiguous and potentially contradictory scientific conclusions. In this benchmark, we demonstrate the importance of adopting fair, robust, and standardized evaluation protocols in adversarial GNN research. We perform a comprehensive re-evaluation of seven widely used attacks and eight recent defenses under both poisoning and evasion scenarios, across six popular graph datasets. Our study spans over 453,000 experiments conducted within a unified framework. We observe substantial differences in adversarial attack performance when evaluated under a fair and robust procedure. Our findings reveal that previously overlooked factors, such as target node selection and the training process of the attacked model, have a profound impact on attack effectiveness, to the extent of completely distorting performance insights. These results underscore the urgent need for standardized evaluations in adversarial graph machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个面向对抗图学习（GNN 对抗攻击与防御）的标准化评测基准：在统一的"风险评估"协议下重跑了 7 种常用攻击（Nettack、FGA、PGD、PR-BCD、SGA、GOttack 及本文新提出的朴素基线 L1D-RND）与 8-9 种防御模型，覆盖同配、异配及大规模共 6 个数据集、evasion 与 poisoning 两种场景、逾 45.3 万次实验。核心结论是：以往文献因目标节点选择偏差、缺少模型选择、固定超参与单一划分等问题，导致攻击/防御排名"失真"；在公平协议下排名与结论大幅改变——朴素基线 L1D-RND 意外地可与梯度类攻击匹敌，Nettack 仍最强但计算最贵，PR-BCD/FGA 具可扩展性，SGA 是唯一能在 OGB-ArXiv 上跑通的攻击；高阶节点天然更鲁棒、异配图更抗攻击、依赖同配假设的防御（GNNGuard/GRAND 等）在异配图上"崩溃"。作者由此呼吁社区采用标准化、可复现、贴近部署的评测协议。
AI.motivation: 对抗学习与 GNN 鲁棒性是社区热点，已有大量攻击与防御方法，但各文献的实验设置（数据划分、超参数、目标节点选取、受害者模型配置）互不一致，导致结论彼此矛盾甚至相互否定，妨碍了科学进展与复现。论文指出三个反复出现的问题：(1) 常以攻击专用的超参数或固定划分训练/评测 GNN（未做模型选择），结果有偏；(2) 新攻击常在比基线更有利的条件下测试；(3) 目标节点选取（沿用 Nettack 的"10 高 margin + 10 低 margin + 20 随机"）系统性低估了高 degree 节点——而高 degree 节点最抗攻击，导致攻击效果被高估。类比视觉社区"苦涩的教训"，作者认为图社区需建立严格评测规范。
AI.method: 提出统一的对抗评测协议（Algorithm 1），融合 Errica et al. 与 Shchur et al. 的风险评估思想：K=5 个随机 train/valid/test 划分（10/10/80）、R=3 次运行；受害模型与代理模型均在干净数据上做网格超参模型选择（仅用验证集），早停 + patience；目标节点选取从 40 个扩展为 50 个且覆盖 5 类：高 degree / 低 degree / 高 margin / 低 margin（仍正确分类）/ 随机；攻击者能力设定为灰盒（可训练代理模型），PR-BCD 同时给出非自适应(NA)与自适应版本；结构扰动预算 Δ=1..5，指标为目标节点误分类率（evasion 与 poisoning 分别统计，poisoning 需在扰动图上重训）。数据集：同配 CORA/CITESEER/PUBMED、异配 SQUIRREL/CHAMELEON、大规模 OGB-ArXiv；受害模型：GCN/GIN/GSAGE/PNA 加 GNNGuard、GRAND、GCORN、NoisyGNN、RobustGCN、ElasticGNN、RUNG、GCN-Jaccard、GCN-GARNET 等防御。核心新增是朴素基线 L1D-RND：加边时连向采样候选中的最高 degree 节点，删边时按邻居特征 L1 范数定义的"影响力分数"删边，计算量极低。另有特征攻击消融、攻击/防御时间与 GPU 显存开销分解（Surrogate/Pre-attack/Attack 三阶段）、以及"含/不含 degree 选点"与"含/不含模型选择"两组消融对照。
AI.result: 同配图上：预算 Δ=1 时 PR-BCD(NA) 在 12 个 evasion 场景中 4 次最优，Δ=2..5 时 Nettack 在 48 个场景中 36 次最优（整体平均排名 1.65，FGA 3.23），且 poisoning 通常强于 evasion（Δ=1 时 Nettack 从 27.76%→32.48%）。异配图上格局反转：FGA 最优（平均排名 1.92），Nettack 跌至 5.48（几乎最差）；朴素 L1D-RND 反而在异配图排名 2.33 优于同配图的 6.27，并在受防御模型上 19/45（evasion）、18/45（poisoning）设置中取得最高误分类率，GRAND 上平均排名 1.13、30 个任务中 26 次最优，暴露出现有梯度类攻击相对简单基线的真实增益存疑。防御侧：GNNGuard 最强（Δ=1 时 evasion 5.01%、poisoning 5.92%），GRAND 次之；但依赖同配假设的防御在异配图上退化甚至"崩溃"（GNNGuard 在 Chameleon 上剪掉所有边导致误分类率恒为 0；GRAND 相对下降 471%，RUNG 下降 1170%），而 RobustGCN/ElasticGNN/GARNET 相对稳定；NoisyGNN 在异配图上反而脆弱。大规模图上仅 L1D-RND、PR-BCD(NA)、SGA 三种攻击可完成，其中 SGA 全面最优；FGA 与 PGD 因需稠密邻接矩阵在 OGB-ArXiv 上 OOM，Nettack/GOttack 单次攻击耗时超 894 s，而 L1D-RND 仅约 0.1 s、显存最低（<40 MB）。消融显示：纳入 degree 选点使攻击性能平均下降 9.8%（PUBMED 平均 −14.97%），不做模型选择会使结果偏差在 −16.40%~19.07%（平均绝对差 5.19%）并可能改变攻击排名；高 degree 节点误分类率仅 0.05%–0.28%，degree-1 节点可达 0.88。特征攻击趋势与结构攻击高度一致（Nettack 平均排名 1.52、FGA 2.56）。
AI.conclusion: 在公平、标准化协议下，很多既有结论不再成立：Nettack 仍是强攻击但计算代价高，PR-BCD 与 FGA 是可扩展的选项，而朴素 L1D-RND 以极低成本取得竞争性结果，挑战了"复杂攻击带来实质进展"的假设；同时数据集性质（同配/异配）、目标节点 degree、被攻击模型的训练/选择过程都会显著改变攻击成功率结论，且这些因素在以往评测中处理不一致。作者强调本文目的不是给攻击方法排名或否定已有工作，而是提供可靠、可复现的评测实践；建议未来研究必须：(1) 做严格的模型选择并分离模型选择与最终评测；(2) 采用覆盖 degree/margin/随机多类的目标节点选取；(3) 报告标准差与公开划分；(4) 同时评测 vanilla 与 defended 受害模型及 evasion/poisoning 两场景；(5) 纳入简单朴素基线做 sanity check；(6) 关注异配图、动态图与可扩展攻击/防御这一开放方向。作者也坦承局限：未对权重初始化做调优（因需额外 44.6 万次实验）、仅覆盖静态图、未包含 certified robustness 评测。

title: MANTRA: Synthesizing SMT-Validated Compliance Benchmarks for Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in settings where their reliable behavior is governed by strict procedural manuals. Ensuring that such agents comply with the rules from these manuals is challenging, as they are typically written for humans in natural language while agent behavior manifests as an execution trace of tool calls. Existing evaluations of LLM agents rely on manually constructed benchmarks or LLM-based judges, which either do not scale or lack reliability for complex, long-horizon manuals. To overcome these limitations, we present MANTRA, a framework for automatically synthesizing machine-checkable compliance benchmarks from natural-language manuals and tool schemas. MANTRA independently generates (i) a symbolic world model capturing procedural dependencies, and (ii) a set of trace-level compliance checks for a given task, and validates their consistency using SMT solving. A structured repair loop resolves inconsistencies, requiring human intervention only as a fallback. %This yields benchmarks that are formally validated. Importantly, MANTRA supports arbitrary domains and long procedural manuals, and provides a tunable notion of task complexity which is utilized to automatically derive challenging tasks accompanying compliance checks. Using MANTRA, we build a new benchmark suite with 285 tasks across 6 domains scaling to 50+ page manuals with minimal human effort. Empirically, we show that the compliance checks are richer with stronger constraint enforcement compared to existing benchmarks. Additionally, the granularity of the checks can be used for debugging the agents' failure modes. These results demonstrate that combining automated benchmark generation with formally grounded validation methods enables scalable and reliable benchmarking of tool-using agents.

AI.tldr: MANTRA 是一个自动化基准生成框架：从自然语言程序手册与工具 schema 自动合成"trace 级合规检查"（必调用/禁调用/时序约束），并独立生成符号世界模型，用 Z3 SMT 有界模型检验做交叉验证与自动修复，从而产出可确定性打分的长流程工具调用合规基准。已在 6 个领域构建 285 个经验证任务，手册最长约 16.6k 词 / 148 个工具。
AI.motivation: 工具型 LLM 智能体越来越多地部署在受严格程序手册（SOP、合规政策）约束的场景中，但手册是面向人类的自然语言，而智能体行为表现为工具调用执行轨迹，二者存在语义鸿沟。现有评测手段各有缺陷：人工构造的基准质量高但难以扩展到长手册和新领域；LLM-as-judge 易于部署但在长轨迹上的严格时序约束、前置条件和禁止动作判定不可靠；多数基准只检查最终数据库状态，无法区分"合规路径"与"结果正确但过程违规"的轨迹。因此需要一种可扩展、可复现、确定性且基于轨迹级别的程序合规评测方法。
AI.method:
整体为"MANual-to-Test-tRAnslation"流水线，输入程序手册 D、工具 schema T 与隐藏数据库 DB，输出经验证的基准 B。
(1) 文档摄取与场景生成：递归按层次+长度阈值切块，LLM 识别显式/隐式引用边，构成依赖图 G_D；采用覆盖驱动节点采样（uniform / coverage_driven / connected_diverse_coverage / coverage_islands，默认 coverage_islands）抽取子图区域 D_S，采样规模可控任务复杂度；LLM 映射相关工具子集 T_S，生成 m 个场景 λ =（提示词 p_λ, 变量赋值 I_λ），其中 I_λ 含可观测外部变量 Var^ext 与提示中显式给出的隐藏内部变量 Var^int。
(2) 检查生成与世界模型生成（双产物）：针对每个场景生成布尔检查集 C_λ，原子为 call(t,a)/no_call(t,a)（部分参数匹配，缺省为通配），复合形式支持 or 与 after/before/follows/precedes 时序算子（after/before 为条件式，follows/precedes 为正向义务）；参数用 I_λ 具体取值 ground。同时独立生成 D_S 的状态转移系统 W_S=(X,T_S,δ)，由 LLM 输出强类型 DSL（model/var/transition，pre/post 条件，Int/Real/Bool/String/Enum/Record/Array 类型，frame 公理、no-op 填充、contiguous-prefix）。
(3) SMT 交叉验证与修复循环：将 C_λ 与 W_S 分别确定性编译为有界 SMT 编码 Φ^h（步变量 t_i、状态向量 σ_b、参数向量 a_i、match 谓词），用 Z3 搜索两类不一致：前向冲突 Φ_fwd = Φ(C) ∧ Φ_bg ∧ Φ_post ∧ ¬Φ_pre（满足检查但违反世界模型前件）；后向审计 Φ_bwd = Φ(W) ∧ ⋀_{k≠j}Φ(c_k) ∧ ¬Φ(c_j)（世界模型允许但仅某检查被违反 → 该检查过约束）。冲突迹 τ* 经 LLM 裁判归因，先做样本级批量世界模型修复（共享缺陷一次修复），再做场景级检查局部修复；所有修复通过类型化编辑语言确定性应用并重编译；迭代至前向冲突 UNSAT 且后向审计通过，仍未解决者经 WebUI 交人工复核（人工修改后不再被自动覆盖）。此外有语法错误修复循环捕获 DSL 解析/类型错误。LLM 从不接触原始 SMT/Z3 表达式，只接触 DSL 与检查语法。
(4) 评测：6 个 LLM 智能体（Strands 框架）跑 285 任务 ×5 次，报告 Pass@1、Pass@5、Pass^5，并按检查粒度归类失败模式。
AI.result: 基准套件 285 个最终验证任务，覆盖 6 域：operations（合成手册，566 词/20 工具，166 生成→63 最终）、sneaky-sasquatch（162→47）、cabin-safety（16,644 词/148 工具，164→43）、tau2-retail（75→44）、tau2-airline（80→57）、tau2-telecom（56→31）；平均每例 2.75–6.19 条检查，5 轮前向精化累计验证曲线显示逐轮上升；相较现有基准检查更丰富、约束更强且为确定性 trace 级评测（已验证用例零 LLM 调用即可打分）。智能体评测显示无模型达到高程序合规率：Pass@1 大致在 10%–57% 区间，τ²-bench 三域虽手册更短、工具更少却更难（源于工具参数复杂度更高：airline 平均 2.57 参数、4 个枚举、5 个数组、3 个复杂工具）；失败模式统计 10,895 条失败检查中 76% 为 Missing-Required-Call(58%) 与 Missing-Anchor(18%)，纯顺序违规仅 2%，即基准主要测量"是否先读后写"；Forbidden-Call 20% 集中在 create_purchase_order、book_travel、run_vitamin_test、transfer_to_human_agents；模型级病灶包括 GPT-OSS 崩溃率 7.6%（operations 23.4%）、Claude Haiku 在 cabin 域 21% 空轨迹、Gemma4 零崩溃但过早写入。Qwen3.6:36B 在 tau2-airline/retail 的过早写入率为 0%，并以领先成绩体现"先查后写"习惯的价值。人工检查发现若干工程性问题（字符串参数被 pin 导致脆弱、IATA 代码不一致、强制单次调用、抽样遗漏相关块、平凡样本），已手工过滤。
AI.conclusion: 将自动化基准生成与形式化验证结合，可在极少人工介入下，把长篇自然语言程序手册转化为可扩展、确定性、trace 级的合规评测基准；MANTRA 在自动生成、大文档支持、新域可扩展、轨迹级评测与确定性打分五项上同时满足，是该类工作中首个兼顾者。局限：不提供对原始文档的完全形式化认证，仅靠双产物交叉验证降低风险；需给定工具 schema；仅在固定迹长界 h（实验中 h=16）内验证，超界不一致可能遗漏；部分歧义场景仍需人工复核；评测仅覆盖 6 个英文域、6 个模型，生成过程因依赖专有 LLM 而不完全可复现；框架聚焦有显式工具调用的交互场景。总体而言 MANTRA 是"机器学习生成 + 形式化验证"互补用于 AI 系统保证的一个组件，而非独立的合规保证。

title: SDFlow: Similarity-Driven Flow Matching for Time Series Generation
summary: Vector quantization (VQ) with autoregressive (AR) token modeling is a widely adopted and highly competitive paradigm for time-series generation. However, such models are fundamentally limited by exposure bias: during inference, errors can accumulate across sequential predictions, leading to pronounced quality degradation in long-horizon generation. To address this, we propose SDFlow ($\textbf{S}$imilarity-$\textbf{D}$riven $\textbf{Flow}$ Matching), a non-autoregressive framework that operates entirely in the frozen VQ latent space and enables parallel sequence generation via flow matching. We tackle three key challenges in making this transition: (1) eliminating exposure bias by replacing step-wise token prediction with a global transport map; (2) mitigating the high-dimensionality of VQ token spaces via a low-rank manifold decomposition with a learned anchor prior over the latent manifold; and (3) incorporating discrete supervision into continuous transport dynamics by introducing a categorical posterior over codebook indices within a variational flow-matching formulation. Extensive experiments show that SDFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving Discriminative Score and substantially reducing Context-FID, particularly for challenging long-sequence generation. Moreover, SDFlow provides significant inference speedups over autoregressive baselines, offering both high fidelity and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SDFlow-D6F3/

AI.tldr: SDFlow proposes a non-autoregressive time-series generation framework using flow matching in VQ latent space, addressing exposure bias, high-dimensional token spaces, and discrete-continuous integration through novel techniques like global transport maps, low-rank manifold decomposition, and variational categorical posteriors.
AI.motivation: Traditional VQ with autoregressive token modeling suffers from exposure bias: during inference, prediction errors accumulate across sequential steps, causing significant quality degradation in long-horizon time-series generation.
AI.method: SDFlow uses a non-autoregressive framework operating in frozen VQ latent space via flow matching. Three key innovations: (1) Global transport map replacing step-wise token prediction to eliminate exposure bias; (2) Low-rank manifold decomposition with learned anchor prior to handle high-dimensional token spaces; (3) Categorical posterior over codebook indices within variational flow-matching to incorporate discrete supervision into continuous dynamics.
AI.result: SDFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance with improved Discriminative Score and substantially reduced Context-FID, especially for challenging long-sequence generation tasks. Additionally, it provides significant inference speedups over autoregressive baselines.
AI.conclusion: SDFlow provides a non-autoregressive solution that eliminates exposure bias while maintaining high fidelity and computational efficiency, making it particularly suitable for long-sequence time-series generation tasks.

title: Towards Scalable One-Step Generative Modeling for Autoregressive Dynamical System Forecasting
summary: Fast surrogate modeling for high-dimensional physical dynamics requires more than low short-term error: useful models must roll out efficiently while preserving the statistical structure of long trajectories. Neural operators provide inexpensive autoregressive forecasts but can drift in turbulent regimes, whereas rolling diffusion and latent generative surrogates can represent stochastic transitions at the cost of multi-step denoising, noise-schedule design, or auxiliary compression models. We propose MeanFlow Long-term Invariant Spatiotemporal Consistency Autoregressive Models (MeLISA), a latent-free autoregressive generative surrogate built on pixel-space MeanFlow. MeLISA defines a blockwise stochastic transition kernel that generates each forecast block with a single model evaluation, avoiding latent encoders and iterative diffusion solvers at inference time. To stabilize long-horizon rollouts, MeLISA combines a Window-Consistency MeanFlow objective that learns conditional spatiotemporal generation from partially observed temporal windows with a Time Increment Consistency loss that constrains multi-lag finite increments and targets temporal-correlation structure. We evaluate MeLISA with compact UNet and scalable DiT backbones on two high-resolution benchmarks, extended 2D Kolmogorov flow at $256 \times 256$ and turbulent channel-flow slice at $192 \times 192$. MeLISA outperforms neural-operator baselines on short-term forecasting accuracy and long-horizon statistical metrics, including energy spectra, turbulent kinetic energy, and mixing-rate-related dynamics, while achieving inference speeds comparable to, and in some cases faster than, neural operators. Compact 3.7-5.7M-parameter variants already deliver strong parameter efficiency, and DiT variants provide a scalable path up to 150M parameters. Overall, MeLISA benefits both rollout efficiency and long-horizon statistical accuracy.

AI.tldr: MeLISA是一种无潜在变量的像素空间自回归生成替代模型，通过块级单次评估生成和时窗/时增量一致性约束，在高分辨率物理动力学中实现了高效的短时预测和保真的长时统计展开，兼具神经算子的推理速度和扩散模型的多模态保真度优势。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子虽能廉价进行自回归预测，但在湍流状态下易漂移失效；扩散模型和潜在生成替代模型虽能表达随机过渡，却依赖多步去噪、噪声调度设计或辅助压缩模型，增加了推理开销。因此需要一种兼具高效 rollout 与长期统计保真度的无潜在变量自回归生成替代方案。
AI.method: MeLISA基于像素空间MeanFlow构建，采用块级随机过渡核，每个预测块仅需单次模型评估即可生成，完全规避了潜在编码器和迭代扩散解码器。同时引入Window-Consistency MeanFlow目标函数以从部分观测时窗中学习条件时空生成，并结合Time Increment Consistency损失约束多滞后有限增量、瞄准时序相关性结构，从而稳定长时序展开。
AI.result: 在256×256 Kolmogorov湍流流和192×192湍流通道流切片两个高分辨率基准上，MeLISA在短时预测精度和长时统计指标（能谱、湍动能、混合率相关动力学）上均优于神经算子基线，推理速度与神经算子相当甚至更快。3.7–5.7M参数紧凑模型即展现强参数效率，DiT变体可扩展至150M参数规模。
AI.conclusion: MeLISA通过Window-Consistency MeanFlow和Time Increment Consistency损失实现了高效且统计准确的长时预测，兼具推理速度和参数效率优势，为高分辨率物理动力学提供了一条可行的无潜在变量自回归生成替代方案。

title: Don't Lose Focus: Activation Steering via Key-Orthogonal Projections
summary: Activation steering controls LLM behaviour towards target behaviour by intervening in internal representations, yet it often degrades reasoning and retrieval performance. We argue that a primary cause of this trade-off is attention rerouting: steering vectors alter query-key matching, shifting attention away from contextually important tokens toward less informative ones. To address this, we propose Steering via Key-Orthogonal Projections (SKOP), a steering method that constrains harmful attention rerouting without eliminating steering efficacy. SKOP achieves this by preserving attention patterns on a small set of focus tokens the model relies on for reasoning and retrieval, while allowing redistribution among less critical tail tokens. Across multiple steering benchmarks, we show that SKOP achieves the best joint steering-utility trade-off, reducing utility degradation by 5-7x while retaining over 95% of vanilla steering efficacy. Our results further suggest that, in long-context retrieval settings where vanilla steering approaches are ineffective, SKOP can maintain robust performance by avoiding attention rerouting.

AI.tldr: SKOP (Steering via Key-Orthogonal Projections) solves the attention rerouting problem in LLM activation steering by preserving attention patterns on critical tokens, achieving a 5-7x reduction in utility degradation while maintaining >95% steering efficacy.
AI.motivation: Existing activation steering methods for controlling LLM behavior suffer from a fundamental trade-off: they effectively steer model behavior but simultaneously degrade reasoning and retrieval performance. This trade-off is primarily caused by "attention rerouting" where steering vectors alter query-key matching patterns.
AI.method: SKOP operates by projecting steering vectors orthogonally to preserve attention patterns on focus tokens while allowing redistribution among less critical tokens. The method constrains harmful attention rerouting without eliminating steering efficacy.
AI.result: SKOP reduces utility degradation by 5-7x while retaining over 95% of vanilla steering efficacy. Additionally, in long-context retrieval settings where vanilla steering approaches are ineffective, SKOP maintains robust performance.
AI.conclusion: SKOP provides a principled solution to the attention rerouting problem in LLM steering, achieving a favorable trade-off between steering efficacy and utility preservation, with particular advantages in long-context retrieval scenarios where vanilla steering fails.

title: ReFlect: An Effective Harness System for Complex Long-Horizon LLM Reasoning
summary: Current reasoning paradigms for LLMs include chain-of-thought, ReAct, and post-hoc self-critique. These paradigms rely on two assumptions that fail on long-horizon, multi-stage tasks. As a result, errors accumulate silently across reasoning steps, leaving an open question: can a reasoning system effectively detect and recover from its own failures? We present ReFlect, a \emph{harness} system for LLM reasoning that creates standalone error detection and recovery logic as a deterministic wrapper around the model. Controlled experiments across 6 reasoning domains show that prompt-level self-critique produces formulaic templates that flag no issues in 90 of 100 audited reflection blocks, and the investigated LLMs wrongly accept a wrong answer in at least 76\% of cases. Our ReFlect harness achieves task success rates ranging from 41\% on gpt-4o-mini to 56\% on Claude Sonnet 4.5 across six models spanning small and frontier scale, with per-model gains over Direct CoT ranging from +7 pp on Qwen2.5-72B to +29 pp on Claude Sonnet 4.5, and additionally raises SWE-bench patch-structural quality from 0\% (Direct CoT) to between 82\% (Qwen2.5-72B) and 87\% (GPT-4o). Notably, the harness gain is inversely proportional to the model's Direct CoT task success rate (the fitted slope is -1.69 with r=-0.76): each pp lost in baseline success rate is mechanically recovered by 1.69 pp of harness gain. We spot that adding structured reasoning state and operators yields only 15.0--18.7\% pair-mean on Llama-3.3-70B and Qwen2.5-72B because models at this scale cannot reliably populate the state its operators require. ReFlect is model-agnostic, training-free, and operates entirely at inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReFlect系统，通过在模型外部构建独立的错误检测和恢复逻辑来克服现有推理范式的局限性。实验表明prompt级自我批判几乎完全失效，而ReFlect在多种规模模型上均取得显著提升，尤其对基线能力较弱的模型帮助更大。
AI.motivation: 现有推理范式（chain-of-thought、ReAct、事后自我批判）依赖两个在长时域、多阶段任务中失效的假设，导致推理步骤中的错误累积且无法被检测和恢复。
AI.method: 提出ReFlect框架：通过确定性包装器为LLM生成独立的错误检测和恢复逻辑，而非依赖模型自身的prompt级自我批判。
AI.result: （1）Prompt级自我批判几乎无效：100个审查块中90个产生公式化模板无法发现问题；LLM在至少76%的情况下错误地接受错误答案。（2）ReFlect在6个模型上的任务成功率为41%-56%，相比Direct CoT提升7-29个百分点。（3）SWE-bench从0%提升至82%-87%。（4）结构化推理状态在70B规模模型上仅达15%-18.7%成对准确率，因模型无法可靠填充操作所需状态。
AI.conclusion: ReFlect是一个模型无关、无需训练、完全在推理时运行的外部包装系统，通过独立的错误检测和恢复机制提升LLM推理能力。该系统在不同规模的模型上均取得显著提升（+7至+29个百分点），且提升幅度与模型基线能力呈负相关（斜率-1.69），表明其对较弱模型的帮助更大。

title: Adaptive Q-Chunking for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning with action chunking eliminates multi-step off-policy bias and enables temporally coherent exploration, but all existing methods use a fixed chunk size across every state. This is suboptimal: near contact events the agent needs short chunks for reactive control, while during free-space motion long chunks provide better credit assignment. The natural solution is to train critics for several chunk sizes and select the best one at each state, but naive comparison of learned critic values systematically collapses to the shortest chunk due to discount-scale mismatch, and degrades to noise in low-value states. We propose Adaptive Q-Chunking (AQC), which resolves both failures by comparing the advantage of each chunk size relative to a per-horizon baseline, normalized by the discount factor. This criterion converts biased wrong answers into unbiased near-random choices when no genuine signal exists, and becomes discriminative when a particular scale enables better planning. We prove theoretical bounds on the advantage selector's noise immunity and on the value dominance of adaptive chunking over any fixed chunk size. We demonstrate that AQC achieves state-of-the-art offline and online success rates on OGBench and Robomimic, and can be applied to enhance the performance of large-scale VLA models that predict action sequences, significantly boosting performance on RoboCasa-GR1 tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应Q分块(AQC)方法，解决离线到在线强化学习中动作分块大小固定的问题。通过比较不同分块大小相对于每 horizon 基线的优势，并按折扣因子归一化，动态选择最优分块大小。理论证明该方法具有噪声免疫性，自适应分块优于任何固定分块大小。在OGBench、Robomimic和RoboCasa-GR1任务上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有离线到在线强化学习方法使用固定的动作分块大小，但这并非最优：在接触事件附近需要短分块进行反应控制，而在自由空间运动时需要长分块进行更好的信用分配。简单比较学习到的Q值会因为折扣因子不匹配而系统性地崩溃到最短分块，在低价值状态下退化为噪声。
AI.method: 提出自适应Q分块(AQC)方法，通过比较每个分块大小相对于每 horizon 基线的优势，并用折扣因子归一化。这个准则将偏置的错误答案转换为无偏的近似随机选择（当没有真实信号时），并在特定尺度能实现更好规划时变得有区分力。
AI.result: AQC在OGBench和Robomimic上实现了最先进的离线在线成功率，并可应用于增强大规模VLA模型的性能，在RoboCasa-GR1任务上显著提升表现。
AI.conclusion: 理论证明了优势选择器的噪声免疫性边界和自适应分块相对于任何固定分块大小的价值优势。该方法为离线到在线强化学习中的时序探索提供了自适应解决方案。

title: SEQUOR: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Realistic Constraint Following
summary: In a conversation, a helpful assistant must reliably follow user directives, even as they refine, modify, or contradict earlier requests. Yet most instruction-following benchmarks focus on single-turn or short multi-turn scenarios, leaving open how well models handle long-horizon instruction-following tasks. To bridge this gap, we present SEQUOR, an automatic benchmark for evaluating constraint adherence in long multi-turn conversations. SEQUOR consists of simulated persona-driven interactions built with constraints extracted from real-world conversations. Our results show that even when following a single constraint, instruction-following accuracy consistently decreases as the conversation grows longer, with drops exceeding 11%. This decline becomes larger when models have to follow multiple constraints simultaneously, reducing their accuracy by over 40%. In scenarios where constraints are added or replaced at arbitrary points of the conversation, model accuracy decreases by more than 9%. Taken together, our results reveal that current models still struggle to follow user instructions in multi-turn conversations, and provide a way for better measuring instruction-following capabilities in assistants.

AI.tldr: SEQUOR是一个用于评估长时多轮对话中约束遵守能力的自动基准，发现当前模型在对话轮次增加、多约束叠加及约束动态变化时指令遵循准确率显著下降，揭示了现有模型的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有指令遵循基准多聚焦单轮或短多轮场景，缺乏对模型在长时对话中指令遵循能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建了基于真实世界对话约束提取的模拟人物驱动交互，自动评估多轮对话中的约束遵守情况。
AI.result: 单约束下对话越长准确率下降超11%；多约束同时遵循时准确率下降超40%；约束动态添加或替换时准确率下降超9%。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型在多轮对话场景中仍难以可靠地遵循用户指令，SEQUOR基准为更好地评估助手指令遵循能力提供了有效方式。

title: HyperLens: Quantifying Cognitive Effort in LLMs with Fine-grained Confidence Trajectory
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, their inference dynamics remain poorly understood because of the limited resolution of existing analysis tools. In this work, we identify an intrinsic magnification mechanism in transformer architectures: deeper layers inherently magnify the small changes of layer-wise confidence, providing a fine-grained confidence trajectory. Building on this insight, we introduce HyperLens, a high-resolution probe designed to trace confidence trajectories and quantify the cognitive effort during inference. Across LLMs and datasets, HyperLens reveals a consistent divergence in confidence trajectories that separates complex from simple tasks. We abstract this pattern into a quantitative cognitive effort metric. Our analysis reveals a fundamental principle: complex tasks consistently require higher cognitive effort. Finally, we provide a mechanistic diagnosis of a common side effect of standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT): it can reduce cognitive effort and consequently degrade performance on in-domain tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyperLens，一种高分辨率分析工具，用于追踪LLM推理过程中的置信度轨迹并量化认知努力。研究发现复杂任务始终比简单任务需要更高的认知努力，且标准SFT可能通过降低认知努力而损害领域内性能。
AI.motivation: LLMs在多项任务中表现优异，但其推理动态机制尚未被深入理解，原因是现有分析工具的分辨率有限。
AI.method: 开发了HyperLens工具，通过识别transformer架构中深层放大层间置信度微小变化的内在放大机制，高分辨率追踪置信度轨迹并量化推理过程中的认知努力。
AI.result: 发现复杂任务与简单任务的置信度轨迹存在显著差异，验证了"复杂任务需要更高认知努力"这一基本原则。
AI.conclusion: Standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)存在副作用，可能降低认知努力从而导致领域内任务性能下降。

title: FedeKD: Energy-Based Gating for Robust Federated Knowledge Distillation under Heterogeneous Settings
summary: Federated learning (FL) operates in heterogeneous environments, where variations in data distributions and asymmetric model design often result in negative transfer. While federated knowledge distillation (FKD) avoids direct model parameter sharing, existing methods typically rely on public datasets or assume that transferred knowledge is uniformly reliable, which limits their robustness in practice. This paper presents FedeKD, a reliability-aware FKD framework that makes sample-wise trust estimation an explicit component of knowledge transfer, without relying on additional public data. Each client maintains a high-capacity private model for local learning and a lightweight shared proxy model for cross-client knowledge exchange. During training, proxy models are aggregated on the server to form a global proxy, which is then used to guide updates of the private models. At the core of FedeKD is an energy-based gating mechanism that converts task-specific private-proxy disagreement into sample-wise trust weights for backward distillation. This mechanism enables sample-wise weighting of knowledge transfer, where the proxy model contributes more to reliable samples while down-weighting unreliable ones. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets demonstrate that FedeKD significantly reduces negative transfer under heterogeneous settings while maintaining strong predictive performance.

AI.tldr: FedeKD 是一种面向异构联邦场景的可靠性感知的联邦知识蒸馏框架，其核心是"能量门控"（energy-based gating）机制：把私有模型与轻量代理模型之间的样本级分歧转化为逐样本信任权重，对反向蒸馏损失进行加权，从而抑制负迁移。该方法无需额外公共数据，在六个真实数据集（4个分类+2个回归）上显著优于 FedAvg/FedProx/FedDyn/FedType 等基线，在平均、最差与尾部负迁移指标上均取得最佳，同时保持有竞争力的精度与最低 RMSE。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在数据分布异构（non-IID）与模型不对称场景下常出现"负迁移"（negative transfer），即联邦方法的表现甚至劣于纯本地训练。现有联邦知识蒸馏（FKD）方法存在两大缺陷：(1) 依赖额外的公共数据集或共享中间表示，实际部署中公共数据难以获取且存在隐私泄露风险；(2) 隐含假设所有迁移的知识同等可靠，忽视了教师模型在不同样本、不同客户端上知识质量的巨大差异。论文的核心问题是："当教师模型值得被信任以指导知识迁移时？"（when should a teacher model be trusted to guide knowledge transfer?）作者以人类学习类比：教师并非对所有知识一视同仁，而是重点强调其最理解、最有把握的部分。
AI.method:
框架结构：每个客户端维护两个模型——高容量私有模型 f_k（本地主任务学习，参数永不上传）与轻量共享代理模型 g_k（跨客户端知识交换，架构统一、可聚合）。每个通信轮分三阶段：(1) 前向代理蒸馏：冻结 f_k，仅用本地数据以任务特定蒸馏损失训练 g_k 模仿 f_k；(2) 代理聚合：服务端对 g_k 取平均得全局代理 g 并广播；(3) 能量门控私有更新：冻结 g，用组合目标更新 f_k。

能量门控机制（核心创新）：先计算私有-代理分歧能量 E(x)。分类任务采用熵归一化对称 KL：E(x) = [½(KL(p‖q)+KL(q‖p))] / [H(p)+H(q)+ε_H]，其中 p=σ(f_k(x)), q=σ(g(x))；该设计具有三个性质：对称性（对交换不变）、熵归一化（相对分歧而非绝对 KL，低熵尖锐预测下的冲突更值得警惕）、结合分布失配与预测特异性。回归任务采用 E(x) = ½‖f_k(x) − g(x)‖²（连续预测分歧）。

随后在每个 minibatch 内做批归一化与逻辑门控：Ẽ_i = (E_i − μ_B)/(s_B + ε_B)，w_i = ρ(−βẼ_i)，ρ 为 sigmoid。信任权重是批内相对的：能量低于批均值者权重 > 1/2，高于批均值者 < 1/2；E_i ≤ E_j ⇒ w_i ≥ w_j（保序性）。最终损失：L_private = L_sup + λ_kd · E_B[ (1/|B|) Σ sg(w_i)·ℓ_KD(x_i) ]，其中 ℓ_KD 分类为 KL(q‖p)、回归为平方误差；sg(·) 为停止梯度，使门控仅作为可靠性权重而非额外优化路径，保证逐样本梯度是原蒸馏梯度的正标量倍、不反转方向。

理论性质（附录F）：命题1批内相对单调性；命题2权重有界非退化（0 < w_i < 1，避免硬拒绝；n=1 时 w=1/2，n≥2 时 w_i ∈ [ρ(−β√(n−1)), ρ(β√(n−1))]）；命题3逻辑门控的变分解释（熵正则化软信任分配问题的唯一极小解）；命题4停止梯度保持逐样本蒸馏方向；推论1/2给出回归与分类的输出级影响界。

实验设置：6 客户端 cross-silo 设定，Dirichlet 划分（α ∈ {0.1, 0.3, 0.5}，分类为标签偏移、回归为 K-means 聚类（B=5）后的协变量偏移），10 次独立随机种子。私有模型 PrivateCNN（3 层卷积 64→128→128 + FC 256），代理模型 ProxyCNN（2 层卷积 32→64 + 128 维特征）。Adam lr=1e-4，5 轮通信，每轮 2 本地 epoch，训练 batch 64，评估 batch 256。β=1、λ_kd=1 无需调参。基线：FedAvg、FedProx、FedDyn，以及 FedType 变体（FedAvg+FedType、FedProx+FedType）。指标：分类用 Δ=Acc_method − Acc_local 的 Avg/Worst/P10；回归用 Δ=RMSE_method − RMSE_local 的 Avg/Worst/P90，另报平均精度与 RMSE。
AI.result: 负迁移（平均指标）：分类任务 AvgΔ 上，FedeKD 在 α=0.1 时于 4 个数据集全部最佳（如 FashionMNIST −0.0065 vs FedAvg 的 −0.4604、CIFAR-10 −0.0033 vs −0.5525），α=0.3 时 3 个数据集最佳，α=0.5 时与最优方法相当。回归任务 AvgΔ 上 FedeKD 在全部 6 个设定中最佳且接近零或为负（RetinaMNIST α=0.1 为 −0.0019，而 FedDyn 为 0.6091、FedAvg 为 0.1459）。鲁棒性尾部指标：分类 WorstΔ 在所有数据集与所有异构水平下均为最佳（如 FashionMNIST α=0.1 为 −0.0213 vs FedAvg −0.7704）；P10Δ 同样全面占优。回归 WorstΔ 与 P90Δ 亦在所有设定中最低（如 RetinaMNIST WorstΔ 0.1663 vs FedAvg 0.3917），说明收益覆盖客户端分布的中心与尾部而非仅靠个别客户端拉低均值。预测性能：分类平均客户端精度保持顶尖（α=0.1 时 4 个数据集全部最佳，如 FashionMNIST 0.9273、OrganAMNIST 0.9303），少数非最佳情形差距极小；回归平均客户端 RMSE 在全部异构水平上最低（RetinaMNIST α=0.1 为 1.2428 vs FedAvg 1.3907）。方差方面 FedeKD 跨运行标准差普遍小于基线，稳定性更好。消融：去掉门控（No Gating，即全信任反向蒸馏）负迁移显著恶化（FashionMNIST α=0.1 从 −0.0065 变为 −0.0636），证明单纯引入反向蒸馏不够；对比熵、margin、LSE、特征距离等替代能量，均未能稳定匹敌 KL 能量（feature-distance 在个别情形有竞争力但方差更大、强异构下退化）。超参敏感性：β 呈单峰，β=2 最优，β∈[1,2] 为稳健默认；过小（0.25）近似均匀权重无门控效果，过大（4、8）过度选择性抑制有用知识；λ_kd 呈单峰，λ_kd∈[0.25,0.5] 较优，过大会放大 λ_kd·w(x) 实质绕过门控并重新引入负迁移。计算与通信开销：相对标准监督更新，每轮额外增加一次私有教师前向、一次代理教师前向和一次轻量代理更新；通信量 O(|θ_g|)，私有参数不出本地。
AI.conclusion: FedeKD 将"知识可靠性"提升为联邦知识蒸馏中的一等公民，通过批归一化逻辑门控把私有-代理分歧转化为连续、样本级、批内相对的信任权重，在无需公共数据的前提下显著抑制异构联邦学习中的负迁移，同时保持（甚至提升）预测性能，并在最差客户端与分布尾部等鲁棒性指标上一致占优。其相对 FedType 的主要差异在于：用连续的样本级加权目标替代离散集合式（共形）可靠性过滤，且原则定义在模型输出层面，可自然推广到回归任务。局限：实验基于公开基准与模拟 cross-silo 划分，难以完全反映真实多中心的采集流程、标注质量等差异；未直接评估子群体公平性（结论应理解为异构下的鲁棒性提升而非公平性解决）；双模型加双向蒸馏带来额外计算与同步开销；回归能量衡量的是预测分歧而非校准的不确定性，且理论性质仅说明门控提供有原则的相对信任分配与梯度缩放，并不保证最终负迁移必然下降。后续方向包括真实多中心部署、公平性评估、自适应与校准感知的信任估计，以及更高效的通信训练。

title: Best Arm Identification in Generalized Linear Bandits via Hybrid Feedback
summary: We study fixed-confidence best arm identification in generalized linear bandits under a hybrid feedback model: at each round, the learner may query either (i) absolute reward feedback from a single arm or (ii) relative (dueling) feedback from an arm pair, both governed by generalized linear models. We introduce a likelihood-ratio--based confidence sequence that unifies heterogeneous generalized linear observations and yields an explicit ellipsoidal confidence set under a self-concordance assumption. Building on this confidence set, we propose a hybrid Track-and-Stop algorithm that adaptively allocates queries by tracking a minimax-optimal design over a joint action space of arms and pairs. We establish $δ$-correctness and provide high-probability upper bounds on the stopping time. We further extend the framework to a cost-aware setting that accounts for heterogeneous acquisition costs across feedback modalities. Empirical experiments demonstrate that the proposed algorithms significantly improve sample efficiency over baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了广义线性 bandit 中固定置信度最佳臂识别问题，创新性地在混合反馈模型下（绝对奖励查询与相对比较查询混合）提出似然比置信序列和自适应 Track-and-Stop 算法，在理论上证明了 δ-正确性并在实验上验证了样本效率优势。
AI.motivation: 传统 bandit 方法通常仅处理单一类型的反馈（纯绝对奖励或纯相对比较），难以适应实际场景中异构反馈并存的情况。需要构建统一框架以同时利用绝对奖励和相对比较两种信息源，提升最佳臂识别的样本效率。
AI.method: 1. 提出基于似然比的置信序列（likelihood-ratio--based confidence sequence），统一异构的广义线性观测；2. 在自共轭假设下推导出显式椭球置信集；3. 设计自适应混合 Track-and-Stop 算法，通过跟踪 minimax 最优设计在臂和配对的联合动作空间上分配查询；4. 扩展至成本感知场景，处理跨模态的异构获取成本。
AI.result: 建立了算法的 δ-正确性（δ-correctness），提供了停止时间的高概率上界，并通过实证实验验证了相对于基线方法有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一个统一的混合反馈 bandit 框架，通过自适应分配绝对奖励和相对比较两类查询，显著提升了样本效率。理论分析和实验验证表明该方法具有可靠性和有效性。

title: Accelerating LMO-Based Optimization via Implicit Gradient Transport
summary: Recent optimizers such as Lion and Muon have demonstrated strong empirical performance by normalizing gradient momentum via linear minimization oracles (LMOs). While variance reduction has been explored to accelerate LMO-based methods, it typically incurs substantial computational overhead due to additional gradient evaluations. At the same time, the theoretical understanding of LMO-based methods remains fragmented across unconstrained and constrained formulations. Motivated by these limitations, we propose \emph{LMO-IGT}, a new class of stochastic LMO-based methods leveraging implicit gradient transport (IGT). We further introduce a unified framework for stochastic LMO-based optimization together with a new stationarity measure, the \emph{regularized support function} (RSF), which bridges gradient-norm and Frank--Wolfe-gap notions within a common framework. By evaluating stochastic gradients at transported points, LMO-IGT accelerates convergence while retaining the single-gradient-per-iteration structure of standard stochastic LMO. Our analysis establishes that stochastic LMO achieves an iteration complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$, variance-reduced LMO achieves $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$ at the cost of additional gradient evaluations, and LMO-IGT achieves $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3.5})$ using only a single stochastic gradient per iteration. Empirically, LMO-IGT consistently improves over stochastic LMO counterparts with negligible overhead. Among its instantiations, Muon-IGT achieves the strongest overall performance across evaluated settings, demonstrating that IGT provides an effective and practical acceleration mechanism for modern LMO-based optimization.

AI.tldr: LMO-IGT提出了一种结合隐式梯度传输的随机LMO优化新方法，在单次梯度计算下实现O(ε^-3.5)复杂度，并通过Muon-IGT等实例验证了其在现代优化中的实用加速效果。
AI.motivation: 现有LMO方法的理论分散在无约束和约束形式中，方差缩减技术虽能加速但带来额外梯度评估开销，且对LMO方法的理论理解不够统一。
AI.method: 提出LMO-IGT方法，利用隐式梯度传输在运输点评估随机梯度；引入正则化支持函数(RSF)作为新的收敛准则，统一了梯度范数和Frank-Wolfe间隙概念；建立了LMO方法的统一框架。
AI.result: 随机LMO达到O(ε^-4)，方差缩减LMO达到O(ε^-3)但需额外梯度评估，LMO-IGT仅用单次随机梯度达到O(ε^-3.5)。
AI.conclusion: LMO-IGT通过隐式梯度传输实现了理论与实践的有效加速，其中Muon-IGT在各种场景下表现最优，证明了IGT作为现代LMO优化加速机制的有效性和实用性。

title: MiA-Signature: Approximating Global Activation for Long-Context Understanding
comment: This is a work in progress; we will continue to revise and improve the manuscript
summary: A growing body of work in cognitive science suggests that reportable conscious access is associated with \emph{global ignition} over distributed memory systems, while such activation is only partially accessible as individuals cannot directly access or enumerate all activated contents. This tension suggests a plausible mechanism that cognition may rely on a compact representation that approximates the global influence of activation on downstream processing. Inspired by this idea, we introduce the concept of \textbf{Mindscape Activation Signature (MiA-Signature)}, a compressed representation of the global activation pattern induced by a query. In LLM systems, this is instantiated via submodular-based selection of high-level concepts that cover the activated context space, optionally refined through lightweight iterative updates using working memory. The resulting MiA-Signature serves as a conditioning signal that approximates the effect of the full activation state while remaining computationally tractable. Integrating MiA-Signatures into both RAG and agentic systems yields consistent performance gains across multiple long-context understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MiA-Signature（心灵景观激活签名），一种基于认知科学启发的压缩表示方法，用于近似LLM中全局激活模式。通过子模选择高级概念构建签名，可选地利用工作记忆迭代更新，集成到RAG和智能体系统中，在长上下文理解任务上获得一致性能提升。
AI.motivation: 认知科学表明可报告的意识访问与分布式记忆系统上的全局点燃相关，但个体只能部分访问激活内容，无法直接获取或枚举所有激活内容。这表明认知可能依赖紧凑表示来近似激活的全局影响。
AI.method: 通过子模优化选择覆盖激活上下文空间的高级概念构建MiA-Signature，并可选择性地使用工作记忆进行轻量级迭代更新。该签名作为条件信号集成到RAG和智能体系统中。
AI.result: 在多个长上下文理解任务中，将MiA-Signature集成到RAG和智能体系统后均获得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: MiA-Signature作为一种压缩表示，能够有效近似完整激活状态对下游处理的影响，同时保持计算可处理性，为LLM系统的长上下文理解提供了一种认知启发的解决方案。

title: Evaluating Explainability in Safety-Critical ATR Systems: Limitations of Post-Hoc Methods and Paths Toward Robust XAI
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) is increasingly rec ognized as essential for deploying machine learning systems in safety critical environments. In Automatic Target Recognition (ATR), where models operate on image, video, radar, and multisensor data, high pre dictive performance alone is insufficient. Model decisions must also be interpretable, reliable, and suitable for validation. This paper presents a structured evaluation of explainability methods in the context of safety-critical ATR systems: We identify major XAI paradigms, including saliency-based, attention-based, and surrogate ap proaches, as well as recent detection-aware extensions. Based on this, we formalize explainability as an assurance-oriented assessment problem, introduce a taxonomy, and assess these methods with respect to four key dimensions: interpretability, robustness, vulnerability to manipula tion, and suitability for validation and verification. The analysis identifies systematic limitations of current post-hoc explanation methods. In par ticular, we derive critical failure modes such as spurious explanations, instability under perturbations, and overtrust induced by visually con vincing outputs. These findings indicate that widely used XAI techniques may be insufficient for safety-critical deployment. Finally, we discuss implications for ATR systems and outline directions toward more robust, causally grounded, and physically informed explain ability methods. Our results emphasize the need to move beyond visually plausible explanations toward approaches that support reliable decision making and system-level assurance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对安全攸关的自动目标识别（ATR）系统，提出一个面向保证（assurance）的XAI评估框架与分类体系，系统比较了显著性、注意力、代理模型、检测感知（detection-aware）和内在/物理信息化五类解释范式在可解释性、鲁棒性、可操纵性与V&V适用性四个维度上的表现。结论是：主流后验（post-hoc）解释方法存在虚假解释、扰动下不稳定、视觉可信导致的过度信任等系统性缺陷，无法单独支撑高保证部署；建议转向因果化、物理化、模型内置的混合可解释方法。
AI.motivation: 在ATR（自动目标识别）这类安全攸关场景中，模型处理的输入涵盖图像、视频、雷达、SAR及多传感器数据，传统的"高预测精度"标准不足以保证系统可交付：决策还必须是可解释、可靠且可用于验证与确认（V&V）的。现有通用XAI综述多与应用无关，检测专用解释基准主要关注定位精度、忠实性与计算复杂度，而安全攸关AI研究又缺乏面向ATR的统一评估视角；且实证研究表明许多解释方法在模型随机化下仍保持稳定、对微小扰动异常敏感、甚至与真实决策过程无关。因此需要一个将解释方法与操作保证要求直接挂钩的、面向ATR的评估框架，以判断现有XAI范式哪些适用、哪些不足、哪些有前景。
AI.method: 不做新解释算法，而是做结构化评估研究：①问题形式化——将ATR建模为预测模型 f(x)=argmax_y p(y|x)，检测场景扩展为 {(y_i,b_i)}，并定义解释函数 E:(f,x)↦e；由于解释缺乏ground truth，将可解释性质量转化为多准则间接评估问题；②提出四个评估维度：可解释性（区分视觉合理性与语义正确性）、鲁棒性（对输入噪声/视角/环境与模型变化的一致性）、可操纵性（对抗性或蓄意修改下解释是否可被篡改而预测不变）、V&V适用性（能否支撑系统化测试、验证与论证）；③构建统一分类：显著性方法（Vanilla Gradients、Integrated Gradients、Grad-CAM、G-CAME）、注意力方法（DETR等Transformer的注意力权重）、代理模型（LIME、SHAP）、检测感知XAI（G-CAME、ODExAI等OD专用评估）、内在/物理信息化模型（雷达/SAR中嵌入物理模型与约束）；④跨范式定性对比并汇总为Table 1，标注各范式在四维度及ATR特定适用性上的评级；⑤归纳失败模式：虚假解释、视觉可信导致的过度信任、扰动下不稳定、深度学习可解释性的根本上限；⑥推导面向稳健、因果化、物理信息化XAI的研究方向。
AI.result: Table 1 给出核心对比结论：显著性方法视觉可解释性高但鲁棒性低、可操纵性高、V&V适用性有限，仅适合EO/IR图像ATR与检测的初步勘察，不可作为独立安全证据；注意力方法中等可解释性、鲁棒性中低、注意力权重不必等价于因果重要性，只能作为诊断信号；代理模型可解释性中至高但依赖采样与近似保真度，在高维图像/雷达/多传感器下易误导，V&V仅中等；检测感知XAI在空间定位上可解释性高、与检测输出对齐，但继承梯度方法的扰动敏感与因果性弱，V&V优于通用显著性但仍需鲁棒性与忠实性测试；内在/物理信息化模型在物理约束匹配时鲁棒性高、可操纵性低至中、V&V适用性高，最适合雷达、SAR、多传感器ATR。失败模式方面：随机化模型权重仍可产生相似显著图（说明解释主要受输入分布驱动而非模型参数）；解释对噪声、微小平移与视角变化高度敏感，损害可复现性；人类倾向信任视觉连贯的解释，产生过度信任风险；高维非线性表示空间与多表征等效性使唯一因果解释难以确立。
AI.conclusion: 现有后验XAI方法（显著性与注意力为主）缺乏鲁棒性、因果有效性与可验证性，不足以支撑安全攸关ATR的高保证部署；检测感知方法改善了空间定位对齐但未解决梯度类方法固有缺陷；代理模型受近似保真度限制。作者主张将可解释性从"视觉上似真的解释"推进到"稳健、因果有据、可验证、扎根于数据物理过程"的解释，未来方向包括结合深度学习灵活性与结构化物理表征的混合/内在可解释模型，以及面向安全攸关应用的标准化评估框架与基准（含检测感知方法的系统比较），并将解释集成进模型设计与形式化V&V流程。

title: AeroJEPA: Learning Semantic Latent Representations for Scalable 3D Aerodynamic Field Modeling
summary: Aerodynamic surrogate models are increasingly used to replace repeated high-fidelity CFD evaluations in many-query design settings, but current approaches still face two important limitations: they often scale poorly to the very large fields arising in realistic 3D aerodynamics, and they rarely produce latent representations that are directly useful for analysis and design. We introduce AeroJEPA, a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for aerodynamic field modeling that addresses both issues. Rather than predicting the full flow field directly from geometry, AeroJEPA predicts a target latent representation of the flow from a context latent representation of the geometry and operating conditions, and optionally reconstructs the field through a continuous implicit decoder. This formulation decouples latent prediction from field resolution while encouraging the latent space to organize semantically. We evaluate AeroJEPA on two complementary datasets: HiLiftAeroML, which stresses the method in a high-fidelity regime with extremely large boundary-layer fields, and SuperWing, which tests large-scale generalization and latent-space optimization over a broad family of transonic wings. Across these benchmarks, AeroJEPA is competitive as a continuous surrogate for aerodynamic fields, scales naturally to high-resolution outputs, and learns context and predicted latents that encode geometry and aerodynamic quantities not used directly as supervision. We further show that the resulting latent space supports controlled interpolation, linear probing, concept-vector arithmetic, and a constrained design latent-optimization experiment. These results suggest that predictive latent learning is a promising direction for scalable and design-meaningful aerodynamic surrogate modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AeroJEPA——一种面向三维气动场的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）代理模型。它不再直接从几何回归整个流场，而是将问题拆分为两个隐空间：上下文编码器把几何点云映射为几何 token，预测器结合工况条件生成"预测气动 token"，再由连续隐式神经表示（INR）解码器按需在指定坐标处查询流场。HiLiftAeroML（千万级边界层点）上 AeroJEPA 与 GeoTransolver 精度相当但推理快 62.6%–77.0%、模型最小；SuperWing 上直接回归 Transformer 精度更优，构成"重建保真度 vs 表示可复用性"的显式权衡。AeroJEPA 的独特优势是选择性解码：在外翼局部区域压力 RMSE=1.468、R²=0.953，远优于 Transolver/GeoTransolver（RMSE≈8.5，R² 为负），且结果与查询批次划分完全无关（repartition NRMSE=0）。隐空间支持线性探针恢复控制面偏转（R²=0.965–0.988）与升阻力系数（R²≈0.93–0.996）、潜变量插值、概念向量算术（襟翼-缝翼解耦）以及带约束的 L/D 潜空间优化。
AI.motivation: 高保真 CFD 计算昂贵，气动代理模型被广泛用于多查询设计优化。但现有方法存在两个关键局限：(1) 面向直接场回归的架构（如 FIGConvUNet、Transolver、GeoTransolver）在真实三维高升力场景下产生的千万级场难以扩展，且即便只需一个局部区域或一个积分气动量，也必须预测整个 CFD 离散化的数百万个场点；(2) 这些模型的中间特征并非为下游工程任务（系数预测、设计变量反演、插值、优化）而组织，无法直接复用。与此同时，JEPA 系列方法（LeJEPA、LeWorldModel 等）通过预测目标表示而非直接回归，并借助显式隐空间正则（SIGReg）避免塌缩，但尚未针对三维气动分析所需的"几何表示"与"气动表示"分离这一特性进行设计。作者因此希望构建一个既可扩展地输出高分辨率场、又直接暴露可复用语义隐表示的代理模型。
AI.method: 框架将问题形式化为：给定几何边界点云 P={x_i} 与工况向量 c（如 α、Re、Ma），学习两个互补表示——几何上下文表示 Z_c 与预测气动表示 Ẑ_t，且预测表示须支持在任意查询坐标 q 上求值场值。结构上：(1) 上下文编码器 E_c：均匀下采样（HiLift 131,072 点、SuperWing 8,192 点）后用最远点采样（FPS）选 tokenizer 中心，局部邻域消息传递聚合 + Point Transformer 骨干（局部自注意力）输出固定长度 token 集（HiLift M=3072,d=64；SuperWing M=512,d=128），表面情形输入坐标，体积情形附加 SDF 值；(2) 目标编码器 E_t：仅训练期使用，对独立采样的流场点云编码为 Z_t，与几何点云无逐点对应要求；(3) 预测器 f_pred：可学习 latent query + 高频 Fourier 位置编码，交替局部自注意力与 cross-attention，从 Z_c 中"取用"几何特征，工况标量经 MLP 与自适应特征调制（AdaLN）注入，使一次几何编码可支持多工况；(4) INR 解码器 f_dec：条件于 Ẑ_t 的 MLP（Fourier 特征编码坐标，体积情形加 SDF），连续、分辨率无关，可在任意坐标点求值，无需体网格。训练目标为端到端耦合：L_total = λ_l·L_lat（||Ẑ_t − Z_t||²）+ λ_r·L_rec（重建 MSE）+ λ_s·L_sig（SIGReg 随机低维投影到各向同性高斯参考分布，抑制维度塌缩且无需 EMA teacher/stop-gradient），主实验 λ_l=1.0、λ_r=1.0、λ_s=0.001。重建查询点独立采样，形成掩码式训练。基线为 FIGConvUNet、Transolver、GeoTransolver（均用官方 NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo 实现），跨两个数据集评测全场误差、TFLOPs、推理时间、参数量，并额外做选择性解码、训练目标消融（SIGReg 权重、对比损失、仅重建 vs 完整目标）、线性探针、潜变量插值、概念向量算术与受约束潜空间优化（SLSQP + Mahalanobis 信任域 + 设计参数仿射边界 + 气动约束 + L/D 上限，8 次随机重启）。
AI.result: HiLiftAeroML（约1500万表面点/5000万体积点）：AeroJEPA 压力相对 L2=0.0048（与 GeoTransolver 持平），u/w 分量误差最低（0.1445/0.1880），v 略次（0.2749 vs 0.2489）；全场解码 57.00 TFLOPs、43 s，较 Transolver（189.44 TFLOPs/115 s）快 62.6%，较 GeoTransolver（309.13 TFLOPs/187 s）快 77.0%；部署模型最小（3.09 M，训练时 3.45 M），训练约 48 h/300 epoch，基线约 96 h。选择性解码（50 个留出案例外翼区域，65,536 点）：AeroJEPA 压力 RMSE=1.468、R²=0.953、u/v/w R²=0.932/0.933/0.962，repartition NRMSE=0.0000；Transolver RMSE=8.462、R²=−0.161、NRMSE=0.0225，GeoTransolver RMSE=8.537、R²=−0.089、NRMSE=0.0134。隐空间分析：上下文隐变量 PCA 结构比自编码器基线更连贯，四个主控制面偏转由 ridge 探针恢复 R²=0.965–0.988（从未监督）；预测隐变量恢复 C_L/C_D 的 R²=0.939/0.986（D.7 报告 0.930/0.996）；概念向量算术显示襟翼-缝翼交叉串扰弱，残余耦合集中于同一表面的内/外段，与数据集中的几何相关性一致；解码场本身积分得到的 C_L/C_D 也有良好一致性。SuperWing（4,239 机翼 / 28,856 RANS 解，32,768 表面点）：AeroJEPA 弱于直接回归——C_f,τ 0.0548 vs GeoTransolver 0.0280，C_f,z 0.1084 vs 0.0529，C_p 0.0644 vs 0.0309，但优于 FIGConvUNet（0.1429/0.2912/0.1946），TFLOPs 0.32 最低；探针指标 Design R²=0.886、Aero R²=0.993、ΔAero R²=0.987。消融：SIGReg λ=1e-3 最佳（field MSE 0.0085），加大权重单调变差，对比损失显著退化（design R²=0.460、field MSE=0.5072）；30 epoch 匹配对比中完整目标优于仅重建（predicted R@1 4%→92%，context R@1 88%→100%）。潜优化在 128 维上下文隐空间中无需解码场即可提升探针预测 L/D，8 次重启收敛到同一邻域，最近邻数据机翼具有相似参数剖面（大参考面积/展弦比、高后掠、强 taper、根部偏置 washout）。
AI.conclusion: AeroJEPA 证明"预测式表示学习"可作为三维气动代理建模的有价值方向：以几何上下文 token 与条件化气动 token 分离表示，配合连续隐式解码器，既能支撑无需全场重建的下游读出（线性探针、插值、概念向量算术、受约束潜空间优化），又能在千万点级的 HiLiftAeroML 上以更低计算成本给出有竞争力的精度。作者明确承认这是"重建保真度 vs 表示可复用性"的有意权衡——在 SuperWing 这类单次前向即可覆盖全场的情形下，直接回归 Transformer 的全场精度仍然更优；而在选择性/局部解码场景中 AeroJEPA 明显占优，并且输出与查询批次划分完全解耦（NRMSE=0）。局限与展望：当前仅覆盖两个定常流数据集，两阶段（冻结目标）与无解码器配置未做实验对比，潜空间优化得到的"最优"未经新 CFD 验证，仅证明表示级设计探索的可行性；未来将扩展至非定常与多保真度、更多下游工程任务，并与逆设计与形状参数化流程集成、通过新 CFD 仿真验证潜空间设计候选。

title: From 124 Million Tokens to 1,021 Neologisms: A Large-Scale Pipeline for Automatic Neologism Detection
comment: 14 pages, 5 tables. Accepted at NeoLLM 2026 Workshop, co-located with LREC-COLING 2026
summary: We present a scalable, modular pipeline for automatic neologism detection that combines rule-based filtering with LLM classification. The pipeline is grounded in two complementary word-formation frameworks, grammatical and extra-grammatical morphology, which jointly define the scope of what counts as a neologism and inform a four-class classification scheme (neologism, entity, foreign, none). While designed to be modular and transferable at the architectural level, the pipeline is instantiated on 527 million English-language Reddit posts spanning 2005-2024. From this corpus, we extract 124.6 million unique tokens and reduce them by over 99.99% to yield 1,021 neologism candidates, a set small enough for manual expert verification. Multiple LLMs independently classify each candidate via majority vote, with a final verification step, revealing substantial cross-model disagreement and highlighting the challenge of operationalizing neologism detection at scale. Manual annotation of all 1,021 candidates confirms that 599 (58.7%) are genuine lexical innovations. The pipeline code, vocabulary compilation scripts, and the annotated candidate list are available at https://github.com/DiegoRossini/neologism-pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个结合形态学理论与LLM的大规模英语新词检测pipeline，在5.27亿Reddit帖子上识别出1,021个候选词，其中599个经验证为真实新词。开源了完整代码和标注数据。
AI.motivation: 新词（neologism）检测对于语言演变追踪、词库建设和NLP系统更新至关重要，但大规模自动化检测面临挑战：如何界定"新词"边界、过滤噪音、验证结果。
AI.method: 采用规则过滤与大语言模型分类相结合的双阶段pipeline。以grammatical和extra-grammatical形态学框架定义新词边界，实现四分类（neologism/entity/foreign/none）。在5.27亿条Reddit帖子上实例化，LLM通过多数投票独立分类，最终人工验证全部1,021个候选词。
AI.result: 从124.6M唯一token中筛选出1,021个候选词（过滤率>99.99%），人工标注确认599个（58.7%）为真正词汇创新。多个LLM分类结果存在显著跨模型分歧。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了一个可复用的模块化框架，将形态学理论与大语言模型相结合，实现了大规模新词检测。58.7%的人工验证准确率表明pipeline具有实用性，但LLM间的显著分歧揭示了"新词"概念操作化的内在挑战。开源代码和数据为后续研究奠定了基础。

title: Confidence is the key: how conformal prediction enhances the generative design of permeable peptides
summary: Generative models coupled with reinforcement learning (RL), such as REINVENT and PepINVENT, have emerged as a powerful framework for de novo molecular design. During the ideation process these generative frameworks utilize various predictive models as part of the optimization objectives. However, the utility of the predictive models can be limited by their domain of applicability. When RL is used to explore the chemical space with predictive models, it can suggest molecules that lie outside the predictor's domain of applicability. As a result, the predictions may become less reliable, potentially steering designs into high reward but also high uncertainty chemical spaces. This is particularly pronounced for cyclic peptides which show therapeutic promise due to their modifiability and large interaction surfaces but are understudied compared to small molecules. While passive membrane permeation in cyclic peptides has attracted interest, identifying optimal permeable designs remains challenging yet crucial for targeting intracellular sites. We present an RL-guided generative framework that designs permeable cyclic peptides using an uncertainty-aware permeability predictor as the scoring component. To address predictive uncertainty, especially impacted by novel chemistry, we integrate conformal prediction (CP) as our uncertainty quantification method. CP assesses designs based on the calibrated model under a user-defined confidence level. We demonstrate that rewarding generated peptides with CP-informed predictions improves both reliability and efficiency of peptide optimization process. This also discourages exploration outside the predictor's applicability domain. This approach bridges the gap between predictive uncertainty and RL-guided exploration, showing how generative modelling and conformal prediction can be combined for the first time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种不确定性感知的RL引导生成框架，通过首次将生成建模与保形预测(CP)相结合来解决环肽膜渗透性优化问题。CP在用户定义置信水平下量化预测不确定性，奖励机制动态约束探索空间，从而提升分子设计的可靠性和效率。
AI.motivation: 在基于RL的环肽生成过程中，预测模型容易在适用域外给出不可靠的高奖励预测，可能将设计导向高奖励但高不确定性的化学空间。环肽因其可修饰性和大接触表面而具有治疗潜力，但与小分子相比研究不足。膜渗透性优化面临识别最佳设计困难的挑战，尤其针对细胞内靶点。
AI.method: 采用RL引导的生成框架设计具有膜渗透性的环肽，关键创新在于集成保形预测(CP)作为不确定性量化方法。CP在用户定义的置信水平下评估设计，基于校准模型对生成肽进行评分，同时结合不确定性感知渗透性预测器作为评分组件。当预测值超过预设置信区间时，系统自动降低奖励值，从而限制模型在适用域外的探索。
AI.result: 实验表明，使用CP知情预测对生成肽进行奖励可显著提升肽优化过程的可靠性和效率，同时有效抑制在预测器适用域外的探索行为。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将生成建模与保形预测相结合，弥合了预测不确定性与RL引导探索之间的差距。通过CP辅助的不确定性感知评分机制，该框架能够在保持优化效率的同时有效约束探索空间，避免在高不确定性区域进行采样，从而提升分子设计的可靠性。

title: When Can Voting Help, Hurt, or Change Course? Exact Structure of Binary Test-Time Aggregation
summary: Majority voting is one of the few black-box interventions that can improve a fixed stochastic predictor: repeated access can be cheaper than changing a high-capability model. Classical fixed-competence theory makes this intervention look monotone -- more votes help above the majority threshold and hurt below it. We show that this picture is fundamentally incomplete. Under the de Finetti representation for exchangeable repeated correctness, voting is governed by a latent distribution of per-example correctness probabilities. Even simple latent mixtures can generate sharply different voting curves, including nonmonotone behavior and, in an explicit construction, infinitely many trend changes. The full latent law determines the curve, but the curve does not determine the law. The exact object recovered by voting is a signed voting signature: at each binomial variance scale, it records excess latent mass above rather than below the majority threshold. Our main theorem proves that the complete odd-budget curve and this signature are equivalent: the curve increments are signed Hausdorff moments, and the full curve recovers the signature uniquely. This viewpoint explains shape phenomena, branch-symmetric nonidentifiability, realizability, variation, and endpoint rates. It also separates estimation regimes: direct per-example success-probability information targets the full signature, whereas fixed-depth grouped labels reveal only a finite prefix.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了多数投票改善随机预测器的传统认知——经典理论认为投票是单调的（多数阈值以上越多投票越好，以下则反之），但作者证明这一图景不完整。在de Finetti表示框架下，投票行为由潜在的正确率分布决定，可产生非单调甚至无限次趋势变化的复杂投票曲线。核心贡献是建立了完整的奇数预算曲线（odd-budget curve）与"符号投票签名"（signed voting signature）之间的等价性——曲线增量是带符号的Hausdorff矩，且完整曲线可唯一恢复该签名。
AI.motivation: 传统固定能力理论将多数投票视为单调干预——在多数阈值以上投票越多越好，以下则反之。本文指出这一图景根本上是是不完整的，需要更深入的理论来解释投票曲线可能呈现的复杂形状现象。
AI.method: 采用de Finetti表示框架刻画可交换重复正确性的潜在分布；构造了简单的潜在混合分布来产生非单调投票曲线和无限次趋势变化的显式构造；建立投票签名概念——记录每个二项方差尺度下阈值以上与以下的超额潜在质量；证明完整的奇数预算曲线与投票签名等价，曲线增量是带符号的Hausdorff矩。
AI.result: 发现了投票曲线的多种反直觉形态：非单调行为、无限次趋势变化；建立了曲线与潜在分布之间的完整对应关系；证明了签名分支对称不可辨识性；区分了两种估计机制——直接获取样本正确率信息可恢复完整签名，而固定深度的分组标签只能揭示有限前缀。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了多数投票的完整理论框架，解释了形状现象、不可辨识性、可实现性、变异性和端点速率，同时明确了估计问题的本质差异——信息获取方式决定了能恢复的签名长度。

title: COVID-19 Infodemic. Understanding content features in detecting fake news using a machine learning approach
summary: The use of content features, particularly textual and linguistic for fake news detection is under-researched, despite empirical evidence showing the features could contribute to differentiating real and fake news. To this end, this study investigates a selection of content features such as word bigrams, part of speech distribution etc. to improve fake news detection. We performed a series of experiments on a new dataset gathered during the COVID-19 pandemic and using Decision Tree, K-Nearest Neighbor, Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine and Random Forest. Random Forest yielded the best results, followed closely by Support Vector Machine, across all setups. In general, both the textual and linguistic features were found to improve fake news detection when used separately, however, combining them into a single model did not improve the detection significantly. Differences were also noted between the use of bigrams and part of speech tags. The study shows that textual and linguistic features can be used successfully in detecting fake news using the traditional machine learning approach as opposed to deep learning.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了文本和语言特征在COVID-19虚假新闻检测中的应用，证明传统机器学习方法（如随机森林）在此任务上有效，但特征融合并未带来额外增益。
AI.motivation: 内容特征（尤其是文本和语言特征）在虚假新闻检测中的研究不足，尽管经验证据表明这些特征有助于区分真假新闻。
AI.method: 在COVID-19疫情期间收集的新数据集上，使用内容特征（词二元组、词性分布等），并采用决策树、K近邻、逻辑回归、支持向量机和随机森林五种机器学习算法进行实验。
AI.result: 随机森林表现最佳，支持向量机次之；文本和语言特征单独使用时均能改善检测效果，但合并使用并未显著提升；词二元组和词性标签的效果存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 文本和语言特征可以成功地用于使用传统机器学习方法（而非深度学习）检测虚假新闻。

title: CircuitFormer: A Circuit Language Model for Analog Topology Design from Natural Language Prompt
summary: Automating analog circuit design remains a longstanding challenge in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). While Transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized software code generation, their application to analog hardware design is hindered by two critical limitations: (i) the scarcity of analog design datasets containing natural language description of a design and its corresponding netlist, and (ii) the inefficiency of general-purpose tokenizers (e.g., Byte Pair Encoding (BPE)) in capturing the inherent graph structure of circuits. To bridge this gap, first, we curate the largest annotated dataset of analog circuit netlists to date, comprising 31,341 netlist-natural language description pairs across all major circuit classes. Furthermore, we propose Circuit Tokenizer (CKT), a novel circuit graph tokenizer designed to encode netlist connectivity by explicitly mining frequent subcircuits. In terms of scalability, CKT overcomes the bottleneck of prior circuit graph serialization methods where vocabulary size scales linearly with maximum number of components in the dataset, n_max, (O(n_max)); instead, CKT decouples vocabulary growth from circuit complexity, achieving a constant O(1) complexity. Empirically, CKT outperforms standard BPE on circuit topology representation, reducing sequence length by 57% and achieving a 2.3x superior compression ratio using a compact, fixed vocabulary of size 512. Leveraging this optimized tokenization, we train a circuit-specific language model, CircuitFormer, a 511M parameter encoder-decoder transformer. Our model achieves 100% syntactic correctness and an 83% functional success rate across all major analog circuit categories, outperforming state-of-the-art open-source LLMs by 10% and 14%, respectively, while requiring 240x fewer parameters. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/touhid314/cktformer-dataset.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对模拟电路自动设计难题，构建最大规模网表-描述配对数据集（31,341对），并提出基于频繁子电路挖掘的Circuit Tokenizer (CKT)，实现常数复杂度词表增长；基于此训练的511M参数模型CircuitFormer在语法正确率（100%）和功能成功率（83%）上均优于参数量240倍于自身的开源LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer大模型在模拟电路设计中的应用受限于两个关键瓶颈：一是缺乏包含自然语言描述与对应网表的大规模模拟设计数据集；二是通用分词器（如BPE）无法有效捕获电路的固有图结构。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含31,341对网表-自然语言描述的大规模数据集；2) 提出CKT分词器，通过挖掘频繁子电路编码网表连接性，实现O(1)词表复杂度；3) 基于CKT训练511M参数的encoder-decoder Transformer模型CircuitFormer。
AI.result: 相比开源LLM基线，CircuitFormer语法正确率达100%、功能成功率83%，分别提升10%和14%，且参数量减少240倍；CKT分词器将序列长度缩短57%，压缩比提升2.3倍，词表仅512个token。
AI.conclusion: CKT实现了常数复杂度的词表增长，突破以往方法的瓶颈；基于此训练的CircuitFormer在模拟电路生成任务上达到SOTA水平。

title: Optimal Contextual Pricing under Agnostic Non-Lipschitz Demand
summary: We study contextual dynamic pricing with linear valuations and bounded-support agnostic noise, whose induced demand curve may be non-Lipschitz with arbitrary jumps and atoms. Such discontinuities break the cross-context interpolation arguments used by smooth-demand pricing algorithms, while the best previous method achieved only $\tilde O(T^{3/4})$ regret. We propose Conservative-Markdown Redirect-UCB Pricing, a polynomial-time algorithm that combines randomized parameter estimation, conservative residual-grid probing, and confidence-based one-step redirection. Our algorithm achieves $\tilde O(T^{2/3})$ optimal regret, matching the known lower bounds of Kleinberg and Leighton (2003) up to logarithmic factors and improving over the previous upper bound of Xu and Wang (2022). Under stochastic well-conditioned contexts, this closes the long-existing open regret gap in linear-valuation contextual pricing under agnostic non-Lipschitz noise distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了上下文动态定价中需求曲线存在非 Lipschitz 间断点时的最优 regret 问题，通过设计新的定价算法将遗憾界从 $\tilde O(T^{3/4})$ 提升至 $\tilde O(T^{2/3})$，达到该设置下的最优下界。
AI.motivation: 现有光滑需求定价算法依赖跨上下文插值论证，但无法处理需求曲线中的非 Lipschitz 间断点（跳跃和原子），导致此前最优 regret 仅达 $\tilde O(T^{3/4})$。
AI.method: 结合三种核心机制：(1) 随机化参数估计；(2) 保守残差网格探测(conservative residual-grid probing)；(3) 基于置信度的单步重定向(one-step redirection)。算法可在多项式时间内完成。
AI.result: $\tilde O(T^{2/3})$ 最优 regret，匹配 Kleinberg 和 Leighton (2003) 的已知下界（至对数因子），优于 Xu and Wang (2022) 的上界。
AI.conclusion: 提出的Conservative-Markdown Redirect-UCB Pricing算法实现了$\tilde O(T^{2/3})$的最优遗憾界，在随机良好条件上下文下，封闭了线性估值情境定价在 agnostic 非 Lipschitz 噪声分布下长期存在的开放遗憾差距。

title: Towards Emotion Consistency Analysis of Large Language Models in Emotional Conversational Contexts
summary: In this work, we conduct an analysis to examine the consistency of Large Language Models (LLMs) with respect to their own generated responses in an emotionally-driven conversational context. Specifically, the text generated by LLM is framed as a query to the same model, and its responses are subsequently assessed. This is performed with three queries across two dimensions of extreme and moderate emotions. The three queries are, in particular, false claim queries that contain inherently wrong assumptions (false presuppositions) in increasing order of intensity. Two commercial models, Claude-3.5-haiku, GPT4o-mini, and a medium-sized model, Mistral-7B, are considered in the study. Our findings indicate that LLMs exhibit below-average performance and remain vulnerable to false beliefs embedded within queries. This susceptibility is especially pronounced for moderate emotional content. Furthermore, an extended attention-score-based analysis highlights a shift in models' priority from evaluative to generative. The results raise important considerations for LLMs' deployment in high-stakes, emotionally sensitive contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验了大语言模型在情绪驱动对话场景中对其自身生成响应的一致性评估能力。研究通过让模型重新评估自身生成的包含虚假预设的文本，测试了三个模型在不同情绪强度下的表现。结果表明模型普遍存在易受虚假信息影响的缺陷，尤其在适度情绪语境下更为严重，提示当前LLM在高风险情绪敏感应用中面临重大局限。
AI.motivation: LLM在情绪敏感场景中的应用日益广泛，但其是否能够一致地评估自身生成的内容尚不明确。特别是在包含虚假预设的查询面前，模型的表现和脆弱性需要系统评估。
AI.method: 将LLM生成的文本作为查询重新输入同一模型进行评估，采用三个包含递增强度虚假预设的假声明问题，在极端情绪和适度情绪两个维度上进行测试。选用三个模型：Claude-3.5-haiku、GPT4o-mini和Mistral-7B，并结合注意力分数分析模型优先级从评估到生成的转变。
AI.result: LLM表现低于平均水平，容易受到查询中嵌入的虚假信念影响，在适度情绪内容上尤为突出。注意力分数分析揭示了模型优先级从评估向生成转移。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果对LLM在高风险、情绪敏感场景中的部署具有重要启示意义，表明当前模型在面对嵌入虚假信念的查询时存在明显漏洞。

title: HEDP: A Hybrid Energy-Distance Prompt-based Framework for Domain Incremental Learning
summary: Domain Incremental Learning is a critical scenario that requires models to continuously adapt to new data domains without retraining. However, domain shifts often cause severe performance degradation. To address this, we propose Hybrid Energy-Distance Prompt, a domain-incremental framework inspired by Helmholtz free energy. HEDP introduces an energy regularization loss to enhance the separability of domain representations and a hybrid energy-distance weighted mechanism that fuses energy-based and distance-based cues to improve domain selection and generalization. Experiments on multiple benchmarks, including CORe50, show that HEDP achieves superior performance on unseen domains with a 2.57\% accuracy gain, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting and enhancing open-world adaptability. Our code is \href{https://github.com/dannis97500/HEDP/}{available here}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HEDP框架解决域增量学习中的性能退化问题。该方法通过能量正则化损失增强域表示区分度，并结合混合能量-距离加权机制提升域选择能力。实验显示该方法在保持可塑性与稳定性平衡方面具有优势。
AI.motivation: 域增量学习场景要求模型持续适应新数据域而无需重新训练，但域转移往往导致严重的性能下降和灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.method: 提出混合能量-距离提示（HEDP）框架，灵感来源于亥姆霍兹自由能。具体包括：(1)设计能量正则化损失函数以增强域表示的可分性；(2)开发混合能量-距离加权机制，融合基于能量和基于距离的线索来改进域选择和泛化能力。
AI.result: 在CORe50等多个基准数据集上的实验表明，HEDP相比现有方法实现了2.57%的准确率提升，有效减轻了灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.conclusion: HEDP通过结合能量正则化和混合能量-距离加权机制，有效解决了域增量学习中的性能退化和灾难性遗忘问题，在CORe50等多个基准数据集上实现了2.57%的准确率提升，显著增强了模型的开放世界适应能力。

title: Litespark Inference on Consumer CPUs: Custom SIMD Kernels for Ternary Neural Networks
