summary: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed artificial intelligence, but their computational requirements remain prohibitive for most users. Standard inference demands expensive datacenter GPUs or cloud API access, leaving over one billion personal computers underutilized for AI workloads. Ternary models offer a path forward: their weights are constrained to {-1, 0, +1}, theoretically eliminating the need for floating-point multiplication. However, existing frameworks fail to exploit this structure, treating ternary models as dense floating-point networks. We address this gap with custom SIMD kernels that replace matrix multiplication with simple addition and subtraction operations, targeting the integer dot product instructions available on modern CPUs. Our implementation, Litespark-Inference, is pip-installable and integrates directly with Hugging-Face, achieving 9.2x faster time-to-first-token, 52x higher throughput, and 14x memory reduction compared to standard PyTorch inference on Apple Silicon, with similar speedups on Intel and AMD processors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Litespark-Inference，一个利用定制 SIMD 内核在消费级 CPU 上高效运行三值权重 LLM 的推理框架。该方法将矩阵乘法替换为加法/减法操作，在 Apple Silicon、Intel 和 AMD 平台上均实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的高计算需求限制了其普及，目前依赖昂贵的 datacenter GPU 或云端API访问。全球超过十亿台个人电脑的AI计算能力未被充分利用。三值模型理论上可通过消除浮点乘法来解决这一问题，但现有框架未充分利用这一特性。
AI.method: 开发了定制SIMD内核，利用整数点积指令替代矩阵乘法，将三值权重运算简化为加法和减法操作。该实现以pip安装包形式发布，可直接集成Hugging-Face生态。
AI.result: 在 Apple Silicon 上实现：首 token 延迟加速 9.2 倍、吞吐量提升 52 倍、内存占用降低 14 倍；在 Intel 和 AMD 处理器上也获得了类似的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: Litespark-Inference成功实现了在消费级硬件上高效运行三值模型的大语言模型推理框架，使超过十亿台个人电脑能够参与AI工作负载，为边缘设备上的LLM部署提供了可行路径。

title: Von Neumann Networks
summary: In the mid-twentieth century, mathematician and polymath John von Neumann created a computational system on an array of cells as a simple model of the human brain, where each cell had one of a finite set of roles or states that he predicted would be modelled by a diffusion process. In this work, we show that such a system, when developed in a modern deep learning setting, enables the construction of an artificial neuron having specialized roles that can be learnt. We refer to this neuron as the Von Neumann neuron, and the resulting neural network from such neurons result in a self-engineered design whose architecture is only dependent on the structure and locations of its inputs and outputs on this cellular array. The mathematical framework for these Von Neumann Networks (VNNs) is also constructed and shows that they are based on the extension of neural operators and the learning of Green's functions with convolutions on a cellular topology having a diffusion signature. We also prove that these VNNs are part of a more general computational system called Cellular Machines that are computationally universal. Initial experiments show that VNN based multi-layered perceptrons outperform their equivalent deep learning variant on basic tasks, while being more parameter efficient and are capable of learning new types of tasks. This includes the ability to solve for and construct an extension of the Von Neumann (hardware) architecture common to all modern computers to cells and suggests new opportunities that could be explored.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"冯·诺依曼网络(VNN)"：把冯·诺依曼设想的细胞自动机推广为现代深度学习框架，在任意维度的方形细胞阵列（Chua 场）上放置带可学习"Codd 状态"的冯·诺依曼神经元，用可学习的格林函数（卷积核）作为信号传播器（PSF），网络可自行学习连接与架构。论文证明其所在的"细胞机器(CM)"是图灵完备的，并在 MNIST/CIFAR-10 分类、8 位算术与逻辑、ALU 模拟、Game of Life 规则学习及可修复网络等实验上验证，VNN 在若干任务上优于同规模 MLP 且参数量更少。
AI.motivation: 冯·诺依曼在20世纪中叶提出用无限方形细胞阵列模拟人脑，每个细胞具有有限个状态/角色，其演化规则被预言为"扩散型非线性偏微分方程"；他据此设计了29状态的自我复制机器与冯·诺依曼硬件架构，但在他于1957年去世前未能写下连续版本。随着深度学习（CNN/Transformer等）在视觉、语言、化学等领域的成功，但现代神经元架构固定：权重是固定的层间连接，架构需人工或NAS预先设计，神经元不能自主决定"是否参与决策"。同时，神经算子（Neural Operators）被证明可用卷积高效实现，且格林函数本身可学习，但这些工作未与细胞自动机的空间化、局部规则与自组织哲学结合。因此作者希望建立"现代深度学习版"的细胞机：让每个细胞拥有可学习的角色（状态），让整个网络的架构与连通性由数据驱动地自动生成，从而实现冯·诺依曼未竟的愿景（自修复的 EoC 硬件、可自复制机器、通用计算）。
AI.method: 方法分为三部分：(1) 冯·诺依曼神经元——在传统神经元(加权求和+b非线性激活)基础上引入可学习的 Codd 状态 s 与其补 s'=1−s；s 接近1时该单元做非线性决策（激活），接近0时仅做加权和的"信号/连接"通道，即让神经元自主学习自己在网络中的角色（借鉴 RealMLP 的对比学习与 s'=1−s 设计）。(2) VNN 形式化——在细胞阵列（称为 Chua 场 C，任意维度 d 的张量）中，把神经算子扩展到细胞拓扑：设线性微分算子 𝒟 作用于 C 得源项 f(c)，格林函数 G 满足 𝒟G(c,c_i)=δ(c−c_i)，正向传播为卷积积分 C(c)=∫G(c,c_i)f(c_i)dc_i；由于神经算子可由卷积核表示，故用大尺寸卷积核实现并学习 M 个格林函数 G_j。前向一步为 C^(n+1)=1/M Σ_j[(I−S)·(C_j^(n)·W)+S·σ(C_j^(n)+B)]，即"被动信号通道"与"主动决策单元"按可学习状态混合；每步相当于 MLP 的一层，步数由输入输出距离与核覆盖范围 (k−1)/2 决定。给出两种架构形式：超平面式（d−1 维层、通道方向带 ω 宽度的分层格林函数）与全维式（d 维卷积、无结构假设）。训练用 SGD/AdamW + 反向自动微分，输入输出坐标处固定 s=1，可把某些单元置 −∞ 模拟损坏/信息瓶颈。(3) 通用性证明——定义细胞机器 CM（无限阵列、每单元保持自身状态、连通性由格林函数集定义），给出三个命题：机器型通用性（CM 等价于模拟冯·诺依曼硬件架构的图灵机，附 AI 辅助 LEAN 验证）、规则型通用性（CM 等价于 GoL，可构造 UTM）、对应型通用性（固定格林函数与固定 Codd 状态的 VNN 退化为普通 MLP，其矩阵乘法为 Toeplitz/块 Toeplitz 矩阵，故等价于图灵完备的深度学习）。实验在 JAX 上实现，使用 3×3/大核卷积，覆盖 CLP 分类、8 位算术、ALU（箱型与带型）、1D 带式图灵机式模型、MNIST/CIFAR-10、可修复网络与 GoL 规则学习，并做方向数、网格尺寸、核尺寸消融。
AI.result: 实验结果：(1) 分类任务上 VNN 优于同规模 MLP 且参数大幅减少——MNIST：VNN Hyperplane 96.7% vs MLP 96.5%（41.2K vs 244.5K 参数）；CIFAR-10：VNN 3D Full 77.7% vs MLP 62.4%（1.2M vs 11.1M），但仍远低于 ResNet 的约94%，作者指出需要构造平移/旋转等变的 CNN 式 VNN。(2) 算术与逻辑：XOR 任务 VNN 达100%且参数更少（3.3K vs 36.2K）；ALU 8 位算术中 2D Full VNN 达99.8%，而传统 MLP 仅66.8%、1D Hyperplane VNN 69.9%，表明全维格林函数的 2D 连通性是完成任务的关键（与冯·诺依曼预言一致）。(3) 1D 带式模型仅用一维 Chua 场与一维格林函数即完成 8 位 XOR，学到的16个格林函数相当于"指令/程序"，呈图灵机带结构。(4) 可修复网络：模拟1%–5%单元损坏（状态置 −∞、权重置零）后精度从99.87%降至17.75%–86.19%，经50 epoch 微调可恢复至97.11%–99.87%。(5) GoL 模拟：64×64 网格、128 个 3×3 格林函数，第40 epoch 收敛到 100% 下一代预测精度，学到的滤波核似乎编码了 GoL 规则（存活/繁殖等邻域计数模式）。(6) 消融显示只需最小网格与核尺寸即可收敛，方向数过多反而略有下降；VNN 是唯一同时具备可微、连续、可学习架构的体系，且是唯一能把输入、输出、中间表示、权重偏置全部嵌入单一1D 空间的模型。
AI.conclusion: 结论：VNN 是把冯·诺依曼细胞自动机思想在现代深度学习语境下的实现——以状态型神经元为单元、以格林函数卷积为信号传播、以可学习 Codd 状态自生成架构的通用可微系统；它既是普通 MLP 的特例（固定格林函数与状态时对应 Toeplitz 矩阵乘法的深度学习），又被证明属于更一般的"细胞机器"，具备图灵完备性，可容纳无明显层次的（1D 带式）网络，并能在训练中构造出可自修复的"Everything-on-Chip"式冯·诺依曼硬件架构。意义在于提供兼具神经元级抽象与硬件原生（并行、空间化）实现的通用 AI 载体。局限与未来工作：大核卷积的高效支持（缩放/空洞卷积近似）、状态量化以贴近离散 CA、研究其他拓扑（图、CNN、Transformer）的 VNN 版本、自动构建自复制系统与人工生命、多智能体系统。总体上作者认为该工作为冯·诺依曼未竟的自复制与通用细胞机研究提供了新的可微探索方向，但当前结果仍属初步（实验规模小、缺与 SOTA 视觉模型对比、理论证明部分借助 AI 辅助形式化验证）。

title: Region-adaptable retrieval of coastal biogeochemical parameters from near-surface hyperspectral remote sensing reflectance using physics-aware meta-learning
summary: Hyperspectral in situ sensing has shown promise in retrieving aquatic biogeochemical (BGC) parameters, such as total suspended solids, dissolved organic carbon, and total chlorophyll-a, for cost-effective monitoring of coastal water quality. However, generalising such retrieval algorithms across water bodies remains challenging, as the relationship between remote sensing reflectance (Rrs) and BGC parameters can vary considerably from one region to another due to regional distinctions in environmental conditions and biogeochemistry that lead to different BGC ranges and bio-optical properties. In this study, we propose a two-stage physics-aware meta-learning framework for retrieving coastal BGC parameters from near-surface Rrs observations. In the first stage, a bio-optical forward model is used to generate a large synthetic dataset based on an in situ bio-optical spectral library with broad representativeness of Australian coastal waters. This dataset is then used to pretrain a region-agnostic base model with meta-learning, allowing the model to learn fundamental physical relationships. In the second stage, the pretrained base model is fine-tuned for specific regions with local samples. We collected in situ hyperspectral Rrs and BGC measurements from five geographically distinct sites in Australian coastal waters. Our experimental results suggest: (1) the BGC parameters and their corresponding hyperspectral Rrs signatures exhibited clear regional distinctions among the experimental sites; (2) the synthetic dataset was physically plausible and closely aligned with real-world samples in both parameter distributions and inter-parameter correlations; (3) the proposed approach outperformed five benchmark models in BGC retrieval; and (4) time series of in situ measured and model-predicted BGC parameters showed good agreement in both magnitude and temporal dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段物理感知元学习框架，利用高光谱近地表遥感反射率(Rrs)反演沿海水域的生物地球化学(BGC)参数。通过结合生物光学前向模型生成的合成数据集与元学习预训练，实现了跨区域BGC参数的高精度反演，在澳大利亚五个沿海水域的实验中表现优于五种基准模型。
AI.motivation: 现有沿海水质监测算法难以跨水域泛化，因为不同区域的生物地球化学参数范围和生物光学特性差异显著，需要一种能够同时利用物理先验知识和区域适配能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段基于澳大利亚沿海水域的原位生物光学光谱库生成大规模合成数据集，用元学习方法预训练区域无关的基础模型，使其学习基本物理关系；第二阶段使用区域样本对预训练模型进行微调适配。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：(1) BGC参数及其对应的高光谱Rrs特征在实验地点间呈现明显区域差异；(2) 合成数据集在参数分布和参数间相关性方面与真实样本高度吻合；(3) 该方法在BGC反演中优于五种基准模型；(4) 时间序列对比显示反演结果在数值和动态变化上均与实测数据一致。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知元学习框架能够有效结合合成数据的物理先验与区域样本的适应性，实现沿海BGC参数的高精度跨区域反演，为沿海水质低成本监测提供了可行方案。

title: The Frequency Confound in Language-Model Surprisal and Metaphor Novelty
comment: to be presented and published at the 15th Joint Conference on Lexical and Computational Semantics (*SEM 2026)
summary: Language-model (LM) surprisal is widely used as a proxy for contextual predictability and has been reported to correlate with metaphor novelty judgments. However, surprisal is tightly intertwined with lexical frequency. We explore this interaction on metaphor novelty ratings using two different word frequency measures. We analyse surprisal estimates from eight Pythia model sizes and 154 training checkpoints. Across settings, word frequency is a stronger predictor of metaphor novelty than surprisal. Across training stages, the surprisal--novelty association peaks at an early stage and then falls again, mirroring a similarly timed increase in the surprisal--frequency association. These results suggest that the often-reported optimal LM surprisal settings may incorrectly associate contextual predictability with metaphor novelty and processing difficulty, whereas lexical frequency may be the major underlying factor.

AI.tldr: This paper questions the validity of using LM surprisal as an indicator of contextual predictability in metaphor processing. By systematically controlling for word frequency across multiple model scales and training stages, the authors show that word frequency may be the true underlying driver of metaphor novelty effects rather than contextual predictability per se.
AI.motivation: Language model surprisal is frequently used as a proxy for contextual predictability and has been linked to metaphor novelty. However, surprisal and lexical frequency are inherently correlated, making it difficult to disentangle their independent contributions to metaphor novelty judgments.
AI.method: Controlled analysis of Pythia models across 8 model sizes and 154 training checkpoints, using two distinct word frequency measures alongside surprisal estimates.
AI.result: Word frequency consistently outperforms surprisal as a predictor of metaphor novelty. The surprisal-novelty correlation is strongest at early training stages but diminishes over continued training, coinciding with an increase in the surprisal-frequency correlation.
AI.conclusion: Word frequency, not surprisal, may be the primary driver of metaphor novelty ratings; reported optimal LM surprisal settings may conflate contextual predictability effects with lexical frequency effects.

title: Sheet as Token: A Graph-Enhanced Representation for Multi-Sheet Spreadsheet Understanding
summary: Workbook-scale spreadsheet understanding is increasingly important for language-model-based data analysis agents, but remains challenging because relevant information is often distributed across multiple sheets with heterogeneous schemas, layouts, and implicit relationships. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches typically decompose spreadsheets into rows, columns, or blocks to improve scalability; however, such chunk-centric representations can fragment worksheets into isolated text spans and weaken global sheet-level semantics. We propose Sheet as Token, a graph-enhanced framework that treats each worksheet as a unified semantic unit for multi-sheet spreadsheet retrieval. Our method extracts schema-aware records from sheet names, column headers, representative values, and layout features, and encodes each worksheet into a compact dense token. Given a natural-language query, a Graph Retriever constructs a query-specific candidate graph over sheet tokens using semantic, query-conditioned, schema-consistency, and shape-compatibility relations, and composes these channels through a multi-stage graph transformer to retrieve supporting sheet sets. Experiments on a constructed multi-sheet spreadsheet corpus show that sheet-level tokenization learns stable representations, and that graph-enhanced cross-sheet reasoning improves listwise retrieval over a shallow graph baseline with limited additional graph-side computation. These results suggest that sheet-level tokenization is a promising abstraction for scalable multi-sheet spreadsheet understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多sheet电子表格理解中的信息碎片化问题，提出Sheet as Token框架，将每个worksheet编码为统一语义token，并通过图检索器构建多关系候选图进行跨sheet推理。实验验证了该方法在学习稳定表示和提升检索性能方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型数据分析agent面临 Workbook级电子表格理解的挑战：相关信息分布在具有异构schema、布局和隐式关系的多张sheet中。现有基于chunk的检索增强方法将电子表格分解为行、列或块，导致worksheet被碎片化为孤立的文本片段，削弱了全局sheet级语义。
AI.method: 提出"Sheet as Token"图增强框架，将每个worksheet作为统一语义单元。方法包括：(1)从sheet名称、列头、代表性值和布局特征中提取schema感知的记录；(2)将每个worksheet编码为紧凑的密集token；(3)Graph Retriever使用语义、查询条件、schema一致性和形状兼容性等关系构建sheet token上的查询特定候选图；(4)通过多阶段图transformer组合这些通道以检索支持sheet集合。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：(1)sheet级tokenization学习到稳定的表示；(2)图增强的跨sheet推理在额外计算开销有限的情况下，相比浅层图基线提升了listwise检索性能。
AI.conclusion: Sheet as Token框架在多表格电子表格理解任务中展现出良好的应用前景。sheet级tokenization为可扩展的多sheet电子表格理解提供了一种有前景的抽象方法。

title: Scaling Pretrained Representations Enables Label-Free Out-of-Distribution Detection Without Fine-Tuning
summary: Models trained with deep learning often fail to signal when inputs fall outside their training data manifold, leading to unreliable predictions under distribution shift. Prior work suggests that effective out-of-distribution (OOD) detection often requires class-conditional modeling or specialized models obtained through supervised fine-tuning. We revisit this assumption in modern pretrained models and show that their frozen representations already encode sufficient geometric structure for accurate label-free OOD detection. Across 59 backbone-task pairings spanning vision and language, we compare two complementary label-free detectors: a global Mahalanobis estimator fit on unlabeled latent representations, and ReSCOPED, a lightweight, diffusion-based typicality estimator operating on the same features at a local level. Despite their different detection mechanisms, representation scaling reveals a consistent regime-dependent pattern: both local and global detectors' absolute performance improves with better representation quality, and performance gaps between the two detectors disappear across both language and vision tasks as representations scale. These results suggest that label-free OOD detection depends strongly on the geometry exposed by frozen pretrained backbones, reducing the importance of detector choice as backbone scale increases and enabling efficient deployment directly on frozen models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"表征中心"的视角：现代预训练模型的**冻结表征本身**已包含足够的 OOD 相关几何结构，因此无需类别标签、无需监督微调即可做高质量分布外检测。作者在 59 个"骨干-任务"配对（视觉+语言）上系统对比两种互补的免标签检测器——全局高斯 Mahalanobis 距离（在无标签潜表示上拟合）与局部扩散式 score-curvature 典型性探针 ReSCOPED，发现一个一致的"尺度相关"规律：**表征越强，两类检测器绝对性能越高且彼此差距趋于消失**；同时发现 Transformer 表征存在跨模态一致的"去噪尺度平台"（约 t=5 / σ≈0.099），并在冻结 LLM 上实现了低延迟（5.4 ms）的 prefill 阶段门控部署。
AI.motivation: 现有 OOD 检测的主流范式依赖两类额外信息：(1) 类别条件建模——Lee et al. (2018) 的 class-conditional Mahalanobis 及其后续扩展（Mueller & Hein 2025; Wei et al. 2025）都需要 ID 标签来定义类均值；(2) 表征适配——Fort et al. (2021) 与 Xu et al. (2021) 表明 near-OOD 检测在冻结表征上很难，需监督微调才能提升。这在实践中很受限：语言场景下标签往往不可得，且微调意味着要维护任务专属的模型变体。此外，Tajwar et al. (2021) 指出不同检测器在不同数据集上排名不稳定，Janiak et al. (2026) 也指出 Mahalanobis 性能强烈依赖表征几何（谱性质、内在维度）。这些观察共同提示：OOD 性能不仅取决于检测器，更取决于表征本身的质量与几何结构；但现有工作未在跨检测器、跨模态的统一框架下检验这一假设。作者的核心问题即：下游任务所用的冻结模型是否已经编码了足够的 OOD 相关几何，从而免去标签与微调？
AI.method:
**检测器（均为免标签，只用无标签 ID 潜表示拟合）**

1. **全局 Mahalanobis 探针**：去掉 Lee et al. (2018) 的类条件结构，用全局均值 μ 与共享协方差 Σ_global = (1/N)Σ(z_i−μ)(z_i−μ)ᵀ + λI（λ=10⁻⁴）拟合单一高斯，OOD 分数 S_global(z) = (z−μ)ᵀΣ_global⁻¹(z−μ)。成本仅 1 次前向。

2. **ReSCOPED（局部 score-curvature 探针，本文提出）**：把 SCOPED (Barkley et al., 2025) 从输入空间搬到表征空间。在冻结编码器 φ 输出的潜表示 z 上训练一个轻量 EDM 去噪器 s_θ(z,σ)（残差 MLP，6 层、宽 1024，约 8M 参数；15 万步、batch 256、Adam 3e-4 余弦退火，单 GPU 约 2 分钟）；测试时计算典型性统计量 T(z) = ‖s_θ(z,σ)‖² / κ(z)，其中 κ(z) = −Tr(∇_z s_θ(z,σ))，迹用 Hutchinson 估计器近似；再对 ID 的 T 值拟合一维高斯核 KDE（带宽 h=0.2），以负对数似然作为异常分数。噪声水平 σ≈0.099 在验证任务（SVHN vs CelebA）上一次性选定后全局复用，规避了以往扩散式方法逐数据集调参的问题。推理成本 2 次前向 + 1 次 JVP。

**实验设计**：59 个骨干-任务配对，来自 Bonsai (JAX) 与 HuggingFace Transformers。视觉：DINOv3 ViT-S/B/L、DINOv2 ViT-B、DINOv1 ViT-B、ViT-B/16，数据集 CIFAR-10 / CIFAR-100 / SVHN / CelebA，以及 OpenOOD v1.5 的 ImageNet-200 (ID) vs SSB-hard / NINCO (near-OOD)；预处理先下采样至最低原生分辨率再上采样，避免分辨率伪信号。语言：BERT-base 与 Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B，CLINC150（跨意图 OOD）与 SST 跨语料 OOD，采用序列均值池化（SMP）得到定长表示。

**基线**：Improved CD、DoSE、WAIC、TT（typicality test）、LR、NLL、MSMA、DDPM-OOD、LMD、DiffPath、SCOPED；语言侧还有 EDF、MDF、IMLM、BCAD、EC-NNK-Means 及微调类方法。

**附加分析**：去噪尺度扫描（59 个配置，51 视觉 + 8 语言）考察性能平台区；基于 KV cache 中间层表征的 prefill 阶段 prefix-level SMP 门控，实现自回归解码前的即时拒绝/路由。
AI.result:
**视觉（Table 1/3）**：DINOv3 上免标签 Mahalanobis 与 ReSCOPED 表现相当甚至略优，且两者在所有规模上大幅超越既有基线（如 C10→C100：Mahalanobis ViT-L 0.983，DiffPath 0.910，LMD 0.504，NLL 0.091）。更难的 OpenOOD 设置同样保持尺度规律，ImageNet-200 上两者平均 AUROC 差距从 ViT-S 的 0.093 降至 ViT-B 的 0.037、再降至 ViT-L 的 0.005（Mahalanobis 0.865/0.795/0.865→SSB-hard 与 0.908/0.800/0.887→NINCO）。near-OOD 方面，冻结 DINOv3-L + ReSCOPED 在 C100(ID) vs C10(near-OOD) 上达 94.3% AUROC，与 Fort et al. (2021) 的全参微调方法相当，回应了"near-OOD 必须微调"的论断。

**语言（Table 2）**：弱表征 BERT 上排名依数据集而变——CLINC150 上 ReSCOPED 优于 Mahalanobis（0.815 vs 0.791），SST 上则相反（0.802 vs 0.965），符合"弱表征下无普适最优检测器"的预期。Qwen3 规模化后差距收敛：CLINC150 上两者从 0.6B 的 0.856/0.856 升至 4B 的 0.903/0.900；SST 上 ReSCOPED 在 0.6B 明显落后（0.764 vs 0.939），到 4B 基本追平（0.949 vs 0.951）。冻结 Qwen3-4B 的免标签检测整体可与依赖微调+标签的方法（IMLM+BCAD+MDF、BCAD+MDF）相当或更优。

**规律性与部署**：去噪尺度扫描显示跨模态一致的宽平台，中心约在 t=5（σ≈0.099），说明 OOD 结构在 Transformer 表征中于稳定的中间粒度被暴露；计算开销上 ReSCOPED 仅 2F+1J，远低于 DiffPath(10F)、DDPM-OOD(350F)、LMD(10⁴F)。在冻结 Qwen3-4B（2560 维）上，ReSCOPED 仅增加约 5.4 ms 延迟，配合 JAX 编译可在解码前做拒绝决策；CLINC150 上 prefix 分数随上下文累积逐渐下降，ID 句式落入 ID 分数 99 分位阈值以下而 OOD 句式持续高于阈值。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心结论是：现代预训练（尤其规模化）的冻结表征已隐含可供全局协方差探针与局部 score-curvature 探针共同利用的 OOD 几何结构，因此**表征几何而非检测器复杂度主导 OOD 性能**；随着骨干族系与规模提升，检测器选择的重要性显著下降，"免标签、免微调"部署在冻结基础模型上可行且高效。ReSCOPED 证明扩散式典型性可从输入空间迁移到潜空间，从而以极小代价实现无标签、无微调、无任务专属异常数据的检测；同时"跨模态一致的 denoising-scale 平台"提示预训练 Transformer 在相近抽象层级暴露 OOD 信息。局限在于覆盖面未尽（模型、模态、部署形态），且仅比较了两类免标签探针，是否对其他检测器族及尚未饱和的更难分布偏移同样成立有待验证；该平台规律的理论基础也仍是开放问题。

title: STALE: Can LLM Agents Know When Their Memories Are No Longer Valid?
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to maintain coherent, long-term personalized memory, yet current benchmarks primarily measure static fact retrieval, overlooking the ability to revise stored beliefs when new evidence emerges. We identify a critical and underexplored failure mode, Implicit Conflict: a later observation invalidates an earlier memory without explicit negation, requiring contextual inference and commonsense reasoning to detect. To rigorously evaluate this capability, we introduce STALE, a benchmark of 400 expert-validated conflict scenarios (1,200 evaluation queries across three probing dimensions) spanning over 100 everyday topics with contexts up to 150K tokens. We propose a three-dimensional probing framework that tests State Resolution (detecting that a prior belief is outdated), Premise Resistance (rejecting queries that falsely presuppose a stale state), and Implicit Policy Adaptation (proactively applying updated states in downstream behavior). A systematic evaluation of frontier LLMs and specialized memory frameworks reveals a pervasive gap between retrieving updated evidence and acting on it, with even the best evaluated model achieving only 55.2% overall accuracy. Models often accept outdated assumptions embedded in a user's query, and they struggle to recognize when a change in one aspect of the user's state should invalidate related memories. To establish an initial baseline for state-aware memory, we further present CUPMem, a prototype that strengthens write-time revision through structured state consolidation and propagation-aware search, suggesting that explicit state adjudication is a promising direction for robust agentic memory.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了"隐式冲突"问题，即LLM智能体在后续观察无明确否定的情况下难以检测到先验记忆已过时。为此构建了STALE基准（含400个冲突场景、1200个评估查询），从状态解析、前提抵抗、隐式策略适应三个维度评估模型，发现当前最先进模型准确率仅55.2%，表明需要显式状态裁决机制来提升记忆鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: Current LLM agent benchmarks only measure static fact retrieval, overlooking the critical ability to revise stored beliefs when new evidence emerges. The paper identifies "Implicit Conflict" as a key underexplored failure mode where later observations invalidate earlier memories without explicit negation, requiring contextual inference and commonsense reasoning to detect.
AI.method: Proposes a three-dimensional probing framework (State Resolution, Premise Resistance, Implicit Policy Adaptation) to evaluate LLM agents on STALE benchmark with 400 expert-validated conflict scenarios (1,200 queries across 100+ topics, contexts up to 150K tokens). Also presents CUPMem prototype that strengthens write-time revision through structured state consolidation and propagation-aware search.
AI.result: Frontier LLMs and specialized memory frameworks show a pervasive gap between retrieving updated evidence and acting on it. The best model achieves only 55.2% overall accuracy. Models frequently accept outdated assumptions embedded in user queries and struggle to recognize cross-domain invalidation of related memories.
AI.conclusion: Explicit state adjudication via structured state consolidation and propagation-aware search represents a promising direction for robust agentic memory systems.

title: Long-Horizon Q-Learning: Accurate Value Learning via n-Step Inequalities
summary: Off-policy, value-based reinforcement learning methods such as Q-learning are appealing because they can learn from arbitrary experience, including data collected by older policies or other agents. In practice, however, bootstrapping makes long-horizon learning brittle: estimation errors at later states propagate backward through temporal-difference (TD) updates and can compound over time. We propose long-horizon Q-learning (LQL), which introduces a principled backstop against compounding error when learning the optimal action-value function. LQL builds on a prior optimality tightening observation: any realized action sequence lower-bounds what the optimal policy can achieve in expectation, so acting optimally earlier should not be worse than following the observed actions for several steps before switching to optimal behavior. Our contribution is to turn this inequality into a practical stabilization mechanism for Q-learning by using a hinge loss to penalize violations of these bounds. Importantly, LQL computes these penalties using network outputs already produced for the TD error, requiring no auxiliary networks and no additional forward passes relative to Q-learning. When combined with multiple state-of-the-art methods on a range of online and offline-to-online benchmarks, LQL consistently outperforms both 1-step TD and n-step TD learning at similar runtime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「长视野Q学习」（LQL）：把轨迹级的最优性不等式（optimality inequality）转化为两类单侧 hinge 惩罚（下界 LB / 上界 UB），与标准 1-step TD 损失相加，从而为离策略价值学习提供一个「长视野兜底约束」，抑制自举误差随时间累积。关键工程优势是：惩罚项完全复用 TD 更新中已产生的网络输出（Q(s_k,a_k) 与目标网络 Q(s_k,a*_k)），无需辅助网络、相对 Q-learning 无额外前向传播。OGBench/RoboMimic 上一致优于 1-step TD 与等长 n-step TD；在稀疏奖励 humanoidmaze-giant 上 L=64 达 75.7% 成功率，而 1-step TD 为 0%、TD-4 为 38.4%、TD-64 降至 6.1%；平均运行时开销仅 4.7%。
AI.motivation: 离策略、基于价值的方法（Q-learning 等）能从任意经验（包括旧策略或其他智能体的数据）中学习，在交互昂贵、长程行为关键的机器人场景极具吸引力。但自举（bootstrapping）在长视野下十分脆弱：后续状态的估计误差会沿 TD 更新反向传播并逐步放大（ deadly triad：离策略+自举+函数逼近），使长程学习变得 brittle。已有的缓解手段是 n-step 或 λ-return 多步备份，但它在离策略下带来新的结构性张力：n-step 目标必然包含回放轨迹中记录的（可能低质量的）后续动作 a_{t+1},…,a_{t+n-1} 的奖励，即使 a_t 本身是高质量决策，备份目标仍然偏悲观；本质上是「部分地在错误假设（智能体会继续沿行为策略走若干步）下评估 (s_t,a_t)」，且多步目标与需要动作似然的离策略修正（如 IS/Retrace/V-trace）相互纠缠，难以兼容扩散/流匹配等表达性生成式策略。核心问题是：能否在保留 1-step TD 低方差、逐转移反事实自举优势的同时，引入一个原则性的长视野约束，以检测并修正导致误差累积的价值不一致性？
AI.method:
**理论出发点：轨迹上的最优性不等式。** 由最优性可得，从任一状态出发「立即最优行动」的期望回报不劣于「先执行任一记录动作序列若干步、再转为最优」的期望回报，即 Q*(s_i,a_i) ≥ E[G_{i:j} + γ^{j-i} Q*(s_j,a_j)]（j>i）。为与 TD 计算能力匹配，使用两个变体：(4) 左侧替换为 s_i 处的最优动作 a*(s_i)，(5) 右侧替换为 s_j 处的最优动作 a*(s_j)；j=i+1 时 (5) 退化为 Bellman 最优性方程。

**两侧 hinge 惩罚（关键工程设计）。** 在回放轨迹 (s_{t:t+L}, a_{t:t+L-1}, r_{t:t+L-1}) 上：
- 下界惩罚 LB：δ_LB(k,ℓ;θ) = [G_{k:ℓ} + γ^{ℓ-k} Q_θ̄(s_ℓ,a*_ℓ) − Q_θ(s_k,a_k)]₊²，把 Q(s_k,a_k) 向上推（若沿轨迹滚动实得回报+后续自举超过当前估计）。
- 上界惩罚 UB：δ_UB(i,k;θ) = [G_{i:k} + γ^{k-i} Q_θ(s_k,a_k) − Q_θ̄(s_i,a*_i)]₊²，把 Q(s_k,a_k) 向下推。特别地 i=k 的同状态上界退化为 Q_θ̄(s_k,a*_k) ≥ Q_θ(s_k,a_k)，即对「次优动作估值高于贪心动作」施加直接向下压力，抑制过估计。
- hinge 保证单侧性（只惩罚违反），平方提供更平滑梯度；对未来索引集合 ℱ(k)（默认排除 ℓ=k+1 以免与 1-step TD 目标重叠）与前序索引集合 𝒫(k)（复用同一次 TD 计算中已得的 s_k 及更早状态的目标网络输出）取平均。

**最终目标。** ℓ_LQL(k) = ℓ_TD(k) + λ_UB ℓ_UB(k) + λ_LB ℓ_LB(k)，主实验取 λ_UB=λ_LB=1（未调参），整条轨迹损失为 ℒ_LQL = (1/L)Σ_k ℓ_LQL(k)。离散部分回报 G_{i:j} 用前缀和高效计算，使 O(L²) 成对比较开销可忽略。

**实现要点。** 只需评估 Q_θ(s_k,a_k)（TD 损失所需）与 Q_θ̄(s_k,a*_k)（自举目标所需），对所有目标网络量 stop-gradient；不引入辅助网络、不增加前向传播；a*_k 在离散空间取 argmax、连续控制取 actor 采样。算法与策略提取解耦（agnostic to policy extraction），可与 1-step TD、n-step TD、动作分块（chunk size 5，此时 hinge 在 chunk 层面建立，最小时间间隔为 chunk 长度）组合。

**理论分析（附录 C.1）。** 在 Q_θ=Q* 处定义 LB/UB 的「虚假违反」信号 Z_L、U_L，通过 Bellman 方程望远镜展开分解为 1-step Bellman 噪声 ε 与次优性间隙 Δ 的加权和；利用有界奖励假设得 |W_j| ≤ M = R_max+(1+γ)Q_max+2Q_max，进而 Var(Z_L) ≤ M²(1/(1-γ))² = V^∞ 与 horizon L 无关；结合 Cantelli 不等式给出虚假违反概率与期望惩罚的上界：Pr([Z_L]₊²>0) ≤ V^∞/(V^∞+γ²Δ̄_LB²)、E[[Z_L]₊²] ≤ (V^∞)^{3/2}/(2(√(V^∞+γ²Δ̄_LB²)+γΔ̄_LB))，UB 侧同理（用 Δ̄_UB）。结论：假惩罚有限、与 L 无关，且随回放数据次优性增大而减小。
AI.result:
**主实验设置。** OGBench（scene、cube-double、cube-triple、humanoidmaze-md、humanoidmaze-giant、antmaze-giant）与 RoboMimic（can、square，多人类演示数据）单任务变体，稀疏/半稀疏奖励；离线→在线协议：Best-of-N、FQL、动作分块（QC-FQL 风格）先离线 1×10⁶ 步再在线 1×10⁶ 步，Gaussian（RLPD 风格）全程在线；4 seeds/task，95% curve-level bootstrap 置信区间；三种 critic 学习规则（1-step TD、等长 TD-n n=8、LQL）严格匹配每梯度步的 Q 网络前向次数（1024 转移；LQL 为 128 条长度 8 的轨迹）。

**主要结果。**
1. **跨策略提取家族的一致提升**：OGBench 5 组等权平均成功率 Best-of-N：TD 48.6 → TD-n 54.5 → LQL 71.2；FQL：33.0 → 36.4 → 66.0；Gaussian：22.8 → 23.5 → 44.5；动作分块：52.9 → 61.4。RoboMimic（square+can 等权）：Best-of-N 52.0→51.7→64.8；FQL 1.5→42.5→75.5；Gaussian 5.0→87.5→88.2。TD-n 常仅带来有限提升甚至在 cube-triple（FQL）更差，符合 n-step 目标离策略偏差的既有认识。
2. **最长任务的压力测试**（humanoidmaze-giant，100M 转移数据集，L=64）：1-step TD 五个任务全部为 0%；TD-4 平均 38.4%（在 n=4 处饱和）并随 n 增大退化，TD-8 26.4%、TD-16 13.6%、TD-64 仅 6.1%；LQL 达 75.7%，其中 task2 97.3%、task5 98.7%。
3. **轨迹长度作为新的扩展轴**：固定轨迹条数增大 L，三种设置下最终成功率均单调上升；对比之下 TD 的 batch-size 扩展无改善甚至退化（复现 Fu et al. 2025 的病理现象）。固定 batch 时最优 L 因任务而异（附录 B.5），说明增益更可能来自样本多样性而非长程 hinge 不稳定。
4. **开销**：A40 GPU 上每次更新平均慢 4.7%（Best-of-N 2.0%、FQL 5.3%、Gaussian 4.5%），与网络规模无关；L=64 时 H100 上 29.72 vs TD 29.91 iter/s，几乎无额外成本。
5. **机制验证**：令 λ_LB=λ_UB=0（保留轨迹采样、去掉 hinge）后性能显著下降，说明增益来自 hinge 约束而非轨迹采样本身；有趣的是轨迹采样版 TD 有时也优于独立转移采样 TD（可能与较小有效 batch 减少对不准确目标的过拟合有关）。
6. **价值稳定性诊断**：humanoidmaze-giant 上奖励非正（Q* ≤ 0），1-step TD 在 15 次运行中有 14 次 Q 值发散并越过 0 增长至 >900；LQL 全部保持在解析有效区间内，直接说明 UB 惩罚抑制了 runaway 过估计。
7. **与最优性收紧（OT, He et al. 2016）对比**：LQL 改写 OT 的离散动作为连续 actor 后在同一协议下对比，4 组等权平均 39.3% vs 10.0%（scene 89.5 vs 32.8，humanoid-md 48.8 vs 0.0），支持「用学习策略的动作构造不等式以复用目标网络输出、避免 2×–4× 额外 Q 评估」的设计。
8. **鲁棒性与敏感性**：在动作上注入高斯噪声（σ 从 0 扫到更高值并重采离线数据）的随机环境中，LQL 在所有噪声水平上匹配或超过 1-step TD；hinge 系数在默认值上下约一个数量级范围内性能稳定（λ=1 未调参即可用）。附录 B.7 显示 hinge 激活频率随距离增加而下降、但幅度在长距离上更大，并呈任务与训练阶段依赖的模式。
AI.conclusion:
**贡献总结。** LQL 将轨迹级最优性不等式转化为可用的双侧 hinge 惩罚，构造出「长视野兜底约束」，在不增加任何网络与前向传播的前提下缓解离策略价值学习中的 TD 误差累积。它与 n-step TD 的本质区别在于：n-step 用多步目标直接替换备份（继承记录动作带来的离策略偏差），LQL 则保留标准 TD 备份、仅用不等式作为软约束，从而能吸收超长轨迹信息而不承受 n 增大时的性能退化；并因此把「轨迹长度」变成一种区别于 batch size 的、可安全扩展的计算轴。

**局限。** 主要为理论层面：最优性不等式是「期望意义」上的陈述，逐样本构造 hinge 惩罚在随机环境中引入偏差（附录 C.1 给出与 horizon 无关的上界，且随数据次优性增大而收紧）；固定 batch size 时最优轨迹长度依任务而变，长 L 在某些环境退化；hinge 系数虽稳健但默认取 1 未针对任务调优。

**展望。** 将同一 hinge 框架叠加到 n-step TD 之上（结合 LQL 的稳定性与 n-step 更快的奖励传播）；机制性地拆解 UB/LB 两项对 Q 值稳定性的各自贡献；把轨迹长度推过 L=64（单调曲线提示仍有可观余量）。

title: Information-Preserving Domain Transfer with Unlabeled Data in Misspecified Simulation-Based Inference
summary: Simulation-based inference (SBI) provides amortized Bayesian parameter inference from simulator-generated data without requiring explicit likelihood evaluation. Its reliability can degrade under model misspecification, where real-world observations are not well represented by the simulator used for training. Existing methods using unlabeled real-world data often align simulated and real-world data distributions, but marginal alignment alone does not directly preserve parameter-relevant information needed for posterior inference. We propose SPIN, an SBI framework with parameter-relevant information-preserving domain transfer using unlabeled, unpaired real-world observations. During training, SPIN translates labeled simulator observations toward the real-world domain and back to the simulator domain, using the original simulator labels to encourage domain transfer that preserves parameter-relevant mutual information. At test time, the learned real-to-simulator transport maps real-world observations into the simulator domain for posterior inference, without requiring real-world parameter labels or paired real--simulator observations. Across controlled synthetic and physical real-world benchmarks, SPIN improves real-world posterior inference, with the improvement becoming clearer as misspecification increases.

AI.tldr: SPIN：面向模型失配下 SBI 的“保参数相关信息的域迁移”框架。训练时把带标签的模拟观测先搬到真实域再搬回模拟域，用原模拟标签监督往返后的观测，使迁移后仍保留与参数相关的互信息；测试时仅需真实到模拟的输运映射即可做摊销后验推断。在 SIR、Pendulum、Wind Tunnel、Light Tunnel 四个基准上，SPIN 相比 NPE、NPE-MMD、NPE-DANN 更稳定地改善 RMSE/LPP/ACAUC，且失配越强收益越明显。
AI.motivation: 神经后验估计（NPE）在模型失配（模拟器无法表征真实观测）下会给出有偏或过度自信的后验。已有利用无标签真实数据的方法（NPE-RS、NPE-MMD、NPE-DANN 等）本质是边缘分布对齐：边缘对齐只匹配观测的边缘分布，不能保证条件结构（观测→参数的依赖关系）不变，迁移过程还可能丢失后验所需信息；基于翻译的域适应同样缺乏语义一致性约束。而理想的信息保持目标 I_r(Θ; G_rs(X_r)) 在无真实参数标签时无法直接计算。此外 RoPE、FRISBI 需要带已知参数的真实校准集，NPE+SC 需要似然评估或辅助似然估计器。因此需要一种既不依赖真实标签、又能显式约束参数相关信息不被迁移破坏的方法。
AI.method: 设定：仅有 N_s 个带标签模拟对 (θ, x_s) 与 N_r 个无标签、无配对真实观测 x_r。测试时推理定义为 p̂(θ|x_r)=q_ψ(θ|G_rs(x_r))，并引入反向输运 G_sr。核心是信息保持损失 L_info(q)=E[−log q(Θ|G_rs(G_sr(X_s)))]：把带标签模拟观测搬到真实域再搬回模拟域后仍使用原 θ 标签，构成 Barber-Agakov 型互信息下界（H_s(Θ) 固定，最小化 L_info 即最大化参数相关 MI 的下界）。附录给出命题 1：在“参数保持的联合输运条件”(Θ,X_r) ≐ (Θ,G_sr(X_s)) 下，真实域测试风险等于 L_info，故 L_info 既是信息保持代理也是真实域条件对数风险的无偏替代。总训练目标包含三部分：生成器损失（对抗翻译 + 循环一致性 + 恒等正则 + λ_info·L_info，且用 stop-gradient 固定后验与摘要网络）、判别器损失（带谱归一化的 hinge 损失）、后验损失（原始模拟观测 + λ_info 加权的搬运观测，搬运观测 stop-gradient）。结构上使用 CycleGAN 式双向观测空间卷积生成器（残差瓶颈、门控残差跳连）与每域一个判别器；后验为条件掩码自回归流（zuko），配任务特定 1D/2D CNN 摘要网络；参数经 logit 变换在无约束空间训练。λ_info 默认 1（等权、免标签）。
AI.result: 主结果（5 个随机种子均值±标准差）：Pendulum 上 SPIN 的 RMSE 0.287（vs NPE 0.774、NPE-MMD 0.514、NPE-DANN 0.572）、LPP −4.33（vs −49.89/−89.53/−57.02）、ACAUC 0.062（最低）；Wind Tunnel RMSE 4.098、LPP −10.04、ACAUC 0.280 均为最优；Light Tunnel RMSE 35.33、LPP −0.124×10³、ACAUC 0.163 显著优于基线。SIR（弱失配）各方法差异很小，NPE 已足够强，SPIN 优势不明显。消融显示 SPIN (w/o L_info) 明显劣于完整 SPIN，说明增益不仅来自双向迁移，更来自信息保持约束；L_info 在 Pendulum/Wind Tunnel/Light Tunnel 上与传输专用变体的差距大于 SIR，且随阻尼强度增大（α=0.05/0.25/0.5）而扩大。次级诊断 sKL 在失配较强的三个任务上更低，Wasserstein 与后验 MMD 呈大体一致但依任务而异；运输观测 x_srs 上的 LPP 直接验证 L_info 按预期作用。对 N_r 的敏感性显示任务/指标依赖，SIR 与 Wind Tunnel 稳定，Light Tunnel 在极小真实数据预算下最不稳定。代价方面：SPIN 可训练参数与单次迭代时间显著更高（如 Pendulum 323 ms vs NPE 15 ms），但测试时仍为摊销推断（每观测约 7 ms）。
AI.conclusion: 提出 SPIN：在无标签、无配对真实数据条件下，通过“模拟→真实→模拟”的往返翻译并用原模拟标签监督，使域迁移显式保持参数相关互信息，而非仅做边缘对齐，从而在模型失配下获得更可靠的摊销后验推断；在合成与受控物理基准上于 RMSE、LPP、ACAUC 上稳定优于 NPE/MMD/DANN 基线，且失配越强收益越大。局限：若学到的输运未满足联合输运条件则真实域推理可能变差（尤其 N_r 较小时经验分布估计粗糙）；λ_info=1 只是免标签默认值，最优强度依任务而定；训练阶段计算开销明显增加。展望：在域迁移中把“参数相关信息保持”作为显式设计原则，可能成为失配 SBI 的更通用范式。

title: Efficient Pre-Training with Token Superposition
summary: Pre-training of Large Language Models is often prohibitively expensive and inefficient at scale, requiring complex and invasive modifications in order to achieve high data throughput. In this work, we present Token-Superposition Training (TST), a simple drop-in method that significantly improves the data throughput per FLOPs during pre-training without modifying the parallelism, optimizer, tokenizer, data, or model architecture. TST is done in two phases: (i) A highly efficient superposition phase where we combine many contiguous tokens into one bag and train using a multi-hot cross-entropy (MCE) objective, and (ii) a recovery phase where we revert back to standard training. We extensively evaluate TST on the scale of 270M and 600M parameters and validate on 3B and a 10B A1B mixture of experts model, demonstrating that it is highly robust in different settings. Ultimately, TST consistently outperforms baseline loss and downstream evaluations, and under equal-loss settings, TST yields up to a 2.5x reduction in total pre-training time at the 10B A1B scale.

AI.tldr: 提出Token-Superposition Training（TST），一种两阶段drop-in预训练方法，通过多热交叉熵目标将多个连续token打包训练以提升数据吞吐量，无需修改模型架构即可在10B规模实现2.5倍预训练加速。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的预训练在规模化时计算成本极高且效率低下，传统的改进方式需要对并行策略、优化器、分词器、数据或模型架构进行复杂且具有侵入性的修改，缺乏一种简单高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出两阶段训练方法：1）叠加阶段（Superposition Phase）：将多个连续token打包为"袋"（bag），使用多热交叉熵（MCE）目标进行高效训练；2）恢复阶段（Recovery Phase）：恢复标准训练方式。同时评估了270M、600M参数模型及3B和10B规模的A1B MoE模型。
AI.result: TST在多种规模下均表现出高鲁棒性，始终优于基线损失和下游评估；在相同损失条件下，10B A1B规模下实现最多2.5倍的总预训练时间减少。
AI.conclusion: TST作为drop-in方法，无需修改并行策略、优化器、分词器、数据或模型架构，即可显著提升预训练的数据吞吐量。在10B A1B规模下，最多可实现2.5倍的总预训练时间缩减，且在损失函数和下游任务评估中均优于基线。

title: AGPO: Asymmetric Group Policy Optimization for Verifiable Reasoning and Search Ads Relevance at JD
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated notable success in enhancing the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, recent studies reveal that while current RLVR methods improve sampling efficiency towards correct paths, they do not elicit fundamentally new reasoning patterns. Instead, the reasoning capability boundary of trained models often narrows compared to their base models, with base models achieving higher coverage at large sample sizes. In this work, we propose Asymmetric Group Policy Optimization (AGPO) to counteract this boundary shrinkage. AGPO adopts a negative-dominant reinforcement strategy to suppress incorrect reasoning paths, maintaining the base model's exploration capacity. For positive reinforcement, AGPO adopts a group advantage mechanism, which scales positive updates based on intra-group variance, allowing the model to focus on rare correct paths while suppressing updates from trivial paths. Our experiments on five mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that AGPO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while consistently improving pass@$k$ performance at scale. In a large-scale industrial application for search ads relevance optimization, AGPO effectively enhances the quality of the data annotation, leading to substantial performance gains in downstream student models.

AI.tldr: 本文针对RLVR导致的推理边界收窄问题，提出AGPO方法，通过负向主导强化和组优势机制双管齐下抑制错误路径、聚焦稀有正确解，在数学基准和工业应用中均展现了显著优势。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法虽然提高了采样效率，但并未激发根本性的新推理模式，反而导致训练后模型的推理能力边界相比基础模型收窄——基础模型在大采样量下仍能获得更高覆盖率。
AI.method: 提出非对称组策略优化（AGPO）：1）采用负向主导强化策略抑制错误推理路径，保持基础模型的探索能力；2）采用组优势机制进行正向强化，根据组内方差缩放正向更新，使模型聚焦于稀有正确路径而抑制平凡路径的更新。
AI.result: 在5个数学基准上达到最优准确率，且在大采样量下pass@k性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 在大规模工业应用中（搜索广告相关性优化），AGPO有效提升了数据标注质量，为下游学生模型带来了显著的性能提升。

title: Structural Correspondence and Universal Approximation in Diagonal plus Low-Rank Neural Networks
summary: The massive computational costs of scaling modern deep learning architectures have driven the widespread use of parameter-efficient low-rank structures, such as LoRA and low-rank factorization. However, theoretical guarantees for their expressive power are less explored, often relying on restrictive priors like a pretrained base matrix, ReLU activations or non-verifiable singularity conditions. We first investigate the limits of neural networks constrained strictly to low-rank manifolds without pretrained dense priors. We demonstrate a theoretical paradox: while purely rank-1 layers can exactly interpolate arbitrary scalar datasets, they collapse for function approximations. To overcome this bottleneck without surrendering parameter efficiency, we introduce a unified \textit{Structural Correspondence} framework. We prove that augmenting low-rank layers with only a minimal sparse diagonal component, say a Diagonal plus Low-Rank (DLoR) structure, is sufficient to reach Universal Approximation. We show that any full-rank transformation can be exactly reconstructed using these DLoR components by trading off network width (additive decomposition) or depth (multiplicative decomposition). By tracking asymptotic Taylor remainders, we prove that DLoR neural networks fully restore the Universal Approximation Theorem for general activation functions. Finally, we establish that multiplicative depth provides superior parameter-to-expressivity scaling compared to additive width. Our results show that dense matrices and specific activation functions are not topological prerequisites for universal expressivity.

AI.tldr: This paper reveals a theoretical paradox where rank-1 layers work for scalar datasets but fail for function approximation, and proposes DLoR (Diagonal plus Low-Rank) structures as a minimal augmentation to restore Universal Approximation without pretrained priors. Multiplicative depth scaling proves superior to additive width scaling for parameter efficiency.
AI.motivation: Existing theoretical guarantees for parameter-efficient low-rank structures (like LoRA) rely on restrictive priors such as pretrained base matrices, ReLU activations, or unverifiable singularity conditions. The theoretical expressive power limits of low-rank neural networks without these priors remain underexplored.
AI.method: The authors propose a unified Structural Correspondence framework that augments low-rank layers with a minimal sparse diagonal component (Diagonal plus Low-Rank, DLoR structure). They analyze asymptotic Taylor remainders and prove that any full-rank transformation can be exactly reconstructed via additive decomposition (trading width) or multiplicative decomposition (trading depth).
AI.result: 1) Purely rank-1 layers exhibit a paradox: they can exactly interpolate arbitrary scalar datasets but collapse for function approximations. 2) DLoR structure with minimal sparse diagonal augmentation is sufficient to achieve Universal Approximation. 3) Any full-rank transformation can be exactly reconstructed using DLoR components. 4) Multiplicative depth scaling outperforms additive width scaling in parameter-to-expressivity.
AI.conclusion: Dense matrices and specific activation functions are not topological prerequisites for universal expressivity. Multiplicative depth provides superior parameter-to-expressivity scaling compared to additive width. This work establishes that parameter-efficient architectures can achieve full universal approximation without relying on pretrained priors or restrictive activation assumptions.

title: Continuous Latent Diffusion Language Model
comment: 99 pages, 31 figures, 9 tables. Project page: https://hongcanguo.github.io/Cola-DLM/
summary: Large language models have achieved remarkable success under the autoregressive paradigm, yet high-quality text generation need not be tied to a fixed left-to-right order. Existing alternatives still struggle to jointly achieve generation efficiency, scalable representation learning, and effective global semantic modeling. We propose Cola DLM, a hierarchical latent diffusion language model that frames text generation through hierarchical information decomposition. Cola DLM first learns a stable text-to-latent mapping with a Text VAE, then models a global semantic prior in continuous latent space with a block-causal DiT, and finally generates text through conditional decoding. From a unified Markov-path perspective, its diffusion process performs latent prior transport rather than token-level observation recovery, thereby separating global semantic organization from local textual realization. This design yields a more flexible non-autoregressive inductive bias, supports semantic compression and prior fitting in continuous space, and naturally extends to other continuous modalities. Through experiments spanning 4 research questions, 8 benchmarks, strictly matched ~2B-parameter autoregressive and LLaDA baselines, and scaling curves up to about 2000 EFLOPs, we identify an effective overall configuration of Cola DLM and verify its strong scaling behavior for text generation. Taken together, the results establish hierarchical continuous latent prior modeling as a principled alternative to strictly token-level language modeling, where generation quality and scaling behavior may better reflect model capability than likelihood, while also suggesting a concrete path toward unified modeling across discrete text and continuous modalities.

AI.tldr: Cola DLM是一种层次化潜空间扩散语言模型，通过将文本生成重构为层次化信息分解过程（在连续潜空间中建模全局语义先验），实现生成效率、表示学习和全局语义建模的联合优化，证明了连续潜空间先验建模可作为token级语言建模的有效替代方案。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型虽在自回归范式下取得成功，但高质量文本生成不必局限于固定的从左到右顺序。当前的替代方案仍难以同时实现生成效率、可扩展的表示学习和有效的全局语义建模。
AI.method: 提出层次化信息分解框架：1) Text VAE学习稳定的text-to-latent映射；2) block-causal DiT在连续潜空间中建模全局语义先验；3) 通过条件解码生成文本。从马尔可夫路径视角，其扩散过程执行潜空间先验传输而非token级观测恢复，实现全局语义组织与局部文本实现的解耦。
AI.result: 通过4个研究问题、8个基准数据集、与约2B参数自回归和LLaDA基线的严格匹配、以及高达约2000 EFLOPs的扩展曲线实验，验证了Cola DLM的有效配置和强扩展行为。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了层次化连续潜空间先验建模作为token级语言建模的原则性替代方案的有效性。生成质量和扩展行为可能比似然值更能反映模型能力，同时为离散文本和连续模态的统一建模提供了可行路径。

title: MolRecBench-Wild: A Real-World Benchmark for Optical Chemical Structure Recognition
summary: Optical Chemical Structure Recognition (OCSR) aims to translate molecular diagrams in scientific literature into machine-readable formats, but current systems remain unreliable on real-world images due to substantial visual and chemical complexity. We introduce MOSAIC, a dual-dimensional difficulty framework with 37 fine-grained labels that jointly characterize visual interference and chemical semantic challenges in molecular diagrams. Based on this framework, we construct MolRecBench-Wild, a benchmark of 5,029 structures from 820 recent chemistry papers, covering the full difficulty spectrum observed in real publications. To enable faithful semantic evaluation beyond SMILES and MolFile, we propose CARBON, a representation language capable of expressing valence variations, icon-based groups, and other non-standard chemical semantics. We further adopt a dual-track evaluation protocol supporting both CARBON and SMILES outputs for broad model compatibility. Comprehensive experiments over 18 OCSR-capable models reveal severe performance degradation on MolRecBench-Wild, exposing a large gap between previous patent benchmarks and real-world academic scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOSAIC双维度难度框架（18个视觉难度标签+19个化学语义标签，共37个细粒度标签），据此从820篇近期化学期刊论文中构建了包含5,029个真实化学结构图的基准MolRecBench-Wild；同时提出可表达价态变化、图标基团、非标准键型的分子表示语言CARBON，并设计CARBON/Graph/SMILES双轨评测协议，对18个OCSR模型全面评测。结果显示所有模型在该基准上性能严重下降（最佳SMILES准确率仅Gemini 2.5 Pro的30.06%，最佳Graph准确率13.04%），暴露了现有专利类基准与真实学术文献场景之间的巨大落差。
AI.motivation: 光学化学结构识别（OCSR）是将文献中的分子图转换为SMILES/分子图/MolFile等机器可读格式的基础技术，是构建高质量AI4Chemistry数据集的核心环节。尽管MolGrapher、MolParser等模型在USPTO、UOB等主流基准上Exact Match已超90%，但这些基准多源自专利或自动生成图像，具有背景干净、分辨率高、风格统一等特征，与近期主流化学期刊中的真实结构图在视觉干扰（扫描噪声、文字遮挡、彩色背景、箭头叠加）和化学语义复杂度（配位键、混合价态、离子键、自由基、Markush图标R基团、聚合物）上差异巨大。既有研究已指出模型在真实文献图像上性能显著下降，说明现有公开基准已无法支撑该领域的进一步突破，亟需更具真实性、难度与多样性的评测基准；同时SMILES/E-SMILES/MolFile等既有表示法无法完整表达真实图中的非标准化学语义，需要一种语义完备的标注语言。
AI.method: 方法分三部分：（1）MOSAIC难度框架：经大量真实文献分析，定义两个正交维度——视觉表现（18个标签：装饰文字、装饰键、边界污染、模糊图像、额外箭头/框/文字、彩色区域或图像背景、键交叉、R以图案表示、彩色原子、短键、编号原子、不完整分子、大分子、大字体、长键、粗键、细键、长基团名等）与化学语义（19个标签：等宽手性键、电荷符号、虚线键、波浪键、孤对电子符号、三键、哈希键、离子键、Ar上R位置不确定、缩写结构、价态符号、聚合物、芳香键、多基团、Ar上原子位置不确定、过渡态、配位键、连续双键、双虚线键等），每张图逐标签人工标注，并定义 MOSAIC 度量 (N_vis, N_chem) 二元组及二维难度分布矩阵。（2）数据构建：采集7本高水平期刊约820篇CC-BY-4.0论文，用DocLayout-YOLO+自研YOLO分子检测器裁剪得7,000张候选图→人工初筛6,548张→MOSAIC标注→按二维空间均衡采样5,029张；用内部模型预测带原子坐标的图结构作预标注，在Ketcher中人工校正并对MolFile不支持的语义制定补充规则；经至少两轮质检；最终导出CARBON、简化Graph与SMILES三种真值。自建在线标注平台，47名化学背景标注者共投入152人天。（3）CARBON表示语言：原子中心（atom-centric）与属性中心（attribute-centric）两种互补形式，可相互转换；支持非标准键型（虚线配位键、粗键、粗双键、双虚线键）、原子属性（氧化态、自由基、同位素、非整数电荷）、重复结构（多基团/聚合物）、图像级二维坐标；具备可扩展、灵活（可退化为SMILES）、简洁可读等特性。（4）双轨评测协议：SMILES-based（专家模型输出SMILES序列，真值中键型做简化）、Graph-based（Graph精确匹配原子类型/键型/括号；Simplified Graph仅匹配原子符号与常见键型并将复杂键型简化）；针对VLM设计SMILES、Simplified Graph与Full Graph三套提示模板，其中Full Graph采用少样本多图上下文（键型视觉参考图+12条标准化转换规则图例）。
AI.result: 在5,029个真实结构图上评测18个OCSR模型，五大类（SMILES专家、Graph专家、VLM、VRM、文档解析工具）性能普遍极低。SMILES轨最佳为Gemini 2.5 Pro 30.06%、MolScribe 41.05%（Graph类模型中MolScribe SMILES 41.05最高、GTR-Mol-VLM 40.43、MolNexTR 40.90），Graph轨最佳Gemini 2.5 Pro 13.04%、GPT-5 8.19%；工具类Mathpix SMILES 27.88远超Logics-Parsing 15.47；OCSU仅6.06。观察到普遍单调降级规律：SMILES准确率 > Simplified Graph > Graph，说明评测协议粒度递进合理。VRM（GPT-5、Seed1.6-Thinking、Intern-S1、Gemini 2.5 Pro）明显优于通用VLM（GPT-4o 7.94、Qwen-VL-Max 6.95），表明显式推理机制对结构识别有实质帮助；图式架构模型因具备更强结构先验而更鲁棒。GTR-Mol-VLM在Simplified Graph上随MOSAIC任一维度难度标签数增加而单调下降，且视觉与化学联合干扰时下降最为陡峭，验证了MOSAIC构建了可控难度谱、模型对异质扰动敏感。案例分析显示：Gemini 2.5 Pro在Graph任务中错误地将苯环单双键全判为芳香键（化学上正确但图式评测判错），GPT-5与Gemini对圆圈等图形可正确转换但对多样键型预测能力差，DECIMERv2.2将[Ph]误识为[Pb]且引入多余手性信息，Mathpix遗漏磷原子且R基统一化表示。
AI.conclusion: 现有OCSR系统在真实化学文献上仍远未可靠，其根因在于缺乏真实的难度建模与语义完备的真值标注。本文贡献三点：首个面向分子结构识别的双维度难度评估框架MOSAIC；完全源自近期化学出版物、覆盖完整视觉与化学复杂度谱的基准MolRecBench-Wild（93.29%样本至少含一个难度标签，42%在两维度均有标签）；以及可超越SMILES/MolFile表达极限的表示语言CARBON与配套评测工具链。18个模型的评测显示各输出格式下均存在显著性能退化，印证了对更鲁棒OCSR方法的迫切需求。未来方向包括视觉—化学跨模态预训练、风格感知的图像增强与泛化、统一结构语言表示，并建议以CARBON作为复杂分子识别的统一标准。

title: Distributionally Robust Multi-Objective Optimization
summary: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) has received growing attention in applications that require learning under multiple criteria. However, the existing MOO formulations do not explicitly account for distributional shifts in the data. We introduce distributionally robust multi-objective optimization (DR-MOO), which minimizes multiple objectives under their respective worst-case distributions. We propose Pareto-type solution concepts for DR-MOO and develop multi-gradient descent algorithms (MGDA) with provable guarantees. Leveraging a Lagrangian dual reformulation, we first design a double-loop MGDA that uses an inner loop to estimate dual variables and achieves a total sample complexity $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-12})$ for reaching an $ε$-Pareto-stationary point. To further improve efficiency, we incorporate gradient clipping to handle generalized-smooth and biased gradient estimates, removing the need for double sampling. This yields a single-loop double-clip MGDA with substantially improved sample complexity $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-4})$. Our theory applies to the nonconvex setting and does not require bounded objectives or gradients. Experiments demonstrate that our methods are competitive with state-of-the-art MGDA baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分布鲁棒多目标优化（DR-MOO）：在 f-散度正则化下为每个目标各自建模分布偏移，定义"分布鲁棒 Pareto 支配/最优/平稳性"，并借助强对偶把无穷维分布最坏化改写为有限维对偶多目标问题。基于此设计了两种 MGDA 类算法：双环 MGDA（内层 SGD 跟踪对偶变量 + 双重采样，样本复杂度 O(ε⁻⁸)）与单环"双裁剪"MGDA（重标度代理目标 + 对偶/原始梯度双重裁剪 + 大批量采样，样本复杂度 O(ε⁻⁴)），均为非凸设定且不需一致有界梯度。实验（Multi-MNIST 对抗攻击、CelebA 标签不平衡、Office-31 域偏移）显示优于或持平现有 MGDA 类基线。注意：arXiv 摘要页所写的 O(ε⁻¹²) 与正文定理 4.1 的 O(ε⁻⁸) 不一致，应以正文为准。
AI.motivation: 多目标优化（MOO）与多任务学习通常假设各任务的名义分布固定，无法刻画任务相关的分布偏移（对抗扰动、类不平衡、域迁移）。作者指出：名义分布下 Pareto 最优的解在每个目标各自被扰动后可能不再 Pareto 最优（附录 B 的双目标玩具例子显示 Pareto 前沿被显著扭曲）。而把 DRO 推广到 MOO 存在三重困难：(1) 需建模"逐目标"偏移并给出可解的 Pareto 型解概念；(2) DRO 的嵌套最坏化目标即使在损失 Lipschitz 且光滑时也会非光滑，现有 MGDA（MoDo、SDMGrad、MoCo 等）的分析依赖一致有界梯度与全局 L-光滑，无法直接搬用；(3) 朴素地组合 MGDA 与 DRO 子程序会引入偏差梯度、导致收敛缓慢。La Torre & Rocca (2024) 虽给出凸损失下的 DR-MOO Pareto 概念，但基于原问题最坏分布的存在性刻画，需要求解无穷维最大化，无实用算法与非渐近保证。
AI.method:
【问题形式化】定义 DR-MOO：min_θ sup_{Q^1..Q^m}[H^1(θ,Q^1),…,H^m(θ,Q^m)]，其中 H^i=E_{Q^i}[ℓ^i]-λD_f(Q^i|P^i)，逐目标独立歧义集，保留向量值权衡而非标量化。定义分布鲁棒 Pareto 支配（对所有 i 不劣、某 j 严格优）与分布鲁棒 Pareto 最优（Def 3.1/3.2），无偏移时退化为标准定义。利用 f-散数 DRO 强对偶（Shapiro 2017; Namkoong & Duchi 2016; Levy 2020; Jin 2021）得到对偶形式 φ^i(θ)=min_{η^i} λE_{P^i}[f*((ℓ^i(θ,ξ)-η^i)/λ)]+η^i，且 ∇φ^i(θ)=∇_θ L^i(θ,η^{i,*})。据此定义 ε-分布鲁棒 Pareto 平稳：存在 w∈单纯形使 ‖Σ_i w^i ∇φ^i(θ)‖≤ε（Def 3.4）。假设：损失 G-Lipschitz、L-光滑，样本方差有界 κ²，f* 为 M-光滑。

【算法1：双环 MGDA】内层用 SGD 跟踪对偶变量 η^{i,*}（控制"优化偏差"）；外层用三次独立采样的内层索引 d,d̄,d̃ 与独立数据批次构造 Y_t, Ȳ_t, Ỹ_t，使 E[Ȳ^TỸ w|H_t]=E[Ȳ|H_t]^T E[Ỹ|H_t] w，消除 Gram 矩阵中的协方差项，得到无偏随机 Gram 估计，无需增大的 minibatch。定理4.1：外层 T=Θ(ε⁻⁴)、内层 D=Θ(Δ_η G⁴γ⁻¹ε⁻²)，得 (1/T)ΣE‖∇Φ(θ_t)w_t‖² ≤ 94ε²，总样本复杂度 O(ε⁻⁸)。关键技术点：独立索引使参数更新与偏好更新的对偶偏差具有相同条件均值，可部分对消，再用 Young 不等式以 O(ε²) 控制残余偏差。

【算法2：单环 Double-Clip MGDA】Lemma 5.1 给出充分判据：若 G Σ|w^i ∇_{η^i}L^i| + ‖Σ w^i ∇_θ L^i‖ ≤ ε 则 ‖∇Φ(θ)w‖≤ε；通过重标度代理 L̂(θ,η)=L(θ,G√m η)（引入 √m 因子处理 m 个目标的聚合）即可用联合梯度满足该判据。由此无需精确跟踪 η*，可单环联合更新 (θ,η) 与 w。对平衡梯度 X_t w_t（原始）与 Z_t w_t（对偶）做裁剪：α_t=min{c1,c2/‖X_t w_t‖}、μ_t=min{f1,f2/‖Z_t w_t‖}，并复用 α_t, μ_t 抑制 Gram 贡献 α_t X_tᵀX_t w_t、μ_t Z_tᵀZ_t w_t（后者注入对偶信息），从而免去双重采样。关键创新：(a) 裁剪因子与问题参数无关（c1=f1=1/2，c2=f2=δε），因 X,Z 及其 Gram 项的光滑度/方差尺度不同；(b) 借助梯度-函数值关系式 (10) 与停时 τ̂（控制异常大随机梯度与函数间隙），处理无界梯度与广义光滑 ((L̂0,L̂1,L̂2)-smooth)、仿射有界噪声；(c) 证明采用高概率（1-δ）分析，批量 N1,N2=O(δ⁻³ε⁻²)。定理5.2：以概率 ≥1-δ，(1/T)Σ‖∇_{θ,η}L̂(θ_t,η_{t+1})w_t‖ ≤ 34ε，迭代复杂度 O(ε⁻²)，样本复杂度 O(ε⁻⁴)（匹配平滑非凸随机优化）。
AI.result: 理论：双环 MGDA 达 O(ε⁻⁸) 总样本复杂度（外层 O(ε⁻⁴) 迭代 + 内层 O(ε⁻⁴) 迭代）；双裁剪单环 MGDA 以高概率达 O(ε⁻⁴) 总样本复杂度、O(ε⁻²) 迭代复杂度，且在广义光滑与仿射有界噪声下无需一致有界梯度/函数值假设，理论上匹配 MoDo/SDMGrad/MoCo/MGDA 的 O(ε⁻⁴) 速率（Table 3）。实验：Multi-MNIST 2/3 数字的 FGSM 攻击下，Double-Clip MGDA 在各攻击强度上均最优（如 3-digit 干净 98.76%、扰动 0.08 时 86.65%，明显高于基线 73–75%）；CelebA 标签不平衡下平均准确率 88.41%、平衡准确率 89.55%、AUC 94.63%，均为最优；Office-31 域偏移下 Double-Clip 取得最高 worst-domain（79.06%）与 mean（91.91%）准确率，Double-Loop 略逊于 MoCo 但优于其余基线。合成线性回归与 UCI 白葡萄酒逻辑回归（100 随机种子）中双裁剪的最终平衡梯度范数一致低于双环（如 1.22 vs 2.53；0.175 vs 0.240），置信区间窄。消融显示：λ 太小（0.4）稳健性略差；双裁剪需要比未裁剪方法更大的学习率（与定理5.2 的 β,γ=O(1) 一致）；批量 256 已足够稳定（理论要求 O(ε⁻²)）；内环步数从 5 到 25 收敛差异很小，说明内层一维凸子问题易解、深度学习场景下取 5 步的额外开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统性地给出非凸 DR-MOO 的形式化与带非渐近保证的 MGDA 型算法：逐目标 f-散数歧义集 + 分布鲁棒 Pareto 支配/最优/平稳性定义，配合强对偶导出的有限维对偶刻画，使原本不可解的原问题最坏分布最大化变成可优化问题。双环方法用"内层对偶跟踪 + 双重采样"把双样本偏差与对偶偏差分别控制，代价是 O(ε⁻⁸) 样本复杂度；单环双裁剪方法通过重标度代理、目标无关的裁剪因子与停时-梯度/函数值耦合分析，在广义光滑、仿射有界噪声、无一致有界梯度的条件下把复杂度降到 O(ε⁻⁴)，并免去双采样。局限：双裁剪的高概率保证对置信参数 δ 的批量依赖很强（δ⁻³ε⁻²），部分源于当前分析框架；方法只求 Pareto 平稳点，未显式支持用户指定的权衡偏好。后续方向包括更精细的集中不等式/Lyapunov 分析、动量或方差缩减以削弱对 δ 的依赖、以及引入偏好感知正则化（如近端或镜像下降）的权衡引导机制。

title: Long Context Pre-Training with Lighthouse Attention
summary: Training causal transformers at extreme sequence lengths is bottlenecked by the quadratic time and memory of scaled dot-product attention (SDPA). In this work, we propose Lighthouse Attention, a training-only symmetrical selection-based hierarchical attention algorithm that wraps around ordinary SDPA and can be easily removed towards the end of the training. Our hierarchical selection is also gradient-free, which exempts us from dealing with a complicated and potentially inefficient backward pass kernel. Our contribution is three-fold: (i) A subquadratic hierarchical pre- and post-processing step that does adaptive compression and decompression of the sequence. (ii) A symmetrical compression strategy that pools queries, keys and values at the same time, while preserving left-to-right causality, which greatly improves parallelism. (iii) A two stage training approach which we pre-train for the majority of the time with Lighthouse Attention and recover a full attention model at the end with a short training. We run preliminary small scale LLM pre-training experiments that show the effectiveness of our method compared to full attention training with all other settings matched, where we achieve a faster total training time and lower final loss after the recovery phase. Full code is available at: https://github.com/ighoshsubho/lighthouse-attention

AI.tldr: Lighthouse Attention 是一种训练阶段的层次化选择注意力算法，通过对称压缩 Q、K、V 序列来加速因果 Transformer 的训练，可在线训练结束后移除恢复完整注意力。在小规模 LLM 预训练实验中，该方法实现了更快的训练速度和更低的最终损失。
AI.motivation: 在极长序列上训练因果 Transformer 时，缩放点积注意力（SDPA）的二次方时间和内存开销成为主要瓶颈，限制了模型扩展。
AI.method: (i) 子二次方层次化预处理/后处理步骤，实现自适应压缩和解压缩；(ii) 对称压缩策略，同时对查询、键、值进行池化，保持从左到右的因果性；(iii) 两阶段训练——先用 Lighthouse Attention 预训练大部分时间，再用短训练恢复完整注意力模型。
AI.result: 小规模 LLM 预训练实验中，在其他设置相同的情况下，Lighthouse Attention 实现了更快的总训练时间和恢复阶段后更低的最终损失。
AI.conclusion: Lighthouse Attention 作为训练辅助技术，可有效加速长序列 Transformer 训练，且训练完成后可移除，保留完整模型能力。

title: On the Role of Language Representations in Auto-Bidding: Findings and Implications
summary: Auto-bidding is a crucial task in real-time advertising markets, where policies must optimize long-horizon value under delivery constraints (e.g., budget and CPA). Existing methods for auto-bidding rely on compact numerical state representations: while they can implicitly capture delivery dynamics, they offer limited support for explicitly representing and controlling high-level intent, evolving feedback, and operator-style strategic guidance in real campaigns. Meanwhile, Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a powerful method for encoding semantic information, it remains unclear when LLMs help and how to integrate them without sacrificing numerical precision. Through systematic preliminary studies, we find that (1) LLM embeddings contain bidding-relevant cues yet cannot replace numerical features, and (2) gains emerge only with careful semantic--numeric integration rather than naive concatenation. Motivated by these findings, we propose \textit{SemBid}, a novel auto-bidding framework that injects LLM-encoded semantics into offline bidding trajectories at the token level. SemBid introduces three semantic inputs: \textit{Task}, \textit{History}, and \textit{Strategy}. It injects these semantics as tokens alongside numerical trajectory tokens and uses self-attention to integrate them, improving controllability and generalization across objectives. Across diverse scenarios and budget regimes, SemBid outperforms competitive baselines from offline RL and generative sequence modeling, with more consistent gains in overall performance, constraint satisfaction, and robustness. Our code is available at: \href{https://github.com/AlanYu04/SemBid-KDD2026}{\textcolor{blue}{here}}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SemBid框架，通过在token级别将LLM编码的语义信息（任务、历史、策略）与数值轨迹token融合，解决了自动出价系统中高层意图表示和控制能力不足的问题。关键发现是LLM嵌入虽包含出价相关线索但不能替代数值特征，需要精心设计的语义-数值融合才能带来收益。
AI.motivation: 现有自动出价方法依赖紧凑的数值状态表示，虽能隐式捕捉投放动态，但缺乏对高层意图、动态反馈和操作风格策略引导的显式表示与控制能力。LLM虽具备强大的语义编码能力，但在自动出价场景中的应用时机和集成方式尚不明确。
AI.method: (1) 系统性初步研究验证LLM嵌入包含出价相关线索但不能完全替代数值特征；(2) 发现收益仅在精心设计的语义-数值融合下才能实现，而非简单拼接；(3) 提出SemBid框架，在token级别将LLM编码的语义信息注入离线出价轨迹；(4) 引入三类语义输入：任务(Task)、历史(History)和策略(Strategy)，配合自注意力机制实现语义与数值token的深度整合。
AI.result: SemBid在多样化的场景和预算约束下，性能、约束满足度和鲁棒性均优于离线强化学习和生成式序列建模的竞争性基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SemBid通过在token层面将LLM编码的语义信息与数值轨迹token融合，并利用自注意力机制进行整合，有效提升了自动出价系统的可控性和泛化能力，在多种场景和预算约束下均优于离线强化学习和生成式序列建模基线方法。

title: Temporal Functional Circuits: From Spline Plots to Faithful Explanations in KAN Forecasting
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables, plus appendix. Under review at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Unlike MLPs, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) expose explicit learnable edge functions on every connection, enabling mechanistic explanation in time-series forecasting. This paper introduces Temporal Functional Circuits, a framework that transforms KAN edge functions from latent visualizations into faithful, temporally grounded explanations. Built on a gated residual KAN that decomposes forecasts into a linear base and a sparsely activated KAN correction, the framework (i) maps each edge to input lags via output-aware attribution, (ii) ranks edges by learned activation range, and (iii) validates faithfulness through edge-level interventions including zeroing and spline removal. Removing the learned B-spline component while retaining the base SiLU term degrades forecasts, providing evidence that the spline shape itself carries predictive value beyond the base activation. On four synthetic regimes of increasing complexity, the learned gate opens progressively wider as signal complexity grows. On regime-switching signals, gated KAN achieves 59% lower MSE than linear-only models. Across eight benchmarks, the gated architecture is competitive with linear, attention, and MLP alternatives, while providing interpretable edge functions that MLP-based corrections cannot offer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「Temporal Functional Circuits (TFC)」框架，将 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) 的可学习样条边函数从"可视化"升级为"忠实且时间锚定"的时序预测解释：基于一个门控残差 KAN（线性基 + 稀疏激活的 KAN 修正），通过输出感知归因把每条边映射到具体输入滞后步，按激活范围对边排序，并用置零/均值替换/样条移除等边级干预验证忠实性。结论是 KAN 的价值主要在可解释性而非普遍精度：门控让模型自行决定何时使用非线性修正，而 KAN 独有的可编辑单变量边函数使 MLP 所不具备的"样条形状级"干预分析成为可能。
AI.motivation: KAN 被广泛宣称"天然可解释"，因为每条连接上都挂有显式的单变量可学习函数（B-spline）。但作者指出：可视化样条曲线并不等于解释了预测。边函数 φ_e(z) 作用于隐空间，它不直接表明 (a) 哪个输入时间步/通道激活了它，(b) 模型是否真正使用了它（而非被下游层抑制），(c) 移除它是否会改变预测。结合此前对 DecompKAN 的受控消融（分解-patch-归一化流水线对性能的贡献大于非线性核的选择，且 KAN 并非在所有数据集上占优），本文的核心问题是：KAN 何时有用、能否解释原因？同时，显著性图研究（Adebayo et al. 2018）表明视觉上合理的解释可能不忠实，而时序的时间自相关会制造表面有意义但不忠实的归因模式，因此时序 XAI 需要"时间锚定 + 干预检验"。
AI.method: 1) 门控残差 KAN：ŷ = f_lin(x) + g_trend(x)⊙f_KAN^trend(x) + g_resid(x)⊙f_KAN^resid(x)。共享预处理流水线：RevIN 逐通道归一化 → 两层 MLP 生成自适应归一化统计量 s（d_s=8，输出 per-channel γ,β，恒等初始化）→ 移动平均分解（K=25）得到趋势/残差分量，各自配一个门。线性分支：patch（长度 P=16、步长 S=8、嵌入 d=32）+ 线性头。KAN 分支：两层 B-spline KAN（网格 G=5、样条阶 p=3、隐层 64），边函数 φ_e(z)=w·SiLU(z)+Σ_k c_k B_k^p(z)。门为两层 MLP+sigmoid，输出 per-channel 标量 g_c(x)∈[0,1]，跨预测步广播。损失 L = MSE + λ_g(E‖g_trend‖_1 + E‖g_resid‖_1)。定义利用率指标 U_KAN = (1/2C)Σ_c(E[g_trend,c]+E[g_resid,c])。2) Temporal Functional Circuit 元组 ℰ_e=(φ_e, A_e, I_e, Δ_e)：(i) 边到滞后步归因 C_e(x)=φ_e(z_e)·∂ŷ/∂a_e（含 stop-gradient，门通过链式法则隐式进入，门关闭时梯度近零），再取 A_e(c,t)=E|∂C_e/∂x_{c,t}|；(ii) 数据加权重要度 I_e=E|φ_e·∂ŷ/∂a_e|；(iii) 无数据的激活范围 R_e=max φ_e − min φ_e（在 B-spline knot 区间 [t0,tG] 上）；(iv) 干预效应 Δ_e=E[ℓ(f^{(-e)}(x),y) − ℓ(f(x),y)]，三种干预：Zero（a_e←0）、Mean（a_e←E[a_e]）、Spline removal（仅保留 w·SiLU(z)）。3) 删除曲线：按重要性代理排序 top-k / random-k / bottom-k 逐级删除，检验 Δ_top-k > Δ_random-k > Δ_bottom-k。4) 实验：8 个基准（Weather、Solar、ECL、ETTh1/h2、ETTm1/m2、PPG-DaLiA），统一流水线与训练配方，核心消融比较 Linear/KAN/Attention/Ungated/Gated KAN/Gated MLP；4 个合成机制（线性正弦、多频周期、阈值 AR (SETAR)、状态切换），门惩罚 λ_g=0 以观察门随复杂度的单调响应；基函数消融（B-spline/Fourier/SinCos/MLP）、门消融、归因方法对比（A_e vs IG vs Grad×Input vs Random）、权重随机化的忠实性 sanity check、Bootstrap 置信区间与显著性检验。
AI.result: 核心消融（H=96，3 种子）：无单一核心全面占优，Gated KAN 在 4/8 数据集最优或并列最优（Weather .149、ETTh1 .451、ETTm1 .345、ETTm2 .148），ETTh2 上 Gated MLP 最佳（.239），多数差异在一个标准差内；Gated KAN 在 4/8 数据集优于 Ungated KAN，说明门控的主要价值是"诊断性控制"而非精度提升；Gated MLP 可匹配精度但无法提供可检查的边函数。U_KAN 从 0.022（PPG/ETTh1）到 0.144（Solar），ETTh1/ETTm2 在长预测步显著上升（0.022→0.288、0.020→0.198）；U_KAN 与独立非线性残差诊断 S_nonlin 的 Spearman ρ=0.46（p=0.015, n=28）。合成实验：无 L1 压力时 U_KAN 随复杂度单调上升 0.49→0.53→0.56→0.72，校准指标 R_KAN 区分度更高（0.046→0.127→0.497→0.420）；状态切换信号上 Gated KAN MSE .0115 vs 线性 .0280，降幅 59%；线性信号上所有核相同（KAN 不造成损害）。忠实性：top-k 删除在 Weather/ETTm2/Solar 上显著大于随机与 bottom（Weather top-50 使 MSE +2.20e-4，而随机为 −0.01±0.05e-4，p<1e-4）；R_e 排序的删除效应比 I_e 大 20–42 倍；B-spline 移除仅保留 SiLU 时 Weather 上只占完整置零效应的 41%（+3.8e-5 vs +9.1e-5），ETTh1 降至 6%；随机化全部 KAN 权重使删除效应完全消失，随机化仅样条系数则效应减弱但不消失（Adebayo 式 sanity check 通过）。时间锚定：在已知滞后 {3,12} 的合成信号上 A_e 的 AUPRC=0.44（随机 0.07，最佳种子 0.75），虽低于 IG 的 0.53，但能定位"哪些边实现了哪个滞后"，这是模型级方法无法提供的；跨种子归因稳定性 Pearson r=0.94–0.97；Weather 上按 IG 掩蔽 top-5 输入位置使 MSE +104%（随机仅 +3%）。KAN 分支整体贡献：Weather 6.9%、Solar 49.7%（相对 MSE），top-1% 边捕获 Weather 分支效应的 20%，表明非线性修正是"分散但不均匀"；λ_g>0 时门在纯线性数据上完全关闭（R_KAN=0）而在线性-切换数据上仍保留必要修正。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心主张是：KAN 的可解释性必须建立在时间锚定与干预检验之上，而非仅仅展示样条曲线。TFC 通过 (φ_e, A_e, I_e, Δ_e) 将边函数映射到原始滞后步并以干预量化其忠实性；门控残差结构让模型学习"何时"使用非线性修正（TFC 回答"用什么"），并提供可测的利用率诊断。实证上 Gated KAN 与线性/注意力/MLP 方案在精度上具竞争力但非全面 SOTA，其独特价值在于提供 MLP 所无法给出的显式边函数、单连接样条移除与可编辑的功能单元。局限：边干预只建立模型内部效应而非数据生成过程的因果性；基于梯度的归因对第一层边最直接，深层存在梯度饱和；KAN 边函数可检查但不天然具备人类语义；自适应 λ_g 选择仍是开放问题；合成机制的判别并不完美。作者将更鲁棒的自适应门控列为未来工作。

title: Automated Clinical Report Generation for Remote Cognitive Remediation: Comparing Knowledge-Engineered Templates and LLMs in Low-Resource Settings
summary: The growing demand for cognitive remediation therapy, combined with limited speech therapist availability, has accelerated the adoption of remote rehabilitation tools. These systems generate large volumes of interaction data that are difficult for clinicians to review efficiently. This paper investigates automated clinical report generation for avatar-guided, home-based cognitive remediation sessions in a low-resource setting with no reference reports. We present and compare two approaches: (1) a rule-based template system encoding speech therapy domain knowledge as explicit decision rules and validated templates, ensuring clinical reliability and traceability; and (2) a zero-shot LLM-based approach (GPT-4) aimed at more fluent and concise output. Both systems use identical pre-extracted, expert-validated structured variables, enabling a controlled factual comparison. Outputs were evaluated by eight speech therapists and final-year students using a nine-criterion questionnaire. Results reveal a clear trade-off between clinical reliability and linguistic quality. The template-based system scored higher on fluidity, coherence, and results presentation, while GPT-4 produced more concise output. Directional differences are consistent across evaluation dimensions, though no comparison reached statistical significance after correction, reflecting the scale constraints of expert clinical evaluation. Based on evaluator feedback, we derive eight design recommendations for clinical reporting systems in remote rehabilitation settings. More broadly, this work contributes a replicable methodology combining expert elicitation, taxonomy-driven generation, and multi-dimensional human evaluation for clinical NLG in low-resource settings, and illustrates how controlled comparisons can inform the responsible adoption of generative AI in healthcare.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比了两种自动生成认知康复治疗临床报告的方法：基于规则的模板系统与GPT-4零样本LLM方法。评估由8名言语治疗师完成，结果显示模板系统在流畅性、一致性和结果呈现上更优，GPT-4则生成更简洁的报告。研究为低资源环境下的临床NLP系统提供了8条设计建议，并展示了如何通过对照比较来指导生成式AI在医疗领域的负责任应用。
AI.motivation: 认知康复治疗需求增长与言语治疗师短缺的矛盾日益突出，远程康复工具产生的海量交互数据难以被临床医生高效审阅。该研究旨在为低资源环境下无参考报告的Avatar引导式居家认知康复会话自动生成临床报告。
AI.method: 研究采用对照实验设计，固定使用专家验证的相同结构化变量，对比两种方法：(1)编码言语治疗领域知识的规则模板系统，强调临床可靠性与可追溯性；(2)GPT-4零样本LLM方法，追求更流畅简洁的输出。由8名言语治疗师及高年级学生使用9项标准问卷进行评估。
AI.result: 两种方法呈现明显的权衡：模板系统在流畅性、一致性和结果呈现方面得分更高，GPT-4则输出更简洁。各评估维度的方向性差异一致，但经校正后未达统计显著水平，反映了专家临床评估的规模限制。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了远程康复场景下临床报告系统的8条设计建议，并贡献了一套可复现的方法论——结合专家知识提取、分类学驱动生成与多维度人工评估，适用于低资源环境下的临床NLP。更广泛地，该研究为生成式AI在医疗领域的负责任采纳提供了实证依据。

title: Taklif.AI: LLM-Powered Platform for Interest-Based Personalized College Assignments
summary: Educators face significant challenges in creating engaging, personalized assignments that accommodate students' diverse interests and cognitive abilities. Traditional one-size-fits-all assignments frequently lead to decreased student engagement and increased reliance on unethical practices such as plagiarism. To address these challenges, we present Taklif.AI, a platform that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically generate personalized assignments tailored to individual student interests. Unlike existing AI-powered educational platforms that personalize based on academic performance metrics alone, Taklif.AI incorporates students' extracurricular interests and cultural contexts into the assignment generation process through a structured prompt engineering pipeline with input and output guardrails. The platform employs a serverless architecture on AWS with Next.js, using Llama 3.3 70B as the primary LLM via LiteLLM for multi-provider load balancing and LangChain for prompt orchestration. We describe the system architecture, the prompt design methodology, and the guardrails framework that ensures output quality. Preliminary user acceptance testing with 68 participants (65 students and 3 educators) indicates positive reception, with 84% of participants rating the personalization feature as beneficial. We discuss the platform's current capabilities and limitations, and outline directions for rigorous empirical evaluation of learning outcomes.

AI.tldr: Taklif.AI是一个利用大语言模型自动生成个性化作业的平台，区别于传统仅基于学业表现的个性化方法，该平台将学生的课外兴趣和文化背景纳入考量，采用无服务器架构和结构化提示工程配以护栏机制确保输出质量。初步测试表明个性化功能受到欢迎，但尚需严格的实证研究验证学习成效。
AI.motivation: 传统一刀切的作业模式导致学生参与度下降和剽窃等不道德行为增加，现有AI教育平台仅基于学业表现指标进行个性化，缺乏对学生课外兴趣和文化背景的关注，因此需要构建更全面的个性化作业生成系统。
AI.method: 采用无服务器架构（AWS + Next.js），使用Llama 3.3 70B作为核心LLM，通过LiteLLM实现多提供商负载均衡，LangChain编排提示词流程；设计了结构化提示工程管道，包含输入/输出护栏以确保输出质量，并将学生的课外兴趣和文化背景纳入作业生成考量。
AI.result: 初步用户接受度测试表明84%的参与者认为个性化功能有益，平台获得正向评价。
AI.conclusion: 目前平台处于初步阶段（68名参与者测试），84%受试者认为个性化功能有益，但尚未进行严格的学习成果实证评估，存在功能完善和数据安全等局限性需要克服。

title: Budgeted Attention Allocation: Cost-Conditioned Compute Control for Efficient Transformers
summary: Transformers usually expose one inference cost per trained model, while deployed systems often need multiple cost-quality operating points. We study Budgeted Attention Allocation, a monotone head-gating mechanism conditioned on a requested attention budget. Dense warm-starting is important for stability: on a robust synthetic sequence task, one budgeted model reaches 99.7% accuracy at 0.303 estimated attention cost and 100.0% accuracy at 0.504 cost. On held-out AG News with a custom word-level transformer, hard-gate adaptation turns soft cost control into measured single-thread CPU speed, reaching 82.1% accuracy with 1.28x speedup at budget 0.50. In pretrained BERT-Mini AG News, budgeted structural pruning reaches 87.6% accuracy with 1.20x speedup at budget 0.50; a validation-ranked zero-shot dense post-hoc structural baseline reaches 86.1%, and one recovery epoch raises that per-budget specialist to 87.9%. On DBpedia14, BERT-Mini budgeted gates reach 97.4% at exact budget 0.50 versus 96.6% for dense full attention. Static fixed-budget gates and recovered dense specialists remain strong. The contribution is therefore not universal dominance, but a reproducible feasibility study of one controllable checkpoint across budgets that can trade attention cost for accuracy and be converted into measured structural speedups on small CPU benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究预算注意力分配机制，通过单调头门控实现单一模型在多个注意力预算下的灵活推理，在多个数据集上验证了成本-精度权衡的可行性。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型通常每个训练好的模型只有一个推理成本，但部署系统往往需要多个成本-质量的操作点。现有方法缺乏在运行时灵活调整计算成本的能力。
AI.method: 提出预算注意力分配（Budgeted Attention Allocation）机制，采用单调头门控（head-gating）设计，可根据请求的注意力预算动态调节。使用密集热启动、硬门控适配和预算化结构剪枝等技术实现。
AI.result: 在多个任务上验证有效：合成序列任务达99.7%-100%准确率；AG News上BERT-Mini达87.6%准确率（1.20x加速）；DBpedia14上达97.4%准确率（超越密集全注意力的96.6%）。静态固定预算门控和恢复的密集专精模型仍保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 单一可控检查点可在不同预算下灵活调整注意力成本以换取精度，并可在小型CPU基准上转换为实测的结构性加速。这是一项可复现的可行性研究，而非声称方法的普遍优越性。

title: UniSD: Towards a Unified Self-Distillation Framework for Large Language Models
summary: Self-distillation (SD) offers a promising path for adapting large language models (LLMs) without relying on stronger external teachers. However, SD in autoregressive LLMs remains challenging because self-generated trajectories are free-form, correctness is task-dependent, and plausible rationales can still provide unstable or unreliable supervision. Existing methods mainly examine isolated design choices, leaving their effectiveness, roles, and interactions unclear. In this paper, we propose UniSD, a unified framework to systematically study self-distillation. UniSD integrates complementary mechanisms that address supervision reliability, representation alignment, and training stability, including multi-teacher agreement, EMA teacher stabilization, token-level contrastive learning, feature matching, and divergence clipping. Across six benchmarks and six models from three model families, UniSD reveals when self-distillation improves over static imitation, which components drive the gains, and how these components interact across tasks. Guided by these insights, we construct UniSDfull, an integrated pipeline that combines complementary components and achieves the strongest overall performance, improving over the base model by +5.4 points and the strongest baseline by +2.8 points. Extensive evaluation highlights self-distillation as a practical and steerable approach for efficient LLM adaptation without stronger external teachers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniSD统一框架，系统研究LLM自蒸馏问题，通过整合多教师一致性、EMA稳定化、token级对比学习、特征匹配和散度裁剪五大机制，在6个基准6个模型上验证了各组件的有效性及其交互规律，构建的UniSDfull集成流程实现最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自蒸馏方法主要考察孤立的设计选择，其有效性、作用机制及相互作用尚不清晰；自回归LLM中的自蒸馏面临自生成轨迹自由形式、正确性任务依赖、合理Rationale可能提供不稳定或不可靠监督等挑战
AI.method: 提出了UniSD统一框架，系统整合了多教师一致性、EMA教师稳定化、token级对比学习、特征匹配和散度裁剪五大机制，分别解决监督可靠性、表示对齐和训练稳定性问题
AI.result: UniSD揭示了自蒸馏何时优于静态模仿、哪些组件驱动性能提升、以及这些组件如何在任务间相互作用
AI.conclusion: 构建了UniSDfull统一流程，在6个基准、6个模型上取得最佳整体性能，超越基线模型+5.4点、超越最强基线+2.8点，验证了自蒸馏作为高效LLM适应方法的可行性与可操控性

title: AirQualityBench: A Realistic Evaluation Benchmark for Global Air Quality Forecasting
summary: Air-quality forecasting models are commonly evaluated on regional, preprocessed, and normalized datasets, where missing observations are removed or artificially completed. Such protocols simplify comparison but hide the conditions that dominate real monitoring networks: uneven global coverage, structured missingness, heterogeneous pollutant scales, and deployment cost. We introduce \textbf{AirQualityBench}, a global multi-pollutant benchmark designed to evaluate forecasting models under these realistic conditions. The benchmark contains hourly observations from 3,720 monitoring stations over 2021--2025, covers six major pollutants, and preserves provider-native observation masks. Rather than imputing a dense data tensor, AirQualityBench exposes missingness as part of the forecasting problem and reports errors on valid future observations after inverse transformation to physical concentration scales. Evaluating representative spatio-temporal models under this unified protocol shows that strong performance on sanitized datasets does not reliably transfer to global, fragmented monitoring streams. AirQualityBench therefore serves as a realistic testbed for scalable, mask-aware, and physically interpretable air-quality forecasting. All benchmark data, code, evaluation scripts, and baseline implementations are available at \href{https://github.com/Star-Learning/AirQualityBench}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AirQualityBench——一个面向全球多污染物空气质量预测的真实评测基准。它基于 OpenAQ 原始观测构建，含 2021–2025 年全球 3,720 个常驻监测站的小时级数据，覆盖 PM2.5、PM10、O3、NO2、SO2、CO 六种污染物；核心设计是保留数据提供方原生的观测掩码（不做插值补全）、把"缺失性"当作预测问题的一部分，并在反归一化后的物理浓度尺度上仅对有效观测计算掩码化 MAE/MSE/RMSE/MAPE。作者在同一划分、掩码协议与球面 k-NN 图下统一评测 12 个时空基线，发现净化数据集上的强性能无法可靠迁移到全球碎片化监测流；D2STGNN 总体最优但代价高昂，BiST 最快却精度最差，呈现出明显的"精度–效率"权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有空气质量预测基准普遍存在三处与实际部署脱节的简化：(1) 空间范围受限——KDD Cup 2018、KnowAir、KnowAir-V2 等均局限于中国单一城市/行政区，节点规模小（184–534 站），切断了全球尺度的污染输送过程，无法检验模型在大型非均匀监测网络上的可扩展性；(2) 缺失被"净化"——通过线性插值或均值补全构造稠密张量，与真实监测系统中结构性（非随机，MNAR）缺失相悖，引入合成偏差，使模型在实验室式补全张量上表现良好却在碎片化观测流上脆弱；(3) 评价尺度缺乏物理可解释性——以无量纲归一化指标为主，掩盖了误差的环境监管与毒理学意义。作者进一步指出，问题核心并非"更大的数据集"，而是"缺乏真实的评测协议"：真实网络的关键属性（缺失观测、非均匀覆盖、污染物特异尺度、部署计算成本）恰被现有协议剔除。
AI.method: 任务形式化：监测网络表示为时空图 G=(V,E,A)，N=3,720 站、C=6 污染物，观测张量 X_t 与二值掩码 M_t；模型需学习 f_θ: R^{T×N×C}×{0,1}^{T×N×C} → R^{T'×N×C}，即从碎片化历史直接推断完整未来轨迹。数据管线：取自 OpenAQ，保留 2021-01-01 至 2025-12-31，按"至少一种污染物五年有效观测率>50%"的常驻站过滤（保留约 35% 候选站）得 3,720 站；PM2.5 活跃站最多（n=3,412），CO 最稀疏（n=1,456）；时间对齐 UTC 并做质控（剔除哨兵值、负值与物理异常值），但不做插值，保留 provider-native units（颗粒物 μg/m³，气态沿用原始单位元数据）。空间先验：基于 Haversine 球面距离（式 6）构造二值 k-NN 邻接矩阵（式 7），避免把全球网络当作平面栅格。实验协议：按时序划分 2021–2023 训练、2024 验证、2025 测试（覆盖未见完整年度气候循环）； Authentic Masking——训练与评估仅在有效观测上计算损失与指标；模型内部可归一化，但报告指标一律反变换回物理单位；对不支持缺失输入的模型，归一化后以零填充并附加掩码作为输入指示。基线覆盖图循环（DCRNN、AGCRN）、时序卷积（STGCN、GWN）、注意力/Transformer（ASTGCN、STTN、PDFormer）、解耦时空（D2STGNN、DSTAGNN）、效率导向（MAGE、BiST）与事件感知（IGSTGNN）。指标：掩码 MAE/MSE/RMSE/MAPE（MAPE 过滤 y<0.1 的原单位样本）；效率剖面报告参数量、推理时延、显存；附加消融（k 值、移除掩码、换成可学习自适应图）、5 个随机种子稳健性、按污染物细分结果、z 归一化 MAE（zMAE）与逐污染物排名，并给出各大洲站点分布与缺失率统计。
AI.result: 主表（全球聚合，物理尺度）：D2STGNN 整体最佳，MAE 5.88/6.62/6.99/7.27（6/12/18/24h），STTN、STGCN、GWN、DCRNN 紧随其后（12h MAE 约 6.56–7.64）；自适应/注意力重型模型并非占优，AGCRN、ASTGCN、BiST、IGSTGNN 明显落后（IGSTGNN 12h MAE 23.28、RMSE 101.85）。作者指出聚合值仅作排名统计，不可解读为物理同质误差，真正结论来自逐污染物 MAE：D2STGNN 在 6–18h 的 PM2.5/PM10/NO2/O3 上最优，SO2 上 STTN 最优，24h 时 GWN 反超 D2STGNN，IGSTGNN 在 CO 上 MAE 高达 235.67。消融：D2STGNN 在 k=10 时最优（MAE 6.62），k 过大性能下降；移除真实掩码使 12h MAE 从 6.62 劣化到 7.45，说明显式观测状态信息在碎片化感知下确有价值；用可学习自适应图替代固定 k-NN 图得 6.89，表明简单距离先验在全球尺度仍具竞争力；5 个种子下标准差仅 ±0.03–0.04，排名稳定。效率侧：参数量与成本不成比例——BiST 推理仅 0.60 ms、显存 31.5 MB 但精度垫底，STGCN 3.60 ms、MAGE 3.11 ms 兼顾尚可精度，而 D2STGNN 推理 70.17 ms、显存 16.56 GB 最重，AGCRN 显存 6.59 GB，ASTGCN 参数量高达 55.69 M；呈现"高精度常伴高计算负担、快模型牺牲精度"的权衡格局。数据层面：整体平均缺失率 0.41，亚洲 1,487 站/0.38、欧洲 923/0.31、北美 721/0.35、南美 312/0.52、非洲 187/0.61、大洋洲 90/0.44；配对相关性随 Haversine 距离衰减但衰减平缓，支持球面 k-NN 归纳偏置并暗示长程依赖存在；各污染物均保留清晰的日变化与季节性节律但主导节律不同。
AI.conclusion: AirQualityBench 的核心结论是：在净化、归一化、区域化协议上取得的好成绩并不能可靠迁移到全球碎片化监测流，因此评测协议本身（而非单纯的数据规模）是当前瓶颈。该基准把缺失性、污染物特异性稀疏、非均匀全球图结构与部署成本同时纳入考量，构成对时空模型的"压力测试"，要求模型具备 mask-aware、可扩展、物理可解释的能力。作者明确把该版本定位为"透明的首次发布"而非最终标准：全球聚合指标受单位混合（尤其 CO 的 provider-native 单位差异）影响不可作毒理学解读，需站点级单位审计与显式换算规则后重新生成评测；未来方向包括更可扩展的图构建、mask-aware 架构、污染物专属建模、区域分层评测轨、不确定性量化与干预/事件中心评测。数据、代码、评测脚本与基线实现均以 GitHub 开源。

title: On the Blessing of Pre-training in Weak-to-Strong Generalization
summary: The paradigm of Weak-to-Strong Generalization (W2SG) suggests that a pre-trained strong model can surpass its weak supervisor, yet the decisive role of pre-training remains theoretically and empirically under-explored. In this work, we identify pre-training as the essential prerequisite for the emergence of W2SG. Theoretically, we formalize the W2SG problem within a high-dimensional single-index model framework using spiked Gaussian data, modeling pre-training as a spectral initialization step. Building upon prior impossibility results regarding the failure of learning under random initialization, we prove that W2SG is achievable when pre-training provides a geometric warm start that places the model within an "effective region" characterized by a perturbed strong-convexity geometry. Within this region, we derive a rigorous generalization bound that naturally captures the optimization dynamics: an initial performance improvement followed by a saturation bottleneck dictated by the weak supervisor's bias. Empirically, we first validate all our assumptions and theoretical insights through controlled synthetic simulations. Finally, through a massive-scale evaluation of hundreds of intermediate pre-training checkpoints from large language models, we demonstrate that W2SG is not an innate capability but emerges via a phase transition tightly coupled with the progression of pre-training.

AI.tldr: This work establishes pre-training as the essential prerequisite for Weak-to-Strong Generalization. Through theoretical analysis in a high-dimensional single-index model and empirical validation on large language models, the authors demonstrate that W2SG emerges via a phase transition during pre-training, not as an innate capability.
AI.motivation: The role of pre-training in Weak-to-Strong Generalization remains theoretically and empirically under-explored, despite being identified as the decisive factor for W2SG emergence.
AI.method: Formalized W2SG within a high-dimensional single-index model framework using spiked Gaussian data, modeling pre-training as a spectral initialization step. The theoretical analysis identifies an "effective region" characterized by perturbed strong-convexity geometry where W2SG is achievable. Empirical validation includes controlled synthetic simulations and large-scale evaluation of hundreds of intermediate pre-training checkpoints from large language models.
AI.result: W2SG is achievable when pre-training provides a geometric warm start that places the model within an "effective region." Within this region, the generalization bound captures optimization dynamics: an initial performance improvement followed by a saturation bottleneck dictated by the weak supervisor's bias. Empirically, W2SG is not an innate capability but emerges via a phase transition tightly coupled with pre-training progression.
AI.conclusion: Pre-training is an essential prerequisite for W2SG emergence, and W2SG is not an innate capability but emerges via a phase transition tightly coupled with pre-training progression. The theoretical framework successfully bridges optimization dynamics and generalization bounds.

title: SANEmerg: An Emergent Communication Framework for Semantic-aware Agentic AI Networking
comment: Accepted at IEEE/IFIP WiOpt Workshop, Columbus, OH, USA, June 2026
summary: Future networking systems are envisioned to become part of an agentic AI-native ecosystem in which a vast number of heterogeneous and specialized AI agents cooperate seamlessly to fulfill complex user requirements in real time. However, traditional networking paradigms are characterized by a rigid decoupling of communication and computation, which often leads to significant inefficiencies in large-scale agentic AI networking (AgentNet) systems. Emergent communication offers a novel solution by enabling autonomous agents that support task-specific signaling protocols for information exchange and collaborative coordination. In this paper, we consider a multi-agent emergent communication framework, tailored for semantic-aware AgentNet systems in which the user's semantic intent can be automatically detected, inferred, and linked to a set of sub-tasks to be assigned to a set of agents. We investigate how communication and signaling protocols can emerge among collaborative agents with computationally bounded intelligence under stringent bandwidth constraints. Our proposed framework, called SANEmerg, is designed to facilitate the emergence of communication for collaborative task fulfillment while adhering to the physical limits of AgentNet. SANEmerg incorporates a bandwidth-adaptable importance-filter that dynamically prioritizes the transmission of higher-contribution message dimensions, ensuring robust performance in bandwidth-limited environments. Furthermore, SANEmerg integrates a complexity-regularizer grounded in the Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle to facilitate the emergence of computationally bounded signaling. Evaluated via an AgentNet prototype and extensive experimentation, SANEmerg demonstrates significant performance improvements over state-of-the-art solutions, achieving superior task accuracy while significantly reducing bandwidth and computational overhead.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes SANEmerg, a multi-agent emergent communication framework for semantic-aware AgentNet systems. The framework uses a bandwidth-adaptable importance-filter and MDL-based complexity-regularizer to enable efficient agent collaboration under resource constraints. Evaluation demonstrates significant improvements in task accuracy with reduced bandwidth and computational costs.
AI.motivation: Traditional networking paradigms suffer from rigid communication-computation decoupling, causing inefficiencies in large-scale AgentNet systems where heterogeneous AI agents must cooperate in real time. There's a critical need for frameworks that enable autonomous emergent communication protocols while respecting physical constraints like bandwidth and computational limits.
AI.method: SANEmerg integrates two key components: (1) a bandwidth-adaptable importance-filter that dynamically prioritizes high-contribution message dimensions, and (2) a complexity-regularizer based on Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle to constrain computational demands. The system was validated through an AgentNet prototype with extensive experimentation.
AI.result: SANEmerg significantly outperforms state-of-the-art solutions, achieving superior task accuracy while substantially reducing bandwidth consumption and computational overhead in bandwidth-limited environments.
AI.conclusion: The proposed SANEmerg framework effectively enables emergent communication among collaborative agents under bandwidth and computational constraints, achieving superior task accuracy while significantly reducing overhead. Experimental results validate the framework's practical applicability in AgentNet systems.

title: Enabling Federated Inference via Unsupervised Consensus Embedding
comment: 18 pages, 15 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (TMC) (under review)
