The non-random nature of exercise recommendations and student choices inevitably induces severe selection bias. Most existing KT methods neglect this issue, training on observed logs using standard empirical risk, which yields biased mastery estimates and accumulates errors in subsequent recommendations. To address this, we introduce a doubly robust (DR) formulation for KT that integrates a propensity model with an error imputation model, theoretically guaranteeing unbiasedness if either model is accurate. Beyond unbiasedness, in the sequential setting of KT, we identify that the estimator's performance is compromised by variance-dependent stochastic deviations that accumulate over time, thereby causing training instability and limiting performance. To mitigate this, we derive a generalization bound that explicitly characterizes the impact of estimator variance and identifies temporal smoothness as a key factor in controlling it. Building on these theoretical insights, we propose the Temporal Smoothness Doubly Robust (TSDR) framework. TSDR jointly optimizes the KT predictor and the imputation model with a smoothness regularizer, effectively reducing variance while preserving the unbiasedness guarantee of DR. Experiments on multiple real-world benchmarks demonstrate that TSDR consistently enhances various state-of-the-art KT backbones, underscoring the vital role of principled bias correction in KT.

AI.tldr: 本文针对知识追踪中的选择偏差问题，提出时序平滑双重鲁棒(TSDR)框架。该框架通过结合倾向性模型与误差填补模型构建双重鲁棒估计器，理论上保证只要任一模型准确即可获得无偏估计；并通过时序平滑正则化控制估计器方差，解决了双重鲁棒估计在序列场景下因方差累积导致的训练不稳定问题。
AI.motivation: 现有知识追踪方法忽视了个性化习题推荐和学生自主选择导致的严重选择偏差问题，直接在观察日志上用标准经验风险训练会产生有偏的掌握度估计，并在后续推荐中累积误差。
AI.method: 提出时序平滑双重鲁棒(TSDR)框架，联合优化知识追踪预测器与填补模型，引入时序平滑正则器控制估计器方差；基于反事实学习框架，集成倾向性模型与误差填补模型构建双重鲁棒估计器。
AI.result: 实验表明TSDR在多个真实世界基准数据集上一致性地提升了多种先进的知识追踪骨干模型性能。
AI.conclusion: TSDR框架通过平滑正则化有效降低了方差同时保留了双重鲁棒性的无偏性保证，在多个真实世界基准数据集上持续提升SOTA知识追踪模型的性能。

title: Selective Rollout: Mid-Trajectory Termination for Multi-Sample Agent RL
summary: Group-relative RL training (GRPO) samples a small group of parallel rollouts for every training prompt and uses their within-group reward spread to compute per-trajectory advantages. In agentic environments each rollout is a long multi-turn dialogue with one LLM call per step, so this multi-sample multiplier dominates the total training cost. When every rollout of a prompt ends with the same reward, the group has zero reward variance and contributes no gradient, so the extra rollouts add no information; such groups are common in practice (typically around 40% of all groups), so the wasted-compute fraction is substantial rather than marginal. Existing methods filter such groups at the prompt level, either after their rollouts are paid for or before any rollout begins, but both decide without using information that becomes available during the rollout itself. We instead ask whether the in-group divergence between the partial trajectories at an intermediate step can already predict that the group will be zero-variance: when the parallel rollouts have already converged on the same action prefix, the group is on track to produce a single reward, and we can stop early. We propose a one-parameter gate that stops a group when the mean pairwise prefix edit distance between its partial action sequences falls below a threshold. On a 60-iteration on-policy GRPO run on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B, averaged over four random seeds, the gated arm finishes 10.7% faster in wall-clock (bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0) and shifts held-out success rate on 50 unseen tasks by +2.5 pp, with the held-out gain tracing to a measurable reduction in zero-advantage gradient-batch dilution. Code is available at https://github.com/zhiyuanZhai20/selective-rollout.

AI.tldr: 针对GRPO训练中大量组因零奖励方差而浪费计算的问题，提出通过监控rollout过程中轨迹前缀的分歧程度来预测组方差并提前停止的简单门控方法，在保持或提升训练效果的同时显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: GRPO在agentic环境中每个prompt需采样多个并行rollout，但约40%的组最终奖励相同导致零方差，额外rollout计算完全浪费。现有方法只能在rollout完成后或开始前决定是否过滤，无法利用rollout过程中的信息。
AI.method: 采用单参数门控机制：当组内并行rollout的 action 序列前缀的均值成对编辑距离低于阈值时停止该组的rollout。实验环境为ALFWorld，使用Qwen2.5-7B模型，60次on-policy GRPO迭代，4个随机种子的平均结果。
AI.result: 门控策略使wall-clock时间减少10.7%（bootstrap 95% CI排除0），在未见任务上成功率提升2.5个百分点，且该提升源于零优势梯度批次稀释的可测量减少。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在ALFWorld环境中使训练速度提升10.7%，同时在50个未见任务上提升成功率2.5个百分点，验证了通过监控轨迹前缀分歧来预测组方差并提前停止的有效性。

title: Retrieval from Within: An Intrinsic Capability of Attention-Based Models
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically treats retrieval and generation as separate systems. We ask whether an attention-based encoder-decoder can instead retrieve directly from its own internal representations. We introduce INTRA (INTrinsic Retrieval via Attention), a framework where decoder attention queries score pre-encoded evidence chunks that are then directly reused as context for generation. By construction, INTRA unifies retrieval and generation, eliminating the retriever-generator mismatch typical of RAG pipelines. This design also amortizes context encoding by reusing precomputed encoder states across queries. On question-answering benchmarks, INTRA outperforms strong engineered retrieval pipelines on both evidence recall and end-to-end answer quality. Our results demonstrate that attention-based models already possess a retrieval mechanism that can be elicited, rather than added as an external module.

AI.tldr: INTRA 提出让预训练编码器-解码器（冻结的 T5Gemma2 4B）用自身的 decoder 交叉注意力查询直接对"预编码的证据块"打分排序，从而在一个共享表示空间内同时完成检索与生成，取代外置检索器。核心工程贡献是 Reverse-QWK（把 key 投影与 RMSNorm 尺度移到 query 侧，使所有层/头共用一份归一化编码器池）以及可学习的检索 token 与层聚合权重（仅约 164K 参数）。在 HotPotQA/2Wiki/MuSiQue/NQ 上，完整证据召回与端到端 EM/F1 在多跳任务上全面超过 TF-IDF、BM25、BGE、Qwen3-Embedding、RRF 混合与 ColBERT MaxSim 等九种基线（HotPotQA R@5 70.1 vs 54.8，EM 48.8 vs 43.4），且静态证据一次编码后可跨查询复用，使 prefill/TTFT 从二次增长降为线性（k=500 时 50× 加速），优势在 21M 块（~3B token）全量维基百科上依然保持。代价是需存储 token 级状态（10 亿 token 约 2.56 TB）及解码端略慢，且仅在编码器-解码器架构、短答案 QA 上验证。
AI.motivation: RAG 默认把检索与生成分离成两个独立系统：检索器在索引化的文本/嵌入空间里挑候选，生成器再把"检索到的文本"重新编码后回答。这种模块化带来两个隐忧：(1) 检索器与生成器训练目标不同，存在表征空间错配（retriever–generator mismatch），检索得分高不等于生成器真正需要该证据；(2) 检索得到的是原始文本，生成时必须二次编码。论文的核心观察是：注意力本身就是一种 query 条件化的匹配机制，与检索在功能上同构——因此问题变为：预训练的 encoder-decoder 是否本就内含一种检索能力，可以被"诱导出来"而非外挂一个模块？作者希望回答"模型内部能在多大程度上承担 RAG"，并主张这是注意力机制长期被当作"基于内容寻址的记忆访问"这一直觉的形式化。
AI.method:
INTRA（INTrinsic Retrieval via Attention）把检索实现为生成内部的一个前向阶段。

（1）统一表征空间：编码器一次性把语料块编码为 K(𝒮)，生成直接条件化于这些表示 y=Dec(x, K(𝒮))，而非原始文本，从而消除检索器/生成器错配。

（2）注意力即检索：将 decoder cross-attention 的查询状态 q_ℓ 视为检索 query，用 ColBERT 风格的 MaxSim 后期交互分数 s_i = MaxSim(Σ_ℓ α_ℓ q_ℓ, k_i) 对块打分，取 top-n 得到 𝒮_INTRA。注意打分覆盖全语料，因此可召回初始候选池之外的证据（不同于仅重排的 reranker）。为获得查询状态，在输入后拼接 R=64 个可学习检索 token ρ（仅取这些位置的 query 参与打分，并可池化为 P 组）。

（3）Reverse-QWK（关键工程贡献）：T5Gemma2 的 cross-attention key 依赖层级/头特定变换 k_ℓ=(RMSNorm(K)⊙γ_{K,ℓ})W_{K,ℓ}，若直接用原始编码器状态算 MaxSim 就需为每层单独计算 key，无法共用一份 ANN 索引。RQWK 将 γ 与 W_K 移到 query 侧：q̃_ℓ=(q_ℓ W_{K,ℓ}^T)⊙γ_{K,ℓ}，从而与 K̄=RMSNorm(K) 的点积在数学上恒等于原 logits，且所有层、所有 GQA 查询头共享同一份"头无关、层无关"的 d 维编码器池；等价于一个被压缩约 30× 的 cross-attention KV cache。

（4）训练目标：冻结 backbone，用带温度 τ 的交叉熵（在 oracle 块上均匀分配质量，候选集 C(x)=O(x)∪N(x) 或全语料）只训练检索 token ρ（约 164K 参数）与层/头聚合权重 α（272 参数）；生成端另做 CLaRa 数据上的 warm-start（冻结编码器，20 块上下文的答案 token 交叉熵，15K 步）。

（5）高效近似：块向量用固定长度均值池化 L_p=7 代替全 token（代价可控，质量随 L_p 单调提升），检索用 IVF-ANN（如 FAISS/cuVS）。推理两段式：先一次 retrieval pass 暴露 {q_ℓ} 对全语料打分，再以选中的预编码状态做自回归生成。
AI.result:
（1）检索质量（100M token、759K 块共享池，完整证据召回 R@k）：INTRA 在多跳任务大幅领先——HotPotQA R@5/10/20 = 70.1/78.7/84.0（次优 BGE 54.8/63.5/69.6、混合 RAG 48.0/61.8/71.2）；2Wiki 50.2/60.0/66.7（BGE 30.9/35.9/40.1）；MuSiQue 16.9/22.9/28.8；NQ 30.7/41.4/51.0（略低于 Qwen3-Emb-4B+Reranker 的 31.9/42.0/50.9，说明单跳场景优势有限）。相比"初始集重排"，全语料打分带来最大增量。

（2）端到端 QA（固定 T5Gemma2 生成器，EM/F1）：INTRA 平均 EM/F1 = 42.2/50.9，超过全部九种基线（最强基线 Qwen3-Emb-4B+Reranker 39.2/47.5）。HotPotQA 48.8/60.6（vs 混合 RAG 43.4/54.3），2Wiki 52.3/56.4，MuSiQue 13.9/23.3，NQ 53.7/63.4（略低于最强基线的 55.1/64.2）。值得注意的是 INTRA 的检索信号来自仅做过生成预训练的冻结 decoder，而 BGE/Qwen-Embedding 在含 HotPotQA、NQ 的大规模检索语料上做过监督预训练。

（3）生成器兼容性/Gap Closure：把 INTRA 检索器接到更强生成器上时，共享同一 T5Gemma2 decoder 的组合 gap closure 最高（平均 60.2%），优于 Qwen3.5-27B（58.0%）、Gemma-4-E2B（56.8%）、Mistral0.3-7B/Llama3.1-8B（55.8%）、Phi-4-mini（51.2%），说明"检索与生成同空间耦合"本身带来收益。

（4）归因分析（HotPotQA leave-one-out，7,384 题/147,680 次消融）：移除 rank-1 块使 EM 降 7.2 点、金标答案对数似然降 1.43 nats，rank 6–10 的影响可忽略；INTRA 在最高分桶上比"编码问题 MaxSim"多掉 0.045 点 EM，识别"移除后掉 >0.5 nats"块的题内 AUC 0.78 vs 0.66。按 hop 拆分：answer-bearing hop 的依赖度 +6.05 nats，bridge hop 仅 +0.16 nats；INTRA 在 answer-bearing hop recall@10 上领先基线 12.0 点、在 bridge 上落后 7.1 点，但"两跳同时召回"为 64.1% vs 54.3%。但分数在 top-k 内部的排序与答案依赖度几乎无相关（47.3%，等同随机），有效信号在于"是否进入 top-k"。

（5）效率：prefill 由 O((L_q+kL_c)²) 降为 O(L_q(L_q+kL_c))，TTFT 随 k 线性（k=1 时 33.8ms，k=500 时 156ms），对比标准 RAG（61.5ms→7.81s），加速 1.8×→50×；相对全上下文提示快 53×–243×。但解码吞吐略低（26.5 vs 28.5 tok/s），k=20 时端到端仅 0.94×，k=500 才 1.11×。若与"预计算每层 K/V 的完全缓存基线"比较，k≲8 时缓存略快，INTRA 的优势来自每查询传输状态少 27.2×（k=20 时 6.6MB vs 178MB）。

（6）规模扩展：在全量维基百科（21M 块、约 3B token，30× 于主池）上多跳任务的优势保持。

（7）消融：去掉初始 BM25 上下文 𝒮_0 影响最大（HotPotQA R@5 −29.4），P=R=1 也几乎同等有害（−31.4），MaxSim→sum 的聚合顺序更差；L_p=1→128 召回单调上升（HotPotQA 48.9→71.2），L_p=7 是成本权衡点而非质量最优点。
AI.conclusion:
论文的核心结论是概念性的：通常被外包给独立检索器的"检索能力"，可以由 encoder-decoder 在其自身表示空间内完成。INTRA 通过让 decoder 的交叉注意力承担 query-文档匹配（MaxSim 后期交互）实现了检索与生成的统一，消除了 retriever–generator 的表征错配；Reverse-QWK 使一份头无关、层无关的归一化编码器池可同时充当检索索引与 cross-attention 记忆，静态证据一次编码、跨查询复用，把 prefill/TTFT 从二次降为线性。

实证上，INTRA 在多跳 QA（HotPotQA、2Wiki、MuSiQue）上以完全证据召回和端到端 EM/F1 双双超过多种精心设计的 RAG 流水线，包括在大规模检索语料上监督预训练的稠密检索器与重排器；其优势被归因于"解码器注意力所偏好的是答案真正依赖的证据块"（而非表面相似），且这一优势在全量维基百科规模下依然成立。

局限与展望：实验限于固定上下文池与单一实现族（T5Gemma2 风格 encoder-decoder + RQWK）与短答案文本 QA，未证明可作为通用检索器或替代开放网络/web 规模 RAG；因依赖 encoder-decoder 交叉注意力，不适用于 decoder-only 模型；TTFT 测量排除了检索时间，token 级记忆显著大于压缩索引，端到端权衡可能反转；扩展到其他规模、模态、动态语料与架构留待未来工作。

title: TheraAgent: Self-Improving Therapeutic Agent for Precise and Comprehensive Treatment Planning
summary: Formulating a treatment plan is inherently a complex reasoning and refinement task rather than a simple generation problem. However, existing large language models (LLMs) mainly rely on one-shot output without explicit verification, which may result in rough, incomplete, and potentially unsafe treatment plans. To address these limitations, we propose TheraAgent, an agentic framework that replaces one-shot generation with an iterative generate-judge-refine pipeline. By mirroring the actual reasoning process of human experts who iteratively revise treatment plans, our framework progressively transforms coarse and incomplete drafts into precise, comprehensive, and safer therapeutic regimens. To facilitate the critical judge component, we introduce TheraJudge, a treatment-specific evaluation module integrated into the inference loop to enforce clinical standards. Experiments show TheraAgent achieves state-of-the-art results on HealthBench, leading in Accuracy and Completeness. In expert evaluations, it attains an 86% win rate against physicians, with superior Targeting and Harm Control. Moreover, the highly agreement between TheraJudge and HealthBench evaluations confirms the reliability of our framework.

AI.tldr: TheraAgent是一个用于治疗计划生成的智能体框架，通过迭代的生成-判断-优化管道替代一次性生成模式，并集成TheraJudge评估模块来强制临床标准。该框架在HealthBench和专家评估中均展现出卓越性能，证明了其在临床治疗计划生成中的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在治疗计划生成中存在局限性：主要依赖一次性输出而缺乏显式验证机制，导致生成的方案粗糙、不完整，甚至可能存在安全隐患，无法满足临床治疗的严格要求。
AI.method: 1. 提出TheraAgent框架，采用迭代的generate-judge-refine管道替代一次性生成模式；2. 开发TheraJudge模块，作为治疗特定评估组件集成到推理循环中以强制执行临床标准；3. 通过迭代优化机制逐步将粗略、不完整的草案转化为精确、全面、安全的治疗方案。
AI.result: TheraAgent在HealthBench上达到最优结果，在准确性和完整性方面领先；专家评估中获得86%的胜率，在靶向性和伤害控制方面表现优异；TheraJudge与HealthBench评估的高度一致性验证了框架的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: TheraAgent通过将一次性生成替换为迭代式生成-判断-优化管道，并引入TheraJudge评估模块，有效解决了现有LLM在治疗计划生成中的粗糙、不完整和不安全问题，在HealthBench上达到最优性能，并在专家评估中获得86%胜率，证明了该框架的临床应用潜力。

title: A Testable Certificate for Constant Collapse in Teacher-Guided VAEs
summary:
Posterior collapse in variational autoencoders is often diagnosed by its symptoms: a small KL term, a strong decoder, or weak use of the latent code. These signals are useful, but they do not define a collapse boundary. We study a concrete failure mode, input-independent constant collapse, and show that this case admits an exact threshold. For any fixed nonconstant teacher distribution \(T(\cdot\mid x)\), the best constant student is the dataset-average teacher distribution, and its alignment cost is the teacher mutual information \(I_T(X;T)\). Therefore, if a strictly latent-only raw witness achieves alignment loss below this value, with a safety margin, the witness cannot be constant in the input.
  This identity turns a qualitative failure mode into a measurable one. In CIFAR-100 experiments with per-seed teacher search, full training stays on the certified side of the boundary, removing alignment drives the raw witness into the constant-student regime, and restarting from a collapsed checkpoint with alignment enabled restores the certificate. Tiny-ImageNet-200 fixed-target runs show the same prevention--collapse--rescue pattern across three independently searched teachers. Standard VAE-style baselines, including methods that preserve reconstruction quality or post-hoc predictability, remain negative under the raw certificate. The guarantee is intentionally narrow: it certifies that the matched nonconstant teacher-relative variation passes through the latent pathway, rather than claiming that all forms of posterior collapse have been ruled out.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 VAE 中的 posterior collapse 问题，提出了一种可测量的诊断边界。通过建立"常数崩塌阈值"的精确数学形式，证明对齐损失需低于 teacher 互信息 I_T(X;T) 才能保证非恒定 variation 经由潜在路径传递。实验验证了该认证的有效性，并为 VAE 训练提供了可验证的保证。
AI.motivation: Variational Autoencoders (VAE) 中的 posterior collapse 问题通常通过症状来诊断：小 KL 项、强解码器或潜在代码弱使用。这些信号虽有用，但并未定义崩塌边界——即无法精确判定何时发生 posterior collapse。
AI.method: 本文研究了一种具体故障模式——输入无关的常数崩塌，并证明其存在精确阈值。核心推导：对于任意固定非恒定 teacher 分布 T(·|x)，最优常数 student 是数据集平均 teacher 分布，其对齐成本为 teacher 互信息 I_T(X;T)。基于此，当且仅当严格潜在变量 raw witness 的对齐损失低于此值（带安全裕度）时，witness 不可能为常数。这一恒等式将定性故障模式转化为可测量模式。
AI.result: CIFAR-100 实验：per-seed teacher 搜索下，完整训练保持在认证边界安全侧，移除对齐驱动 raw witness 进入常数 student 区域，从崩塌检查点重启并启用对齐可恢复认证。Tiny-ImageNet-200 固定目标运行显示三个独立搜索 teacher 的 prevention-collapse-rescue 模式一致。标准 VAE 基线方法（包括保留重构质量或后验可预测性的方法）在 raw certificate 下保持阴性。
AI.conclusion: 本文的保证范围虽较窄，但具有实际意义：证明了匹配的 teacher's distribution 相对变化必须经过潜在路径，而非声称排除了所有形式的 posterior collapse。这种可测量的边界定义为 VAE 训练提供了可验证的保证。

title: BehaviorGuard: Online Backdoor Defense for Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to deep reinforcement learning (DRL). Current defenses typically rely on reward anomalies to reverse-engineer triggers and model finetuning to remove backdoors. However, complex trigger patterns undermine their robustness, and fine-tuning entails high costs, limiting practical utility. Therefore, we shift defense concerns to trigger-agnostic backdoor output behaviors and propose BehaviorGuard, an online behavior-based backdoor detection and mitigation framework for DRL. Specifically, we find that regardless of attacks, backdoored policies induce consistent shifts in action distributions to ensure reliable activation, leaving detectable traces in high-quantile regions and distribution tails, even in the absence of triggers. Based on this, we design a novel metric that captures behavioral drift in action distributions to identify and suppress backdoor actions at runtime. To our knowledge, this is the first online backdoor defense that counters attacks both in single- and multi-agent DRL. Evaluated across diverse benchmarks with different backdoor attacks, BehaviorGuard consistently surpasses prior methods in both efficacy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BehaviorGuard，一种针对深度强化学习(DRL)的在线基于行为的后门检测与缓解框架，通过分析动作分布在高量子区域和尾部的行为漂移来识别和抑制后门，无需依赖奖励异常或模型微调，是首个同时适用于单智能体和多智能体DRL的在线后门防御方法。
AI.motivation: 现有DRL后门防御方法依赖奖励异常来逆向触发器或通过模型微调移除后门，但复杂触发模式降低方法鲁棒性，且微调带来高成本，限制实际应用。因此需要一种触发器无关的防御方法。
AI.method: 1) 发现关键规律：无论攻击方式如何，被植入后门的策略都会在动作分布上产生一致的变化以确保触发器可靠激活，在高量子区域和分布尾部留下可检测痕迹；2) 设计新颖度量指标捕获动作分布中的行为漂移；3) 在运行时识别并抑制后门动作。
AI.result: 在多种基准测试和不同后门攻击下，BehaviorGuard在功效和效率上均持续优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: BehaviorGuard是首个针对单智能体和多智能体DRL的在线后门防御框架，通过行为层面的分析而非触发器特征实现防御，具有更强的通用性和实用性。

title: HCInfer: An Efficient Inference System via Error Compensation for Resource-Constrained Devices
summary: LLMs often struggle with memory-constrained deployment on consumer-grade hardware due to their massive parameter sizes. While existing solutions such as model compression and offloading improve deployment feasibility, they often suffer from substantial accuracy degradation or severe throughput bottlenecks. Recent error compensation methods recover accuracy through auxiliary LoRA-style branches, and we observe that these branches are inherently amenable to offloading: they require substantial parameter storage but access only a small subset of compensation parameters during each inference step. Motivated by this opportunity, we propose HCInfer, a heterogeneous inference system that offloads residual compensation to the CPU while executing the compressed backbone on the GPU, and further introduces an asynchronous compensation pipeline and sensitivity-aware dynamic rank allocation to hide compensation overhead and maximize accuracy recovery. Experimental results show that HCInfer achieves a maximum accuracy improvement of 5.2% on downstream tasks compared to compression model and sustaining a maximum speedup of 10.4x compared to full-precision model.

AI.tldr: HCInfer是一种异构LLM推理系统，通过将LoRA风格的残差补偿模块卸载至CPU并将压缩主干保持在GPU上执行，结合异步管道和动态秩分配，在消费级硬件上实现了精度与效率的平衡。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型参数量巨大，在消费级硬件上部署面临内存约束挑战。现有解决方案如模型压缩和卸载虽然改善了部署可行性，但存在严重的精度损失或吞吐量瓶颈问题。
AI.method: 提出了HCInfer异构推理系统，采用异步补偿管道隐藏补偿开销，并引入敏感度感知的动态秩分配策略最大化精度恢复能力，将残差补偿模块卸载至CPU，而压缩后的主干模型保持在GPU上执行。
AI.result: 在下游任务上相比压缩模型最高提升精度5.2%，相比全精度模型最高实现10.4倍加速。
AI.conclusion: HCInfer通过将补偿计算卸载至CPU同时保持压缩主干在GPU上执行，实现了精度与效率的良好平衡，异步管道和动态秩分配策略进一步隐藏了补偿开销，为消费级硬件上的LLM部署提供了可行方案。

title: TACT: Mitigating Overthinking and Overacting in Coding Agents via Activation Steering
summary: When language model agents tackle complex software engineering tasks, they often degrade over long trajectories, which we define as *agent drift*. We focus on two recurring failure modes *overthinking* and *overacting*, i.e., where the agent repeatedly reasons over information it already has, and where it issues tool calls without integrating recent observations or acquiring new evidence. In this paper, we introduce TACT (Think-Act Calibration via activation Steering), to detect and mitigate agent drift in the residual stream before it surfaces as a behavioral failure. In specific, we label trajectory steps as overthinking, overacting, or calibrated, and find that their hidden states can separate linearly along two *drift axes*, pointing from calibrated behavior toward each failure mode (AUC $\approx$ 0.9). To mitigate agent drift, we project each step's activation onto these axes at test time and pull drifted ones back toward the calibrated region. Experiments show that TACT outperforms unsteered baselines across SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.0, and CLAW-Eval, lifting average resolve rate by $+5.8$ pp on Qwen3.5-27B and $+4.8$ pp on Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it while cutting steps-to-resolve by up to $26\%$. These gains frame agent drift as a steerable direction in the residual stream, and position TACT as a viable handle for reliable long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TACT方法，通过激活 steering 检修正大语言模型智能体在长轨迹中的性能退化问题，在多个基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体在处理复杂软件工程任务时，随轨迹增长性能下降（称为agent drift），主要表现为overthinking（重复推理已有信息）和overacting（工具调用不整合最新观测）两种失败模式。
AI.method: 通过标注轨迹步骤为overthinking、overacting或calibrated，发现隐状态沿两个"drift axes"可线性分离(AUC≈0.9)，测试时将激活投影到这些轴上，将偏离点拉回校准区域。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0和CLAW-Eval上优于基线，Qwen3.5-27B平均解决率提升+5.8pp，Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it提升+4.8pp，步骤数减少最多26%。
AI.conclusion: TACT将agent drift建模为残差流中可 steering 的方向，在测试时通过激活投影修正偏差点，为可靠的长时程智能体提供了可行方案。

title: MDN: Parallelizing Stepwise Momentum for Delta Linear Attention
summary: Linear Attention (LA) offers a promising paradigm for scaling large language models (LLMs) to long sequences by avoiding the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Recent LA models such as Mamba2 and GDN interpret linear recurrences as closed-form online stochastic gradient descent (SGD), but naive SGD updates suffer from rapid information decay and suboptimal convergence in optimization. While momentum-based optimizers provide a natural remedy, they pose challenges in simultaneously achieving training efficiency and effectiveness. To address this, we develop a chunkwise parallel algorithm for LA with a stepwise momentum rule by geometrically reordering the update coefficients. Further, from a dynamical systems perspective, we analyze the momentum-based recurrence as a second-order system that introduces complex conjugate eigenvalues. This analysis guides the design of stable gating constraints. The resulting model, Momentum DeltaNet (MDN), leverages Triton kernels to achieve comparable training throughput with competitive linear models such as Mamba2 and KDA. Extensive experiments on the 400M and 1.3B parameter models demonstrate consistent performance improvements over strong baselines, including Transformers, Mamba2 and GDN, across diverse downstream evaluation benchmarks. Code: https://github.com/HuuYuLong/MomentumDeltaNet .

AI.tldr: 本文提出Momentum DeltaNet (MDN)，通过几何重排序更新系数实现带动量的分块并行线性注意力算法，并从动力系统角度分析动量线性 recurrences，引入稳定门控约束设计。在400M和1.3B参数规模下，MDN在多种下游任务上优于Transformer、Mamba2和GDN等强基线模型。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力(LA)虽能避免自注意力的二次复杂度，但现有模型（如Mamba2、GDN）将线性 recurrences解释为朴素SGD在线更新，存在信息快速衰减和优化收敛次优的问题。动量优化器虽是自然解决方案，但在训练效率和效果上难以兼顾。
AI.method: 1. 通过几何重排序更新系数，开发带逐步动量规则的块级并行算法；2. 从动力系统视角将动量 recurrences建模为二阶系统，分析复共轭特征值；3. 基于分析结果设计稳定门控约束。
AI.result: MDN模型在训练吞吐量上与Mamba2、KDA等高效线性模型相当；在400M和1.3B参数规模下，于多种下游评测基准上取得一致的性能提升，超越Transformer、Mamba2和GDN等强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过动量机制与稳定门控约束的协同设计，MDN有效解决了线性注意力中的信息衰减问题，验证了二阶动力学分析对模型设计的指导价值，为高效长序列建模提供了新思路。

title: Hypothesis generation and updating in large language models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly help people solve problems, from debugging code to repairing machinery. This process requires generating plausible hypotheses from partial descriptions, then updating them as more information arrives. Yet how LLMs perform this form of inference, and how close it is to optimal, remains unclear. We study this question in the number game, a controlled setting in which a learner infers the hypothesis supported by a few positive integers, such as $\{16, 8, 2, 64\}$: a rule like powers of 2 or an interval like numbers near 20. We measure the posterior over hypotheses using three complementary probes: posterior prediction, hypothesis evaluation, and hypothesis generation. We then compare LLM behavior with an optimal Bayesian model and human behavior, and test whether the same posterior is expressed across probes. LLMs are often well described by a two-parameter Bayesian fit, but with systematic offsets: by default they show a strong-sampling assumption that creates an implicit Occam's razor, favoring narrower hypotheses, while thinking mode shifts them toward greater prior reliance. We also find a robust evaluation--generation gap: LLMs select more correct hypotheses during hypothesis evaluation but generate simpler, more rule-like hypotheses. Finally, this Bayesian-with-bias pattern does not extrapolate. Models can behave as if they hold rule-like hypotheses over observed examples, yet generalize poorly to parts of the hypothesis domain not covered by those examples. Our results highlight a limitation of LLMs as general problem solvers, especially for scientific inference, where hypotheses must go beyond the data.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型在假设推断任务中表现出贝叶斯式的后验分布，但伴随系统性的采样偏置，导致评估与生成之间存在差距，且无法泛化到未见假设域。
AI.motivation: LLM被广泛用于从部分描述中解决问题（如调试代码、维修设备），这一过程涉及从有限信息生成合理假设，并随新信息更新假设。然而，LLM如何执行这类推理、以及与最优推理的差距尚不清楚。这一研究问题旨在揭示LLM假设推断的能力与局限性。
AI.method: 采用三种互补探测方法测量假设后验分布：后验预测（posterior prediction）、假设评估（hypothesis evaluation）和假设生成（hypothesis generation）。在"数字游戏"这一受控环境中进行测试，给定少量正整数（如{16, 8, 2, 64}）供模型推断底层规则（如2的幂次或接近20的区间）。将LLM行为与最优贝叶斯模型及人类行为进行对比，并检验三种探测方法是否表达相同的后验分布。实验还测试了模型在不同假设域上的泛化能力。
AI.result: LLM行为通常可用双参数贝叶斯模型较好拟合，但存在系统性偏移：默认模式下表现出强采样假设倾向（隐式奥卡姆剃刀），偏向窄假设；思维模式则转向更强的先验依赖。发现存在稳健的"评估-生成差距"：LLM在假设评估中选择更正确的假设，但在生成时产生更简单、更具规则性的假设。该贝叶斯+偏置模式无法外推——模型可能对观察样本持有规则型假设，却在未被样本覆盖的假设域部分泛化能力差。
AI.conclusion: LLMs表现出一种系统性的"贝叶斯+偏置"模式：在默认模式下偏向窄假设（隐式奥卡姆剃刀），思考模式则转向更强的先验依赖。在假设评估与生成之间存在稳健的"评估-生成差距"：评估时能选中正确答案但生成时倾向简单规则型假设。更关键的是，该模式无法外推——模型可能对观察到的样本持有规则型假设，但在未覆盖的假设域上泛化能力差。这揭示了LLM作为通用问题解决器的根本局限，尤其对需要假设超越数据的科学推理构成挑战。

title: Strat-LLM: Stratified Strategy Alignment for LLM-based Stock Trading with Real-time Multi-Source Signals
comment: Accepted by the 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are evolving into autonomous trading agents, yet existing benchmarks often overlook the interplay between architectural reasoning and strategy consistency. We propose Strat-LLM, a framework grounded in Stratified Strategy Alignment. Operating in a live-forward setting throughout 2025, it integrates heterogeneous data including sequential prices, real-time news, and annual reports to eliminate look-ahead bias. Extensive stress tests on A-share and U.S. markets reveal: (1) reasoning-heavy models achieve peak utility in Free Mode via internal logic, whereas standard models require Strict Mode as a vital risk anchor; (2) alignment utility is regime-dependent, with Free and Guided modes capturing momentum in uptrending markets, while Strict Mode mitigates drawdowns in downtrends; (3) mid-scale models (35B) show optimal fidelity under strict constraints, whereas ultra-large models (122B) suffer an alignment tax under rigid rules but gain a performance premium in Guided Mode; (4) standard LLMs often fall into a high win-rate trap, optimizing for small gains at the expense of total returns, which can only be mitigated through deep reasoning or strict external guardrails. Project details are available at https://Strat-LLM.github.io.

AI.tldr: Strat-LLM 提出"分层策略对齐"评测框架：在 2025 年实盘前向（live-forward）环境下，用 T+1 滚动窗口回测融合分钟级价格、实时新闻与年报三类多源信号，驱动 LLM 在 Free/Guided/Strict 三种自主度递增的策略约束模式下交易，进而审计"模型架构—策略一致性"的交互机制。
AI.motivation: 现有金融 LLM 基准（FinBen、Pixiu 等静态知识；FinTSB、StockBench 等动态仿真）存在三大缺陷：其一，只看最终收益，忽视决策过程是否遵守预设风险规则，缺失"策略可执行性"（引用 Wallace 等指出 LLM 在指令层级上无法保证特权系统指令优先于市场噪声）；其二，缺乏行为偏差审计，标准模型易陷入"高胜率陷阱"，表现出类散户的处置效应（Disposition Effect）——过度兑现小额浮盈却无力执行止损；其三，数据污染未解决，模型可能只是记忆历史模式而非随时间动态推理。同时，现有评测将多源推理视为静态任务，无法刻画真实市场中"财报利好与技术破位"式的信号冲突与信息过载。
AI.method: 框架由三模块组成：(1) 多源数据整合模块——分钟级价格、NLP 抽取的新闻情绪与关键事件、经层次化摘要的静态年报知识库（仅含截至 T 日公开信息），融合为统一状态向量 S_T；采用双时间尺度设计（每市场 3 个约 15 交易日的短期战术窗口 + 1 个约 90 交易日的长期战略窗口），美股评估期 2025-01-01 至 06-30，A 股 2025-06-01 至 09-30，初始资金 100 万（美元/人民币），并设"现金截断"约束。(2) 分层策略脚手架引擎——基于专家策略分类 S1 短期反转、S2 突破动量（3 日新高）、S3 波动率压缩、S4 量价确认，通过提示工程实现 Free（零样本原生直觉）、Guided（S1-S4 作为可被新闻调整的参考）、Strict（必须严格遵守并在理由中引用具体策略条款）三种自主度递增模式，以解耦"推理能力"与"指令遵循能力"。(3) 动态执行与评估引擎——T+1 开盘价撮合（Action∈{-1,0,1}，扣除成本），日终更新未实现盈亏与持仓状态 H_T 回注下一日提示，指标含年化收益、Alpha、Sharpe、Sortino、最大回撤、Calmar、波动率、胜率。实验覆盖开源模型（Qwen3.5-9B/35B-A3B/122B-A10B、DeepSeek-V3.2/Reasoner/Chat、GLM-5 think 与 nothink、Kimi-K2.5 think 与 nothink、Minimax-M2.5）与闭源模型（GPT-5.4、Claude-4.5-Sonnet、Gemini-3.1-Pro），统一采样配置、相同券商与输入模态。
AI.result: (1) 市场状态依赖性：A股上行期 Free/Guided 捕捉动量（GPT-5.4 Strict MDD 由 Guided 的 20.83% 降至 11.66%），美股下行期 Strict 成为减回撤的"保险机制"。(2) 推理二分：原生思维链模型（Kimi-K2.5_think、DeepSeek-Reasoner、GLM-5_think）在 Free 模式最优（Kimi think TR 11.68%、WR 75%；DeepSeek-Reasoner Free TR 7.62%、MDD 仅 1.98%，Strict 反而降至 3.52%），标准模型（DeepSeek-Chat、Kimi/GLM nothink）失去约束即崩塌，最优在 Strict/Guided（DeepSeek-Chat Strict 7.04%），Strict 是必需的"风险锚"。(3) 规模悖论：35B 存在"中规模甜点"，Strict 下 TR 12.33%、指令保真最佳；122B 在刚性规则下承受"对齐税"，但在 Guided 下转为"对齐溢价"（TR 13.68%）。(4) 高胜率陷阱：WR 与 TR/Alpha 背离——Minimax-M2.5（Guided）WR 66.67% 但 TR 10.55%；GPT-5.4（Strict）WR 仅 54.55% 却 TR 12.31%、Alpha 17.88%；美股熊市中 GLM-5_nothink（Strict）WR 50% 而 TR −0.51%，GPT-5.4（Strict）WR 25.81% 但 TR −0.40%、Alpha 6.72%。(5) 时间尺度敏感性：90 日长期窗口显著优于 15 日短期窗口，说明 LLM 更适合战略定位而非高频战术调整。
AI.conclusion: Strat-LLM 将金融智能体评测范式从"静态盈利能力"转向"分层策略可审计性"，证明最优策略约束强度取决于模型架构与市场状态的耦合：推理型模型依赖内部逻辑取胜，标准模型必须依靠刚性外部护栏抑制下行；约 35B 参数存在中规模对齐优势，超大模型在刚性规则下被惩罚但在引导式自主中获益，挑战金融任务的传统 scaling law；暴露的处置效应类行为偏差只能通过内生 CoT 或外生 Strict 约束缓解。该工作为可信自主交易提供了基线，在无监管生成与专业合规之间架起桥梁；但样本窗口较短、资产数量有限，结果的跨市场普适性仍需更长周期的复现验证。

title: Measuring Learning Progress via Gradient-Momentum Coupling
summary: Measuring learning progress is essential for curiosity-driven exploration in reinforcement learning, but widely used signals such as prediction error often fail to distinguish meaningful, learnable patterns from random noise. This paper proposes Gradient-Momentum Coupling (GMC), a signal derived from optimization dynamics that quantifies how useful each sample's gradient is for ongoing learning by measuring its per-parameter normalized absolute product with the momentum from previous gradients. By leveraging momentum's natural filtering of noise and oscillations, GMC identifies samples that contribute to ongoing parameter updates. Controlled experiments demonstrate noise robustness and emergent curriculum learning, with the signal prioritizing tasks by learning speed rather than difficulty. Experiments on MiniGrid suggest that replacing prediction error with GMC within existing curiosity-driven architectures can improve robustness to observation noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出梯度动量耦合（GMC），利用优化动力学中的动量机制来过滤噪声，量化样本对学习的贡献，以改进强化学习中的好奇心驱动探索。与预测误差相比，GMC能更有效地区分有意义的学习模式，在MiniGrid实验中展现出更强的噪声鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 在强化学习中，测量学习进度对好奇心驱动的探索至关重要，但广泛使用的信号（如预测误差）难以区分有意义的、可学习的模式与随机噪声。
AI.method: 通过计算每个样本梯度的参数级归一化绝对乘积与先前梯度动量之间的乘积，量化每个样本对持续学习的贡献程度。
AI.result: 在受控实验中验证了噪声鲁棒性和涌现的课程学习能力，该信号按学习速度（而非难度）优先选择任务。在MiniGrid环境中，用GMC替换预测误差可提升对观测噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: GMC可作为现有好奇心驱动架构中预测误差的有效替代方案，提升对观测噪声的鲁棒性，同时自然地实现课程学习。

title: Pathways to AGI
summary: Our focus are five related questions that stem from a critical software studies perspective. Underpinning this view is the acknowledged need to avoid assumptions regarding the inevitability of the current situation relating to AI. What we need to see is the closeness of the linkage between current commercial AI development and our prevailing social, political and economic circumstances. This does mean that the perspectives presented here are done so critically and conditionally. Most importantly, Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) is seen as being problematic both conceptually and definitionally. This conditioning of any view regarding AGI does lead the discussion in specific directions and to certain conclusions regarding the future. However, adopting this perspective enables the work to offer some final recommendations. We set out to ask the following questions, 1. What are the critical pathways that produced the current dominant generative AI tools (capabilities, product forms, adoption patterns)? 2. Which decision points acted as leverage nodes (small changes that had large downstream effects), and which dead ends reveal alternative possibilities that did not become dominant? 3. How do pathways differ across three foundational-model trajectories such as the frontier proprietary models, open-weight models or specific domain and sovereign models? 4. Which alternative projects branched from key leverage nodes, what is their current state, and why did some succeed, stall, fail or become absorbed? 5. Based on this analysis, what socio-technical development programmes could plausibly move toward AGI-adjacent capability while meeting requirements for transparency, moderation, wellbeing and sustainable business models?

AI.tldr: 这篇论文从批判性软件研究视角出发，通过追溯当前生成式AI发展的关键路径、杠杆节点和替代项目，分析了三种基础模型轨迹（前沿闭源、开源权重、特定领域/主权模型）的差异，旨在为符合透明度、节制、福祉和可持续商业模式要求的AGI邻近能力开发提供建议。
AI.motivation: Adopt a critical software studies perspective to avoid assumptions about AI inevitability; examine the linkage between current commercial AI development and prevailing social, political, and economic circumstances; challenge the conceptual and definitional foundations of AGI.
AI.method: Critical software studies approach examining five key questions: (1) critical pathways producing current generative AI tools, (2) leverage nodes and dead ends in AI development history, (3) differences across frontier proprietary, open-weight, and domain/sovereign model trajectories, (4) alternative projects branched from leverage nodes, and (5) desirable socio-technical development programs.
AI.result: Not applicable (abstract only).
AI.conclusion: To offer final recommendations for socio-technical development programs toward AGI-adjacent capabilities that meet requirements for transparency, moderation, wellbeing, and sustainable business models.

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Rotation Profile Control in Tokamaks
summary: Tokamaks remain leading candidates for achieving practical fusion energy, yet many important control problems inside these devices are still difficult or unsolved. One such challenge is controlling the plasma rotation profile, which strongly influences stability, confinement, and transport. While the average rotation can be controlled, controlling the full profile is challenging due to high dimensionality, response to multiple actuators and dependence on plasma condition. Learning-based control methods, such as reinforcement learning (RL), provide a potential solution to this challenging problem with ability to model complex interactions leading to effective multi-input multi-output control. However, learning such policies is challenging due to the lack of accurate simulators that can model the rotation profile dynamics. In this work, we investigate the use of offline RL and offline model-based RL algorithms for rotation profile control, training them solely on historical data from the DIII-D tokamak. Our final method uses probabilistic models of plasma dynamics to generate rollouts for RL training. We deploy this policy on the DIII-D Tokamak and observe promising real-world results. We conclude by highlighting key challenges and insights from training and deploying an RL policy on a complex physical device while using only limited past data.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索了离线强化学习方法控制托卡马克等离子体旋转剖面的可行性，仅利用DIII-D历史数据训练，通过概率模型辅助rollouts生成，最终在实际托卡马克上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 托卡马克等离子体旋转剖面的精确控制对装置稳定性、约束和输运性能至关重要，但现有方法难以应对其高维度、多执行器耦合及时变等离子体条件的复杂特性。
AI.method: 采用离线强化学习和离线模型预测强化学习算法，仅基于DIII-D托卡马克的历史运行数据进行训练；利用概率动力学模型生成模拟rollouts以增强RL策略训练。
AI.result: 成功在DIII-D托卡马克上部署训练策略，获得有前景的真实实验结果，验证了离线数据驱动方法对旋转剖面控制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了利用历史数据通过离线强化学习和概率动力学模型实现托卡马克旋转剖面控制的可行性，为未来高级等离子体控制提供了新思路，同时识别出数据有限性、sim-to-real迁移等关键挑战。

title: Novelty-based Tree-of-Thought Search for LLM Reasoning and Planning
summary: Although advances such as chain-of-thought, tree-of-thought or reinforcement learning have improved the performance of LLMs in reasoning and planning tasks, they are still brittle and have not achieved human-level performance in many domains, and often suffer from high time and token costs. Inspired by the success of width-based search in planning, we explore how the concept of novelty can be transferred to language domains and how it can improve tree-of-thought reasoning. A tree of thoughts relies on building possible "paths" of consecutive ideas or thoughts. These are generated by repeatedly prompting an LLM. In our paper, a measurable concept of novelty is proposed that describes the uniqueness of a new node (thought) in comparison to nodes previously seen in the search tree. Novelty is estimated by prompting an LLM and making use of embedded general knowledge from pre-training. This metric can then be used to prune branches and reduce the scope of the search. Although this method introduces more prompts per state, the overall token cost can be reduced by pruning and reducing the overall tree size. This procedure is tested and compared using several benchmarks in language-based planning and general reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将宽度优先搜索中的"新颖性"概念迁移到语言领域，用于改进思维树(ToT)推理。通过LLM评估新节点相对于已访问节点的唯一性，作为剪枝指标以降低搜索成本。
AI.motivation: 尽管链式思维、树式思维和强化学习等方法提升了LLM的推理能力，但其在许多领域仍表现脆弱，未达到人类水平，且往往面临高时间和token成本问题。
AI.method: 提出一种可测量的新颖性概念，描述新节点相对于搜索树中已访问节点的唯一性；通过提示LLM并利用预训练中的嵌入式常识知识来估计新颖性；将该指标用于剪枝分支、缩小搜索范围。
AI.result: 虽然每状态引入更多提示，但通过剪枝和缩小树规模，整体token成本得以降低。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在多个语言规划和通用推理基准测试中得到验证，与现有方法相比展现出优势。

title: Do Neural Operators Forget Geometry? The Forgetting Hypothesis in Deep Operator Learning
summary:
Neural operators perform well on structured domains, yet their behaviour on irregular geometries remains poorly understood. We show that this limitation is not merely an encoding issue, but a depth-wise failure mode inherent to deep operator architectures.
  We formalise the Geometric Forgetting Hypothesis: due to the Markovian structure of operator layers and their reliance on global mixing mechanisms, neural operators progressively lose access to domain geometry as depth increases. Using layer-wise geometric probing, we demonstrate that both spectral and attention-based operators systematically lose geometric fidelity.
  We show that this geometric forgetting degrades accuracy, stability, and generalisation. To counteract it, we introduce a lightweight geometry memory injection mechanism that restores geometric constraints at intermediate depths with minimal architectural overhead. This simple intervention consistently mitigates forgetting and exposes a geometric shortcut instability in transformer-based operators, revealing that geometric retention is a structural requirement rather than a design choice.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了深度神经算子架构中普遍存在的"几何遗忘"现象：由于算子层的Markovian结构和全局混合机制依赖，神经算子随深度增加逐步丢失对域几何的访问能力。通过逐层几何探针验证了该假设，并提出轻量级几何记忆注入机制来恢复几何约束，为神经算子在不规则几何域上的应用提供了重要的结构性改进方向。
AI.motivation: 神经算子在不规则几何域上的行为尚未被充分理解，现有的神经算子架构存在根本性限制。
AI.method: 采用逐层几何探针方法，评估spectral算子和attention-based算子在各层的几何保真度；设计轻量级几何记忆注入机制，在中间深度层恢复几何约束。
AI.result: 实验证明spectral和attention-based算子均存在系统性几何遗忘；几何遗忘会损害准确性、稳定性和泛化能力；几何记忆注入机制持续有效缓解遗忘，并揭示了Transformer算子的几何快捷不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 几何保持是神经算子架构的结构性需求，而非设计选择；通过轻量级几何记忆注入可有效缓解遗忘问题，同时揭示了Transformer类算子存在的几何快捷不稳定性。

title: Visual Fingerprints for LLM Generation Comparison
comment: Submitted to the Short Paper track at IEEE VIS 2026
summary: Large language model (LLM) outputs arise from complex interactions among prompts, system instructions, model parameters, and architecture. We refer to specific configurations of these factors as generation conditions, each of which can bias outputs in various ways. Understanding how different generation conditions shape model behaviors is essential for tasks such as prompt design and model evaluation, yet it remains challenging due to the stochastic and open-ended nature of text generation. We present an approach to visually compare LLM outputs across generation conditions by modeling responses as collections of linguistic choices, including content, expression, and structure. We extract these choices using natural language processing pipelines and represent their distributions across repeated samples. We then visualize these distributions as visual fingerprints, enabling direct, distribution-level comparison of condition-specific tendencies. Through four usage scenarios, we demonstrate how visual fingerprints reveal consistent patterns in LLM behavior that are difficult to observe through individual responses or aggregate metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"视觉指纹"方法，通过将LLM输出抽象为语言选择（内容、表达、结构）的分布，实现跨生成条件的直接比较，有效揭示了LLM行为的条件特异性模式。
AI.motivation: 理解不同生成条件如何塑造模型行为对于提示设计和模型评估至关重要，但由于文本生成的随机性和开放性，这一问题仍具挑战性。生成条件包括提示、系统指令、模型参数和架构等因素的不同配置。
AI.method: 该方法将LLM输出建模为语言选择集合（包括内容、表达和结构），使用自然语言处理管道提取这些选择，并跨重复样本表示其分布，然后将这些分布可视化为"视觉指纹"，实现条件间直接比较。
AI.result: 视觉指纹方法能够揭示LLM行为中一致的模式，这些模式难以通过个体响应或聚合指标观察到。
AI.conclusion: 通过四个使用场景验证了视觉指纹方法能够揭示LLM行为中难以通过个体响应或聚合指标观察到的模式，为条件特定倾向的分布级比较提供了有效工具。

title: SOPE: Stabilizing Off-Policy Evaluation for Online RL with Prior Data
summary: Incorporating prior data into online reinforcement learning accelerates training but typically forces a difficult trade-off between high computational costs and long, multi-stage training pipelines. While fixed-length stabilization phases are significantly more computationally efficient than static update schedules, they require task-dependent manual tuning, risking either the waste of prior knowledge or severe overfitting. To address this, we propose SOPE, an algorithm that uses an actor-aligned Off-Policy Policy Evaluation (OPE) signal as an automated early-stopping mechanism to dynamically control the length of offline training phases. By evaluating the critic on a held-out validation split under the current policy's action distribution, SOPE halts gradient updates exactly when out-of-distribution benefits saturate, eliminating the need for manual schedule tuning. Evaluated on 25 continuous control tasks from the Minari benchmark suite, SOPE improves baseline performance by up to 45.6% while reducing the required TFLOPs by up to 22x, thus balancing the tradeoff between sample and computational efficiency. These findings demonstrate that adaptive, evaluation-driven update schedules are more effective than relying on static, exhaustive update schedules.

AI.tldr: SOPE是一种通过离策略策略评估信号自动控制离线训练长度的强化学习算法，无需人工调优即可在保持性能的同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 将先验数据融入在线强化学习虽能加速训练，但存在计算成本高与多阶段训练流程复杂的矛盾。固定长度稳定阶段虽计算效率高，但需要任务相关的手动调优，存在先验知识浪费或严重过拟合的风险。
AI.method: SOPE算法：利用演员对齐的离策略策略评估（OPE）信号作为自动化早停机制，通过在当前策略动作分布下对验证集评估评论家，动态控制离线训练阶段长度，当离分布收益饱和时立即停止梯度更新。
AI.result: 在Minari基准套件的25个连续控制任务上，SOPE相比基线提升高达45.6%，同时将所需TFLOPs降低高达22倍，显著平衡了样本效率与计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 自适应评估驱动的更新调度比静态穷举更新调度更有效，SOPE在保持性能的同时大幅降低计算成本，为离线强化学习中的训练调度提供了一种无需人工干预的解决方案。

title: QuadraSHAP: Stable and Scalable Shapley Values for Product Games via Gauss-Legendre Quadrature
summary: We study the efficient computation of Shapley values for \emph{product games} -- cooperative games in which the coalition value factorizes as a product of per-player terms. Such games arise in machine learning explainability whenever the value function inherits a multiplicative structure from the underlying model, as in kernel methods with product kernels and tree-based models. Our key result is that the Shapley value of each player in a product game admits an exact one-dimensional integral representation: the weighted sum over exponentially many feature coalitions collapses to the integral of a degree-$(d-1)$ polynomial over $[0,1]$, where $d$ is the total number of features. This yields a Gauss--Legendre quadrature scheme that is \emph{provably exact} whenever the number of nodes satisfies $m_q \geq \lceil d/2 \rceil$, and otherwise provides a \emph{near-exact} approximation with error provably decaying geometrically in $m_q$. In practice, a few hundred nodes can achieve highly precise estimates even with thousands of features. Building on this formulation, we derive a numerically stable implementation via log-space evaluation, together with an efficient parallel implementation based on associative scan primitives that achieves $O(d\,m_q)$ total work and $O(\log d)$ parallel time. Experiments show that \textsc{QuadraSHAP} is the fastest numerically stable method across all tested configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究乘积博弈（product games）中Shapley值的高效计算问题。核心发现是指数级多的特征联盟加权和可坍缩为[0,1]区间上d-1次多项式的积分，通过Gauss-Legendre求积方案实现精确或近似计算，并提出名为QuadraSHAP的快速数值稳定实现。
AI.motivation: Shapley值是合作博弈论中公平分配的核心工具，但在高维特征空间（数千特征）中计算复杂度呈指数级，导致在机器学习可解释性场景中实际不可用。现有方法需在精确性与效率间妥协。
AI.method: (1) 将Shapley值从指数复杂度的特征联盟求和转换为d-1次多项式在[0,1]区间的单重积分表示；(2) 采用Gauss-Legendre求积方案，当节点数m_q ≥ ⌈d/2⌉时保证精确计算，否则提供几何收敛的近似；(3) 通过对数空间求值实现数值稳定性；(4) 基于关联扫描原语实现并行化。
AI.result: 理论保证：当m_q ≥ ⌈d/2⌉时精确计算；其他情况误差呈几何级数衰减。实际应用：数百个节点即可在数千特征规模下获得高精度估计。性能：总工作量O(d·m_q)，并行时间O(log d)，是当前所有测试配置中最快的数值稳定方法。
AI.conclusion: QuadraSHAP通过将高维组合问题转化为低维积分问题，实现了Shapley值在产品博弈中的高效可靠计算，为核方法、树模型等具有乘积结构的机器学习模型提供了实用的可解释性工具。

title: Safety Certification is Classification
summary: The goal of this paper is certifying safety of dynamical systems subject to uncertainty. Existing approaches use trajectory data to estimate transition probabilities, and compute safety probabilities recursively via dynamic programming (DP). This recursion may lead to compounding errors in the certified safety probability, thus collapsing to a vacuous lower bound for growing horizons $T$. We propose a kernel embedding framework that treats safety certification as a classification problem on trajectory data, directly estimating the $T$-step safety probability without recursion. We show that the framework subsumes well-established approaches from the literature (e.g., barrier certificates, robust Markov models) as special cases, and allows us to go beyond their limitations. As the main consequence, it bypasses compounding error across the horizon and enables certification for systems with non-Markovian dynamics. We demonstrate that direct estimators remain stable independent of the certification horizon and in the non-Markovian setting, whilst DP-based certificates silently go unsound -- confirmed in simulation on a neural-controlled quadrotor.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于核嵌入的安全认证框架，将安全认证问题重新表述为轨迹数据上的分类问题，直接估计T步安全概率，避免了动态规划递归带来的误差累积问题。该方法涵盖了屏障证书、鲁棒马尔可夫模型等现有方法，并能处理非马尔可夫动力学系统。实验验证了在长时域和非马尔可夫场景下，直接估计器保持稳定，而基于DP的认证方法会失效。
AI.motivation: Existing DP-based approaches for certifying safety of dynamical systems under uncertainty suffer from compounding errors when estimating transition probabilities via trajectory data. These errors accumulate through dynamic programming recursion, causing the certified safety probability to collapse to vacuous lower bounds as the horizon T grows.
AI.method: The authors propose a kernel embedding framework that reformulates safety certification as a classification problem on trajectory data. This approach directly estimates T-step safety probability rather than computing it recursively. The framework generalizes existing methods (barrier certificates, robust Markov models) as special cases.
AI.result: The kernel embedding approach bypasses compounding errors across horizons and enables safety certification for systems with non-Markovian dynamics. Direct estimators remain stable independent of certification horizon and in non-Markovian settings.
AI.conclusion: The proposed kernel embedding framework directly estimates T-step safety probability without recursion, bypassing compounding errors and enabling certification for non-Markovian dynamics. Experiments on a neural-controlled quadrotor demonstrate that direct estimators remain stable regardless of horizon and in non-Markovian settings, while DP-based certificates become unsound.

title: Retain-Neutral Surrogates for Min-Max Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of designated training data while preserving performance on the remaining data. Approximate unlearning can be viewed as a local editing problem; in min-max unlearning, the key local object is the surrogate point at which the retain objective is evaluated. When forget and retain gradients are strongly aligned, an unconstrained forget-maximizing perturbation can move to a surrogate point that increases retain loss. We propose Retain-Orthogonal Surrogate Unlearning (ROSU), which constrains the inner surrogate construction by maximizing first-order forget gain subject to zero first-order retain change under a fixed perturbation budget. This yields a closed-form retain-orthogonal perturbation, a lightweight transported outer update, and amplification along the retain-neutral direction. Our analysis establishes (i) a curvature-controlled second-order bound on retain damage, (ii) a positive-alignment regime in which ROSU strictly reduces surrogate retain loss relative to standard min-max perturbations, and (iii) near-equivalence when the two gradients are nearly orthogonal. Across vision and language benchmarks (CIFAR-10/100, Tiny-ImageNet, TOFU, WMDP), the empirical pattern follows this geometry: ROSU gives its clearest gains in high-coupling regimes while remaining competitive elsewhere.

AI.tldr: ROSU proposes a geometry-aware unlearning approach that orthogonally constrains the surrogate perturbation to preserve retain loss. By ensuring zero first-order impact on retain while maximizing forget gain, the method provides theoretical guarantees on retain damage and demonstrates empirical improvements across vision and language benchmarks, particularly in high-gradient-alignment scenarios.
AI.motivation: Current min-max unlearning approaches face a critical issue: when forget and retain gradients are strongly aligned, an unconstrained forget-maximizing perturbation can move to a surrogate point that inadvertently increases retain loss. This creates a fundamental tension between maximizing forget utility and preserving retain performance.
AI.method: ROSU constrains the inner surrogate construction by maximizing first-order forget gain while ensuring zero first-order retain change under a fixed perturbation budget. This produces a closed-form retain-orthogonal perturbation, a lightweight transported outer update, and amplification along the retain-neutral direction. The key insight is to decompose the perturbation space into directions aligned with and orthogonal to the retain gradient.
AI.result: ROSU achieves better retain loss preservation in high-coupling regimes where gradients align strongly, while remaining competitive in low-coupling scenarios. The geometry-based analysis provides a clear prediction: the method's advantage is proportional to the coupling between forget and retain objectives.
AI.conclusion: The analysis establishes three theoretical guarantees: (i) curvature-controlled second-order bound on retain damage, (ii) positive-alignment regime where ROSU strictly reduces surrogate retain loss relative to standard min-max perturbations, and (iii) near-equivalence when gradients are nearly orthogonal. Empirical validation across vision and language benchmarks confirms the geometry-driven advantage, with clearest gains in high-coupling regimes.

title: Shallow Prefill, Deep Decoding: Efficient Long-Context Inference via Layer-Asymmetric KV Visibility
summary: Long-context inference in decoder-only language models is costly because long prompts are processed during Prefill, cached at every layer, and repeatedly attended to during autoregressive Decode. We introduce \emph{Shallow Prefill, dEEp Decode} (SPEED), a phase-asymmetric KV-visibility policy that materializes non-anchor prompt-token KV states only in lower layers while keeping Decode-phase tokens full-depth. Unlike previous approaches that make upper-layer prompt KV states cheaper to store or construct, SPEED removes prefill tokens from the upper-layer Decode visibility set altogether. With a minimal BoS anchor, this simple change preserves broad benchmark quality while reducing long-context cost. In a controlled Llama-3.1-8B instruction-tuning study, SPEED using only 75\% of layers for prefill tokens reaches 51.2 average score on OLMES-style benchmarks, compared with 51.4 for the full-depth baseline, while improving TTFT by 33\%, TPOT by 22\%, and reducing active KV memory by 25.0\% at 128K context. Layer-wise diagnostics suggest that this cutoff retains the main prompt-selection and representation-stabilization regions of the full-depth model. These results show that long-context prompt tokens need not always persist as full-depth KV-cache objects when Decode-phase tokens remain full-depth.

AI.tldr: SPEED通过在浅层保留预填充令牌KV状态、深层仅保留解码令牌的全深度可见性，在保持性能（51.2 vs 51.4基线）的同时，显著降低延迟（TTFT 33%、TPOT 22%）和内存开销（128K上下文下KV内存减少25%）。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理成本高昂，因为提示令牌在Prefill阶段被处理、在每层缓存、并在Decode阶段被反复注意力访问。
AI.method: SPEED：一种相不对称的KV可见性策略，仅在较低层实现预填充令牌KV状态物化，将预填充令牌从上层Decode可见性集合中完全移除。
AI.result: 使用75%层处理预填充令牌达到51.2平均分（基线51.4），TTFT改善33%，TPOT改善22%，128K上下文下活跃KV内存减少25%。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文提示令牌无需始终作为全深度KV-cache对象持久化，当Decode令牌保持全深度时即可。

title: RepFlow: Representation Enhanced Flow Matching for Causal Effect Estimation
summary:
Estimating causal effects from observational data has become increasingly critical in diverse fields including healthcare, economics, and social policy. The fundamental challenge in causal inference arises from the missing counterfactuals and the selection bias. Existing methods are largely limited to point estimates and lack the capacity for distribution modeling. In this work, we propose RepFlow, a novel framework that formulates causal effect estimation as a joint optimization problem integrating representation learning with Conditional Flow Matching (CFM).
  RepFlow mitigates selection bias by minimizing the entropically regularized Wasserstein distance between treated and control representations.
  To enhance numerical stability, we further introduce an $L_2$ normalization constraint on latent representations.
  This balanced representation enables the flow model to accurately capture the distribution of potential outcomes. Extensive experiments across a wide range of benchmarks demonstrate that RepFlow consistently outperforms existing methods in both point and distributional causal effect estimation.

AI.tldr: RepFlow是一种新型因果效应估计框架，通过将表示学习与条件流匹配相结合来联合建模潜在结果分布。该方法利用熵正则化Wasserstein距离缓解选择偏差，并引入L2归一化约束增强数值稳定性，在点估计和分布估计两个层面均表现出色。
AI.motivation: 因果推断面临两个根本性挑战：反事实的缺失和选择偏差。现有方法大多局限于点估计，缺乏分布建模能力，无法全面刻画潜在结果的不确定性。
AI.method: RepFlow将因果效应估计表述为联合优化问题，融合了表示学习和条件流匹配(CFM)。其核心策略包括：(1) 通过最小化处理组与对照组表示之间的熵正则化Wasserstein距离来缓解选择偏差；(2) 引入L2归一化约束以增强数值稳定性；(3) 利用平衡的表示使流模型能够准确捕捉潜在结果的分布。
AI.result: 在多种基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，RepFlow在点估计和分布因果效应估计两个维度上均一致性地优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: RepFlow通过将表示学习与条件流匹配相结合，成功解决了观察性数据中因果效应估计的核心挑战。该方法通过最小化熵正则化Wasserstein距离来缓解选择偏差，并通过L2归一化约束增强数值稳定性。实验表明，该方法在点估计和分布因果效应估计两方面均实现了最先进的性能。

title: Near-Policy: Accelerating On-Policy Distillation via Asynchronous Generation and Selective Packing
summary: Standard knowledge distillation for autoregressive models often suffers from distribution mismatch. While on-policy methods mitigate this by leveraging student-generated outputs, they rely on computationally expensive Reinforcement Learning (RL) frameworks. To improve efficiency, we propose Near-Policy Distillation (NPD), an asynchronous approach that decouples student generation from training. This reformulation enables Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with sequence packing. However, asynchronous updates inevitably introduce policy lag and sample noise, which can cause the behavior to drift from near-policy toward off-policy. To counteract this without sacrificing efficiency, NPD integrates sparse student updates and the $Δ$-IFD filtering mechanism, a heuristic sample selection mechanism that empirically stabilizes the optimization trajectory. By filtering extreme out-of-distribution samples, $Δ$-IFD prevents noise from dominating the gradients, ensuring updates remain within a safe proximal learning zone. Empirically, the NPD framework achieves a 8.1x speedup over on-policy baselines and outperforms SFT by 8.09%. Crucially, by effectively narrowing the exploration space for subsequent RL, our method enables openPangu-Embedded-1B to reach a state-of-the-art score of 68.73%, outperforming the substantially larger Qwen3-1.7B. Codes will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NPD框架，通过异步设计+稀疏更新+Δ-IFD过滤机制，在保持近策略稳定性的同时大幅提升知识蒸馏效率，显著优于传统SFT和on-policy方法，并以更小模型超越更大模型达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 传统知识蒸馏存在分布不匹配问题；现有on-policy方法虽能缓解该问题，但依赖计算密集的强化学习框架，效率较低。
AI.method: 提出Near-Policy Distillation (NPD)框架，采用异步架构将学生模型生成与训练解耦，支持序列打包的SFT；通过稀疏学生更新策略减少策略滞后；引入Δ-IFD过滤机制筛选极端分布外样本，使梯度更新保持在近策略的安全邻域内。
AI.result: 相比on-policy基线实现8.1倍加速；相比SFT提升8.09%；openPangu-Embedded-1B达到68.73%的最新水平，优于参数量更大的Qwen3-1.7B。
AI.conclusion: NPD框架通过异步设计有效平衡了效率与稳定性，8.1x加速证明了其工程可行性；openPangu-Embedded-1B超越Qwen3-1.7B表明该方法具有可扩展性；该方法为后续RL阶段提供了更好的起点，具有持续迭代的潜力。

title: On Time, Within Budget: Constraint-Driven Online Resource Allocation for Agentic Workflows
summary: Agentic systems increasingly solve complex user requests by executing orchestrated workflows, where subtasks are assigned to specialized models or tools and coordinated according to their dependencies. While recent work improves agent efficiency by optimizing the performance--cost--latency frontier, real deployments often impose concrete requirements: a workflow must be completed within a specified budget and before a specified deadline. This shifts the goal from average efficiency optimization to maximizing the probability that the entire workflow completes successfully under explicit budget and deadline constraints. We study \emph{constraint-driven online resource allocation for agentic workflows}. Given a dependency-structured workflow and estimates of success rates and generation lengths for each subtask--model pair, the executor allocates models and parallel samples across simultaneously executable subtasks while managing the remaining budget and time. We formulate this setting as a finite-horizon stochastic online allocation problem and propose \emph{Monte Carlo Portfolio Planning} (MCPP), a lightweight closed-loop planner that directly estimates constrained completion probability through simulated workflow executions and replans after observed outcomes. Experiments on CodeFlow and ProofFlow demonstrate that MCPP consistently improves constrained completion probability over strong baselines across a wide range of budget--deadline constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究智能体工作流在预算和时间限制下的资源分配问题，提出MCPP方法，通过蒙特卡洛模拟估计约束下完成概率，在CodeFlow和ProofFlow上验证了其在多种约束条件下提升工作流成功完成率的能力。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统通过编排工作流解决复杂任务，但现有研究聚焦于平均效率优化，忽视实际部署中的明确约束：预算限制和时间期限。这需要从追求平均最优转向最大化在给定约束下的成功完成概率。
AI.method: 将问题建模为有限时域随机在线分配问题，提出Monte Carlo Portfolio Planning (MCPP)方法——一种轻量级闭环规划器，通过模拟工作流执行直接估计约束完成概率，并根据观察结果动态重规划。
AI.result: 在CodeFlow和ProofFlow基准上的实验表明，MCPP在广泛的预算-期限约束组合下，持续优于强基线方法，显著提升约束完成概率。
AI.conclusion: MCPP为智能体工作流提供了一种有效的约束驱动资源分配方案，能够在有限预算和时间下最大化工作流成功完成的可能性。

title: VARS-FL: Validation-Aligned Client Selection for Non-IID Federated Learning in IoT Systems
summary: Federated learning (FL) systems typically employ stateless client selection, treating each communication round independently and ignoring accumulated evidence of client contribution quality. Under non-IID data, this leads to slow convergence and unstable training, particularly when selection relies on local proxies (e.g., training loss) that are misaligned with the global optimization objective. These challenges are especially pronounced in Internet of Things (IoT) and Industrial IoT (IIoT) environments, where data is highly heterogeneous and distributed across devices observing different traffic patterns. In this paper, we propose VARS-FL (Validation-Aligned Reputation Scoring for Federated Learning), a client selection framework that quantifies each client's contribution using the reduction in server-side validation loss induced by its update. These per-round signals are aggregated into a Reputation score that combines a sliding-window average of recent contributions with a logarithmically scaled participation term, enabling robust exploration-exploitation selection. VARS-FL requires no changes to local training or aggregation and remains fully compatible with standard FedAvg. We evaluate VARS-FL on a 15-class non-IID IoT intrusion detection task using the Edge-IIoTset dataset, with 100 clients across multiple seeds, and compare it against FedAvg, Oort, and Power-of-Choice. VARS-FL consistently improves accuracy, F1-Macro, and loss, while accelerating convergence (up to 36% fewer rounds to reach 80% accuracy). These results demonstrate that validation-aligned, history-aware client selection provides a more reliable and efficient training process for federated learning in heterogeneous IoT environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VARS-FL（Validation-Aligned Reputation Scoring for Federated Learning），一种面向 IoT/IIoT 场景非独立同分布（non-IID）联邦学习的客户端选择框架。其核心思想是：不再使用本地代理指标（如训练损失）来估计客户端效用，而是用"服务端验证集损失下降量"直接度量每个客户端更新对全局目标的贡献，并将其累积为带滑动窗口的信誉分（Reputation），再通过多臂老虎机式的"利用+探索"策略完成每轮客户端采样。该方法无需修改本地训练与聚合流程，与标准 FedAvg 完全兼容，且不增加客户端通信开销。在 Edge-IIoTset（15 类、100 客户端、3 个随机种子、100 轮）任务上，相比 FedAvg、Oort、Power-of-Choice，VARS-FL 在准确率、F1-Macro、加权 F1 上均取得最佳均值，损失最低且跨种子方差最小，达到 80% 准确率所需轮数最多减少 36%。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中的客户端选择存在两个耦合缺陷：(1) 无状态性（statelessness）——FedAvg 等方法每轮独立随机采样，不利用客户端历史贡献证据；在 100 客户端、10% 参与率下，持有稀有类别的"关键客户端"每轮仅约 10% 概率被选中，导致训练低效且全局类别覆盖不足。(2) 目标错位（objective misalignment）——Oort、Power-of-Choice 等基于本地损失/梯度范数的代理信号，反映的是客户端本地分布而非全局分布；non-IID 下高本地损失可能仅意味着全局模型对其分布不适配，优先选择这类客户端会使全局模型被带偏，且误差跨轮累积。论文引用的实证表明 Oort 在多个随机种子下出现持续精度震荡、100 轮内无法达到 80% 准确率。这一问题在 IoT/IIoT 入侵检测场景中尤为突出：设备只观测到各自有限的攻击类型（如 SCADA 传感器多见 Ransomware/Backdoor，网关节点多见 DDoS），数据高度异质且类别极度不平衡。已有工作（FedProx/SCAFFOLD/MOON）侧重优化层面的漂移缓解，FLTrust 侧重对抗鲁棒性，均未同时解决"目标对齐"与"历史累积"的客户端选择问题。
AI.method:
1) 数据与模型：Edge-IIoTset 原始 63 维特征中剔除 19 个非数值协议字段（IP/URI/MQTT 载荷/端口等），保留 43 维数值特征；Normal 类上限截断至 18%（原 72.8%），得到 736,046 样本、15 类；70/15/15 划分为训练/验证/测试（515,232/110,407/110,407）；训练集按异质 non-IID 方案切分至 100 客户端，单客户端样本 426~5,152（均值 3,250），本地类别数 1~15（均值 7.9）。模型为 3 隐层全连接 DNN（128-64-32，ReLU，前两层 Dropout 0.3，15 类 softmax），共 16,463 参数；Adam，lr=1e-3，batch 256，E=3 本地轮。

2) 验证损失改进量（核心信号）：δ_i^t = max(0, L_val(θ^{t-1}) − L_val(θ_i^t))，即"应用该客户端更新前后的验证损失差"，负贡献记为 0；轮内归一化 Q_i^t = max(ε, δ_i^t/(max_j δ_j^t + ζ))，ε 保证探索下限，ζ 保证数值稳定。

3) 信誉分：R_i^t = Q̄_i^(t) · log(1 + p_i^t)，其中 Q̄ 为最近 W=5 次质量分的滑动窗口均值，p_i 为参与计数；对数项使频繁参与收益递减，避免"仅凭参与频率"取胜。滑窗设计被解释为非平稳 bandit 估计量。

4) 选择策略（Algorithm 2）：前 T0=15 轮冷启动阶段均匀随机采样；之后 m_rep = ⌊(1−ρ)m⌋ 个名额取信誉分 top-m_rep（利用），剩余 m_rnd = m − m_rep 个名额从其余客户端均匀随机抽取（探索），ρ=0.3。

5) 聚合：完全使用标准 FedAvg（按样本量加权），信誉分不参与聚合权重，保证协议兼容；客户端只上传模型参数，不上报任何额外统计量，所有打分与选择计算均在服务端完成。复杂度：额外服务端开销 O(m·|D_val|·C_fwd) 且与客户端总数 N 无关（当前配置约 1.79×10^10 MACs/轮），存储 O(N·W)（100 客户端仅 500 个浮点数）。

6) 消融：验证集组成鲁棒性实验——将分层验证集（110,407）替换为每类 150 样本的均匀平衡验证集（2,250），其余配置不变。
AI.result: 整体性能（100 客户端、100 轮、种子 7/42/123 均值±标准差）：VARS-FL 全面最优——Accuracy 0.8185±0.0040（vs FedAvg 0.7671±0.0422，+0.0514）、F1-Macro 0.6422±0.0241（vs 0.5565，+0.0857）、F1-Weighted 0.8086±0.0080（+0.0584）、Precision 0.8026±0.0392（+0.0745）、Loss 0.4937±0.0200（−0.0916）；对照组中 Oort 波动最大（Accuracy 0.6866±0.1043、Loss 0.8118±0.2257），PoC 居中（0.7925、0.5928）。收敛速度：75% 阈值下 VARS-FL 分别需 16/20/18 轮，相对 FedAvg 加速约 ×1.9/×1.4/×1.8，且在每个种子上均快于 PoC；80% 阈值下 VARS-FL 是唯一在三个种子上均能达标的方法（63/60/58 轮，最多少 36%），FedAvg 在种子 42、123 未达标、Oort 三种子全部失败、PoC 需 93/67 轮。训练动态：前 15 轮冷启动阶段各方法速率相近，约第 20 轮起 VARS-FL 损失持续低于所有基线，第 100 轮为 0.489（FedAvg 0.568、PoC 0.563、Oort 0.778）；相对 FedAvg 的逐轮精度差值在全部 100 轮中基本为正，而 Oort 在第 50 轮后转负并伴随高频大幅震荡，印证"本地损失偏置导致方向错位"。类别级召回（种子 42）：FedAvg 召回率低于 0.50 的六个类别在 VARS-FL 下全部提升（+0.056 至 +0.519，Port_Scanning 0.4059→0.9253、Ransomware 0.3862→0.6370、Fingerprinting 0.1000→0.2267）；Oort 虽在部分类极高（Uploading 0.8439）但出现单类崩塌（Backdoor 0.000、DDoS_TCP 0.1557）；VARS-FL 唯一显著回退为 Backdoor（−0.110），原因是已易分类客户端的 δ 较小、信誉分偏低。验证集鲁棒性：分层集与均匀集之间所有指标变化均 <1 个百分点（Accuracy −0.24pp，F1-Macro −0.48pp，Loss −0.0049），且均匀集下方差下降（0.0200→0.0136）；作者解释为 δ 定义为同一验证集上两次损失之"差"，分布偏置在相减中大部分抵消，仅保留相对排序信息。
AI.conclusion: VARS-FL 将联邦学习客户端选择重新定义为"目标对齐、证据驱动"的过程：用服务端验证损失下降量这一与全局优化目标天然一致的信号替代本地代理指标，并以滑动窗口 + 对数参与项的信誉机制跨轮累积证据，再由混合利用-探索的 bandit 策略完成采样。实验证明其在高度异质的 IoT 入侵检测任务上同时提升最终精度、类别均衡泛化能力与收敛速度，并显著降低跨种子方差，且不增加任何客户端通信开销，对验证集的类别组成不敏感，因而适合真实 IIoT 部署（只需数千条独立采集的平衡验证样本）。作者也明确指出的局限是依赖服务端验证集：未在验证集中出现的类别会被系统性低估，未来的覆盖感知打分、收敛性理论保证与自适应信誉机制是自然的后续方向。整体而言，该工作定位清晰（首个同时具备"全局对齐 + 历史感知 + IoT 安全评测"的客户端选择框架），创新点在于信号定义的替换与轻量级的信誉聚合，工程部署成本低，但理论分析与更大规模/更多数据集上的外部效度仍有待补充。

title: CrossCult-KIBench: A Benchmark for Cross-Cultural Knowledge Insertion in MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), trained primarily on English-centric data, frequently generate culturally inappropriate or misaligned responses in cross-cultural settings. To mitigate this, we introduce the task of cross-cultural knowledge insertion, which focuses on adapting models to specific cultural contexts while preserving their original behavior in other cultures. To facilitate research in this area, we introduce CrossCult-KIBench, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for assessing both the effectiveness of knowledge insertion and its unintended side effects on non-target cultures. The benchmark includes 9,800 image-grounded cases covering 49 culturally relevant visual scenarios across English, Chinese, and Arabic language-culture groups. It supports evaluation in both single-insert and sequential-insert settings. We also propose Memory-Conditioned Knowledge Insertion (MCKI) as a baseline method. MCKI retrieves relevant cultural knowledge from an external memory using frozen MLLM representations, prepending matched entries as conditional prompts when applicable. Extensive experiments on CrossCult-KIBench reveal that current approaches struggle to balance effective cultural adaptation with behavioral preservation, highlighting a key challenge in developing culturally-aware MLLMs. Our work thus underscores an important research direction for developing more culturally adaptive and responsible MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态大语言模型在跨文化场景中的文化错位问题，提出跨文化知识插入任务及CrossCult-KIBench评估基准（含9,800个案例，覆盖49个文化视觉场景，支持英语、中文、阿拉伯语），并引入MCKI基线方法。实验表明现有方法难以平衡文化适应与行为保持。
AI.motivation: 当前MLLM主要在英语中心数据上训练，在跨文化场景中经常产生文化不当或错位的响应，需要在保持模型在非目标文化中原有行为的同时，适应特定文化上下文
AI.method: 提出Memory-Conditioned Knowledge Insertion (MCKI)方法，从外部记忆库中检索相关文化知识，使用冻结的MLLM表示进行检索，并将匹配条目作为条件提示进行添加
AI.result: 当前方法难以在有效文化适应与行为保持之间取得平衡，揭示了开发文化感知MLLM的关键挑战
AI.conclusion: 开发更文化适应性且负责任的MLLM的重要研究方向

title: VisMMOE: Exploiting Visual-Expert Affinity for Efficient Visual-Language MoE Offloading
summary: Large-scale vision-language mixture-of-experts (VL-MoE) models provide strong multimodal capability, but efficient deployment on memory-constrained platforms remains difficult. Existing MoE offloading systems are largely designed for text-centric workloads and become much less effective for visual-heavy inputs, where large numbers of visual tokens induce broader and less predictable expert accesses. We present VisMMoE, a VL-MoE offloading system built on a single systems insight: pruning redundant visual tokens can improve offloading not only by reducing computation, but also by reshaping expert demand. We refer to this effect as \textit{visual-expert affinity}: token pruning makes expert accesses more concentrated within layers and more stable across layers, producing a smaller and more predictable expert working set. Guided by this insight, VisMMoE combines affinity-aware token compression, lookahead expert prediction, and cache/pipeline orchestration to improve expert locality and prefetch effectiveness under tight memory budgets. We implement VisMMoE on multiple frameworks and evaluate it on representative VL-MoE models and benchmarks. VisMMoE improves end-to-end inference performance by up to 2.68x and 1.61x, respectively, over strong baselines for today's VL-MoE deployments while maintaining competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VisMMoE，一种针对视觉-语言MoE模型的卸载系统。核心洞察是：剪枝冗余视觉token不仅能减少计算，还能通过重塑专家需求来改善卸载效果（视觉-专家亲和性）。该方法结合亲和性感知token压缩、前瞻专家预测和缓存/流水线编排，在内存受限场景下显著提升推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE卸载系统主要针对文本中心工作负载设计，在处理视觉密集型输入时效果显著下降。原因在于大量视觉token导致更广泛且不可预测的专家访问模式，给内存受限平台的高效部署带来挑战。
AI.method: VisMMoE采用三方面技术组合：1）亲和性感知的视觉token压缩；2）前瞻性专家预测；3）缓存/流水线协同编排。这些技术协同作用以提升专家局部性并在严格内存预算下增强预取效率。
AI.result: 在代表性VL-MoE模型和基准测试上，VisMMoE相较于强基线方法实现了最高2.68倍和1.61倍的端到端推理性能提升，同时保持有竞争力的精度。
AI.conclusion: VisMMoE通过单点系统洞察（视觉-专家亲和性）有效解决了VL-MoE在内存受限平台上的部署难题，在保持竞争力的精度的同时实现了端到端推理性能2.68x和1.61x的提升。

title: Policy-Guided Stepwise Model Routing for Cost-Effective Reasoning
summary: Inference-time computation has greatly enhanced the performance of large language models (LLMs) on challenging reasoning tasks, but this strategy can incur high inference costs. One solution is to route intermediate chain-of-thought (CoT) states to language models of different sizes; however, existing approaches rely on handcrafted routing strategies that limit performance, or on training large process reward models that may be infeasible in many applications. We formulate stepwise model routing as a constrained decision-making problem, which we solve by training a small control policy using reinforcement learning in conjunction with threshold calibration to tune the performance-efficiency tradeoff. We validate our method on three math benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH500, and OmniMath) on both open and closed models. Our method consistently improves the accuracy-cost tradeoff compared to handcrafted approaches, while achieving a comparable tradeoff to methods that require training large process reward models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「策略引导的逐步模型路由」（policy-guided stepwise model routing）：把推理链中间步骤的模型选择（用小模型继续 vs 升级到大模型）形式化为受约束的马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），用强化学习训练一个小型神经网络控制策略，并与阈值校准联合优化，从而在目标准确率约束下最小化推理成本。在 GSM8K、MATH500、OmniMath 上，开放模型设定下以约一半算力达到 7B 模型准确率（GSM8K 94.5% vs 94.6%），优于 SpecReason/STEER 等免外部模型基线，并可与依赖大型过程奖励模型（PRM）的 RSD 取得相近的准确率-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 推理时扩展（CoT、自一致性、树搜索、MCMC 采样等）显著提升 LLM 在数学/编程等困难推理任务上的能力，但带来高昂的推理成本。利用不同规模模型之间的能力-成本差异、在推理链的中间状态（token 级、推理步级或任务级）动态路由，可降低单位算力成本。然而现有方法存在两类缺陷：(1) 依赖手工设计的路由策略（如基于语言化置信度或逐步高斯混合模型 GMM 的阈值判定），无法显式建模步骤间的时序依赖，性能受限；(2) 依赖训练大型过程奖励模型（PRM，如 RSD、SpecReason）获取步级奖励信号，数据与算力开销大、部署可行性差。此外，所有基线都依赖事后网格搜索（grid search）调阈值来确定目标性能-成本折中点，效率低且粒度受限。
AI.method:
问题形式化：设有 K 个按能力/成本递增的模型（M1..MK，实验用 K=2：草稿小模型 m 与目标大模型 M）。推理轨迹为有限时域 CoT 序列 h_t=(x, y_1:t)，路由过程建模为有限时域 POMDP。策略 π 接收黑盒观测 o_t（源自 h_t）并跟踪当前模型，输出动作集 A={继续使用 M_k} ∪ {升级到 M_k'（k'>k）}，每步产生推理步并计入推理成本 c(h_{t-1}, a_t, y_t)（FLOPs 或 API 费用，含输入上下文长度影响），终止后给出二元正确性奖励 r(x, ŷ, y*)。目标是阈值策略 Π_{π,κ}(h)={a: π(a|h)≥κ}，在约束 ℙ(R_Π=1 ∨ R_M=0) ≥ 1-α（大模型答对时路由系统也须答对，即相对正确性/覆盖保证）下最小化期望成本。

算法（Threshold Constrained Policy Optimization）：(1) 策略学习——π 为简单三层、每层 64 隐单元的神经网络（不用 LLM，保证数据效率），以 V-trace 离策略修正估计阈值过滤后动作集 S_{π,κ} 的价值函数；(2) 信赖域更新——类似 CPO，用重要性采样加权估计 ℙ[R_Π=1]，对奖励项与约束项同时做梯度下降，计算最优拉格朗日乘子（共轭梯度求解自然梯度步），并施加 KL 信赖域约束 D_KL(S_{π,κ}||S_k) ≤ δ；(3) 阈值校准——按 conformal prediction 的阈值更新规则 κ_{k+1}=κ_k+η_k(1-1{R_Π=1 ∨ R_M=0}-α)，并提出“局部验证”近似：引入辅助逐步验证器 LLM V 给出逐步二元判定 V(o_t,ỹ_t)，以 ∏_t V(o_t,ỹ_t)=1 作为覆盖/动作集规模约束的实用代理量，避免在推理树上做遍历式轨迹级验证；验证器仅用于训练，推理期零额外开销；(4) 置信度/观测构造——开放模型下按数学相关 token 位置的平均最大 logit 定义 S^os_i；API 设定仅有 top-5 对数概率时用数学 token 的最小 top-1 概率 S^API_i；并加入步索引、问题难度指示、是否为最终答案步、当前步长度等轻量上下文特征。

实现细节：温度 0.7，vLLM，以 "\n\n" 切分推理步；训练中用 xVerify 做答案抽取与等价性判定以获得可靠正确性标签；训练/校准集划分；α=0.02，训练 1000 步、lr=1e-3、batch size 5、阈值步长 0.1。模型：Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct 1.5B/7B（开放），以及 Qwen 小模型 + GPT-4.1-mini 大模型（开放到闭源），GPT-4o-mini 作步级覆盖检查，RSD 用 Skywork-o1-PRM-1.5B。基线：SpecReason（LLM 评审语言化打分）、RSD（PRM 阈值）、STEER（逐步 GMM 置信度），均按原文做 0.1 步长网格搜索。指标：准确率、平均 FLOPs/平均 API 成本（美分）、Accuracy-per-Cost。
AI.result:
开放模型设定（Table 1）：GSM8K 上本文方法 94.5% 准确率、2.03 FLOPs，几乎与 7B-only 的 94.6%（4.42 FLOPs）持平而算力不足其一半，A/C 达 46.55，优于 RSD（94.4/2.27/41.59）与 STEER（94.4/2.66/35.49），显著优于 SpecReason（85.2/1.03/82.72）。MATH500 上准确率 82.8%、5.34 FLOPs，为各方法最高准确率且明显低于 7B-only 的 9.10 FLOPs。OmniMath 上 29.1% 准确率、8.24 FLOPs，与最强外部奖励模型基线 RSD（30.0/8.54）竞争，A/C 3.53 与 RSD 3.51 相当。

开放到闭源设定（Table 2，Qwen 小模型 + GPT-4.1-mini）：本文方法在 GSM8K 94.5%/0.0205 美分（优于 SpecReason 94.9%/0.0994、RSD 93.5%/0.0093 略贵、STEER 94.5%/0.0608），MATH500 85.0%/0.0493，OmniMath 38.6%/0.285；相较直接调用 GPT-4.1-mini（95.2%/0.0293、84.8%/0.1313、43.0%/0.3356）显著降低平均 API 成本并保持可比准确率。与 RSD 的比较结果混合（GSM8K 略优，MATH500 与 OmniMath 略逊），作者归因于 API 仅提供 top-5 对数概率、不确定性信号质量较低，以及 Qwen 与 GPT 的格式差异（尤其符号密集的 OmniMath）。

讨论要点：本文方法能显式捕获步骤间依赖与未来价值（对比 STEER 的逐步独立 GMM 建模），并避免事后阈值网格搜索；推理期无需外部评审/PRM，具有低延迟优势。实验还支持“模型自身置信度对逐步编排有用”的观点，但原始对数概率在数学逐步推理中信息量弱于基于 logit 的置信度。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的阈值策略训练框架为成本高效推理提供了一条有原则的替代路线：相比基于语言化奖励（SpecReason）或逐步 GMM 加人工调参（STEER）的方法，以及依赖外部大型过程奖励模型（RSD）的方法，它以约束序列决策 + 策略优化的统一框架，在 GSM8K、MATH500、OmniMath 上取得强准确率-成本权衡——开放模型设定下优势尤为突出，开放到闭源设定下亦具竞争力。整体而言，该方法是面向成本感知推理系统的有前景的轻量方案，可在性能、算力与统计可靠性之间取得平衡。作者指出未来方向包括直接延迟评测、更广泛的非数学基准，以及更丰富的多模型路由不确定性表示。

title: Quadratic Objective Perturbation: Curvature-Based Differential Privacy
summary: Objective perturbation is a standard mechanism in differentially private empirical risk minimization. In particular, Linear Objective Perturbation (LOP) enforces privacy by adding a random linear term, while strong convexity and stability are ensured by an additional deterministic quadratic term. However, this approach requires the strong assumption of bounded gradients of the loss function, which excludes many modern machine learning models. In this work, we introduce Quadratic Objective Perturbation (QOP), which perturbs the objective with a random quadratic form. This perturbation induces strong convexity and enforces stability of the problem through curvature, thereby enabling privacy and allowing sensitivity to be controlled through spectral properties of the perturbation rather than assumptions on the gradients. As a result, we obtain $(\varepsilon, δ)$-differential privacy under weaker assumptions, in the interpolation regime. Furthermore, we extend the analysis to account for approximate solutions, showing that privacy guarantees are preserved under inexact solves. Additionally, we derive utility guarantees in terms of empirical excess risk, and provide a theoretical and numerical comparison to LOP, highlighting the advantages of curvature-based perturbations. Finally, we discuss algorithmic aspects and show that the resulting problems can be solved efficiently using modern splitting schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出二次目标扰动(QOP)方法，通过添加随机二次型扰动实现差分隐私下的经验风险最小化。该方法利用曲率而非梯度有界假设来控制敏感度，从而在更弱的假设下获得隐私保证，并扩展到近似解情形。
AI.motivation: 现有线性目标扰动(LOP)方法需要梯度有界这一强假设，排除了许多现代机器学习模型。研究旨在突破这一限制，通过曲率而非梯度假设来控制敏感度，从而扩展可处理的模型范围。
AI.method: 提出QOP方法，在目标函数中添加随机二次型扰动，利用曲率性质确保强凸性和稳定性；分析扩展到近似求解情形；采用现代分裂算法实现高效求解。
AI.result: 在较弱假设下实现(ε, δ)-差分隐私；获得经验 excess risk 的效用保证；理论与数值实验验证了QOP相比LOP的优势；证明了近似求解下隐私保证的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: QOP通过谱性质控制敏感度，突破传统梯度有界假设的限制；曲率扰动提供了更灵活的隐私-效用权衡；在插值 regime 下具有更强的一般性；现代分裂算法确保计算效率。

title: Back to the Beginning of Heuristic Design: Bridging Code and Knowledge with LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently advanced automatic heuristic design (AHD) for combinatorial optimization (CO), where candidate heuristics are iteratively proposed, evaluated, and refined. Most existing approaches search over executable programs and distill insights from execution feedback to guide later iterations. Because this process moves from low-level implementations to high-level principles, we refer to it as a bottom-up paradigm. We argue that this view is incomplete and introduce a complementary top-down perspective: knowledge becomes the primary search object and code merely instantiates and tests it, making what is learned explicit and reusable across problems and trajectories. We formalize this shift through a statistical-learning view that exposes a distortion--compression trade-off, and instantiate it in both population-based and tree-based AHD frameworks. Across CO and tasks beyond it, knowledge-first search improves discovery efficiency, transfer, and generalization, often outperforming code-centric pipelines, while combining both strategies yields further gains. Our results suggest that progress in AHD depends on iteratively constructing and evolving interpretable hypotheses that retain value beyond a single search trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种互补的"自顶向下"自动启发式设计范式，将知识作为主要搜索对象，代码仅作为知识的实例化和测试载体。通过统计学习框架揭示失真-压缩权衡，在种群和树两种AHD框架中实现知识优先搜索，显著提升发现效率、迁移性和泛化能力，并证明两种范式结合可带来额外收益。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型自动启发式设计（AHD）方法大多遵循"自底向上"范式，从低层代码实现逐步提炼高层原理。作者认为这一视角不够完整，缺少对知识本身作为搜索对象的关注，导致学习到的知识难以跨问题迁移和复用。
AI.method: 本文通过统计学习视角形式化这一转变，揭示了失真-压缩权衡，并将该方法分别在基于种群的AHD框架和基于树的AHD框架中实现。研究涵盖组合优化及组合优化以外的任务，验证了知识优先范式的广泛适用性。
AI.result: 知识优先搜索在多个组合优化任务及更广泛领域均表现出更优的发现效率、迁移能力和泛化性能，通常优于传统的代码中心管道。将知识优先与代码优先策略相结合可进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出知识优先搜索范式，强调迭代构建和演化可解释假设的重要性，这些假设能够超越单一搜索轨迹保持价值。结合自底向上和自顶向下两种策略可进一步提升性能，表明组合优化中启发式设计的进步取决于知识的显式表达和跨问题迁移能力。

title: From Drops to Grid: Noise-Aware Spatio-Temporal Neural Process for Rainfall Estimation
summary: High-resolution rainfall observations are crucial for weather forecasting, water management, and hazard mitigation. Traditional operational measurements are often biased and low-resolution, limiting their ability to capture local rainfall. Accurate high-resolution rainfall maps require integrating sparse surface observations, yet existing deep learning densification methods are hindered by rainfall's skewed, localized nature, noise, and limited spatio-temporal fusion. We present DropsToGrid, a Neural Process-based method that generates dense rainfall fields by fusing temporal sequences from noisy, irregularly distributed private weather stations with spatial context from radar. Leveraging multi-scale feature extraction, temporal attention, and multi-modal fusion, the model produces stochastic, continuous rainfall estimates and explicitly quantifies uncertainty. Evaluations on real-world datasets demonstrate that DropsToGrid outperforms both operational and deep learning baselines, generating accurate high-resolution rainfall maps with well-calibrated uncertainty, even when only few stations are available and in cross-regional scenarios.

AI.tldr: DropsToGrid是一个基于神经过程(Neural Process)的高分辨率降雨估计方法，通过融合稀疏气象站时序数据与雷达空间信息，结合多尺度特征提取、时序注意力机制和多模态融合，生成具有不确定性量化的密集降雨场。在真实数据集上优于现有业务化和深度学习方法。
AI.motivation: 传统业务化降雨测量方法分辨率低且存在偏差，难以捕捉局地降雨特征。现有深度学习方法在处理降雨的偏态分布、局地性、噪声干扰及时空融合方面存在局限。
AI.method: 提出DropsToGrid方法，基于神经过程架构，主要技术包括：(1)多尺度特征提取；(2)时序注意力机制；(3)多模态融合（气象站时序数据+雷达空间信息）；(4)随机连续估计与显式不确定性量化。
AI.result: 在真实数据集评估中，DropsToGrid在站点稀缺和跨区域场景下均优于业务化基线和深度学习基线，能够生成准确的高分辨率降雨图，且不确定性校准良好。
AI.conclusion: 基于神经过程的方法能有效融合稀疏站点观测与雷达空间上下文，生成高质量高分辨率降雨估计，并提供可靠的不确定性估计。

title: Grokking or Glitching? How Low-Precision Drives Slingshot Loss Spikes
summary: Deep neural networks exhibit periodic loss spikes during unregularized long-term training, a phenomenon known as the "Slingshot Mechanism." Existing work usually attributes this to intrinsic optimization dynamics, but its triggering mechanism remains unclear. This paper proves that this phenomenon is a result of floating-point arithmetic precision limits. As training enters a high-confidence stage, the difference between the correct-class logit and the other logits may exceed the absorption-error threshold. Then during backpropagation, the gradient of the correct class is rounded exactly to zero, while the gradients of the incorrect classes remain nonzero. This breaks the zero-sum constraint of gradients across classes and introduces a systematic drift in the parameter update of the classifier layer. We prove that this drift forms a positive feedback loop with the feature, causing the global classifier mean and the global feature mean to grow exponentially. We call this mechanism Numerical Feature Inflation (NFI). This mechanism explains the rapid norm growth before a Slingshot spike, the subsequent reappearance of gradients, and the resulting loss spike. We further show that NFI is not equivalent to an observed loss spike: in more practical tasks, partial absorption may not produce visible spikes, but it can still break the zero-sum constraint and drive rapid growth of parameter norms. Our results reinterpret Slingshot as a numerical dynamic of finite-precision training, and provide a testable explanation for abnormal parameter growth and logit divergence in late-stage training.

AI.tldr: 本文证明「Slingshot 机制」（grokking 中周期性 loss spike、末层参数范数近指数增长）并非内在优化动力学（EOS/Adam 自适应）所致，而是浮点精度限制的产物：当正确类 logit 与其他类 logit 之差超过吸收误差阈值（float32 约 16）时发生 Softmax Collapse，正确类梯度被舍入为零而错误类梯度非零，破坏分类器梯度的零和约束；由此在全局分类器均值 W_G 与全局特征均值 μ_G 之间形成正反馈「数值特征膨胀（NFI）」，二者反平行并指数增长，最终使部分样本 margin 跌破阈值、正确类梯度突然复现，被 Adam 放大的有效学习率造成巨大参数更新与 loss spike。
AI.motivation: Slingshot 机制由 Thilak 等在无显式正则化的 grokking 中发现：训练后期末层分类器参数范数快速（近指数）增长并伴随突发训练损失尖峰。此前解释主要诉诸优化动力学本身——Thilak 等归因于 Edge of Stability（EOS），Nanda 等归因于多尺度梯度与自适应优化器的相互作用；Prieto 等虽已定位到 PyTorch 交叉熵实现中的浮点「吸收误差」与 Softmax Collapse（SC），但只将其视为「停止泛化」，并未建立 SC 与 Slingshot 的因果关系，甚至猜测 Slingshot 是模型为逃避 SC 而产生的主动优化反应。同时，梯度流理论（Soudry 等）预言无正则化可分模型的参数范数仅对数增长，与实践中后期参数与 logit 的异常快速发散相矛盾，暴露出既有分析忽略有限精度效应。此外，随着 BF16/FP8/FP4 低精度训练成为主流，log-prob 计算的数值误差成为新的不稳定性来源，需要被识别与评估。
