AI.method: **理论**：以 IEEE-754 吸收误差为出发点，定义 Softmax Collapse（margin > (p-1)ln2 时正确类梯度严格舍入为 0）与 Neural Collapse（NC1 类内塌缩 / NC2 Simplex ETF / NC3 自对偶）。定理 3.4 在类均衡全批、GD 下证明 SC 使分类器梯度零和约束从 0 变为 ε·h（ε 为错误类残余概率质量），从而 E[ΔW_G] = -ηε/K·μ_G；定义修正的 NC3′（以 W_k - W_G 为中心仍构成 ETF）后，命题 3.6 在 W_G ⟂ span{W_k*} 假设下证明特征梯度在 W_G 方向的分量为 ε·W_G；定理 3.7 将两者写成耦合线性系统 [[I,-αI],[-βI,I]]（α=ηε/K, β=ηε），特征值 1±ηε/√K，主特征值 >1 给出指数增长，且渐近 W_G ≈ -μ_G/√K、cos → -1、特征空间塌缩为 rank-1。**Slingshot 触发链**：μ_G 指数增长使类内方差可与类间方差可比 → 靠近决策边界的样本 margin 跌破吸收阈值 → 正确类梯度从 0 突变为有限值，而 Adam 一二阶矩响应不同步、有效学习率已被放大至 η/ε_Adam → 更新量放大约 40–50 倍 → 损失回到随机猜测水平。**区分 EOS**：证明 CE 插值解下 λ_max(H_θ) → 0（GGN+残差分解），故晚期不存在 progressive sharpening；float64 下早期 EOS 振荡保留而晚期尖峰消失，二者可共存。**实验**：模除法（p=97，2 层 Transformer 与 6 层 MLP）、CIFAR-10（MLP/VGG11/VGG11+BN/ResNet18/12 层 ViT）、nanoGPT 110M on FineWeb；均 CE + Adam + weight decay 0。**干预与消融**：logit 梯度零和投影、loss 计算升 float64、Adam ε 增至 1e-5、LN/BN/标签平滑、Adam 换 GD（η=1e5）、学习率扫描、bias 项、数据集规模、logit margin 截断排除下溢、ε 演化追踪。
AI.result: 1) 精度因果确认：仅将 softmax/logits/loss 计算转为 float64（参数仍为 float32）即可完全消除 Slingshot，证明不稳定源于损失计算而非优化器自适应；Adam 换为 η=1e5 的 vanilla GD 在同一 epoch 触发尖峰（但无法恢复，永久发散），说明起点与自适应无关，仅取决于步长量级。2) 机制量化：尖峰 epoch 分类器参数更新分布出现 ±4e-4 双峰，而前一步约 1e-5，放大 40 倍以上；理论 Adam 更新估计 4e-4 与实测吻合；更新分布与 ε、‖μ_G‖ 的时间演化（多数样本 SC 后才快速上升）、cos(W_G, μ_G) → -1 均与理论一致。3) 架构依赖：MLP/VGG11/VGG11+BN/ViT 在 CIFAR-10 全部 20/20 次运行出现尖峰，ResNet18 不出现——因其 ε(t) 衰减过快（∝1/t 或 log t/t），使 (1+ηε/√K)^t 退化为多项式增长，反馈环无法进入指数区。4) 零和投影完全消除尖峰，证实破坏零和分量是 NFI 的必要环节。5) 缓解措施：Adam ε=1e-5（降低 η/ε 上界）可消除尖峰；分类器前 BN（减去 μ_G）消除尖峰，而卷积层内 BN 无效（其后 ReLU 重新引入秩压缩），纠正了 Thilak 的结论；LN 无效甚至加速尖峰（压缩特征范长使角间隔更易跌破阈值）；标签平滑消除数值尖峰但引入与精度无关的 EOS 型尖峰（因 λ_max(H) 不再趋零，附录给出 tr(H_z) → α(2-α(1+1/(K-1))) 的正下界）。6) 反直觉现象：更小学习率更易触发尖峰（大 lr 起到隐式正则、避免尖锐极小值）；带 bias 会加速尖峰（特征范数达 1e2 使权重更新比 bias 快两个量级，造成滞后失配）；增大数据集并不抑制尖峰；排除下溢（对 margin 设下限 100）后尖峰依旧，确认根因是尾数吸收误差而非指数下溢。7) grokking 关联：模除法中每次尖峰伴随测试精度阶跃提升，50 万步达 100%，尖峰可视为一种隐式扰动，帮助模型迁移到更平坦解。8) 现实场景：VGG11（batch 256）约半数样本在 1e6 步后进入 SC 且损失为零，未塌陷样本维持非零梯度与 Adam 矩估计，故无可见尖峰，但 μ_G 与 logit 仍异常快速增长；减去 W_G 或在分类器前加 BN 可显著减缓。nanoGPT 每步约 1.3e5 token 中约 4000 token 处于 SC（高频词多为数据集模板词如 "example"/"org"/"last"），且此时 float64 反而使平均 logit 更高（183→498），说明语言模型中 W_G 的增长主要源于 Zipf 频率不平衡而非 NFI 的反平行机制，两种机制方向相反。9) 论文还报告未能复现 Wortsman 等所称「logit 漂移至负无穷」的 output logit divergence（PyTorch 与 Nanodo 均未复现），与 Stollenwerk 等一致观察到向正无穷发散。
AI.conclusion: 论文将 Slingshot 从「内在优化动力学」重新诠释为「有限精度训练下的数值动力学」：核心是 Softmax Collapse 破坏分类器梯度的零和约束，从而产生全局分类器均值与全局特征均值之间的正反馈数值特征膨胀（NFI），解释了尖峰前的参数范数快速增长、正确类梯度复现与随后的损失尖峰，并给出了对后期参数异常增长与 logit 发散的可检验解释。作者强调 NFI 不等价于可见尖峰——在实际任务中部分吸收不产生尖峰但仍驱动参数范数快速增长，因此有限精度损失计算应被当作长期训练稳定性分析中的一阶因素，而中心流、神经热力学等既有精化仍局限于内在动力学。论文同时澄清 Slingshot 与 EOS 机制不同（前者是数值伪影、float64 即消失；后者是曲率固有属性）但可在同一训练中共存。局限方面：分析仅涉及倒数第二层特征与最后层分类器的耦合，隐含 Unconstrained Feature Model 假设（骨干网络足够表达、特征梯度直接位移），可能过度简化浅层网络的动力学（与 Nanda 等在浅网中难以观测 Slingshot 的报告一致），且依赖类均衡批、NC 近似、ε 缓变等强假设；公式 (6)(7) 中 (1+ηε/K)^t 与特征值 1±ηε/√K 的写法存在不一致。

title: P-Guide: Parameter-Efficient Prior Steering for Single-Pass CFG Inference
summary: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is essential for high-fidelity conditional generation in flow matching, yet it imposes significant computational overhead by requiring dual forward passes at each sampling step. In this work, we address this bottleneck by introducing \textbf{P-Guide}, a framework that achieves high-quality guidance through a single inference pass by modulating only the initial latent state. We further show that, under a first-order approximation, P-Guide is equivalent to CFG in the sense that it steers generation from the prior space, without requiring explicit velocity field extrapolation during sampling. We consider both homoscedastic and \textbf{heteroscedastic} priors, and find that jointly modeling the mean and variance enables adaptive loss attenuation and improved robustness to data uncertainty. Extensive experiments demonstrate that P-Guide reduces inference latency by approximately 50\% while maintaining fidelity and prompt alignment competitive with standard dual-pass CFG baselines.

AI.tldr: P-Guide proposes a single-pass alternative to dual-pass Classifier-Free Guidance in flow matching by modulating initial latent state, achieving ~50% latency reduction with competitive generation quality.
AI.motivation: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is essential for high-fidelity conditional generation but imposes significant computational overhead by requiring dual forward passes at each sampling step.
AI.method: P-Guide modulates only the initial latent state to achieve guidance effects in a single inference pass. Under first-order approximation, it maintains equivalence to CFG by steering generation from the prior space without explicit velocity field extrapolation. The approach extends to heteroscedastic priors by jointly modeling mean and variance for adaptive loss attenuation.
AI.result: Experiments demonstrate that P-Guide reduces inference latency by approximately 50% while maintaining fidelity and prompt alignment competitive with standard dual-pass CFG baselines.
AI.conclusion: P-Guide provides an efficient alternative to standard CFG by modulating only the initial latent state, achieving comparable generation quality with approximately 50% latency reduction, and joint mean-variance modeling enhances robustness to data uncertainty.

title: Rethinking Adapter Placement: A Dominant Adaptation Module Perspective
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that places trainable low-rank adapters into frozen pre-trained models. Recent studies show that using fewer LoRA adapters may still maintain or even improve performance, but existing methods still distribute adapters broadly, leaving where to place a limited number of adapters to maximize performance largely open. To investigate this, we introduce PAGE (Projected Adapter Gradient Energy), a gradient-based sensitivity probe that estimates the initial trainable gradient energy available to each candidate LoRA adapter. Surprisingly, we find that PAGE is highly concentrated on a single shallow FFN down-projection across two model families and four downstream tasks. We term this module the dominant adaptation module and show that its layer index is architecture-dependent but task-stable. Motivated by this finding, we propose DomLoRA, a placement method that places a single adapter at the dominant adaptation module. With only ~0.7% of vanilla LoRA's trainable parameters, DomLoRA outperforms it on average across various downstream tasks, including instruction following, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn conversation. This method also improves other LoRA variants, supporting the dominant adaptation module perspective as a practical placement guideline.

AI.tldr: 论文发现LoRA适配器的梯度能量高度集中于单个浅层FFN下投影模块，提出DomLoRA方法仅在该主导适配模块放置单个适配器，以约0.7%的可训练参数超越vanilla LoRA在多种任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有方法广泛分布适配器，但使用更少的LoRA适配器仍可能保持或提升性能。然而如何放置有限数量的适配器以最大化性能仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 提出PAGE（投影适配器梯度能量）方法，这是一种基于梯度的敏感性探测工具，用于估算每个候选LoRA适配器位置的初始可训练梯度能量。进一步基于发现提出DomLoRA方法，仅在主导适配模块位置放置单个适配器。
AI.result: 发现PAGE在两个模型家族和四个下游任务中高度集中于单个浅层FFN下投影模块。这种主导适配模块的层索引具有架构依赖性但任务稳定性。DomLoRA以约0.7%的vanilla LoRA可训练参数，在指令跟随、数学推理、代码生成、多轮对话等多种下游任务上平均优于LoRA，并能改进其他LoRA变体。
AI.conclusion: DomLoRA方法将单个适配器放置在主导适配模块位置，仅使用约0.7%的vanilla LoRA可训练参数即可在多种下游任务（指令跟随、数学推理、代码生成、多轮对话）上优于vanilla LoRA，同时也能改进其他LoRA变体，为适配器放置提供了实用的放置指南。

title: Skill1: Unified Evolution of Skill-Augmented Agents via Reinforcement Learning
summary: A persistent skill library allows language model agents to reuse successful strategies across tasks. Maintaining such a library requires three coupled capabilities. The agent selects a relevant skill, utilizes it during execution, and distills new skills from experience. Existing methods optimize these capabilities in isolation or with separate reward sources, resulting in partial and conflicting evolution. We propose Skill1, a framework that trains a single policy to co-evolve skill selection, utilization, and distillation toward a shared task-outcome objective. The policy generates a query to search the skill library, re-ranks candidates to select one, solves the task conditioned on it, and distills a new skill from the trajectory. All learning derives from a single task-outcome signal. Its low-frequency trend credits selection and its high-frequency variation credits distillation. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that Skill1 outperforms prior skill-based and reinforcement learning baselines. Training dynamics confirm the co-evolution of the three capabilities, and ablations show that removing any credit signal degrades the evolution.

AI.tldr: Skill1 用单一策略、单一任务结果信号 r(τ)，通过将结果信号分解为低频趋势（信用分配给技能选择）与高频变化（信用分配给技能蒸馏），联合优化"技能选择—技能利用—技能蒸馏"三个阶段，实现技能增强智能体的协同进化。在 ALFWorld 达 97.5% 成功率（超 RetroAgent 2.6 点，p=0.021），WebShop 达 96.0/82.9。
AI.motivation: 持久化技能库需要三种耦合能力：技能选择（从库中检索并选出相关技能）、技能利用（基于所选技能执行任务）、技能蒸馏（从轨迹中提炼新技能）。现有方法要么只优化其中部分阶段（如 SkillRL 冷启动后冻结选择模块、RetroAgent 不给选择提供梯度），要么使用异质奖励源（任务结果奖励 vs. 自评质量/启发式匹配分数等辅助信号），导致部分进化与冲突性优化：会用的策略若路由到次优技能仍表现不佳，不同信号对同一成功事件施加不一致压力。核心问题：(1) 如何同时进化三种能力；(2) 如何让三者朝同一目标协同进化。
AI.method: 形式化为带技能库的 POMDP：状态 S=(x, e, B)，B 为持久技能库，技能 s 含策略 s.strat 与适用场景描述 s.desc，单条轨迹 τ=(q, z, a1, o1, …, aT, oT, s_new)。工作流三阶段：① 选择——策略生成自然语言查询 q，冻结编码器（all-MiniLM-L6-v2）按语义相似度检索 top-K=5 候选，策略再生成排列 σ 重排序（训练用 UCB、评估用 Greedy，相似度权重 0.6）；② 利用——以所选技能策略为条件多轮交互至多 T 步（ALFWorld 50 / WebShop 15）；③ 蒸馏——策略反思轨迹生成新技能，仅当 r(τ)=1 时入库，库容 5000，超容时按 U(s)·log n(s) 退休最低效用技能。奖励分配（全部来自任务结果 r(τ)∈{0,1}）：利用奖励 R_util=r(τ)；选择信用——每技能效用分数 U(s) 用 EMA（α=0.05）更新所有检索候选，得 Ũ=max U(ℬ_K)，以 NDCG(σ, argsort(−U)) 作为重排奖励 R_rerank；查询 q 位于动作前缀，直接通过利用目标获得梯度；蒸馏信用——高频变化 R_distill=r(τ)−Ũ，正值表示超越库现有水平。联合目标 J = J_util(GRPO) + λ1·J_rerank(REINFORCE，因不同 rollout 候选集不同无法组内比较) + λ2·J_distill(GRPO，优势独立归一化)，λ1=λ2=0.3，一次梯度步更新。基座 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，GRPO，G=16，lr=1e-6，8×H800 80GB，VeRL + vLLM(TP=4)。
AI.result: ALFWorld 平均成功率 97.5%（Pick 100.0/Look 98.6/Clean 97.3/Heat 99.2/Cool 96.1/Pick2 96.0），超最强基线 RetroAgent 94.9% 达 2.6 点（Welch t=4.06, p=0.021；Heat p=0.004、Cool p=0.005、Look p=0.020；Clean 低 1.9 点但 p=0.147 不显著）；种子方差更小（0.6 vs 0.9）。WebShop Score 96.0 / Succ 82.9，全面领先。超纯 RL 最强方法 GiGPO 6.7 点（Look、Pick2 增益最大，说明可复用技能对多步子过程组合价值更高）。消融：去技能库 97.5→80.9（降幅最大，Heat/Pick2 各降逾 28 点）；去选择 −5.7（Heat/Pick2 集中下降，说明路由瓶颈）；去蒸馏 −5.1；λ1=0 −3.5；λ2=0 −2.6；两者皆置零 −7.3 至 90.2，劣于单独移除，呈互补性。动态：选择精度最先收敛（step 20 到 0.95），随后利用与蒸馏在 step 60 达 0.8；去掉任一信用信号均拖慢全部三阶段。质量：任务-技能相似度 0.51→0.60；top 技能效用 Ũ 在 step 85 达 0.91（消融滞后约 0.10）。多样性：Skill1 激活的高频技能数量约为消融版的 2 倍且策略空间分布更广（t-SNE）。开销：387–494 s/step，约为无库 GRPO（~290s）的 1.3–1.7 倍，源于库上下文增长；无蒸馏变体库膨胀 2.4 倍、step 60 时慢 69% 并更早触顶 5000。
AI.conclusion: Skill1 证明单一任务结果信号经低频趋势/高频变化分解即可为三个生命周期阶段提供差异化信用分配，无需辅助奖励、外部教师模型或额外 rollout，从而实现选择、利用、蒸馏的协同进化，并在两个文本环境上同时超越技能型与纯 RL 基线；消融显示三者相互依赖，训练动态证实耦合效应。局限：仅在两个纯文本环境（ALFWorld、WebShop）验证，未覆盖深度检索或视觉观测环境；技能库容量固定为 5000，任务多样性增大时可能成为瓶颈，需要更精细的淘汰或分层组织机制。后续方向是扩展到分层/多智能体场景下的技能共享与冲突解决。

title: Knowing but Not Correcting: Routine Task Requests Suppress Factual Correction in LLMs
summary: LLMs reliably correct false claims when presented in isolation, yet when the same claims are embedded in task-oriented requests, they often comply rather than correct. We term this failure mode \emph{correction suppression} and construct a benchmark of 300 false premises to systematically evaluate it across eight models. Suppression rates range from 19\% to 90\%, with four models exceeding 80\%, establishing correction suppression as a prevalent and severe phenomenon. Mechanistic analysis reveals that suppression is not a knowledge failure: the model registers the error internally but task context diverts early-layer attention from the false claim as output intent crystallizes toward compliance at middle layers. We characterize this as \emph{knowing but not correcting} -- suppression occurs at response selection rather than knowledge encoding. Guided by this mechanism, we propose two training-free interventions. Correction Direction Steering (CDS) estimates a correction-compliance direction from matched pairs and injects it at middle layers before output intent crystallizes. Dynamic Payload Amplification (DPA) localizes payload tokens via attention divergence between early and late layers and amplifies their representation at the final layer, requiring no calibration data. Experiments on Qwen3.5-9B and LLaMA3.1-8B show both methods substantially improve factual strictness. CDS achieves the highest correction rate on Qwen3.5-9B (0\%$\to$58.2\%). DPA is the only method that preserves or improves reasoning capability on both models. These findings introduce \emph{factual strictness} -- the willingness to uphold accuracy against contextual pressures -- as a new dimension of model reliability.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了LLM中的"纠正抑制"现象：模型在独立判断时能纠正错误，但在任务上下文中会忽视错误。机制分析表明这是"知道但不纠正"——抑制发生在响应选择层而非知识编码层。基于此提出了两个无需训练的干预方法（CDS和DPA），显著提升了模型的事实严格性。
AI.motivation: 发现LLM在独立呈现错误信息时能可靠纠正，但在嵌入任务导向请求时却往往服从而非纠正——这种"纠正抑制"现象严重损害了模型在真实应用场景中的事实守持能力。
AI.method: 采用300个假前提构建基准测试，在8个模型上系统评估纠正抑制现象；通过注意力机制分析揭示抑制发生在响应选择而非知识编码层面；提出两个无需训练的干预方法：1）CDS通过配对样本估计纠正-服从方向向量并注入中间层；2）DPA通过比较早晚期层注意力差异定位有效载荷token并在最终层放大其表示。
AI.result: 纠正抑制广泛存在（19%-90%），四个模型超80%；CDS在Qwen3.5-9B上实现最高纠正率（0%→58.2%）；DPA是唯一能保持或提升推理能力的方案；机制分析确认抑制发生在响应选择而非知识编码阶段。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了"事实严格性"（factual strictness）作为评估模型可靠性的新维度，并证明通过理解抑制机制可以有效开发无需训练的干预方法，为提升LLM在真实场景中的事实守持能力提供了可行路径。

title: OPSD Compresses What RLVR Teaches: A Post-RL Compaction Stage for Reasoning Models
summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has recently emerged as an alternative to Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), promising higher accuracy and shorter responses through token-level credit assignment from a self-teacher conditioned on privileged context. However, this promise does not carry over to thinking-enabled mathematical reasoning, where reported accuracy gains shrink and sometimes turn negative. We hypothesize that hindsight supervision can specify better token-level alternatives in short thinking-disabled outputs, but in long thinking-enabled traces it more readily identifies redundancy than supplies better replacements. To test this, we applied OPSD separately to correct and incorrect rollout groups, so that compression and correction can be observed in isolation. Our results show that in thinking-enabled mathematical reasoning, OPSD behaves most reliably as a compression mechanism rather than a correction mechanism: training only on correct rollouts preserves accuracy while substantially shortening responses, whereas training only on incorrect rollouts damages accuracy. In light of these findings, we propose a revised post-training pipeline for thinking-enabled mathematical reasoning: SFT then RLVR then OPSD.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了OPSD在思维增强数学推理任务中失效的根本原因：对于长思维链输出，OPSD只能识别冗余而非提供更好的替代方案，因此应作为压缩工具而非纠正工具使用，推荐的后训练流程为SFT→RLVR→OPSD。
AI.motivation: OPSD在简单RLVR任务中表现优异，但在思维增强的数学推理中准确率提升消失甚至变为负值，这一反常现象需要解释。
AI.method: 将OPSD分别应用于正确rollouts组和错误rollouts组，隔离观察压缩效应和纠正效应。
AI.result: OPSD在思维增强数学推理中主要表现为压缩机制而非纠正机制：仅在正确rollouts上训练可在保持准确率的同时显著缩短响应长度，仅在错误rollouts上训练则损害准确率。
AI.conclusion: 提出改进的后训练流程：SFT → RLVR → OPSD，适用于思维增强的数学推理任务。

title: Graphlets as Building Blocks for Structural Vocabulary in Knowledge Graph Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models excel at language, where sentences become tokens, and vision, where images become pixels, because both reduce to discrete symbols on a shared, fixed grid. Knowledge Graphs share the discreteness, but not the geometry. Their entities and relations are discrete symbols, yet their arrangement is relational and lacks a common, fixed grid. Knowledge Graphs (KGs) share the discreteness, but not the geometry. They form irregular, non-Euclidean topologies whose local neighborhoods differ from graph to graph. Therefore, Knowledge Graph Foundation Models (KGFMs) rely on identifying structural invariances to produce transferable representations. Without a universal token set, KGFMs are limited in their ability to transfer representations across unseen KGs. We close this gap by treating graphlets, small connected graphs, as structural tokens that recur in heterogeneous KGs. In this paper, We introduce a model-agnostic framework based on a vocabulary of graphlets that mines a KG between relations via pattern matching. In particular, we considered closed and open 2- and 3-path, and star graphlets, to obtain robust invariances. The framework is evaluated on 51 KGs from a wide range of domains, for zero-shot inductive and transductive link prediction. Experiments show that adding simple graphlets to the vocabulary yields models that outperform prior KGFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将图元（graphlets）作为结构化token来处理知识图谱缺乏固定几何结构的挑战，通过模式匹配挖掘知识图谱中的关系间结构模式，在51个知识图谱上验证了零样本链接预测任务中优于先前的知识图谱基础模型。
AI.motivation: 语言和视觉领域的基础模型依赖离散符号在固定网格上的表示，但知识图谱虽具有离散性却缺乏统一几何结构，其不规则、非欧几里得的拓扑结构使得跨图谱迁移表示困难。当前知识图谱基础模型（KGFM）缺乏通用token集，限制了模型在未见知识图谱上的迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出基于图元词汇的模型无关框架，通过模式匹配在异构图谱中挖掘关系间的结构模式。具体采用闭合/开放2-路径、3-路径及星形图元获取鲁棒的结构不变量。
AI.result: 在51个来自不同领域的知识图谱上进行了零样本归纳式和直推式链接预测评估。结果表明，向词汇表添加简单图元即可使模型性能超越先前知识图谱基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 图元可作为知识图谱基础模型的通用结构token，有效解决了知识图谱缺乏固定几何结构的问题，为跨图谱迁移学习提供了可行方案。

title: Uncertainty Estimation via Hyperspherical Confidence Mapping
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026. 24 pages, 7 figures, including appendix
summary: Quantifying uncertainty in neural network predictions is essential for high-stakes domains such as autonomous driving, healthcare, and manufacturing. While existing approaches often depend on costly sampling or restrictive distributional assumptions, we propose Hyperspherical Confidence Mapping (HCM), a simple yet principled framework for sampling-free and distribution-free uncertainty estimation. HCM decomposes outputs into a magnitude and a normalized direction vector constrained to lie on the unit hypersphere, enabling a novel interpretation of uncertainty as the degree of violation of this geometric constraint. This yields deterministic and interpretable estimates applicable to both regression and classification. Experiments across diverse benchmarks and real-world industrial tasks demonstrate that HCM matches or surpasses ensemble and evidential approaches, with far lower inference cost and stronger confidence-error alignment. Our results highlight the power of geometric structure in uncertainty estimation and position HCM as a versatile alternative to conventional techniques.

AI.tldr: HCM introduces a sampling-free, distribution-free uncertainty estimation framework by interpreting uncertainty as geometric constraint violation on the unit hypersphere, achieving superior performance with lower computational cost.
AI.motivation: Existing uncertainty quantification methods rely on costly sampling or restrictive distributional assumptions, limiting their practicality in high-stakes applications like autonomous driving, healthcare, and manufacturing.
AI.method: HCM decomposes neural network outputs into magnitude and normalized direction vectors constrained to the unit hypersphere, enabling a novel geometric interpretation of uncertainty as the degree of constraint violation.
AI.result: HCM matches or outperforms ensemble and evidential approaches while maintaining lower inference cost and stronger confidence-error alignment, validated across diverse benchmarks and industrial tasks.
AI.conclusion: HCM provides a versatile, computationally efficient alternative to ensemble and evidential methods for uncertainty estimation, with strong empirical performance across diverse benchmarks and real-world industrial applications.

title: The Granularity Axis: A Micro-to-Macro Latent Direction for Social Roles in Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are routinely prompted to take on social roles ranging from individuals to institutions, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations encode the granularity of such roles, from micro-level individual experience to macro-level organizational, institutional, or national reasoning. We show that they do. We define a contrast-based Granularity Axis as the difference between mean macro- and micro-role hidden states. In Qwen3-8B, this axis aligns with the principal axis (PC1) of the role representation space at cosine 0.972 and accounts for 52.6% of its variance, indicating that granularity is the dominant geometric axis organizing prompted social roles. We construct 75 social roles across five granularity levels and collect 91,200 role-conditioned responses over shared questions and prompt variants, then extract role-level hidden states and project them onto the axis. Role projections increase monotonically across all five levels, remain stable across layers, prompt variants, endpoint definitions, held-out splits, and score-filtered subsets, and transfer to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The axis is also causally relevant: activation steering along it shifts response granularity in the predicted direction, with Llama moving from 2.00 to 3.17 on a five-point macro scale under positive steering on prompts that admit local responses. The two models differ in controllability, suggesting that steering depends on each model's default operating regime. Overall, our findings suggest that social role granularity is not merely a stylistic surface feature, but a structured, ordered, and causally manipulable latent direction in role-conditioned language model behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究表明大语言模型内部表征编码了社会角色的粒度维度，从微观个人到宏观机构/国家角色形成了有序且可操控的潜在方向。这一发现基于几何分析、跨模型迁移和因果干预实验得到验证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被普遍赋予从个人到机构的各种社会角色，但尚不清楚其内部表征是否编码这些角色的粒度差异（从微观个体经验到宏观组织/制度/国家推理）。
AI.method: 定义对比粒度轴（macro与micro角色隐状态均值之差）；构建75个跨5个粒度级别的社会角色，收集91,200个角色条件响应；提取角色级隐状态并投影到粒度轴；进行激活 steering 实验验证因果相关性。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B中，粒度轴与角色表征空间主轴PC1余弦相似度达0.972，解释了52.6%方差，证明粒度是组织提示社会角色的主导几何轴。角色投影在所有五个层级单调递增，在层间、提示变体、端点定义、held-out分割及分数过滤子集中保持稳定，并能迁移到Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。激活steering可因果性转移响应粒度。
AI.conclusion: 社会角色粒度不是表面风格特征，而是角色条件语言模型行为中一个结构化、有序且可因果操控的潜在维度。研究为理解LLM如何表征和应用社会角色提供了新框架，并对可解释性和可控AI系统设计具有启示意义。

title: Beyond Uniform Credit Assignment: Selective Eligibility Traces for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a key approach for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, widely used critic-free algorithms such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) necessitate a ``uniform credit assignment'' assumption that indiscriminately broadcast trajectory-level advantages, hindering learning efficiency by failing to distinguish critical reasoning steps. To address this limitation, we propose Selective Eligibility Traces (S-trace). Grounded in the intuition of partial trust region preservation, we initially introduce P-trace as a sample-efficient, critic-free eligibility traces method, upon which we build S-trace, implementing a sparse eligibility traces mechanism to further mitigate variance and achieve fine-grained credit assignment by selectively masking low-entropy tokens. Theoretically, we contextualize the recent Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) method within the critic-free eligibility traces framework, identifying it as a special instance of the eligibility traces method operating under uniform credit assignment. Experiments demonstrate that S-trace not only outperforms GRPO, showing gains of 0.49\% on Qwen3-1.7B and 3.16\% on Qwen3-4B, and maintaining a robust 2.98\% improvement when scaled further to Qwen3-8B in average pass@16, but notably achieves this with simultaneously higher sample and token efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文针对RLVR中GRPO类无评论家算法"统一信用分配"（同一轨迹级优势广播到所有token）导致长推理链中关键步骤与冗余token无法区分的问题，提出无评论家的**选择性后继资格迹（Selective Successor Eligibility Traces, S-trace）**方法。核心思想：将PPO梯度重写为actor-only资格迹形式（Prop 4.1），用"后继重要性重加权"把下游仍存活的梯度信号回传给那些自身被PPO裁剪抑制的历史token；再用基于token熵的选择掩码（ρ=0.2，仅保留高熵"分叉"token）把稠密迹变为稀疏迹，以抑制噪声与梯度爆炸。理论上给出后继重加权估计器与原始资格迹估计器差异的上界（由KL散度κ与迹衰减因子λ=γλ共同控制）。实验基于veRL，在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B上以DAPO-Math-14k训练，MATH500/AIME24/AIME25/AMC23/Minerva/BeyondAIME评测：相较GRPO平均pass@16绝对提升1.80%(1.7B)、6.17%(4B)，8B上3项基准均值49.22% vs GRPO 46.63%，且响应更短、样本与token效率更高。附录D证明GSPO可视为"均匀信用分配"下的资格迹特例，从而对比了均匀分配与近因（recency）分配两类信用分配策略。注意：提供的摘要版本（arXiv摘要）与全文标题/数字不一致（摘要称0.49%/3.16%/2.98%、方法名P-trace→S-trace、标题"Selective Eligibility Traces"），应以全文为准。
AI.motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）已成为提升LLM推理能力的主流范式，GRPO等无评论家算法通过组内标准化奖励替代价值网络，显著降低了显存与计算开销，被广泛用于大模型后训练。但这类方法依赖"统一信用分配"假设：把同一条轨迹的结局级优势平均广播给所有token。对动辄上千token的数学推理链而言，日常token与决定成败的关键推理步骤（如关键的因式分解、结论推导）无法区分，造成信用分配粒度过粗，模型难以利用有用的时间依赖，且长轨迹中噪声token持续被同幅度强化，抑制了有效学习与响应精简。作者希望引入经典RL中的资格迹（eligibility traces）机制来做细粒度的时间信用分配，但直接照搬已有的GRPO(λ)（Parthasarathi et al., 2025）在PPO裁剪下失效：某个历史token的重要性比被裁剪时，其累积的迹贡献也被一并抹掉，即便后续token仍保有有效学习信号；同时经验上trace式GRPO(λ)的裁剪率显著高于标准GRPO，说明朴素资格迹未能充分利用可用信用信号。此外稠密迹会引入噪声更新与梯度范数爆炸，需要一种"选择性"机制来稀疏化信用传播。
AI.method:
**1. 形式化与动机定位。** 将RLVR建模为确定性MDP（状态为提示+历史前缀，动作=选token，奖励在序列末给出可验证结果）。回顾PPO（裁剪代理目标+GAE优势）与GRPO（组内标准化优势、逐token重要性比、k3 KL正则）。GSPO把重要性比与裁剪提升到序列级，属于另一类"均匀"策略。

**2. Prop 4.1：PPO梯度的资格迹重写。** 利用GAE与TD(λ)的结构同构，在无裁剪、无min算子时证明 ∇E[Σ r_t Â_t] = E[Σ δ_t e_t]，其中迹 e_t = r_t ∇log π(o_t|·) + γλ e_{t-1}，衰减因子为 γλ（区别于Kimura & Kobayashi的γ），并需要重要性比做off-policy校正。将TD误差替换为轨迹级组优势（Â=δ_1）即得无评论家资格迹估计器，重排后正好复现"权重式"GRPO(λ)的梯度结构。

**3. 后继重要性重加权（successor importance reweighting）。** 直接用Eq.(9)时，PPO裁剪会压制被裁token的直接梯度，其迹贡献随之消失。作者用当前token的重要性比近似历史比 r_{i,<t}≈r_{i,t}，把当前比因子提出来，得到 r_{i,t} Â_{i,t}·Σ_j (γλ)^{t-j} ∇log π(o_{i,j}) 的组平均估计器：下游token未裁剪的有效信号可回传至被裁剪的上游token。

**4. 理论界（Thm 1）。** 记 ξ=γλ、裁剪指示 m_{i,t}，定义裁剪迹估计器 𝒢 与原始迹估计器 𝒢′，在 |o|≤H、|Â|≤A*、||∇logπ||≤B、条件KL上界 κ 的假设下证明 E||𝒢−𝒢′||₂ ≤ (2A*B√(2κ)/ε)·(ξ/(1−ξ))·(𝓗_H−1)。含义：策略越接近rollout策略、λ越小则界越紧；λ↑虽保留长程信用但放松了界，构成"长程信用 vs. 估计偏差"的张力。θ=θ_old 时两估计器精确相等。

**5. 资格迹化实现：EIW与leave-own-out选择。** 构造"合格重要性权重" r̃ = sg[r/r^λ]·r^λ，数值上与常规重要性比完全相同，但求导时诱导出资格迹结构（式13–17）；进一步用leave-own-out形式 r^{λ,ω}_{i,t}=r_{i,t}∏_{j<t} r_{i,j}^{ω_{i,j}ξ^{t-j}}，掩码ω∈{0,1}决定哪些历史token接受后继信用，同时每个token自身的直接梯度贡献始终保留（不改变GRPO本身的裁剪项）。ρ=0时退化为GRPO，ρ=1时退化为稠密EIW。迹递推为 e^ω_{i,t}=ω_{i,t}∇_{i,t}+ξ e^ω_{i,t-1}。

**6. 熵基选择。** 无oracle准则时，按token熵排序，屏蔽每条rollout中最低(1−ρ)比例熵的token（ρ=0.2，遵循Wang et al. 2025b的80/20观察），优先保留不确定的"分叉点"token。

**7. 统一视角（附录D）。** 证明GSPO的梯度等价于衰减因子被均匀常数1/|o_i|替代、重要性比取几何平均的资格迹形式，即GSPO=均匀信用分配下的资格迹特例；trace式GRPO(λ)则把梯度扩展到所有前缀序列。

**8. 实验设置。** veRL框架，Qwen3-1.7B/4B（及8B扩展），DAPO-Math-14k训练，评测MATH500、Minerva、AMC23、AIME24、AIME25（8B另加BeyondAIME），pass@16、3次运行均值±标准差；基线含GRPO、trace式GRPO(0.9/0.99)、OPO、GSPO。超参：lr 1e-6、AdamW、wd 0.01、constant调度、batch 128/64、γ=1、KL系数0.001、ε=0.2、λ=0.9、ρ=0.2，A100 FSDP2。
AI.result:
**主结果（表2，pass@16%）。** Qwen3-1.7B：S-trace(0.9,0.2) 55.64 vs GRPO 53.84（+1.80）、GRPO(0.9) 53.32（+2.32）、GRPO(0.99) 52.30；4B：S-trace 64.66 vs GRPO 58.49（+6.17）、GRPO(0.9) 60.57（+4.09）、GRPO(0.99) 63.79（+0.87）、OPO 57.51。逐基准看，S-trace在AIME24/25（56.59/45.17）显著领先，Minerva略低于GRPO(0.9)（38.27 vs 43.67）。

**规模扩展（表3，Qwen3-8B）。** S-trace在AIME24/AIME25/BeyondAIME均值49.22% vs GRPO 46.63%、GRPO(0.9) 45.26%；AIME25 56.55 明显更高（AIME24略低于GRPO的69.58）。

**均匀 vs 近因（表1、图1c）。** Qwen3-4B上GRPO(0.9)与S-trace平均pass@16分别比GSPO高2.74%与6.83%；GSPO的响应长度曲线与GRPO高度重叠甚至后期更长，而两种近因方法最低平均长度显著更短，S-trace最低。

**裁剪率/梯度分析（图1a、1b）。** trace式GRPO(λ)与GSPO的裁剪率全程高于GRPO与S-trace，说明序列级重要性比更易被裁剪，而EIW的数值行为在多数训练步上与GRPO的token级重要性比几乎一致——这被认为是学习效率高的关键原因。梯度范数：S-trace(0.9,1) 3.17、S-trace(0.99,1) 27.76（训练不稳定）vs 选择性S-trace(0.9,0.2) 2.48，说明选择性机制在不缩短时域的前提下抑制梯度幅度、提升稳定性。

**消融（图3a、表4）。** 熵基选择优于随机选择：平均pass@16 64.66% vs 61.06%，增益集中在AIME24/25。稠密变体中λ=0.9优于λ=0.7/0.8（51.58/37.82 vs 44.38/32.83等），且响应最短，印证长程信用分配的价值；但稠密版本梯度范数过大导致不稳定。

**训练效率。** S-trace在奖励曲线上样本效率与渐近性能均更优，且平均响应长度下降最快，提示模型更早定位成功推理轨迹并把学习聚焦于关键位置。
AI.conclusion: S-trace在无需价值网络的前提下，把"下游仍有效的学习信号"经由后继重要性重加权传播到被选中的历史token（哪怕其自身梯度被PPO裁剪抑制），并以熵基选择实现稀疏化。理论方面给出了后继重加权估计器与原始资格迹估计器差异的上界，由策略KL散度与迹衰减因子λ共同控制，揭示了"保留长程信用"与"控制估计偏差"之间的张力；在θ=θ_old时两者精确一致。实验表明S-trace在Qwen3系列1.7B/4B/8B上于MATH500、AIME24/25、AMC23、Minerva、BeyondAIME上稳定超越GRPO、trace式GRPO(λ)、OPO与GSPO，同时具备更高的样本效率与token效率（更短响应）。对GSPO的对比还给出了"统一信用分配 vs 近因信用分配"的初步洞见：近因式资格迹更能抑制推理链尾部的噪声续写，从而带来更短、更好的数学推理。局限：仅在≤8B的Qwen3与数学任务上验证，尚未覆盖更大模型、其他架构与非数学推理；熵基选择仍是启发式，未来需更有原则的token选择准则、更强的稳定性保证，以及对时间依赖如何塑造信用分配的更深入理解。

title: Post Reasoning: Improving the Performance of Non-Thinking Models at No Cost
summary: As the widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) accelerates, token consumption from intermediate reasoning traces increasingly contributes to inference latency and operational cost. Recent studies suggest that many real-world tasks require little to no explicit reasoning, with additional reasoning sometimes even degrading performance. In this work, we propose \textbf{Post-Reasoning}, a simple yet effective approach that improves instruction-tuned models by conditioning them to justify their answers after generating the final response. By design, it enables the final answer to be obtained without additional latency or token cost, while still improving performance through simple instruction augmentation. We evaluate Post-Reasoning across \(117\) model--benchmark settings spanning \(13\) open and proprietary models, \(4\) model families, and \(9\) diverse reasoning and knowledge-intensive benchmarks, including AMC, HMMT, GSM8K, GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and BIG-Bench Hard. Post-Reasoning improves performance in over \(88.19\%\) of evaluated settings, achieving a mean relative improvements of \(17.37\%\). Furthermore, we propose supervised post-reason tuning, which further improves performance in over \(91.11\%\) of evaluated settings, and exceeds the prompt-based post-reasoning baseline by an average of \(8.01\%\), demonstrating that post-reasoning can be effectively internalized through training. Ultimately, Post-Reasoning establishes a new performance ceiling for direct-answer capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出 Post-Reasoning（后推理）：通过在指令中要求模型"先立即给出最终答案，再给出论证"，让指令微调（非思考型）模型在几乎零额外延迟/token 成本下提升准确率。因答案先于论证生成，部署时可用停止符截断论证，答案获取延迟与 Direct 基线几乎相同（实测仅差 0.02–0.07 s）。在 117 个模型—基准设置中约 88% 获得提升、平均相对提升约 16–17%；进一步用掩码损失（只在论证 token 上计算交叉熵）做"后推理微调"，在 91% 以上的设置中继续提升，平均超过纯提示基线 8.01%，并可跨领域泛化。
AI.motivation: 推理型模型在给出答案前会生成大量中间思考 token，显著抬高单次推理的延迟与运营成本，甚至在低难度任务上出现"思考冗余"式性能退化。已有缓解路线（推理压缩、剪枝、选择性思考、思考/非思考路由）依然要为"答案前的思考"付费。因此本文追问一个更锐利的问题：推理发生在答案之后是否仍然有用？即能否在不增加答案前延迟与 token 开销的前提下，通过"指令层面的条件化"（F1）而非"思考 token 本身"（F2）来提升直接作答能力，从而为指令微调模型建立更高的直接作答性能上界。
AI.method: 方法分两条路径。（1）提示式后推理：把标准任务指令（系统指令+3-shot 示例+问题）后缀改为 "State the final answer immediately and justify your answer."，形式化为 y ~ LM(x, δ_p)、c_p ~ LM(x, δ_p, y)，答案不依赖答案前生成的思考 token；推理时可用结束标记/停止符在答案处截断解码，论证 token 不计入交付成本（可选继续生成以提供可解释性）。（2）监督式后推理调优（post-reason tuning）：LoRA（r=16, α=32, dropout 0.05，lr 2e-5，cosine，3 epochs，有效 batch 32，bf16，FlashAttention2/DeepSpeed ZeRO-3）+ 目标化损失掩码（system prompt、用户问题、答案本身标为 -100，仅在 justification/"Explanation:" 段上计算损失），使模型在"已知答案"的条件下学会生成连贯论证；训练轨迹来源比较三种：专家蒸馏、改写蒸馏、目标条件自蒸馏（自蒸馏最优），语料为从 Numina 严格过滤的约 3500 道整数答案数学题（Orca Math/Synthetic Math/CN K-12/Olympiads/Synthetic AMC），过滤泄漏与过短（<20 词）样本。实验覆盖 Llama-3.1/3.3、Gemma-3、Ministral-3、Mistral-Small、Qwen3.5、Qwen3、GPT-OSS-20B 及 Gemini-2.5-Flash、Claude-Haiku-4.5、GPT-5.4-Mini，基准为 AMC 8/10/12、HMMT Feb/Nov、GSM8K、GPQA、MMLU-Pro、BBH，并含 3 组指令增强消融（Post-Summary / Post-Confidence / Post-Reason）、掩码 vs 非掩码消融、Numina vs MMLU 语料消融、延迟与解析可靠性测量。
AI.result: 提示式后推理在约 88%（论文不同版本记为 87.18%–88.19%）的模型—基准设置上提升性能，平均相对提升 16.30%–17.37%。分基准看：竞赛数学 AMC 平均约 +25%（多篇/正文给 30.01%，最高相对增益达 +141.53%），HMMT +23.11%（20 个设置中 18 个提升，Llama-3.1-8B +100%、Ministral-3-8B +111.57%），GSM8K 仅约 +1.13%（10 个模型中 6 个提升），GPQA Main +10.14%（最高 +34.52%），MMLU-Pro +4.45%，BBH +3.16%。闭源模型上同样有效（AMC 8/10/12 全为正，Claude-Haiku-4.5 HMMT Feb +27.31%、GPQA +14.14%、BBH +15.98%；GPT-5.4-Mini 偶有负增益，如 MMLU-Pro −2.15%）。监督式后推理调优在 91.11% 以上的设置中优于提示基线，平均超出 8.01%，其中 AMC/HMMT 增益最大（如 Qwen3.5-4B HMMT Feb +56.97%、Ministral-3-8B AMC 12 +47.61%），GSM8K 增益小且偶为负；仅用数学语料训练仍能泛化到 GPQA/MMLU-Pro/BBH（GPQA 上最高 +12.31%）。消融显示自蒸馏 > 改写蒸馏 > 专家蒸馏（GPQA 上 45.17 vs 38.43 vs 36.40）；掩码损失在全部 9 个设置上优于非掩码（p<0.05，Welch t 检验，n=3）；Post-Reason > Post-Confidence > Post-Summary，说明收益来自"论证"这一认知目标而非单纯的续写长度；训练语料换成以事实记忆为主的 MMLU 时，自蒸馏的收敛优势被中和，说明该方法依赖推理密集型数据。成本侧：答案到达延迟与 Direct 相差 0.02–0.07 s，单流解码吞吐与 TTFT 基本不变，到答案的中位 token 数 10.5 vs 10.9，90 个模型—基准单元中答案先于论证且解析成功率 ≥99.6%。原生 thinking 模型上（低思考预算）27 个闭源设置全部提升，平均 +7.90%、中位 +4.95%；开源小模型获益极大（如 Qwen-3-8B AMC 8 +290.43%），而 Qwen-3.5-27B 等强模型出现轻微退化。
AI.conclusion: Post-Reasoning 表明：即使推理发生在答案之后，仍可通过简单的指令增强在零额外答案延迟与 token 成本下提升直接作答准确率，从而为指令微调模型建立新的性能上界；其核心机制被归因于常被忽视的"指令层面条件化（F1）"而非答案前的思考 token（F2）。监督式后推理调优进一步证明该行为可被内化进模型权重（自蒸馏最优、掩码损失最优、跨领域可迁移）。局限包括：HMMT 类需要深层算法搜索的任务上仍受限；GSM8K 等强基线任务上收益小、偶有回退；自蒸馏的监督信号强度依赖任务复杂度；主结果未报告多种子显著性（仅掩码消融报告 p<0.05）；摘要与 arXiv 版本在模型族数量（4 vs 7）、提升比例（88.19% vs 87.18%）与平均提升（17.37% vs 16.30%）上存在不一致，且部分表格数值（如 Qwen3.5-9B 的 AMC 8 分数在表 1 与表 9 中不一致、AMC 与 HMMT 间存在重复数值）提示复制粘贴误差，需以原始代码与数据核验。

title: Sharper Guarantees for Misspecified Kernelized Bandit Optimization
summary:
Existing guarantees for misspecified kernelized bandit optimization pay for misspecification through kernel complexity: in generic offline bounds, the misspecification level $\varepsilon$ is multiplied by $\sqrt{d_\mathrm{eff}}$, where $d_\mathrm{eff}$ is the kernel effective dimension, while in online regret bounds, the corresponding penalty is $\sqrt{γ_n}\,n\varepsilon$, where $γ_n$ is the maximum information gain after $n$ rounds of interaction.
  In this work, we show that, for a large class of kernels, the misspecification amplification can be reduced to logarithmic or polylogarithmic growth. In the offline setting, we first prove high-probability simple-regret bounds whose misspecification term is governed by a spectral Lebesgue constant. This yields logarithmic amplification for one-dimensional monotone spectra and polylogarithmic amplification for multivariate Fourier-diagonal product kernels. In the online setting, we modify a domain-splitting algorithm and prove a cumulative regret bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{γ_n n}+n\varepsilon)$ under mild localized eigendecay assumptions, removing the extra $\sqrt{γ_n}$ factor from the misspecification term. The common principle is localization: spectral localization controls the Lebesgue constant of the offline approximation operator, while domain splitting implements the spatial analogue of this mechanism in the online setting, preventing local misspecification errors from being amplified globally.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种改进核赌博机优化中误判放大的方法，通过谱局部化和区域分割技术将误判惩罚从多项式复杂度降低到对数或多对数水平。
AI.motivation: 现有核赌博机优化的误判保证存在过度惩罚问题：离线界限中误判水平ε乘以√d_eff（核有效维度），在线遗憾界限中对应惩罚为√γ_n·nε。这种放大机制导致误判成本过高，限制了方法的实用性。
AI.method: 离线设置：利用谱Lebesgue常数控制逼近算子的局部化特性；对于一维单调谱证明高概率简单遗憾界限；对于多元Fourier对角积核实现多对数放大。在线设置：修改区域分割算法，在温和的局部特征值衰减假设下证明累积遗憾界限O(̃√(γ_n n) + nε)，消除误判项中的额外√γ_n因子。核心原理是通过局部化机制防止局部误判误差被全局放大。
AI.result: 对于一大类核函数，成功将误判放大从多项式级别降低到对数或多对数级别。离线设置中，一维单调谱实现对数放大，多元Fourier对角积核实现多对数放大；在线设置中，去除误判项的额外√γ_n因子。
AI.conclusion: 局部化是控制核赌博机误判放大的有效机制，谱局部化控制离线逼近算子的Lebesgue常数，区域分割在在线设置中实现空间局部化。该工作为设计更高效的核赌博机算法提供了理论基础。

title: BioMedArena: An Open-source Toolkit for Building and Evaluating Biomedical Deep Research Agents
summary: Building a deep research agent today is an exercise in glue code: the same backbone evaluated on the same benchmark can report different accuracies in different papers because harness and tool registry all differ, and integrating a new foundation model into a comparable evaluation surface costs weeks of model-specific engineering. We call this the per-paper engineering tax and release BioMedArena, an open-source toolkit that not only alleviates it but also provides an arena for fair comparison of different foundation models when evaluating them as deep-research agents. BioMedArena decouples six layers of biomedical agent evaluation -- benchmark loading, tool exposure, tool selection, execution mode, context management, and scoring -- and exposes 147 biomedical benchmarks and 75 biomedical tools across 9 functional families. Adding a new model, benchmark, or tool reduces to registering a few-line provider adapter. We further provide 6 agent harnesses with 6 context-management strategies, which provide 12 backbones with competitive research capabilities and significantly improved performance, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on 8 representative biomedical benchmarks, with an average lift of +15.03 percentage points over prior SOTA. The toolkit, configurations, and per-task traces are available at https://github.com/AI-in-Health/BioMedArena

AI.tldr: BioMedArena是一个开源工具包，通过解耦生物医学智能体评估的六个层次（基准加载、工具暴露、工具选择、执行模式、上下文管理、评分），解决了深度研究智能体评估中的"每篇论文工程税"问题。该工具包提供147个生物医学基准和75个工具，支持6种评估框架和策略，使新模型/基准/工具的集成成本大幅降低，并在8个基准上实现SOTA性能，平均提升15.03个百分点。
AI.motivation: 当前构建深度研究智能体面临"每篇论文工程税"问题：相同的骨干模型在相同基准上因测试框架和工具注册表不同而导致不同论文报告的准确率存在差异。将新基础模型集成到可比评估环境中需要数周的模型特定工程工作。
AI.method: BioMedArena将生物医学智能体评估解耦为六个层次：基准加载、工具暴露、工具选择、执行模式、上下文管理和评分。提供147个生物医学基准测试和75个生物医学工具（涵盖9个功能家族），以及6种智能体测试框架和6种上下文管理策略。添加新模型、基准或工具仅需注册几行代码的提供者适配器。
AI.result: BioMedArena为12个具有竞争性研究能力的骨干模型提供支持，在8个代表性生物医学基准上达到SOTA水平，平均提升+15.03个百分点。
AI.conclusion: BioMedArena是一个开源工具包，通过模块化设计将评估流程解耦为6个层次，显著降低了深度研究智能体的工程成本。该工具包为生物医学领域提供了标准化、可比较的评估框架，使新模型、基准或工具的集成仅需注册少量代码即可完成。

title: Training Transformers for KV Cache Compressibility
summary: Long-context language modeling is increasingly constrained by the Key-Value (KV) cache, whose memory and decode-time access costs scale linearly with the prefix length. This bottleneck has motivated a range of context-compression methods, from token-level summarization to recent optimization-based KV compression methods. These post-hoc methods operate on the KV cache of a fixed pretrained model, so their effectiveness is fundamentally limited by how well the model's internal representations can be compressed. In this work, we formalize the notion of KV compressibility and show that it is a property of the learned representations, rather than of the context alone. We prove that almost any sequence-to-vector function admits both highly compressible and inherently non-compressible transformer implementations, highlighting the need to guide transformers toward compressible representations during training. Motivated by this, we propose KV-Compression Aware Training (KV-CAT), a continued pretraining procedure that incentivizes the emergence of compressible representations. We introduce a train-time KV sparsification policy that masks KV slots during training. This forces the model to use fewer KV slots and encourages it to learn representations amenable to post-hoc compression. Empirically, we show that KV-CAT improves the quality-budget tradeoff of downstream compression methods across retrieval, long-context question answering, and perplexity-based evaluation of compressed-prefix continuation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对长上下文语言模型中KV缓存的线性扩展问题，证明了KV可压缩性是学习表示的属性而非上下文本身的属性，并提出KV-CAT训练方法，通过在训练时稀疏化KV表示来促使模型学习更易压缩的内部表示，从而改善下游压缩方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文压缩方法（基于固定预训练模型的KV缓存）效果受限于模型内部表示的可压缩性，需要在训练阶段引导模型学习可压缩的表示。
AI.method: 提出了KV-Compression Aware Training (KV-CAT)方法，在继续预训练阶段使用KV稀疏化策略，在训练时掩码部分KV槽位，迫使模型使用更少的KV槽位学习表示，从而鼓励模型学习适合事后压缩的表示。
AI.result: 实验证明KV-CAT能够改善下游压缩方法在多个任务（检索、长上下文问答、压缩前缀延续困惑度评估）上的质量-预算权衡。
AI.conclusion: KV-CAT通过掩码KV槽位的训练策略，使模型学会更易压缩的表示，从而改善了下游压缩方法在检索、长上下文问答和困惑度评估等多个任务上的质量-预算权衡。

title: Is Escalation Worth It? A Decision-Theoretic Characterization of LLM Cascades
summary: Model cascades, in which a cheap LLM defers to an expensive one on low-confidence queries, are widely used to navigate the cost-quality tradeoff at deployment. Existing approaches largely treat the deferral threshold as an empirical hyperparameter, with limited guidance on the geometry of the resulting cost-quality frontier over a model pool. We develop a decision-theoretic framework grounded in constrained optimization and duality. For a two-model cascade, we establish piecewise concavity of the cost-quality frontier on decreasing-benefit regions of the confidence support, with reciprocal shadow prices linking the budget- and quality-constrained formulations. Given a pool of $k$ models, we characterize the frontier achievable by deterministic two-model threshold cascades as the pointwise envelope over $\binom{k}{2}$ pairwise cascades, with switching points where the optimal pair changes. For $k$-model cascades, we derive first-order conditions in which a single shadow price equalizes marginal quality-per-cost across stage boundaries. We validate the framework on five benchmarks (MATH, MMLU, TriviaQA, SimpleQA, LiveCodeBench) across eight models from five providers. Within the deterministic threshold-cascade class, full fixed chains underperform the pairwise envelope, and optimized subsequence cascades do not deliver practically meaningful held-out gains over it. A lightweight pre-generation router exceeds the best cascade policy on four of five datasets, mainly because it avoids the cheap model's generation cost on queries sent directly to a larger model rather than because of a stronger routing signal. These results suggest that cascade performance is limited primarily by structural cost, since cascades pay the cheap model before any escalation decision, rather than by a shortage of intermediate stages.

AI.tldr: The paper develops a theoretical framework using constrained optimization and duality to characterize the cost-quality frontier of LLM cascades. It shows that the frontier equals the envelope of pairwise cascades, and empirically validates that structural costs (pre-escalation generation) limit cascade performance more than insufficient model stages.
AI.motivation: Existing cascade approaches treat deferral thresholds as empirical hyperparameters without theoretical guidance on the geometry of cost-quality frontiers over model pools.
AI.method: Decision-theoretic framework grounded in constrained optimization and duality. For 2-model cascades: piecewise concavity of cost-quality frontier on decreasing-benefit confidence regions. For k-model cascades: first-order conditions with single shadow price equaling marginal quality-per-cost across stage boundaries.
AI.result: Achievable frontier for deterministic two-model threshold cascades = pointwise envelope over C(k,2) pairwise cascades with switching points where optimal pair changes. Full fixed chains underperform pairwise envelope; optimized subsequence cascades show no meaningful held-out gains. Lightweight pre-generation routers exceed best cascade on 4/5 benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: Cascade performance is primarily limited by structural cost (paying cheap model before escalation), not by shortage of intermediate stages. Lightweight pre-generation routers outperform cascades on 4/5 datasets due to avoiding cheap model generation cost rather than better routing signals.

title: Physical Fidelity Reconstruction via Improved Consistency-Distilled Flow Matching for Dynamical Systems
summary: Reconstructing high-fidelity flow fields from low-fidelity observations is a central problem in scientific machine learning, yet recent diffusion and flow-matching models typically rely on iterative sampling, making them costly for latency-sensitive workflows such as ensemble forecasting, real-time visualization, and simulation-in-the-loop inference. We study whether a high-fidelity flow-matching generative model can be compressed into a compact one-step model for fast scientific flow reconstruction. Our approach distills an optimal-transport flow-matching teacher into a one-step consistency model. Low-fidelity observations are incorporated at inference by initializing the generative trajectory from a noised observation along the transport path, allowing an unconditional high-fidelity flow model to perform conditional reconstruction without retraining the teacher. We evaluate this distillation strategy on three fluid benchmarks, Smoke Buoyancy, Turbulent Channel Flow, and Kolmogorov Flow, using coarse-to-fine reconstruction as a controlled testbed at field sizes up to $256 \times 256$. Across these settings, the distilled student retains similar performance of the teacher's model on spectrum metrics, while using roughly half as many parameters and achieving a $12\times$ inference speedup over the flow-matching teacher. Under the same training budget, the distilled student also outperforms a one-step consistency model trained directly from scratch by $23.1\%$ in SSIM, showing that teacher distillation improves training efficiency rather than merely accelerating sampling. These results suggest a promising route for turning future high-capacity scientific generative models into compact reconstruction models that are faster to train, cheaper to run, and easier to deploy.

AI.tldr: 本文将流匹配教师模型蒸馏为单步一致性模型以实现快速高保真流场重建，参数减半、推理加速12倍，同时证明蒸馏策略优于从头训练。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型和流匹配模型依赖迭代采样，对延迟敏感场景（集成预报、实时可视化、模拟在环推理）成本过高，需要压缩为紧凑单步模型。
AI.method: 将最优传输流匹配教师模型蒸馏为单步一致性模型。推理时通过沿传输路径从带噪观测初始化生成轨迹，使无条件高保真流模型无需重新训练即可执行条件重建。
AI.result: 蒸馏学生模型在谱指标上保持教师相近性能，参数减半，推理速度提升12倍；相比从头训练的单步模型，SSIM提升23.1%。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏策略为将大型科学生成模型转化为紧凑重建模型提供了可行路径，训练更快、推理更便宜、部署更容易。

title: E = T*H/(O+B): A Dimensionless Control Parameter for Mixture-of-Experts Ecology
comment: 12 experiments, 11,000+ training epochs, cross-modal validation (vision + language). Extended version of the Claude-in-the-Loop ecology framework
summary: We introduce E = T*H/(O+B), a dimensionless control parameter that predicts whether Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models will develop a healthy expert ecology or collapse into dead experts. E combines four hyperparameters -- routing temperature T, routing entropy weight H, oracle weight O, and balance weight B -- into a single quantity. Through 12 controlled experiments (8 vision, 4 language) totaling over 11,000 training epochs, we establish that E >= 0.5 alone is sufficient to guarantee zero dead experts, removing the necessity for handcrafted load-balancing auxiliary losses. We validate this cross-modally on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet-200, WikiText-2, and WikiText-103. Six additional findings emerge: (1) dead experts can resuscitate -- triggered by balance loss driving router re-exploration; (2) ortho toxicity is dataset-dependent, not universal; (3) task complexity shifts the critical E threshold; (4) model overfitting is decoupled from expert ecological health; (5) three-tier MoE spontaneously collapses into a two-tier functional structure; (6) ecological structure is temperature-invariant across a 50x range. We propose that E serves as a unified diagnostic for MoE training, analogous to the Reynolds number in fluid dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无量纲控制参数E = T×H/(O+B)预测MoE模型专家生态健康状况，经验证E >= 0.5可完全消除死专家现象，无需负载均衡辅助损失，并发现专家生态具有温度不变性等重要规律。
AI.motivation: Mixture-of-Experts模型在训练过程中容易出现专家退化（死专家）问题，导致模型崩溃；现有方法依赖手工设计的负载均衡辅助损失，缺乏理论指导；需要建立一个可预测专家生态健康与否的统一指标。
AI.method: 提出控制参数E = T×H/(O+B)，整合路由温度、熵权重、oracle权重和平衡权重；通过12组受控实验（8个视觉+4个语言任务）累计超过11,000个训练轮次进行验证，涵盖CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet-200、WikiText-2和WikiText-103等数据集。
AI.result: E >= 0.5足以保证零死专家，验证了跨模态（CIFAR和WikiText系列）的普适性；额外发现包括：死专家可被平衡损失复苏、正交毒性与数据集相关、任务复杂度影响临界E阈值、模型过拟合与专家生态健康解耦、三层MoE自发塌陷为两层功能结构、以及生态结构在50倍温度范围内保持不变。
AI.conclusion: E >= 0.5可作为MoE训练的统一诊断指标（如流体力学中的雷诺数），无需人工设计的负载均衡辅助损失即可保证专家生态健康；研究还发现死专家可复苏、三层MoE会自发塌陷为两层结构等6项额外规律，表明专家生态结构具有温度不变性。

title: Event-Causal RAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Long Video Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
summary: Recent large vision-language models have achieved strong performance on short- and medium-length video understanding, yet they remain inadequate for ultra-long or even infinite video reasoning, where models must preserve coherent memory over extended durations and infer causal dependencies across temporally distant events. Existing end-to-end video understanding methods are fundamentally limited by the $O(n^2)$ complexity of self-attention, while recent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches still suffer from fragmented clip-level memory, weak modeling of temporal and causal structure, and high storage and online inference costs. We present Event-Causal RAG, a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework for infinite long-video reasoning. Instead of indexing fixed-length clips, our method segments streaming videos into semantically coherent events and represents each event as a structured State-Event-State (SES) graph, capturing the event together with its surrounding state transitions. These graphs are merged into a global Event Knowledge Graph and stored in a dual-store memory that supports both semantic matching and causal-topological retrieval. On top of this memory, we design a bidirectional retrieval strategy to efficiently identify the most relevant event causal chains and provide them, together with the associated video evidence, to a backbone video foundation model for answer generation. Experiments on long-video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that Event-Causal RAG consistently outperforms strong clip-based retrieval baselines and long-context video models, particularly on questions requiring multi-event integration and causal inference across long temporal gaps, while also achieving improved memory efficiency and robust streaming performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Event-Causal RAG，一个用于无限长视频推理的轻量级检索增强框架。该方法通过将视频按语义事件分割、表示为结构化 SES 图并构建全局 Event Knowledge Graph，结合双存储记忆和双向检索策略，有效解决了现有方法在超长视频推理中记忆碎片化、因果建模弱及计算成本高的问题，在长视频理解基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的大视觉-语言模型在短视频和中等长度视频理解上表现良好，但在超长甚至无限长视频推理方面存在明显不足，主要挑战在于：需要在长时序上保持连贯记忆，以及推断跨时间距离的事件间因果依赖关系。现有端到端方法受限于自注意力的 O(n²) 复杂度，而基于 RAG 的方法仍存在碎片化的片段级记忆、弱的时间/因果结构建模以及高存储和在线推理成本等问题。
AI.method: 方法层面，首先将流式视频按语义连贯性分割为事件，每个事件表示为 State-Event-State (SES) 结构化图以捕捉状态转换关系；随后将这些局部事件图合并为全局 Event Knowledge Graph，存储于双存储记忆系统中，支持语义匹配和因果-拓扑检索；在记忆系统之上设计双向检索策略，定位最相关的因果链并连同视频证据一同输入视频基础模型生成答案。
AI.result: 在长视频理解基准测试上的实验表明，Event-Causal RAG 在需要多事件整合和跨长时间间隔因果推理的问题上持续优于基于片段的检索基线和长上下文视频模型，同时实现了更好的记忆效率和稳健的流式处理性能。
AI.conclusion: Event-Causal RAG 是一种针对超长视频推理的高效检索增强框架，通过事件分割和结构化 SES 图表示，结合双向检索策略，在保持记忆连贯性和因果建模能力的同时显著降低了存储与推理开销，为无限长视频推理提供了轻量且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Towards Steering without Sacrifice: Principled Training of Steering Vectors for Prompt-only Interventions
summary: Recently, steering vectors (SVs) have emerged as an effective and lightweight approach to steer behaviors of large language models (LLMs), among which fine-tuned SVs are more effective than optimization-free ones. However, current approaches to fine-tuned SVs suffer from two limitations. First, they require careful selection of steering factors on a per-SV basis to balance steering effectiveness and generation quality at inference time. Second, they operate as full-sequence SVs (FSSVs), which can sacrifice generation quality regardless of factor selection due to excessive intervention on the model generation process. To address the first limitation, we propose joint training of steering factors and directions, such that post-hoc factor selection is no longer required. Using neural network scaling theory, we find that moderately large initialization sizes and learning rates for steering factors are essential for stability and efficiency of joint training. To tackle the second limitation, we draw inspiration from representation fine-tuning and introduce Prompt-only SV (PrOSV), an SV that intervenes only on a few prompt tokens. Our empirical results show that PrOSV outperforms traditional FSSVs on AxBench when using our joint training scheme. We also find that PrOSV achieves a better tradeoff between general model utility and adversarial robustness than FSSV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套「无需事后选因子、无需牺牲生成质量」的引导向量（Steering Vector, SV）训练与应用范式。核心贡献有两点：(1) 将 steering factor（引导因子 α）与 steering direction（引导方向 v）端到端联合训练，并用神经网络 scaling theory（神经标度理论，μP/γ-算子框架）推导出二者初始化尺度与学习率的幂律规则（η_v·η_α=Θ(1)、γ[v0]≤γ[ηv]、γ[α0]≤γ[ηα]；取 v0~N(0, λn⁻¹I)、α0=βn^{1/2}、η_v=Θ(n^{-1/2})、η_α=Θ(n^{1/2})），从而把「每个 SV 单独网格搜因子」这一昂贵、易碎的推理期流程变为一次性预训练调参；(2) 借鉴 ReFT（表示微调）提出 Prompt-only SV（PrOSV），仅在 prefill 阶段对极少数 prompt token（最优为 p2+s2 共 4 个）施加加性干预，不在 decode 阶段干预，从而在保留通用能力的同时实现有效的 concept-based steering。在 AxBench 上 PrOSV+SimPO 取得 SOTA（Gemma2-2B 0.803、Gemma2-9B 0.905、Qwen2.5-32B 1.102），并在通用能力保持与对抗鲁棒性上优于传统全序列 SV（FSSV），推理开销降低约 37×。
AI.motivation:
方向引导向量（steering vector, SV）因其轻量、可解释、可逆，成为控制 LLM 行为的第三条路径（介于 prompting 与 fine-tuning 之间）。但现有微调式 SV（fine-tuned SV）存在两大局限，限制了它作为工程化工具的实用性：
（1）推理期因子选择（factor selection）：先前工作把 steering factor α 视为外部常数，只训练 steering direction v；训练时用单位因子 α=1 或「因子采样」（factor sampling），推理时需为每一个 SV 实例在 14 个候选因子上做网格搜索并用 LLM judge 选出最优 α。该过程对因子高度敏感、代价高昂（每个 SV 需采样数百条被干预响应），且无法跨概念复用，是主要瓶颈。
（2）全序列干预（FSSV）：传统 SV 在 prompt 与生成 token 的全序列上施加加性干预，即使精挑因子也会因过度干预而严重损害生成质量（fluency/instruct score 下降），并可能压制模型通用能力。
作者提出 SV 作为可用工具应满足的两条附加要求：极少超参调参（保证跨概念可扩展性）以及对模型通用能力影响最小。
AI.method:
任务设定：单层加性干预 Φ_Add(h; α, v) = h + αv；目标为 concept-based steering（把概念 c 注入回答且不违反指令 x）。

（1）联合训练方案的标度理论推导。在 Adam 优化器、无穷宽极限下（γ-算子描述坐标尺度），定义 SV 特征 z = αv，并给出稳定性（z_t=Θ(1)）与效率/特征学习（Δz_t 的三项分解 δ¹=(Δα)v、δ²=αΔv、δ³=(Δα)(Δv) 均为 Θ(1)）两个定义。解方程组得：γ[η_v]+γ[η_α]=0（即 η_v·η_α=Θ(1)），且 γ[v0]≤γ[η_v]、γ[α0]≤γ[η_α]（初始化尺度不得超过对应学习率尺度）。取不等式为等式、Kaiming 初始化（σ_v²=λn⁻¹），得 v0~N(0, λn⁻¹I)、α0=βn^{1/2}、η_v=Θ(n^{-1/2})、η_α=Θ(n^{1/2})。该「因子化参数化」（α 与 v 分离）是关键：若直接优化 z，则退化为 z0=η_z=Θ(1)，几乎无指导意义。附录还证明 ClampInv 得到同一组标度条件，但稳定性保证无实际收益，故推荐 AddInv。工程上超参只需「一次性」网格搜（β、λ、η_α、η_v、训练轮数），可被所有未来 SV 摊销，且推理期零因子搜索开销。

（2）PrOSV。借鉴 ReFT 的 prompt-only 干预设计，只在 prefill 阶段对固定数量的 prompt token 施加干预，位置集合 I = {1..p} ∪ {m-s+1..m}（前缀 p 个 + 后缀 s 个），不在 decode 阶段干预，从而隐式编辑 KV cache、最小化对注意力图的破坏。搜索 |I| ∈ {2,4,8} 及 prefix-only / suffix-only / prefix-suffix 三种位置变体，发现 p2+s2（4 个 token）是跨模型无关的最优折中，且性能不随干预预算严格单调。

（3）实验设置。数据集 AxBench 的 Concept10（验证与位置实验）与 Concept500（规模化评估，Qwen2.5-32B 用 100 个概念）；模型 Gemma2-2B（L10）、Gemma2-9B（L20）、Qwen2.5-32B（L32）；干预为加性；训练目标为 Lang.（response-only 语言建模）与 SimPO（偏好优化）；指标为 AxBench 的 overall score（concept/instruct/fluency 的调和平均）、concept score，由 gpt-4o-mini 担任 judge，3 个随机种子平均。对比基线：prompting、FSSV（固定单位因子 / 因子采样+因子选择）、FSSV(RePS)、LoReFT、DiffMean、SAE、KV cache steering（作者自行复现，overall 仅 0.180）。另在 tinyMMLU / tinyGSM8K（~1K 长上下文）上评估通用能力与概念抑制攻击下的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.result:
1）理论验证（Concept10, Figure 3）：SV 对超参高度敏感；FSSV 与 PrOSV 均在 β>1 且 η_α>η_v 时取得最优 concept score，印证「因子需较大初始化与较大学习率」；更大的方向初始化 λ 对 FSSV 无益但普遍提升 PrOSV；PrOSV 对因子学习率的鲁棒区间显著宽于 FSSV。Qwen2.5-32B 上用过大因子采样集（60~600）复现 FSSV 时出现严重性能退化（overall ≈0.406/0.555），与理论一致。
2）干预位置（Table 1）：全 prompt 干预 concept 分最高但 overall 最低；PrOSV 的 concept 分略低于 FSSV，但在 Gemma2-9B / Qwen2.5-32B 上可追平甚至在 overall 上反超；prefix-suffix 优于 prefix-only / suffix-only；p2+s2 折中最佳。
3）AxBench 规模化（Table 2，overall score）：Lang. 目标下 FSSV 0.663→联合训练 0.736→PrOSV 0.758（Gemma2-2B）；0.788→0.821→0.859（Gemma2-9B）；0.798→0.919→1.049（Qwen2.5-32B）。SimPO/RePS 目标下：0.756→0.769→0.803；0.892→0.886→0.905；0.947→0.982→1.102（PrOSV+SimPO 为 SOTA，且超过 prompting 的 0.698/1.075/1.060、LoReFT 0.701/0.777、DiffMean 0.297/0.322、SAE 0.546）。唯一例外是 Gemma2-9B 上 RePS FSSV（联合训练 +0.009，属方差范围）。
4）通用能力与鲁棒性（Table 3、Figure 4）：FSSV 在 tinyGSM8K 上使准确率下降 68–90%，PrOSV 仅下降 18–29%；SimPO 目标对 FSSV 损害通用能力明显，对 PrOSV 无显著差异；PrOSV 在「通用能力 vs 概念抑制攻击鲁棒性」上位于更优 Pareto 前沿，推理期调整 FSSV 因子（80%/50%）无法改善该权衡；长上下文（~1K）下 PrOSV 在 Gemma2-2B/9B 上弱于 FSSV，但在 Qwen2.5-32B 上反超。
5）效率（Table 6）：PrOSV 只在 prefill 阶段对 4 个 token 干预、decode 阶段零开销，总成本约为 FSSV 的 1/37；联合训练方案在 SV 数量超过约 55 个后即优于「因子采样+因子选择」的摊销开销。
6）机制分析（附录 N）：PrOSV 对注意力图的扰动范围显著小于 FSSV（FSSV 使模型几乎停止关注指令内容 token、大量关注 BOS），解释了其能力保持优势；PrOSV 与 FSSV 方向余弦相似度低（<0.25）但非负，说明机制不同但略有共性；数据量从 3→72 样本时各项分数单调提升。
7）失败模式：PrOSV 在 code/math 类精细概念（如「代码中的下划线字符」「HTML 标记属性」）上得分接近 0。
AI.conclusion:
贡献：(1) 首次把 steering factor 纳入可训练参数，并用 LoRA 标度理论（同 Hayou 等、Li 等的框架）推导出 SV 训练的稳定性与特征学习条件，给出可操作的初始化/学习率幂律规则（η_v η_α=Θ(1)、η_v=Θ(n^{-1/2})、η_α=Θ(n^{1/2})、α0=βn^{1/2}、v0~N(0,λn⁻¹I)），证明在正确超参下无需推理期因子选择；(2) 反直觉地证明仅在 4 个 prompt token 上干预（p2+s2）即可实现与全序列 FSSV 相当甚至更好的 concept-based steering，PrOSV 在 AxBench 上取得 SOTA（Qwen2.5-32B 达 1.102），并在通用能力保持与对抗鲁棒性上给出更优 Pareto 前沿，同时推理开销降低约 37×。总体判断：SV 可从「重启发式的实验工具」转型为「理论有据的工程组件」。

局限与未来工作：仅研究微调式 SV，优化无关型 SV（DiffMean/SAE）的因子与方向仍缺乏原则性方法（因 v、α 均为常数 Θ(1)，标度理论无法指导因子选择）；训练目标对性能影响巨大，需设计更强目标以推进前沿；干预位置仅覆盖 prefix/suffix，更一般的定位策略有待探索；「干预后的模型能力 vs 对抗鲁棒性」的冲突在 PrOSV 与 FSSV 上均未根本解决；p2+s2 仅为有限算力下的经验最优，非理论最优。

title: Invariant Features in Language Models: Geometric Characterization and Model Attribution
summary: Language models exhibit strong robustness to paraphrasing, suggesting that semantic information may be encoded through stable internal representations, yet the structure and origin of such invariance remain unclear. We propose a local geometric framework in which semantically equivalent inputs occupy structured regions in latent space, with paraphrastic variation along nuisance directions and semantic identity preserved in invariant subspaces. Building on this view, we make three contributions: (1) a geometric characterization of invariant latent features, (2) a contrastive subspace discovery method that separates semantic-changing from semantic-preserving variation, and (3) an application of invariant representations to zero-shot model attribution. Across models and layers, empirical results support these contributions. Invariant structure emerges in specific depth regions, semantic displacement lies largely outside the nuisance subspace, and representation-level interventions indicate a causal role of invariant components in model outputs. Invariant representations also capture model-specific geometric patterns, enabling accurate attribution. These findings suggest that semantic invariance can be viewed as a local geometric property of latent representations, offering a principled perspective on how language models organize meaning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言模型中语义不变性的几何框架，认为语义等价输入在潜在空间中占据结构化区域，paraphrase 变异沿干扰方向而语义保持通过不变子空间实现。通过对比子空间发现方法分离语义相关与语义无关变异，并将不变表示应用于零样本模型归因，验证了语义不变性的几何本质。
AI.motivation: 语言模型对释义表现出强鲁棒性，暗示语义信息可能通过稳定的内部表示编码，但这种不变性的结构和来源尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出局部几何框架，将语义等价输入映射到潜在空间的构造区域，其中 paraphrase 变异沿"干扰方向"分布，而语义身份保留在"不变子空间"中。三项贡献：(1) 不变潜在特征的几何表征；(2) 对比子空间发现方法，分离语义变化与语义保持的变异；(3) 不变表示在零样本模型归因中的应用。
AI.result: 实验结果验证了三个贡献：不变结构在特定深度区域出现；语义位移主要位于干扰子空间之外；表示层面的干预表明不变成分对模型输出具有因果作用；不变表示捕获了模型特定的的几何模式，实现准确的归因。
AI.conclusion: 语义不变性可被视为潜在表示的局部几何性质，为理解语言模型如何组织意义提供了原则性视角。

title: DiBA: Diagonal and Binary Matrix Approximation for Neural Network Weight Compression
summary: In this paper, we propose DiBA (Diagonal and Binary Matrix Approximation), a compact matrix factorization for neural network weight compression. Many components of modern networks, including linear layers, $1\times1$ convolutions, attention projections, and embedding layers, have dense matrix weights. DiBA approximates $A\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ by $\widehat A=D_1B_1D_2B_2D_3$, where $D_1,D_2,D_3$ are diagonal matrices and $B_1,B_2$ are $0/1$ binary matrices. The intermediate dimension $k$ controls the trade-off between theoretical storage and approximation accuracy. For matrix-vector products, DiBA decomposes dense multiplication into three element-wise scaling operations and two binary mixing operations, reducing the floating-point multiplication count from $mn$ to $m+k+n$. For optimization, we introduce DiBA-Greedy, an alternating solver that combines closed-form least-squares updates for the diagonal factors with exact one-bit improvement tests for the binary factors. We also introduce DiBARD (DiBA with Retuning only Diagonal factors), which replaces dense-matrix layers by DiBA factors, freezes the binary matrices, and retunes only the diagonal entries on downstream data. This preserves compact binary mixing without discrete search during adaptation. On 40 dense weight matrices extracted from public pretrained models, DiBA-Greedy yields consistent SNR improvements as the theoretical storage ratio increases. After DiBA replacement in two component-replacement studies, DiBARD improves DistilBERT/WikiText masked-token accuracy from 0.4447 to 0.5210 and Speech Commands test accuracy for an Audio Spectrogram Transformer from 0.7684 to 0.9781 without reoptimizing the binary factors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DiBA（Diagonal and Binary Matrix Approximation），用「三个实对角因子 + 两个 0/1 二值因子」交错相乘来近似网络中的稠密权重矩阵；配套 DiBA-Greedy 交替求解器（对角因子闭式最小二乘 + 二值因子精确单比特翻转判定）与 DiBARD（冻结二值因子、仅重调对角元素的下游适配方法）。40 个真实预训练权重矩阵上 SNR 随存储预算单调提升；DistilBERT/WikiText MLM 准确率由 0.4447 提升至 0.5210，AST/Speech Commands 测试准确率由 0.7684 提升至 0.9781（理论压缩 68.87×）。
AI.motivation: 现代网络的线性层、1×1 卷积、注意力投影与嵌入层都以稠密矩阵存储权重，占据模型体积、内存带宽与推理算力的主要部分，是模型分发、端侧推理与任务适配的关键瓶颈。已有路线各有缺陷：剪枝需判定「哪些连接不重要」；量化虽在硬件上实用，但在极低比特下需同时优化离散量化码、缩放/零点、分组位宽与重构/任务损失，导致带混合整数结构的非凸问题，依赖直通估计器、ADMM/近端方法、二阶近似与校准数据；低秩/张量分解虽利用线性结构，但仍是实值低秩分解，不具备位级存储优势；蒸馏则需额外训练更大教师模型。作者希望走一条不同于「逐元素舍入到量化码本」的路线：把整块稠密矩阵表示为「共享的二值选择-求和混合模式 + 对角缩放承载符号与幅度」，从而把实值自由度集中到极少参数上，同时保留结构化低秩的表述能力与交替优化的可解性。论文明确声明：存储比均为理论值（假设二值因子逐位打包），不提供实测内存、位打包内核或推理加速基准。
AI.method:
**DiBA 表示**：A∈R^{m×n} 近似为 Â = D₁B₁D₂B₂D₃，其中 D₁∈D_m, D₂∈D_k, D₃∈D_n 为实对角矩阵，B₁∈{0,1}^{m×k}, B₂∈{0,1}^{k×n} 为二值矩阵，中间维 k 调节存储—精度权衡。展开式 B₁D₂B₂ = Σ_ℓ (d₂)_ℓ (B₁)_{:,ℓ}(B₂)_{ℓ,:}，故 Â 是 k 个缩放秩一模式的叠加，rank(Â) ≤ k，但大因子仅 1 比特，区别于无约束实值低秩分解。k=mn 时可精确表示任意矩阵（仅为表达能力论证，非压缩场景）；因子存在对角间缩放与中间通道置换的非唯一性。

**存储核算**：S_DiBA(k;Q) = k(m+n) + Q(m+k+n) 比特（Q=16 对应 FP16 稠密/对角，二值因子按 1 比特/元素），相对 Qmn 稠密存储的比值 ρ = [k(m+n)+Q(m+k+n)]/(Qmn)，忽略形状等元数据。矩阵—向量乘从右至左展开，三次对角缩放 + 两次二值选择求和，浮点乘法数由 mn 降至 m+k+n，其余为加法与位操作（未实测加速）。

**DiBA-Greedy**：交替求解。固定二值因子时对角因子有闭式最小二乘：左/右对角逐行/列解 (d₁)_i = ⟨A_i:, G_i:⟩/‖G_i:‖²，(d₃)_j 同理（分母为零时置 0）；中间对角满足法方程 F d₂ = b，F = (G_LᵀG_L) ⊙ (G_R G_Rᵀ)，b_r = (G_L)_:,rᵀ A (G_R)_r,:ᵀ，数值上用 (F+λI)d₂ = b。二值因子更新采用精确目标差：翻转单比特 δ = 1−2B_ij 时 Δ_ij = 2(1−2B_ij)(Y_ij − Z_ij) + h_i r_j，其中 H = G_R G_Rᵀ, h = d⊙d, r = diag(H), Y = (h⊙row B)H, Z = d⊙row(Ã G_Rᵀ)；仅接受 Δ < −τ 的翻转（B₂ 通过对转置使用同一子问题）。子问题按行分解，故不同行各至多一次翻转可并行且同时应用，批量目标变化为各 Δ 之和。算法采用行批量贪心 RowGreedy（b=1024），理想化下每次原语更新单调不增。

**DiBARD**：替换稠密权重后冻结 B₁、B₂，仅将 d₁,d₂,d₃ 视为可训练逐元素缩放层，在下游数据上以梯度法（AdamW/Adam，lr 3e-6）优化，从而避免在非线性网络损失中再次进行离散搜索；每替换一个 m×n 矩阵仅需 m+k+n 个可训练标量，且理论存储比不变。实验采用严格的「仅对角」协议：二值因子、偏置及所有未替换层均固定。
AI.result:
**实验 1（存储—SNR 扫描）**：从 Hugging Face/TorchVision 收集 885 个候选矩阵（排除任一维 ≤100 或元素数 >3,000,000 的矩阵），按 attention_related / ffn_or_projection / embedding / conv1x1 四类各选 10 个共 40 个（含 26 个 NLP、14 个视觉）。k∈{8,…,1024}，τ=1e-6，种子 0，存储比上限 ρ≤0.75；320 次计划运行中完成 317 次（仅 3 个小矩阵在 k=1024 被跳过）。SNR = 10log₁₀(‖A‖²_F/‖A−Â‖²_F) 随 k 单调不减，平均值从 k=8 的 0.70 dB 升至 k=1024 的 16.35 dB（37 个矩阵均值）。k=1024 时各类均值：embedding 21.3 dB、1×1 卷积 19.6 dB、注意力 13.6 dB、FFN/投影 11.5 dB；作者说明未控制奇异值谱，类别差异仅为经验趋势。

**实验 2-1（DistilBERT/WikiText-103 MLM）**：替换 tied embedding/MLM 输出权重（V=30522, H=768），k=2048，仅训练 d₁,d₂,d₃（33,338 参数），AdamW lr 3e-6、batch 16、5 epoch，固定掩码 40,850 个 masked token。结果：Original 0.4906 / PPL 15.88；Int2-PTQ 0.0023；Int4-PTQ 0.4179（ρ=0.1263）；Int4-scale-RT 0.5110；DiBA（未调）0.4447（PPL 21.62，ρ=0.0869）；DiBARD 0.5210（PPL 13.29），较 DiBA 提升 7.63 点、较 Int4-scale-RT 高 1.00 点，但仅用 0.0869 的目标存储比（低于 Int4 的 0.1263）。作者强调超过原模型属目标域重调而非零样本替换。

**实验 2-2（AST/Speech Commands v0.02）**：替换 12 层编码器中全部 48 个 768×768 注意力投影（Q/K/V/O），k=128，仅训 79,872 个对角参数，Adam lr 3e-6、1 epoch（去掉 _silence_，35 类；84,843/9,981/4,482 划分）。结果：Original 测试 0.9837；Int4-PTQ 0.9837（7.85×）；Int2-PTQ 0.7066；DiBA 未调 0.7684（ρ=0.0145，理论 68.87×）；DiBARD 0.9781，+20.97 点，恢复了 DiBA 引入差距的 97.4%，且与 Int4-PTQ 仅差 0.56 点。48 个矩阵的分解 SNR 均值仅 2.13 dB（1.20–5.24 dB），Q/K 投影（2.59/2.58 dB）优于 V/输出投影（1.73/1.60 dB），说明低重构误差也可通过少量对角重调恢复下游性能。
AI.conclusion: DiBA 将稠密权重压缩表述为「固定二值混合 + 轻量对角重调」：三个实对角因子承载全部实值自由度，两个 1 比特二值因子承载共享的选择—求和模式，中间维 k 与理论存储比 ρ(k;Q) 提供统一的存储—精度调节旋钮。实验支持两点结论：(1) DiBA-Greedy 在 40 个真实预训练矩阵上 SNR 随存储预算单调改善，且 ρ_DiBA 是跨不同形状矩阵比较近似质量的自然横轴；(2) DiBARD 冻结二值结构、仅重调 m+k+n 个对角标量即可大幅恢复下游性能（DistilBERT MLM +7.63 点、AST 分类 +20.97 点），从而避免在下游损失中重做离散搜索。局限：存储比为理论值（假设逐位打包），无实测内存/位打包内核/推理速度基准；下游实验的 ρ 仅针对被替换的目标组件而非整模型；DiBA-Greedy 仅为局部贪心求解器，不保证全局最优；评测任务少、种子有限。作者列为未来工作的方向包括打包实现、更广泛的层与模型覆盖，以及多种子重复评测。总体而言，该文提供了一种把「离散结构搜索」与「连续尺度适配」解耦的权重压缩范式。

title: Patch-Effect Graph Kernels for LLM Interpretability
summary: Mechanistic interpretability aims to reverse-engineer transformer computations by identifying causal circuits through activation patching. However, scaling these interventions across diverse prompts and task families produces high-dimensional, unstructured datasets that are difficult to compare systematically. We propose a framework that reframes mechanistic analysis as a graph machine-learning problem by representing activation-patching profiles as patch-effect graphs over model components. We introduce three graph-construction methods: direct-influence via causal mediation, partial-correlation, and co-influence and apply graph kernels to analyze the resulting structures. Evaluating this approach on GPT-2 Small using Indirect Object Identification (IOI) and related tasks, we find that patch-effect graphs preserve discriminative structural signals. Specifically, localized edge-slot features provide higher classification accuracy than global graph-shape descriptors. A screened paired-patching validation suggests that CI and PC selected candidate edges correspond to stronger activation-influence effects than random or low-rank candidates. Crucially, by evaluating these representations against rigorous prompt-only and raw patch-effect controls, we make the evidential scope of the benchmark explicit: graph features compress structured patching signal, while raw tensors and surface cues define strong baselines that any circuit-level claim should address. Ultimately, our framework provides a compression and evaluation pipeline for comparing patching-derived structures under controlled baselines, separating robust slice-discriminative evidence from stronger task-general causal-circuit claims.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将激活修补分析重新定义为图机器学习问题，通过修补效应图表示模型组件间的激活影响关系。提出三种图构建方法（直接影响力、偏相关、共影响），在GPT-2 Small的IOI任务上验证了图的判别能力，并提供了受控基准以区分结构化电路证据与基线信号。
AI.motivation: 可解释性研究中，将transformer计算反向工程为因果电路时，激活修补实验的缩放面临挑战：跨多样化提示和任务家族的干预产生高维、非结构化数据集，难以系统性比较。现有方法缺乏统一的表示框架和可控基准来评估电路级claims的有效性。
AI.method: 将激活修补概况表示为模型组件上的修补效应图（Patched-Effect Graphs），并提出三种图构建方法：直接影响力（通过因果中介分析）、偏相关（PC）和共影响（CI）。应用图核分析这些结构，并在GPT-2 Small上使用间接对象识别（IOI）及相关任务进行评估。
AI.result: （1）修补效应图保留了判别性结构信号；（2）局部边缘槽特征比全局图形状描述符提供更高分类准确率；（3）CI和PC筛选的候选边缘比随机或低秩候选具有更强的激活影响效应；（4）图特征可压缩结构化修补信号，而原始张量和表面线索构成强有力的基线。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的图框架为激活修补数据的压缩与评估提供了系统性方法论，分离了任务相关的切片判别证据与更强的任务通用因果电路证据。通过直接影响力、偏相关和共影响三种图构建方法与图核结合，该框架在GPT-2 Small的IOI任务上验证了结构信号保留能力，为电路级研究提供了可复现的基准框架。

title: Systematic Evaluation of Large Language Models for Post-Discharge Clinical Action Extraction
summary: The work in this paper evaluates zero-shot and few-shot large language models (LLMs) for safety-critical clinical action extraction using the CLIP discharge-note dataset, with particular emphasis on transitions of care and post-discharge patient safety. To manage the complexity of clinical documentation, we introduce a two-stage extraction framework that decomposes discharge notes, that are written in narrative form, into fine-grained, explicitly actionable clinical tasks through a staged prompting strategy. Our contributions include a systematic assessment of generative LLMs for clinical action extraction, a detailed comparison between general-purpose LLMs and task-specific supervised BERT-based models, and an analysis of annotation inconsistencies across different action categories. We show that contemporary LLMs achieve performance comparable to or exceeding supervised models on binary actionability detection, while supervised baselines retain a meaningful advantage on fine-grained multi-label category classification, despite the absence of task-specific fine-tuning and under strict data-privacy constraints. Qualitative error analysis reveals that many failures stem from misalignment between model reasoning and dataset annotation conventions, particularly in cases involving implicit clinical actions and rigid structural labeling rules. These results indicate that reported performance reflects model limitations due to lack of clinical reasoning, that is not captured by plain annotations. Labels without rationales make it impossible to distinguish clinical reasoning failures from annotation convention mismatches. Advancing clinical NLP requires reasoning-annotated datasets that document why specific spans are actionable, not merely which spans were labeled, enabling proper evaluation of model clinical understanding.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了零样本和少样本大语言模型在临床行动提取任务中的表现，特别是在出院小结中识别安全关键性临床行动。研究引入两阶段提取框架，将叙述性出院记录分解为可操作的临床任务。结果表明，当代LLM在二元行动检测上可媲美或超越监督模型，但在细粒度多标签分类上仍落后于监督模型。研究指出许多失败源于模型推理与标注规范之间的不一致，强调需要带推理理由的标注数据集来正确评估模型的临床理解能力。
AI.motivation: 临床文档的复杂性使得从叙述性出院记录中提取安全关键性行动面临挑战。传统监督模型需要大量标注数据且缺乏泛化能力，而临床场景下的数据隐私限制进一步制约了模型开发。需要系统评估现代LLM在此类安全关键任务中的可行性。
AI.method: 1) 引入两阶段提取框架，通过分层提示策略将出院记录分解为细粒度可操作任务；2) 系统评估生成式LLM在临床行动提取中的表现；3) 对比通用LLM与特定任务监督BERT模型；4) 分析不同行动类别间的标注不一致性。
AI.result: 当代LLM在二元行动检测任务上达到或超越监督模型性能；但在细粒度多标签分类任务上，监督基线仍保持显著优势。定性错误分析表明，许多失败源于模型推理与数据集标注规范之间的不一致，尤其涉及隐含临床行动和刚性结构化标注规则的情况。
AI.conclusion: 当前性能指标未能充分反映模型缺乏临床推理能力的局限性，因为标注仅包含"什么被标注"而缺乏"为什么"的推理依据。推进临床NLP发展需要构建包含推理理由的标注数据集，使研究者能够区分模型临床推理失败与标注规范不一致，从而正确评估模型对临床内容的理解能力。

title: A Fine-Grained Understanding of Uniform Convergence for Halfspaces
summary: We study the fine-grained uniform convergence behavior of halfspaces beyond worst-case VC bounds. For inhomogeneous halfspaces in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with $d\ge 2$, we show that standard first-order VC bounds are essentially tight: even consistent hypotheses can incur population error $Θ(d\ln(n/d)/n)$, and in the agnostic setting the deviation scales as $\sqrt{τ\ln(1/τ)}$ at true error $τ$. In contrast, homogeneous halfspaces in $\mathbb{R}^2$ exhibit a markedly different behavior. In the realizable case, every hypothesis consistent with the sample has error $O(1/n)$. In the agnostic case, we prove a bandwise, log-free deviation bound on each dyadic risk band via a critical-wedge localization argument. Unioning over bands incurs only a $\ln\ln n$ overhead, and we establish a matching lower bound showing this overhead is unavoidable. Together, these results give a fine-grained and nearly complete picture of uniform convergence for halfspaces, revealing sharp dimensional and structural thresholds.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了半空间的高精度uniform收敛理论，证明了非齐次半空间的标准VC界不可改进，而齐次半空间在二维情况下展现出显著更优的收敛行为，揭示了维度和齐次性对学习复杂度的关键影响。
AI.motivation: 超越最坏情况的VC界，深入研究细粒度uniform收敛行为，区分齐次与非齐次半空间在维度上的结构差异。
AI.method: 使用critical-wedge localization argument证明齐次半空间的bandwise log-free deviation bound，并通过matching lower bound证明lnln n开销的必要性。
AI.result:
1. 非齐次半空间（d≥2）：即使一致假设也会产生Θ(dln(n/d)/n)的population error；agnostic情况下在真误差τ处的偏差为√(τln(1/τ))量级
2. 齐次半空间（ℝ²）：真实情况下一致假设误差为O(1/n)；agnostic情况下每个dyadic risk band上有log-free deviation bound，union后仅需lnln n的开销
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了半空间uniform收敛中尖锐的维度和结构阈值：在非齐次情况下VC界本质上是不可改进的，而在齐次情况下则存在显著更好的收敛率（真实情况下为O(1/n)， agnostic情况下仅需lnln n开销）。这项工作为半空间的uniform收敛理论提供了近乎完整的刻画。

title: Cubit: Token Mixer with Kernel Ridge Regression
summary: Since its introduction in 2017, the Transformer has become one of the most widely adopted architectures in modern deep learning. Despite extensive efforts to improve positional encoding, attention mechanisms, and feed-forward networks, the core token-mixing mechanism in Transformers remains attention. In this work, we show that the attention module in Transformers can be interpreted as performing Nadaraya-Watson regression, where it computes similarities between tokens and aggregates the corresponding values accordingly. Motivated by this perspective, we propose Cubit, a potential next-generation architecture that leverages Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR), while the vanilla Transformer relies on Nadaraya-Watson regression. Specifically, Cubit modifies the classical attention computation by incorporating the closed-form solution of KRR, combining value aggregation through kernel similarities with normalization via the inverse of the kernel matrix. To improve the training stability, we further propose the Limited-Range Rescale (LRR), which rescales the value layer within a controlled range. We argue that Cubit, as a KRR-based architecture, provides a stronger mathematical foundation than the vanilla Transformer, whose attention mechanism corresponds to Nadaraya-Watson regression. We validate this claim through comprehensive experiments. The experimental results suggest that Cubit may exhibit stronger long-sequence modeling capability. In particular, its performance gain over the Transformer appears to increase as the training sequence length grows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Cubit：把 Transformer 注意力机制从「Nadaraya-Watson 回归」升级为「核岭回归（KRR）」的 token mixer。作者证明注意力等价于使用指数核（softmax）+ L1 归一化的 NW 估计器，而 KRR 闭式解 f(x)=k(x)ᵀ(K+λI)⁻¹Y 中，k(x)ᵀY 即 NW 部分，(K+λI)⁻¹ 则作为跨样本耦合的归一化算子并提供显式正则。Cubit 在标准注意力中插入 KRR 归一化矩阵 Σ=(g(KKᵀ)+λI)⁻¹，输出 Z=AΣSV，其中 A 为核相似度矩阵，S 由新增的 Limited-Range Rescale（LRR）给出且有界可逆。实验显示 Cubit 在 Arxiv/Books3/FineWeb-Edu 上持续优于 Transformer 与 DeltaFormer，且随训练序列变长（至 8192）性能差距单调扩大（loss gap 0.05–0.06），下游零样本平均分也更优。
AI.motivation: 自 2017 年 Transformer 诞生以来，尽管位置编码、注意力变体（GQA/MQA/MLA、ReLU/sigmoid 注意力、门控注意力）、残差连接、稀疏/线性注意力、SSM/MoE 等大量工作层出不穷，其核心 token 混合机制仍是注意力。作者指出该机制在数学上等价于 Nadaraya-Watson 回归：以指数核（softmax）度量相似度并做 L1 归一化的相似度加权聚合，缺少显式正则化与全局核矩阵耦合，理论上偏弱且保留二次复杂度。作者希望为 token 混合建立与经典回归方法（Nadaraya-Watson、核岭回归、局部线性/多项式回归）相通的统一理论框架，并用理论更完备的核方法替换注意力，得到具备更强长序列建模能力的下一代架构。
AI.method:
**理论框架**：借助表示定理与 Mercer 定理推导 KRR 闭式解；将注意力写为 z_i=Σ_j A_ij v_j，解释为带可学习相似度函数与可学习回归目标的非参数核回归；说明注意力温度 w^(h) 相当于自适应带宽（w→0 全局平均，w→∞ 近邻回归），多头对应多尺度。

**Cubit 架构**：定义归一化矩阵 Σ^(h)=(g(K^(h)K^(h)ᵀ)+λI)⁻¹，其中 K^(h)=φ(XW_K)；核相似度矩阵 A^(h) 使用 query-key 参数化 k(x_i)=[φ(x_iW_Q)φ(x_1W_K)ᵀ;…;φ(x_iW_Q)φ(x_iW_K)ᵀ]，既放松 Mercer 严格形式又提升表达力与数值稳定性；当 φ 取恒等且对堆叠核向量做 softmax 时退化为标准注意力。最终 Z^(h)=A^(h)Σ^(h)V^(h)。

**LRR**：引入可学习缩放向量 ŝ=α·σ(W_s x)+β ∈ (β, α+β)，保证 S=diag(ŝ) 可逆且逆元有界于 (1/(α+β), 1/β)，通过求解 S Σ⁻¹ o = V 得 Z=AΣSV，从而稳定训练并自适应调整核精度。

**变体与实现**：附录给出 Local Linear Regression 版本（以局部仿射拟合修正边界偏差，内点 O(h²)→边界 O(h)→O(h²)），但速度慢；PyTorch 实现用 softmax 相似度 + λI 构造下三角矩阵后 solve_triangular 求解，λ 采用对数参数化，R 投影可独立或与 K 共享。

**与 DeltaFormer 区别**：动机（KRR vs DeltaNet+Transformer）、构造（单一嵌入 r/k 保证可逆 vs 双嵌入 w/k）、不强制对角为 1、额外引入 LRR。
AI.result: 1) **基线对比（125M）**：Arxiv 512 上 Cubit loss 1.8802 vs Transformer 1.9003、DeltaFormer 1.8983；Books3 512 上 3.4168 vs 3.4514/3.4371；1024 长度上差距进一步拉大（Arxiv 1.7023 vs 1.7210，Books3 3.2204 vs 3.2529），且从训练初期（5K step）到收敛全程领先。2) **多域 FineWeb-Edu**：512 时 3.7110 vs 3.7443/3.7242；1024 时 3.4597 vs 3.4960/3.4705。3) **长序列**：差距随训练长度单调扩大，8192 时稳定在 0.05–0.06；翻倍 batch size 后差距缩小，证明增益源于长序列架构优势而非更多训练 token。4) **规模扩展**：350M 时 3.3166 vs 3.3438/3.3284；1.3B 时 3.1849 vs 3.2100/3.2057，DeltaFormer 相对 Transformer 的优势随规模扩大而消失，Cubit 保持一致收益。5) **消融**：独立 R 投影优于共享嵌入的 Cubit-Share；LRR 有增益（Cubit 3.4597 > NoLRR 3.4645 > Transformer 3.4960），即使共享嵌入仍优于 Transformer，说明增益来自结构设计而非参数量。6) **下游零样本**：350M/50B tokens 平均 50.01（Transformer 49.48、DeltaFormer 49.63）；350M/10B 为 48.31（48.13/48.09）；1.3B/10B 为 51.78（51.53/51.33），小数据量与大规模下均领先。7) **核函数消融**：softmax 作用于 QK 与 KK 最佳（3.711），RBF 仅用于 KK 与 Transformer 相当（3.7242 vs 3.7443），RBF 用于 QK 时显著恶化（5K step 达 5.93）。8) **显著性**：三个随机种子下 Cubit 均值全程低于 Transformer 与 DeltaFormer，方差相近。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张 token 混合与经典回归方法存在统一对应关系：Transformer 注意力是 Nadaraya-Watson 回归，而 Cubit 用核岭回归替换之，借助 (K+λI)⁻¹ 提供显式正则、RKHS 中更快的收敛速率、对噪声与边界效应的更强鲁棒性；配合 LRR 保障训练稳定性。实验表明 Cubit 在多种数据集、序列长度（512→8192）与模型规模（125M→1.3B）下均稳定优于 Transformer 与 DeltaFormer，且性能增益随训练序列变长而单调增大，下游零样本平均分也更优，因此有望成为下一代基础模型架构。作者同时指出局限：KRR 的每头线性方程组求解（三角求解为 O(T³)）与 LLR 版本计算开销较大，长序列加速留待未来（可考虑 Local Kernel Ridge Regression 等）；附录亦坦陈模型能力更强可能被滥用。此外 LLR 版本在 Books3/512 上优于 KRR 版本（50K step 3.4543 vs 3.4350 更差…最终 KRR 3.4350 优于 LLR 3.4543），但速度慢，未来需兼顾精度与效率。

title: PairAlign: A Framework for Sequence Tokenization via Self-Alignment with Applications to Audio Tokenization
summary:
Many operations on sensory data -- comparison, memory, retrieval, and reasoning -- are naturally expressed over discrete symbolic structures. In language this interface is given by tokens; in audio, it must be learned. Existing audio tokenizers rely on quantization, clustering, or codec reconstruction, assigning tokens locally, so sequence consistency, compactness, length control, termination, and edit similarity are rarely optimized directly.
  We introduce PairAlign, a framework for compact audio tokenization through sequence-level self-alignment. PairAlign treats tokenization as conditional sequence generation: an encoder maps speech to a continuous condition, and an autoregressive decoder generates tokens from BOS, learning token identity, order, length, and EOS placement. Given two content-preserving views, each view's sequence is trained to be likely under the other's representation, while unrelated examples provide competing sequences. This gives a scalable surrogate for edit-distance preservation while discouraging many-to-one collapse.
  PairAlign starts from VQ-style tokenization and refines it with EMA-teacher targets, cross-paired teacher forcing, prefix corruption, likelihood contrast, and length control.
  On 3-second speech, PairAlign learns compact, non-degenerate sequences with broad vocabulary usage and strong cross-view consistency. On TIMIT retrieval, it preserves edit-distance search while reducing archive token count by 55%. A continuous-sweep probe shows lower local overlap than a dense geometric tokenizer, but stronger length control and bounded edit trajectories under 100 ms shifts. PairAlign is a sequence-symbolic predictive learner: like JEPA-style objectives, it predicts an abstract target from another view as a learned variable-length symbolic sequence, not a continuous latent.

AI.tldr: PairAlign 提出了一种基于序列级自对齐的紧凑音频分词框架，通过将分词建模为条件序列生成任务，使用编码器-自回归解码器架构，从双视图学习中优化序列一致性、紧凑性、长度控制和编辑距离保持性。
AI.motivation: 现有音频分词器依赖量化、聚类或编解码重建，采用局部标记分配方式，导致序列一致性、紧凑性、长度控制、终止条件以及编辑相似性等特性未被直接优化。
AI.method: PairAlign 将分词视为条件序列生成任务：编码器将语音映射为连续条件，自回归解码器从 BOS 开始生成 token。双视图训练中，每个视图的序列被训练为对另一个视图表示的似然估计。核心技术包括：VQ式分词初始化、EMA教师目标、交叉配对教师强制、前缀腐败、似然对比和长度控制。
AI.result: 在3秒语音上，PairAlign 学习到紧凑、非退化的序列，具有广泛词汇使用和强跨视图一致性。在 TIMIT 检索任务中，在保持编辑距离搜索的同时将存档 token 数量减少 55%。连续扫描探针显示局部重叠低于密集几何分词器，但具有更强的长度控制和 100ms 偏移下的有界编辑轨迹。
AI.conclusion: PairAlign 是一种序列-符号预测学习器，类似于 JEPA 风格目标，从另一个视图预测抽象目标作为学习到的可变长度符号序列，而非连续潜变量。

title: Towards Annotation-Free Validation of MLLMs: A Vision-Language Logical Consistency Metric
summary: Dominant accuracy evaluation might reward unwarranted guessing of Large Language Models, and it might not be applicable to novel tasks for model validation without ground-truth (gt) annotation. Based on basic logic principle, we propose a novel framework to evaluate the vision-language logical consistency of MLLMs on both sufficient and necessary cause-effect relations. We define Vision-Language Logical Consistency Metric (VL-LCM) on traditional MC-VQA tests, and recent NaturalBench tests without the need for gt annotation. Through systematic experiments on representative VL benchmark MMMU and recent VL challenges like NaturalBench, we evaluated 11 recent open-source MLLMs from 4 frontier families. Our findings reveal that, despite significant progress of recent MLLMs on accuracy, logical consistency lags behind significantly. Extensive evaluations on the correlations of VL-LCM with metrics on gt, the reliability of LCM, and the relation of VL-LCM with response distribution justify the validity and applicability of VL-LCM even without gt annotation. Our findings suggest that, beyond accuracy, logical consistency could be employed for both accuracy and reliability. VL-LCM can also be employed for MLLM selection, validation, and reliable answer justification in novel tasks without gt annotation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VL-LCM框架，通过基本逻辑原则评估多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)的视觉-语言逻辑一致性，可无需ground-truth标注对新任务进行评估。实验涵盖MMMU和NaturalBench等11个开源模型，结果显示当前模型逻辑一致性显著落后于准确率表现。
AI.motivation: 现有主导的准确率评估可能奖励模型的不正当猜测，且在没有ground-truth标注的新任务上不适用。需提出新的评估框架来衡量模型的逻辑一致性。
AI.method: 提出Vision-Language Logical Consistency Metric (VL-LCM)框架，基于充分和必要因果关系的基本逻辑原则，评估MLLMs的视觉-语言逻辑一致性。该指标可应用于传统MC-VQA测试和无需gt标注的NaturalBench测试。
AI.result: 尽管近期MLLMs在准确率上取得显著进步，但其逻辑一致性严重滞后。VL-LCM与gt标注指标的关联性、LCM的可靠性以及VL-LCM与响应分布的关系均验证了该指标的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VL-LCM可有效用于MLLM选择、验证及新颖任务中的可靠答案解释，且无需ground-truth标注即可评估模型的可靠性和逻辑一致性。

title: Matrix-Decoupled Concentration for Autoregressive Sequences: Dimension-Free Guarantees for Sparse Long-Context Rewards
summary: Sequence-level evaluations in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on highly dependent token generation. Establishing tight concentration bounds for these processes remains a challenge due to two fundamental bottlenecks in existing frameworks: (i) classical inequalities typically separate dependency structures from target sensitivities, leading to a scalar collapse that inflates the variance proxy to a suboptimal $\mathcal{O}(N)$ for sparse terminal rewards; (ii) conversely, while certain spatial methods achieve tighter bounds, they lack the strictly causal filtration required by sequential generation, rendering them inapplicable to the autoregressive setting.
