However, heterogeneity remains a critical challenge, as subgraphs across clients typically differ significantly in both semantics and structures. Existing methods address heterogeneity by enforcing the rigid alignment of model parameters or prototypes between clients and the server. However, these alignments implicitly rely on a restrictive global linearity assumption that summarizes local data distributions using a single and globally consistent representation space. This severely compresses the personalized representation space of clients and fails to preserve diverse local graph distributions. To overcome these limitations, we propose Federated Graph Manifold Calibration (FedGMC), a novel paradigm that tackles semantic heterogeneity and structural heterogeneity from a unified manifold perspective. Instead of enforcing rigid alignment, FedGMC introduces a dual manifold calibration mechanism that preserves global commonalities while maximizing the personalized representation space of local clients. Specifically, for semantic heterogeneity, the server constructs a geometrically optimal semantic manifold via equidistant semantic anchors, so as to guide the calibration of local semantic manifolds. For structural heterogeneity, the server constructs a global structural manifold by building global structural templates, so as to guide the calibration of local structural manifolds. Finally, the server dynamically refines both global semantic manifolds and structural manifolds by aggregating local manifolds. Extensive experiments on eleven homophilic and heterophilic graphs demonstrate that FedGMC effectively balances global commonality and local personalization, thereby significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baseline methods.

AI.tldr: FedGMC是一种新型图联邦学习方法，通过双流形校准机制而非刚性参数对齐来同时处理语义和结构异构性，在保留全局共性的同时最大化本地客户的个性化表示空间。
AI.motivation: 现有图联邦学习方法通过强制对齐模型参数或原型来应对异构性，但这依赖于限制性的全局线性假设——即用单一全局一致的表示空间汇总局部数据分布。这严重压缩了客户的个性化表示空间，无法保留多样的本地图分布。
AI.method: FedGMC提出双流形校准机制：(1)语义层面，通过等距语义锚点构建几何最优的全局语义流形，指导局部语义流形校准；(2)结构层面，通过构建全局结构模板建立全局结构流形，指导局部结构流形校准。服务器端动态聚合本地流形以迭代优化全局流形。
AI.result: 在11个同配性和异配性图数据集上的实验表明，FedGMC有效平衡了全局一致性和局部个性化，显著优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FedGMC通过统一流形视角有效解决了图联邦学习中的异构性问题，在11个同配性和异配性图数据集上显著优于现有方法，证明了该方法在平衡全局一致性和局部个性化方面的有效性。

title: Inference-Time Refinement Closes the Synthetic-Real Gap in Tabular Diffusion
summary: Diffusion-based generators set the current state of the art for synthetic tabular data. These methods approach but rarely exceed real-data utility, and closing this synthetic-real gap has so far been pursued exclusively at training time, via architectural advances, scaling, and retraining of monolithic generators. The inference-time alternative, i.e., refining the outputs of a pre-trained backbone with parameters left untouched, has remained largely unexplored for tabular synthesis. We introduce TARDIS (Tabular generation through Refinement, Distillation, and Inference-time Sampling), an inference-time refinement framework that operates on a frozen pre-trained backbone, configured per dataset by a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator search over score-level guidance during reverse diffusion, with each trial's objective set by an inner grid search over post-hoc sample selectors and an optional soft-label distillation step. The search space encodes a single mathematical pattern we name Bidirectional Chamfer Refinement (BCR): the symmetric Chamfer functional between synthetic and real samples is minimized both continuously, via a score-level gradient, and discretely, via batch-ranking post-generation. The per-dataset search recovers BCR-aligned configurations on most datasets, evidence for BCR as the dominant refinement pattern. Across 15 binary, multiclass, and regression benchmarks TARDIS achieves a median +8.6% downstream-task improvement over models trained on real data (95% CI [+3.3, +16.4], Wilcoxon p=0.016, 11/15 strict wins) and improves over the TabDiff backbone on all 15 datasets (mean +12.9%, p<10^-4), matching the backbone on manifold fidelity, diversity, and sample-level privacy. Inference-time refinement of a pre-trained tabular diffusion backbone reaches and exceeds real-data utility in 1 to 80 minutes on a single consumer-grade GPU.

AI.tldr: TARDIS is an inference-time refinement framework for tabular data synthesis that operates on a frozen pre-trained diffusion backbone (TabDiff). It uses TPE-based search over score-level guidance to optimize Bidirectional Chamfer Refinement (BCR) — a pattern that minimizes symmetric distances between synthetic and real samples both continuously and discretely. Across 15 benchmarks, TARDIS achieves +8.6% median improvement over real data and +12.9% mean improvement over its backbone, completing in 1-80 minutes on a single GPU.
AI.motivation: Current diffusion-based tabular generators approach but rarely exceed real-data utility. Closing this gap has been pursued exclusively via training-time approaches (architectural advances, scaling, retraining). The inference-time alternative — refining pre-trained generator outputs without modifying parameters — remained largely unexplored for tabular synthesis.
AI.method: TARDIS uses Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) to search over score-level guidance in the reverse diffusion process. The search optimizes Bidirectional Chamfer Refinement (BCR) — a symmetric Chamfer functional minimizing distances between synthetic and real samples continuously via score gradients and discretely via batch-ranking post-generation. Per-dataset configuration includes post-hoc sample selectors and optional soft-label distillation. The frozen pre-trained backbone (TabDiff) remains untouched during inference.
AI.result: Across 15 binary, multiclass, and regression benchmarks, TARDIS achieves: (1) median +8.6% downstream-task improvement over models trained on real data (95% CI [+3.3, +16.4], Wilcoxon p=0.016, 11/15 strict wins); (2) improvement over TabDiff backbone on all 15 datasets (mean +12.9%, p<10^-4); (3) matching backbone performance on manifold fidelity, diversity, and sample-level privacy; (4) inference-time refinement completes in 1-80 minutes on a single consumer-grade GPU.
AI.conclusion: TARDIS achieved a median +8.6% improvement over real data across 15 benchmarks and +12.9% over the backbone TabDiff model (p<10^-4). Inference-time refinement completes in 1-80 minutes on a single GPU while maintaining manifold fidelity, diversity, and privacy. BCR is validated as the dominant refinement pattern for tabular synthesis.

title: Can Attribution Predict Risk? From Multi-View Attribution to Planning Risk Signals in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving models generate future trajectories from multi-view inputs, improving system integration but introducing opaque decisions and hard-to-localize risks. Existing methods either rely on auxiliary monitoring models or generate textual explanations, but are decoupled from the planning process and fail to reveal the visual evidence underlying trajectory generation. While attribution offers a direct alternative, planning differs from image classification by taking six-view camera images as input and predicting continuous multi-step trajectories, requiring attribution to capture both critical views and regions and their influence on outputs. Moreover, whether attribution maps can support risk identification remains underexplored. To address this, we propose a hierarchical attribution framework for end-to-end planning. Specifically, using L2 consistency with the original trajectory as the objective, we design a coarse-to-fine region attribution strategy that searches candidate regions across the full six-view input and refines attribution within them. We further extract three attribution statistics as predictive signals for planning risk, including attribution entropy to measure how concentrated the planner's reliance is over the joint visual space, within-camera spatial variance to characterize how spread out the attribution is within each view, and cross-camera Gini coefficient to quantify how unevenly attribution is distributed across the six cameras. Experiments on BridgeAD, UniAD, and GenAD show that these statistics correlate with planning risk, achieving Spearman correlations of $0.30 \pm 0.07$ with trajectory error and AUROC of $0.77 \pm 0.04$ for collision detection. The signal generalizes to held-out scenes with negligible degradation and remains stable under an alternative attribution baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向端到端自动驾驶规划的层级归因框架，通过粗到细区域搜索策略生成归因图，并提取归因熵、相机内空间方差、跨相机基尼系数三个统计量作为风险预测信号，在多个数据集上验证了这些信号与规划风险的关联性，可用于规划安全监控。
AI.motivation: 现有方法与规划过程解耦，无法揭示轨迹生成的视觉证据；规划任务与图像分类不同，需要从六视角摄像头输入预测连续多步轨迹，归因需同时捕获关键视角和区域及其对输出的影响。
AI.method: 采用粗到细的区域归因策略，在全视角输入中搜索候选区域并进行归因细化；提取三个归因统计量作为规划风险的预测信号：归因熵、相机内空间方差、跨相机基尼系数。
AI.result: 在BridgeAD、UniAD、GenAD上实验验证，归因统计量与规划风险相关：与轨迹误差的Spearman相关性达0.30±0.07，碰撞检测AUROC达0.77±0.04；在未见场景上泛化良好，不同归因方法下性能稳定。
AI.conclusion: 提出的层级归因框架能够有效识别端到端自动驾驶规划中的风险，可作为规划安全监控的辅助信号，在不同场景和归因方法间具有良好的泛化能力。

title: A Flow Matching Algorithm for Many-Shot Adaptation to Unseen Distributions
summary: While generative modeling has achieved remarkable success on tasks like natural language-conditioned image generation, enabling model adaptation from example data points remains a relatively underexplored and challenging problem. To this end, we propose Function Projection for Flow Matching (FP-FM), an algorithm that directly conditions generation on samples from the target distribution. FP-FM learns basis functions to span the velocity fields corresponding to a set of training distributions, and adapts to new distributions by computing a simple least-squares projection onto this basis. This enables efficient generation of samples from diverse target distributions without additional training at inference time. We further introduce multiple variants of FP-FM that provide a trade-off in expressivity and compute by enriching the coefficient calculation, e.g., by making the coefficients dependent on time. FP-FM achieves greatly improved precision and recall relative to baselines across synthetic and image-based datasets, with especially strong gains on unseen distributions.

AI.tldr: FP-FM是一种用于流匹配的条件生成算法，通过学习基函数来表示多个训练分布的速度场，并利用最小二乘投影快速适应新分布，无需额外训练即可生成目标分布样本。
AI.motivation: 当前生成模型在自然语言条件图像生成方面已取得显著成功，但如何从少量示例数据点实现模型自适应仍是一个未被充分探索且具有挑战性的问题。
AI.method: FP-FM学习基函数来跨越一组训练分布对应的速度场，通过简单的最小二乘投影计算来适应新分布。此外还引入了多种变体，通过丰富系数计算（如让系数依赖时间）来在表达力和计算成本之间提供权衡。
AI.result: FP-FM在合成数据集和图像数据集上均实现了显著提升的精确率和召回率，特别是在未见过的分布上表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够高效地从多样化目标分布生成样本，且在推理时无需额外训练，为基于示例的生成式适应提供了有效解决方案。

title: When Labels Have Structure: Improving Image Classification with Hierarchy-Aware Cross-Entropy
summary: Standard cross-entropy is the default classification loss across virtually all of machine learning, yet it treats all misclassifications equally, ignoring the semantic distances that a class hierarchy encodes. We propose Hierarchy-Aware Cross-Entropy (HACE), a drop-in replacement for standard cross-entropy that incorporates a known class hierarchy directly into the loss. HACE combines two components: prediction aggregation, which propagates the model's probability mass upward through the class hierarchy to ensure that parent nodes accumulate the confidence of their children; and ancestral label smoothing, which distributes the ground-truth signal along the path from the true class to the root. We evaluate HACE on CIFAR-100, FGVC Aircraft, and NABirds in two regimes: end-to-end training across six architectures spanning convolutional and attention-based designs, and linear probing on frozen DINOv2-Large features. In end-to-end training, HACE improves accuracy over standard cross-entropy in 15 out of 18 architecture--dataset pairs, with a mean gain of 4.66\%. In linear probing on frozen DINOv2-Large features, HACE outperforms all competing methods on all three datasets, with a mean improvement of 2.18\% over the next best baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Hierarchy-Aware Cross-Entropy (HACE)损失函数，通过预测聚合和祖先进似标签平滑两个机制将类层次结构信息融入交叉熵损失。在CIFAR-100、FGVC Aircraft和NABirds三个数据集上，相比标准交叉熵和多层次损失方法均有显著提升，且可作为直接替代方案零成本部署。
AI.motivation: 标准交叉熵对所有错误分类一视同仁，忽略了类层次结构编码的语义距离信息，导致层次化分类任务中对语义相近错误的惩罚不足。
AI.method: 提出HACE，包含两个核心组件：(1) 预测聚合——将模型的概率质量沿类层次结构向上传播，确保父节点累积其子节点的置信度；(2) 祖先进似标签平滑——将真实标签的监督信号沿从真类到根节点的路径进行分布式传播。
AI.result: 端到端训练：18个架构-数据集组合中15个实现精度提升，平均增益4.66%；DINOv2-Large冻结特征线性探测：三个数据集上均超越所有对比方法，平均领先最优基线2.18%。
AI.conclusion: HACE作为标准交叉熵的直接替代方案，在层次化分类任务中表现出显著优势，可有效提升模型性能而不增加推理复杂度。

title: PACE: Prune-And-Compress Ensemble Models
summary: Ensemble models achieve state-of-the-art performance on prediction tasks, but usually require aggregating a large number of weak learners. This can hinder deployment, interpretability, and downstream tasks such as robustness verification. Remedies to this issue fall into two main camps: pruning, which discards redundant learners, and compression, which generates new ones from scratch. We introduce PACE, a framework that interleaves these paradigms in a two-phase strategy. First, new learners are actively generated via a theoretically grounded procedure to enhance the diversity of the initial ensemble. When no more relevant learners can be found, a second phase of pruning is performed on this enriched ensemble. During both operations, PACE allows fine control on the faithfulness to the original ensemble. Experiments show that our method outperforms prior pruning and compression methods while offering principled control of faithfulness guarantees.

AI.tldr: PACE是一种集成模型压缩框架，通过交替执行压缩生成和剪枝操作，在提升模型效率的同时保持对原始集成的高保真度，实验验证其性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 集成模型虽性能卓越，但聚合大量弱学习器会带来部署困难、可解释性差及鲁棒性验证复杂等问题。现有的压缩方法（剪枝或压缩）各有利弊，需寻找更优平衡。
AI.method: 提出PACE框架，采用两阶段策略：第一阶段通过理论支撑的主动生成程序创建新学习器以增强集成多样性；第二阶段对丰富后的集成执行剪枝操作。两阶段均支持对原模型保真度的精细控制。
AI.result: 实验表明PACE在性能上优于现有的剪枝和压缩方法，同时提供可量化的保真度保证。
AI.conclusion: PACE框架通过两阶段策略（先生成后剪枝）实现对集成模型的有效压缩，同时提供对原始模型保真度的精细控制。这种交替结合压缩和剪枝的方法能够平衡模型性能和部署效率。

title: INEUS: Iterative Neural Solver for High-Dimensional PIDEs
summary: In this paper, we introduce INEUS, a meshfree iterative neural solver for partial integro-differential equations (PIDEs). The method replaces the explicit evaluation of nonlocal jump integrals with single-jump sampling and reformulates PIDE solving as a sequence of recursive regression problems. Like Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), INEUS learns global solutions over the entire space-time domain, yet it offers a more efficient treatment of nonlocal terms and avoids the computationally expensive differentiation of full PIDE residuals. These features make INEUS particularly well suited for high-dimensional PDEs and PIDEs. Supported by a contraction-based convergence proof for linear PIDEs, our numerical experiments show that INEUS delivers accurate and scalable solutions for various high-dimensional linear and nonlinear examples.

AI.tldr: INEUS 是一种面向高维偏积分微分方程(PIDE)的无网格迭代神经求解器:用"单次跳跃采样"替代非局部跳跃积分的显式数值积分,把 PIDE 求解重构为一串递归回归问题;配合硬约束 PINN(hPINN)与 DGM 网络,在 d=100~150 维仍给出高精度全局解,计算成本明显低于标准 PINN 与 deep BSDE。理论方面在线性 PIDE 下给出基于 Feynman–Kac 半群收缩性的收敛证明。
AI.motivation: 1) 高维 PDE/PIDE 遭遇维数灾难:有限差分/有限元需空间离散,成本随状态维度指数增长。2) PINN 虽能学习整个时空域的全局解,但对非局部跳跃项不友好:必须在每个配点做数值积分(通常 64 次 MC 采样),且残差含二阶空间导数,反传需三阶混合导数,昂贵且数值敏感。3) Feynman–Kac / deep BSDE 类方法能把跳跃并入随机动力学,但仅适用于抛物型 PIDE,依赖离散化随机过程,误差随时间步累积,只能在有限时间网格上给出局部解,难以逼近全局解。4) 深度学习在 PIDE 上的文献相对稀少,缺乏兼顾"全局解 + 高效非局部处理"的方案。
AI.method: 1) 无期望算子:定义 𝒢_ξ(t,x,e,u)=u(t,x)+ξ[∂_t u+ℱ(u,∇u,∇²u)+λℓ(u(t,x+γ(t,x,e))−u(t,x))],跳跃项只在单个抽样 e~ν 上求值,不做数值积分。命题 2.1 证明 PIDE 解 u 是 E[(v(Y)−𝒢_ξ(Y,E₁,u))²] 的最小化者(条件期望性质);引理 2.2 证明该回归更新等价于算子 T̄u=u+ξ𝒜[u],其不动点即 PIDE 的经典解。2) 递归训练:hPINN 硬约束终值/边界条件(u_θ=A+B·v_θ),目标网络权重冻结,反向传播只需 ∇_θ u_θ,免除三阶混合导数;每次迭代用小批量梯度下降(N 步)。3) 方向微分技巧(命题 C.2):用一元函数的二阶导数替代显式梯度与 Hessian(避免 O(d²) 复杂度);非线性 HJB 型经对数变换 v=e^{−ηu}(引理 C.3)同样适用。4) 收敛理论(限线性 PIDE):Feynman–Kac 表示 → 仿射算子族 𝒯_h=𝒮_h+𝒛_h;半群 𝒮_h 单调且严格收缩(模 ρ_h=e^{−c₀h}),生成元 𝒜_0=∂_t+ℒ+ℐ−c;松弛算子 T̃_h=Ψ+(α/h)(𝒯_hΨ−Ψ) 在 0<α<2h/(1+ρ_h) 时为收缩映射,PIDE 解为其唯一不动点;泰勒展开(命题 3.4)证明重复最小化 (7) 同时逼近 𝒯_h 与 T̃_h(误差 O(αh/(n−1))+O(αh^{n−1})),配合 Polyak 平均提升稳定性。5) 算法 1:外层 epoch k、内层 n−1 步递归、ξ=h/(n−1),Polyak 更新后每 K=10 个 epoch 通过"蒸馏"回归把目标投影回 hPINN 类;参数 M=1024, n=20, N=32, k*=1000, Adam lr=5e−4, α=0.4, h=0.5,RAD 采样(BS 问题叠加路径采样)。基线:同架构 PINN/DGM(64 次跳跃 MC)与含跳跃的 deep BSDE(多初始点 + 监督全局代理)。
AI.result: 线性 PIDE(有解析解):d=100 时 INEUS 与解析解吻合,而标准 PINN 已不可行;d=10 对比显示 INEUS 每 epoch 收敛略快、运行时间显著更低,且 MAE-时间曲线优于 deep BSDE(含跳跃),后者因离散化误差累积与域覆盖不足而退化。非线性 HJB PIDE(d=100,含高斯跳跃):与 Feynman–Kac MC 参考解吻合。非线性 Black–Scholes 含违约风险 PIDE(d=100):无跳跃得 u(0,x₀)≈57.300(对齐文献基准),含跳跃得 ≈55.810(对齐前向 Picard 基准)。可扩展性:线性 PIDE 从 d=10→150,MAE 0.00043→0.0409,耗时仅 4120→5028 s;线性 BS PIDE d=5→100,MAE 约 0.02–0.03;非线性 PIDE d=5→100,MAE 0.0049→0.2526。即使去掉跳跃项(纯 PDE),INEUS 仍比 PINN 更高效。代价:递归方法训练稳定性弱于残差型 PINN,误差曲线波动更大(靠松弛算子+Polyak 平均缓解)。
AI.conclusion: INEUS 把"PINN 式全局逼近"与"Feynman–Kac/BSDE 式非局部项高效处理"结合起来,通过单跳跃无期望目标 + 递归回归 + 硬约束网络,实现了高维 PIDE 的无网格全局求解,并在精度—时间曲线上优于 PINN 与 deep BSDE;在线性情形下给出了收缩性收敛论证,把迭代更新与 Feynman–Kac 半群及其松弛版本联系起来,松弛参数 α 提供额外的稳定性调节手段。局限与展望:收敛分析仅覆盖线性 PIDE 且依赖较强光滑性/半群结构,非线性情形需全新理论工具;递归训练稳定性仍不及残差方法,未来可考虑自适应松弛因子、改进采样,并有望推广到随机控制问题。

title: Attributions All the Way Down? The Metagame of Interpretability
summary: We introduce the metagame, a conceptual framework for quantifying second-order interaction effects of model explanations. For any first-order attribution $φ(f)$ explaining a model $f$, we measure the directional influence of feature $j$ on the attribution of feature $i$, denoted as meta-attribution $\varphi_{j \to i}(f)$, by treating the attribution method itself as a cooperative game and computing its Shapley value. Theoretically, we prove that attributions hierarchically decompose into meta-attributions, and establish these as directional extensions of existing interaction indices. Empirically, we demonstrate that the metagame delivers insights across diverse interpretability applications: (i) quantifying token interactions in instruction-tuned language models, (ii) explaining cross-modal similarity in vision-language encoders, and (iii) interpreting text-to-image concepts in multimodal diffusion transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"元游戏"(metagame)框架，通过将归因方法本身建模为合作博弈并计算其Shapley值，来量化模型解释中的二阶交互效应。理论上证明了归因可层次分解为元归因；实践中应用于指令微调语言模型、视觉-语言编码器和扩散Transformer的分析。
AI.motivation: Existing attribution methods only provide first-order explanations but lack a framework for quantifying directional second-order interaction effects between features in explanations.
AI.method: Treat the attribution method itself as a cooperative game and compute its Shapley value to measure the directional influence (meta-attribution $\varphi_{j \to i}(f)$) of feature $j$ on the attribution of feature $i$.
AI.result: Meta-attributions successfully quantify token interactions in instruction-tuned LMs, explain cross-modal similarity in vision-language encoders, and interpret text-to-image concepts in multimodal diffusion transformers.
AI.conclusion: Meta-attributions hierarchically decompose first-order attributions and serve as directional extensions of existing interaction indices, with practical applications in analyzing language models, vision-language encoders, and diffusion transformers.

title: Region Seeding via Pre-Activation Regularization: A Geometric View from Piecewise Affine Nerual Networks
summary: Deep networks with continuous piecewise affine activations induce polyhedral partitions of the input space, making the number of realized affine regions a natural measure of expressive capacity and a key determinant of how well the model can approximate nonlinear target functions. In practice, standard training realizes far fewer region refinements in data-visited neighborhoods than the architecture could in principle support, while existing region-count theory is primarily architectural and offers little guidance on how optimization shapes the realized partition near the data. Our theory provides a sufficient condition under which bringing neuron switching surfaces sufficiently close to data points ensures their intersection with local neighborhoods, which in turn implies a strict increase in the local affine-region count, yielding a principled training-time handle for seeding data-relevant partitions early in optimization. Guided by these results, we propose a plug-and-play region-seeding regularizer that encourages early partitioning while allowing task-driven refinement to dominate later in training. Experiments show that the regularizer increases the number of realized affine regions via exact enumeration and improves overall performance on toy datasets, while also improving early-stage accuracy and achieving comparable (or slightly improved) final accuracy on ImageNet-1k for classical models.

AI.tldr: 本文从局部几何视角分析连续分段线性(CPA)网络的仿射区域增长机制：提出两个局部定理(定理1：新增神经元零集与数据邻域相交则局部仿射区域数严格增加；定理2：预激活幅度足够小是零集与邻域相交的充分条件)，并据此设计"区域播种"(region-seeding)正则器——对各激活模块的预激活做归一化ℓ2惩罚，按深度加权(浅层更重)并随epoch线性退火。玩具数据集上精确枚举验证区域数增加、精度提升；ImageNet-1k上早期精度更高、最终精度持平或略优。
AI.motivation: 已有CPA网络仿射区域数的理论(Hanin & Rolnick等)主要是架构层面的、给出的是全局上界，既无法在训练中直接监测，也完全没有回答"优化过程如何在数据附近塑造已实现的分区"这一问题。实证上，标准训练在数据访问到的邻域内实现的区域细分远少于架构上限，导致模型的局部表达能力被浪费。该文因此寻求一种保持架构不变、可在训练期直接操作的手段，把区域细化的压力引导到数据相关的邻域。
AI.method: 几何观察：每个隐藏神经元在输入空间诱导一个切换超平面；数据点x到该超平面在父区域内的距离为 |z_{ℓ,i}(x)|/‖a_{ℓ,i}‖，其中 z 为预激活、a=A_{ℓ-1}^T w 为输入空间法向。因此压小数据上的预激活幅度即可拉近切换面与数据的距离。理论上给出两个局部定理(附完整证明，含"遗传局部非退化"假设A1的三个子条件：A1有限CPA复杂度、A2正则非折叠迹且切于内部、A3相交迹的非冗余性；以及引理3关于闭集与内部相交单元计数相等)：定理1证明新增零集与凸邻域内部相交会使局部区域数N_ε至少+1，且 N_ε ≥ 1+I_ε，局部一般位置下还有上界 N_ε ≤ Σ_{k=0}^d C(I_ε,k)；定理2给出以预激活量表述的充分条件 |z_{ℓ,i}(x)| < δ_ε(x; a_{ℓ,i})·‖a_{ℓ,i}‖，保证 Z_{ℓ,i} ∩ int(P_ε(x)) ≠ ∅，其中 δ_ε 为邻域沿法向的方向厚度。据此提出即插即用的正则化器：逐层惩罚 R_ℓ = (1/|B|)Σ_b ‖vec(u_ℓ(x_b))‖₂/n_ℓ；总正则 R = α·η(t)·Σ_ℓ λ_ℓ R_ℓ，其中 λ_ℓ = 4(L−ℓ+1)/(L+1)(浅层更重)，η(t)=max(0,1−t/T_max) 线性退火；总损失 L = L_task + R。实现为包装器模块，支持ReLU/LeakyReLU/GELU(GELU情形仅作启发式扩展，不依赖CPA机制)。
AI.result: 玩具实验(Random数据集，500样本、ℝ²、500 epoch、Adam lr=1e-4、batch 64、α=1e-2、3个随机种子)：对前馈MLP(5×32)与残差MLP在有/无BN四种设置下，用精确枚举得到[−1,1]²上实现的满维仿射区域数并可视化分区；加入正则器后区域数一致增加、任务损失下降更快、大多数epoch测试精度更高，且趋势在BN下依然成立。附录在Two Moons与Gaussian Quantiles(5类、宽度64)上复现相同结论；直方图显示正则化模型的数据到超平面log距离分布明显左移(更负)，验证机制。ImageNet-1k(90 epoch SGD,α=1e-3;ViT-B/16 300 epoch AdamW,α=1e-2,3 seeds)：VGG-19 noBN、ResNet-18、ResNet-50、ViT-B/16在训练早期Top-1/Top-5均高于基线、去正则项的任务损失下降更快，随训练推进差距收窄，末期精度与基线相当或略高。消融显示"线性退火+深度衰减权重"组合最优：不退火会损害最终精度，均匀权重(尤其重罚深层)不如浅层重罚。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把"CPA网络表达力"从架构层面的静态计数推进到训练期可操控的局部几何层面：给出了从可观测的预激活量到局部仿射区域数严格增长的完整理论链条，并落地为一个零额外开销的正则器，证明了"先播种、后精修"策略的有效性。局限在于：理论依赖较强的非退化性假设(A1/A2/A3)，是局部充分条件而非必要条件；对ViT等非CPA激活只有经验性启发式解释而无论证；ImageNet规模上无法精确枚举区域数，区域增长只能间接通过早熟收敛来推断；最终精度无显著提升，主要价值在于早期加速。展望方向是设计更多显式促进数据邻域局部细分的目标函数，并推广到非凸/软划分与更深架构。

title: Molecules Meet Language: Confound-Aware Representation Learning and Chemical Property Steering in Transformer-VAE Latent Spaces
summary: Molecular generative models often assume meaningful latent geometry, but apparent property predictability can reflect sequence-level shortcuts rather than chemical organization. We study this issue in an unsupervised autoregressive Transformer-VAE trained on SELFIES. After training, we freeze the model, fit linear probes to RDKit descriptors, and use the probe weights as candidate global steering directions. To separate chemical signal from SELFIES artifacts, we introduce a confound-aware evaluation based on residualization, confound-direction alignment analysis, and decoded-molecule traversal. This is necessary because SELFIES length, branch tokens, ring tokens, and token entropy are strongly encoded in the latent space. Under this confound-aware evaluation, we find robust monotonic steering for cLogP, FractionCSP3, HeavyAtomCount, TPSA, BertzCT, and HBA. Nonlinear probes further show that some properties admit stable global directions, while others are better described by local latent gradients. Overall, our results show that chemically meaningful steering can emerge in entangled molecular latent spaces, but only when validated through decoded molecules and controlled for representation-level confounds.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了分子生成模型潜在空间中属性控制的有效性，发现SELFIES表示中的特定伪影会严重影响潜在空间的化学解释。通过引入混杂感知评估方法，证明了在控制表示层面的混杂因素后，化学有意义的属性控制是可行的，但必须通过解码分子进行验证。
AI.motivation: 分子生成模型通常假设潜在空间具有有意义的几何结构，但可观察的属性可预测性可能反映的是序列级捷径而非化学组织。SELFIES表示中的特定伪影（长度、分支令牌、环令牌、令牌熵）会强烈编码到潜在空间中，需要开发新的评估方法来正确区分化学信号与表示层面的混杂因素。
AI.method: 使用无监督自回归Transformer-VAE在SELFIES分子表示上进行训练。通过拟合线性探针到RDKit描述符来识别全局控制方向，并引入基于残差化、混杂方向对齐分析和分子解码遍历的混杂感知评估框架，以区分化学信号与SELFIES伪影。
AI.result: 在混杂感知评估下，发现cLogP、FractionCSP3、HeavyAtomCount、TPSA、BertzCT和HBA等属性具有稳健的单调控制能力。非线性探针进一步表明，某些属性（如HBA）可获得稳定的全局控制方向，而其他属性更适合用局部潜在梯度来描述。
AI.conclusion: 在纠缠的分子潜在空间中，化学有意义的控制是可行的，但必须通过解码分子验证并控制表示层面的混杂因素。研究还发现某些属性（如cLogP）适合全局方向控制，而其他属性可能更适合通过局部潜在梯度来描述。

title: Perceive, Route and Modulate: Dynamic Pattern Recalibration for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Local temporal patterns in real-world time series continuously shift, rendering globally shared transformations suboptimal. Current deep forecasting models, despite their scale and complexity, rely on fixed weight matrices applied uniformly to all temporal tokens. This creates a static pattern response: models settle into a compromised average, unable to adapt to changing local dynamics. We introduce Dynamic Pattern Recalibration (DPR), a backbone-agnostic mechanism that resolves this via token-level recalibration. Through a lightweight "Perceive-Route-Modulate" pipeline, DPR computes a soft-routing distribution over a learned basis of adaptive response patterns, generating a time-aware modulation vector that recalibrates hidden states via a residual Hadamard product. As a backbone-agnostic adapter, DPR enhances forecasting across diverse architectures with minimal overhead, confirming it addresses a general bottleneck. As a minimalist standalone model, DPRNet achieves competitive performance across 12 benchmarks, validating dynamic recalibration against macroscopic parameter scaling.

AI.tldr: DPR（动态模式重校准）是一种用于时间序列预测的即插即用机制，通过"感知-路由-调制"管道在token级别进行动态调整，解决现有深度预测模型使用固定权重矩阵导致的静态模式响应问题。DPRNet作为独立模型在12个基准数据集上表现具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 当前深度预测模型依赖全局共享的固定权重矩阵，无法适应时间序列中不断变化的局部时间模式。模型被迫收敛到"折中平均值"，缺乏对动态局部特征的适应性，导致预测性能受限。
AI.method: DPR采用轻量级的"感知-路由-调制"管道：首先感知当前上下文，计算在自适应响应模式学习基上的软路由分布，生成时间感知的调制向量，最后通过残差Hadamard乘积对隐藏状态进行重校准。该方法支持两种部署模式：(1)作为骨干无关的适配器增强现有模型；(2)作为独立模型DPRNet。
AI.result: 作为适配器使用时，DPR以最小开销增强了多种架构的预测性能，验证了其解决通用瓶颈的能力。作为独立模型，DPRNet在12个基准数据集上达到具有竞争力的表现，证明了动态重校准机制相对于宏观参数缩放的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 动态token级重校准是时间序列预测的重要改进方向。DPR证明了通过轻量级机制实现动态模式适应比单纯增加模型参数量更具效率，为未来时间序列预测模型设计提供了新思路。

title: When Does $\ell_2$-Boosting Overfit Benignly? High-Dimensional Risk Asymptotics and the $\ell_1$ Implicit Bias
summary: Benign overfitting is well-characterized in $\ell_2$ geometries, but its behavior under the $\ell_1$ implicit bias of greedy ensembles remains challenging. The analytical barrier stems from the non-linear coupling of coordinate selection thresholds, which invalidates standard spectral resolvent tools. To isolate this algorithmic bias, we characterize the high-dimensional risk of continuous-time $\ell_2$-Boosting over $p$ features and $n$ samples. By coupling the Convex Gaussian Minimax Theorem with delicate asymptotic expansions of double-sided truncated Gaussian moments, we analytically resolve the non-smooth $\ell_1$ interpolant. Under an isotropic pure-noise model, we prove that benign overfitting fails at the linear rate: greedy selection localizes noise into sparse active sets, and the excess variance decays at a logarithmic rate $Θ(σ^2/\log(p/n))$ for noise variance $σ^2$. We remark that while this localization mechanism should persist in the presence of signals, the exact signal-noise decomposition remains an open problem. For spiked-isotropic designs with $k^*$ head eigenvalues and $r_2 = p - k^*$ tail dimensions, the risk converges to zero when $r_{2} \gg n$, but only at a logarithmic rate $Θ(σ^2/\log(r_2/n))$, which is slower than the linear decay observed in $\ell_2$ geometries. To avoid this slow convergence, we analyze the non-smooth subdifferential dynamics of the boosting flow. This yields a tuning-free early stopping rule that, under a bounded $\ell_1$-path condition, recovers the Lasso basic inequality and attains the minimax-optimal empirical prediction rate for $\ell_1$-bounded signals.

AI.tldr: 论文研究连续时间ℓ2-Boosting在ℓ1隐式偏差下的良性过拟合现象，证明了纯噪声模型中贪婪选择导致对数速率的过剩方差衰减（而非ℓ2几何下的线性衰减），并提出一种无需调参的早停规则在L1有界信号下达到最优预测率。
AI.motivation: 现有良性过拟合理论在ℓ2几何下已较完善，但ℓ1隐式偏差（即贪婪集成）下的行为缺乏分析工具，原因在于坐标选择阈值的非线性耦合破坏了标准谱预解式方法。
AI.method: 采用连续时间ℓ2-Boosting在高维 setting 下进行分析；核心技术工具为凸高斯 minimax 定理（CGMT）结合双侧截断高斯矩的精细渐近展开，以解析求解非光滑ℓ1插值器。
AI.result: 在纯噪声模型下，良性过拟合以线性速率失效——贪婪选择将噪声局部化到稀疏活跃集，过剩方差以对数速率Θ(σ²/log(p/n))衰减；在尖峰-各向同性设计下，当r₂≫n时风险趋于零，但仅以对数速率而非ℓ2几何下的线性衰减；早停规则在L1有界信号下可恢复Lasso基本不等式并达到最小最大最优率。
AI.conclusion: 提出关键发现：贪婪选择以对数速率将噪声局部化到稀疏活跃集；L1几何下的良性过拟合以Θ(σ²/log(p/n))速率失败，比L2几何的线性衰减慢；通过无调参早停规则可在L1有界信号下恢复Lasso基本不等式并达到最小最大最优经验预测率。

title: Pro-KLShampoo: Projected KL-Shampoo with Whitening Recovered by Orthogonalization
summary: Optimizers that exploit the matrix structure of gradients are central to modern LLM pre-training, with two distinct frontiers: explicit Kronecker-factored preconditioning -- most recently KL-Shampoo, which estimates the preconditioner via KL divergence minimization -- and orthogonalization of the gradient momentum, exemplified by Muon and analyzed as steepest descent under the spectral norm. The two routes are typically developed in isolation. We make a structural observation about KL-Shampoo's Kronecker preconditioners: their eigenvalue spectra exhibit a \emph{spike-and-flat} shape -- a few dominant eigenvalues followed by an approximately uniform tail -- across layers and training stages, holding exactly under a rank-$ρ$ signal-plus-noise gradient model. We exploit this structure by restricting one of KL-Shampoo's Kronecker factors to a parametric family aligned with the spike-and-flat shape: full spectral structure on a tracked $r$-dimensional subspace, single shared eigenvalue across the remaining $n-r$ directions. On these directions, we apply orthogonalization. An identity shows that this orthogonalization recovers the algebraic form of full KL-Shampoo's preconditioner. On four pre-training scales (GPT-2 124M / 350M, LLaMA 134M / 450M), Pro-KLShampoo consistently outperforms KL-Shampoo at every subspace rank we test in validation loss, peak per-GPU memory, and wallclock time to reach each loss level.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析KL-Shampoo中Kronecker预条件子的特征值谱呈现"尖峰-平坦"形状这一结构性质，创新性地将正交化方法与Kronecker因子预条件相结合，提出Pro-KLShampoo算法。该方法在r维子空间上保留完整谱结构，在其余方向上应用正交化，从而融合两种优化范式的优势，在多个预训练规模上实现了更好的性能和效率。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM预训练中存在两条优化器前沿：基于KL散度最小化的显式Kronecker因子预条件（如KL-Shampoo）和基于梯度动量正交化的方法（如Muon/谱范数下的最速下降）。这两条路线通常独立发展，缺乏统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 本文提出Pro-KLShampoo算法，核心思想是将KL-Shampoo的Kronecker预条件子限制为与尖峰-平坦特征相符的参数族：在r维子空间上保留完整谱结构，在剩余n-r方向上使用单一共享特征值，并在这些方向上应用正交化。论文给出了一个恒等式，证明该正交化可恢复完整KL-Shampoo预条件子的代数形式。
AI.result: 在GPT-2 124M/350M和LLaMA 134M/450M四个预训练规模上，Pro-KLShampoo在验证损失、峰值每GPU内存和达到特定损失水平的墙上时间三个维度上均一致性地超越KL-Shampoo，且该优势在所有测试的子空间秩设置下均成立。
AI.conclusion: Pro-KLShampoo通过在四个预训练规模上的实验验证了其有效性，在验证损失、峰值GPU内存和达到特定损失水平的墙上时间三个指标上均优于原始KL-Shampoo，且性能提升在所测试的所有子空间秩设置下保持一致。

title: SMolLM: Small Language Models Learn Small Molecular Grammar
summary: Language models for molecular design have scaled to hundreds of millions of parameters, yet how they learn chemical grammar is poorly understood. We train SMolLM, a 53K-parameter weight-shared transformer, to generate novel SMILES with 95% validity on the ZINC-250K drug-like-molecule benchmark, outperforming a standard GPT with 10 times more parameters. Mechanistically, the same block resolves SMILES constraints across passes in a fixed order: brackets first, rings second, and valence last, as shown by error classification, linear probing, and sparse autoencoders. A systematic ablation across attention heads and passes further localizes the first bracket-matching step to a single attention head. Together, these results yield a compact, mechanistically interpretable molecular generator and a testbed for studying iterative computation in formal-language domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SMolLM：一个仅 53K 参数、权重共享（单一 Transformer 块复用 8 次，即"循环/虚拟深度"架构）的自回归模型，在 ZINC-250K 上生成 SMILES 的 RDKit 有效率达 95.3%，优于参数多 10 倍的未共享 GPT（87.6%），并逼近参数量多 60 倍的 GPT-3.2M（99.4%）。机制上，共享块按固定层级逐轮（pass）解决 SMILES 约束：括号配对（pass 2）→ 环闭合数字长程配对（pass 4）→ 价键化学合法性（pass 8）；该顺序由错误分类、线性探针、稀疏自编码器（SAE）与注意力头消融四类证据一致支持。
AI.motivation: 分子生成的语言模型已从 RNN 发展到数亿参数级的 Transformer 判别器/生成器，但其"学习化学语法"的内部机制仍不清楚：规模是否是必要的？有效生成背后到底做了什么计算？先前机制可解释性工作（Elhage et al.; Varadi et al. 2025）多在每层独立权重的标准 Transformer 上分解电路，层间功能差异可能只反映参数差异而非计算差异，无法干净地分离"层身份"与"时间/迭代顺序"的混淆。同时，SMILES 不同于 SELFIES，其有效性完全依赖模型自行学会括号配对、环数字配对、价键合法这三类硬约束，因而可以在每个中间轮次上用精确符号检查量化"哪一类约束何时被解决"，为研究迭代计算（iterative computation）提供了理想的受控测试台。作者的目标是：把参数量压到 100 万以下的同时保持高有效性，并用权重共享把跨轮计算变得可观测、可因果验证。
AI.method:
架构与训练：基于 GPT 风格自回归 Transformer，pre-norm LayerNorm、输入/输出嵌入绑定、dropout 0.1、无 bias。对比三类模型：标准 GPT（学习位置编码+GELU，FFN 扩张 4×）、现代 GPT（RoPE+SwiGLU）、权重共享模型 WS（复用单个现代 GPT 块做 D 轮前向，D 称为"虚拟深度"，默认 D=8），另加参数量匹配的 GRU 基线。训练集为 ZINC-250K（249,455 个类药分子），用 RDKit 做 n_aug=10 的随机 SMILES 增广，字符级分词（词表 50，最长 128）；AdamW、100 epoch、batch 256、cosine LR（峰值 5e-4、200 步 warmup）、AMP、梯度裁剪 1.0；核心实验 3 种子（42/43/44），消融 1 种子，总计约 500 GPU-hours（MI210/MI250）。

评估：每模型采样 N=1,000（消融 n=2,000）条，温度 0.8、top-k=40；指标包括 RDKit 有效率、FCD（Fréchet ChemNet Distance，类比 FID）、内部多样性（1−平均两两 Tanimoto，Morgan r=2、1024-bit）、唯一性、新颖性（不在训练集中的比例）。

四类机制分析：(1) 错误分类——在 D∈{1,2,4,8,16} 各自单独训练的 WS-206K-D_N 上，把每个无效分子归入 Brackets/Rings/Valence/Other 单一失败类，并另用已训练 8 轮模型的输出头做逐轮中间读出，以排除"训练深度不同"的混淆；(2) 表征探针——在 8 轮模型的各轮隐状态上训练线性探针解码 bracket depth 与 ring state；在每轮隐状态上训练 512 特征的 SAE（单位 ℓ2 约束字典原子、L1 稀疏），考察与 is_bracket、is_ring_digit、bracket_depth、ring_state、is_atom 五类化学属性的特征相关性，并做 2,000→20,000 SMILES 的语料规模稳定性检验；(3) 因果消融——4 个头 × 8 轮共 32 个头-轮组合逐一零化，每条件生成 2,000 条分子，配 Bonferroni 校正；对照包括整轮消融与激活范数比较；(4) 容量对比——WS-53K 与 WS-206K 的时序差异。

鲁棒性检查：GRU 同参数对照、单表示（无增广）训练、解码温度/top-k/top-p 网格（12 个有效格，符号检验 p<10⁻³）、离线知识蒸馏（τ=2.0、α=0.5，教师 GPT-467K-mod）、DPO（5 epoch、lr 1e-5、β=0.1）、以及 800 epoch 训练算力对照与"移除迭代"（D=1）对照。
AI.result:
1) 参数-有效性帕累托前沿：WS-53K 有效率 95.3%±0.7 vs GPT-527K 87.6%±0.7（+7.7pp、参数少 10 倍），内部多样性持平（0.852 vs 0.851）；与 GPT-3.2M 差距 4.1pp（99.4%）但参数少 60 倍。1M 参数以下区间 WS 曲线全面占优。代价是 FCD 略差（2.5–2.9 vs 2.0–2.4）。记忆化轻微：有效样本仅 0.13% 为训练集精确复制，最近邻 Tanimoto 均值 0.52 < 训练集内部 0.59。

2) 虚拟深度扫描：WS-206K 有效率 D=1→2→4→8→16 为 33.0%→90.5%→97.1%→98.6%→98.7%，在 D=8 饱和；D=1→D=2 提升 58pp，之后收益递减。移除迭代使有效性下降 65pp；参数量更大但未共享的 GPT-241K（88.4%）、GPT-228K-mod（91.2%）仍低于 WS-206K（98.0%）；把现代 GPT 训练延长到 800 epoch（8 倍）仅达 94.2%，仍差 3.8pp，说明增益来自迭代本身而非训练算力或 RoPE/SwiGLU 等架构元素（标准 GPT-h4 91.6%→现代 94.4%→权重共享 98.0%，且参数减半）。

3) 鲁棒性：GRU-53K 87.7%、GRU-206K 95.5%，WS 在同参数下分别高 7.7pp 与 2.5pp（优势随循环容量增大而收窄）；无增广训练 WS-53K 降至 92.3%（−3.0pp）、WS-206K 降 0.2pp（种子方差内），说明增广有帮助但不如架构；解码参数网格中 WS-206K 在全部有效格优于 403K 现代 GPT；离线 KD 反而使有效性下降约 8pp（软标签把概率质量摊到非法 token，教师质量不是瓶颈），DPO 基本无损（98.5→97.6%）。

4) 跨轮约束层级：单独训练的 WS-206K-D_N 中，括号错误由 pass 1 的 23.0% 崩至 pass 2 的 1.3%；环错误在 pass 2→4 由 1.9% 降至 0.8%；价键错误在 pass 4→8 由 2.0% 降至 1.0%。对已训练 8 轮模型做逐轮中间读出，顺序不变（括号 pass 3 <5%、环 pass 5、价键 pass 6），排除训练深度混淆。

5) 表征层面同序：探针上 WS-53K 括号深度峰值 98.4%@pass 3、环状态 98.0%@pass 5；WS-206K 为 99.2%@pass 3、98.6%@pass 4。SAE 中 token 级检测器（is_bracket r=0.97、is_ring_digit r=0.99）与原子识别（r=0.84）早现于 pass 2–3，需跨 token 整合的 bracket depth 与 ring state 峰值延后（环状态 r=0.64@pass 5），WS-53K 的括号深度呈双峰（pass 2 与 8，r≈0.63/0.64，中间 r≈0.49）。特征-属性相关在语料从 2K 扩到 20K 时增强或保持（≤0.01），说明是涌现分解而非监督读出。

6) 因果定位：在 WS-206K 中括号匹配定位到单个注意力头（各种子为头 1/2/0），pass 1 消融该头使括号错误 +23pp 而环、价键错误不变，影响持续到 pass 2（+17pp）、pass 3（+5pp），pass 4 消失；其余所有头/轮变化均 <2pp。整轮消融仅使有效性降 0.5pp（约单头效应的 1/50），排除"早轮普遍敏感"；该头的 pass-1 激活范数反而最小，排除幅值驱动解释。WS-53K 无单头主导，最大 pass-1 增量仅 3pp，10pp 的均值效应由不同种子的不同头携带，说明小模型把括号匹配分布到多个头。

7) 容量只改变速率不改变顺序：WS-53K 与 WS-206K 满足同一约束序列，但前者各里程碑晚约 1 轮（逐轮有效率峰值 pass 8 vs 7；环状态探针 pass 5 vs 4；括号深度两者同为 pass 3），且实现方式从"单头集中"变为"跨头分布"。
AI.conclusion:
权重共享不只是压缩手段，更是把迭代计算"照亮"为可测步骤的方法：在具有精确符号约束的形式语言域中，同一参数块的跨轮变化可以直接归因于计算而非权重差异。SMolLM 表明 53K 参数即可达到接近 60 倍参数模型的有效性，并把亚兆参数区的帕累托前沿从"未共享 GPT"推向"共享块"；机制上共享块以固定层级（局部括号 → 长程环闭合 → 化学价键）逐轮扩大作用域地解决 SMILES 约束，且该层级在 53K–206K 参数间稳定，容量仅影响解决速度（速率）与功能的集中程度（单头 vs 分布），不改变顺序本身。

作者明确列出三项局限：(1) 实证范围限定于 ZINC-250K 的 SMILES 有效性计算，而非与表示无关的分子结构性质；(2) 机制测量为有限样本估计（SAE 仅 20,000 条 SMILES / ~770K token，稀有特征可能尚未出现；消融每条件 2,000 条分子，只能识别括号头的显著效应而难以分辨其他头的微小效应）；(3) 权重共享降低参数量但不降低自回归推理算力，因为 FLOPs 随轮数线性增长。

后续方向包括推广到其他具有分层约束的科学域（如 RNA 折叠从局部碱基配对到长程三级接触）、让每一轮分别解决不同空间/时间尺度的问题、以及设计匹配逐轮表征（而非仅匹配输出分布）的蒸馏目标以保留迭代计算。此外作者提示生成分子在未经毒性、安全性与可行性筛选前不应直接用于合成优先级排序。

在解读时应注意若干方法论边界：主要结论建立在单一数据集与单一表示（SMILES，且明确不以 SELFIES 为目标以保留语法/化学约束的学习空间）之上；GRU 对照仅 2 种子且训练轮数不匹配（25–30 vs 100 epoch），匹配轮数比较被留给未来工作；KD/DPO 相关消融多为单种子；论文中"虚拟深度"的轮次编号在正文（1-indexed）与代码（0-indexed）之间相差 1，复现时需注意映射。

title: LINC: Decoupling Local Consequence Scoring from Hidden Matching in Constructive Neural Routing
summary: Constructive neural routing solvers usually score the next action by matching a decoder context to candidate embeddings, hiding deterministic one-step consequences such as travel, waiting, slack, and capacity changes. We propose LINC (Local Inference via Normed Comparison), a decoder-side candidate decision architecture that computes these consequences explicitly. LINC uses them according to their decision role: centered relative consequences are compared by a shared linear local scorer, while feasible-set summaries modulate the decoder context. This preserves standard global matching and relieves the hidden state from rediscovering transition arithmetic. The Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (CVRPTW) serves as the main constrained-routing stress test; the same interface extends to the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) and Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). In particular, for CVRPTW, LINC reduces PolyNet's Solomon/Homberger gaps from 13.83\%/38.15\% to 7.26\%/14.71\%; for TSP and CVRP, it also improves external-benchmark gaps.

AI.tldr: LINC（Local Inference via Normed Comparison）是一种构建式神经路由求解器的**解码器端候选决策架构**：它把"确定性一步后果的计算"（行程时间、等待、时间窗松弛、到达/离开时刻、容量变化）与"学习这些后果的决策权重"彻底解耦。其做法是：环境在每个解码步显式计算候选节点的后果特征 φ_t(j)，用**状态条件化的共享线性比较器**（所有候选共用一个权重向量 v_t = W_φ^T h̃_t）打分，同时用**可行集摘要** r_t 调制解码上下文（FiLM 式 γ/β 与门控 α）。编码器仍只运行一次（静态键可缓存），全局匹配路径得以保留。核心优势在 CVRPTW：Solomon/Homberger 外部基准的无引导 gap 从 PolyNet 的 13.8%/38.14% 降至 7.3%/14.71%；TSP/CVRP 外部基准 gap 亦改善；免重训规模迁移优势随规模扩大而加剧（CVRPTW n=1000 相对 PolyNet 降低 51.11%）。代价是推理时间约 2×。
AI.motivation: 构建式神经组合优化（NCO）的主流范式（AM、POMO、PolyNet）通过编码器一次性生成并缓存静态节点嵌入，解码时仅以解码器上下文与候选键的内积 b_{t,j}=⟨h_t,k_j⟩ 打分。然而在 CVRPTW/CVRP 中，选择一个候选会确定性地改变行程时间、等待时长、服务起止时刻、时间窗松弛、剩余容量与后续可行集，这些"一步后果"虽被环境用于可行性判定，却未作为候选级输入暴露给网络，必须由模型从静态嵌入中隐式推断——这加重了表征负担，尤其在分布外/规模外推时。论文据此提出把"可由已知转移精确计算的量"从隐式匹配中显式化（动机类比语言模型把确定性计算委托给外部程序并把结果写入上下文），并与 algorithmic alignment、BQ-NCO/LEHD/ReLD 等"解码器瓶颈"工作相区分：LINC 不做全 MDP 商化，而是在单步打分接口层面做功能解耦。
AI.method: **架构**：最终 logit 为 u_{t,j} = α_t⟨h_t,k_j⟩ + ⟨h̃_t, W_φ φ_t(j)⟩，等价于用扩展查询 [α_t h_t; v_t] 匹配扩展键 [k_j; φ_t(j)]。**候选级后果向量**：CVRPTW 为 6 维 [归一化行程 ĉ_t(j)、等待 ŵ_t(j)、松弛 δ̂_t(j)、到达 arr̂_t(j)、离开 dep̂_t(j)、仓库视角夹角 θ̂_t(j)]，其中 arr=T_t+c_t(j)、w=max{e_j−arr,0}、dep=arr+w+q_j、δ=l_j−arr−w；CVRP 为 [ĉ, 需求比 d_j/max(Q_t,ε), 仓库距离 ĉ_0, θ̂]；TSP 为 [ĉ, 相对质心夹角]。仓库候选 j=0 由返回转移求值（零需求/等待/角度）。**可行集摘要**：r_t = [可行客户比 ρ_t=|F_t|/n、各特征均值、关键约束量最小值]（CVRPTW 用 min δ̂；CVRP 用 min(1−d̂)；TSP 用 min ĉ）。**调制**：[h_t; r_t] 经三个小 MLP 得 γ_t=tanh(·)、β_t、α_t=σ(·)，h̃_t=h_t⊙(1+γ_t)+β_t。**共享线性比较器**：v_t=W_φ^T h̃_t 在所有候选间共享，差分 logit 满足 ℓ_{t,j}−ℓ_{t,k}=v_t^T(φ_t(j)−φ_t(k))，故 v_t 可解释为各后果特征的边际偏好权重。**不变性**：附录证明客户置换等变（Proposition B.1）。**训练**：REINFORCE + z 向量采样 K=128 rollout；CVRPTW 从零训练并采用"匹配软 top-1"优势 A_i=(K−1)(m_loo(i)−m_all)（温度 τ 在 τ→∞ 时退化为 POMO 组均值优势、τ→0 时逼近 hard top-1）；TSP/CVRP 由 PolyNet 权重初始化并用 hard top-1，同时用 score morphing（u_final = u_ref + λ(u−u_ref)，λ 从 0 退火到 1，前 100 epoch 完成）以适配新打分接口。**数据**：自建 CVRPTW 程序化生成器，采样空间形态（聚类/均匀/带状/离群混合）、时间耦合、约束强度三维包络（附录 G）。**编码器辅助**：GateAttn 头级门控与 Depth Mixer 深度混合。
AI.result: **CVRPTW**（Table 2）：无引导下 Synthetic-100 gap 3.41%（PolyNet 8.59%）、Solomon-100 7.3%（13.8%）、Homberger-200 14.71%（38.14%）；SGBS 引导下进一步降至 2.18%/4.73%/7.82%（PolyNet SGBS 为 6.13%/9.18%/22.42%）。训练曲线显示 LINC 以更少累计实例达到 PolyNet 的最终训练分数。**TSP**（Table 3）：TSP100 均为 0.000%；TSP150 0.061% vs 0.064%；TSPLIB50–200 2.03% vs 3.27%（SGBS 0.59% vs 1.41%）。**CVRP**（Table 4）：CVRP100 0.48% vs 0.50%；CVRP150 2.17% vs 2.37%；CVRPXML100 3.20% vs 3.87%（SGBS 2.07% vs 2.51%）。**免重训规模迁移**（Table 5）：相对 PolyNet 的目标下降随规模扩大——TSP 500/1000 为 −1.11%/−2.44%，CVRP 为 −21.66%/−47.07%，CVRPTW Homberger 400/600/1000 为 −30.18%/−39.65%/−51.11%（同时平均车辆数大幅下降，如 n=1000 时 68.83 vs 155.88）。**等实例续训对照**（附录 K）：PolyNet 额外训练同等实例数后仍全面劣于 LINC（CVRP 六个设置 95% 配对 bootstrap 区间均偏向 LINC，最大 Holm 校正 p=1.54e−14），说明增益不来自额外训练。**消融**（Table 6/9）：去掉局部后果接口 +2.26%，改为朴素 2 层 MLP +2.31%，去掉步级摘要 +3.15%，去掉 Depth Mixer +1.44%，去掉 GateAttn −0.03%，改用 group_mean +5.77%，hard top-1 +0.57%。**预算敏感性**（Table 10）：z=400 的 LINC 在 CVRPTW/Homberger/Solomon 等外部集上仍优于 z=800 的 PolyNet，墙钟时间相当。**机制诊断**（附录 J）：α_t 门控在早中期保持活跃；旅行特征权重占主导，而在可行集变小时 wait/arr/dep/角度项权重上升，符合"先避免无效行程、后期重视时间紧迫性"的直觉。**代价**：推理时间约为基线 2×（如 Homberger 15s vs 8s），摘要/可行性掩码仍需每步计算。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出并验证了一条"功能解耦"设计原则：凡是已知转移/模拟器/约束过程能精确低成本计算的量，就应显式计算并交给网络，网络只负责学习如何权衡。LINC 以共享状态条件线性比较器 + 可行集摘要调制实现了该原则的实例化，在不重编码（编码器每实例仍只跑一次）的前提下把确定性过渡算术从隐式匹配中剥离，显著改善了受约束路由（CVRPTW）的外部基准表现与规模外推能力，同时 TSP/CVRP 的外部基准 gap 也随之下降。**局限**（4.6）：继承自 POMO/PolyNet 的自回归构造范式——单一序列构造、访问仓库即切分路线，缺乏显式多车辆协同机制，早期路线固定可能导致路径失衡与"早承诺"问题，一步后果特征不刻画跨路线耦合；此外显式后果项在训练早期可能主导 logit，导致策略坍缩为短视的"选最便宜候选"规则而削弱探索。未来工作：沿同一接口暴露廉价的多步（短视野）后果摘要，从一步比较走向"预测式局部比较"，并考虑并行路线构造或路线级 lookahead 以实现跨路线协调。

title: Eliciting associations between clinical variables from LLMs via comparison questions across populations
summary: The training data of large language models (LLMs) comprises a wide range of biomedical literature, reflecting data from many different patient populations. We investigate how it might be possible to recover information on correlation and causal links between patient characteristics, as a key building block for medical decision making. To avoid the pitfalls of direct elicitation, we propose an approach based on structured comparison questions, specifically patient comparison triplet questions. This is combined with a statistical model for the LLM representation that provides estimates of correlations without access to activations or model internals. Intuitively, we consider how similarity decisions of LLMs based on a first variable are affected by providing information on a second variable for one of the patients being assessed. We then induce prompt-level environment shifts to obtain correlation estimates for different subpopulations, which enables an invariant causal prediction (ICP) approach to obtain conservative candidate parent links. We demonstrate the method in two clinical domains, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and multiple sclerosis (MS). Across prompted environments, the elicited correlations are smooth, stable, and clinically interpretable, yet vary in a statistically significant way that supports downstream invariance testing, such that ICP provides a small set of candidate invariant parent links. These results show that indirect elicitation via triplet comparisons can recover meaningful association structure from LLMs and offer a cautious route from implicit correlations to causal statements that are congruent with LLM answering patterns.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索从LLM训练数据中恢复患者特征间相关性和因果关系的方法，通过患者比较三联问题和提示级环境变换技术，结合不变因果预测(ICP)框架，在COPD和MS两个临床领域验证了间接诱导方法能够恢复有意义且稳定的关联结构。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型训练数据包含大量生物医学文献和不同患者群体信息，但直接询问可能导致误导性结果，需要探索从LLM中恢复患者特征间相关性和因果链接信息的方法。
AI.method: 提出基于结构化比较问题的患者比较三联问题方法，结合LLM表示的统计模型，通过提示级环境变换获取不同亚群体的相关性估计，并应用不变因果预测(ICP)方法获得候选不变父链接。
AI.result: 在COPD和MS两个临床领域验证了方法可行性，诱导的相关性在不同提示环境中平滑、稳定且具有临床可解释性，同时在统计上存在显著差异，支持下游不变性检验，ICP方法能够提供一组候选不变父链接。
AI.conclusion: 间接通过三联比较问题的诱导方法能够从LLM中恢复有意义的关联结构，为从隐式相关性到符合LLM回答模式的因果陈述提供了一条谨慎的路径。

title: Topological Signatures of Grokking
summary: We study the grokking phenomenon through the lens of topology. Using persistent homology on point clouds derived from the embedding matrices of a range of models trained on modular arithmetic with varying primes, we identify a clear and consistent topological signature of grokking: a sharp increase in both the maximum and total persistence of first homology ($H_1$). Persistence diagrams reveal the emergence of a dominant long-lived topological feature together with increasingly structured secondary features, reflecting the underlying cyclic structure of the task. Compared to existing spectral and geometric diagnostics -- specifically, Fourier analysis and local intrinsic dimension -- persistent homology provides a unified geometric and topological characterization of representation learning, capturing both local and global multi-scale structure. Ablations across data regimes and control settings show that these topological transitions are tied to generalization rather than memorization. Our results suggest that persistent homology offers a principled and interpretable framework for analyzing how neural networks internalize latent structure during training.

AI.tldr: This paper uses persistent homology to analyze the grokking phenomenon in neural networks trained on modular arithmetic. The key finding is that grokking exhibits a distinctive topological signature — specifically, a sharp increase in H1 persistence — reflecting the cyclic structure of the underlying task. Unlike existing spectral or geometric methods, persistent homology provides a unified characterization capturing multi-scale structure. These topological transitions are shown to correlate with generalization rather than memorization.
AI.motivation: The paper addresses the need to understand the underlying mechanisms of grokking — the phenomenon where neural networks initially overfit then suddenly generalize. Existing diagnostic tools (spectral and geometric) provide fragmented insights, and there is a gap in unified frameworks that capture both local and global structure during this learning process.
AI.method: The authors apply persistent homology analysis to point clouds derived from embedding matrices of models trained on modular arithmetic tasks with varying primes. They compare this approach against existing spectral methods (Fourier analysis) and geometric diagnostics (local intrinsic dimension), and conduct ablation studies across different data regimes and control settings.
AI.result: A clear topological signature of grokking is identified: a sharp increase in both maximum and total persistence of first homology (H1). Persistence diagrams reveal the emergence of a dominant long-lived topological feature accompanied by increasingly structured secondary features, reflecting the underlying cyclic structure of the task.
AI.conclusion: Persistent homology provides a unified framework that captures both local and global multi-scale structure, offering principled and interpretable insights into how neural networks internalize latent structure during training. These topological transitions are specifically tied to generalization rather than memorization.

title: Order-Agnostic Autoregressive Modelling with Missing Data
summary: Order-Agnostic autoregressive models have demonstrated strong performance in deep generative modeling, yet their use in settings with incomplete data remains largely unexplored. In this work, we reinterpret them through the lens of missing data. First, we show that their standard training procedure on fully observed data implicitly performs imputation under a missing completely at random mechanism, resulting in robust out-of-sample imputation performance in settings with high missingness. Second, we introduce the first principled framework for training them directly on incomplete datasets under general missingness mechanisms. Third, we leverage their amortized conditional density estimation to perform active information acquisition, i.e., sequentially selecting the most informative missing variables for downstream prediction or inference. Across a suite of real-world benchmarks, our Missingness-Aware Order-Agnostic Autoregressive Model (MO-ARM) consistently outperforms established imputation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Missingness-Aware Order-Agnostic Autoregressive Model (MO-ARM)，首次将顺序无关自回归模型应用于不完整数据的系统性框架，通过隐式插补和主动信息获取机制，在多种真实基准上优于现有插补方法。
AI.motivation: 顺序无关自回归模型在深度生成建模中表现优异，但在不完整数据场景下的应用尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1) 从缺失数据角度重新解释模型；2) 证明标准训练过程隐式执行MCAR机制下的插补；3) 提出在一般缺失机制下直接训练不完整数据集的框架；4) 利用摊销条件密度估计进行主动信息获取，序贯选择最具信息量的缺失变量用于下游预测或推断。
AI.result: MO-ARM在多种真实世界基准测试中一致性地优于现有插补基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次建立了顺序无关自回归模型与缺失数据处理的系统性联系，证明了其在高缺失率场景下的鲁棒样本外插补性能，并开辟了主动信息获取的新应用方向。

title: Memory Efficient Full-gradient Attacks (MEFA) Framework for Adversarial Defense Evaluations
summary: This work studies the robust evaluation of iterative stochastic purification defenses under white-box adversarial attacks. Our key technical insight is that gradient checkpointing makes exact end-to-end gradient computation through long purification trajectories practical by trading additional recomputation for substantially lower memory usage. This enables full-gradient adaptive attacks against diffusion- and Langevin-based purification defenses, where prior evaluations often resort to approximate backpropagation due to memory constraints. These approximations can weaken the attack signal and risk overestimating robustness. In parallel, stochasticity in iterative purification is frequently under-controlled, even though different purification trajectories can substantially change reported robustness metrics. Building on this insight, we introduce a memory-efficient full-gradient evaluation framework for stochastic purification defenses. The framework combines checkpointed backpropagation with evaluation protocols that control stochastic variability, thereby reducing memory bottlenecks while preserving exact gradients. We evaluate diffusion-based purification and Langevin sampling with Energy-Based Models (EBMs), demonstrating that full-gradient attacks uncover vulnerabilities missed by approximate-gradient evaluations. Our framework yields stronger state-of-the-art $\ell_{\infty}$ and $\ell_{2}$ white-box attacks and further supports probing out-of-distribution robustness. Overall, our results show that exact-gradient evaluation is essential for reliable benchmarking of iterative stochastic defenses.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过梯度检查点技术实现精确全梯度计算，解决了迭代随机净化防御评估中的内存瓶颈问题，揭示了近似梯度评估高估鲁棒性的风险，并提供了更可靠的防御基准测试框架。
AI.motivation: 现有迭代随机净化防御的评估常因内存限制而采用近似反向传播，导致攻击信号弱化，可能高估防御鲁棒性；同时，迭代净化中的随机性控制不足，不同净化轨迹会显著改变鲁棒性评估结果。
AI.method: 结合梯度检查点技术与受控随机性评估协议，实现低内存占用的精确端到端梯度计算，从而支持对扩散模型和基于能量的模型进行全梯度白盒对抗攻击评估。
AI.result: 全梯度攻击揭示了近似梯度评估遗漏的防御漏洞，在ℓ∞和ℓ2范数下实现了更强的白盒攻击效果，并可探测分布外鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为迭代随机防御的可靠基准测试提供了重要工具，并通过精确梯度评估揭示了现有近似梯度方法可能高估防御鲁棒性的风险。

title: Preliminary Insights in Chronos Frequency Data Understanding and Reconstruction
summary: This paper presents a preliminary analysis of the ability of Chronos foundation model to process and internally represent frequency domain information. Foundation models that process time-series data offer practitioners a unified architecture capable of learning generic temporal representations across diverse tasks and domains, reducing the need for task-specific feature engineering and enabling transfer across signal modalities. Despite their growing adoption, the extent to which such models encode fundamental signal properties remains insufficiently characterised. We address this gap by analysing Chronos under controlled conditions, starting from the simplest class of signals: discrete sinusoids generated at fixed frequencies. Using lightweight online minimum description length probes applied to the decoder architecture, we test for the presence and separability of frequency information in the model's internal representations. The results provide insight into how frequential content is captured across the frequency spectrum and highlight regimes in which representation quality may degrade or require particular care. These findings offer practical guidance for users of Chronos in signal processing and information fusion contexts, and contribute to ongoing efforts to improve the interpretability and evaluation of foundation models for temporal data.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了Chronos基础模型处理和内部表征频域信息的能力。通过对简单离散正弦信号进行受控测试，发现模型能够捕获频率信息，但存在特定频率区域的表征质量退化问题。研究为信号处理和信息融合应用提供了实用指导。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型虽应用广泛，但对其编码基本信号特性的程度研究不足，存在认知缺口。
AI.method: 在受控条件下使用轻量级在线最小描述长度（MDL）探针对Chronos的解码器架构进行测试，检验频率信息在其内部表征中的存在性和可分离性。
AI.result: 揭示了频率内容在频谱中的捕获方式，并识别出模型表征质量可能退化或需要特别关注的频域区域。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为Chronos用户提供了信号处理和信息融合场景下的实践指导，并推进了时序基础模型的可解释性评估工作。研究表明需要在特定频率区域特别注意模型表征质量的潜在退化问题。

title: Flow Matching with Arbitrary Auxiliary Paths
summary: We introduce a new generative modeling framework, \textbf{Flow Matching with Arbitrary Auxiliary Paths (AuxPath-FM)}, which generalizes conditional flow matching by incorporating an auxiliary variable drawn from an arbitrary distribution into the probability path. Unlike prior methods that restrict auxiliary components to Gaussian noise, AuxPath-FM allows the variable $η$ to follow any distribution, producing trajectories of the form $X_t = a(t)X_1 + b(t)X_0 + c(t)η$. We theoretically demonstrate that this construction preserves the continuity equation and maintains a training objective consistent with the marginal formulation. This flexibility enables the design of diverse probability paths using various priors, including Gaussian, Uniform, Laplace, and discrete Rademacher distributions, each offering unique geometric properties for generative flows. Furthermore, our framework allows for specialized tasks such as label-guided generation by encoding structured semantic information into the auxiliary distribution. Overall, AuxPath-FM provides a principled and general foundation for probability path design, offering both theoretical generality and practical flexibility for diverse generative modeling tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AuxPath-FM框架，将辅助变量的分布从高斯噪声推广至任意分布，允许构建形式为X_t = a(t)X_1 + b(t)X_0 + c(t)η的多样化轨迹。该方法在保持理论一致性的同时，为生成模型提供了更灵活的概率路径设计空间。
AI.motivation: 现有条件流匹配方法将辅助变量限制为高斯噪声，缺乏灵活性，无法充分利用不同先验分布的独特几何特性来设计多样化的概率路径。
AI.method: 将来自任意分布的辅助变量η引入概率路径，构建形式为X_t = a(t)X_1 + b(t)X_0 + c(t)η的轨迹，证明了该构造保持连续性方程并与边际公式化的训练目标一致。
AI.result: 该框架支持多种先验分布（高斯、均匀、拉普拉斯、离散Rademacher等），每种分布提供不同的几何特性；可编码结构化语义信息实现标签引导生成。
AI.conclusion: AuxPath-FM为概率路径设计提供了兼具理论严谨性和实践灵活性的通用框架，可应用于生成建模、标签引导生成等多种任务。

title: Layer Collapse in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as competitive alternatives to autoregressive (AR) language models, yet differences in their activation dynamics remain poorly understood. We characterize these dynamics in LLaDA-8B and identify a striking layer-collapse property: a few early layers exhibit highly similar, collapsed activation patterns dominated by a single large super-outlier persisting over a long token range. Despite its apparent redundancy, this outlier is critical: pruning it causes outputs to degrade into repetitive random token loops. Paradoxically, layers in LLaDA contain more redundant representations overall, with redundancy most pronounced in earlier layers -- the reverse of AR models, where deeper layers grow redundant due to undertraining. Our analysis indicates that layer collapse in DLMs is not driven by undertraining but by overtraining: a dominant outlier becomes an indispensable information carrier while remaining representations collapse into redundant structure. These findings have strong practical implications, verified through controlled pre-training experiments. DLMs are surprisingly robust to compression: LLaDA under 3-bit GPTQ quantization drops only -1.8% on GSM8K, whereas Llama-3.1-8B drops -64.7%. Optimal sparsity allocation also reverses between families: at 50% average sparsity, allocating more to early layers in LLaDA yields +8.4% over the reverse strategy, while the same allocation costs Llama -8.4%. Our findings reveal that the DLM training objective fundamentally reshapes layer dynamics relative to AR models, with direct consequences for compression and deployment. Code: github.com/Conzel/super-outlier-dlm.

AI.tldr: 本文发现扩散语言模型（DLM，如 LLaDA-8B）存在"层坍塌"现象：少数早期层中单个激活通道（super-outlier，通道 3848）在所有 token 位置上持续保持极高幅值（约为次大离群值的 5 倍），主导并压制了其他通道的表达，使这些层产生几乎共线的冗余表示；剪掉该通道会使模型输出退化为随机 token 循环。层间相似度结构与自回归模型（AR）相反：LLaDA 早期层冗余度极高，Llama-3.1-8B 则深层冗余（curse of depth）。权重谱重尾分析（Hill 估计）表明这不是"欠训练"而是"过训练"所致。实践后果：DLM 抗压缩能力远超 AR（3-bit GPTQ 下 LLaDA 仅 -1.8% 而 Llama -64.7%），且最优稀疏分配方向相反（50% 稀疏下 LLaDA 早层更稀疏 +8.4%，Llama 则 -8.4%）。作者通过同条件预训练的 AR-160M / DLM-160M 对照实验，证明这些现象源于扩散训练目标本身。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）正成为自回归语言模型（AR）的有力替代品，但其内部激活动态与 AR 模型的差异尚不清楚。AR 模型文献中已广泛报道注意力汇（attention sink）、massive activations、super-weights 等现象，且已知 AR 模型深层因欠训练而高度冗余（curse of depth）。这些结论能否迁移到 DLM，直接影响 DLM 的训练、微调与压缩策略。作者因此系统刻画 DLM 的激活直方图、层间相似度与权重谱，并考察压缩（量化/剪枝）表现，以判断基于 AR 经验提出的启发式（如 OWL 对强离群层降低稀疏率）在 DLM 上是否成立。
AI.method: 1）指标：以逐 token 余弦相似度定义层间相似度 sim(i,j)=E[<h_i,h_j>/(||h_i||·||h_j||)]，作为层冗余度代理；激活用 C4 校准集 128 条长度 2048 序列估计（DLM 样本复制 4 次并随机 mask 一定比例 token，附录验证不 mask 结论不变）。2）层训练性度量：依据 Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization，用 W^T W 特征值的 Hill 估计 α_Hill 衡量权重谱重尾程度（值越小越重尾、训练越充分/过训练），k 由 fix-finger 方法确定。3）离群通道分析：统计 QKV 输入各层 top-5 通道幅值，定位 super-outlier（通道 3848），并做单通道剪除消融。4）压缩实验：对 LLaDA-8B 与 Llama-3.1-8B 使用 WANDA 剪枝（128 条 C4 校准）与 GPTQ 量化（256 条校准），稀疏率 0.3/0.5/0.7，三种分配策略（uniform、earlier-is-sparser、DIS，线性 ε=0.08）；评估 ARC-C/HellaSwag/PIQA/WinoGrande/BoolQ/OBQA 与 GSM8K（DLM 用 FastDLLM，block=32、生成 1024 步、每步 1 token、low-confidence remasking）。5）受控对照：Pythia-160M 架构、FineWebEdu 100B tokens、仅训练目标不同（因果交叉熵 vs 带 mask 的重要性加权交叉熵）预训练 AR-160M 与 DLM-160M，重复相似度、α_Hill、剪枝/量化实验。
AI.result: 1）LLaDA-8B 存在单一 super-outlier 通道（3848），在所有 token 位置、跨前半网络层持续激活，幅值可达次大离群值的 5 倍，类似网络学到的常量偏置；Llama 中主导通道逐层变化且量级相当。2）剪除该通道使 LLaDA GSM8K 准确率从 79% 掉到 0%（-83%），输出退化为重复随机 token 循环；而剪除 Llama 最大幅值通道仅 -4%。3）LLaDA 几乎所有层（尤其前 10+ 层）表示近乎共线、冗余极高；将 outlier 置零后冗余部分缓解但仍高于 Llama。Llama 呈相反模式（早期层多样、深层冗余）。DREAM-7B 因由 Qwen-2.5-7B 微调而来，相似度结构几乎与 Qwen 相同，不具该特征。4）α_Hill 在 LLaDA 早期层极低（重尾、已过训练），Llama 则平坦；与 super-outlier 集中于早期层一致。5）压缩：LLaDA 明显更鲁棒，50% 稀疏下 GSM8K 精度约为 Llama 两倍；3-bit GPTQ 下 LLaDA GSM8K 仅 -1.8%，Llama -64.7%，且 3-bit 时 LLaDA 在 QnA 上反超。6）最优稀疏分配方向相反：Llama 上 early-is-sparser 总是次优，uniform 或 deeper-is-sparser 最佳；LLaDA 上 EIS 或 uniform 最佳（仅 0.7 稀疏 QnA 时 DIS 显著占优，作者推测因高稀疏开始不得不剪到与 super-outlier 相连的权重）。7）160M 对照：DLM-160M 早期层相似度 0.877 vs AR-160M 0.818，深层 0.787 vs 0.829（关系反转）；DLM 早期层 α_Hill 更低；压缩下 DLM 损失更小，最优分配为 EIS（AR 为 DIS）；量化时 DLM 自 2-bit 起超过 AR。DLM-160M 未出现 super-outlier（作者指出需 >6.7B 规模）。
AI.conclusion: DLM 的扩散训练目标从根本上重塑了层级动态：早期层被一个持续激活的 super-outlier 通道主导而坍塌为冗余结构，机制是"过训练"而非"欠训练"，与 AR 模型"深层冗余"的规律相反。因此，来自 AR 的层间压缩启发式在 DLM 上不只是次优而是方向性错误：DLM 可被更激进地压缩，且应优先压缩早期层。实践上 DLM 对量化与剪枝都异常鲁棒（如 3-bit GPTQ 仅 -1.8%）。局限：结论主要基于 LLaDA-8B 与 Llama-3.1-8B 一对模型，160M 对照未复现 super-outlier，且当前大多 DLM 由 AR 权重微调而来故保留原动态；作者呼吁开展多规模（350M–16B）大规模 DLM 预训练研究，并探究 super-outlier 的成因与是否有益、能否通过改进预训练使各层表示更具区分度。

title: A Unified Pair-GRPO Family: From Implicit to Explicit Preference Constraints for Stable and General RL Alignment
summary: Large language model (LLM) alignment via reinforcement learning from human preferences (RLHF) suffers from unstable policy updates, ambiguous gradient directions, poor interpretability, and high gradient variance in mainstream pairwise preference learning paradigms. To systematically address these limitations, we establish a unified theoretical framework for preference-based RL optimization centered on the Pair-GRPO family, comprising two tightly coupled variants: Soft-Pair-GRPO and Hard-Pair-GRPO. Soft-Pair-GRPO is a minimal modification of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that replaces group-normalized scalar rewards with binary pairwise preference rewards, retaining GRPO's clipped surrogate and KL-regularized structure. We prove a critical gradient equivalence theorem: under first-order Taylor expansion around the current policy, Soft-Pair-GRPO's gradient is a positive scalar multiple of standard GRPO's gradient, explaining its empirical stability despite discarding continuous reward magnitudes. Building on this foundation, we propose Hard-Pair-GRPO, an advanced variant introducing explicit local probability constraints and constrained KL-fitting optimization to further suppress gradient noise and global policy drift. We provide comprehensive theoretical guarantees for both variants--including monotonic policy improvement, deterministic gradient direction, gradient-variance reduction, and dynamic step-size convergence. Extensive experiments on standard LLM alignment benchmarks (HH-RLHF,UltraFeedback) and the MuJoCo continuous control task HalfCheetah-v4 demonstrate that our Pair-GRPO family consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in alignment quality, human preference win rate, training stability, and generalization to general reinforcement learning. Ablation studies validate the critical contributions of each core component.

AI.tldr: arXiv 全文是另一篇论文《Ordinal Credit Assignment: Multi-Step Reinforcement Learning from Comparisons Alone》（Hao Yu），与所给标题/摘要（Pair-GRPO，Soft/Hard-Pair-GRPO，面向 LLM 对齐）内容不一致，以下分析基于全文。该文研究"只用成对比较、无任何标量奖励与奖励模型"的多步 RL：每步用同组仍在运行的轨迹之间的比较胜负作为优势，理论上证明其期望更新等于把回报-到-go 替换为"对同刻存活群体的胜率"的策略梯度（Theorem 1），并证明近平局噪声与位置偏置不改变更新方向、独立翻转会将其削弱、比较训练的 critic 作为控制变量不改变期望更新；实验（6 个环境、预注册、10 种子）显示比较信号在同等粒度下与 GRPO 无显著差异、在 LunarLander 上优于 PPO，但在 HalfCheetah 上仍比标量奖励 PPO 差约 2–3 倍；LLM 评审实验中"比较"比"打分"准确 7–10 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 策略梯度方法需要标量奖励，但许多任务无法写出完整目标函数，手写奖励会引入偏差并被策略利用；对两个结果做"哪更好"的比较往往比打分更容易也更可靠。已有工作（GRPO 类胜率/排序优势、RLOO 基线、自博弈）已在响应级或轨迹级使用组内胜率，但尚未解决：比较信号如何用于多步任务的逐步信用分配、这类更新究竟在优化什么、以及在真实 LLM 评审的标签噪声（近平局、位置偏置）下的行为。作者因此提出一个更基础的问题：只用比较信号（无奖励函数、无奖励模型），强化学习能做到什么？
AI.method: 设置：回合制 MDP，每次更新从同一初始状态采样 K 条轨迹；在选定时间点对当时仍在运行的轨迹两两比较，得到标签 c_t^{ij}∈{-1,0,+1}（允许平局，反对称），算法完全看不到 r 与回报-到-go G。逐步比较优势：Â_t^i = 归一化后的对其他存活轨迹的平均比较结果（按 batch 标准差缩放、不再中心化），直接代入 PPO-clip 代理目标。比较训练的 critic：用 Bradley–Terry 损失在相同标签上训练状态排序器 V_φ，并从优势中减去"仅由两个状态可预测的比较"部分（控制变量），且必须先用上一批的 critic 计算优势、再用当前批标签训练 critic。比较预算：每隔 L 步比较全部配对、窗口内动作共享窗口起点的优势。理论结果：Proposition 1（优势等于中心化秩，对被比较量的任意严格单调变换不变，而 GRPO 的 z-score 只对仿射不变）；Lemma 1（单步时优势对动作无偏，期望更新等于对"冻结当前策略"的胜率的梯度）；Proposition 2（确定性奖励下仅最优策略稳定、可改进策略不稳定）；Proposition 3（随机奖励下胜率最优可能期望更低，GRPO 的组内标准化同样有此失败）；Proposition 4（独立翻转把更新按 1-2ε 缩放；近平局集中噪声保持方向；位置偏置只增方差）；Proposition 5（critic 作为控制变量不改变期望更新）；Theorem 1（多步期望更新 = 策略梯度中把 G_t 换成 c_t·u_t(G_t)，其中 u_t 是对同刻存活群体的胜率、c_t=1-(1-p_t)^{K-1} 是至少有一条对手存活的权重）；Proposition 6（确定性环境：按真实 Q 排序、最优策略稳定、可改进策略不稳定），并用精确枚举与随机 MDP 做了数值校验。实验协议：CartPole/Acrobot/LunarLander/Hopper/HalfCheetah/MiniGrid DoorKey-5×5，K=8、每更新 8192 步、共享 PPO-clip 设置，全部主结论预注册（检验、校正、决策规则先于实验写下），10 种子、Welch t 检验 + Holm 校正、TOST 等效/非劣检验。
AI.result: ① 与标量 GRPO 同粒度比较：各环境差异均不显著，仅在 LunarLander 上确立 10% 等效（262±4 vs 252±13），其余因种子方差过大无法判定。② 与带 critic 的 PPO 长期训练比较：LunarLander 上非劣且显著更优（p=0.009），Hopper 上非劣未确立，HalfCheetah 上 PPO 约好 3 倍（4488 vs 1481）。③ critic 变体在 HalfCheetah 显著优于无 critic（p=0.013，AUC p=0.006），Hopper 方差最小；"仅模型给优势"变体先快后衰（策略沿动作维度利用 critic 误差，而状态对排序准确率恒为 0.67）；双重稳健组合不更优；GiGPO 在连续控制中退化为轨迹级分组。④ 与"同一批比较学奖励模型+PPO"相比总体可比，在 LunarLander 上显著更差（RM 仅能解释 70% 比较）；轨迹级自博弈 SPO 在 Hopper 更好但 LunarLander 很差（102）、DoorKey 上慢 22%。⑤ DoorKey：所有比较方法 100% 成功，AUC 与 PPO/GRPO 无可测差异。⑥ LLM 评审：比较（排序/成对）比 0–10 打分准确高 7.2–10.5 个百分点，且更强的评审差距更大（它排序更准但打分更差，因打分两极化、约一半成平局）；近平局处各格式都接近随机。⑦ 用 LLM 评审纯比较训练 LunarLeft（手写奖励未包含"落在左半边"要求）：v1 描述因缺少速度/触腿信息全部坠毁，v2 后 5 个种子全部习得该要求（左半边占比 0.97–1.00 vs 0.52），但落地率仅 27%（oracle 比较为 92%），预注册扩展规则未通过，故止于 5 种子。⑧ 标签噪声（25% 翻转）：独立翻转使无 critic 方法崩溃（70±79），近平局与位置偏置几乎无影响；critic 变体对独立翻转也稳健。⑨ 比较预算：每 10 步比较全部配对（约 10% 标签）几乎保留性能，而每步只比一对（15%）尤其在 HalfCheetah 上退化。⑩ 超参敏感性：LunarLander 上比较比 PPO 稳健得多（0.89 vs 0.54），Acrobot 上相反（0.74 vs 0.92），"最不敏感"的说法被预注册检验否定。⑪ 预注册中被推翻的预测：双重稳健会有帮助、SPO 在 Hopper 强、比较比 PPO 慢 10–15%、更强评审缩小差距等。
AI.conclusion: 纯比较信号（无奖励函数、无奖励模型）在多步任务中可以替代标量奖励：它给出方向明确的低方差更新，只依赖排序而非幅度，对真实评审中普遍存在的近平局错误与位置偏置具有鲁棒性，且能传递手写奖励中缺失的自然语言要求。实践指南：把标签预算集中在少数时间点的全配对比较而非每步一对；让 LLM 评审做排序/成对而非打分（一次列表排序即可得到全部 K(K-1)/2 标签）；允许平局；状态分叉明显且标签充足时使用"比较训练的 critic"但必须保留观测比较项（绝不让学习模型单独提供优势）；若逐步奖励对比较的解释度低则直接比较而非拟合奖励模型；注意随机结果下该更新优化的是胜率而非期望回报，稀有的大损失会被低估。局限：多数标签仍来自环境回报，LLM 评审训练仅单任务 5 种子试点；需可重置的模拟器与共享初始状态；HalfCheetah 上仍比标量 PPO 低约 2 倍；探索受限（全体失败的组内比较无信号）；函数逼近与随机动力学下的全局收敛仍未解决。此外需注意：所给标题/摘要（Pair-GRPO、Soft/Hard-Pair-GRPO、HH-RLHF/UltraFeedback）与所附 arXiv 全文并非同一篇论文，两者不应混同引用。

title: MinMax Recurrent Neural Cascades
summary: We show that the MinMax algebra provides a form of recurrence that is expressively powerful, efficiently implementable, and most importantly it is not affected by vanishing or exploding gradient. We call MinMax Recurrent Neural Cascades (RNCs) the models obtained by cascading several layers of neurons that employ such recurrence. We show that MinMax RNCs enjoy many favourable theoretical properties. First, their formal expressivity includes all regular languages, arguably the maximal expressivity for a finite-memory system. Second, they can be evaluated in parallel with a runtime that is logarithmic in the input length given enough processors; and they can also be evaluated sequentially. Third, their state and activations are bounded uniformly for all input lengths. Fourth, at almost all points, their loss gradient exists and it is bounded. Fifth, they do not exhibit a vanishing state gradient: the gradient of a state w.r.t. a past state can have constant value one regardless of the time distance between the two states. Finally, we find empirical evidence that the favourable theoretical properties of MinMax RNCs are matched by their practical capabilities: they are able to perfectly solve a number of synthetic tasks, showing superior performance compared to the considered state-of-the-art recurrent neural networks; also, we train a MinMax RNC of 127M parameters on next-token prediction, and the obtained model shows competitive performance for its size, providing evidence of the potential of MinMax RNCs on real-world tasks.

AI.tldr: MinMax algebra enables RNNs that avoid vanishing/exploding gradients, achieve full regular language expressivity, and scale efficiently with bounded states—validated by strong synthetic and real-world task performance.
AI.motivation: Address vanishing and exploding gradient problems in traditional RNNs while maintaining expressive power and efficient implementation.
AI.method: Cascade multiple layers of neurons using MinMax algebra-based recurrence to create MinMax Recurrent Neural Cascades (RNCs); evaluate both theoretically and empirically.
AI.result: Theoretically: (1) Expressivity includes all regular languages; (2) Parallel evaluation with logarithmic runtime; (3) Uniformly bounded states and activations; (4) Gradient exists and bounded; (5) No vanishing state gradient (constant gradient regardless of time distance). Empirically: (1) Perfect performance on synthetic tasks, outperforming state-of-the-art RNNs; (2) 127M parameter model achieves competitive performance on next-token prediction.
AI.conclusion: MinMax RNCs demonstrate favorable theoretical properties (bounded states, non-vanishing gradients) that translate to practical capabilities, achieving perfect performance on synthetic tasks and competitive results on real-world next-token prediction with 127M parameters.

title: Data-Driven Covariate Selection for Nonparametric and Cycle-Agnostic Causal Effect Estimation
summary: Estimating causal effects from observational data requires identifying valid adjustment sets. This task is especially challenging in realistic settings where latent confounding and feedback loops are present. Existing approaches typically assume acyclicity or rely on global causal structure learning, limiting applicability and computational efficiency. In this work, we study a local, data-driven method for covariate selection based on conditional independence information. While this method is known to be sound and complete in acyclic causal models, its validity in the presence of cycles has remained unclear. Our main contribution is to show that these guarantees extend to cyclic causal models. In particular, our result relies on the invariance of conditional independence assertions under $σ$-acyclification. These findings establish a unified, cycle-agnostic perspective on covariate selection and causal effect estimation, showing that the method applies across cyclic and acyclic settings without modification. Empirically, we validate this on extensive synthetic data, showing reliable performance in cyclic causal models.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了基于条件独立信息的局部协变量选择方法在循环因果模型中同样有效，建立了统一的无环性无关协变量选择框架。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据估计因果效应需要识别有效的调整集，但在存在潜在混杂和反馈回路的现实场景中，这一任务极具挑战性。现有方法通常假设因果图无环或依赖全局因果结构学习，限制了适用性和计算效率。
AI.method: 利用条件独立信息进行局部数据驱动的协变量选择方法。该方法的核心理论依据是条件独立断言在σ-非循环化下的不变性性质。
AI.result: 证明了该方法在循环因果模型中同样具备可靠性和完备性保证，其理论保证可从无环模型扩展到有环模型。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在循环和非循环因果模型中均可适用，无需修改，为协变量选择和因果效应估计提供了统一的无环性无关视角。通过广泛的合成数据实验验证了该方法在循环因果模型中的可靠性能。

title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation: Bridging Exploitation and Imitation at the Token Level
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with token-level teacher feedback and often outperforms off-policy distillation and standard reinforcement learning. However, we find that its standard advantage weighted policy gradient suffers from three structural weaknesses, including high variance updates, vanishing gradients in zero-advantage regions, and exploration bottlenecks when corrective signals are insufficient.We therefore propose Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation (AOPD), which replaces ineffective negative reinforcement with localized divergence minimization in non-positive advantage regions while preserving positive reinforcement learning. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that AOPD consistently outperforms standard OPD, with average gains of 4.09 / 8.34 under strong / weak initialization, respectively. AOPD also maintains higher policy entropy during training and better capability retention during sequential tool-use adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对标准on-policy蒸馏(OPD)的优势加权策略梯度方法的三个结构性问题（高方差更新、零优势区域梯度消失、探索瓶颈），提出非对称on-policy蒸馏(AOPD)，通过在非正优势区域用局部散度最小化替代无效负强化，同时保留正强化学习。实验表明AOPD在数学推理基准上显著优于标准OPD，尤其在弱初始化条件下增益达8.34。
AI.motivation: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) with advantage weighted policy gradient suffers from three structural weaknesses: high variance updates, vanishing gradients in zero-advantage regions, and exploration bottlenecks when corrective signals are insufficient.
AI.method: AOPD replaces ineffective negative reinforcement with localized divergence minimization in non-positive advantage regions while preserving positive reinforcement learning, targeting high variance updates, vanishing gradients, and exploration bottlenecks.
AI.result: AOPD consistently outperforms standard OPD on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, with average gains of 4.09/8.34 under strong/weak initialization. It maintains higher policy entropy during training and demonstrates better capability retention during sequential tool-use adaptation.
AI.conclusion: AOPD effectively addresses OPD's structural weaknesses, achieving 4.09/8.34 gains on mathematical reasoning under strong/weak initialization, with higher policy entropy and better sequential tool-use adaptation capability retention.

title: Consistent Geometric Deep Learning via Hilbert Bundles and Cellular Sheaves
summary: Modern deep learning architectures increasingly contend with sophisticated signals that are natively infinite-dimensional, such as time series, probability distributions, or operators, and are defined over irregular domains. Yet, a unified learning theory for these settings has been lacking. To start addressing this gap, we introduce a novel convolutional learning framework for possibly infinite-dimensional signals supported on a manifold. Namely, we use the connection Laplacian associated with a Hilbert bundle as a convolutional operator, and we derive filters and neural networks, dubbed as \textit{HilbNets}. We make HilbNets and, more generally, the convolution operation, implementable via a two-stage sampling procedure. First, we show that sampling the manifold induces a Hilbert Cellular Sheaf, a generalized graph structure with Hilbert feature spaces and edge-wise coupling rules, and we prove that its sheaf Laplacian converges in probability to the underlying connection Laplacian as the sampling density increases. Notably, this result is a generalization to the infinite-dimensional bundle setting of the Belkin \& Niyogi \cite{BELKIN20081289} convergence result for the graph Laplacian to the manifold Laplacian, a theoretical cornerstone of geometric learning methods. Second, we discretize the signals and prove that the discretized (implementable) HilbNets converge to the underlying continuous architectures and are transferable across different samplings of the same bundle, providing consistency for learning. Finally, we validate our framework on synthetic and real-world tasks. Overall, our results broaden the scope of geometric learning as a whole by lifting classical Laplacian-based frameworks to settings where the signal at each point lives in its own Hilbert space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 "HilbNets"：以 Hilbert 束（纤维为可无限维 Hilbert 空间）上的连接 Laplacian Δ_∇ 作为卷积算子，构建处理流形上无限维信号（时间序列、概率分布等）的卷积网络；通过"流形采样 + 信号采样"两阶段离散化，把连续框架实现为网络层（network sheaf）上的 sheaf 神经网络，并证明离散 sheaf Laplacian 以概率收敛到连续连接 Laplacian（首次把 Belkin & Niyogi 2008 的图 Laplacian→Laplace-Beltrami 收敛定理推广到无限维束与任意联络），进而证明离散网络在 MSE 下收敛到连续架构且可跨采样迁移（分辨率一致性）。实验在信息几何合成任务与 METR-LA/PEMS-BAY 交通预测上验证。
AI.motivation: 现代深度学习所处理的信号日益呈现"每点一个无限维对象"的结构：节点上的时间序列、概率分布（测度）、算子等，定义在不规则流形/图域上。现有几何深度学习工作（CNN、GCN、单纯复形/胞腔复形网络、切丛束网络、胞形层/网络层神经网络）均假设纤维有限维，且隐含假设 Levi-Civita 或平坦联络，无法覆盖真正无限维的流形信号（如时空场、分布信号、量子态）。更根本的障碍是理论缺口：Belkin & Niyogi (2008) 的"图 Laplacian 依概率收敛到流形 Laplace-Beltrami 算子"是几何学习的理论基石，但其结论未推广到带任意联络的无限维束；缺少该类推广，就无法给出"离散化模型与连续模型一致、跨分辨率可迁移"的理论保证。
AI.method: 框架分三层。(1) 连续层：在闭 Riemann 流形 M 上定义 Hilbert 束 (M, E, ∇)，信号为 L² 截面（S 为 Bochner 积分意义），用 Fréchet 意义下的联络定义自伴连接 Laplacian Δ_∇ = ∇*∇；通过 Borel 泛函演算定义卷积滤波 g⋆_{Δ_∇}S := g(Δ_∇)S（g 为有界紧支撑 Borel 函数），并堆叠滤波与逐纤维逐点非线性得到连续模型 HilbNet Ω(E, Δ_∇, W, σ)。(2) 空间离散化：对 M 作 iid 均匀采样 X_n = {x_i}，取测地中点 m_ij，构造 Hilbert 胞形层：节点 stalk = E_{x_i}，边 stalk = E_{m_ij}，限制映射为 √k^t_{ij} P_{x_i→m_ij}（k^t_{ij}=exp(−d_M²/4t)），由此定义 Hilbert sheaf Laplacian Δ_{F^t_n}（自伴有界），它把标量边权替换为平行移动算子。(3) 信号离散化：用纤维 Hilbert 空间正交基的截断投影 Π_d（Kuiper 定理保证存在有限秩逼近子束序列，且投影与联络相容）得到 d 维 stalk 的网络层 F^t_{n,d}，其 Laplacian 为 nd×nd 块矩阵 Δ_{ij} = Σ_r k^t_{ir} I_d (i=j)、−k^t_{ij} P^{(d,e_ij)}_{j→i} (i≠j)。可实现的 (n,d)-HilbNet 取多项式滤波时写成 sheaf 神经网络形式 S^{ℓ+1} = σ(Σ_k (Δ)^k S^ℓ W_{ℓ,k})。实践上平行移动可由已知几何给出（任务先验）、由 RKHS 核最大化对齐给出（域先验）、或端到端学习，并限制在假设类 C ⊆ O(d) 内：冻结单位阵（退化为 GCN）、正交循环矩阵（时间平移不变先验，仅 ⌊(T−1)/2⌋ 个相位参数/边）、Householder 乘积自由 O(d)（Cartan–Dieudonné）。理论上引入点云延拓算子 Δ̂_{F^t_n}，使 sheaf 与 bundle 层算子可在同一 L² 空间比较，并做偏差-方差分解（bias O(t²)、variance O(1/(n t^{2+m/2}))）。
AI.result: 理论结果：定理 1（Hilbert sheaf Laplacian 收敛）——对 m 维闭流形、Fréchet 相容联络、C³ 截面，带宽 t_n = n^{-1/(m+2+α)} 时，(1/[t_n(4πt_n)^{m/2}])Δ̂ S(x) 依概率收敛到 Δ_∇S(x)/vol(M)；C⁴ 截面时进一步有 E‖·‖²_{L²} → 0（依 L² 范数），这同时推广了 Belkin–Niyogi (2008) 与向量扩散图结果 (2008)，并在 E = M×R 时退化为经典结论。定理 2（有限秩逼近）：存在确定性递增序列 d_n，使纤维截断后的有限秩 sheaf Laplacian 收敛到 Δ_∇S（在 E‖·‖²_{L²} 意义下）。推论 2.1（架构收敛）：离散 (n,d_n)-HilbNet 与连续 HilbNet 在 MSE 下收敛（经 Borel 演算与 Lipschitz 非线性的逐层误差递推证明）。推论 2.2（可迁移性）：对同一束的两次独立采样，输出的 L² 差异期望趋于 0，并给出与采样无关的定量上界；文中还论证 CNN/GNN/规范等变网络/时空 GNN 均可视为特定束与联络下的 HilbNet 实例。实验：合成任务中自由 O(m) 类以 ≈2×10⁻⁷ 精度复原 Levi-Civita 平行移动，各受限类收敛到解析 Frobenius 投影平台（偏差 ≤0.05%）；sheaf Laplacian 的低频谱随采样密度单调稳定。交通预测（METR-LA 207 传感器 / PEMS-BAY 325 传感器，T=12，2 层 sheaf 卷积，K=2）：学习非平凡 transport 的一律优于冻结单位阵；METR-LA 上 free O(T) 最佳（h=12 MAE 3.938 vs circulant 4.059 vs GCN 4.608），circulant 用约 1/10 参数（11,656 vs 119,036）取得可比性能，两数据集上均优于 FC-LSTM，但整体仍不及参数规模大得多的 STAEformer。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于三点：首次为无限维纤维、任意联络的流形信号建立基于连接 Laplacian 的统一卷积学习框架（HilbNets）；给出 Hilbert 束与 Hilbert 胞形层之间的首个严格联系，并把 Belkin–Niyogi 收敛定理推广到该设定；由此建立"离散实现—连续架构"的一致性与跨采样（分辨率）迁移保证，并在合成与真实交通数据上验证学习非平凡平行移动（信号级几何先验）能带来一致增益。作者也指出局限：理论假设闭流形、充分光滑信号、均匀 iid 采样，而真实传感器网络既非均匀采样也不在紧流形上、信号含噪；sheaf Laplacian 规模随空间×纤维维数二次增长，需靠稀疏 kNN 图与结构化 transport 控制；其他无限维信号类型（如流形上的函数型数据）尚待验证。未来方向包括 sheaf 谱聚类/特征映射、结构化自监督学习，以及把收敛与迁移机器引入 Transformer（视位置编码为流形采样点、残差流表示为 Hilbert 束截面、自注意力为学习到的 sheaf 扩散）的一般化理论与机制可解释性（用注意力的 holonomy 检测头部实现的几何变换）。

title: SparseForge: Efficient Semi-Structured LLM Sparsification via Annealing of Hessian-Guided Soft-Mask
summary:
Semi-structured sparsity provides a practical path to accelerate large language models (LLMs) with native hardware support, but post-training semi-structured pruning often suffers from substantial quality degradation due to strong structural coupling. Existing methods rely on large-scale sparse retraining to recover accuracy, resulting in high computational cost.
  We propose SparseForge, a post-training framework that improves recovery efficiency by directly optimizing the sparsity mask rather than scaling up retraining tokens. SparseForge combines Hessian-aware importance estimation with progressive annealing of soft masks into hardware-executable structured sparsity, enabling stable and efficient sparse recovery. On LLaMA-2-7B under 2:4 sparsity, SparseForge achieves 57.27% average zero-shot accuracy with only $\textbf{5B}$ retraining tokens, surpassing the dense model's 56.43% accuracy and approaching the 57.52% result of a state-of-the-art method using $\textbf{40B}$ tokens. Such improvements on the accuracy-efficiency trade-off from SparseForge are shown to be consistent across model families.

AI.tldr: SparseForge是一个后训练剪枝框架，通过Hessian感知的重要性估计和软掩码渐进退火策略，直接优化稀疏掩码而非增加训练数据量。在LLaMA-2-7B的2:4稀疏度下，仅用5B tokens即达到57.27%准确率，超越密集模型并接近使用40B tokens的SOTA方法，显著改善了精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练半结构化剪枝方法面临严重的质量退化问题，主要源于权重间的结构耦合效应。传统解决方案依赖大规模稀疏重训练（如40B tokens）来恢复精度，导致计算成本极高。作者认为直接在稀疏掩码层面进行优化可能比单纯增加训练数据量更为高效。
AI.method: SparseForge采用Hessian感知的重要性估计来评估权重重要性，并结合软掩码的渐进退火（progressive annealing）策略将软稀疏模式逐步转化为硬件可执行的2:4结构化稀疏。该方法跳过了传统方法依赖大规模稀疏重训练恢复精度的范式，直接在稀疏掩码层面进行优化。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-2-7B上应用2:4稀疏度，SparseForge仅使用5B重训练tokens即达到57.27%的平均零样本准确率，显著超越密集模型基线（56.43%），逼近使用40B tokens的SOTA方法（57.52%）。该精度-效率权衡的优势在其他模型家族中也得到验证。
AI.conclusion: SparseForge在极少的5B tokens条件下即可超越密集模型基线（56.43%），接近使用40B tokens的SOTA方法（57.52%），证明了直接优化稀疏掩码而非增加训练数据量是一种更高效的稀疏恢复路径。该方法在多个模型家族中表现一致，展现出良好的泛化能力。

title: FRInGe: Distribution-Space Integrated Gradients with Fisher--Rao Geometry
summary: Gradient-based attribution methods are model-faithful and scalable, but Integrated Gradients (IG) can be brittle because explanations depend on heuristic baselines, straight-line paths, discretization, and saturation. We propose Fisher--Rao Integrated Gradients (FRInGe), which defines both the reference and interpolation schedule in predictive distribution space. FRInGe replaces input baselines with a maximum-entropy predictive reference and follows a Fisher-Rao geodesic on the probability simplex. The corresponding input-space trajectory is realized through the pullback Fisher metric and stabilized by KL and Euclidean trust regions; attributions are obtained by integrating input gradients along this trajectory. Across six ImageNet architectures, FRInGe most clearly improves calibration-oriented attribution metrics, especially MAS scores, while remaining competitive on perturbation AUC and infidelity.

AI.tldr: FRInGe proposes a new integrated gradients method that operates in predictive distribution space using Fisher-Rao geodesic interpolation instead of traditional input-space baselines, addressing brittleness issues through pullback Fisher metric and trust region stabilization, demonstrating improved performance on calibration metrics across multiple architectures.
AI.motivation: Integrated Gradients (IG) suffers from brittleness due to reliance on heuristic baselines, straight-line paths, discretization, and saturation effects. The authors seek a more principled approach that operates in predictive distribution space rather than input space.
AI.method: FRInGe uses a maximum-entropy predictive reference instead of input baselines and follows a Fisher-Rao geodesic on the probability simplex. The input-space trajectory is realized through pullback Fisher metric, stabilized by KL and Euclidean trust regions. Attribution is obtained by integrating input gradients along this trajectory.
